
padma-purāṇaḥ

==I==
sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍaḥ

(1)
prathamo'dhyāyaḥ 

auṃ śrī-viṣṇave namaḥ || 
auṃ svacchaṃ candrāvadātaṃ kari-kara-makara-kṣobha-saṃjātaphenaṃ 
brahmodbhūti-prasaktair vrata-niyama-paraiḥ sevitaṃ vipra-mukhyaiḥ |
auṃ kārālaṅkṛtena tribhuvana-guruṇā brahmaṇā dṛṣṭi-pūtaṃ 
sambhogābhoga-ramyaṃ jalam aśubha-haraṃ pauṣkaraṃ vaḥ punātu ||1||

sūtam ekaṃ tam āsīnaṃ vyāsa-śiṣyaṃ mahā-matiḥ |
lomaharṣaṇa-nāmā vā ugraśravasam āha tat ||2|
ṛṣīṇām āśramāṃs tāta gatvā dharmān samāsataḥ |
pṛcchatāṃ vistarād brūhi yan mattaḥ śrutavān asi ||3||
veda-vyāsān mayā putra purāṇāny akhilāni ca |
tavākhyātāni prāptāni munibhyo vada-vistarāt ||4||
prayāge muni-varyaiś ca yathā pṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
pṛṣṭena cānuśiṣṭās te munayo dharma-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||5||
deśaṃ puṇyam abhīpsanto vibhunā ca hitaiṣiṇā |
sunābhaṃ divya-rūpaJca satyagaṃ śubha-vikramaṃ ||6||
anaupamyam idaṃ cakraṃ vartamānam atandritāḥ |
pṛṣṭato yāta-niyamāt padaṃ prāpsyatha yad dhitam ||7||
gacchato dharma-cakrasya yatra nemir viśīryate |
puṇyaḥ sa deśo mantavya ity uvāca svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||8||
uktvā caivam ṛṣīn sarvān adṛśyatvam agāt punaḥ |
gaṅgāvarta-samāhāro nemir yatra vyaśīryata ||9|| 
ījire dīrgha-satreṇa ṛṣayo naimiṣe tadā |
tatra gatvā tu tān brūhi pṛcchato dharma-saṃśayān ||10||
ugraśravās tato gatvā jñānavin muni-puṅgavān |
abhigamyopasaṅgṛhya namaskṛtvā kṛtāṣjaliḥ ||11||
toṣayāmāsa medhāvī praṇipātena tān ṛṣīn |
te cāpi satriṇaḥ prītāḥ sa sadasyā mahātmane ||12||
 tasmai sametya pūjāṃ ca yathāvat pratipedire |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ---
kutas tvam āgataḥ sūta kasmād deśād ihāgataḥ ||13||
kāraṇaṃ cāgame brūhi vṛndāraka-sama-dyute |
sūta uvāca—
pitrāhaṃ tu samādiṣṭo vyāsa-śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā ||14||
śuśrūṣasva munīn gatvā yat te pṛcchanti tad vada |
vadantu bhagavanto māṃ kathayāmi kathāṃ tu yāṃ ||15||
purāṇaṃ cetihāsaṃ vā dharmān atha pṛthag-vidhān |
tāṃ giraṃ madhurāṃ tasya śuśruvur ṛṣi-sattamāḥ ||16||
atha teṣāṃ purāṇasya śuśrūṣā samapadyata |
dṛṣṭvā tam ativiśvastaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ laumaharṣaṇiṃ ||17||
tasmin satre kula-patiḥ sarva-śāstra-viśāradaḥ |
śaunako nāma medhāvī vijṣānāraṇyake guruḥ ||18||
itthaṃ tad-bhāvam ālambya dharmān śuśrūṣur āhatam |
tvayā sūta mahā-buddhe bhagavān brahma-vittamaḥ ||
itihāsa-purāṇārthaṃ vyāsaḥ samyag upāsitaḥ ||19||
dudohithamatiṃ tasya tvaṃ purāṇāśrayāṃ śubhām ||20||
amīṣāṃ vipra-mukhyānāṃ purāṇaṃ prati samprati |
śuśrūṣā''ste mahā-buddhetachrāvayitum arhasi ||21||
sarvehīmemahātmānonānāgotrāḥ samāgatāḥ |
svān svān aṃśān purāṇoktāṣ chṛṇvantu brahma-vādinaḥ ||22||
sampūrṇe dīrgha-satre’smiṃs tāṃs tvaṃ śrāvaya vai munīn |
pādmaṃ purāṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ kathayasva mahā-mate ||23||
kathaṃ padmaṃ samudbhūtaṃ brahma tatra kathaṃ nv abhūt |
prodbhūtena kathaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā tāṃ tu tathā vada ||24||
evaṃ pṛṣṭas tatas tāṃs tu pratyuvāca śubhāṃ giram |
sūkṣmaṃ ca nyāya-saṃyuktaṃ prābravīd raumaharṣaṇiḥ ||25||
prīto’smy anugṛhīto’smi bhavadbhir iha codanāt |
purāṇārthaṃ purāṇa-jṣaiḥ sarva-dharma-parāyaṇaiḥ ||26||
yathā-śrutaṃ suvikhyātaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ |
dharma eṣa tu sūtasya sadbhir dṛṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ ||27||
devatānām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca rājṣāṃ cāmita-tejasām |
vaṃśānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ stutīnāṃ ca mahātmanām ||28||
itihāsa-purāṇeṣu dṛṣṭāye brahma-vādinaḥ |
na hi vedeṣv adhīkāraḥ kaścit sūtasyadṛśyate ||29||
vainyasyahipṛthoryajṣevarttamānemahātmanaḥ |
māgadhaś caiva sūtaś ca tamastautāṃ nareśvaram ||30||
tuṣṭenāthatayorddattovarorājṣāmahātmanā |
sūtāya sūta-viṣayo magadho māgadhāya ca ||31||
tatra sūtyāṃ samutpannaḥ sūto nāmeha jāyate |
aindre satre pravṛtte tu graha-yukte bṛhaspatau ||32||
tam evaindraṃ bārhaspatye tatra sūto vyajāyata |
śiṣya-hastena yat pṛktam abhibhūtaṃ guror haviḥ ||33||
adharottara-dhāreṇa jajṣe tad-varṇa-saṅkaram |
yetrakṣatrāt samabhavan brāhmaṇyāś caiva yonitaḥ ||34||
pūrveṇaiva tu sādharmyād vai dharmās te prakīrtitāḥ |
madhyamo hy eṣa sūtasya dharmaḥ kṣetropajīvinaḥ ||35||
purāṇeṣv adhikāro me vihito brāhmaṇair iha |
dṛṣṭvā dharmam ahaṃ pṛṣṭo bhavadbhir brahma-vādibhiḥ ||36||
tasmāt samyag bhuvi brūyāṃ purāṇam ṛṣi-pūjitam |
pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā vāsavaṃ samapadyata ||37||
apadhyātā ca pitṛbhir matsya-garbhe babhūva sā |
araṇīva hutāśasya nimittaṃ puṇya-janmanaḥ ||38||
tasyāṃ babhūva pūtātmā maharṣis tu parāśarāt |
tasmai bhagavate kṛtvā namaḥ satyāya vedhase ||39||
puruṣāya purāṇāya brahmavākyānuvartine |
mānavacchadmarūpāya viṣṇaveśaṃ sitātmane ||40||
jātamātraṃ cayaṃ vedaupatasthesasaṅgrahaḥ |
matimaṃ thānamāvidhyayenāsauśrutisāgarāt ||41||
prakāśojanitolokemahā-bhāratacandramāḥ |
bhārataṃ bhānumānviṣṇuryadinasyuramītrayaḥ ||42||
tato'jñānatamoṃ dhasyakāvasthājagatobhavet |
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ viddhinārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||43||
kohyanyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣānmahā-bhāratakṛdbhavet |
tasmād ahamupāśrauṣaṃ purāṇaṃ brahma-vādinaḥ ||44||
sarva-jṣāt sarva-lokeṣu pūjitāddīptatejasaḥ |
purāṇaṃ sarva-śāstrāṇāṃ prathamaṃ brahmaṇā smṛtam ||45||
uttamaṃ sarva-lokānāṃ sarva-jṣānopapādakam |
trivarga-sādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ śata-koṭi-pravistaram ||46||
niḥśeṣeṣu ca lokeṣu vāji--rūpeṇa keśavaḥ |
brahmaṇas tu samādeśād vedān āhṛtavān asau ||47||
aṅgāni caturo vedān purāṇanyāya vistaram |
asureṇākhilaṃ śāstram apahṛtyātma-sāt-kṛtam ||48||
matsya-rūpeṇājahāra kalpādāv udakārṇave |
aśeṣam etad avadad udakāntar-gato vibhuḥ ||49||
śrutvā jagāda ca munīn prati vedāṃś catur-mukhaḥ |
pravṛttiḥ sarva-śāstrāṇāṃ purāṇasyābhavat tadā ||50||
kālenāgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā purāṇasya tadā vibhuḥ |
vyāsa-rūpas tadā brahmā saṅgrahārthaṃ yuge yuge ||51||
catur-lakṣa-pramāṇena dvāpare dvāpare jagau |
tadāṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā bhūloke’smin prakāśitaṃ ||52||
adyāpi deva-lokeṣu śata-koṭi-pravistaram |
tad evātra catur-lakṣaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa niveśitam ||53||
pravakṣyāmi mahā-puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ pādma-saṃjṣitam |
sahasraṃ paṣca-paṣcāśat-paṣca-khaṇḍaiḥ samanvitam ||54||
tatrādau sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍaṃ syād bhūmi-khaṇḍaṃ tataḥ param |
svarga-khaṇḍaṃ tataḥ paścāt tataḥ pātālakhaṇḍakam ||55||
paṣcamaṃ ca tataḥ khyātam uttaraṃ khaṇḍam uttamam |
etadevamahā-padmamudbhūtaṃ yanmayaṃ jagat ||56||
tadvṛttāntāśrayaṃ yasmāt pādmamityucyatetataḥ ||
etatpurāṇamamalaṃ viṣṇumāhātmyanirmalam ||57||
devadevohariryadvaibrahmaṇeproktavānpurā |
brahmaṇābhihitaṃ pūrvaṃ yāvanmātraṃ marīcaye ||58||
etadeva cavaibrahmāpādmaṃ lokejagādavai |
sarva-bhūtāśrayaṃ taccapādmamityucyatebudhaiḥ ||59||
pādmaṃ tatpaṣcapaJcāśatsahasrāṇīhapaṭhyate |
paṣcabhiḥ parvabhiḥ proktaṃ saṅkṣepādvyāsakāritāt ||60||
pauṣkaraṃ prathamaṃ parvayatrotpannaḥ svayaṃ virāṭ |
dvitīyaṃ tīrthaparvasyātsarvagrahagaṇāśrayam ||61||
tṛtīyaparvagrahaṇārājānobhūridakṣiṇāḥ |
vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva caturtheparikīrtitam ||62||
paṣcamemokṣatatvaṃ casarvatatvaṃ nigadyate |
pauṣkarenavadhāsṛṣṭiḥ sarveṣāṃ brahmakāritā ||63||
devatānāṃ munīnāṃ capitṛsargastathāparaḥ |
dvitīyeparvatāś caiva dvīpāḥ saptasasāgarāḥ ||64||
tṛtīyerudrasargastudakṣaśāpastathaiva ca |
caturthe sambhavorājṣāṃ sarvavaṃśānukīrttanam ||65||
antyepavargasaṃ sthānaṃ mokṣaśāstrānukīrttanam |
sarvametatpurāṇe'smit kathayiṣyāmivodvijāḥ ||66||
idaṃ pavitraṃ yaśasonidhānam idaṃ pitṝṇāmativallabhaṃsyāt | idaṃ cadevasyasukhāya nityam idaṃ mahā-pātakabhiccapuṃ sām ||67||
iti śrī-padmapurāṇeprathame sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍe purāṇāvatāreprathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||

##dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ##

sūta uvāca—--
namasye sarva-lokānāṃ viśvasyajagataḥ patim |
yaimaṅkurutebhāvaṃ sṛṣṭirūpaṃ pradhānavit ||1||
lokakṛllokatatvajṣoyogamāsthāyayogavit |
asṛjatsarva-bhūtāni sthāvarāṇicarāṇi ca ||2||
tamajaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ citpatiṃ lokasākṣiṇam |
purāṇākhyānajijṣāsurvrajāmiśaraṇaṃ vibhum ||3||
brahmaviṣṇugirīśebhyo namaskṛtvāsamāhitaḥ |
indrāyalokapālebhyaḥ savitrecasamādhinā ||4||
munīnāṃ cavariṣṭhāyavasiṣṭhāyamahātmane |
tadvaktre bhātatapasejātūkarṇyāyacākṣuṣe ||5||
 tasmai bhagavatenatvāveda-vyāsāyavedhase |
puruṣāyapurāṇāyabhṛguvākyānuvartine ||6||
tasmād ahamupāśrauṣaṃ purāṇaṃ brahma-vādinaḥ |
sarva-jṣāt sarva-lokeṣu pūjitāddīptatejasaḥ ||7||
avyaktaṅkāraṇaṃ yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam |
mahadādiviśeṣāṃ taṃ sṛjatītiviniś ca yaḥ ||8||
aṇḍehiraṇmayepūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sūtiruttamā |
aṇḍasyāvaraṇaṃ cādbhir apāmapicatejasā ||9||
vāyunātasyavāyoḥ khāttadbhūtādita āvṛtam |
bhūtādirmahatācāpiavyaktenāvṛtomahā-n ||10||
prādurbhāvaś ca lokānām aṇḍa evopavarṇitaḥ |
nadīnāṃ parvatānāṃ caprādurbhāvonuvarṇyate ||11||
manvaṃ tarāṇāṃ saṅkṣepātkalpānāṃ copavarṇanam |
brahmavṛkṣalayabrahmaprajāsargopavarṇanam ||12||
kalpānāṃ saṃ caraś caiva jagataḥ sthāpanantathā |
śayanaṃ caharerapsupṛthivyuddharaṇaṃ punaḥ ||13||
daśadhājanmasaṃ cārobhṛguśāpenakeśave |
sanniveśoyugādīnāṃ sarvāśramavibhājanam ||14||
svargasthānavibhāgaś ca martyānāṃ svargacāriṇāṃ |
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva sambhavaḥ parikīrttitaḥ ||15||
tathāni rvacanaṅkalpaṃ svādhyāyasyaparigrahaḥ |
pratisargāḥ punaḥ proktābrahmaṇobuddhipūrvakāḥ ||16||
trayonye'buddhipūrvāstetathālokānakalpayat |
brahmaṇovadanebhyaś ca bhṛgvādīnāṃ samudbhavaḥ ||17||
kalpayoraṃ taraṃ proktaṃ pratisaṃ dhiś ca sargayoḥ |
bhṛgvādīnām ṛṣīṇāṃ caprajāsargopavarṇanam ||18||
vasiṣṭhasyacabrahmarṣerbrahmattvaṃ parikīrttitam |
svāyaṃ bhuvasyacamanostataścāpyanukīrtanam ||19||
uktonābhervisargaś ca rajasaś ca mahātmanaḥ |
dvīpānāṃ casamudrāṇāṃ parvatānāṃ cakīrtanam ||20||
dvīpabhedasamudrāṇām antarbhāvaś ca saptasu |
kīrtyanteyojanāgreṇayeca tatra nivāsinaḥ ||21||
tadīyāni cavarṣāṇinadībhiḥ parvataiḥ saha |
jaṃ būdvīpādayodvīpāḥ samudraiḥ saptabhir vṛtāḥ ||22||
aṇḍasyāṃ tastvimelokāḥ saptadvīpācamedinī |
sūryācandramasoścārograhāṇāṃ jyotiṣāṃ tathā ||23||
kīrtyatedhruvasāmarthyātprajānāṃ caśubhāśubham |
brahmaṇāni rmitaḥ sauraḥ syaṃ danorthavaśātsvayam ||24||
kalpito bhagavāṃ stenaprasarpatidivākaraḥ |
sūryādīnāṃ syaṃ danānāṃ dhruvādevapravarttanaṃ ||25||
kalpitaḥ śiṃ śumāraś ca yasyapucchedhruvaḥ sthitaḥ |
 sambhavāṃ tecasaṃ hāraḥ saṃ hārāṃ teca sambhavaḥ ||26||
devatānām ṛṣīṇāṃ camanoḥ pitṛgaṇasyaca |
naśakyaṃ vistarād vaktumityuktaṃ casamāsataḥ ||27||
atītānāgatānāṃ vaisamaṃ svāyaṃ bhuvenatu |
manvaṃ tareṣu devānāṃ prajeśānāṃ cakīrtanam ||28||
naimittikaḥ prākṛtikastathaivātyanti kaḥ smṛtaḥ |
trividhaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṅkalpitaḥ pratisaṃ caraḥ ||29||
anāvṛṣṭirbhāskarāccaghoraḥ saṃ varttakānalaḥ |
meghāś ca ikārṇavāyetutathārātrirmahātmanaḥ ||30||
saṃ dhyālakṣaṇamuddiṣṭaṃ tathābrāhmaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
bhūtānāṃ cāpilokānāṃ saptānām anuvarṇanam ||31||
saṅkīrtyaṃ temayācātrapāpānāṃ rauravādayaḥ |
sarveṣām eva satvānāṃ pariṇāmavinirṇayaḥ ||32||
brahmaṇaḥ pratisargaś ca sarvasaṃ hāravarṇanam |
kalpekalpeca##tānāṃ mahatāmapisaṅkṣayaḥ ||33||
susaṅkhyāya cabuddhvāvaibrahmaṇaścāpyanityatām |
daurātmyaṃ caiva bhogānāṃ saṃsārasyacakaṣṭatām ||34||
durllabhatvaṃ camokṣasyavair āgyāddoṣadarśanam |
vyaktāvyaktaṃ parityajya satvaṃ brahmaṇisaṃ sthitam ||35||
nānātvadarśanātsusthastatas tadabhivarttate |
tatas tāpatrayātītovirūpākhyoniraṃ janaḥ ||36||
ānaṃ daṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāptonabibhetikutaś ca na |
itikṛtyasamuddeśaḥ pramāṇasyopavarṇitaḥ ||37||
kīrtyaṃ tejagato yatra sargapralayavikriyāḥ |
pravṛttiścāpibhūtānāṃ nivṛttīnāṃ phalāni ca ||38||
prādurbhāvovasiṣṭhasyaśakterjanmatathaiva ca |
saudāsānnigrahastasyaviśvāmitrakṛtenaca ||39||
parāśarasyacotpattiradṛśyantyāṃ yathā vibho ḥ |
jajṣepitṝṇāṅkanyāyāṃ vyāsaścāpiyathāmuniḥ||40||
śukasyacayathājanmaputrasyasahadhīmataḥ |
parāśarasyavidveṣoviśvāmitrakṛtoyathā ||41||
vasiṣṭha sambhṛtaścāgnirviśvāmitrajighāṃ sayā |
saṃ dhānahetorvibhunājīrṇaḥ kaṇvenadhīmatā ||42||
devenaviprāviprāṇāṃ viśvāmitrahitaiṣiṇā |
ekaṃ vedaṃ catuḥ pādaṃ caturdhāpunarīśvaraḥ ||43||
yathābibhedabhagavānavyāsaḥ sarveṣv anugrahāt |
tasyaśiṣyapraśiṣyaiś ca śākhābhedāḥ punaḥ kṛtāḥ ||44||
prayāgemuni-varyaiś ca yathāpṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
kṛṣṇenacānuśiṣṭāste munayodharmakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||45||
etatsarvaṃ yathātatvam ākhyātaṃ dvija-sattamāḥ |
munīnāṃ dharmanityānāṃ lokataṃ tramanuttamam ||46||
brahmaṇāyatpurāproktaṃ pulastyāyamahātmane |
pulastyenāthabhīṣmāyagaṅgādvāreprabhāṣitam ||47||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvvapāpapraṇāśanam |
kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāsyadhāraṇaṃ caviśeṣataḥ ||48||
sūtenānukrameṇedaṃ purāṇaṃ samprakāśitam |
brāhmaṇeṣu purāyaccabrahmaṇoktaṃ savistaram ||49||
pādamasyavidansamyagyodhīyītajitedriyaḥ |
tenādhītaṃ purāṇaṃ syātsarvaṃ nāst yatra saṃśayaḥ ||50||
yovidyāccaturovedānsāṅgopaniṣadodvijaḥ |
purāṇaṃ cavijānātiyaḥ satasmād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||51||
itihāsa-purāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃ hayet |
bibhetyalpaśrutādvedomāmayaṃ pratariṣyati ||52||
adhītyacaikamadhyāyaṃ svayaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ bhuvā |
āpadaḥ prāpyamucyetayatheṣṭāṃ prāpnuyādgatim ||53||
purāparaṃ parāṃ vaktipurāṇaṃ tenavaismṛtam |
niruktimasyayovedasarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||54||
ṛṣayohyabruvansūtaṃ kathaṃ bhīṣmeṇasaṅgataḥ |
brahmaṇomānasaḥ putraḥ pulastyobhagavānṛṣiḥ ||55||
durlabhaṃ darśanaṃ yasyanaraiḥ pāpasamanvitaiḥ | 
atyāś ca ryam idaṃ sūtakṣatriyeṇa kathaṃ muniḥ||56||
ārādhitobṛhadbhūtastannovadamahā-mate |
kīdṛśaṃ vātapastenakovānyoniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ||57||
yenatuṣṭomunirbrāhmastathātenaprabhāṣitaḥ |
parvavāpyathaparvārdhaṃsamagraṃ vāprabhāṣitam ||58||
yasminsthāneyathādṛṣṭaḥ pulastyobhagavānṛṣiḥ |
tannovadamahā-bhāgakalyāḥ smaśravaṇevayam ||59||
sūta uvāca—--
 yatra gaṅgāmahā-bhāgāsādhūnāṃ hitakāriṇī |
vibhidyaparvataṃ vegānniḥsṛtālokapāvanī ||60||
gaṅgādvāremahā-tīrthebhīṣmaḥ pitṛparāyaṇaḥ |
śuśrūṣuḥ suciraṅkālaṃ mahatāṃ niyamesthitaḥ ||61||
yāvadvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ parameṇasamādhinā |
dhyāyamānaḥ paraṃ brahmatrikālaṃ snānamācarat ||62||
pitṝndevāṃ starpayataḥ svādhyāyenamahātmanaḥ |
ātmānaṅkarṣataścāsyatuṣṭodevaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||63||
 uvācatanayaṃ brahmāpulastyam ṛṣisattamam |
satvaṃ devavrataṃ bhīṣmaṃ vīraṅkurukulodbhavam ||64||
tapasaḥ saṃ nivarttasvakāraṇaṃ cāsyakīrttaya |
pitṝnbhaktyāmahā-bhāgodhyāyamānaḥ samāsthitaḥ ||65||
yohyasyamanasaḥ kāmastaṃ sampādayamāciram |
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā pulastyomunisattamaḥ ||66||
gaṅgādvāramathāgatyabhīṣmaṃ vacanamabravīt |
varaṃ varayabhadraṃ teyattemanasivarttate ||67||
tuṣṭastetapasāvīrasākṣāddevaḥ pitāmahaḥ |
brahmaṇāpreṣitastehaṃ varāndāsyāmikāṅkṣitān ||68||
bhīṣmopitadvacaḥ śrutvā manaḥ śrotrasukhāvaham |
unmīlyanayanedṛṣṭvā pulastyaṃ purataḥ sthitam ||69||
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātenanatvātaṃ munisattamam |
 uvācapraṇatobhūtvāsarvāṅgāliṅgitāvaniḥ||70||
adyamesaphalaṃ janmadinaṃ cedaṃ suśobhanam |
bhavataś ca raṇaudṛṣṭau jagad vaṃ dyaumayātviha ||71||
tapasaś ca phalaṃ prāptaṃ yaddṛṣṭobhagavānmayā | 
varapradoviśeṣeṇa samprāptaś ca nadītaṭe ||72||
iyaṃ brasīmayāklaptā āsyatāṃ sukhadākṛtā |
arghyapātretupālāśedūrvākṣatasumaiḥ kuśaiḥ ||73||
sarṣapaiś ca dadhikṣaudrair yavaiś ca payasāsaha |
aṣṭāṅgohyeṣanirddiṣṭohyarghohimunibhiḥ purā ||74||
śrutvaitadvacanantasyabhīṣmasyāmitatejasaḥ |
upaviṣṭobrahmasutaḥ pulastyobhagavānṛṣiḥ ||75||
viṣṭaraṃ sahapādyenaarghapātraṃ mudānvitaḥ |
jujoṣabhagavānprītaḥ sadācāreṇatenatu ||76||
pulastya uvāca—-
satyavāndānaśīlosisatyasaṃ dhirnareśvaraḥ |
hrīmānmaitraḥ kṣamāśīlovikrāṃ taḥ śatruśāsane ||77||
dharmajṣastvaṅkṛtajṣastvaṃ dayāvānpriyabhāṣitā |
mānyamānayitāvijṣobrahmaṇyaḥ sādhuvatsalaḥ ||78||
tuṣṭastehaṃsadāvatsapraṇipātaparasyavai |
pra brūhi tvaṃ mahā-bhāga kathanaṃ tevadāmy aham ||79||
bhīṣma uvāca—-
bhagavanbhagavānbrahmākasminkālesthitovibhuḥ |
sṛṣṭiṃ cakāravaipūrvaṃ devādīnāṃ vadasvame ||80||
sthitiṃ vābhagavānviṣṇuḥ kathaṃ rudrastunirmitaḥ |
 kathaṃ vāṛṣayodevāḥ sṛṣṭāstenamahātmanā ||81||
 kathaṃ pṛthvī kathaṃ vyoma kathaṃ cemetusāgarāḥ |
 kathaṃ dvīpāḥ parvatāś ca grāmāraṇyapurāṇica ||82||
munīnprajāpatīṃ ś caiva saptarṣīnpravarānapi | 
varṇānvāyuṃ purāsthānaṅgandharvānyakṣarākṣasān ||83||
tīrthāni saritovāthasūryādīngrahatārakān |
yathāsasarjabhagavāṃ stathāmetvaṃ vadasvaha ||84||
pulastya uvāca||
paraḥ parāṇāṃ paramaḥ paramātmāpitāmahaḥ || 
rūpavarṇādirahitoviśeṣaṇavivarjitaḥ ||85||
apakṣayavināśābhyāṃ pariṇāmarddhijanmabhiḥ |
guṇair vivarjitaḥ sarvaiḥ sabhātītihikevalam ||86||
sarvatrāsausamaścāpivasannanupamomataḥ |
bhāvayanbrahma-rūpeṇa vidvadbhiḥ paripaṭhyate ||87||
taṅguhyaṃ paramaṃ nityamajamakṣayamavyayam |
tathāpuruṣa-rūpeṇa kāla-rūpeṇa saṃ sthitam ||88||
taṃ natvāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāsṛṣṭiṃ cakāraha |
pūrvaṃ tupadmaśayanādutthāyajagataḥ prabhuḥ ||89||
guṇavyaṃ jana sambhūtaḥ sargakālenarādhipa |
sātvikorājasaś caiva tāmasaś ca tridhāmahā-n ||90||
pradhānatatvenasamaṃ tathābījādibhir vṛtaḥ |
vaikārikastaijasaś ca bhūtādiś caiva tāmasaḥ ||91||
trividhoyamahaṅkāromahattattvādajāyata |
bhūtendriyāṇāṃ paJcānāṃ tathākarmendriyaiḥ saha ||92||
pṛthivyāpastathātejovāyurākāśameva ca |
ekaikaśaḥ sva-rūpeṇa kathayāmiyathottaram ||93||
śabdamātramathākāśaṃ bhūtādiḥ khaṃsamāvṛṇot |
athākāśaṃ vikurvāṇaṃ sparśamātraṃ sasarjaha ||94||
balavāneṣavaivāyustasyasparśoguṇomataḥ |
ākāśaṃ śabdamātraṃ tusparśamātraṃ samāvṛṇot ||95||
tatovāyurvikurvāṇorūpamātraṃ sasarjaha |
jyotīrūpantutadvāyustadrūpaguṇamucyate ||96||
sparśarūpastuvaivāyūrūpamātraṃ samāvṛṇot |
jyotiścāpivikurvāṇaṃ rasamātraṃ sasarjaha ||97||
 sambhavanti tatoṃ bhāṃ sirūpamātraṃ samāvṛṇot |
vikurvāṇāni cāṃ bhāṃ sigandhamātraṃ sasarjire ||98||
saṅghātojāyatetasmāt tasyagandhomatoguṇaḥ |
taijasānīndriyāṇyāhurdevāvaikārikādaśa ||99||
ekādaśammanaścātradevāvaikārikāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tvakcakṣurnāsikājihvāśrotramatracapaṣcamam ||100||
##teṣāṃ tumataṅkṛtyaṃ śabdādigrahaṇaṃ punaḥ |
vākpāṇipādapāyūnicopasthaṃ tatra paṣcamam ||101||
visargaśilpagatyuktirguṇā eṣāṃ viparyayāt |
ākāśavāyutejāṃ sisalilaṃ pṛthivītathā ||102||
śabdādibhir guṇair vīrayuktānītyuttarottaraiḥ |
śāṃ tāghorāś ca mūḍhāś ca viśeṣāstenatesmṛtāḥ ||103||
nānāvīryāḥ pṛthagbhūtāstatas tesaṃ hatiṃ vinā |
nāśaknuvanprajāḥ sraṣṭumasamāgamyakṛtsnaśaḥ ||104||
sametyānyonyasaṃ yogātparasparasamāśrayāt |
ekasaṅghātalakṣāś ca samprāpyaikyamaśeṣataḥ ||105||
puruṣādhiṣṭhitatvāccavyaktānugrahaṇetathā |
mahadādayoviśeṣāṃ tāhyaṇḍamutpādayanti vai ||106||
tatkrameṇavivṛttaṃ tujalabudbudavatsamam |
tatrāvyaktasvarūposauvyaktarūpījanārdanaḥ ||107||
brahmābrahmasva-rūpeṇa svayamevavyavasthitaḥ |
merurulbamabhūttasyajarāyuś ca mahīdharāḥ ||108||
garbhodakaṃ samudrāś ca tasyāsaṃ ś ca mahātmanaḥ |
 tatra dvīpāḥ samudrāś ca sajyotirlokasaṅgrahaḥ ||109||
tasminnaṇḍe'bhavanvīrasadevāsaramānuṣāḥ |
vārivahnyanilākāśair vṛtair bhūtādinābahiḥ ||110||
vṛtaṃ daśaguṇair aṇḍaṃ bhūtādirmahatātathā |
avyaktenāvṛtorājaṃ staiḥ sarvaiḥ sahitomahā-n ||111||
ebhir āvaraṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarva-bhūtaiś ca saṃ yutam |
nārikelaphalaṃ yadvadbījaṃ bāhyadalair iva ||112||
brahmāsvayaṃ cajagatovisṛṣṭau sampravarttate |
sṛṣṭiṃ capātyanuyugaṃ yāvatkalpavikalpanā ||113||
sasaṃ jṣāṃ yātibhagavāneka evajanārdanaḥ |
satvabhugguṇavāndevohyaprameyaparākramaḥ ||114||
tamodrekaṃ cakalpāṃ terūpaṃ raudraṅkarotica |
rājendrākhilabhūtāni bhakṣayatyatibhīṣaṇaḥ ||115||
bhakṣayitvācabhūtāni jagatyekārṇavīkṛte |
nāgaparyaṅkaśayaneśetesarvasvarūpadhṛk ||116||
prabuddhaś ca punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ prakaroticarūpadhṛk |
sṛṣṭisthityaṃ takaraṇādbrahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ ||117||
sraṣṭāsṛjaticātmānaṃ viṣṇuḥ pālyaṃ capātica |
upasaṃ hriyatecāpisaṃ harttācasvayaṃ prabhuḥ ||118||
pṛthivyāpastathātejovāyurākāśameva ca |
sa evasarva-bhūteśoviśvarūpoyatovyayaḥ ||119||
sargādikaṃ tatosyaivabhūtasthamupakārakam |
sa evasṛjyaḥ sacasargakarttāsa evapālyaṃ pratipālyateyataḥ |
brahmādyavasthābhir aśeṣamūrttirbrahmāvariṣṭhovaradovareṇyaḥ ||120||
iti śrī-padmapurāṇeprathame sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍe purāṇāvatāredvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||


##tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ##

bhīṣma uvāca—-

nirguṇasyāprameyasyaśuddhasyāthamahātmanaḥ |
 kathaṃsargādikarttṛtvaṃ brahmaṇohyupapadyate ||1||
pulastya uvāca—-
śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānām acintyājñānagocarāḥ |
yattatobrahmaṇastāstusargādyābhāvaśaktayaḥ ||2||
utpannaḥ procyatevidvānnitya evopacārataḥ |
nijenatasyamānena āyurvarṣaśataṃ smṛtam ||3||
tatparākhyaṃ parārddhaṃ catadarddhaṃ parikīrttitam |
kāṣṭhāpaṣcadaśākhyātāni meṣā nṛpasattama ||4||
kāṣṭhāsiṃ traśatkalātriṃśat-kalāmauhūrttikovidhiḥ |
tāvatsaṅkhyair ahorātraṃ muhūrttair mānuṣaṃ smṛtam ||5||
ahorātrāṇitāvanti māsaḥ pakṣadvayātmakaḥ |
taiṣṣaḍbhir ayanaṃ varṣamayanedakṣiṇottare ||6||
ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ rātrirdevānām uttaraṃ dinam |
divyair varṣasahasraistukṛtatretādisaṃ jṣitam ||7||
caturyugaṃ dvādaśabhistadvibhāgaṃ nibodhame |
catvāritrīṇidvecaikaṅkṛtādiṣuyathākramam ||8||
divyābdānāṃ sahasrāṇiyugeṣvāhuḥ purāvidaḥ |
tatpramāṇaiḥ śataiḥ saṃ dhyāpūrvātatrābhidhīyate ||9||
saṃ dhyāṃ śakaś ca tattulyoyugasyānantarohiyaḥ |
saṃ dhyāsaṃ dhyāṃ śayoraṃ taḥ kāloyo nṛpasattama ||10||
yugākhyaḥ satuvijṣeyaḥ kṛtatretādisaṃ jṣitaḥ |
kṛtaṃ tretādvāparaṃ cakaliś caiva caturyugam ||11||
procyatetatsahasraṃ tubrahmaṇodivasaṃ nṛpa |
brahmaṇodivaserājanmanavaś ca caturdaśa ||12||
bhavanti parimāṇaṃ cateṣāṅkālakṛtaṃ śṛṇu |
saptarṣayaḥ surāḥ śakromanustatsūnavo nṛpa ||13||
ekakālehisṛjyaṃ tesaṃ hriyaṃ tecapūrvavat |
cataryugānāṃ saṅkhyātāsādhikāhyekasaptatiḥ ||14||
manvaṃ taraṃ manoḥ kālaḥ surādīnāṃ capārthiva |
aṣṭauśatasahasrāṇidivyayāsaṅkhyayāsmṛtaḥ ||15||
dvipaJcāśattathānyāni sahasrāṇyadhikāni ca |
triṃśat-koṭyas tu sampūrṇāḥ saṅkhyātāḥ saṅkhyayā nṛpa ||16||
sapta-ṣaṣṭis tathānyāni niyutāni mahā-mate |
viṃśatiś ca sahasrāṇi kālo’yam adhikaṃ vinā ||17||
manvantarasya saṅkhyeyaṃ mānuṣair iha vatsaraiḥ |
caturdaśa-guṇo hy eṣa kālo brāhma-mahaḥ smṛtam ||18||
brāhmo naimittiko nāma tasyāṃ te prati saṣcaraḥ |
tadā hi dahyate sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhūr-bhuvādikam ||19||
janaṃ prayāntitāpārttā mahar-loka-nivāsinaḥ |
ekārṇave tu trailokye brahmā brahma-vidāṃ varaḥ ||20||
bhogi-śayyā-gataḥ śete trailokya-grāsa-bṛṃhitaḥ |
jana-sthair yogibhir devaś cintyamāno jagad vibhuḥ ||21||
tat-pramāṇāṃ hitāṃ rātriṃ tad-ante sṛjate punaḥ |
evaṃ tu brahmaṇo varṣam evaṃ varṣa-śataṃ ca tat ||22||
śataṃ hitasya varṣāṇāṃ paramāyur mahātmanaḥ |
ekam asya vyatītaṃ tu parārdhaṃ brahmaṇonagha ||23||
tasyāntebhūn mahā-kalpaḥ pādmaity abhiviśrutaḥ |
dvitīyasya parārdhasya vartamānasya vai nṛpa ||24||
vārāha iti kalpo’yaṃ prathamaḥ parikalpitaḥ |
brahmānārāyaṇākhyosaukalpādaubhagavānyathā ||25||
sasarjasarva-bhūtāni tadācakṣvamahā-mune |
pulastya uvāca—-
prajāḥ sasarjabhagavānanādiḥ sarva sambhavaḥ ||26||
atītakalpāvasāneniśāsuptotthitaḥ prabhuḥ |
satvodriktastathābrahmāśūnyaṃ lokamavaikṣata ||27||
toyāntaḥ samahīṃ jṣātvāni magnāṃ vāri samplave |
pravicintyataduddhāraṅkartukāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||28||
viṣṇurūpaṃ tadājṣātvāpṛthvīṃ voḍhuṃ svatejasā |
matsya-kūrmādikāṃ cānyāṃ vārāhīṃ tanum āviśat ||29||
vedayajṣamayaṃ rūpamāśrityajagataḥ sthitau |
sthitaḥ sthirātmāsarvātmāparamātmāprajāpatiḥ ||30||
praviveśetadātoyanto yādhāredharādharaḥ |
nirīkṣyataṃ tadādevīpātālatalamāgatam ||31||
tuṣṭāvapraṇatābhūtvābhaktinamrāvasuṃ dharā |
pṛthivy uvāca—-
namastesarva-bhūtāyanamasteparamātmane ||32||
māmuddharāsmādadyatvaṃ tvattohaṃ pūrvamutthitā |
paramātmannamastestupuruṣātmannamostute ||33||
pradhānavyaktarūpāyakālabhūtāyate namaḥ |

bhakṣayitvācasakalaṃ jagatyekārṇavīkṛte ||35||
śeṣetvamevagovindacintyamānomanīṣibhiḥ |
bhavatoyatparaṃ rūpaṃ tannajānātikaś ca na ||36||

tvanmayyahaṃ tvadādhārātvatsṛṣṭātvāmupāśritā ||39||
mādhavīmitilokoyamabhidhattetatohimām |

sāmasvaradhvaniḥśrī-mānjagarjaparighargharam |
tataḥ samutkṣipyadharāṃ svadaṃ ṣṭrayāmahā-varāhaḥ sphuṭapadmalocanaḥ |
rasātalādutpalapatrasannibhaḥ samutthitonīlaivācalomahā-n ||41||
uttiṣṭhatātenamukhāni lāhataṃ tadāplavāṃ bhojanalokasaṃ śrayān |
sanaṃ danādīnapakalmaṣānmunīṃ ś ca kārabhūyopipavitratāspadam ||42||
prayānti toyāni khurāgravikṣaterasātale'dhaḥ kṛtaśabdasaṃ tatiḥ |
balāhakānāṃ catatistutasyaśvāsāni lāstāparitaḥ prayāti ||43||
uttiṣṭhatastasyajalārdrakukṣermahā-varāhasyamahīṃ vidārya |
vidhūnvatovedamayaṃ śirīraṃ romāṃ tarasthāmunayojuṣanti ||44||
janeśvarāṇāṃ parameśakeśavaprabhurgadāśaṅkhadarāsicakradhṛk |

pādeṣu vedāstavayūpadaṃ ṣṭrādaṃ teṣu yajṣāḥ śrutayaś ca vaktre |
hutāśajihvositanūruhāṇidarbhāḥ prabho yajṣapumāṃ stvameva ||46||
dyāvāpṛthivyoratulaprabhāvayadaṃ taraṃ tadvapuṣātavaiva |

paramātmātvamevaikonānyostijagataḥ pate ||48||
tavaiṣamahimāyenavyāptametaccarācaraṃ |
jñānasvarūpamakhilaṃ jagad etadabuddhayaḥ ||49||
arthasvarūpaṃ paśyanto bhrāmyaṃ tetamasaḥ plave |
yetujñānavidaśśuddhacetasaste'khilaṃ jagat ||50||

uddharorvīmameyātmannimagnāmabjalocana |
sṛtvodriktosibhagavangoviṃ dapṛthivīmimām ||52||
samuddharabhavāyeśakurusarva jagad dhitaṃ |
evaṃ saṃ stūyamānaś ca paramātmāmahīdharaḥ ||53||
ujjahārakṣitiṅkṣipraṃ nyastavānsamahā-rṇave |
tasyoparijalaughesyamahatīnaurivasthitā ||54||
tataḥ kṣitiṃ samāṅkṛtvāpṛthivyāmacinodgirīn |
yathāvibhāgaṃ bhagavānanādiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||55||
bhūvibhāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvāsaptadvīpānyathātathaṃ |
bhūtādyāṃ ś ca turolokānpūrvavatsamakalpayat ||56||
brahmaṇeviṣṇunāpūrvametadevapradarśitaṃ |
tuṣṭenadevadevenatvaṃ devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||57||
tvayāmayājagaccedaṃ dhāryaṃ pālyaṃ cayatnataḥ |
yeṣāṃ tvasuramukhyānāṃ varodattomayādhunā ||58||
devānāṃ hitakāmenahaṃ tavyāstetvayā vibho |
ahaṃsṛṣṭiṅkariṣyāmisācapālyātvayā vibho ||59||
evamuktogatoviṣṇurdevādīnasṛjadvibhuḥ |
abuddhipūrvakastasyaprādurbhūtastamomayaḥ ||60||
tamomohomahā-mohastāmisrohyandhasaṃ jṣakaḥ |
paṣcadhāvasthitaḥ sargodhyāyatastumahātmanaḥ ||61||
bahiraṃ taścāprakāśaḥ saṃ vṛtātmānagātmakaḥ |
mukhyānāgāyataścoktāmukhyasargastatas tvayaṃ ||62||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sādhakaṃ sargamamanyadaparaṃ prabhuḥ |
tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargastiryaksrotobhyavartata ||63|
yasmāt tiryakpravṛttiḥ syāttiryaksrotastataḥ smṛtaḥ |
paśvādayastevikhyātāstamaḥ prāyāhyavedinaḥ ||64||

tatorvāksrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ satumānuṣaḥ |
aṣṭamonugrahaḥ sargaḥ sātvikastāmasastusaḥ ||80||

etetavasamākhyātānavasargāḥ prajāpateḥ |

arvāksrotāstu kathitobhavatāyastumānuṣaḥ |

nemistudharmacakrasyaśīrṇāyatrābhavatpurā |

adyāpi pitṛtīrthaṃ tusarvakāmaphalapradam ||14||
nīlakaṇṭhamitikhyātaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ narādhipa |
tathābhadrasaraḥ puṇyaṃ saromānasameva ca ||15||
maṃ dākinītathā'cchodāvipāśācasarasvatī |
sarvamitrapadaṃ tadvadvaidyanāthaṃ mahā-phalam ||16||
kṣiprānadītathāpuṇyātathākālaṣjaraśubham |

 sambhedaś ca ṇḍavegāyāṃ tathaivāmarakaṃ ṭakam ||20||
kurukṣetrāccadviguṇaṃ tasminasnānādikaṃ bhavet |

śūlatāpīpayoṣṇīcapayoṣṇīsaṅgamastathā ||24||
mahauṣadhīcāraṇācanāgatīrthapravarttinī |
mahā-veṇānadīpuṇyāmahā-śālastathaiva ca ||25||

aṅgāravāhikātadvannadaudvauśoṇaghargharau |

vatsavrāteśvaraṃ tadvattathāgokāmukhaṃ param ||41||
govarddhanaṃ hariś ca ndraṃ puraś ca ndraṃ pṛthūdakam |
sahasrākṣaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathācakadalīnadī ||42||

eteṣu sarvadevānāṃ sāṃ nidhyaṃ paṭhyateyataḥ ||44||

bāhudācanadīpuṇyātathāsiddhavaṭaṃ śubham ||45||

śrāddhameteṣu sarveṣu dattaṅkoṭiśatottaram ||46||

yutāliṅgasahasreṇasavyetarajalāvahā ||47||

śrāddhāgnidānakāryaṃ ca tatra koṭiśatādhikam ||49||
tathāsahasraliṅgaṃ carāghaveśvaramuttamam |
sendrakālānadīpuṇyā tatra śakrogataḥ purā ||50||
nihatyanamuciṃ mitraṃ tapasāsvargamāptavān |
 tatra dattaṃ naraiḥ śrāddhamanantaphaladaṃ bhavet ||51||
puṣkaraṃ nāma vai tīrthaṃ śālagrāmaṃ tathaiva ca |
śoṇapātaś ca vikhyāto yatra vaiśvānarāśayaḥ ||52||
tīrthaṃsārasvataṃ caiva svāmitīrthaṃ tathaiva ca |
malaṃ darānadīpuṇyākauśikīcandrakātathā ||53||

kāverīcottarāṅgācatathājālaṃ dharogiriḥ ||54||
eteṣu śrāddhatīrtheṣu śrāddhamānaṃ tyamaśnute |

divyaṃ sarvatragaṅgāyāstathānadyāstaṭaṃ śubham |
kubjāmrakaṃ tathātīrthamūrvaśīpulinantathā ||56||
saṃsāramocanaṃ tīrthaṃ tathaivaṛṇamocanam |
eteṣu pitṛtīrtheṣu śrāddhamānaṃ tyamaśnute ||57||
aṭṭahāsaṃ tathātīrthaṅgautameśvarameva ca |
tathāvasiṣṭhatīrthaṃ cabhārataṃ catataḥ param ||58||
brahmāvartaṅkuśāvartaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca |
piṇḍārakaṃ cavikhyātaṃ śaṅkhoddhāraṃ tathaiva ca ||59||
bhāṇḍeśvaraṃ bilvakaṃ canīlaparvatameva ca |
tathācabadarītīrthaṃsarvatīrtheśvareśvaram ||60||
vasudhārāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca |
jayaṃ tīvijayā caiva śuklatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca ||61|
eṣu śrāddhapradātāraḥ prayānti paramaṃ padam |
tīrthaṃ mātṛgṛhaṃ nāmakaravīrapuraṃ tathā ||62||
sapta-godāvarī nāma sarva-tīrtheśvareśvaram |
 tatra śrāddhaṃ pradātavyamanantaphalamīpsubhiḥ ||63||
kīkaṭeṣu gayāpuṇyāpuṇyaṃ rājagṛhaṃ vanam |
cyavanasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ nadīpuṇyāpunaḥ punā ||64||
viṣayārādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ nadīyātupunaḥ punā |
 yatra gāthāvicaratibrahmaṇāparikīrtitā ||65||
eṣṭavyābahavaḥ putrāyadyekopigayāṃ vrajet |
yajetavāśvamedhenanīlaṃ vāvṛṣamutsṛjet ||66||
eṣāgāthāvicaratitīrtheṣvāyataneṣu ca |
sarvemanuṣyārājendrakīrttayaṃ taḥ samāgatāḥ ||67||
kimasmākaṅkulekaścid gayāṃ yāsyatiyaḥ sutaḥ |
prīṇayiṣyatitān gatvā saptapūrvāṃ stathāparān ||68||
mātāmahā-nāmapyevaṃ śrutireṣāciraṃ tanī |
gaṅgāyāmasthinicayaṅ gatvā kṣepsyatiyaḥ sutaḥ ||69||
tilaiḥ saptāṣṭabhir vāpidāsyatecajalāṃ jalim |
araṇyatritayevāpipiṇḍadānaṅkariṣyati ||70||
prathamaṃ puṣkarāraṇyenaimiṣetadanantaraṃ |
dharmāraṇyaṃ punaḥ prāpyaśrāddhaṃ bhaktyāpradāsyati ||71||

vrajankṛtvāni vāpaṃ yastvadhvānaṃ parisarpati |

kuletasyanarājendrapretobhavatikaś ca na |

ekenapiṇḍadānenatṛptāstemokṣagāminaḥ ||76||

gayāsutīrtheṣu naraiḥ pradattaṃ taddharmahetuṃ pravaraṃ vadanti ||77||
sarvātmanāsurucināmahā-calamahā-nadī |
yetupaśyanti tāṅ gatvā mānasedakṣiṇottare ||78||

yadyadicchativaimartyastattadāpnotyasaṃśayam ||79||
eṣatūddeśataḥ proktastīrthānāṃ sagrahomayā |

varṇāśramāṇāṅgehepitīrthaṃ śamaudāhṛtam ||81||

gayāyāṃ yattuvaiśrāddhaṃ tacchrāddhamapavargadam ||82||
yasmāt tasmāt prayatnenatīrtheśrāddhaṃ vidhīyate |

madhyāhnastrimuhūrtaḥ syādaparāhṇastataḥ param |

rākṣasīnām asāvelāgarhitāsarvakarmasu |
ahnomuhūrtāvyākhyātādaśapaṣcacasarvadā ||85||
tatrāṣṭamomuhūrtoyaḥ sakālaḥ kutapaḥ smṛtaḥ |

tasmād anantaphaladastatrāraṃ bhoviśiṣyate |
khaḍgapātraṃ cakutapastathānaipālakaṃ balam ||87||
rukmaṃ darbhāstilāgāvodauhitraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
pāpaṅkutsitamityāhustasyatattāpakāriṇaḥ ||88||
aṣṭāveteyatastasmāt kutapā itiviśrutāḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ muhurttātkutapānmahūrttaṃ cacatuṣṭayam ||89||
muhūrttapaṣcakaṃ caiva svadhāvācanamiṣyate |
viṣṇudehasamudbhūtāḥ kuśāḥ kṛṣṇatilāstathā ||90||
śrāddhasyalakṣaṇaṅkālamitiprāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ |
tilodakāṃ jalirdeyojalāṃ tetīrthavāsibhiḥ ||91||
sadarbhahastenaikenagṛheśrāddhaṅgamiṣyati |

brahmaṇā caiva kathitaṃ tīrthaśrāddhānukīrtanam |
śṛṇotiyaḥ paṭhedvāpiśrī-mānsaṃ jāyatenaraḥ ||93||
śrāddhakālecavaktavyaṃ tathātīrthanivāsibhiḥ |
sarva-pāpopaśāṃ ntyarthamalakṣmīnāśanaṃ mataṃ ||94||
idaṃ pavitraṃ yaśasonidhānam idaṃ mahā-pātakanāśanaṃ ca |
brahmārkarudrair abhipūjitaṃ caśrāddhasyamāhātmyamuśanti tajjṣāḥ ||95||
iti śrī-padma-purāṇe prathame sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍe śrāddhaprakaraṇaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ 
bhīṣma uvāca—
somavaṃśaḥ kathaṃ jātaḥ kathayātraviśārada |
tadvaṃ śeketurājānobabhūvuḥ kīrtivarddhanāḥ ||1||
pulastya uvāca—
ādiṣṭobrahmaṇāpūrvamatriḥ sargavidhaupurā |
anantaraṃ nāmatapaḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ taptavānvibhuḥ ||2||
yadānaṃ dakaraṃ brahmabhagavankleśanāśanaṃ |
brahmarudrendrasūryāṇām abhyaṃ taramatīṃ driyaṃ ||3||
śāntiṅkṛtvātmamanasātadatriḥ saṃ yamesthitaḥ |
māhātmyaṃ tapasovāpiparamānaṃ dakārakaṃ ||4||
yasmādvaṃśapatiḥ sārddhaṃsamayetadadhiṣṭhitaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā caṣṭasomenatasmāt somobhavadvibhuḥ ||5||
athasusrāvanetrābhyāṃ jalaṃ tatrātri sambhavam |
dyotayadviśvamakhilaṃ jyotsnayāsacarācaram ||6||
taddiśojagṛhus tatra strīrūpeṇāsahṛcchayāḥ |
garbhobhūtvodaretāsāṃ sthitaḥ sopyatri sambhavaḥ ||7||
āśāś ca mumucurgarbhamaśaktādhāraṇetataḥ |
samādāyāthataṅgarbhamekīkṛtyacaturmukhaḥ ||8||
yuvānamakarodbrahmāsarvāyudhadharaṃ naram |
syaṃ danethasahastenavedaśaktimayeprabhuḥ ||9||
āropyalokamanayadātmīyaṃ sapitāmahaḥ |
tatobrahmarṣibhiḥ proktaṃ hyasmatsvāmībhavatvayam ||10||
ṛṣibhir devagandharvair apsarobhistathaiva ca |
stūyamānasyatasyābhūdadhikaṃ mahadaṃ taram ||11||
tejovitānādabhavadbhuvidivyauṣadhīgaṇaḥ |
taddīptiradhikātasmād rātraubhavatisarvadā ||12||
tenauṣadhīśaḥ somobhūddvijeṣv apihigaṇyate |
vedadhāmārasaścāyaṃ yadidaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śubham ||13||
kṣīyatevarddhate caiva śuklekṛṣṇecasarvadā |
viṃśatiṃ catathāsaptadakṣaḥ prācetasodadau ||14||
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃ yuktās tasmai kanyāḥ suvarcasaḥ | 
tataḥ śaktisahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇidaśaivatu ||15|| 
tapaś ca kāraśītāṃ śurviṣṇudhyānaikatatparaḥ | 
tatas tuṣṭaś ca bhagavāṃ s tasmai nārāyaṇohariḥ ||16||
varaṃ vṛṇīṣvacovācaparamātmājanārdanaḥ |
tatovavrevaraṃ somaḥ śakralokeyajāmy aham ||17||
pratyakṣamevabhoktārobhavaṃ tuma mamaṃ dire |
rājasūyesuragaṇābrahmādyāyecaturvidhāḥ ||18||
rakṣapālaḥ surosmākamāstāṃ śūladharoharaḥ |
tathetyuktaḥ samājahrerājasūyaṃ tuviṣṇunā ||19||
hotātrirbhṛguradhvaryurudgātācacaturmukhaḥ |
brahmatvam agamattasyaupadraṣṭāhariḥ svayam ||20||
sadasyāḥ sarvadevāsturājasūyavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
vasavodhvaryavastadvadviśvedevāstathaiva ca ||21||
trailokyaṃ dakṣiṇātenaṛtvigabhyaḥ pratipāditā |
somaḥ prāpyāthaduṣprāpyamaiśvaryaṃ sṛṣṭisatkṛtaṃ ||22||
saptalokaikanāthatvaṃ prāptaḥ svatapasātadā |
kadācidudyānagatāmapaśyadanekapuṣpābharaṇopaśobhām ||23||
bṛhannitaṃ bastanabhārakhedāṃ puṣpāvabhaṅgepyatidurbalāṅgīṃ |
bhāryāṃ catāṃ devaguroranaṅgabāṇābhir āmāyatacārunetrāṃ ||24||
tārāṃ satārādhipatiḥ smarārtaḥ keśeṣu jagrāhaviviktabhūmau |
sāpismarārtāsahatenaremetadrūpakāṃ tyāhṛtamānasaiva ||25||
ciraṃ vihṛtyāthajagāmatārāṃ vidhurgṛhītvāsvagṛhaṃ tatopi |
natṛptirāsītsvagṛhepitasyatārānuraktasyasukhāgameṣu ||26||
bṛhaspatistadvirahāgnidagdhastaddhyānaniṣṭhaikamanā babhūva |
śaśākaśāpaṃ nacadātumasmainamantraśastrāgniviṣair anekaiḥ ||27||
tasyāpakartuṃ vividhair upāyair naivābhicārair apivāgadhīśaḥ |
sayācayāmāsatatas tudevaṃ somaṃ svabhāryārthamanaṅgataptaḥ ||28||
sayācyamānopidadaunabhāryāṃ bṛhaspateḥ kāmavaśenamohitaḥ |
maheśvareṇāthacaturmukhenasādhyair marudbhiḥ sahalokapālaiḥ ||29||
dadauyadātāṃ na kathaṃ cidiṃ dustadāśivaḥ krodhaparo babhūva |
yovāmadevaprathitaḥ pṛthivyāmanekarudrārcitapādapadmaḥ ||30||
tataḥ saśiṣyogiriśaḥ pinākībṛhaspateḥ snehavaśānubaddhaḥ |
dhanurgṛhitvājagavaṃ purārirjagāmabhūteśvarasiddhajuṣṭaḥ ||31||
yuddhāyasomenaviśeṣadīptastṛtīyanetrānalabhīmavaktraḥ |
sahaivajagmuś ca gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ viṃśādhikāṣaṣṭirathogramūrtiḥ ||32||
yakṣeśvarāṇāṃ sagaṇair anekair yutonvagātsyaṃ danasaṃ sthitānāṃ |
vetālayakṣoragakinnarāṇāṃ padmenacaikenatathārbudānām ||33||
lakṣaistribhir dvādaśabhīrathānāṃ somopyagāt tatra vivṛddhamanyuḥ |
śanaiś ca rāṅgārakavṛddhatejānakṣatradaityāsurasainyayuktaḥ ||34||
jagmurbhayaṃ saptatathaivalokādharāvanadvīpasamudragarbhāḥ |
sasomamevābhyagamatpinākīgṛhītadīptāstraviśālavahniḥ||35||
athābhavadbhīṣaṇabhīmasomasainyadvayasyāthamahā-havosau |
aśeṣasatvakṣayakṛtpravṛddhastīkṣṇapradhānojvalanaikarūpaḥ ||36||
śastrair athānyonyamaśeṣasainyaṃ dvayorjagāmakṣayamugratīkṣṇaiḥ |
patanti śastrāṇi tathojjvalāni svar-bhūmi-pātāla-malaṃ dahanti ||37||
rudraḥ krodhād brahma-śiro mumoca 
somo’pi somāstram amogha-vīryaṃ |
tayor nipātena samudra-bhūmyor 
athāntarikṣasyacabhītirāsīt ||38||
tadā su-yuddhaṃ jagatāṃ kṣayāya 
pravṛddham ālokya pitāmaho’pi |

aṃ tarddhānena samprāptāpuṣkaraṃ sāmahā-nadī ||197||
maryādāparvatetasmin sambhūtāvimalāsarit |
puṣkarāraṇyaṃ vipulaṃ surasiddhaniṣevitam ||198||
pitāmahenayatrāsīdyajṣasatraṃ niṣevitam |
sidhyarthaṃ munimukhyānām āgatāsaumahā-nadī ||199||
yeṣu tatra kṛtohomaḥ kuṇḍeṣvāsīdviriṃ cinā |
tāni sarvāṇi samplāvyatoyenāpyudgatāhisā ||200||
 tatra kṣetremahā-puṇyāpuṣkaresātathotthitā |
tenatatpūraṇaṃ proktaṃ vāyunā jagad āyuṣā ||201||
sāpitatkṣetramāsādyapuṇyaṃ puṇyāmahā-nadī |
sarasvatīsthitādevīmartyānāṃ pāpanāśinī ||202||
 tatra yeśubhakarmāṇaḥ puṣkarasthāṃ sarasvatīm |
paśyanti tenapaśyanti sughorāṃ tāmadhogatiṃ ||203||
yaḥ punas tatra bhāvenanaraḥ snānaṃ samācaret |
sabrahmalokamāsādyabrahmaṇāsahamodate ||204||
yastudadyāt tatra dadhibrāhmaṇāyamanoramam |
so’py agni-lokam āsādya bhuṅkte bhogān suśobhanān ||205||
varaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ yopibhaktyādadyāddvijātaye |
sopisadvastradānasyaphalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet ||206||
jyeṣṭhakuṇḍenaraḥ snātvāyaḥ saṃ tarpayatepitṝn |
satānuddharatesarvānnarakādapiśuddhadhīḥ ||207||
kṣetrepaitāmahepūtepuṇyāṃ prāpyasarasvatīm |
naraḥ kiṃ prārthayedanyattīrthaṃ brahmasutobravīt ||208||
tasmāt sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snātaḥ prāpnotiyatphalam |
tatsarvaṃ prāpnuyānmartyojyeṣṭhakuṇḍesakṛtplutaḥ ||209||
kimatrabahunoktenakṣetraṃ tīrthaṅgatiśśubhā |
yenaitattritayaṃ prāptaṃ prāptātenagatiḥ parā ||210||
kālekṣetretathātīrthesnātvāhutvāpi tatra yaḥ |
prayacchatedvijāyārthaṃsonantaṃ sukhamaśnute ||211||
kārttikemāsiśuklecavaiśākheśaśibhūṣaṇe |
candrasūryoparāgecakālecakurujāṅgale ||212||
kṣetreṣveteṣu tīrthāni yānyuktāni munīśvaraiḥ |
teṣāṃ puṇyatamaṃ tīrthamidamāhapitāmahaḥ ||213||
kuṇḍetumadhyamesnātvākārtikyāṃ yaḥ pumāndvije |
prayacchatecāpidravyaṃ sośvamedhamavāpnuyāt ||214||
evaṅkaniṣṭhakep yatra kuṇḍesnātvāsamādhinā |
yaḥ prayacchativiprāyasurūpāmapiśālikām ||215||
saprayātinaraḥ kṣipramagnilokaṃ manoramam |
triḥ sapta-kula-saṃyukto bhuṅkte tatra mahā-phalam ||216||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnenagamanāyamatiḥ sthirā |
puruṣeṇatukartavyāpuṣkarāvāptayeśubhā ||217||

matiḥ smṛtiḥ śubhāprajṣāmedhābuddhirdayāparā ||218||
sarasvatyāstuparyāyāṣṣaḍete samprakīrtitāḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛtiyatrāsauprācībhūtāsarasvatī ||219||
 tatra sthaṃ tajjalaṃ yepipaśyanti taṭasaṃ sthitāḥ |
tepyaśvamedhasyaphalaṃ labhaṃ tenātrasaṃśayaḥ ||220||
yovatīryapunas tatra kaścit snānaṃ samācaret |
naraḥ samādhiyuktovaibrahmaṇonucarobhavet ||221||
śākādināpihipitṝnyastatrārcayatenaraḥ |
sopyetivipulānbhogāṃ steṣāmevānubhāvataḥ ||222||
yepunarvidhinā tatra śrāddhaṅkurvanti mānavāḥ |

āditīrtham idaṃ tasmāt tīrthānāṃ bhuviviśrutam ||225||
dharmāpavargayoḥ krīḍāni dhibhūtamavasthitam |
sarasvatyāpunaś caiva sametaṅguṇavattaram ||226||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ caturṇāmapidāyakam |
yep yatra malanāśāyapumāṃ soviviśurjalam ||227||
gopradānasamaṃ teṣāṃ sukhenaivaphalaṃ bhavet |
suvarṇadānenasamamevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||228||

svargaṃ prayāntipitaras tatra putreṇatāritāḥ ||229||

telabhante'kṣayānlokānbrahmaviśveśavaṃ ditān ||230||

sāpuṇyavadbhiḥ samprāptuṃ puṃ bhiśśakyāmahā-nadī ||231||
munibhardharmatattvajṣais tatra tatra niṣevitā |
tasmāt sarvatrasādevīpavitrāsarvataḥ sthitā ||232||
puṣkaretuviśeṣeṇapūtātpūtatamāhisā |
nadīsarasvatīpuṇyāsulabhājagatisthitā ||233||

tattīrthaṃsarvatīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ vihitaṃ bhuvi ||234||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ caturṇāmapisādhakam |
prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ prāpyayonyattīrthaṃ himārgate ||235||
sakarasthaṃsamutsṛjyahyamṛtaṃ viṣamicchati |
jyeṣṭhejyeṣṭhāprayāgasyamadhyamemadhyamāsmṛtā ||236||

triṣvapyeteṣu snāyītakuryāccāpipradakṣiṇam ||237||
prayacchatipitṛbhyo yastoyaṃ teṣāṃ tilānvitam |
tepituṣṭāḥ punastasyaprayacchaṃ tyamitaṃ phalam ||238||
yaḥ snātvāprayatonityaṃ tataḥ paśyetpitāmaham |
anulomavilomābhyāṃ tathāvyastasamastayoḥ ||239||
snātavyaṃ puṣkarenityaṃ brahmalokamabhīpsitā |
trīṇaśṛṅgāṇiśubhrāṇitrīṇiprasravaṇāni ca ||240||
puṣkarāṇiprasiddhāni navidmas tatra kāraṇaṃ |
kanīyāṃ saṃ madhyamaṃ catṛtīyaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkaraṃ ||241||
śṛṅgaśadbābhidhānāni śubhaprasravaṇāni ca |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ saṅkalpair aphalaṃ naraḥ ||242||
yas tatra saṃ tyajeddehaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam |
prayataḥ saṃ yatastasyāṃ snātvādadyādvijeśubhām ||243||
gām ekāṃ mantrapūtāṃ calokānāpnotimokṣadān |
kimatrabahunoktenarātrāvapihiyorthine ||244||
arthaṃ prayacchatesnātvāsonantaṃ sukhamaśnute |
 tatra dānaṃ praśaṃ santi tilānāṃ munisattamāḥ ||245||
kṛṣṇapakṣecaturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ cavihitaṃ sadā |
piṇyākenaguḍenāpipiṇḍaṃ yotraprayacchati ||246||
pitṝṇāṃ prayatobhūtvāpitṛlokaṃ sayachati |
puṣkarāraṇyamāsādyapunastasmāt sarasvatī ||247||
aṃ tarddhānaṅgatāgaṃ tuṃ pravṛttāgapaścimāmukhī |
nātidūretatas tasyapuṣkarasyasuśobhanā ||248||

tatroṣitvāpunardevīvanemunimanorame ||249||
sarvartukusumākīrṇesiddhacāraṇasevite |
naṃ dānām asaricchreṣṭhātriṣulokeṣu viśrutā ||250||
mīnanakrajhaṣopetāvimalodakapūritā |
sūta uvāca— |
athadevavrataḥ prāhakimanyāsāsaridvarā ||251||

 kathaṃ mebhavitāmokṣaḥ kathaṃsatyāmṛgībhavet |

 uvācavacanaṅghoraṃ dhenukekiṃ prarudyate ||290||

 kathaṃ tvaṅgokulaṅ gatvā gopījanasamākulam ||306||

 yatra vatsāś ca huṅkāraṅkaruṇaṃ mātṛkāṅkṣayā ||311||

saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

pulastya uvāca—
tadadbhutatamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā caraghunaṃ danaḥ |
gauravādvismayāccāpibhūyaḥ praṣṭuṃ pracakrame ||1||
rāma uvāca—
bhagavaṃ stadvanaṅghoraṃ yatrāsautaptavāṃ stapaḥ |
śvetovaidarbhakorājātadadbhutamabhūt kathaṃ ||2||
viṣamaṃ tadvanaṃ rājāśūnyaṃ mṛgavivarjitaṃ |
praviṣṭastapa āsthātuṃ kathaṃ vadamahā-mune ||3||
samaṃ tādyojanaśataṃ nirmanuṣyamabhūt kathaṃ |
bhavān kathaṃ praviṣṭastadyenakāryeṇatadvada ||4||
agastya uvāca—
purākṛtayugerājāmanurdaṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ |
tasyaputrothanāmnāsīdikṣvākuramitadyutiḥ ||5||
taṃ putraṃ pūrvajaṃ rājyenikṣipyabhuvisaṃ matam |
pṛthivyāṃ rājavaṃśānāṃ bhavarājety uvāca ha ||6||
tatheticapratijṣātaṃ pituḥ putreṇarāghava |
tataḥ paramasaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ punastaṃ pratyabhāṣata ||7||
prīto’smi paramodārakarmaṇātena saṃśayaḥ |
daṇḍenacaprajārakṣanacadaṇḍamakāraṇam ||8||
aparādhiṣuyodaṇḍaḥ pātyatemānavair iha |
sadaṇḍovidhivanmuktaḥ svargaṃ nayatipārthivam ||9||
tasmād daṇḍemahā-bāhoyatnavānbhavaputraka |
dharmasteparamolokekṛta evaṃ bhaviṣyati ||10||
ititaṃ bahusaṃ diśyamanuḥ putraṃ samādhinā |
jagāmatridivaṃ hṛṣṭobrahmalokamanuttamam ||11||

toṣayāmāsaputraiḥ sapitṝndevasutopamaiḥ |
sarveṣāmuttamasteṣāṅkanīyānraghunaṃ dana ||13||

bhaviṣyaddaṇḍapatanaṃ śarīretasyavīkṣyaca |
 sampaśyamānastaṃ doṣaṅghoraṃ putrasyarāghava ||15||
saviṃ dhyanīlayormadhyerājyamasyadadauprabhuḥ |
sadaṇḍas tatra rājābhūdramyeparvatamūrddhani ||16||
puraṃ cāpratimaṃ tenaniveśāyatathākṛtam |
nāmatasyapurasyāthamadhumattamitisvayam ||17||
tathādeśena sampannaḥ śūrovāsamathākarot |
evaṃ rājāsatadrājyaṃ cakārasapurohitaḥ ||18||
prahṛṣṭasuprajākīrṇaṃ deva-rājoyathādivi |
tataḥ sadaṇḍaḥ kākutsthabahuvarṣagaṇāyutam ||19||
akārayattudharmātmārājyaṃ nihatakaṃ ṭakaṃ |
athakāletukasiṃ maścidrājābhārgavamāśramam ||20||
ramaṇīyamupākrāmaccaitramāsemanorame |
 tatra bhārgavakanyāṃ turūpeṇāpratimāṃ bhuvi ||21||
vicaraṃ tīṃ vanoddeśedaṇḍopaśyadanuttamām |
uttuṅgapīvarīṃ śyāmāṃ candrābhavadanāṃ śubhām ||22||
sunāsāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ pīnonnata-payodharām |
madhyekṣāmāṃ cavistīrṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṅkurutemudam ||23||
ekavastrāṃ vanecaikāṃ prathameyauvanesthitām |
satāṃ dṛṣṭvā tvadharmeṇaanaṅgaśarapīḍitaḥ ||24||
abhigamyasuviśrāṃ tāṅkanyāṃ vacanamabravīt |
kutas tvam asisuśroṇikasyacāsisuśobhane ||25||
pīḍatohamanaṅgenapṛcchāmitvāṃ suśobhane |
tvayāmepahṛtaṃ cittaṃ darśanādevasuṃ dari ||26||
idaṃ tevadanaṃ ramyaṃ munīnāṃ cittahārakam |

tasminkruddhetudaityendretamobhūtamabhūjjagat |
āvahaḥpravahaś caiva vivahothasamīraṇaḥ ||122||
parāvahaḥ saṃ vahaś ca udvahaś ca mahā-balaḥ |
tathāparivahaḥśrī-mānutpātabhayaśaṃ sinaḥ ||123||
ityevaṅkṣubhitāḥsaptamarutogaganecarāḥ |
yegrahāḥ sarva-lokasyakṣayeprādurbhavanti hi ||124||
tesarvegaganehṛṣṭāvyacaraṃ ś ca yathāsukham |
ayogataścāpyacaradyogaṃ niśiniśācaraḥ ||125||
sagrahaḥsahanakṣatraistārāpatirariṃ dama |
vivarṇatāṃ cabhagavāngatodividivākaraḥ ||126||
kṛṣṇaḥkabandhaś ca tadālakṣyatesumahā-ndivi |
asṛjac cāsitāṃ sūryo dhūmavat tāṃ vibhāvasuḥ ||127||
gaganasthaś ca bhagavānabhīkṣṇaṃ pariviṣyate |
saptadhūmanibhāghorāḥsūryādivisamutthitāḥ ||128||
somasyagaganasthasyagrahāstiṣṭhanti śṛṃ ṅgagāḥ |
vāmecadakṣiṇe caiva sthitauśukrabṛhaspatī ||129||
śanaiś ca rolohitāṅgolohitāṅgasamadyutiḥ |
samaṃ samadhirohaṃ tasarvevaigaganecarāḥ ||130||
śṛṅgāṇiśanakair ghorāyugāṃ tāvarttanagrahāḥ |
candramāś ca sanakṣatrograhaiḥsahatamonudaḥ ||131||
carācaravināśāyarohiṇīṃ nābhyanaṃ data |
gṛhītorāhuṇācandraulkābhir abhihanyate ||132||
ulkāḥprajvalitāś ca ndrevyacaraṃ tayathāsukham |
devānām adhipodevaḥsopyavarṣataśoṇitam ||133||
apatadgaganādulkāvidyudrūpāmahā-svanā |
akālecadrumāḥ sarvepuṣpyanti caphalanti ca ||134||
latāś ca saphalāḥsarvāyā āhurdaityanāśikāḥ |
phalephalānyajāyaṃ tapuṣpepuṣpaṃ tathaiva ca ||135||
unmīlanti nimīlanti hasanti prarudanti ca |
vikrośanti cagaṃ bhīraṃ dhūmāyaṃ tejvalanti ca ||136||
pratimāḥ sarvadevānāṃ kathayaṃ tyomahadbhayam |
āraṇyaiḥsahasaṃ sṛṣṭāgrāmyāś ca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ||137||
cukruśurbhair avaṃ tatra mṛgayuddhaupasthite |
nadyaś ca pratikūlāni vahanti kaluṣodakāḥ ||138||
naprākāśaṃ tacadiśoraktareṇusamākulāḥ |
vānaspatyānapūjyaṃ tepūjanārhāḥ kathaṃ cana ||139||
vāyuvegenahanyaṃ tebhajyaṃ tepraṇamanti ca |
tathācasarva-bhūtānāṃ chāyānaparivarttate ||140||
apareṇagatesūryesalokānāṃ yugakṣaye |
tadāhiraṇyakaśipordaityasyopariveśmanaḥ ||141||
bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgāreniviṣṭamabhavanmadhu |
asurāṇāṃ vināśāyasurāṇāṃ vijayāya ca ||142||
dṛśyaṃ tevividhotpātāghorāghoranidarśanāḥ |
etecānyecabahavoghorarūpāḥsamutthitāḥ ||143||
daityendrasyavināśāyadṛśyaṃ teraṇaśaṃ sinaḥ |
medinyāṅkaṃ pamānāyāṃ daityendreṇamahātmanaḥ ||144||
mahīdharānāgagaṇāni peturamitaujasaḥ |
viṣajvālākulair vaktrair vimuṃ canto hutāśanam ||145||
catuḥśīrṣāḥpaṣcaśīrṣāḥsaptaśīrṣāś ca pannagāḥ |
vāsukistakṣakaś caiva karkoṭakadhanaṃ jayau ||146||
elāmukhaḥkāliyaś ca mahā-padmaś ca vīryavān |
sahasraśīrṣaśśuddhāṅgohematāladhvajaḥprabhuḥ ||147||
śeṣonanto mahā-nāgohyaprakaṃ pyaś ca kaṃ pitāḥ |
dīpyaṃ teṃ tarjalasthāni pṛthivīvivarāṇivai ||148||
saptadaityendrakopenakaṃ pitāni samaṃ tataḥ |
nānātejodharāścāpipātālatalacāriṇaḥ ||149||
pātālesahasākṣubdheduṣprakaṃ pyāḥprakaṃ pitāḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityastadāsaṃ spṛṣṭavānmahīm ||150||
saṃ daṣṭauṣṭhapuṭaḥkruddhovarāhaivapūrvajaḥ |
gaṅgābhāgīrathī caiva kauśikīsarayūrapi ||151||
yamunā cātha kāverī kṛṣṇaveṇī ca nimnagā |
tuṅgabhadrā mahā-vegā nadī godāvarī tathā ||152||
carmaṇvatīcasiṃ dhuś ca tathānadanadīpatiḥ |
melakaprabhavaś caiva śoṇomaṇinibhodakaḥ ||153||
narmadācaśubhasrotāstathāvetravatīnadī |
gomatīgokulākīrṇātathāpūrvāsarasvatī ||154||
mahā-kālamahī caiva tamasāpuṣpavāhinī |
jaṃ būdvīpaṃ ratnavaccasarvaratnopaśobhitam ||155||
suvarṇapuṭakaṃ caiva suvarṇākaramaṇḍitam |
mahā-nadaś ca lauhityaśśailaḥkāṣcanaśobhitaḥ ||156||
pattanaṅkośakārāṇāṅkaśaṃ carajatākaram |
magadhāś ca mahā-grāmāḥpuṇḍrā ugrāstathaiva ca ||157||
srughnāmallāvidehāś ca mālavāḥkāśikosalāḥ |
bhavanaṃ vainateyasyadaityendreṇābhikaṃ pitam ||158||
kailāsaśikharākāraṃ yatkṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
ratnatoyomahā-bhīmolauhityonāmasāgaraḥ ||159||
udayaś ca mahā-śailaucchritaḥśatayojanam |
savarṇavedikaḥśrī-mānmeghapaṅktiniṣevitaḥ ||160||
bhrājamānorkasadṛśair jātarūpamayair drumaiḥ |
sālaistālaistamālaiś ca karṇikāraiś ca puṣpitaiḥ ||161||
ayomukhaś ca vikhyātaḥsarvatodhātumaṇḍitaḥ |
tamālavanagandhaś ca parvatomalayaḥśubhaḥ ||162||
surāṣṭrāś ca sabāhlīkāśśūdrābhīrāstathaiva ca |
bhojāḥpāṇḍyāś ca vaṅgāś ca kaliṅgāstāmraliptakāḥ ||163||
tathaivapauṇḍrāḥśubhrāś ca vāmacūḍāḥ sakeralāḥ |
kṣobhitāstenadaityenadevāścāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ ||164||
agastyabhavanaṃ caiva yadagastyakṛtaṃ purā |
siddhacāraṇasaṅghaiś ca viprakīrṇaṃ manoharam ||165||
vicitranānāvihagaṃ sapuṣpitamahā-drumam |
jātarūpamayaiḥśṛṅgair apsarogaṇasevitam ||166||
giriḥpuṣpitakaś caiva lakṣmīvānpriyadarśanaḥ |
utthitaḥsāgaraṃ bhitvāviśrāmaś ca ndrasūryayoḥ ||167||
rarājasamahā-śṛṅgair gaganaṃ vilikhanniva |
candrasūryāṃ śusaṅkāśaiḥsāgarāṃ busamāvṛtaiḥ ||168||
vidyuttvānparvataḥśrī-mānāyataḥśatayojanam |
vidyutāṃ yatra sampātāni pātyaṃ tenagottame ||169||
ṛṣabhaḥparvataś caiva śrī-mānṛṣabhasaṃ sthitaḥ |
kuṃ jaraḥparvataḥśrī-mānagastyasyagṛhaṃ śubham ||170||
vimalākhyācadurddharṣāsarpāṇāṃ mālatīpurī |
tathābhogavatīcāpidaityendreṇābhikaṃ pitā ||171||
mahā-senagiriś caiva pāriyātraś ca parvataḥ |
cakravāṃś ca giri-śreṣṭho vārāhaś caiva parvataḥ ||172||
prāgajyotiṣapuraṃ cāpijātarūpamayaṃ śubham |
yasminnuvāsaduṣṭātmānarakonāmadānavaḥ ||173||
meghaś ca parvataśreṣṭhomeghagaṃ bhīraniḥsvanaḥ |
ṣaṣṭis tatra sahasrāṇiparvatānāṃ viśāṃ pate ||174||
taruṇādityasaṅkāśomeruś caiva mahā-ngiriḥ |
yakṣarākṣasagandharvair nityaṃ sevitakaṃ daraḥ ||175||
hemagarbhomahā-senastathāmeghasakhogiriḥ |
kailāsaś caiva śailendrodānavendreṇakaṃ pitaḥ ||176||
hemapuṣkarasaṣchannaṃ tenavaikhānasaṃ saraḥ |
kaṃ pitaṃ mānasaṃ caiva haṃsakāraṇḍavākulam ||177||
triśṛṅgaḥparvataśreṣṭhaḥkumārīcasaridvarā |
tuṣāracayasaṃ cchannomaṃ daraścāpiparvataḥ ||178||
uśīrabījaś ca girirbhadraprasthastathādrirāṭ |
prajāpatigiriś caiva tathāpuṣkaraparvataḥ ||179||
devābhaḥparvataś caiva tathāvaivālukāgiriḥ |
krauṃ caḥsaptarṣiśailaś ca dhūmravarṇaś ca parvataḥ ||180||
etecānyecagirayodeśājanapadāstathā |
nadyaḥsasāgarāḥsarvāḥdānavenābhikaṃ pitāḥ ||181||
kapilaś ca mahīputrovyāghravāṃ ś ca prakaṃ pitaḥ |
khecarāś ca niśāputrāḥpātālatalavāsinaḥ ||182||
gaṇastathāparoraudromeghanāmāṅkuśāyudhaḥ |
ūrddhvagobhīmavegaś ca sarva etebhikaṃ pitāḥ ||183||
gadīśūlīkarālaś ca hiraṇyakaśipustathā |
jīmūtaghananirghoṣojīmūtaivavegavān ||184||
devārirditijodṛptonṛsiṃ haṃsamupādravat |
satutenatatas tīkṣṇair mṛgendreṇamahā-nakhaiḥ ||185||
tadoṅkārasahāyenavidāryanihatoyudhi |
mahīcakālaś ca śaśīnabhaś ca grahāḥ sasūryāś ca diśaś ca sarvāḥ ||186||
nadyaś ca śailāś ca mahā-rṇavāś ca gatāḥprasādaṃ ditiputranāśāt |
tataḥpramuditādevāṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ ||187||
tuṣṭuvurnāmabhir divyair ādidevaṃ sanātanam |
yattvayāvidhṛtaṃ devanārasiṃ ham idaṃ vapuḥ ||188||
etadevārcayiṣyanti parāparavidojanāḥ |
brahmovāca—
bhavānbrahmācarudraś ca mahendrodevasattamaḥ ||189||
bhavānkarttāvikarttācalokānāṃ prabhavovyayaḥ |
parāṃ casiddhiṃ caparaṃ casatvaṃ paraṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ haviś ca ||190||
paraṃ cadharmaṃ paramaṃ yaśaś ca tvāmāhuragryaṃ paramaṃ purāṇam |
paraṃ casatyaṃ paramaṃ tapaś ca paraṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ camārgaṃ ||191||
paraṃ cayajṣaṃ paramaṃ cahotraṃ tvāmāhuragayraṃ paramaṃ purāṇam |
paraṃ śarīraṃ paramaṃ cabrahmaparaṃ cayogaṃ paramāṃ cavāṇīm ||192||
paraṃ rahasyaṃ paramāṅgatiṃ catvāmāhuragayraṃ paramaṃ purāṇam |
evamuktvātubhagavān sarva-lokapitāmahaḥ ||193||
stutvānārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ brahmalokaṅgataḥprabhuḥ |
tatonadatsutūryeṣu nṛtyaṃ tīṣvapsaraḥsuca ||194||
kṣīrodasyottaraṅkūlaṃ jagāmaharirīśvaraḥ |
nārasiṃ haṃ vapurdevaḥsthāpayitvāsudīptimān ||195||
paurāṇaṃ rūpamāsthāyaprayayaugaraḍadhvajaḥ |
aṣṭacakreṇayānenabhūtiyuktenabhāsvatā ||196||
avyaktaprakṛtirdevaḥsvasthānaṅgatavānprabhuḥ ||197||

śrī-bhīṣma uvāca—
narasiṃ hasyamāhātmyaṃ vistareṇatvayeritaṃ |
tathābhavasyamāhātmyaṃ bhair avasyābhidhīyatām ||1||
pulastya uvāca—
tasyāpidevadevasyaśṛṇutvaṅkarmacottamaṃ |
āsīddaityoṃ dhakonāmabhinnāṃ janacayopamaḥ ||2||
tapasāmahatāyuktohyavadhyastridivaukasām |
sakadācinmahā-devaṃ pārvatyāsahitaṃ vibhuṃ ||3||
krīḍamānantadādṛṣṭvā hartuṃ devīṃ pracakrame |
etāṃ devīṃ harāmyadyaviyogemṛtyumeṣyati ||4||
tataḥsthirābhavitrīmebhāryaiṣālokasuṃ darī |
bibauṣṭhaṃ cāruvadanaṃ cārukāṃ tataraṃ mukhaṃ ||5||
yadyeṣānabhavedbhāryājīvitekiṃ prayojanam |
etāṃ matimathāsthāyamantribhiḥsahamantryaca ||6||
cakreyogaṃ sasainyasyasenāpatimabhāṣata |
ānayasvarathaṃ mahyaṃ jaitraṃ devanipātanam ||7||
jayiṣyetridaśānsarvānviṣṇurudrapurogamān |
hariṣyeparvatasutāṃ tayāmepahṛtaṃ manaḥ ||8||
mantriṇātasyacākhyātaḥkanakasyavadhaḥ suraiḥ |
parabhāryānuraktasyakṛtodevaiḥsavāsavaiḥ ||9||
tataḥkopaparītātmāhanmidevānsaśaṅkarān |
taṃ hatvādānavaṃśakrobhayādaṃ dhāsurasyaca ||10||
jagāmaśaraṇānveṣīkailāsaṃ śaṅkarālayaṃ |
dṛṣṭvā praṇamyadeveśaṃ candrārddhakṛtaśekharaṃ ||11||
bhītovijṣāpayāmāsadhṛtasāhasralocanaḥ |
abhayaṃ dehimedevadānavādaṃ dhakādahaṃ ||12||
bibhemitasyaputrodyamayāyudhinipātitaḥ |
tadyāvannasajānātihataṃ putraṃ mahā-suraḥ ||13||
tāvat tatra stha evāśuhanyatāṃ madbhayāvahaḥ |
strīlaulyāddānavaḥkrūraḥparabhāryāpahārakaḥ ||14||
sarvathāghātanīyastebhavatāsura-sattama |
śakrasyaivaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śaraṇyaḥśaṅkarastadā ||15||
dadāvabhayamevāsaumābhair itiśatakratoḥ |
dattābhayothakelāsādājagāmakuśasthalīm ||16||
vṛtobhūtagaṇair īśovadhārthamaṃ dhakasyatu |
kṛtvārūpaṃ mahā-kāyaṃ viśvarūpaṃ subhair avaṃ ||17||
sarpair jvaladbhir dhāvadbhir bhīmaṃ bhīmabhujaṅgavat |
jaṭāsaṭābhir ākāśaṃ phaṇiratnaśikhārciṣā ||18||
dahannatīvatejobhiḥkālāgnirivasaṅkṣaye |
mukhair daṃ ṣṭrāṅkurāṅkaiś ca dvitīyendukalojjvalaiḥ ||19||
pātālodararūpābhair bhair avārāvanādibhiḥ |
bhujair anekasāhasrair bahuśastrakṛtagrahaḥ ||20||
bahvābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyair aṇeghoraninādibhiḥ |
siṃ hacarmaparīdhānaṃ vyāghratvaguttarīyakaṃ ||21||
gajājinakṛtāṭopaṃ patadbhṛṅgaravākulaṃ |
īdṛgrūpaṃ vidhāyeśodanudaityabhayāvahaṃ ||22||
avātaranmahīṃ bhīmodanūnāṅkṣayakārakaḥ |
aṃ dhāsuropidanujaḥputraṃ śrutvā hataṃ yudhi ||23||
krodhenatamasāviṣṭoraṇatūryāṇyacodayat |
saṃ hatyāvahitaḥprāpto yatra tetridaśāḥsthitāḥ ||24||
mahatyāsenayāsārddhaṃ rathavāraṇayuktayā |
tedevādānavānvīkṣyamahā-havakṛtādarān ||25||
vyapayātatanutrāṇāḥśaṃ bhuṃ śaraṇamanvayuḥ |
mābhair iticatāndevodevānuktvātrilocanaḥ ||26||
gṛhītvāśūlamātiṣṭhaddaṃ ṣṭrāravadharoruṣā |
aṃ dhakenātharuṣṭenaśata-koṭi-śarair gaṇāḥ ||27||
nihatāścāpidevānāṃ bahūnām ekatākṛtāṃ |
sasphuliṅgārciṣovahnermuṃ camānaḥ pinākadhṛk ||28||

danunāthorathasthothaśithilaḥśithilāyudhaḥ ||29||
nimantryadānavānsarvānsayoddhumupacakrame |
bahudhātadbalaṃ bhagnaṃ vividhāyudhayodhibhiḥ ||30||
yudhivīrair hataṃ devaiḥsthāṇunāsakhyamāśritaiḥ |
dānavaścāṃ dhakaḥsainyaṃ bhinnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtaṃ suraiḥ ||31||
ātmānaṃ camaheśenaniruddhaṃ bāṇakoṭibhiḥ |
vihvalībhūtadehosaudhair yamālambya kevalam ||32||
pinākaṃ caiva rudrasyagṛhyarudramatāḍayat |
pinākasyābhighātenarudrobhūmimathāgamat ||33||
bhūmaunipātitedevecalitaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ |

patitebhuvideveśe aṃ dhakogadayāpunaḥ ||35||

muhūrttāccetanāṃ labdhvā utthitaḥparameśvaraḥ |
gṛhītvāparaśuṃ divyaṃ dānavaṃ naivapaśyati ||37||

tayāvimohitedevekvanuvaidānavogataḥ ||38||
śaṃ bhorbhayamathoprāpyakiṃ nupāpaḥkariṣyati |
tamasāchāditāyāvaddevāvyākulatāṅgatāḥ ||39||
 sambhrāṃ tamānasānīkāstadocuḥkāryagauravāt |
etasminnantaresūryastejorūpovyavasthitaḥ ||40||
uttasthaunara-rūpeṇa kurvanvitimirādiśaḥ |

prabhāsaṃ taṃ tadādṛṣṭvā paJcāṅgāliṅgitāvaniḥ||44||

 uvācasnigdhagaṃ bhīravācādevaṃśanair haraḥ |

yajanto jaṃ tavobhaktyāyaṃ devaṃ vividhāḥsadā |
niḥśreyasāyakalpaṃ tetaṃ natobhāskaraṃ vibhum ||49||
yastūdayādriśikharemakuṭāyamānalīlāgabhastibhir alaṅkusumaprakāśaiḥ |

brahmendrarudramarudacyutavahnipāthonāthaprayoganipuṇaiś ca ṛṣīṃ drasaṅghaiḥ |

deveśatepitavapādanatābhavanti sadyodviraṣṭaśaradākṛtayomanuṣyāḥ ||53||

teṣāṃ śriyāvimānānāṃ munīnāṅkiraṇaistathā |
śatasūryamivābhātinān yatra cagṛhodare ||68||
hāhatāsmi kathaṃsūromadgṛhesamupasthitaḥ |

patyurmenidhanebrahmanvidhavālokaniṃ ditā |

vimānenārkavarṇenasvarloṅkādāgatenaca |

idānīṃ śrotumicchāmipatraṃ puṣpaṃ sumokṣadam ||104||
īśvara uvāca—
sarvebhyaḥpatrapuṣpebhyaḥsattamātulasīśivā |
sarvakāmapradāśuddhāvaiṣṇavīviṣṇusupriyā ||105||
bhuktimuktipradāmukhyā sarva-lokaparāśubhā |
yāmāśrityagatāḥsvargamakṣayaṃ munisattamāḥ ||106||
hitārthaṃsarva-lokānāṃ viṣṇunāropitāpurā |
tulasīpatrapuṣpaṣcasarvadharmapratiṣṭhitam ||107||
yathāviṣṇoḥpriyālakṣmīryathāhaṃ priya eva ca |
tatheyaṃ tulasīdevīcaturthonopapadyate ||108||
tulasīpatram ekaṃ tuśatahemaphalapradam |
nānyaiḥpuṣpaistathāpatrair nānyair gandhānulepanaiḥ ||109||
tuṣyatedaityahāviṣṇustulasyāś ca dalair vinā |
anenapūjitoyenaharirnityaṃ parāśayā ||110||
tenadattaṃ hutaṃ jṣātaṅkṛtaṃ yajṣavratādikam |
janmajanmanibhāsitvaṃ sukhaṃ bhāgyaṃ yaśaḥśriyaṃ ||111||
kulaṃ śīlaṅkalatraṃ caputraṃ duhitaraṃ tathā |
dhanaṃ rājyamarogatvaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānameva ca ||112||
vedavedāṅgaśāstraṃ capurāṇāgamasaṃ hitāḥ |
sarvaṅkaragataṃ manyetulasyābhyarcanehareḥ ||113||
yathāgaṅgāpavitrāṅgīsuralokevimokṣadā |
yathābhāgīrathīpuṇyātathaivaṃ tulasīśivā ||114||
kiṃ cagaṅgājalenaivakiṃ capuṣkarasevayā |
tulasīdalamiśreṇajalenaivapramodyate ||115||
mādhavaḥsaṃ mukhoyasyajanmajanmasudhīmataḥ |
tasyaśraddhābhavechrutvātulasyāharimarcitum ||116||
yomaṃ jarīdalair evatulasyāviṣṇumarcayet |
tasyapuṇyaphalaṃ skandakathituṃ naivaśakyate ||117||
 tatra keśavasānnidhyaṃ yatrāstitulasīvanam |
 tatra brahmācakamalāsarvadevagaṇaiḥsaha ||118||
tasmāt tāṃ saṃ nikṛṣṭetusadādevīṃ prapūjayet |
stotramantrādikaṃ yadvāsarvamānaṃ tyamaśnute ||119||
yecapretāś ca kūśmāṇḍāḥpiśācābrahmarākṣasāḥ |
bhūtadaityādayas tatra palāyaṃ tesadaivahi ||120||
alakṣmīrnāśinīghūrṇāyāḍākinyādimātaraḥ |
sarvāḥsaṅkocitāṃ yānti dṛṣṭvā tutulasīdalaṃ ||121||
brahmahatyādayaḥpāpavyādhayaḥpāpa sambhavāḥ |
kumantriṇākṛtāyecasarvenaśyanti tatra vai ||122||
bhūtalevāpitaṃ yenaharyarthaṃ tulasīvanam |
kṛtaṅkratuśataṃ tenavidhivatpriyadakṣiṇam ||123||
hariliṅgeṣu cānyeṣu sālagrāmaśilāsuca |
tulasīgrahaṇaṅkṛtvāviṣṇoḥsāyujyamāvrajet ||124||
naṃ danti puruṣāstasyamādhavārthekṣitautuyaḥ |
tulasīṃ ropayeddhīraḥsayātimādhavālayam ||125||
pūjayitvāhariṃ devaṃ nirmālyaṃ tulasīdalam |
dhārayedyaḥsvaśīrṣetupāpātpūtodivaṃ vrajet ||126||
pūjanekīrttanedhyāneropaṇedhāraṇekalau |
tulasīdahatepāpaṃ rsvargaṃ mokṣaṃ dadātica ||127||
upadeśaṃ diśedasyāḥsvayamācaratepunaḥ ||128||
sayātiparamaṃ sthānaṃ mādhavasyaniketanam |
hareḥpriyakaraṃ yaccatanmepriyataraṃ bhavet ||129||
sarveṣāmapidevānāṃ devīnāṃ macasamaṃ tataḥ |
śrāddheṣu yajṣakāryeṣu parṇam ekaṃ ṣaḍānana ||130||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnenatulasīsevanaṅkuru |
tulasīsevitāyenatenasarvaṃ tusevitam ||131||
guruṃ vipraṃ devatīrthaṃ tasmāt sevayaṣaṇmukha |
śikhāyāṃ tulasīṅkṛtvāyastuprāṇānparityajet ||132||
duṣkṛtaughādvinirmuktaḥsvargametinirāmayam |
rājasūyādibhir yajṣair vrataiś ca vividhair yamaiḥ ||133||
yāgatiḥprāpyatedhīraiḥtulasīsevināṃ bhavet |
tulasīdalenacaikenapūjayitvāhariṃ naraḥ ||134||
vaiṣṇavatvam avāpnotikimanyaiḥśāstravistaraiḥ |
napibetsapayomātustulasyāḥkoṭisaṅkhyakaiḥ ||135||
arcitaḥkeśavoyenaśākhāmṛdulapallavaiḥ |
bhāvayetpuruṣānmartyaḥśataśothasahasraśaḥ ||136||
pūjayitvāhariṃ nityaṅkomalaistulasīdalaiḥ |
pradhānatoguṇāstātatulasyāgaditāmayā ||137||
nikhilaṃ purukālenaguṇaṃ vaktuṃ naśaknumaḥ |
yastvidaṃ śṛṇuyānnityamākhyānaṃ puṇyasaṃ cayam ||138||
pūrvajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyatejanmabandhanāt |
sakṛtpaṭhanamātreṇavahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||139||
natasyavyādhayaḥputramūrkhatvaṃ nakadācana |
sarvadājayamāpnotinagacchetsaparājayaṃ ||140||
lekhastiṣṭhedgṛheyasyatasyalakṣmīḥpravartate |
nacādhayonacapretānaśokonāvamānanā ||141||
natiṣṭhanti kṣaṇaṃ tatra yatreyaṃ vartatelipiḥ ||142||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe prathame sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍe 
tulasī-māhātmyaṃ nāma
ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||60||

(61)
ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ
dvijā ūcuḥ--
tulasīpuṣpamāhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ tvattohareḥśubham |
tasyāstotraṅkṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ śrotumicchāmahevayam ||1||
vyāsa uvāca—
purāskaṃ dapurāṇecayanmayākīrtitaṃ dvijāḥ |
 kathayāmipurāṇaṃ capuratomokṣahetave ||2||
śatānaṃ damuneḥśiṣyāḥsarvetesaṃ śitavratāḥ |
praṇipatyaguruṃ viprāḥpapracchuḥpuṇyatohitam ||3||
pūrvaṃ brahmamukhānnāthayacchrutaṃ talasīstavam |
tadvayaṃ śrotumicchāmastvattobrahmavidāṃ vara ||4||
śatānaṃ da uvāca—
nāmoccārekṛtetasyāḥprīṇātyasuradarpahā |
pāpāni vilayaṃ yānti puṇyaṃ bhavaticākṣayam ||5||
sā kathaṃ tulasīlokaiḥpūjyatevaṃ dyatena hi |
darśanādevayasyāstudānaṅkoṭigavāṃ bhavet ||6||
dhanyāstemānavālokeyadgṛhevidyatekalau |
sālagrāmaśilārthaṃ tutulasīpratyahaṅkṣitau ||7||
tulasīṃ yevicinvanti dhanyāstekarapallavāḥ |
keśavārthaṅkalauyecaropayaṃ tīhabhūtale ||8||
kiṅkariṣyatisaṃ ruṣṭoyamopisahaiṅkaṅkaraiḥ |
tulasīdalenadeveśaḥpūjitoyenaduḥkhahā ||9||
tīrthayātrādigamanaiḥphalaiḥsidhyatikinnaraḥ |
snānedānetathādhyāneprāśanekeśavārcane ||10||
tulasīdahatepāpaṅkīrtaneropaṇekalau |
tulasyamṛtajanmāsisadātvaṅkeśavapriye ||11||
keśavārthaṃ cinomitvāṃ varadābhavaśobhane |
tvadaṅga sambhavair nityaṃ pūjayāmiyathāharim ||12||
tathākurupavitrāṅgikalaumalavināśini |
mantreṇānenayaḥkuryādvicityatulasīdalam ||13||
pūjanaṃ vāsudevasyalakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |
prabhāvaṃ tava deveśi gāyanti sura-sattamāḥ ||14||
munayaḥ siddha-gandharvāḥ pātāle nāgarāṭ svayam |
na te prabhāvaṃ jānanti devatāḥ keśavādṛte ||15||
guṇānāṃ parimāṇaṃ tu kalpa-koṭi-śatair api |
kṛṣṇānandāt samudbhūtā kṣīroda-mathanodyame ||16||
uttamāṅge purā yena tulasī viṣṇunā dhṛtā |
prāpyaitāni tvayā devi viṣṇor aṅgāni sarvaśaḥ ||17||
pavitratā tvayā prāptā tulasīṃ tvāṃ namāmy aham |
tvad-aṅga-sambhavaiḥ patraiḥ pūjayāmi yathā harim ||18||
tathā kuruṣva me'vighnaṃ yato yāmi parāṃ gatim |
ropitā gomatī-tīre svayaṃ kṛṣṇena pālitā ||19||
jagad-dhitāya tulasī gopīnāṃ hita-hetave |
vṛndāvane vicaratā sevitā viṣṇunā svayam ||20||
gokulasya vivṛddhy-arthaṃ kaṃsasya nidhanāya ca |
vasiṣṭha-vacanāt pūrvaṃ rāmeṇa sarayū-taṭe ||21||
rākṣasānāṃ vadhārthāya ropitātvaṃ jagat-priye |
ropitā tapaso vṛddhyai tulasīṃ tvāṃ namāmy aham ||22||
viyoge vāsudevasya dhyātvā tvāṃ janakātmajā |
aśoka-vana-madhye tu priyeṇa saha saṅgatā ||23||
śaṅkarārthaṃ purā devi pārvatyā tvaṃ himālaye |
ropitā tapaso vṛddhyai tulasīṃ tvāṃ namāmy aham ||24||
sarvābhir deva-patnībhiḥ kinnaraiś cāpi nandane |
duḥsvapna-nāśanārthāya sevitā tvaṃ namo’stu te ||25||
dharmāraṇye gayāyāṃ ca sevitā pitṛbhiḥ svayam |
sevitā tulasī puṇyā ātmano hitam icchatā ||26||
ropitā rāmacandreṇa sevitā lakṣmaṇena ca |
pālitā sītayā bhaktyā tulasī daṇḍake vane ||27||
trailokya-vyāpinī gaṅgā yathā śāstreṣu gīyate |
tathaiva tulasī devī dṛśyate sa-carācare ||28||
ṛśyamūke ca vasatā kapirājena sevitā |
tulasī vāli-nāśāya tārā-saṅgama-hetave ||29||
praṇamya tulasī-devīṃ sāgarotkramaṇaṃ kṛtam |
kṛta-kāryaḥ prahṛṣṭaś ca hanūmān punar āgataḥ ||30||
tulasī-grahaṇaṃ kṛtvā vimukto yāti pātakaiḥ |
athavā muni-śārdūla brahma-hatyāṃ vyapohati ||31||
tulasī-patra-galitaṃ yas toyaṃ śirasā vahet |
gaṅgā-snānam avāpnoti daśa-dhenu-phala-pradam ||32||
prasīda devi deveśi prasīda hari-vallabhe |
kṣīroda-mathanodbhūte tulasi tvāṃ namāmy aham ||33||
dvādaśyāṃ jāgare rātrau yaḥ paṭhet tulasī-stavam |
dvātriṃśad-aparādhāṃś ca kṣamate tasya keśavaḥ ||34||
yat pāpaṃ yauvane bālye kaumāre vārdhake kṛtam |
tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tulasī-stava-pāṭhataḥ ||35||
prītimāyātideveśastuṣṭolakṣmīṃ prayacchati |
kuruteśatrunāśaṃ casukhaṃ vidyāṃ prayacchati ||36||
tulasīnām amātreṇadevāyacchanti vāṃ chitam |
garhyāṇamapideveśomuktiṃ yacchatidehinām ||37||
tulasīstavasaṃ tuṣṭāsukhaṃ vṛddhiṃ dadātica |
udgataṃ helayāviddhipāpaṃ yamapathesthitam ||38||
yasmingṛhecalikhitovidyatetulasīstavaḥ |
nāśubhaṃ vidyatetasyaśubhamāpnotiniścitam ||39||
sarvaṃ camaṅgalaṃ tasyanāstikiṃ cidamaṅgalam |
subhikṣaṃ sarvadātasyadhanaṃ dhānyaṃ capuṣkalam ||40||
niś ca lākeśavebhaktirnaviyogaś ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ |
jīvativyādhinirmuktonādharmejāyatematiḥ ||41||
dvādaśyāṃ jāgarerātrauyaḥpaṭhettulasīstavam |
tīrthakoṭisahasraistuyatphalaṃ lakṣakoṭibhiḥ ||42||
tatphalaṃ samavāpnotipaṭhitvātulasīstavam ||43||
iti śrī-padma-purāṇe prathame sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍe tulasīstavamāhātmyaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||61||
||dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ||
dvijāūcuḥ--
majjanādakhilaṃ pāpaṅkṣayaṃ yātisuniścitam |
mahā-pātakamanyaccatadādeśaṃ vadasvanaḥ ||1||
pāpātpūto'kṣayaṃ nākamaśnutediviśakravat |
surayonernahāni ḥsyādupadeśaṃ vadasvanaḥ ||2||
atrabhogyaṃ paraṃ sarvaṃ mṛtesvargesurottamaḥ |
kalipāpahatānāṃ casvargasopānamucyate ||3||
vyāsa uvāca—
gatiṃ ciṃ tayatāṃ viprāstūrṇaṃ sāmānyajanmanām |
strīpuṃ sāmīkṣaṇādyasmādgaṅgāpāpaṃ vyapohati ||4||
gaṅgetismaraṇādevakṣayaṃ yāticapātakam |
kīrtanādatipāpāni darśanādgurukalmaṣam ||5||
snānātpānāccajāhnavyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇāttathā |
mahā-pātakavṛndāni kṣayaṃ yānti dinedine ||6||
agninādahyatetūlaṃ tṛṇaṃ śuṣkaṅkṣaṇādyathā |
tathāgaṅgājalasparśātpuṃ sāṃ pāpaṃ dahetkṣaṇāt ||7||
 samprāpnotyakṣayaṃ svargaṅgaṅgāsnānenakeśavam |
yaśorājyaṃ labhetpuṇyaṃ svargamaṃ teparāṅgatim ||8||
pitṝn uddiśya gaṅgāyāṃ yas tu piṇḍaṃ prayacchati |
vidhināvākyapūrveṇatasyapuṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||9||
annaikenatusāhasraṃ varṣaṃ pūjyaḥsurālaye |
tilenadviguṇaṃ viddhitathāmedhyaphalenaca ||10||
gavyenavidhināviprāḥsvargasyānto navidyate |
evaṃ piḍapradānenanityaṅkratuśataṃ bhavet ||11||
pitaronirayasthāyedhanyāstemartyavāsinaḥ |
dhanaputrayutārogyaṃ sukhasaṃ mānapūjitāḥ ||12||
rasātalagatāyecayecakīṭāmahītale |
sthāvarepakṣisaṅghādautemartyādhaninonṛpāḥ ||13||
tattatputraiś ca pautraiś ca gotrair dauhitrakaistathā |
jāmātṛbhāgineyaiś ca suhṛnmitraiḥpriyāpriyaiḥ ||14||
pradīyatejalaṃ piṇḍaṃ yathopakaraṇānvitam |
gaṅgātoyeṣu tīreṣu teṣāṃ svargo'kṣayobhavet ||15||
piṇḍādūrdhvaṃ sthitāyecapitaromātṛgotrajāḥ |
bhavanti sukhinaḥsarvemartyāśśatasahasraśaḥ ||16||
svargetasyasthitāḥsatvā adhaḥsthāmadhyavāsinaḥ |
nityaṃ vāṃ ṣchanti sadgaṅgāṅgacchaṃ tusuranimnagām ||17||
ekogacchatigaṅgāṃ yaḥpūyaṃ tetasyapūruṣāḥ |
etadevamahā-puṇyaṃ taratetārayatyapi ||18||
gaṅgākṛtsnaguṇaṃ vaktuṃ naśaktaś ca turānanaḥ |
ataḥkiṃ cidvadām yatra bhāgīrathyādvijāguṇam ||19||
munayaḥsiddhagandharvāyecānyesura-sattamāḥ |
gaṅgātīretapastaptvāsvargaloke'cyutābhavan ||20||
divyenavapuṣāsarvekāmagenarathenaca |
adyāpi nanivartaṃ teratnapūrṇakṣayeṣu vai ||21||
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇāḥ sarva-lokordhvagāśśivāḥ |
iṣṭadravyaiḥsu sampūrṇāḥstriyo yatra manoramāḥ ||22||
pārijātaḥsamāḥpuṣpavṛkṣāḥkalpadrumopamāḥ |
gaṅgātīretapastaptvā tatra iśvaryaṃ labhanti hi ||23||
tapobhir bahubhir yajṣair vratair nānāvidhaistathā |
purudānair gatiryācagaṅgāṃ saṃ sevatāṃ casā ||24||
jārajaṃ patitaṃ duṣṭamaṃ tyajaṅgurughātinam |
sarvadroheṇasaṃ yuktaṃ sarvapātakasaṃ yutam ||25||
tyajanti pitaraṃ putrāḥpriyaṃ patnyaḥsuhṛdgaṇāḥ |
anyecabāndhavāḥsarvegaṅgātunaparityajet ||26||
yathāmātāsvayaṃ janmamalaśaucaṃ cakārayet |
kroḍīkṛtyatathāteṣāṅgaṅgāprakṣālayenmalam ||27||
bhavanti tesuvikhyātābhogyālaṅkārapūjitāḥ |
darśanekriyategaṅgāsakṛdbhaktyānaraistuyaiḥ ||28||
teṣāṅkulānāṃ lakṣaṃ tubhavāttārayateśivā |
smṛtārtihartrīyair dhyātāsaṃ stutāsādhumoditā ||29||
gaṅgātārayatenṝṇāmubhauvaṃśaubhavārṇavāt |
saṅkrāṃ tiṣuvyatīpātegrahaṇecandrasūryayoḥ ||30||
puṇyesnātvātugaṅgāyāṅkulakoṭiṃ samuddharet |
śuklapakṣedivāmartyāgaṅgāyāmuttarāyaṇe ||31||
dhanyā dehaṃ vimuṣcanti hṛdisthe ca janārdane |
anena vidhinā yas tu bhāgīrathyā jale śubhe ||32||
prāṇāṃs tyaktvā vrajet svargaṃ punar āvṛtti-varjitam |
yogaṅgānugato nityaṃ sarva-devānugo hi saḥ ||33||
sarvadevamayoviṣṇurgaṅgāviṣṇumayīyataḥ |
gaṅgāyāṃ piṇḍa-dānena pitṝṇāṃ vai tilodakaiḥ ||34||
narakasthādivaṃ yānti svargasthāmokṣamāpnuyuḥ |
paradāraparadravyabādhādrohaparasyaca ||35||
gatirmanuṣyamātrasyagaṅgaivaparamāgatiḥ |
vedaśāstravihīnasyaguruniṃ dāparasyaca ||36||
samayācāra-hīnasya nāsti gaṅgā-samā gatiḥ |
kiṃ yajṣair bahuvittāḍhyaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiḥ suduṣkaraiḥ ||37||
svargamokṣapradāgaṅgāsukhasaubhāgyapūjitā |
niyamaiḥparamair nityaṅkiṃ yogaiścittarodhakaiḥ ||38||
bhuktimuktipradāgaṅgāsukhamokṣāgrataḥsthitā |
anekajanmasaṅghātapāpaṃ puṃ sāṃ vinaśyati ||39||
snāna-mātreṇa gaṅgāyāṃ sadyaḥ syāt puṇyabhāṅ naraḥ |
prabhāsegosahasrasyarāhugrastedivākare ||40||
labhateyatphalaṃ dānegaṅgāsnānāddinedine |
dṛṣṭvā tuharatepāpaṃ spṛṣṭvātulabhatedivam ||41||
prasaṅgādapisāgaṅgāmokṣadātvavagāhitā |
sarvendriyāṇāṃ cāpalyaṃ vāsanāśakti sambhavam ||42||
nirghṛṇatvaṃ tatogaṅgādarśanātpravinaśyati |
paradravyābhikāṅkṣitvaṃ paradārābhilāṣitā ||43||
paradharmeruciś caiva darśanādevanaśyati |
yadṛcchālābhasanto ṣaḥ svadharmeṣu pravartate ||44||
sarva-bhūta-samatvaṃ ca gaṅgāyāṃ majjanād bhavet |
yas tu gaṅgāṃ samāśritya sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ ||45||
jīvanmuktaḥ sa evehasarveṣāmuttamottamaḥ |
gaṅgāṃ saṃ śrityayastiṣṭhettasyakāryaṃ navidyate ||46||
kṛtakṛtyaḥ savaimuktojīvanmuktaś ca mānavaḥ |
yajṣodānantapojapyaṃ śrāddhaṃ casurapūjanam ||47||
gaṅgāyāṃ tu kṛtaṃ nityaṃ koṭi-koṭi-guṇaṃ bhavet |
anyasthānekṛtaṃ pāpaṅgaṅgātīrevinaśyati ||48||
gaṅgātīrekṛtaṃ pāpaṅgaṅgāsnānenanaśyati |
ātmanojanmanakṣatrejāhnavīsaṅgatedine ||49||
naraḥ snātvā tu gaṅgāyāṃ sva-kulaṃ ca samuddharet |
ādareṇayathāstautidhanavaṃ taṃ sadānaraḥ ||50||
sakṛdgaṅgāṃ tathāstutvābhavetsvargasyabhājanam |
aśraddhayāpi gaṅgāyāṃ yo’sau nāmānukīrtanaṃ ||51||
karoti puṇya-vāhinyāḥ sa vai svargasya bhājanam |

nihato vāsudevena praviṣṭo vaiṣṇavīṃ tanum ||8||
sṛṣṭi-bhāvaṃ śṛṇuṣva tvam asyaiva ca mahātmanaḥ |
saṅgaraṃ prāpya putrādyair viṣṇunā saha vīryavān ||9||
praviṣṭo vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ samprāpya svena tejasā |
purākalpe mahā-bhāga yathā-jātaḥ sa vīryavān ||10||
vṛttāṃ taṃ tasya vīrasya pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ |
paścime sāgarasyānte dvārakā nāma vai purī ||11||
sarva-ṛddhi-samāyuktā sarva-siddhi-samanvitā |

śivaśarmeti vikhyāto veda-śāstrārtha-kovidaḥ |
tasyāpi paṣca-putrās tu babhūvuḥ śāstra-kovidāḥ ||13||
yajṣaśarmā vedaśarmā dharmaśarmā tathaiva ca |

na vidanti mahātmānas tad-bhāvena tu bhāvitāḥ |
teṣāṃ tu bhaktiṃ sampaśyaṣ chivaśarmā dvijottamaḥ ||16||

viṣṇoś caiva prasādāt sa sarva-siddhir babhūva ha ||18||

upāyaṃ brāhmaṇa-śreṣṭhas tapasas tejasaḥ kila ||19||

priyavāksatyavādīcadhānyavāndhanavānguṇī |

 uvācacainaṃ rājānamavadhyāstrīsadānṛpa ||108||

gavāṃ vadhemahatpāpaṃ dṛṣṭamastidvijottamaiḥ ||109||
mayāvināmahā-rājakathaṃ dhārayaseprajāḥ |

mayilokāḥ sthirārājanmayedaṃ dhāryatejagat |
madvināśevinaśyeyuḥ prajāḥ sarvā na saṃśayaḥ ||113||
namāmarhasivaihaṃ tuṃ śreyaścettvaṃ cikīrṣasi |
prajānāṃ pṛthivīpālaśṛṇudevavacomama ||114||

samālokyahyupāyaṃ tvaṃ prajāyenadhariṣyati ||115||
māṃ hatvātvaṃ mahā-rājadhāraṇepālanesadā |
poṣaṇecamahā-prājṣamadvināhikathaṃ nṛpa ||116||

annamayībhaviṣyāmidhariṣyāmiprajāmimām ||117||

avadhyāṃ tu striyaṃ prāhus tiryag-yoni-gatām api ||118||
vicāryaivaṃ mahā-rājan adharmaṃ tyaktum arhasi |
evaṃ nānā-vidhair vākyair ukto dhātryā narādhipaḥ ||119||

evam uktas tayā rājā pṛthur vainyaḥ prajāpatiḥ |

ayaṃ rājāmahā-raudraḥ kālarūpaḥ samāgataḥ |

ikṣvākurnāmadurdharṣomanuputromahā-balaḥ |
saṃ hariṣyatikālo'yaṃ dūraṃ yātasuputrakāḥ ||70||
putrā ūcuḥ 
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvāyaḥ prayātisapāpadhīḥ |
mahā-raudraṃ sughoraṃ tunarakaṃ pratipadyate ||71||
mātuḥ puṇyaṃ payaḥ pītvā puṣṭo bhavati nirghṛṇaḥ |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvā yaḥ prayāti sudurbalaḥ ||72||
pūyaṃ narakam etīha kṛmi-durgandha-saṅkulam |
mātustasmānnayāsyāmoguruṃ tyaktvāihaivaca ||73||
evaṃ viṣādaḥ saṃ jātasteṣāṃ dharmārthasaṃ yutaḥ |
vyūhaṅkṛtvāsthitāḥ sarvebalatejaḥ samākulāḥ ||74||
sāhasotsāhasaṃ pannāḥ paśyanti nṛpanaṃ danam |
nadaṃ taḥ pauruṣairyuktāḥ krīḍamānāvanetadā ||75||

paṣcacatvāriṃ śattamo'dhyāyaḥ 
sukalovāca—
athatelubdhakāḥ sarveśūkarīṃ pratijagmire |

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe bhūmi-khaṇḍevenopākhyānesukalācaritre

tadannaṃ piṇḍakavalairgrāsairbhuktaṃ cadehibhiḥ |
annamūlāśayesarva-prāṇānsthāpayatikramāt ||16||
apakvaṃ bhuktamāhāraṃ savāyuḥ kurutedvidhā |
saṃ praviśyānnamadhyecapakvaṅkṛtvāpṛthagguṇam ||17||
agnerūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpyatadannaṃ cajalopari |
jalasyādhaḥ svayaṃ prāṇaḥ sthitvāgniṃ dhamateśanaiḥ ||18||
vāyunādhamyamānogniratyuṣṇaṅkurutejalam |
tadannamuṣṇayogenasamaṃ tātpacyatepunaḥ ||19||
dvidhābhavatitatpakvaṃ pṛthaikkaṭṭaṃ pṛthagrasaḥ |
malairdvādaśabhiḥ kiṭṭaṃ bhinnaṃ dehādbahirvrajet ||20||
karṇākṣināsikājihvādaṃ toṣṭhaprajanaṅgudā |
malānasravedathasvedoviṇmūtraṃ dvādaśasmṛtāḥ ||21||
hṛtpadmepratibaddhāścasarvanāḍyaḥ samaṃ tataḥ |
tāsāṃ mukheṣutaṃ sūkṣmaṃ prāṇaḥ sthāpayaterasam ||22||
rasenatenatānāḍīḥ prāṇaḥ pūrayatepunaḥ |
saṃ tarpayanti tānāḍyaḥ pūrṇādehaṃ samaṃ tataḥ ||23||
tataḥ sanāḍīmadhyasthaḥ śārīreṇoṣmaṇārasaḥ |
pacyatepacyamānaścabhavetpākadvayaṃ punaḥ ||24||
tvaṅmāṃ sāsthimajjāmedorudhiraṃ caprajāyate |
raktāllomānimāṃ saṃ cakeśāḥ snāyuścamāṃ sataḥ ||25||
snāyormajjātathāsthīnivasāmajjāsthi sambhavā |
majjākāreṇavaikalyaṃ śukraṃ caprasavātmakam ||26||
itidvādaśaśāntasya pariṇāmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
śukraṃ tasya parīṇāmaḥ śukrāddehasya sambhavaḥ ||27||
ṛtukāleyadāśukraṃ nirdoṣaṃ yonisaṃ sthitam |
tadātadvāyusaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ strīraktenaikatāṃ vrajet ||28||
visargakāleśukrasya jīvaḥ kāraṇasaṃ yutaḥ |
nityaṃ praviśateyoniṅkarmabhiḥ svairniyaṃ tritaḥ ||29||
śukrasya saharaktasya ekāhātkalalaṃ bhavet |
paṣcarātreṇakalalebudbudatvaṃ tatobhavet ||30||
māṃ satvaṃ māsamātreṇapaṣcadhājāyatepunaḥ |
grīvāśiraścaskaṃ dhaścapṛṣṭhavaṃ śastathodaram ||31||
pāṇīpādautathāpārśvaukaṭirgātraṃ tathaiva ca |
māsadvayenaparvāṇikramaśaḥ sambhavanti ca ||32||
tribhirmāsaiḥ prajāyaṃ teśataśoṅkurasaṃ dhayaḥ |
māsaiś ca turbhirjāyaṃ teaṅgulyādiyathākramam ||33||
mukhaṃ nāsācakarṇaucamāsairjāyanti paṣcabhiḥ |
daṃ tapaṅktistathājihvājāyatetunakhāḥ punaḥ ||34||
karṇayoścabhavecchidraṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃ tarepunaḥ |
pāyurmeḍhramupasthaṃ caśiśnaścāpyujāyate ||35||
saṃ dhayoyecagātreṣumāsairjāyanti saptabhiḥ |
aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃ pūrṇaṃ śiraḥ keśasamanvitam ||36||
vibhaktāvayavaspaṣṭaṃ punarmāsāṣṭamebhavet |
paṃ cātmakasamāyuktaḥ paripakvaḥ satiṣṭhati ||37||
māturāhāravīryeṇaṣaḍvidhenarasenaca |
nābhisūtranibaddhenavarddhatesadinedine ||38||
tataḥ smṛtiṃ labhejjīvaḥ saṃ pūrṇosmiṣcharīrake | 
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vijānātinidrāṃ svapnaṃ purākṛtam ||39||
mṛtaścāhaṃ punarjātojātaścāhaṃ punarmṛtaḥ |
nānāyonisahasrāṇimayādṛṣṭānyanekadhā ||40||
adhunājātamātrohaṃ prāptasaṃ skāra eva ca |
tataḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyāmiyenagarbhena sambhavaḥ ||41||
garbhasthaścintayatyevamahaṅgarbhādviniḥ sṛtaḥ |
adhyeṣyāmiparaṃ jñānaṃ saṃ sāravinivartakam ||42||
avaśyaṅgarbhaduḥkhenamahatāparipīḍitaḥ |
jīvaḥ karmavaśādāstemokṣopāyaṃ vicintayet ||43||
yathāgirivarākrāṃ taḥ kaścidduḥkhenatiṣṭhati |
tathājarāyuṇādehīduḥkhanti ṣṭhatiduḥkhitaḥ ||44||
patitaḥ sāgareyadvadduḥkhamāstesamākulaḥ |
garbhodakenasiktāṅgastathāstevyākulātmakaḥ ||45||
lohakuṃ bheyathānyastaḥ pacyatekaścidagninā |
garbhakuṃ bhetathākṣiptaḥ pacyatejaṭharāgninā ||46||
sūcībhiragnivarṇābhirbhinnagātroniraṃ taram |
yadduḥkhaṃ jāyatetasya tadgarbheṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet ||47||
garbhavāsātparaṃ vāsaṅkaṣṭaṃ naivāstikutracit |
dehināṃ duḥkhamatulaṃ sughoramapisaṅkaṭam ||48||
ityetadgarbhaduḥkhaṃ hiprāṇināṃ parikīrtitam |
carasthirāṇāṃ sarveṣāmātmagarbhānurūpataḥ ||49||
garbhātkoṭiguṇāpīḍāyoniyaṃ tranipīḍanāt |
saṃ mūrcchitasya jāyetajāyamānasya dehinaḥ ||50||
ikṣuvatpīḍyamānasya pāpamudgarapeṣaṇāt |
garbhānniṣkramamāṇasya prabalaiḥ sūtivāyubhiḥ ||51||
jāyatesumahadduḥkhaṃ paritrāṇaṃ naviṃ dati |
yaṃ treṇapīḍyamānāḥ syurniḥ sārāścayathekṣavaḥ ||52||
tathāśarīraṃ yonisthaṃ pātyateyaṃ trapīḍanāt |
asthimadvartulākāraṃ snāyubandhanaveṣṭitam ||53||
raktamāṃ savasāliptaṃ viṇmūtradravyabhājanam |
keśalomanakhacchannaṃ rogāyatanamuttamam ||54||
vadanaikamahā-dvāraṅgavākṣāṣṭakabhūṣitam |
oṣṭhadvayakapāṭaṃ tudaṃ tajihvāgalānvitam ||55||
nāḍīsvedapravāhaṃ cakaphapittapariplutam |
jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṅkālavaktrānalesthitam ||56||
kāmakrodhasamākrāṃ taṃ śvasanaiścopamarditam |
bhogatṛṣṇāturaṅgūḍhaṃ rāgadveṣavaśānugam ||57||
savarṇitāṅgapratyaṅgaṃ jarāyupariveṣṭitam |
saṅkaṭenāviviktenayonimārgeṇanirgatam ||58||
viṇ-mūtra-rakta-siktāṅgaṃ ṣaṭ-kauśika-samudbhavam |
asthipaṃ jarasaṅghātaṃ jṣeyamasminkalevare ||59||
śatatrayaṃ śatādhikaṃ paṣcapeśīśatānica |
sārdhābhistisṛbhiśchannaṃ samaṃ tādromakoṭibhiḥ ||60||
śarīraṃ sthūlasūkṣmābhirdṛśyādṛśyābhiraṃ tataḥ |
etābhirmāṃ sanāḍībhiḥ koṭibhistatsamanvitam ||61||
prasvedamaśuciṃ tābhiraṃ tarasthaṃ catenahi |
dvātriṃ śaddaśanāḥ proktāviṃśatiścanakhāḥ smṛtāḥ ||62||
pittasya kuḍavaṃ jṣeyaṅkaphasyārdhāḍhakaṃ tathā |
vasāyāścapalāḥ paṣcatadardhaṃ phalakasya ca ||63||
paṃ cārbudapalājṣeyāḥ palānidaśamedasaḥ |
palatrayaṃ mahā-raktaṃ majjāraktāccaturguṇā ||64||
śukrārdhakuḍavaṃ jṣeyaṃ tadardhaṃ dehināṃ balam |
māṃ sasya caikaṃ piṇḍenapalasāhasramucyate ||65||
raktaṃ palaśataṃ jṣeyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ cāpramāṇataḥ |
itidehagṛherājanvāsaḥ syānnityamātmanaḥ ||66||
aśuddhaṃ caviśuddhasya karmabandhavinirmitam |
śukraśoṇitasaṃ yogāddehaḥ saṃ jāyatekvacit ||67||
nityaṃ viṇmūtrasaṃ yuktastenāyamaśuciḥ smṛtaḥ |
yathāvaiviṣṭhayāpūrṇaḥ śuciḥ sāṃ tarbahirghaṭaḥ ||68||
śaucenaśodhyamānopidehoyamaśucirbhavet |
yaṃ prāpyātipavitrāṇipaṣcagavyahavīṃ ṣica ||69||
aśucitvaṃ prayāṃ tyāśudehoyamaśucistataḥ |
hṛdyānyapyannapānāniyaṃ prāpyasurabhīṇica ||70||
aśucitvaṃ prayāṃ tyāśuko'nyaḥ syādaśucistataḥ |
hejanāḥ kiṃ napaśyadhvaṃ yanniryātidinedine ||71||
dehānugomalaḥ pūtistadādhāraḥ kathaṃ śuciḥ |
dehaḥ saṃ śodhyamānopipaṣcagavyakuśāṃ bubhiḥ ||72||
ghṛṣyamāṇaivāṅgāronirmalatvaṃ nagacchati |
srotāṃ siyasya satataṃ pravahanti gireriva ||73||
kaphamūtrādyamaśuciḥ sadehaḥ śudhyatekatham |
sarvāśucinidhānasya śarīrasya navidyate ||74||
śucirekapradeśopiśucirnasyādṛte'pivā |
divāvāyadivārātraumṛttauyaiḥ śodhyatekaraḥ ||75||
tathāpiśucibhāṅnasyānnavirajyanti tenarāḥ |
kāyoyamagryadhūpādyairyatnenāpisusaṃ skṛtaḥ ||76||
najahātisvabhāvaṃ hiśvapucchamivanāmitam |
tathājātyaivakṛṣṇorṇānaśuklājātujāyate ||77||
saṃ śodhyamānāpitathābhavenmūrtirnanirmalā |
jighrannapisvadurgandhaṃ paśyannapimalaṃ svakam ||78||
navirajyatiloko'yaṃ pīḍayannapināsikām |
ahomohasya māhātmyaṃ yenavyāmohitaṃ jagat ||79||
jighranpaśyansvakāndoṣānkāyasya navirajyate |
svadehasya vigaṃ dhenavirajyetanayonaraḥ ||80||
virāgakāraṇaṃ tasya kimanyadupadiśyate |
sarvam eva jagatpūtaṃ dehamevāśuciḥ param ||81||
yanmalāvayavasparśācchucirapyaśucirbhavet |
gandhalepāpanodāyaśaucaṃ dehasya kīrtitam ||82||
dvayasyāpagamātpaścādbhāvaśuddhyāviśuddhyati |
gaṅgātoyenasarveṇamṛdbhārairgātralepanaiḥ ||83||
martyodurgandhadehosaubhāvaduṣṭonaśudhyati |
tīrtha-snānais tapobhiś ca duṣṭātmā na ca śudhyati ||84||
svamūrtiḥ kṣālitā tīrthe na śuddhim adhigacchati |
antar-bhāva-praduṣṭasya viśato’pi hutāśanam ||85||
nasvargonāpavargaścadehanirdahanaṃ param |
bhāvaśuddhiḥ paraṃ śaucaṃ pramāṇaṃ sarvakarmasu ||86||
anyathāliṅgyatekāṃ tābhāvenaduhitānyathā |
manasābhidyatevṛttirabhinneṣvapivastuṣu ||87||
anyathaivasatīputraṃ cintayedanyathāpatim |

nādyādvividhamannādyaṃ rasyānisurabhīṇica ||89||
abhāvenanarastasmādbhāvaḥ sarvatrakāraṇam |
cittaṃ śodhayayatnenakimanyairbāhyaśodhanaiḥ ||90||
bhāvataḥ śuciśuddhātmāsvargaṃ mokṣaṃ caviṃ dati |
jṣānāmalāṃ bhasāpuṃ saḥ savairāgyamṛdāpunaḥ ||91||
avidyārāgaviṇmūtraleponaśyedviśodhanaiḥ |
evametaccharīraṃ hinisargādaśuciṃ viduḥ ||92||
vidyādasāraniḥ sāraṅkadalīsārasannibham |
jṣātvaivaṃ doṣavaddehaṃ yaḥ prājṣaḥ śithilībhavet ||93||
sotikrāmatisaṃ sāraṃ dṛḍhagrāhovatiṣṭhati |
evametanmahā-kaṣṭaṃ janmaduḥkhaṃ prakīrtitam ||94||
puṃ sāmajñānadoṣeṇanānākarmavaśenaca |
garbhasthasya matiryāsītsājātasya praṇaśyati ||95||
sumūrcchitasya duḥkhenayoniyaṃ tranipīḍanāt |
bāhyenavāyunācāsyamohasaṅgenadehinām ||96||
spṛṣṭamātrasya ghoreṇajvaraḥ samupajāyate |
tenajvareṇamahatāmahā-mohaḥ prajāyate ||97||
saṃ mūḍhasya smṛtibhraṃ śaḥ śīghraṃ saṃ jāyatepunaḥ |
smṛtibhraṃ śāttatastasya pūrvakarmavaśenaca ||98||
ratiḥ saṃ jāyatetasya jaṃ tostatraivajanmani |
raktomūḍhaścalokoyamakāryesaṃ pravarttate ||99||
nacātmānaṃ vijānātinaparaṃ nacadaivatam |
naśṛṇotiparaṃ śreyaḥ sacakṣurapinekṣate ||100||
samepathiśanairgacchanaskhalatīvapadepade |

saṃ sāreiklaśyatetenanarolobhavaśānugaḥ |
garbhasmṛterabhāvecaśāstramuktaṃ śivenaca ||102||
tadduḥkhakathanārthāyasvargamokṣaprasādhakam |
yenatasmiṣchivejṣātedharmakāmārthasādhane ||103||
nakurvaṃ tyātmanaḥ śreyastadatramahadadbhutam |
avyakteṃ driyabuddhitvādbālyeduḥkhaṃ mahatpunaḥ ||104||
icchannapinaśaknotivaktuṅkartuṃ nasatkṛtī |
daṃ tajanmamahadduḥkhaṃ laulyenavāyunātathā ||105||
bālarogaiś ca vividhaiḥ pīḍābālagrahairapi |
tṛḍbubhukṣāparītāṅgaḥ kvacittiṣṭhatigacchati ||106||
viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇādyaṃ camohādbālaḥ samācaret |
kaumāraḥ karṇavedhenamātāpitroścatāḍanaiḥ ||107||
akṣarādhyayanādyaiś ca duḥkhaṅgurvādiśāsanāt |
pramatteṃ driyavṛtteścakāmarāgaprapīḍinaḥ ||108||
rogārditasya satataṅkutaḥ saukhyaṃ hiyauvane |
īrṣayāsumahadduḥkhaṃ mohādduḥkhaṃ prajāyate ||109||
tatrasyātkupitasyaivarāg##duḥkhāyakevalam |

natesukhāyamaṃ tavyāḥ svedajāivabiṃ davaḥ |
kṛmibhistāḍyamānasya kuṣṭhinaḥ pāmarasya ca ||112||
kaṇḍūyanāgnitāpenayatsukhaṃ strīṣutadviduḥ |
yādṛśaṃ manyatesaukhyamarthopārjanacintayā ||113||

tatonyonyaṃ purāprāptamaṃ tesaivānyathābhavet |

apūrvavatsamātmānaṃ jarayāparipīḍitam |

ekottaraṃ mṛtyuśatamasmindehepratiṣṭhitam |

yetvihāgaṃ tavaḥ proktāstepraśāmyanti bheṣajaiḥ |
japahomapradānaiś ca kālamṛtyurnaśāmyati ||123||
yadivāpamṛtyurnasyādviṣāsvādādaśaṅkitaḥ |

vividhāvyādhayastatrasarpādyāḥ prāṇinastathā |

śaknuvanti paritrātuṃ naraṅkālenapīḍitam ||127||

avāṃ taritaśānti ḥ syātkālamṛtyumavāpnuyāt ||128||

dehabhedenayaḥ paśyedviyogaṅkarmasaṅkṣayāt ||129||

bāṃ dhavaiḥ saparityaktaḥ priyaiś ca parivāritaḥ ||132||

anyonyaṃ nātivartaṃ tesāmyaṃ bhavativaitadā ||8||

dviraṃ śepippalastasyadviraṃ śecaśaśomahā-n ||16||

āpastato nyāvijṣeyāḥśeṣaḥ saṅkṣepaucyate ||17||

sūta uvāca—
prāgāyatāmahā-prājṣāḥṣaḍeteratnaparvatāḥ ||20||

idaṃ tu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tato haimavataṃ param |
hemakūṭāt paraṃ caiva hari-varṣaṃ pracakṣate ||25||

abhigamyāmaraśreṣṭhaṃ stuvanti vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ |
saptarṣayomahātmānaḥkaśyapaś ca prajāpatiḥ ||38||

parvatasyāṃ taredivyaṃ sarvartukusumaiścitam ||41||

tatrasākṣātpaśupatirdivyabhūtaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||42||
umāsahāyobhagavānramatebhūtabhāvanaḥ |
karṇikāramayīṃ mālāṃ bibhradāpādalaṃ binīm ||43||
tribhirnetraiḥkṛtoddyotastribhiḥ sūryairivoditaiḥ |
tamugratapasaḥ siddhāḥ suvratāḥ satyavādinaḥ ||44||
paśyanti nahidurvṛttaiḥśakyodraṣṭuṃ maheśvaraḥ |
tasyaśailasyaśikharātkṣīradhārādvijottamāḥ ||45||
viśvarūpātparamitābhīmanirghātanisvanā |
puṇyāpuṇyatamairjuṣṭāgaṅgābhāgīrathīśubhā ||46||
plavaṃ tīcapravegenahradecandramasaḥśubhe |
tayāhyutpāditaḥpuṇyaḥ sahradaḥ sāgaropamaḥ ||47||
tāṃ dhārayāmāsatadādurddharāṃ parvatairapi |
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇiśirasaivapinākadhṛk ||48||
merostupaścimepārśveketumālodvijottamāḥ |
jaṃ būkhaṇḍetutatraivamahā-janapadodvijāḥ ||49||
āyurdaśasahasrāṇivarṣāṇāṃ tatrasattamāḥ |
suvarṇavarṇāś ca narāstriyaścāpsarasāṃ samāḥ ||50||
anāmayāvītaśokānityaṃ muditamānasāḥ |
jāyante mānavāstatranistaptakanakaprabhāḥ ||51||
gandhamādanaśṛṅgeṣukuberaḥ saharākṣasaiḥ |
saṃ vṛtopsarasāṃ saṅghairmodateguhyakādhipaḥ ||52||
gandhamādanapārśvetuparevigatapātakāḥ |
ekādaśasahasrāṇivarṣāṇāṃ paramāyuṣaḥ ||53||
tatrakṛṣṇānarāviprāstejoyuktāmahā-balāḥ |
striyaścotpalapatrābhāḥ sarvāḥ supriyadarśanāḥ ||54||
nīlotpaladharaṃ śvetaṃ śvetāddhairaṇyakaṃ varam |
varṣamairāvataṃ viprānānājanapadāvṛtam ||55||
dhanukhaṇḍeḥmahā-bhāgādvevarṣedakṣaṇ##ttare |
ilāvṛttaṃ madhyagaṃ tupaṣcavarṣāṇi caiva hi ||56||
uttarottarametebhyo varṣamudricyateguṇaiḥ |
āyuḥpramāṇamārogyaṃ dharmataḥkāmato'rthataḥ ||57||

hemakūṭastusumahā-nkailāsonāmaparvataḥ |
tatravaiśravaṇo devoguhyakaiḥ sahamodate ||59||
