ramyaṃ viṣṇusaronāmayatrarājābhagīrathaḥ ||61||
 dṛṣṭvā bhāgīrathīṅgaṅgāmuvāsabahulāḥ samāḥ |
yūpāmaṇimayāstatrakṣetrāś cāpihiraṇmayāḥ ||62||
tatreṣṭvātugataḥ siddhiṃ sahasrākṣomahā-yaśāḥ |
sraṣṭābhūtipatiryatrasarvalokaiḥ sanātanaḥ ||63||
upāsyatetigmate jāyatrabhūtaḥ samaṃ tataḥ |
naranārāyaṇaubrahmāmanuḥ sthāṇuś ca paṣcamaḥ ||64||
tatradivyātripathagāprathamaṃ tupratiṣṭhitā |
brahmalokādapākrāṃ tāsaptadhāpratipadyate ||65||
vaṭodakāsānalinīpārvatīcasarasvatī |
jaṃ būnadīcasītācagaṅgāsindhuś ca saptamī ||66||
aciṃ tyādivyasaṃ jṣāsāprabhāvaiś ca samanvitā |
upāsyate yatrasatraṃ sahasrayugaparyaye ||67||
dṛśyādṛśyācabhavatitatratatrasarasvatī |
etādivyāḥ saptagaṅgāstriṣu lokeṣuviśrutāḥ ||68||
rakṣāṃ sivaihimavatīhemakūṭecaguhyakāḥ |
sarpānāgāś ca niṣadhegokarṇaṃ catapovanam ||69||
devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śvetaḥparvatamucyate |
gandharvāniṣadhenityaṃ nīlebrahmarṣayastathā ||70||
śṛṅgavāṃ stumahā-bhāgādevānāṃ pratisaṃ caraḥ |
ityetānimahā-bhāgāḥ saptavarṣāṇibhāgaśaḥ ||71||
bhūtānyupaniviṣṭānigatimanti dhruvāṇi ca |
teṣāṃ mṛddhirbahuvidhādṛśyatedevamānuṣā ||72||
aśakyaṃ parisaṅkhyātuṃ śraddheyātuvibhūṣitā |
yāṃ tupṛcchathamāṃ viprādivyamenāṃ śaśākṛtim ||73||
pārśveśaśasyadvevarṣeukteyedakṣiṇottare |
karṇetunāgadvīpaś ca kāśyapadvīpa evaca ||74||
karṇadvīpaśiloviprāḥśrī-mānmalayaparvataḥ |
etaddvitīyaṃ dvīpasyadṛśyateśaśi-saṃsthitam ||75||

śuklābhijanasaṃ pannāḥ sarvasupriyadarśanāḥ ||7||

tānnirharaṃ tīhamṛtāndarīṣuprakṣipanti ca ||12||
uttarāḥkuravoviprāvyākhyātāstesamāsataḥ |

bhadraśālavanaṃ yatrakālāmrāś ca mahā-drumāḥ ||14||

drumāś ca yojanotsedhāḥ siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ ||15||
tatratepuruṣāḥśvetāstejoyuktamahā-balāḥ |
striyaḥkumudavarṇāś ca sundaryaḥpriyadarśanāḥ ||16||
candravarṇāś ca turvarṇāḥpūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ |
candraśītalagātrāś ca nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ ||17||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇitatrāyurdvijasattamāḥ |
kālāmrarasapītāstenityaṃ -saṃsthitayauvanāḥ ||18||
dakṣiṇenatunīlasyaniṣadhasyottareṇatu |
sudarśanonāmamahā-njaṃ būvṛkṣaḥ sanātanaḥ ||19||
sarvakāmaphalaḥpuṇyaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ |
tasyanāmnāsamākhyātojaṃ būdvīpaḥ sanātanaḥ ||20||
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ caśataṃ cadvijasattamāḥ |

mahā-rajatasaṅkāśājāyante tatramānavāḥ ||22||

tapastapyanti tedivyaṃ bhavanti hyūrdhvaretasaḥ ||23||

aṃ dhakārātparoviprāmainākaḥ parvatottamaḥ |
mainākātparatoviprāgovindogiriruttamaḥ ||18||

bhojanaṃ cātraviprendrāḥ prajāḥ svayamupasthitam ||31||

caturasromahā-prājṣaḥ sarva-taḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ |
 tatra tiṣṭhanti viprendrāś ca tvārolokasaṃ matāḥ ||33||
diggajāhimuniśreṣṭhāvāmanairāvatāṃ janāḥ |

|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe paṣcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15||

ṛṣir uvāca—

aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
tadā prabhṛti brahmādyā ṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ |
sevante narmadāṃ rājan kāma-krodha-vivarjitāḥ ||1||
tasmin nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śūlaṃ devasya bhūtale |
tasya puṇyaṃ samākhyātaṃ śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā ||2||
śūla-bhedeti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ mahat |

arcayitvā mahā-devaṃ punar janma na vidyate ||4||
bhīmeśvaraṃ tato gacchen narmadeśvaram uttamam |
ādityeśvaraṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ tathā''jya-madhunā saha ||5||

varuṇeśvaraṃ tataḥ paśyen nīrājeśvaram uttamam ||6||

tato gaccheta rājendra yuddhaṃ vai yatra sādhitam ||7||

yatra te nihatā rājan dānavā bala-darpitāḥ ||8||

 sarva-taḥ sahadevenaśirasādāyadhārayet ||

subhagorūpasampannaḥ strīṇāṃ bhavativallabhaḥ ||79||
idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyenabhāṣitam |
yeprayānti narājendravaṣcitāstenasaṃśayaḥ ||80||
māseśvaraṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
snāta-mātro naras tatra svargalokam avāpnuyāt ||81||
modate sarva-lokasthoyāvadiṃ drāś ca turdaśa |
tataḥ samīpataḥ sthitvānāgeśvaraṃ tapovanam ||82||
 tatra snātvā tu rājendraśucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
bahubhirnāgakanyābhiḥ krīḍatekālamakṣayam ||83||
kuberabhavanaṃ gacchetkubero yatra -saṃsthitaḥ |
kāleśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ kubero yatra toṣitaḥ ||84||
 yatra snātvā tu rājendra sarva-sampadamāpnuyāt |
tataḥ paścimatogacchenmarutālayam uttamam ||85||
 tatra snātvā tu rājendraśucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
kāṣcanaṃ tu tatodadyādannaśaktyātubuddhimān ||86||
puṣpakeṇavimānenavāyulokaṃ sagacchati |
mamatīrthaṃ tato gacchenmāghamāseyudhiṣṭhira ||87||
kṛṣṇapakṣecaturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
naktaṃ bhojyaṃ tataḥ kuryānnagacchedyonisaṃ kaṭam ||88||
ahalyātīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
snāta-mātro naras tatra apsarobhiḥ pramodate ||89||
pārameśvaretapastaptvāahalyāmuktimāgamat |
caitramāsetusamprāpteśukla-pakṣetrayodaśī ||90||
kāmadevadine tasmin nahalyāṃ tuprapūjayet |
 yatra tatra samutpannonaras tatra priyo bhavet ||91||
strīvallabhobhavecchrīmānkāmadevaivāparaḥ |
ayodhyāṃ tu samāsādya tīrthaṃ śakrasya viśrutam ||92||
snāta-mātro naras tatra go-sahasra-phalaṃ labhet |
soma-tīrthaṃ tato gacchet snāna-mātraṃ samācaret ||93||
snāta-mātro naras tatra sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
somagrahetu-rājendra pāpa-kṣaya-karaṃ bhavet ||94||
trailokya-viśrutaṃ rājan soma-tīrthaṃ mahā-phalam |
yas tu cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa ||95||
sarva-pāpa-viśuddhātmā soma-lokaṃ sa gacchati |
agni-praveśe tu jale’py athavāpi hy anāśane ||96||
soma-tīrthe’mṛto yas tu nāsau martye’bhi jāyate |
stambha-tīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret ||97||
snāta-mātro naras tatra somaloke mahīyate |
tato gaccheta rājendra viṣṇutīrtham anuttamam ||98||
yodhanīpuravikhyātaṃ viṣṇutīrtham anuttamam |
asurāyodhitās tatra vāsudevenakoṭiśaḥ ||99||
tatra tīrthaṃ samutpannaṃ viṣṇuḥ prīto bhaved iha |
aho-rātropavāsena brahma-hatyāṃ vyapohati ||100||
tato gacchet tu rājendra tāpaseśvaram uttamam |
amohakam iti khyātaṃ pitṝn yas tatra tarpayet ||101||
paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryād yathā vidhi |
tatra snātvā naro rājan pitṛ-piṇḍaṃ tu dāpayet ||102||
gaja-rūpāḥ śilās tatra toya-madhye pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
tasmiṃs tu dāpayetiṃ paḍaṃ vaiśākhaituviśeṣataḥ ||103||
tṛpyanti pitaras tāvad yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī |
tato gaccheta rājendrasiddheśvaram anuttamam ||104||
tatra gatvā tu rājendragaṇapatyanti kaṃ vrajet |
tato gaccheta rājendraliṅgo yatra janārdanaḥ ||105||
tatra snātvā tu rājendra viṣṇu-loke mahīyate |
narmadā-dakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ parama-śobhanam ||106||
kāma-devaḥ svayaṃ tatra tapas tapyaty asau mahān |
divyaṃ varṣa-sahasraṃ tu śaṅkaraṃ paryupāsate ||107||
samādhi-parva-dagdhas tu śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |
śveta-parvopamaś caiva hutāśaḥ śukla-parvaṇi ||108||
ete dagdhās tu te sarve kusumeśvara saṃsthitāḥ |
divya-varṣa-sahasreṇa tuṣṭas teṣāṃ maheśvaraḥ ||109||
umayā sahito rudras teṣāṃ tuṣṭo vara-pradaḥ |
vimokṣayitvā tān sarvān narmadā-taṭam āsthitān ||110||
tasya tīrtha-prabhāveṇa punar devatvam āgataḥ |
tvat-prasādān mahā-deva-tīrthaṃ ca bhavatūttamam ||111||
ardha-yojana-vistīrṇaṃ tīrthaṃ dikṣu samantataḥ |
tasmiṃs tīrthe naraḥ snātvā upavāsa-parāyaṇaḥ ||112||
kusumāyudha-rūpeṇa rudra-loke mahīyate |
vaiśvānare yamenaiva kāma-devena vāyave ||113||
tapas taptvā tu rājendra tatraiva ca purāgataiḥ |
andhonasya samīpe tu nātidūre tu tasya vai ||114||
snānaṃ dānaṃ ca tatraiva bhojanaṃ piṇḍa-pātanam |
agni-veśe jale vāpi athavāpi anāśane ||115||
anivartikāgatis tasya mṛtasyāpy ardha-yojane |
traiyambakena toyena snāpayen nara-puṅgavaḥ ||116||
andhona-mūle dattvā tu piṇḍaṃ caiva yathā vidhi |
pitaras tasya tṛpyanti yāvac candra-divākarau ||117||
uttarāyaṇe tu samprāpte tatra snānaṃ karoti yaḥ |
puruṣo vāpi strī vāpi vased āyatane śuciḥ ||118||
siddheśvarasya devasya prabhāte pūjanān naraḥ |
satāṃ gatim avāpnoti natāṃ sarvair mahā-makhaiḥ ||119||
yadā ca tīrtha-kālena rūpavān subhago bhavet |
martye bhavati rājāsāv āsamudrānta-gocare ||120||
kṣetra-pālaṃ na paśyec ca daṇḍa-pālaṃ mahā-balam |
vṛthā tasya bhaved yātrā a dṛṣṭvā karṇa-kuṇḍalam ||121||
etat tīrtha-phalaṃ jṣātvā sarve devāḥ samāgatāḥ |
muṣcanti puṣpa-vṛṣṭiṃ tu stuvanti kusumeśvaram ||122||

|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||

(19)
ūnaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
bhārga veśaṃ tato gacched bhaktyā yatra ca viṣṇunā |
huṃkāritās tu devena dānavāḥ pralayaṃ gatāḥ ||1||
tatra snātvā tu rājendra sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
śukla-tīrthasya cotpattiṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ pāṇḍu-nandana ||2||
himavac-chikhare ramye nānā-dhātu-vicitrite |
taruṇāditya-saṅkāśe tapta-kāṣcana-saṃnibhe ||3||
vajra-sphaṭika-sopāne citra-paṭṭa-śilātale |
jāmbūnada-maye divye nānā-padmopaśobhite ||4||
tatrāsīnaṃ mahā-devaṃ sarva-jṣaṃ prabhum avyayam |
lokānugrāhakaṃ śāntaṃ gaṇa-vṛndaiḥ samāvṛtam ||5||
skanda-nandi-mahā-kālair vīrabhadra-gaṇādibhiḥ |
umayā sahitaṃ devaṃ mārkanḍaḥ paripṛcchati ||6||
deva-deva mahā-deva indra-kāmādi-saṃstuta |
saṃsāra-bhava-bhīto’haṃ sukhopāyaṃ bravīhi me ||7||
bhagavan bhūta-bhavyeśa sarva-pāpa-praṇāśanam |
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tad vadasva maheśvara ||8||
īśvara uvāca— 
śṛṇu vipra mahā-bhāga sarva-śāstra-viśārada |
snānādi kuru gaccha tvaṃ ṛṣi-saṅghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||9||
manv-atri-yājṣavalkyāś ca kāśyapaś caiva aṅgirāḥ |
yamāpastamba-saṃvartāḥ kātyāyana-bṛhaspatī ||10||
nārado gautamaś caiva pṛcchanti dharma-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ gayā ||11||
kurukṣetraṃ tu puṇyaṃ ca rāhu-graste divākare |
divāvāya divārātrau śukla-tīrthaṃ mahā-phalam ||12||
darśanāt sparśanāc caiva snānād dhyānāt tapo’rjanāt |
homāc caivopavāsāc ca śukla-tīrtha-phalaṃ mahat ||13||
śukla-tīrthaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ nadyāṃ tu saṃvyavasthitam |
cāṇikyo nāma rājarṣiḥ siddhiṃ tatra samāgataḥ ||14||
etat kṣetraṃ samutpannaṃ yojanāvṛtti-saṃsthitam |
śukla-tīrthaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ sarva-pāpa-praṇāśanam ||15||
pādapāgreṇa dṛṣṭena brahma-hatyāṃ vyapohati |
aham atra ṛṣi-śreṣṭha tiṣṭhāmi hy umayā saha ||16||
vaiśākhe vimale māsi kṛṣṇa-pakṣe caturdaśī |
kailāsāc cāpi nirgatya tatra saṃnihito hy aham ||17||
deva-kinnara-gandharvāḥ siddha-vidyādharās tathā |
gaṇāś cāpsaraso nāgāḥ sarve devāḥ samāgatāḥ ||18||
gagana-sthās tu tiṣṭhanti vimānaiḥ sarva-kāmakaiḥ |
śukla-tīrthe tu rājendra āgatā dharma-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||19||
rajakena yathā vastraṃ śuklaṃ bhavati vāriṇā |
ājanma-saṣcitaṃ pāpaṃ śukla-tīrthe vyapohati ||20||
snānaṃ dānaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ mārkaṇḍa ṛṣi-sattama |
śukla-tīrthāt paraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||21||
pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kṛtvā pāpāni  mānavaḥ |
ahorātropavāsena śukla-tīrthe vyapohati ||22||
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajṣair dānena vā punaḥ |
deva-dānena yā puṣṭir na sākratu-śatair api ||23||
kārtikasya ca māsasya kṛṣṇa-pakṣe caturdaśī |
ghṛtena snāpayed devam upoṣya parameśvaram ||24||
ekaviṃśat-kulopeto na cyavec caiśvarāt padāt |
śukla-tīrtha-paraṃ tīrtham ṛṣi-siddha-niṣevitam ||25||
tatra snātvā tato rājan punar janma na vidyate |
snātvā vai śukla-tīrthe’pi arcayed vṛṣabha-dhvajam ||26||
jāgaraṃ kārayet tatra nṛtya-gītādi-maṅgalaiḥ |
prabhāte śukla-tīrthe tu snānaṃ vai devatārcanam ||27||
ācāryaṃ bhojayet paścāc chiva-vrata-paraḥ śuciḥ |
bhojanaṃ ca yathā śaktyā vitta-śāṭhyaṃ na kārayet ||28||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śanair devāntikaṃ vrajet |
evaṃ vai kurute yas tu tasya puṇya-phalaṃ śṛṇu ||29||
divya-yāna-samārūḍhaḥ stūyamāno'psaro-gaṇaiḥ |
śiva-tulya-balopetas tiṣṭhaty ābhūta-samplavam ||30||
śukla-tīrthe tu yā nārī dadāti kanakaṃ śubham |
ghṛtena snāpayed devaṃ kumāraṃ cābhipūjayet ||31||
evaṃ yā kurute bhaktyā tasyāḥ puṇya-phalaṃ śṛṇu |
modate deva-lokasthā yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||32||
ayane vā caturdaśyāṃ saṅkrāntau viṣuve tathā |
snātvā tu sopavāsaḥ sa nirjitātmā samāhitaḥ ||33||
dānaṃ dadyād yathā śaktyā prīyetāṃ hari-śaṅkarau |
śukla-tīrtha-prabhāveṇa sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||34||
anāthaṃ durgataṃ vipraṃ nāthavantam athāpi vā |
udvāhayati yas tīrthe tasya puṇya-phalaṃ śṛṇu ||35||
yāvat tad-roma-saṅkhyā tu tat prasūti-kuleṣu ca |
tāvad varṣa-sahasrāṇi śiva-loke mahīyate ||36||
|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe ūnaviṃśodhyāyaḥ ||19|| 

(20)
viṃśatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
nārada uvāca—
tatas tu narakaṃ gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
snāta-mātro naras tatra narakaṃ tatra paśyati ||1||
asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ pāṇḍu-nandana |
tasmiṃs tīrthe tu rājendra yāny asthīni vinikṣipet ||2||
vilayaṃ yānti sarvāṇi rūpavān jāyate naraḥ |
go-tīrthaṃ tu tato gacched dṛṣṭvā pāpāt pramucyate ||3||
tato gaccheta rājendra kapilā-tīrtham uttamam |
tatra snātvā naro rājan go-sahasra-phalaṃ labhet ||4||
jyeṣṭha-māse tu samprāpte caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
tatropoṣya naro bhaktyā kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati ||5||
ghṛtena dīpaṃ prajvālya ghṛtena snāpayec chivam |
sa-ghṛtaṃ śrī-phalaṃ dattvā kṛtvācānte pradakṣiṇam ||6||
ghaṇṭābharaṇa-saṃyuktāṃ kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
śiva-tulyo naro bhūtvā na ceha jāyate punaḥ ||7||
aṅgāraka-dine prāpte caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
snāpayitvā śivaṃ bhaktyā brāhmaṇebhyas tu bhojanam ||8||
aṅgāraka-navamyāṃ tu amāvasyāṃ tathaiva ca |
snāpayet tatra yatnena rūpavān subhago bhavet ||9||
ghṛtena snāpaye ilaṃ lagaṃ pūjayed bhaktito dvijān |
puṣpakeṇa vimānena sahasraiḥ parivāritaḥ ||10||
śaivaṃ padam avāpnoti nātra cābhigataṃ bhavet |
akṣayaṃ modate kālaṃ yathā rudras tathaiva ca ||11||
yadā tu karma-saṃyogān martya-lokam upāgataḥ |
rājā bhavati dharmiṣṭho rūpavān jāyate balī ||12||
tato gaccheta rājendra ṛṣi-tīrtham anuttamam |
tṛṇa-bindu ṛṣir nāma śāpa-dagdho vyavasthitaḥ ||13||
tasya tīrtha-prabhāveṇa pāpa-mukto'bhavad dvijaḥ |
tato gaccheta rājendra gaṇeśvaram anuttamam ||14||
śrāvaṇe māsi samprāpte kṛṣṇa-pakṣe caturdaśīm |
snāta-mātro naras tatra rudra-loke mahīyate ||15||
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate ca ṛṇa-trayāt |
gaṇeśvara-samīpe tu gaṅgā-vadanam uttamam ||16||
akāmo vā sa-kāmo vā tatra snātvā tu mānavaḥ |
ājanma-janitaiḥ pāpair mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||17||
sarvadā parva-divase snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate ca ṛṇa-trayāt ||18||
prayāge yat phalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |
tad eva nikhilaṃ puṇyaṃ gaṅgā-rāhv-arka-saṅgame ||19||
tasyaivaṃ paścime sthāne samīpe nātidūrataḥ |
daśāśvamedhikaṃ nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ||20||
upoṣya rajanīm ekāṃ māsi bhādrapade tathā |
amāvasyāṃ naraḥ snātvā vrajed vai yatra śaṅkaraḥ ||21||
sarvadā parva-divase snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā aśvamedha-phalaṃ labhet ||22||
daśāśvamedhāt paścimato bhṛgur brāhmaṇa-sattamaḥ |
divyaṃ varṣa-sahasraṃ tu īśvaraṃ paryupāsata ||23||
valmīkāvasthitaś cāsau dakṣiṇaṃ ca niketanam |
āś ca ryaṃ ca mahaj-jātam umāyāḥ śaṅkarasya ca ||24||
gaurī tu pṛcchate devaṃ koyam atra tu saṃsthitaḥ |
devo vā dānavo vātha kathayasva maheśvara ||25||
īśvara uvāca—
bhṛgur nāma dvija-śreṣṭha ṛṣīṇāṃ pravaro muniḥ |
dhyāyatemāṃ samādhistho varaṃ prārthayate priye ||26||
tatra prahasitā devī īśvaraṃ pratyabhāṣata |
dhūmāvarta-śikhā-jātā tato'dyāpi na tuṣyasi |
durārādhyo'si tena tvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||27||
deva uvāca—
na jṣāyase mahā-devi ayaṃ krodhena ceṣṭitaḥ |
darśayāmi yathā tathyaṃ priyaṃ te ca karomy aham ||28||
smārito devadevena dharma-rūpo vṛṣas tadā |
smaraṇād eva devasya vṛṣaḥ śīghram upasthitaḥ ||29||
prāhāsau mānuṣīṃ vācam ādeśo dīyatāṃ prabho |
valmīkaiś chādito vipra enaṃ bhūmau nipātaya ||30||
yoga-sthas tu tato dhyāyaṃs tatas tena nipātitaḥ |
tat kṣaṇāt krodha-saṃtapto hastam utkṣiptavān vṛṣam ||31||
evaṃ sambhāṣamāṇas tu kutra gacchasi bho vṛṣa |
adya tvām atha pāpmānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ hanamy ahaṃ vṛṣa ||32||
dharṣitas tu tadā vipro hy antarīkṣaṃ gataṃ vṛṣam |
ākāśe prekṣate bhūya etad adbhutam uttamam ||33||
tataḥ prahasiterudreṛṣiragrevyavasthitaḥ |
tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vailakṣyātpatito bhuvi ||34||
praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau stuvate parameśvaram |
praṇipatyabhūtanāthaṃ bhavodbhavaṃ tvāmahaṃ divyarūpam ||
bhavabhītobhuvanapatebhūtaṃ vijṣāpayekiJcit  ||35||
tvadguṇanikarānvaktuṃ kaḥ śaktobhavatimānuṣonātha |
vāsukirayaṃ hikadācidvadanasahasraṃ bhaved yasya ||36||
bhaktyātavāpiśaṅkarabhuvanapatetvatstutautumukharasya |
vaṃ dyakṣamasvabhavanprasīdametavacaraṇapati tasya ||37||
satvaṃ rajastamastvaṃ sthityutpattauvināśanedeva |
tvāṃ muktvābhuvanapatebhuvaneśvaranaivadaivataṃ kiJcit  ||38||
yamaniyamayajṣadānairvedābhyāsāvadhāraṇodyogāt |
tvadbhakteḥ sarvam idaṃ nārhatikalāsahasrāṃ śena ||39||
utkṛṣṭarasarasāyanakhaḍgāṃ janapādukādisiddhirvā |
cihnānibhavatpraṇatānāṃ dṛśyaṃ taihajanmaniprakaṭam ||40||
śāṭhyenanamatiyadyapidadāsitvaṃ dharmamicchatāṃ deva |
bhaktirbhavacchedakarīmokṣāyavinirmitānātha ||41||
paradāraparasvarataṃ paribhavapariduḥkhaśokasaṃ taptam |
paravadanavīkṣaṇaparaṃ parameśvaramāṃ paritrāhi ||42||
alīkābhimānadagdhaṃ kṣaṇabhaṃ guravibhavavilasitaṃ deva |
krūraṃ kupathābhimukhaṃ patitaṃ māṃ trāhideveśa ||43||
dīnendriyagaṇasārthairbandhujanair evapūritāāśā |
tucchā tathā piśaṅkarakiṃ mūḍhaṃ māṃ viḍambayasi ||44||
tṛṣṇāṃ harasvaśīghraṃ lakṣmīṃ māṃ dehihṛdayavāsinīṃ nityām |
chiṃ dhimadamohapāśānuttārayamāṃ mahā-deva ||45||
karuṇābhyudayaṃ nāmastotramidaṃ siddhidaṃ divyam |
yaḥ paṭhatibhaktiyuktas tasya tutuṣyedbhṛgor yathā hiśivaḥ ||46||
īśvara uvāca—
ahaṃ tuṣṭosmitevipravaraṃ prārthayasvepsitam |
umayāsahito devovaraṃ tasya hidāpayet ||47||
bhṛgur uvāca—
yadituṣṭosideveśayadideyovaromama |
rudravedībhavedevametatsampādayasvame ||48||
īśvara uvāca—
evaṃ bhavatuviprendrakrodhasthānaṃ bhaviṣyati |
napitāputrayoś caiva ekavākyaṃ bhaviṣyati ||49||
tadāprabhṛtibrahmādyāḥ sarvedevāḥ sakinnarāḥ |
upāsanto bhṛgostīrthaṃ tuṣṭo yatra maheśvaraḥ ||50||
darśanāt tasya tīrthasyasadyaḥ pāpāt pramucyate |
avaśāḥ svavaśāś cāpi mriyaṃ te tatra jaṃ tavaḥ ||51||
guhyātiguh yasya gatisteṣāṃ niḥ saṃ śayābhavet |
etatkṣetraṃ suvipulaṃ sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam ||52||
 tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti yemṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ |
aupānahaṃ tadāchatraṃ deyamannaṃ cakāṣcanam ||53||
bhojanaṃ ca yathā śaktyāakṣa## tasya tadbhavet |
sūryoparāgeyodadyāddānaṃ caiva yathecchayā ||54||
tīrthasnānaṃ tuyaddānamakṣayaṃ tasya tadbhavet |
candrasūryoparāgeṣu vṛṣotsargam anuttamam ||55||
najānanti narāmūḍhāviṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ |
narmadāyāṃ sthitaṃ divyaṃ vṛṣatīrthaṃ narādhipa ||56||
bhṛgutīrthasyamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotinaraḥ sakṛt |
vimuktaḥ sarva-pāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sagacchati ||57||
tato gaccheta rājendra gautameśvaram uttamam |
 tatra snātvā naro rājannupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||58||
kāṃ canenavimānenabrahmaloke mahīyate |
dhautapāpaṃ tato gaccheddhautaṃ yatra vṛṣeṇatu ||59||
narmadāyāṃ sthitaṃ rājan sarva-pātaka-nāśanam |
 tatra tīrthenaraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||60||
 tasmin tīrthe mahā-rājaprāṇatyāgaṃ karotiyaḥ |
caturbhujastrinetrasturudratulyabalo bhavet ||61||
vasetkalpāyutaṃ sāgraṃ rudratulyaparākramaḥ |
kālenamahatāprāptaḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhavet ||62||
tato gaccheta rājendra eraṇḍītīrtham uttamam |
prayāgeyatphalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mārkaṇḍeyenabhāṣitam ||63||
tatphalaṃ labhaterājansnātamātrastumānavaḥ |
māsibhādrapade caiva śukla-pakṣasyacāṣṭamīm ||64||
upoṣyarajanīmekāṃ tatra snānaṃ samācaret |
yamadūtairnabādhyetaindralokaṃ sagacchati ||65||
tato gaccheta rājendra siddho yatra janārdanaḥ |
hiraṇyadvīpavikhyātaṃ sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam ||66||
 tatra snātvā naro rājandhanavānrūpavānbhavet |
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ mahat ||67||
garuḍenatapastaptaṃ tasmiṃ stīrthenarādhipa |
vikhyātaṃ sarva-lokeṣu yoginī tatra tiṣṭhati ||68||
krīḍateyogibhiḥ sārdhaṃ śivenasahanṛtyati |
 tatra snātvā naro rājanrudraloke mahīyate ||69||
tato gaccheta rājendra īśatīrtham anuttamam |
īśas tatra vinirmuktogataūrdhvaṃ nasaṃśayaḥ ||70||
tato gaccheta rājendra siddho yatra janārdanaḥ |
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāyaaciṃ tyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||71||
varāha-tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
viṣṇu-lokam avāpnoti narakaṃ tu na gacchati ||72||
tato gaccheta rājendra soma-tīrtham anuttamam |
paurṇimāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa tatra snānaṃ samācaret ||73||
praṇipatyacaīśānaṃ balis tasya prasīdati |
hariś ca ndrapuraṃ divyamantar- ikṣetudṛśyate ||74||
cakradhvajesamāvṛttesuptenāgāriketane |
narmadātoyavegenarurukacchopasevitam ||75||
 tasmin sthānenivāsaṃ caviṣṇuḥ śaṅkaramabravīt |
dvīpeśvarenaraḥ snātvā labhedbahusuvarṇakam ||76||
tato gaccheta rājendra rudrakanyāṃ tusaṅgame |
snāta-mātro naras tatra devyāḥ sthānam avāpnuyāt ||77||
deva-tīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarva-devanamaskṛtam |
tatra snātvā tu rājendradaivataiḥ sahamodate ||78||
tato gaccheta rājendra śikhitīrtham anuttamam |
tatra vaidīyatedānaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||79||
aparapakṣeamāvāsyāṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ koṭirbhavatibhojitā ||80||
bhṛgutīrthetu rājendratīrthakoṭirvyavasthitā |
akāmovāsakāmovā tatra snāyītamānavaḥ ||81||
aśvamedham avāpnoti daivataiḥ sahamodate |
tatra siddham avāpnoti bhṛgustumuni-puṅgavaḥ ||
avatāraḥ kṛtastenaśaṅkareṇamahātmanā ||82||

|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe viṃ śatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
tato gaccheta rājendra vihageśvaram uttamam |
darśanāt tasya rājendramucyate sarva-pātakaiḥ ||1||
tato gaccheta rājendra narmadeśvaram uttamam |
 tatra snātvā naro rājansvargaloke mahīyate ||2||
aśvatīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
subhagodarśanīyaś ca bhogavān jāyate naraḥ ||3||
pitāmahaṃ tato gacchedbrahmaṇānirmitaṃ purā |
 tatra snātvā naro bhaktyāpitṛpiṇḍaṃ tudāpayet ||4||
tiladarbhavimiśraṃ tuudakaṃ tupradāpayet |
 tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa sarvaṃ bhavaticākṣayam ||5||
sāvitrītīrthamāsādyayas tusnānaṃ samācaret |
vidhūya sarva-pāpāni brahmaloke mahīyate ||6||
manoharaṃ ca tatra ivatīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam |
 tatra snātvā naro rājanpitṛloke mahīyate ||7||
tato gaccheta rājendra mānasaṃ tīrtham uttamam |
 tatra snātvā naro rājanrudraloke mahīyate ||8||
tato gaccheta rājendra kratutīrtham anuttamam |
vikhyātaṃ sarva-lokeṣu sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam ||9||
yānyānprārthayatekāmānpaśuputradhanāni ca |
prāpnuyāttānisarvāṇi tatra snātvā narādhipa ||10||
tato gaccheta rājendra tridaśadyotiviśrutam |
 tatra tāṛṣikanyāstutapastapyanti suvratāḥ ||11||
bharttābhavatusarvāsāmīśvaraḥ prabhuravyayaḥ |
prītasteṣāṃ mahā-devaś ca ṇḍarūpadharoharaḥ ||12||
vikṛtānanabībhatsastaccatīrthamupāgataḥ |
 tatra kanyāmahā-rājavarāyaparameśvaraḥ ||13||
kanyāṛddhiṃ cayaḥ sevetkanyādānaṃ prayacchati |
tīrthaṃ tatra mahā-rājadaśakanyetiviśrutam ||14||
 tatra snātvā rccayeddevaṃ sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
tato gaccheta rājendra svargabinduritiśrutam ||15||
 tatra snātvā naro rājandurgatiṃ cana paśyati |
apsareśaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret ||16||
krīḍatenāgalokastho'psarobhiḥ sahamodate |
tato gaccheta rājendra narakaṃ tīrtham uttamam ||17||
 tatra snātvā rccayeddevaṃ narakaṃ canagacchati |
bhārabhūtaṃ tato gacchedupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||18||
etattīrthaṃ samāsādyaavatāraṃ tuśāṃ bhavam |
arcayitvāvirūpākṣaṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||19||
tasmiṃs tīrthenaraḥ snātvā bhārabhūtemahātmanaḥ |
 yatra tatra mṛtasyāpidhruvaṃ gāṇeśvarīgatiḥ ||20||
kārtikasyatumāsasyaarcayitvāmaheśvaram |
aśvamedhācchataguṇaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||21||
dīpakānāṃ śataṃ kṛtvāghṛtapūrṇaṃ tudāpayet |
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃ kāśairvrajate yatra śaṅkaraḥ ||22||
vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayacchetaśaṃ khakuṃ deṃ dusaṃnibham |
vṛṣayuktenayānenarudralokaṃ sagacchati ||23||
carumekaṃ tuyodadyāttasmiṃs tīrthenarādhipa |
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyāṇivividhāni ca ||24||
 yathā śaktyanurājendrabhojayetsahadakṣiṇam |
 tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||25||
narmadāyājalaṃ siktvāarcayitvāvṛṣadhvajam |
durgatiṃ canapaṃ śyanti tasya tīrthaprabhāvataḥ ||26||
etattīrthaṃ samāsādyayas tuprāṇānparityajet |
 sarva-pāpaviśuddhātmāvrajate yatra śaṅkaraḥ ||27||
jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃs tīrthenarādhipa |
haṃ sayuktenayānenarudralokaṃ sagacchati ||28||
yāvaccandraś ca sūryaś ca himavāṃ ś ca mahodadhiḥ |
gaṅgādyāḥ saritoyāvattāvatsvargemahīyate ||29||
anāśanaṃ tuyaḥ kuryāttasmiṃs tīrthenarādhipa |
garbhavāsetu rājendranapunar jāyate naraḥ ||30||
tato gaccheta rājendra aṭavītīrtham uttamam |
 tatra snātvā naro rājanindrasyārddhāsanaṃ labhet ||31||
śṛṃ gatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam |
tatrāpisnātamātrasyadhruvaṃ gāṇeśvarīgatiḥ ||32||
eraṇḍīnarmadāyāś ca saṅgamaṃ lokaviśrutam |
 tatra tīrthaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam ||33||
upavāsaparobhūtvā nityaṃ brahmaparāyaṇaḥ |
 tatra snātvā tu rājendramucyatebrahmahatyayā ||34||
tato gaccheta rājendra narmadodadhisaṅgamam |
jamadagniritikhyātaṃ siddho yatra janārdanaḥ ||35||
yatreṣṭvābahubhiryajṣairiṃ dro devādhipobhavat |
 tatra snātvā naro rājannarmadodadhisaṅgame ||36||
triguṇasyāśvamedhasyaphalaṃ prāpnotimānavaḥ |
paścimodadhisāyujyaṃ muktidvāravighāṭanam ||37||
 tatra devāḥ sagandharvāṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ |
ārādhayanti deveśaṃ trisamdhyaṃ vimaleśvaram ||38||
 sarva-pāpaviśuddhātmārudraloke mahīyate |
vimaleśvaraparaṃ tīrthaṃ nabhūtaṃ nabhaviṣyati ||39||
tatropavāsaṃ kṛtvāyepaśyanti vimaleśvaram |
 sarva-pāpaviśuddhātmārudralokaṃ vrajanti te ||40||
tato gaccheta rājendra keśinītīrtham uttamam |
 tatra snātvā naro rājannupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||41||
upoṣyarajanīmekāṃ niyatoniyatāśanaḥ |
 tatra tīrthaprabhāveṇamucyatebrahmahatyayā ||42||
 sarva-tīrthābhiṣekaṃ cayaḥ paśyetsāgareśvaram |
yojanābhyantar- etiṣṭhedāvarte-saṃsthitaḥ śivaḥ ||43||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarva-tīrthānidṛṣṭānisyurnasaṃśayaḥ |
 sarva-pāpavinirmukto yatra rudraḥ sagacchati ||44||
narmadāsaṅgamaṃ yāvadyāvaccāmarakaṃ ṭakam |
tatrāntaremahā-rājantīrthakoṭyodakasthitāḥ ||45||
tīrthāttīrthāṭanaṃ caryāṛṣikoṭiniṣevitā |
agnihotraiś ca divyāṃ śaiḥ sarva-irjñānaparāyaṇaiḥ ||46||
sevitāstenarājendraīpsitārthapradāyikāḥ |
yaścedaṃ vaipaṭhennityaṃ śṛṇuyādvāpibhaktitaḥ ||47||
taṃ tutīrthānisarvāṇiabhiṣiṃ canti pāṇḍava |
narmadācasadāprītābhavedvainātra saṃśayaḥ ||48||
prītas tasya bhavedrudromārkaṇḍeyomahā-muniḥ |
vaṃ dhyācalabhateputrāndurbhagāsubhagābhavet ||49||
kumārīṃ labhatebharttāyaccayovāṣchatephalam |
tad eva labhate sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||50||
brāhmaṇovedamāpnotikṣatriyovijayībhavet |
vaiśyas tulabhatedhānyaṃ śūdraḥ prāpnotisadgatim ||51||
mūrkhastulabhatevidyāṃ trisamdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ |
narakaṃ cana paśyetaviyoniṃ canagacchati ||52||
|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21|| 
dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 
nārada uvāca—
evaṃ tekathitaṃ rājannarmadātīrtham uttamam |
purāgandharvakanyānāṃ śāpajaṃ bhayamulbaṇam ||1||
nāśitaṃ tanmahā-rājarevājalakaṇāgninā |
revājalakaṇasparśānmuktobhavatimānavaḥ ||2||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
bhagavanbahukanyābhiḥ śāpolaṃ bhi kathaṃ kutaḥ |
kasyāpatyānitāstāsāṃ nāmakiṃ kīdṛśaṃ vayaḥ ||3||
 kathaṃ revājalasparśādvipākācchāpasambhavāt |
vimuktāḥ kutra tāḥ sasnuḥ sarvaṃ mekathayaprabho ||4||
narmadātīrthamāhātmyaṃ camatkārakaraṃ bhavet |
śravaṇād api pāpānāṃ malanāśanamucyate ||5||
narmadānarmadāśabdoyenakenaciducyate |
 tasya syācchāśvatīmuktiryāvadācandratārakam ||6||
vyāhṛtaṃ bhavatāpūrvaṃ revāmāhātmyam uttamam |
 tathā picaritaṃ sādhoyadetattannigadyatām ||7||
athacottamavārtāyāsevitavyāmanīṣibhiḥ |
ataḥ pṛcchāmiviprendrarevāmāhātmyam uttamam ||
itihāsaṃ vadavibhokanyānāṃ caritojjvalam ||8||
nārada uvāca—
śrūyatāṃ rājaśārdūladharmagarbhāparākathā |
 yathā raṇirvahnigarbhādharmastubrahmasūr iva ||9||
gandharvaḥ śukasaṅgītis tasya kanyāpramohinī |
suśīlasyasuśīlācasusvarāsvaravedinaḥ ||10||
sutārācandrakāṃ tasya caṃ drikāsuprabhasyaca |
imānivaranāmānitāsāmapsarasāṃ nṛpa ||11||
kumāryaḥ paṣcasarvāstāvayasāsubhagāḥ punaḥ |
bhāṣaṃ te ca mithastāstubhaginyaiva sarvadā ||12||
caṃ drādivaviniṣkrāṃ tāś ca ṃ drikāivasojjvalāḥ |
caṃ drānanāḥ sukeśyaś ca candrakāṃ tāivojjvalāḥ ||13||
deveṣvetāvilāsinyaḥ kaumudyaḥ kairaveṣviva |
lāvaṇyapiṇḍasambhūtādivyarūpāmanoharāḥ ||14||
udbhinnakucapadminyaḥ ketakyaivamādhave |
utpannayauvanaiḥ kāṃ tāvallīvanavapallavaiḥ ||15||
hemagaurāś ca hemābhāhemābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
hemacaṃ pakamālinyohemacchavisuvāsasaḥ ||16||
svaragrāmāvalīhāsuvividhāmūrcchanāsuca |
tālavādyavinodeṣu veṇuvīṇāpravādane ||17||
mṛdaṃ ganādasambhinnalāsyamadhyalayeṣu ca |
citrādiṣuvinodeṣu kalāsucaviśāradāḥ ||18||
evaṃ bhūtāś ca tāḥ kanyāmumuhuḥ krīḍanairvaraiḥ |
pitṛbhirlālitāḥ sarvāśceruś ca dhanadālaye ||19||
kautukādekadāpaṣcamilitvāmāsimādhave |
kanyāmaṃ dārapuṣpāṇivicinvanty ovanādvanam ||20||
gaurīṃ samārādhayituṃ svarāṃ ganāḥ kadācidacchodasarovaraṃ yayuḥ |
hemāmbujānipravarāṇitāḥ punastasmādupādāyavarotpalaiḥ saha ||21||
vaiḍūryaśuddhasphuṭikaprakuṭṭimesnātvā tughaṭṭeparidhāyacāṃ baram |
maunenacasthaṇḍilapiṇḍikāmayīṃ suvarṇamuktābharaṇāṃ vinirmamuḥ ||22||
samarcitāṃ caṃ danagandhakuṃ kumairabhyarcyagaurīṃ varapaṃ kajādibhiḥ |
nānopahāraiḥ śubhabhaktibhāvitālāsyaprayogairnanṛtuḥ kumārikāḥ ||23||
gāṃ dharvamāśrityaparaṃ svaraṃ tatogeyaṃ svabhāvadhvanibhiḥ samūrchanam |
eṇīdṛśastāḥ prajaguḥ kalākṣaraṃ tārapravṛddhaṃ gatibhiś ca susvaram ||24||
 tasmin subhāverasavarṣaharṣaṃ kanyāsvalaṃ nirbharacittavṛttiṣu |
acchodatīrthepravaretadāgataḥ snātuṃ munervedanidheḥ sutograjaḥ ||25||
rūpeṇaniḥ sīmatarovarānanaḥ praphullapadmāyatalocanoyuvā |
vistīrṇavakṣāḥ subhujo'tisundaraḥ śyāmacchaviḥ kāmaivāparohisaḥ ||26||
sabrahmacārīsuśikhohiśobhatedaṇḍenayuktodhanuṣevamanmathaḥ |
eṇājinaprāvaraṇaḥ samudradhṛghemābhamauṃ jīkaṭimekhalaḥ paraḥ ||27||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇaṃ bālāstās tatra sarasastaṭe |
jahṛṣuḥ kautukāviṣṭāayaṃ nobhavitātithiḥ ||28||
santy aktagītanṛtyāstāstasyālokanalālasāḥ |
hariṇyolubdhakenevaviddhāḥ kāmenasāyakaiḥ ||29||
paśyapaśyetijalpanty omugdhāḥ paṣcasasambhramam |
 tasmin vipravareyūnikāmadevabhramaṃ yayuḥ ||30||
punaḥ punastamabhyarcyanayanaiḥ paṃ kajair iva |
paścādvicāramārabdhamapsarobhiḥ parasparam ||31||
yadyayaṃ kāmadevohiratihīnaḥ kathaṃ bhavet |
athāvāhyaśvinaudevautāvubhauyugacāriṇau ||32||
gandharvaḥ kinnaro vāthasiddhovākāmarūpadhṛk |
ṛṣiputro'thavākaścitkaścid vāmanujottamaḥ ||33||
astivākaścidevāyaṃ dhātrāsṛṣṭohinaḥ kṛte |
 yathā bhāgyavatāmarthenidhānaṃ pūrvakarmabhiḥ ||34||
 tathā smākaṃ kumārīṇāṃ gauryānītovarottamaḥ |
karuṇājalakallolalabdhārdrīkṛtacittayā ||35||
mayāvṛtastvayācāyaṃ tvayāvṛtas tathā nayā |
evaṃ paṣcasukanyāsuvadaṃ tīṣunṛpottama ||36||
śrutvātadvacanaṃ tatra kṛtamādhyāhnikakriyaḥ |
ciṃ tayāmāsamedhāvīkiṃ kṛtvāsukṛtaṃ bhavet ||37||
gādhisambhavaparāśarādayaḥ kaṇḍudevalamukhāś ca yedvijāḥ |
te'piyogibalinovimohitāḥ līlayātadabalābhiradbhutam ||38||
yoṣitāṃ nayanatīkṣṇasāyakairbhrūlatāsudṛḍhacāpanirgataiḥ |
dhanvināmakaraketunāhataḥ kasyanopatativāmanomṛgaḥ ||39||
tāvadevanayadhīrvirājatetāvadevajanatābhayaṃ bhavet |
tāvadevadhṛtacittatābhṛśaṃ tāvadevagaṇanākulasyaca ||40||
tāvadevatapasaḥ pragalbhatātāvadevaśamasevanaṃ nṛṇām |
yāvadevalalanekṣaṇāsavairmādyatedrutamadairnapūruṣaḥ ||41||
mohayanti madayanti rāgiṇaṃ yoṣitaḥ svalalitairmanoharaiḥ |
modayanti madayanti māmimādharmarakṣaṇaparaṃ hisvairguṇaiḥ ||42||
māṃ saraktamalamūtranirmiteyoṣitāṃ vapuṣinirguṇe'śucau |
kāminastuparikalpyacārutāmāviśanti suvimūḍhacetasaḥ ||43||
dāruṇāhiparikīrtitāṃ ganāsādhubhirvimalabuddhibhirbudhaiḥ |
yāvadevanasamīpagāimāstāvadevahigṛhaṃ vrajāmy aham ||44||

nārada uvāca—

 uvāca—taṃ devadūtaṃ madhuraṃ nipuṇaṃ vacaḥ |

nityasnānenapūyante ye'pipātakinonarāḥ |

pratigṛhanivṛttoyaḥ pratigrahakṣamo'pisan ||

tapāṃsi yāni tapyante vratāni niyamāś ca ye |

ambu-binduṃ yaḥ kuśāgreṇa māse māse naraḥ pibet |

pātakaṃ tu mahad yac ca tathā kṣudropapātakam |

etāvatālam agha-nirharaṇāya puṃsāṃ

##gaṃ samudraṃ sa dhyānaṃ saṛṣiḥ chanda-daivatam |

yaḥ pūjayed dhariṃ cakre śālagrāma-śilodbhave |
rājasūya-sahasreṇa teneṣṭaṃ prativāsare ||118||
sadāmananti vedāntā brahma-nirvāṇam acyutam |

api pāpa-samācārāḥ karmaṇy anadhikāriṇaḥ |
śālagrāmārcakā vaiśya naiva yānti yamālayam ||121||

agnihotraṃ kṛtaṃ tena dattā pṛthvī sa-sāgarā |

uṣitvā sa harer loke cakravartīha jāyate ||126||

dvaṃ dvasaṅgaparityaktānāgārikṛtaketanāḥ |

tīrthesnāṃ tinayevaiśyanadattaṃ kāṣcanaṃ cayaiḥ |
naivataptaṃ tapaḥ kiJcit tesyuḥ sarva-traduḥkhitāḥ ||166||
saṃ kṣipyakathitaṃ dharmaṃ narakasyanirūpaṇam |
adrohaḥ sarva-bhūteṣu vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmabhiḥ ||167||
iṃ driyāṇāṃ nirodhaś ca dānaṃ caharisevanam |
varṇāśramakriyāṇāṃ capālanaṃ vidhitaḥ sadā ||168||
svargārthī sarvadā vaiśyatapodānaṃ nakīrtayet |
 yathā śakti tathā dadyādātmanohitakāmyayā ||169||
upānadvastramannānipatraṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ jalam |
avaṃ dhyaṃ divasaṃ kāryyaṃ daridreṇāpivaiśyaka ||170||

dātāro naiva paśyanti tāṃ tāṃ vai yama-yātanām ||171||

kimatrabahunoktenayāṃ tyadharmeṇadurgātim ||172||
ārohanti divaṃ dharmenarāḥ sarva-tra sarvadā ||173||
tenabālatvamārabhyakartavyodharmasaṅgrahaḥ |
ititekathitaṃ sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotum icchasi ||174||
vikuṇḍala uvāca—
śrutvātvadvacanaṃ saumyaprasannaṃ cittam evame |
gaṅgodaṃ pāpa-haṃ sadyaḥ pāpa-hārisatāṃ vacaḥ ||175||
upakartuṃ priyaṃ vaktuṃ guṇonaisargikaḥ satām |
śītāṃ śuḥ kriyatekenaśītalo'mṛtamaṇḍalaḥ ||176||
devadūtatatobrūhikāruṇyānmamapṛcchataḥ |
narakānniṣkṛtiḥ sadyobhrāturme jāyatekatham ||177||
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvādevadūtojagādaha |
dhyānaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvātanmaitrīrajjubandhanaḥ ||178||
yattevaiśyāṣṭamepuṇyaṃ tvayājanmanisaṃ citam |
tadbhrātredīyatāṃ sarvaṃ svargaṃ tasya yadīcchasi ||179||

kiṃ tatpuṇyaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kiṃ janmacapurātanam |
tat sarvaṃ kathyatāṃ dūtatatodāsyāmisatvaram ||180||
devadūta uvāca—
śṛṇuvaiśyapravakṣyāmitatpuṇyaṃ casahetukam |
purāmadhuvanepuṇyeṛṣirāsīccaśākuniḥ ||181||
tapo'dhyayanasampannastejasāṃ brahmaṇāsamaḥ |

paśyanto viṣṇurūpeṇajagat sarvaṣcarācaram |

nakurvanti kriyāṃ kāṃ cidarthamātraṃ hiyoginaḥ |

tadābhinanditāḥ sarvetayāsūnṛtayāgirā ||193||
adyamesaphalaṃ janmajīvitaṃ saphalaṃ tathā |
adyaviṣṇuḥ prasannomesanātho'dyāsmipāvanaḥ ||194||

mamādyapitarodhanyādhanyāgāvaḥ śrutaṃ dhanam ||195||

bhavatāṃ darśanaṃ yasmād dhanyasyaiva harer iva ||196||
evaṃ sampūjya kṛtvā tu pāda-prakṣālanaṃ tathā |
dhṛtaṃ mūrdhni viśāṃ śreṣṭha śraddhayā parayā tadā ||197||
yatra pādodakaṃ vaiśya śraddhayā śirasā dhṛtam |
gandha-puṣpākṣatair dhūpair dīpair bhāva-puraḥ saram ||198||
sampūjya sundarānnena bhojitā yatayas tathā |
tṛptāḥ param ahaṃ sāste viśrāntā mandire niśi ||199||
dhyāyantaś ca paraṃ brahma yaj jyotir jyotiṣāṃ matam |
teṣām ātithyajaṃ puṇyaṃ jātaṃ yat te viśāṃ vara ||200||
natadvaktrasahasreṇavaktuṃ śaknomy ahaṃ khalu |
bhūtānāṃ prāṇinaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ prāṇināṃ mati-jīvinaḥ ||201||
mati-matsu surāḥ śreṣṭhā nareṣu brahma-jātayaḥ |
brāhmaṇeṣu ca vidvāṃso vidvat sukṛta-buddhayaḥ ||202||
kṛta-buddhiṣu kartāraḥ kartṛṣu brahma-vedinaḥ |
ata eva supūjyās te tasmāc chreṣṭhā jagat-traye ||203||
tat-saṅgatir viśāṃ śreṣṭha mahā-pātaka-nāśinī |
viśrāntā gṛhiṇo gehe santuṣṭā brahma-vedinaḥ ||204||
ājanma-saṣcitaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayantī kṣaṇena vai |
saṣcitaṃ yad gṛhasthasya pāpam āmaraṇāntikam ||205||
vinirdahati tat sarvam eka-rātroṣito yatiḥ |
svabhrātre dehi tat-puṇyaṃ narakād yena mucyate ||206||
iti dūta-vacaḥ śrutvā dadau puṇyaṃ sa satvaram |
hṛṣṭena cetasā bhrātā nirayāt so'pi nirgataḥ ||207||
devais tu puṣpa-varṣeṇa pūjitau ca divaṃ gatau |
tābhyāṃ sampūjitaḥ samyag gato dūto yathā gataḥ ||208||
akhila-bhuvana-bodhaṃ deva-dūtasya vākyaṃ 
nigama-vacana-tulyaṃ vaiśya-putro niśamya |
svakṛta-sukṛta-dānād bhrātaraṃ tārayitvā 
sura-pati-vara-lokante na sārdhaṃ jagāma ||209||
itihāsamimaṃ rājanyaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād api |

nārada uvāca—

yadipāpoyadiśaṭhoyadivādhārmikonaraḥ |
vārāṇasīṃ samāsādyapunātisakalaṃ kulam ||39||
vārāṇasyāṃ ye'rcayanti mahā-devaṃ stuvanti vai |
sarva-pāpavinirmuktāstevijṣeyāgaṇeśvarāḥ ||40||
anyatra yoga-jṣānābhyāṃ saṃnyāsād athavānyataḥ |
prāpyatetatparaṃ sthānaṃ sahasreṇaivajanmanām ||41||
yebhaktādevadeveśivārāṇasyāṃ vasanti vai |
tevindanti paraṃ mokṣamekenaivatujanmanā ||42||
yatra yogas tathā jñānaṃ muktirekenajanmanā |
avimuktaṃ tadāsādyanānyadicchettapovanam ||43||
yatomayā'vimuktaṃ tadavimuktaṃ tataḥ smṛtam |
tad eva guhyaṃ guhyānāmetadvijñānamucyate ||44||
jṣānājṣānābhiniṣṭhānāṃ paramānaṃ damicchatām |
yāgatirviditāsubhrūḥ sāvimuktemṛ tasya tu ||45||
yāni caivāvimuk tasya dehedṛṣṭānikṛtsnaśaḥ |
purīvārāṇasītebhyaḥ sthānebhyo 'pyadhikāśubhā ||46||
yatra sākṣānmahā-devodehāṃ tesvayamīśvaraḥ |
vyācaṣṭetārakaṃ brahma tatra ivahyavimuktaye ||47||
yattatparataraṃ tattvamavimuktamitiśrutam |
ekenajanmanādevivārāṇasyāntadāpnuyāt ||48||
bhrūmadhye nābhimadhye cahṛdaye caiva mūrdhani |
yathā vimuktamādityevārāṇasyāṃ vyavasthitam ||49||
varaṇāyās tathā cāsyāmadhye vārāṇasīpurī |
tatra iva-saṃsthitaṃ tattvaṃ nityamevaṃ vimuktakam ||50||
vārāṇasyāḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ nabhūtaṃ nabhaviṣyati |
yatra nārāyaṇo devomahā-devodivīśvaraḥ ||51||
tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ |
upāsate yaṃ satataṃ devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||52||
mahā-pātakino devi ye tebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛttamāḥ |
vārāṇasīṃ samāsādyate yānti paramāṃ gatim ||53||
tasmān mumukṣur niyato vased vai maraṇāntakam |
vārāṇasyāṃ mahā-devāj jñānaṃ labdhvā vimucyate ||54||
kiṃ tu vighnā bhaviṣyanti pāpopahata-cetasaḥ |
tato naivācaret pāpaṃ kāyena manasā girā ||55||
etad-rahasyaṃ devānāṃ purāṇānāṃ ca suvrate |
avimuktāśrayaṃ jñānaṃ na kaścid vetti tattvataḥ ||56||
nārada uvāca—
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ caśṛṇvatāṃ parameṣṭhinām |
devadevenakathitaṃ sarva-pāpa-vināśanam ||57||
 yathā nārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
yatheśvarāṇāṅgiriśaḥ sthānānāmetaduttamam ||58||
yaiḥ samārādhitorudraḥ pūrvasminnekajanmani |
tevidanti paraṃ kṣetramavimuktaṃ śivālayam ||59||
kalikalmaṣasambhūtāyeṣāmupahṛtāmatiḥ |
nateṣāṃ vedituṃ śakyaṃ sthānaṃ tatparameṣṭhinaḥ ||60||
yesmaranti sadākālaṃ vadanti capurīmimām |
teṣāṃ vinaśyatikṣipramihāmutracapātakam ||61||
yānicehaprakurvanti pātakānikṛtālayāḥ |
nāśayettānisarvāṇidevaḥ kālatanuḥ śivaḥ ||62||
āgacchettadidaṃ sthānaṃ sevitaṃ mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
mṛtānāṃ capunar janmanabhūyobhavasāgare ||63||
tasmāt sarva-prayatnenavārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ |
yogīvāpyathavāyogīpāpīvāpuṇyakṛttamaḥ ||64||
nalokavacanātpitrorna caiva guruvādataḥ |
matirnakramaṇīyāsyādavimuktagatiṃ prati ||65||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe 
trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 
||33||

(34)
catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
tatredaṃ vimalaṃ liṅgamoṃ kāraṃ nāmaśobhanam |
 yasya smaraṇamātreṇamucyate sarva-pātakaiḥ ||1||
etatparataraṃ jñānaṃ paṣcāyatanam uttamam |
sevitaṃ munirbhirnityaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ vimokṣaṇam ||2||
 tatra sākṣānmahā-devaḥ paṣcāyatanavigrahaḥ |
ramatebhagavānrudrojaṃ tūnāmapavargadaḥ ||3||
etatpāśupataṃ jñānaṃ paṣcāyatanamucyate |
tadetadvimalaṃ liṅgamoṃ kāraṃ samupasthitam ||4||
śāṃ tyatītā tathā śāṃ tirvidyācaivāparāvarā |
pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiś ca paṣcātmaṃ liṅgam aiśvaram ||5||
paṣcānāmapiliṅgānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ samāśrayam |
auṃ kārabodhakaṃ liṅgaṃ paṣcāyatanamucyate ||6||
saṃ smaredīśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ paṣcāyatanamavyayam |
dehāṃ teparamaṃ jyotirānaṃ daṃ viśatebudhaḥ ||7||
 tatra devarṣayaḥ pūrvaṃ siddhābrahmarṣayas tathā |
upāsyadevamīśānamāpurantaḥ paraṃ padam ||8||
matsyodaryāstaṭepuṇyesthānaṃ guhyatamaṃ śubham |
gocarmamātraṃ rājendraauṃ kāreśvaram uttamam ||9||
kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ madhyameśvaram uttamam |
viśveśvaraṃ tathoṃ kāraṃ kaṃ darpeśvaramevaca ||10||
etāniguhyaliṅgānivārāṇasyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
na kaścidihajānātivināśaṃ bhoranugrahāt ||11||
kṛttivāseśvarasyaivamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇupārthiva |
 tasmin sthānepurādaityohastībhūtvā śivāntikam ||12||
brāhmaṇānhaṃ tumāyāto yatra nityamupāsate |
teṣāṃ liṅgānmahā-devaḥ prādurāsīttrilocanaḥ ||13||
rakṣaṇārthaṃ mahā-devobhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ |
hatvāgajākṛtiṃ daityaṃ śūlenāvajṣayāharaḥ ||14||
vāsastasyākarotkṛttiṃ kṛttivāseśvarastataḥ |
 tatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptāmunayohiyudhiṣṭhira ||15||
tenaivacaśarīreṇaprāptāstatparamaṃ padam |
vidyāvidyeśvarārudrāḥ śivāyecaprakīrttitāḥ ||16||
kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ nityamāśrityasaṃ sthitāḥ |
jṣātvākaliyugaṅghoramadharmabahulaṃ janāḥ ||17||
kṛttivāsaṃ namuṃ canti kṛtārthāstenasaṃśayaḥ |
janmāntarasahasreṇamokṣoyatrāpyatenavā ||18||
ekenajanmanāmokṣaḥ kṛttivāse'tralabhyate |
ālayaṃ sarva-siddhānāmetatsthānaṃ vadanti hi ||19||
gopitaṃ devadevenamahā-devenaśaṃ bhunā |
yugeyugeh yatra dāṃ tābrāhmaṇāvedapāragāḥ ||20||
upāsante mahātmānaṃ japanti śatarudriyam |
stuvanti satataṃ devaṃ tryaṃ bakaṃ kṛttivāsasam ||
dhyāyanti hṛdayedevaṃ sthāṇuṃ sarvāntaraṃ śivam ||21||
gāyanti siddhāḥ kilagītakānivārāṇasīṃ yenivasanti viprāḥ |
teṣāmathaikenabhavedvimuktiryekṛttivāsaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ ||22||
samprāpyalokejagatāmabhīṣṭaṃ sudurlabhaṃ viprakuleṣu janma |
dhyānesamādhāyajapanti rudraṃ dhyāyanti citteyatayomaheśam ||23||
ārādhayanti prabhumīśitāraṃ vārāṇasīmadhyagatāmunīṃ drāḥ |
yajanti yajṣairabhisamdhihīnāḥ stuvanti rudraṃ praṇamanti śaṃ bhum ||24||
namobhavāyāmalayogadhāmnesthāṇuṃ prapadyegiriśaṃ purāṇam |
smarāmirudraṃ hṛdayeniviṣṭaṃ jānemahā-devamanekarūpam ||25||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe
catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
||34||

(35)
paṣcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
athānyat tatra vai liṅgaṃ kapardīśvaram uttamam |
snātvā tatra vidhānena tarpayitvā pitṝn nṛpa ||1||
mucyate sarva-pāpebhyo muktiṃ bhuktiṃ ca vindati |
piśāca-mocanaṃ nāma tīrtham anyat tataḥ sthitam ||2||
tatrāś ca ryamayo devo muktidaḥ sarva-doṣahaḥ |
kaścid daityo jagāmedaṃ śārdūlo ghora-rūpa-dhṛk ||3||
mṛgīm ekāṃ bhakṣayituṃ kapardīśvaram uttamam |
tatra sā bhīta-hṛdayā kṛtvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ||4||
dhāvamānā susambhrāntā vyāghrasya vaśam āgatā |
tāṃ vidāryanakhaistīkṣṇaiḥ śārdūlaḥ samahā-balaḥ ||5||
jagāmacānyaṃ vijanaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā munīśvarān |
mṛtamātrācasābālākapardīśāgratomṛgī ||6||
adṛśyatamahā-jvālāvyomnisūryasamaprabhā |
trinetrānīlakaṃ ṭhācaśaśāṃ kāṃ kitamūrddhajā ||7||
vṛṣādhirūḍhāpuruṣaistādṛśair evasaṃ vṛtā |
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vimuṃ canti khecarāstatsamaṃ tataḥ ||8||
gaṇeśvarīsvayaṃ bhūtvā nadṛṣṭātatkṣaṇāttataḥ |
 dṛṣṭvā tadāś ca ryavaraṃ praśaśaṃ suḥ surādayaḥ ||9||
tanmaheśasyavailiṅgaṃ kapardīśvaram uttamam |
smṛtvaivāśeṣapāpaughātkṣipramasyavimuṃ cati ||10||
kāmakrodhādayodoṣāvārāṇasīnivāsinām |
vighnāḥ sarvevinaśyanti kapardīśvarapūjanāt ||11||
tasmātsadaivadraṣṭavyaṃ kapardīśvaram uttamam |
pūjitavyaṃ prayatnenastotavyaṃ vaidikaistavaiḥ ||12||
dhyāyatāṃ cātraniyataṃ yogināṃ śāntacetasām |
 jāyateyogasiddhiḥ syātṣaṇmāsenanasaṃśayaḥ ||13||
brahmahatyādayaḥ pāpāvinaśyaṃ t yasya pūjanāt |
piśācamocanekuṇḍesnātaḥ syātpraśamoyataḥ ||14||
 tasmin kṣetrepurāviprastapasvīsaṃśita-vrataḥ |
śaṃ kukarṇaitikhyātaḥ pūjayāmāsaśaṅkaram ||15||
jajāparudramaniśaṃ praṇavaṃ brahmarūpiṇam |
puṣpadhūpādibhistotraiḥ namaskāraiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ ||16||
upāsītātrayogātmākṛtvādīkṣāṃ tu na iṣṭhikīm |
kadācidāgataṃ pretaṃ paśyatismakṣudhānvitam ||17||
asthicarmapinaddhāṃ gaṃ niśvasaṃ taṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā samuniśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayāparayāyutaḥ ||18||
provācakobhavānkasmāddeśāddeśamimaṃ śritaḥ |
tasmaipiśācaḥ kṣudhayāpīḍyamāno'bravīdvacaḥ ||19||
pūrvajanmanyahaṃ viprodhanadhānya-samanvitaḥ |
putrapautrādibhiryuktaḥ kuṭuṃ babharaṇotsukaḥ ||20||
napūjitāmahā-devāgāvo'pyatithayas tathā |
nakadācitkṛtaṃ puṇyamalpaṃ vānalpamevaca ||21||
ekadābhagavāndevovṛṣabheśvaravāhanaḥ |
viśveśvarovārāṇasyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭonamaskṛtaḥ ||22||
tadācireṇakālenapaṣcatvamahamāgataḥ |
nadṛṣṭaṃ tanmahā-ghoraṃ yamasyasadanaṃ mune ||23||
pipāsayādhunākrāṃ tonajānāmihitāhitam |
yadikaṃ citsamuddhartumupāyaṃ paśyasiprabho ||24||
kuruṣvataṃ namastubhyaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
ityuktaḥ śaṃ kukarṇo'thapiśācamidamabravīt ||25||
tādṛśonahiloke’sminvidyatepuṇyakṛttamaḥ |
yattvayābhagavānpūrvaṃ dṛṣṭoviśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ ||26||
saṃ spṛṣṭovaṃ ditobhūyaḥ ko'nyastvatsadṛśo bhuvi |
tenakarmavipākenadeśametaṃ samāgataḥ ||27||
snānaṃ kuruṣvaśīghraṃ tvamasminkuṇḍesamāhitaḥ |
yenemāṃ kutsitāṃ yoniṃ kṣipramevaprahāsyasi ||28||
sa evamuktomunināpiśācodayālunādevavaraṃ trinetram |
smṛtvākapardīśvaramīśitāraṃ cakresamādhāyamanovagāham ||29||
tadāvagāḍhomunisannidhānemamāradivyābharaṇopapannaḥ |
adṛśyatārkapratimovimāneśaśāṃ kacihnīkṛtacārumauliḥ ||30||
vibhātirudraiḥ sahitodiviṣṭhaiḥ samābhṛtoyogiribharaprameyaiḥ |
savālakhilyādibhireṣadevoyathodayebhānuraśeṣadevaḥ ||31||
stuvanti siddhādividevasaṅghānṛtyanti divyāpsaraso'bhirāmāḥ |
muṃ canti vṛṣṭiṃ kusumāmbumiśrāṃ gandharvavidyādharakinnarādyāḥ ||32||
saṃ stūyamāno'thamunīndrasaṅghairavāpyabodhaṃ bhagavatprasādāt |
samāviśanmaṇḍalametadagryaṃ trayīmayaṃ yatra vibhātirudraḥ ||33||
 dṛṣṭvā vimuktaṃ sapiśācabhūtaṃ muniḥprahṛṣṭomanasā maheśam |
viciṃ tyarudraṃ kavimekamagniṃ praṇamyatuṣṭāvakapardinaṃ tam ||34||
śaṃ kukarṇa uvāca—
kapardinaṃ tvāṃ parataḥ parastādgoptāramekaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam |
vrajāmiyogeśvaramīpsitāramādityamagniṃ kapilādhirūḍham ||35||
tvāṃ brahma-sāraṃ hṛdi saṃniviṣṭaṃ 
hiraṇmayaṃ yoginam ādimaṃ tam |
vrajāmi rudraṃ śaraṇaṃ diviṣṭhaṃ 
mahā-muniṃ brahma-mayaṃ pavitram ||36||
sahasrapādākṣiśirobhiyuktaṃ sahasrarūpaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt |
taṃ brahmapāraṃ praṇamāmiśaṃ bhuṃ hiraṇyagarbhādhipatiṃ trinetram ||37||
 yatra prasūtirjagatovināśoyenāvṛtaṃ sarvam idaṃ śivena |
taṃ brahmapāraṃ bhagavaṃ tamīśaṃ praṇamyanityaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ||38||
aliṅgamālokavihīnarūpaṃ svayaṃ prabhuṃ citpatimekarūpam |
taṃ brahmapāraṃ parameśvaraṃ tvāṃ namaskariṣyenayato'nyadasti ||39||
yaṃ yoginastyaktasabījayogālabdhvāsamādhiṃ paramātmabhūtāḥ |
paśyanti devaṃ praṇato'sminityaṃ taṃ brahmapāraṃ paramasvarūpam ||40||
na yatra nāmādiviśeṣaklṛptirnasamdṛśetiṣṭhatiyatsvarūpam |
taṃ brahmapāraṃ praṇato'sminityaṃ svayaṃ bhuvaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ||41||
yadvedavādābhiratāvidehaṃ sabrahmavijñānamabhedamekam |
paśyanty anekaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpaṃ taṃ brahmapāraṃ praṇato'sminityam ||42||
yataḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ purāṇobibhartitejaḥ praṇamanti devāḥ |
namāmitaṃ jyotiṣisanniviṣṭaṃ kālaṃ bṛhaṃ taṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam ||43||
vrajāminityaṃ śaraṇaṃ guheśaṃ sthāṇuṃ prapadyegiriśaṃ purāṇam |
śivaṃ prapadye harimiṃ dumauliṃ pinākinaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ||44||
stutvaivaṃ śaṃ kukarṇo'pibhagavaṃ taṃ kapardinam |
papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau proccaran praṇavaṃ param ||45||
tatkṣaṇātparamaṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam |
jñānamānaṃ damatyaṃ taṃ koṭijvālāgnisannibham ||46||
śaṃ kukarṇo'thamuktātmātadātmā sarva-go'malaḥ |
nililyevimaleliṅgetadadbhutamivābhavat ||47||
etadrahasyamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ tekaparddinaḥ |
na kaścid vettitamasāvidvānap yatra muhyati ||48||
yaimāṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm |
tyaktapāpaviśuddhātmārudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt ||49||
paṭheccasatataṃ śuddhobrahmapāraṃ mahā-stavam |
prātarmadhyāhnasamayesayogaṃ prāpnuyātparam ||50||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe
vārāṇasī-māhātmye
paṣcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
||35||

(36)
ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
vārāṇasyāṃ mahā-rājamadhyameśaṃ parātparam |
 tasmin sthānemahā-devo devyāsahamaheśvaraḥ ||1||
ramatebhagavānnityaṃ rudraiś ca parivāritaḥ |
 tatra pūrvaṃ hṛṣīkeśoviśvātmādevakīsutaḥ ||2||
uvāsavatsaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sadāpāśupatairyutaḥ |
bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃ gorudrādhyayanatatparaḥ ||3||
ārādhayanhariḥ śaṃ bhuṃ kṛtvāpāśupataṃ vratam |
 tasya tebahavaḥ śiṣyāḥ brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ ||4||
labdhvātadvadanājjñānaṃ dṛṣṭavanto maheśvaram |
 tasya devomahā-devaḥ pratyakṣaṃ nīlalohitaḥ ||5||
dadaukṛṣṇasyabhagavānvaradovaram uttamam |
ye'rcayanti cagovindaṃ madbhaktāvidhipūrvakam ||6||
teṣāntadaiśvaraṃ jñānamutpatsyatijaganmayam |
namasyo'rcayitavyaś ca dhyātavyomatparairjanaiḥ ||7||
bhaviṣyanti nasamdehomatprasādādvijātayaḥ |
ye'tradrakṣyanti deveśaṃ snātvā devaṃ pinākinam ||8||
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāmāśuvinaśyati |
prāṇāṃ styakṣyanti yermatyāḥ pāpa-karmaratāapi ||9||
te yānti tatparaṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
dhanyāstukhalutevijṣāmaṃ dākinyāṃ kṛtodakāḥ ||10||
arcayitvāmahā-devaṃ madhyameśvaramīśvaram |
jñānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tviha ||11||
ekaikaśaḥ kṛtaṃ karmapunātyāsaptamaṃ kulam |
sannihatyāmupaspṛśyarāhugrastedivākare ||12||
yatphalaṃ labhatemarttyastasmāddaśaguṇaṃ tviha |
evamuktaṃ mahā-rājamāhātmyaṃ madhyameśvare ||
yaḥ śṛṇotiparaṃ bhaktyāsayātiparamaṃ padam ||13||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe
vārāṇasī-māhātmye
ṣaṭ-triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
||36||

(37)
saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
anyāni camahā-rājatīrthānipāvanānitu |
vārāṇasyāṃ sthitānīhasaṃ śṛṇuṣvayudhiṣṭhira ||1||
prayāgādadhikaṃ tīrthaṃ prayāgaṃ paramaṃ śubham |
viśvarūpaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tālatīrtham anuttamam ||2||
ākāśākhyaṃ mahā-tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caivārṣabhaṃ param |
sunīlaṃ camahā-tīrthaṃ gaurītīrtham anuttamam ||3||
prājāpatyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ svargadvāraṃ tathaiva ca |
jambukeśvaram ity uktaṃ dharmākhyaṃ tīrtham uttamam ||4||
gayātīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva mahā-nadī |
nārāyaṇaparaṃ tīrthaṃ vāyutīrtham anuttamam ||5||
jñānatīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ vārāhaṃ tīrtham uttamam |
yamatīrthaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ saṃ mūrtikaṃ śubham ||6||
agnitīrthaṃ mahā-rājakalaśeśvaram uttamam |
nāgatīrthaṃ soma-tīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca ||7||
parvatākhyaṃ mahā-guhyaṃ maṇikarṇyam anuttamam |
ghaṭotkacaṃ tīrthavaraṃ śrītīrthaṃ capitāmaham ||8||
gaṅgātīrthaṃ tudeveśaṃ yayātestīrtham uttamam |
kāpilaṃ caiva someśaṃ brahmatīrtham anuttamam ||9||
 tatra liṅgaṃ purāṇīyaṃ sthātuṃ brahmā yathā gataḥ |
tadānīṃ sthāpayāmāsaviṣṇustailaṃ lagamaiśvaram ||10||
 tatra snātvā samāgamyabrahmāprovācataṃ harim |
mayānītamidaṃ liṅgaṃ kasmātsthāpitavānasi ||11||
tamāhaviṣṇustvatto'pirudrebhaktirdṛḍhāmama |
tasmātpratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ nāmnātavabhaviṣyati ||12||
bhūteśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmasamudbhavam |
gandharvatīrthaṃ suśubhaṃ vāhneyaṃ tīrtham uttamam ||13||
daurvāsikaṃ vyomatīrthaṃ candratīrthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
cintāṃ gadeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ vidyādhareśvaram ||14||
kedāratīrthamugrākhyaṃ kālaṃ jaram anuttamam |
sārasvataṃ prabhāsaṃ carudrakarṇahradaṃ śubham ||15||
kokilākhyaṃ mahā-tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva mahā-layam |
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ goprekṣaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva m anuttamam ||16||
upaśāntaṃ śivaṣcaiva vyāghreśvaram anuttamam |
trilocanaṃ mahā-tīrthaṃ lokārkaṃ cottarāhvayam ||17||
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam |
śukreśvaraṃ mahā-puṇyamānaṃ dapuram uttamam ||18||
evamādīnitīrthānivārāṇasyāṃ sthitāni vai |
naśakyaṃ vistarādvaktuṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi ||19||

vārāṇasī-māhātmye

nārada uvāca—
athasamdhyāṃ samāsādyasavidyāṃ tīrtham uttamam |
upaspṛśyanaro vidvānbhavennāsty atra saṃśayaḥ ||1||

narastārayatesarvānyas tuprāṇānparityajet ||9||
evaṃ jṣātvātu rājendrasadāśraddhāparo bhavet |
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣāḥ pāpopahata-cetasaḥ ||
naprāpnuvanti tatsthānaṃ prayāgaṃ devanirmitam ||10||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
snehādvādravyalobhādvāye tu kāmavaśaṃ gatāḥ |
 kathaṃ tīrtha-phalaṃ teṣāṃ kathaṃ puṇyam avāpnuyuḥ ||11||

kīrtanādvarddhatepuṇyaṃ śrutaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||21||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
yamunāyāṃ tu kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tu mahā-mune |
etanme sarvam ākhyāhi yathā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā śrutam ||22||

 tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca yamunāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |

paścimedharmarājasyatīrthaṃ haravaraṃ smṛtam ||27||
 tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti yemṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ |
evaṃ tīrtha-sahasrāṇi yamunā-dakṣiṇe taṭe ||28||
uttareṇapravakṣyāmiādit yasya mahātmanaḥ |
tīrthaṃ tuvirajaṃ nāma yatra devāḥ savāsavāḥ ||29||
upāsatesmasamdhyāṃ tunityakālaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |

yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—

iklaśyatecāparas tatra naivayogam avāpnuyāt |

pūjyatetīrtharājasyasatyametadyudhiṣṭhira ||15||

anenaivānumānenatvaṃ jṣāsyasiyudhiṣṭhira ||17||
 yathā puṇyamapuṇyaṃ vā tathaiva kathitaṃ mayā |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
śrutaṃ tadyattvayāproktaṃ vismito'haṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||18||
 kathaṃ yogenatatprāptiḥ svargalokastukarmaṇā |
tadācalabhatebhogāngāṃ catatkarmaṇāṃ phalam ||19||
tānikarmāṇipṛcchāmipunaryaiḥ prāpyatemahīm |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca—
śṛṇurājanmahā-bāhoyathoktakarmaṇāmahī ||20||
gāmagniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śāstraṃ kāṣcanaṃ salilaṃ striyaḥ |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva yoniṃ datinarādhipa ||21||
naiteṣāmūrdhvagamanamevamāhaprajāpatiḥ |
evaṃ yogasyasamprāptiḥ sthānaṃ paramadurlabham ||22||
gacchanti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yenarāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ |
hastyaśvaṃ gāmanaḍvāhaṃ maṇimuktādikāṣcanam ||23||

|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe prayāgamāhātmye

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca—
śṛṇurājanprayāgasyamāhātmyaṃ punar eva tu |
naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva gotīrthaṃ sindhusāgaram ||1||
kurukṣetraṃ gayā caiva gaṅgāsāgaramevaca |
etecānyecabahavoyecapuṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ ||2||
daśatīrthasahasrāṇitriṃśatkoṭyas tathā pare |

trīṇicāpyagnikuṇḍāniyeṣāṃ madhye tujāhnavī |

bhogavatyathayā caiva vedireṣāprajāpateḥ ||8||
 tatra devāś ca yajṣāś ca mūrtimanto yudhiṣṭhira |
pūjayanti prayāgaṃ teṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ ||9||

daśatīrthasahasrāṇitisraḥ koṭyas tathā pare ||11||
 yatra gaṅgāmahā-bhāgāsadeśastattapovanam |
siddhakṣetraṃ tutajjṣeyaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam ||12||
itisatyaṃ dvijātīnāṃ sādhūnāmātmajasyavā |
suhṛdāṃ cajapetkarṇeśiṣyasyānuga tasya vā ||13||
idaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ sevyamidaṃ śubham |

adhītyacadvijodhyāyannirmalatvam avāpnuyāt ||15||

jātismaratvaṃ labhatenākapṛṣṭhecamodate ||16||

snāhitīrtheṣu kauravyanacavakramatirbhava ||17||

yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
kathāsarvātviyaṃ proktāprayāgasyamahā-mune |
evaṃ me sarvam ākhyāhi yathā camamatārayet ||1||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca—
śṛṇurājanpravakṣyāmiproktaṃ sarvam idaṃ jagat |

īśvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṃ yaḥ paśyatisapaśyati |

yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
apy āha me yathā tattvaṃ yathaiṣāṃ tiṣṭhate śrutam |

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca—
prayāgenivasanty etebrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
kāraṇaṃ tupravakṣyāmiśṛṇutattvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||9||

|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe prayāgamāhātmye

sūta uvāca—
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitāḥ sarvepāṇḍavādharmaniś ca yāḥ |
brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtvāgurudevāṃ stvatarpayan ||1||
vāsudevo'pi tatra ivakṣaṇenābhyāgatastadā |

abhiṣiktaḥ svarājye tu dharmaputroyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||3||
e tasmin nantar- e caiva mārkaṇḍeyomahātmavān |
tataḥ svastīticoktvāvaikṣaṇādāśramamāgataḥ ||4||
yudhiṣṭhiro'pidharmātmābhrātṛbhiḥ sahitastusaḥ |
mahā-dānaṃ dadaucāthadharmaputroyudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||5||

prayāgamanugacchedvāvasatevāpiyonaraḥ |
 sarva-pāpaviśuddhātmāsvargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||9||

ahaṃ kāranivṛttaś ca satīrtha-phalamaśnute |

ātmopamaś ca bhūteṣu satīrtha-phalamaśnute ||11||
ṛṣibhiḥ kratavaḥ proktādevaiś cāpi yathā kramam |

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ -
bhavatākathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatiṃ kacitpṛṣṭamevaca |
idānīmapipṛcchāma ekaṃ vadamahā-mate ||1||
eteṣāṃ khalutīrthānāṃ sevanādyatphalaṃ labhet |
sarveṣāṃ kilakṛtvaikaṃ karmakenacalabhyate ||2||
etannobrūhi sarva-jṣakarmaivaṃ yadivartate |
sūta uvāca—
karmayogaḥ kilaproktovarṇānāṃ dvijapūrvaśaḥ ||3||
nānāvidhomahā-bhāgās tatra caikaṃ viśiṣyate |
hari-bhaktiḥ kṛtāyenamanasā vacasāgirā ||4||
jitaṃ tenajitaṃ tenajitam evanasaṃśayaḥ |
harirevasamārādhyaḥ sarva-deveśvareśvaraḥ ||5||
harināmamahā-mantrairnaśyet pāpapiśācakam |
hareḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvāsakṛdapyamalāśayāḥ ||6||
 sarva-tīrthasamāplāvaṃ labhaṃ teyannasaṃśayaḥ |
pratimāṃ caharer dṛṣṭvā sarva-tīrtha-phalaṃ labhet ||7||
viṣṇunāmaparaṃ japtvā sarvam aṃ traphalaṃ labhet |
viṣṇu-prasāda-tulasīm āghrāya dvija-sattamāḥ ||8||
pracaṇḍaṃ vikarālaṃ tadyamasyāsyaṃ na paśyati |
sakṛtpraṇāmīkṛṣṇasyamātuḥ stanyaṃ pibennahi ||9||
hari-pādemanoyeṣāṃ tebhyo nityaṃ namonamaḥ |
pulkasaḥ śvapacovāpiyecānyemlecchajātayaḥ ||10||
te'pivaṃ dyāmahā-bhāgāhari-pādaikasevakāḥ |
kiṃ punarbrāhmaṇāḥ puṇyābhaktārājarṣayas tathā ||11||
haraubhaktiṃ vidhāyaivagarbhavāsaṃ na paśyati |
hareragresvanairuccairnṛtyaṃ stannāmakṛnnaraḥ ||12||
punātibhuvanaṃ viprāgaṅgādisalilaṃ yathā |
darśanātsparśanāt tasya ālāpād apibhaktitaḥ ||13||
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpair mucyatenātra saṃśayaḥ |
hareḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kurvannuccaistannāmakṛnnaraḥ ||14||
karatālādisamdhānaṃ susvaraṃ kalaśabditam |
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ tenaivakaratālitam ||15||
hari-bhaktikathāmuktvākhyāyikāṃ śṛṇuyāccayaḥ |
tasya sandarśanād eva pūto bhavati mānavaḥ ||16||
kiṃ punas tasya pāpānām āśaṅkā muni-puṅgavāḥ |
tīrthānāṃ ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇa-nāma maharṣayaḥ ||17||
tīrthīkurvanti jagatīṃ gṛhītaṃ kṛṣṇa-nāma yaiḥ |
tasmānmunivarāḥ puṇyaṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ viduḥ ||18||
viṣṇuprasādanirmālyaṃ bhuktvādhṛtvācamastake |
viṣṇurevabhavenmartyoyamaśokavināśanaḥ ||19||
arcanīyonamaskāryoharirevanasaṃśayaḥ |
(yemahā-viṣṇumavyaktaṃ devaṃ vāpimaheśvaram ||20||
ekībhāvena paśyanti nateṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ |)
tasmādanādinidhanaṃ viṣṇumātmānamavyayam ||21||
hariṃ caikaṃ prapaśyadhvaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ tathaiva hi |
yesamānaṃ prapaśyanti hariṃ vaidevatāntaram ||22||
te yānti narakānghorāṃ nnatāṃ stugaṇayeddhīraḥ |
mūrkhaṃ vāpaṇḍitaṃ vāpibrāhmaṇaṃ keśavapriyam ||23||
śvapākaṃ vāmocayatinārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
nārāyaṇātparonāstipāparāśidavānalaḥ ||24||
kṛtvāpipātakaṃ ghoraṃ kṛṣṇanāmnāvimucyate |
svayaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ svanāmnijagatāṃ guruḥ ||25||
ātmano'bhyadhikāṃ śaktiṃ sthāpayāmāsasuvratāḥ |
atrayevivadaṃ tevaiāyāsalaghudarśanāt ||26||
phalānāṃ gauravāccāpi te yānti narakaṃ bahu |
tasmāddharaubhaktimānsyāddharināmaparāyaṇaḥ ||27||
pūjakaṃ pṛṣṭhatorakṣennāminaṃ vakṣasiprabhuḥ |
hari-nāma mahā-vajraṃ pāpa-parvata-dāraṇe ||28||
tasya pādautusaphalautadarthaṃ gatiśālinau |
tāvevadhanyāvākhyātauyautupūjākaraukarau ||29||
uttamāṃ gam uttamāṃ gaṃ taddharaunamramevayat |
sājihvāyāhariṃ stautitanmanastatpadānugam ||30||
tānilomānicocyaṃ teyānitannāmnicotthitam |
kurvanti tac ca netrāmbu yad acyuta-prasaṅgataḥ ||31||
aho lokā atitarāṃ daiva-doṣeṇa vaṣcitāḥ |
nāmoccāraṇamātreṇamuktidaṃ nabhajanti vai ||32||
vaṣcitāste ca kaluṣāḥ strīṇāṃ saṅgaprasaṅgataḥ |
pratiṣṭhanti calomāniyeṣāṃ nokṛṣṇaśabdane ||33||
temūrkhāhyakṛtātmānaḥ putraśokādivihvalāḥ |
rudanti bahulālāpairnakṛṣṇākṣarakīrtane ||34||
jihvāṃ labdhvāpiloke'sminkṛṣṇanāmajapennahi |
labdhvāpimuktisopānaṃ helayaivacyavanti te ||35||
tasmādyatnenavaiviṣṇuṃ karmayogenamānavaḥ |
karmayogārccitoviṣṇuḥ prasīdatyevanān yathā ||36||
tīrthādapyadhikaṃ tīrthaṃ viṣṇorbhajanamucyate |
sarveṣāṃ khalutīrthānāṃ snānapānāvagāhanaiḥ ||37||
yatphalaṃ labhatemartyastatphalaṃ kṛṣṇasevanāt |
yajaṃ tekarmayogenadhanyāevanarāharim ||38||
tasmādbhajadhvaṃ munayaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ paramamaṅgalam ||39||
|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe viṣṇubhaktipraśaṃ sanaṃ 
nāmapaṣcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||50||

[51]
ekapaṣcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ 

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ --
karmayogaḥ kathaṃ sūtayenacārādhitohariḥ |
prasīdatimahā-bhāgavadanovadatāṃ vara ||1||
yenāsaubhagavānīśaḥ samārādhyomumukṣubhiḥ |
tadvadākhilalokānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dharmasaṅgraham ||2||
taṃ karmayogaṃ vadanaḥ sūtamūrtimayas tuyaḥ |
itiśuśrūṣavoviprābhavadagrevyavasthitāḥ ||3||
sūta uvāca—
evamevapurāpṛṣṭovyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ |
ṛṣibhiragnisaṃ kāśairvyāsastānāhatacchṛṇu ||4||
vyāsa uvāca—
śṛṇudhvaṃ mṛṣayaḥ sarvevakṣyamāṇaṃ sanātanam |
karmayogaṃ brāhmaṇānāmātyanti kaphalapradam ||5||
āmnāyasiddhamakhilaṃ brāhmaṇārthaṃ pradarśitam |
ṛṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pūrvaṃ manurāhaprajāpatiḥ ||6||
 sarva-vyādhiharaṃ puṇyamṛṣisaṅghairniṣevitam |
samāhitadhiyoyūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadatomama ||7||
kṛtopanayanovedānadhīyītadvijottamaḥ |
garbhāṣṭame'ṣṭamevābdesvasūtroktavidhānataḥ ||8||
daṇḍīcamekhalīsūtrīkṛṣṇājinadharomuniḥ |
bhikṣāhāroguruhitovīkṣyamāṇogurormukham ||9||
kārpāsamupavītārthaṃ nirmitaṃ brahmaṇāpurā |
brāhmaṇānāṃ trivṛtsūtraṃ kauśaṃ vāvastramevavā ||10||
sadopavītī caiva syātsadābaddhaśikhodvijaḥ |
an yathā yatkṛtaṃ karmatadbhavatya yathā kṛtam ||11||
vasedavikṛtaṃ vāsaḥ kārpāsaṃ vākaṣāyakam |
tad eva paridhānīyaṃ śuklaṃ tāntavam uttamam ||12||
uttaraṃ tusamāmnātaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śubham |
abhāvegāvayamapirauravaṃ vāvidhīyate ||13||
uddhṛtyadakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ savyabāhausamarpitam |
upavītaṃ bhavennityaṃ nivītaṃ kaṃ ṭhasajjane ||14||
savyabāhuṃ samuddhṛtyadakṣiṇetudhṛtaṃ dvijāḥ |
prācīnāvītamityuktaṃ pitryekarmaṇiyojayet ||15||
agnyāgāregavāṃ goṣṭhehometapye tathaiva ca |
svādhyāyebhojanenityaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ casannidhau ||16||
upāsanegurūṇāṃ ca samdhyayoḥ sādhusaṅgame |
upavītībhavennityaṃ vidhireṣasanātanaḥ ||17||
mauṃ jītrivṛtsamāṃ śliṣṭāṃ kuryādviprasyamekhalām |
muṃ jābhāvekuśenāhurgraṃ thinaikenavātribhiḥ ||18||
dhārayed vaiṇava-pālāśau daṇḍau keśāntikau dvijaḥ |
yajṣārhavṛkṣajaṃ vāthasaumyamavraṇamevaca ||19||
sāyaṃ prātardvijaḥ samdhyāmupāsītasamāhitaḥ |
kāmāllobhādbhayānmohāttyaktvaināṃ patito bhavet ||20||
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryātsāyaṃ prātaḥ prasannadhīḥ |
snātvā santar- payeddevānṛṣīnpitṛgaṇāṃs tathā ||21||
devatābhyarcanaṃ kuryātpuṣpaiḥ patrairyavāmbubhiḥ |
abhivādanaśīlaḥ syānnityaṃ vṛddheṣu dharmataḥ ||22||
asāvahaṃ bhonāmetisamyakpraṇatipūrvakam |
āyurārogyasiddhyarthaṃ taṃ drādipar ivarjitaḥ ||23||
āyuṣmānbhavasaumyetivacovipro'bhivādane |
ākāraścāsyanāmnoṃ 'tevācyaḥ pūrvākṣaraplutaḥ ||24||
yonavettyabhivādasyavipraḥ pratyabhivādanam |
nābhivādyaḥ saviduṣā yathā śūdras tathaiva saḥ ||25||
vyatyastapāṇinākāryaṃ pādasaṅgrahaṇaṃ guroḥ |
savyenasavyaḥ sapraṣṭavyodakṣiṇenatudakṣiṇaḥ ||26||
laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vāpi tathā dhyātmikamevavā |
avāpyaprayatojñānaṃ taṃ pūrvamabhivādayet ||27||
nodakaṃ dhārayedbhaikṣyaṃ puṣpāṇisamidhas tathā |
evaṃ vidhānicānyāninadevārtheṣu karmasu ||28||
brāhmaṇaṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchetkṣatrabandhumanāmayam |
vaiśyaṃ kṣemaṃ samāgamyaśūdramārogyamevaca ||29||
upādhyāyaḥ pitājyeṣṭhobhrātātrātācabhītitaḥ |
mātulaḥ śvaśuraś caiva mātāmahapitāmahau ||30|
varṇaśreṣṭhaḥ pitṛvyaś ca puṃ so'traguravaḥ smṛtāḥ |
mātāmātāmahīgurvīpiturmātuś ca sodarāḥ ||31||
śvaśrūḥ pitāmahījyeṣṭhādhātrīcaguravaḥ striyaḥ |
jṣeyas tuguruvargo'yaṃ mātṛtaḥ pitṛtodvijāḥ ||32||
anuvartanameteṣāṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ |
gurūn dṛṣṭvā samuttiṣṭhedabhivādyakṛtāṣjaliḥ ||33||
naitairupaviśetsārdhaṃ vivadennātmakāraṇāt |
jīvitārthamapidveṣādgurubhirnaivabhāṣaṇam ||34||
udrikto'piguṇairanyairgurudveṣīpatatyadhaḥ |
gurūṇāmapisarveṣāṃ paṣcapūjyāviśeṣataḥ ||35||
teṣāmādyāstrayaḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ mātāsupūjitā |
yobhāvayatiyāsūteyenavidyopadiśyate ||36||
jyeṣṭhobhrātācabhartācapaṣcaiteguravaḥ smṛtāḥ |
ātmanaḥ sarva-yatnenaprāṇatyāgenavāpunaḥ ||37||
pūjanīyāviśeṣeṇapaṣcaitebhūtimicchatā |
yāvatpitācamātācadvāvetaunirvikāriṇau ||38||
tāvat sarvaṃ parityajyaputraḥ syāttatparāyaṇaḥ |
pitāmātācasuprītausyātāṃ putraguṇairyadi ||39||
saputraḥ sakalaṃ dharmaṃ prāpnuyāttenakarmaṇā |
nāstimātṛsamaṃ daivaṃ nāstipitṛsamoguruḥ ||40||
tayoḥ pratyupakāro'pina kathaṃ canavidyate |
tayornityaṃ priyaṃ kuryātkarmaṇāmanasā girā ||41||
natābhyāmananujṣātodharmamanyaṃ samācaret |
varjayitvāmuktiphalaṃ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathā ||42||
dharmasāraḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ pretyānaṃ taphalapradaḥ |
samyagārādhyavaktāraṃ visṛṣṭastadanujṣayā ||43||
śiṣyovidyāphalaṃ bhuṅktepretyacāpadyatedivi |
yobhrātaraṃ pitṛsamaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ mūḍho'vamanyate ||44||
tenadoṣeṇasampretyanirayaṃ ghoramṛcchati |
 puṃsāṃ vartmanisṛṣṭenapūjyobhartātu sarvadā ||45||
apimātariloke'sminnupakārāddhigauravam |
mātulāṃ ś ca pitṛvyāṃ ś ca śvaśurānṛtvijogurūn ||46||
asāvahamitibrūyātpratyutthāyābhivādayet |
avācyodīkṣitonāmnāyavīyānapiyo bhavet ||47||
bhobhavatpūrvakaṃ tvenamabhibhāṣetadharmavit |
abhivādyaś ca pūjyaś ca śirasānamya evaca ||48||
brāhmaṇakṣatriyādyaiś ca śrīkāmaiḥ sādaraṃ sadā |
nābhivādyāś ca vipreṇakṣatriyādyāḥ kathaṃ cana ||49||
jñānakarmaguṇopetāyadyapyetebahuśrutāḥ |
brāhmaṇaḥ sarva-varṇānāṃ svastikuryāditiśrutiḥ ||50||
savarṇenasavarṇānāṃ kāryamevābhivādanam |
gururagnirdvijātīnāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇoguruḥ ||51||
patirekoguruḥ strīṇāṃ sarva-trābhyāgatoguruḥ |
vidyākarmavayobandhurvittaṃ bhavatipaṣcamam ||52||
mānyasthānānipaṣcāhuḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurūttarāt |
paṣcānāṃ triṣuvarṇeṣu bhūyāṃ sibalavanti ca ||53||
 yatra syuḥ so'tramānārhaḥ śūdro'pidaśamīṃ gataḥ |
paṃ thādeyobrāhmaṇāyastriyairājṣevicakṣuṣe ||54||
vṛddhāyabhārabhagnāyarogiṇedurbalāyaca |
bhikṣāmāhṛtyaśiṣṭānāṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato'nvaham ||55||
nivedyaguruve'śnīyādvāgyatastadanujṣayā |
bhavatpūrvaṣcaredbhaikṣyamupavītīdvijottamaḥ ||56||
bhavanmadhyaṃ turājanyovaiśyas tubhavaduttaram |
mātaraṃ vāsvasāraṃ vāmāturvābhaginīṃ nijām ||57||
bhikṣetabhikṣāṃ prathamaṃ yācainaṃ navimānayet |
sajātīyagṛheṣvevasārvavarṇikamevavā ||58||
bhaikṣyasyācaraṇaṃ proktaṃ patitādivivarjitam |
vedayajṣairahīnānāṃ praśastānāṃ svakarmasu ||59||
brahmacāryyāharedbhaikṣyaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato'nvaham |
guroḥ kulenabhikṣetanajṣātikulabandhuṣu ||60||
alābhetvanyagehānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vivarjayet |
 sarvaṃ vāvicaredgrāmaṃ pūrvoktānāmasambhave ||61||
niyamyaprayatovācaṃ diśastvanavalokayan |
samāhṛtyatubhaikṣyānnaṃ yāvadarthamamāyayā ||62||
bhuṣjītaprayatonityaṃ vāgyato'nanyamānasaḥ |
bhaikṣyeṇavartayennityaṃ naivekānnobhavedvratī ||63||
bhaikṣyaiṇavarttinovṛttirupavāsasamāsmṛtā |
pūjayedaśanaṃ nityamadyāccainamakutsayan ||64||
 dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyetprasīdecca pratinaṃ decca sarva-śaḥ |
anārogyamanāyuṣyamasvargyaṃ cātibhojanam ||65||
apuṇyaṃ lokavidviṣṭaṃ tasmāttatpar ivarjayet |
prāṅmukho'nnānibhuṣjītasūryābhimukhamevavā ||66||
nādyādudaṅmukhonityaṃ vidhireṣasanātanaḥ |
prakṣālyapāṇipādaucabhuṣjānodvirupaspṛśet ||67||
śuddhedeśesamāsīnobhuktvācadvirupaspṛśet ||68||
|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe svarga-khaṇḍe karmayogakathanaṃ 
nāma ekapaṣcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||51||
dvipaṣcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ 
vyāsa uvāca—
bhuktvāpītvācasuptvācasnātvā rathyopasarpaṇe |
oṣṭhāvalomakauspṛṣṭvāvāsoviparidhāyaca ||1||
retomūtrapurīṣāṇāmutsarge'nṛtabhāṣaṇe |
ṣṭhīvitvā'dhyayanāraṃ bhekāsaśvāsāgame tathā ||2||
catvaraṃ vāśmaśānaṃ vāsamākramyadvijottamaḥ |
samdhyayorubhayostadvadācāṃ to'pyācametpunaḥ ||3||
caṇḍālamlecchasambhāṣestrīśūdrocchiṣṭabhāṣaṇe |
ucchiṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhojyaṃ cāpi tathā vidham ||4||
ācāmedaśrupātevālohi tasya tathaiva ca |
bhojanesamdhyayoḥ snātvā pītvāmūtrapurīṣayoḥ ||5||
āgatovācametsuptvāsakṛtsakṛdathānyataḥ |
agnergavāmathālaṃ bhespṛṣṭvāprayatam evavā ||6||
strīṇāmathātmanaḥ sparśenīlīṃ vāparidhāyaca |
upasparśejjalaṃ vārtaṃ tṛṇaṃ vābhūmimevaca ||7||
keśānāṃ cātmanaḥ sparśevāsasaḥ skhali tasya ca |
anuṣṇābhirakeśābhiraduṣṭābhiś ca dharmataḥ ||8||
śauce'psu sarvadā cāmedāsīnaḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ |
śiraḥ prāvṛtyakaṃ ṭhaṃ vāmuktakeśaśikho'pivā ||9||
akṛtvāpādayoḥ śaucaṃ mārgatonaśucirbhavet |
sopānatkopānasthovānoṣṇīṣīcācamedbudhaḥ ||10||
na caiva varṣadhārābhirnatiṣṭhannuddhṛtodakaiḥ |
naikahastārpitajalairvināsūtreṇavāpunaḥ ||11||
napādukāsanasthovābahirjānurathāpivā |
najalpannahasanprekṣanśayānastalpa evaca ||12||
nāvikṣitābhiḥ phenādyairupetābhirathāpivā |
śūdrāśucikaronmuktairnakṣārābhis tathaiva ca ||13||
nacaivāṃ gulibhiḥ śabdaṃ nakuryānnānyamānasaḥ |
navarṇarasaduṣṭābhirna caiva pradarodakaiḥ ||14||
napāṇikṣubhitābhirvānabahirgandha evavā |
hṛdgābhiḥ pūyatevipraḥ kaṃ ṭhyābhiḥ kṣatriyaḥ śuciḥ ||15||
prāśitābhis tathā vaiśyaḥ strīśūdrausparśatoṃ 'tataḥ |
aṃ guṣṭhamūlāntaratorekhāyāṃ brāhmamucyate ||16||
antar- āṃ guṣṭhadeśinyaiḥ pitṝṇāṃ tīrthamucyate |
kaniṣṭhāmūlataḥ paścātprājāpatyaṃ pracakṣate ||17||
aṃ gulyagraṃ smṛtaṃ daivaṃ tadevārṣaṃ prakīrtitam |
mūlenadaivamārṣaṃ syādāgneyaṃ madhyataḥ smṛtam ||18||
tad eva saumikaṃ tīrthametajjṣātvānamuhyati |
brāhmeṇaivatutīrthenadvijonityamupaspṛśet ||19||
homayedvāthadaivenanatupitryeṇavaidvijāḥ |
triḥ prāśnīyādapaḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmeṇaprayatastataḥ ||20||
saṃ mṛjyāṃ guṣṭhamūlenamukhaṃ vaisamupaspṛśet |
aṃ guṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tuspṛśennetradvayaṃ tataḥ ||21||
tarjanyaṃ guṣṭhayogenaspṛśennāsāpuṭadvayam |
kaniṣṭhāṃ guṣṭhayogenaśravaṇesamuspṛśet ||22||
sarvāsāmathayogenahṛdayaṃ tutanavā |
spṛśedvaiśirasastadvadaṃ guṣṭhenāṃ sakadvayam ||23||
triḥ prāśnīyādyadaṃ bhastuprītāstenāsyadevatāḥ |
brahmāviṣṇurmaheśaś ca bhavaṃ tītyanuśuśruma ||24||
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva prīye te parimārjanāt |
saṃ spṛṣṭayorlocanayoḥ prīyeteśaśibhāskarau ||25||
nāsatyadasrauprīyetespṛśennāsāpuṭadvayam |
karṇayoḥ spṛṣṭayostadvatprīyetecānilānalau ||26||
saṃ spṛṣṭehṛdayecāsyaprīyaṃ te sarva-devatāḥ |
mūrdhnisaṃ sparśanādekaḥ prītaḥ sapuruṣo bhavet ||27||
nocchiṣṭaṃ kurvatevaktrevipruṣoṃ gelaganti yāḥ |
daṃ tavaddaṃ talagneṣu jihvāsparśeśucirbhavet ||28||
spṛśanti biṃ davaḥ pādauyaācāmayataḥ parān |
bhūmipāṃ śusamājṣeyānatairaspṛśyatābhavet ||29||
madhuparkecasomecatāṃ būlasyacabhakṣaṇe |
phalamūlecekṣudaṇḍenadoṣaṃ prāhavaimanuḥ ||30||
pracaraṃ ścānnapāneṣu dravyahastobhavennaraḥ |
bhūmaunikṣipyataddravyamācamyābhyukṣayettutat ||31||
taijasaṃ vaisamādāyayadyucchiṣṭobhaveddvijaḥ |
bhūmaunikṣipyataddravyamācamyābhyukṣayettutat ||32||
yadyaddravyaṃ samādāyabhaveduccheṣaṇānvitaḥ |
anidhāyaivataddravyaṃ bhūmautvaśucitāmiyāt ||33||
vastrādiṣuvikalpaḥ syāttatsaṃ spṛśyācamediha |
araṇyenirjanerātraucauravyāghrākulepathi ||34||
kṛtvāmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vādravyahastonaduṣyati |

evaṃ tvāśramaniṣṭhānāṃ yatīnāṃ niyatātmanām |

 sarva-syādhāramavyaktamānaṃ daṃ jyotiravyayam ||9||

 tathā picanakartavyaḥ prasaṅgohyeṣadāruṇaḥ ||24||

(61)
ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ

sūta uvāca—
evam uktā purā viprā vyāsenāmita-tejasā |
etāvad uktvā bhagavān vyāsaḥ satyavatī-sutaḥ ||1||
samāśvāsya munīn sarvān jagāma ca yathā gatam |
bhavadbhyas tu mayā proktaṃ varṇāśrama-vidhānakam ||2||
evaṃ kṛtvā priyo viṣṇor bhavaty eva na cānyathā |
rahasyaṃ tatra vakṣyāmi śṛṇuta dvija-sattamāḥ ||3||
ye cātra kathitā dharmā varṇāśrama-nibandhanāḥ |
hari-bhakti-kalāṃśāṃśa-samānā na hi te dvijāḥ ||4||
puṃsām eke ha vai sādhyā hari-bhaktiḥ kalau yuge |
yugāntareṇa dharmā hi sevitavyā nareṇa hi ||5||
kalau nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ yajate yaḥ sa dharma-bhāk |
dāmodaraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ puruhūtaṃ sanātanam ||6||
hṛdi kṛtvā paraṃ śāntaṃ jitam eva jagat trayam |
kali-kāloragādaṃśāt kilbiṣāt kāla-kūṭataḥ ||7||
hari-bhakti-sudhāṃ pītvā ullaṅghyo bhavati dvijaḥ |
kiṃ japaiḥ śrī-harer nāma gṛhītaṃ yadi mānuṣaiḥ ||8||
kiṃ snānair viṣṇu-pādāmbu mastake yena dhāryate |
kiṃ yajṣena hareḥ pāda-padmaṃ yena dhṛtaṃ hṛdi ||9||
kiṃ dānena hareḥ karma sabhāyāṃ vai prakāśitam |
harer guṇa-gaṇān śrutvā yaḥ prahṛṣyet punaḥ punaḥ ||10||
samādhinā prahṛṣṭasya sā gatiḥ kṛṣṇa-cetasaḥ |
tatra vighna-karāḥ proktāḥ pākhaṇḍālāpa-peśalāḥ ||11||
nāryas tat-saṅginaś cāpi hari-bhakti-vighātakāḥ |
nārīṇāṃ nayanādeśaḥ surāṇām api durjayaḥ ||12||
sa yena vijito loke hari-bhaktaḥ sa ucyate |
mādyanti munayo’py atra nārī-carita-lolupāḥ ||13||
hari-bhaktiḥ kutaḥ puṃsāṃ nārī-bhakti-juṣāṃ dvijāḥ |
rākṣasyaḥ kāminī-veṣāś ca ranti jagati dvijāḥ ||
narāṇāṃ buddhi-kavalaṃ kurvanti satataṃ hitāḥ ||14||
tāvad vidyā prabhavati tāvaj jñānaṃ pravartate |
tāvat sunirmalā medhā sarva-śāstra-vidhāriṇī ||15||
tāvaj japas tapas tāvat tāvat tīrtha-niṣevaṇam |
tāvac ca guru-śuśrūṣā tāvad dhita-raṇe matiḥ ||16||
tāvat prabodho bhavati vivekas tāvad eva hi |
tāvat satāṃ saṅga-rucis tāvat paurāṇa-lālasā ||17||
yāvat sīmantinī-lola-nayanāṃ dolanaṃ na hi |
janopari pated viprāḥ sarva-dharma-vilopanam ||18||
tatra ye hari-pādābjamadhuleśa-prasāditāḥ |
teṣāṃ na nārī-lolākṣi-kṣepaṇaṃ hi prabhur bhavet ||19||
janma-janma-hṛṣīkeśa-sevanaṃ yaiḥ kṛtaṃ dvijāḥ |
dvije dattaṃ hutaṃ vahnau viratis tatra tatra hi ||20||
nārīṇāṃ kila kiṃ nāma saundaryaṃ paricakṣate |
bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ cākacakyaṃ tad ucyate ||21||
snehātma-jñāna-rahitaṃ nārī-rūpaṃ kutaḥ smṛtam |
pūya-mūtra-purīṣā-sṛk-tvaṅ-medo’sthi-vasānvitam ||22||
kalevaraṃ hi tan nāma kutaḥ saundaryam atra hi |
tad evaṃ pṛthag ācintya spṛṣṭvā snātvā śucir bhavet ||23||
taiḥ saṃhitaṃ śarīraṃ hi dṛśyate sundaraṃ janaiḥ |
aho’tidurdaśā nṝṇāṃ durdaiva-ghaṭitā dvijāḥ ||24||
kucāvṛte’ṅge puruṣo nārī buddhvā pravarttate |
kā nārī vā pumān ko vā vicāre sati kiṃcana ||25||
tasmāt sarvātmanā sādhur nārī-saṅgaṃ vivarjayet |
ko nāma nārīm āsādya siddhiṃ prāpnoti bhūtale ||26||
kāminī kāminī-saṅgi-saṅgam ity api santyajet |
tat-saṅgād rauravam iti sākṣād eva pratīyate ||27||
ajṣānāl lolupā-lokās tatra daivena vaṣcitāḥ |
sākṣān naraka-kuṇḍe’smin nārī-yonau pacen naraḥ ||28||
yata evāgataḥ pṛthvyāṃ tasminn eva punā ramet |
yataḥ prasarate nityaṃ mūtraṃ reto-malotthitam ||29||
tatra iva ramate lokaḥ kas tasmād aśucir bhavet |
tatrātikaṣṭaṃ loke’sminn aho daiva-viḍambanā ||30||
punaḥ punā ramet tatra aho nistrapatā nṛṇām |
tasmād vicārayed dhīmān nārī-doṣa-gaṇān bahūn ||31||
maithunād bala-hāniḥ syān nidrātitaruṇāyate |
nidrayāpahṛta-jñānaḥ svalpāyur jāyate naraḥ ||32||
tasmāt prayatnato dhīmān nārīṃ mṛtyum ivātmanaḥ |
paśyed govinda-pādābje mano-vairam ayed budhaḥ ||33||
ihāmutra-sukhaṃ tad dhi govinda-pada-sevanam |
vihāya komahā-mūḍho nārī-pādaṃ hi sevate ||34||
janārdanāṅghri-sevā hi hy apunar-bhava-dāyinī |
nārīṇāṃ yoni-sevā hi yoni-saṅkaṭa-kāriṇī ||35||
punaḥ punaḥ pated yonau yantra-niṣpācito yathā |
punas tām evābhilaṣed vidyād asya viḍambanam ||36||
ūrdhva-bāhur ahaṃ vacmi śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
govinde dhehi hṛdayaṃ na yonau yātanā-juṣi ||37||
nārīsaṅgaṃ parityajyayaś cāpi par ivarttate |
padepadeśvamedhasyaphalamāpnotimānavaḥ ||38||
kulāṅganādaivayogādūḍhāyadinṛṇāṃ satī |
putramutpādyayas tatra tatsaṅgaṃ par ivarjayet ||39||
 tasya tuṣṭojagannāthobhavatyevanasaṃśayaḥ |
nārīsaṅgohidharmajṣairasatsaṅgaḥ prakīrtyate ||40||
 tasmin satiharaubhaktiḥ sudṛḍhānaiva jāyate |
 sarva-saṅgaṃ parityajyaharaubhaktiṃ samācaret ||41||
hari-bhaktiś ca loketradurllabhāhimatāmama |
harau yasya bhavedbhaktiḥ sakṛtārthonasaṃśayaḥ ||42||
tattadevācaretkarmahariḥ prīṇātiyenahi |
tasmiṃs tuṣṭejagattuṣṭaṃ prīṇiteprīṇitaṃ jagat ||43||
haraubhaktiṃ vinānṝṇāṃ vṛthājanmaprakīrtitam |
brahmeśādisurā yasya yajaṃ teprītihetave ||44||
nārāyaṇamanāvyaktaṃ nataṃ sevetakojanaḥ |
 tasya mātāmahā-bhāgāpitā tasya mahā-kṛtī ||45||
janārdanapadadvaṃ dvaṃ hṛdayeyenadhāryate |
janārdanajagadvaṃ dyaśaraṇāgatavatsala ||46||
itīrayanti yemartyānateṣāṃ nirayegatiḥ |
brāhmaṇāhiviśeṣeṇapratyakṣaṃ harirūpiṇaḥ ||47||
pūjayeyur yathā yogaṃ haristeṣāṃ prasīdati |
viṣṇurbrāhmaṇarūpeṇavicaretpṛthivīmamām ||48||
brāhmaṇenavinākarmasiddhiṃ prāpnotinaivahi |
dvijapādāmbubhaktyāyaiḥ pītvāśirasicārpiṃ tam ||49||
tarpitāpitaras tenaātmāpikilatāritaḥ |
brāhmaṇānāṃ mukheyenadattaṃ madhuramarcitam ||50||
sākṣātkṛṣṇamukhedattaṃ tadvaibhuṅktehariḥ svayam |
ahotidurllabhālokāpratyakṣekeśavedvije ||51||
pratimādiṣusevaṃ tetadabhāvehitatkriyā |
brāhmaṇānāmadhiṣṭhānātpṛthvīdhanyetigīyate ||52||
teṣāṃ pāṇaucayaddattaṃ haripāṇautadarpitam |
tebhyaḥ kṛtānnamaskārāttiraskārohipāpmatām ||53||
mucyatebrahmahatyādipāpebhyo vipravaṃ danāt |
tasmātsatāṃ samārādhyobrāhmaṇoviṣṇubuddhitaḥ ||54||
kṣudhi tasya dvijasyāsyeyatiṃ kaciddīyate yadi |
pretyapīpūṣadhārābhiḥ siṃ catekalpakoṭikam ||55||
dvijatuṇḍaṃ mahā-kṣetramanūṣaramakaṃ ṭakam |
 tatra cedupyatekiJcit koṭikoṭiphalaṃ labhet ||56||
saghṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ cāsmaidattvākalpaṃ samodate |
nānāsumiṣṭamannaṃ yodadātidvijatuṣṭaye ||57||
 tasya lokāmahā-bhogāḥ koṭikalpāntamuktidāḥ |
brāhmaṇaṃ capuraskṛtyabrāhmaṇenānukīrtitam ||58||
purāṇaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ mahā-pāpadavānalam |
purāṇaṃ sarva-tīrtheṣu tīrthaṃ cādhikamucyate ||59||
 yasya ikapādaśravaṇāddharirevaprasīdati |
 yathā sūryavapurbhūtvā prakāśāyacareddhariḥ ||60||
sarveṣāṃ jagatāmevaharirālokahetave |
tathaivāntaḥ prakāśāyapurāṇāvayavohariḥ ||61||
vicaredihabhūteṣu purāṇaṃ pāvanaṃ param |
tasmādyadihareḥ prīterutpādedhīyatematiḥ ||62||
śrotavyamaniśaṃ puṃ bhiḥ purāṇaṃ kṛṣṇarūpiṇam |
viṣṇubhaktenaśāṃ tenaśrotavyamapidurlabham ||63||
purāṇākhyānamamalamamalīkaraṇaṃ param |
 yasmin vedārthamāhṛtyahariṇāvyāsarūpiṇā ||64||
purāṇaṃ nirmitaṃ vipratasmāttatparamo bhavet |
purāṇeniścitodharmodharmaś ca keśavaḥ svayam ||65||
tasmātkṛtepurāṇehiśruteviṣṇurbhavediti |
sākṣātsvayaṃ harirvipraḥ purāṇaṃ ca tathā vidham ||66||
etayoḥ saṅgamāsādyaharirevabhevannaraḥ |
 tathā gaṅgāmbusekenanāśayetkilbiṣaṃ svakam ||67||
keśavodravarūpeṇapāpāttārayatemahīm |
vaiṣṇavoviṣṇubhajanasyākāṅkṣīyadivartate ||68||
gaṅgāmbusekamamalamamalīkaraṇaṃ caret |
viṣṇubhaktipradādevīgaṅgā bhuvi cagīyate ||69||
viṣṇurūpāhisāgaṅgālokavistārakāriṇī ||70||
brāhmaṇeṣu purāṇeṣu gaṅgāyāṃ goṣupippale |
nārāyaṇadhiyāpuṃ bhirbhaktiḥ kāryāhyahaitukī ||71||
pratyakṣaviṣṇurūpāhitatvajṣairniścitāamī |
tasmātsatatamabhyarcyāviṣṇubhaktyabhilāṣiṇā ||72||
viṣṇaubhaktiṃ vinānṝṇāṃ niṣphalaṃ janmaucyate |
kalikālapayorāśiṃ pāpagrāhasamākulam ||73||
viṣayāmajjanāvartaṃ durbodha-phenilaṃ param |
mahā-duṣṭa-jana-vyāla-mahā-bhīmaṃ bhayānakam ||74||
dustaraṃ ca taranty eva hari-bhakti-tari-sthitāḥ |
tasmād yateta vai loko viṣṇu-bhakti-prasādhane ||75||
kiṃ sukhaṃ labhate jantur asad-vārtāvadhāraṇe |
harer adbhuta-līlasya līlākhyānena sajjate ||76||
tad vicitra-kathā-lokenānāviṣaya-miśritāḥ |
śrotavyā yadi vai nṝṇāṃ viṣaye sajjate manaḥ ||77||
nirvāṇe yadi vā cittaṃ śrotavyā tad api dvijāḥ |
helayā śravaṇāc cāpi tasya tuṣṭo bhaved dhariḥ ||78||
niiṣkrayopihṛṣīkeśonānākarmacakārasaḥ |
śuśrūṣūṇāṃ hitārthāyabhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||79||
nalabhyatekarmaṇāpivājapeyaśatādinā |
rājasūyāyutenāpi yathā bhaktyāsalabhyate ||80||
yatpadaṃ cetasāsevyaṃ sadbhirācaritaṃ muhuḥ |
bhavābdhitaraṇesāramāśrayadhvaṃ hareḥ padam ||81||
rereviṣayasaṃ lubdhāḥ pāmarāniṣṭhurānarāḥ |
rauravehikimātmānamātmanāpātayiṣyatha ||82||
vināgovindasaumyāṃ ghrisevanaṃ māgamiṣyati |
anāyāsenaduḥkhānāntaraṇaṃ yadivāṃ chatha ||83||
bhajadhvaṃ kṛṣṇacaraṇāvapunarbhavakāraṇe |
kuta evāgatomartyaḥ kuta evapunarvrajet ||84||
etadvicāryamatimanāśrayeddharmasaṅgraham |
nānānarakasampātādutthitoyadipūruṣaḥ ||85||
sthāvarāditanuṃ labdhvāyadibhāgyavaśātpunaḥ |
mānuṣyaṃ labhate tatra garbhavāsotiduḥkhadaḥ ||86||
tataḥ karmavaśājjanturyadivā jāyate bhuvi |
bālyādibahudoṣeṇapīḍitobhavatidvijāḥ ||87||
punaryauvanamāsādyadāridryeṇaprapīḍyate |
rogeṇaguruṇāvāpianāvṛṣṭyādinā tathā ||88||
vārddhakenalabhetpīḍāmanirvācyāmitastataḥ |
manasaś ca lanādvyādhestatomaraṇamāpnuyāt ||89||
natasmādadhikaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃsārepyanubhūyate |
tataḥ karmavaśājjanturyama-lokeprapīḍyate ||90||
tatrātiyātanāṃ bhuktvā punar eva prajāyate |
jāyate mriyate jantur mriyate jāyate punaḥ ||91||
anārādhita-govinda-caraṇe tv īdṛśī daśā |
anāyāsena maraṇaṃ vināyāsena jīvanam ||92||
anārādhita-govinda-caraṇasya na jāyate |
dhanaṃ yadi bhaved gehe rakṣaṇāt tasya kiṃ phalam ||93||
yadāsau kṛṣyate yāmyair dūtaiḥ kiṃ dhanam anviyāt |
tasmād dvijāti-sat-kāryaṃ draviṇaṃ sarva-saukhyadam ||94||
dānaṃ svargasya sopānaṃ dānaṃ kilbiṣa-nāśanam |
govinda-bhakti-bhajanaṃ mahā-puṇya-vivardhanam ||95||
balaṃ yadi bhaven martye na vṛthā tad-vyayaṃ caret |
harer agre nṛtya-gītaṃ kuryād evam atandritaḥ ||96||
yat kiṃcid vidyate puṃsāṃ tac ca kṛṣṇe samarpayet |
kṛṣṇārpitaṃ kuśaladamanyārpitam asaukhyadam ||97||
cakṣurbhyāṃ śrī-harer eva pratimādi-nirūpaṇam |
śrotrābhyāṃ kalayet kṛṣṇa-guṇa-nāmāny ahar-niśam ||98||
jihvayā hari-pādāmbu-svāditavyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
ghrāṇenāghrāya govinda-pādābja-tulasī-dalam ||99||
tvacā spṛṣṭvā harer bhaktaṃ manasā dhyāya tat-padam |
kṛtārtho jāyate jantur nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||100||
tan-manā hi bhavet prājṣas tathā syāt tad-gatāśayaḥ |
tam evānte’bhyeti loko nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||101||
cetasā cāpy anudhyātaḥ svapadaṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
nārāyaṇam anādy-antaṃ nataṃ seveta ko janaḥ ||102||
satata-niyata-citto viṣṇu-pādāravinde 
vitaraṇam anuśakti-prītaye tasya kuryāt |
nati-mati-ratim asyāGghri-dvaye saṃvidadhyāt
sa hi khalu nara-loke pūjyatām āpnuyāc ca ||103||

sūta uvāca—
evaṃ yanmahimālokelokanistārakāraṇam |
tasya viṣṇoḥ pareśasyanānāvigrahadhāriṇaḥ ||1||

ūrū bhāgavataṃ proktaṃ nābhiḥ syān nāradīyakam ||3||

laiṅgaṃ hi gulphakaṃ dakṣaṃ vārāhaṃ vāma-gulphakam ||5||
skāndaṃ purāṇaṃ lomāni tvag asya vāmanaṃ smṛtam |
kaurmaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ samākhyātaṃ mātsyaṃ medaḥ prakīrtitam ||6||
majjā tu gāruḍaṃ proktaṃ brahmāṇḍam asthi gīyate |
evam evābhavad viṣṇuḥ purāṇāvayavo hariḥ ||7||
hṛdayaṃ tatra vai pādmaṃ yac chrutvāmṛtam aśnuyate |
pādmam etat purāṇaṃ tu svayaṃ devo’bhavad dhariḥ ||8||
yasyaikādhyāyam adhyāpya sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
tatrādimaṃ svargam idaṃ sarva-pādma-phala-pradam ||9||
svargakhaṇḍaṃ samākarṇyamahā-pātakinopiye |
mucyaṃ tetepipāpebhyastvacojīrṇādyathoragāḥ ||10||
apicetsudurācāraḥ sarva-dharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ |
ādisvargaṃ samākarṇyayatphalaṃ sam avāpnuyāt ||11||

māghemāseprayāgetusnātvā pratidinaṃ naraḥ ||12||

dattātenasvarṇatulādattā caiva dharākhilā ||13||
kṛtaṃ vitaraṇaṃ tenadraridreyatkṛtamṛṇam |
harernāmasahasrāṇipaṭhitānihyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||14||
sarvevedās tathā dhītāstattatkarmakṛtaṃ tathā |
adhyāpakāś ca bahavaḥ sthāpitāvṛttidānataḥ ||15||
abhayaṃ bhayalokebhyo dattaṃ tena tathā dvijāḥ |
guṇavanto jñānavanto dharmavanto numānitāḥ ||16||
meṣakarkaṭayor madhye toyaṃ dattaṃ suśītalam |
brāhmaṇārthegavārthecaprāṇāstyaktāś ca tenahi ||17||
anyāni casukarmāṇikṛtānitenadhīmatā |
yenādikhaṇḍaṃ sadasiśrutaṃ saṃ śrāvitaṃ tathā ||18||
svargakhaṇḍaṃ samādhītyanānābhogānsamaśnute |
antaḥ puraganārīṇāṃ sukhasuptaḥ prabudhyate ||19||
kiṃ kiṇīravasannādais tathā madhurabhāṣaṇaiḥ |
indrasyārdhāsanaṃ bhuṅkteindralokevasecciram ||20||
tataḥ sūr yasya bhavanaṃ candralokaṃ tatovrajet |
saptarṣibhavanebhogānbhuktvāyātitatodhruvam ||21||
tataś ca brahmaṇolokaṃ prāpyatejomayaṃ vapuḥ |
 tatra ivajñānamāsādyanirvāṇaṃ paramṛcchati ||22||
sadbhiḥ sahavaseddhīmānsattīrthesnānamācaret |
kuryādevasadālāpaṃ sacchāstraṃ śṛṇuyān naraḥ ||23||
tatra pādmaṃ mahā-śāstraṃ sarvāmnāya-phala-pradam |
svargaṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca tan-madhye mahā-puṇya-phala-pradam ||24||

gamiṣyadhvaṃ lokān ativimala-bhogān atitarām |

yadīcchā-vīcīnāṃ sukha-taraṇam iṣṭānilabhata ||25||

śaunaka uvāca—
kalau samāgate sūta prāṇināṃ kena karmaṇā |
uddhāro vai bhavet tasmāt kathayasva mamāgrataḥ ||1||
sūta uvāca—
sādhu sādhu muni-śreṣṭha puṇyātmanāṃ varo bhavān |
sarveṣāṃ ca janānāṃ ca śubha-vāṣcho nirantaram ||2||
etad vyāsaḥ purā vipraḥ sarva-jṣaḥ sarva-pūjitaḥ |

daṇḍavat praṇipatyāsau vyāsaṃ sarvārtha-pāragam |
guruṃ satyavatī-sūnuṃ papraccha muni-puṅgavaḥ ||4||
jaiminir uvāca—
kalau nṝṇāṃ bhavet kena mokṣo vai kathayasva me |
alpenāpi ca puṇyena martyāś cālpāyuṣo yataḥ ||5||
vyāsa uvāca—
sādhu-saṅgād bhaved vipra śāstrāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ prabho |

na rocate kathā bhūmau pāpiṣṭhāya janāya vai |
vaiṣṇavī sa tu vijṣeyaḥ pāpiṣṭha-pravaro dvijaḥ ||7||
