vaiṣṇavānāṃ tvamagryo'si sarva-lokahiterataḥ ||3||
dhenūnāṃ tuśataṃ dattvāyatphalaṃ labhatenaraḥ |
tasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pratijṣāpālanedvija ||4||
pratijṣākhaṇḍanānmūḍhonirayaṃ yātidāruṇam |
śatamanvantar-aṃ yāvatpacyatenātrasaṃ śayaḥ ||5||
tato'trajanmacāsādyanirdhanasyaniketane |
annavastrairvihīnaḥ syākleśīcāpi svakarmaṇā ||6||
satyenaśapathaṃ kuryāddevāgnigurusannidhau |
tāvaddahativaigātraṃ viṣṇorvaṃ śonalupyate ||7||
mithyāyāṃ śapatheviprakimahaṃ vacmisāmpratam |
śatamanvantar-aṃ vipranirayaṃ mithyayākimu ||8||
nirmālyaṃ śrīhareḥ spṛṣṭvāsatyenamuni-puṅgava |
gṛhītvāpuruṣānsaptapacyatenirayeciram ||9||
kadācijjanmasamprāpyakuṣṭhīcapratijanmani |
satyenaivaṃ bhavedvipraanṛtevaikimucyate ||10||
yomartyodakṣiṇaṃ datvākaraṃ tatpratipālyate |
 tasya prāptirbhavetkṛṣṇaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ||11||
karaṃ dattvātuyomartyovacanasyacapālanam |
tāvannakuryātpitaraḥ prāpnuvanti cayātanām ||12||
svayaṃ tumuniśārdūlanirayaṃ cātidāruṇam |
uddhāraṃ koṭipuruṣairmṛtoyātinasaṃ śayaḥ ||13||
śaunaka uvāca—
kṛṣṇaprāptiḥ purākasyakarasyapratipālanāt |
dakṣiṇasya mune brūhi śrotum icchāmi sādarāt ||14||
sūta uvāca—
purākiṃ citpureśūdronāmnāsīdvīravikramaḥ |
bahvāśīpṛthulāṃ gaś ca bahuvaktātisuṃ daraḥ ||15||
dhanavānputravānsabhyovidvān sarva-janapriyaḥ |
viprāṇāmatithīnāṃ capūjakaḥ sarva-daivatu ||16||
pitṛbhaktodvija-śreṣṭhapratijṣāpālakaḥ sadā |
vācāṃ gurujanānāṃ capālakoharisevakaḥ ||17||
ekadāsuṃ darogehaṃ śvapacas tasya chadmanā |
prāptodhṛtvābrāhmaṇasyarūpaṃ vaitaruṇaḥ sudhīḥ ||18||
brāhmaṇa uvāca—
śṛṇumevacanaṃ dhīramamajāyāmṛtāśubhā |
kiGkaromikvagacchāmikathayādyānukaṃ payā ||19||
vivāhaṃ yojanaḥ kuryādbrāhmaṇaṃ caviśeṣataḥ |
kiṃ cadānaiḥ kiṃ catīrthaiḥ kiṃ yajṣairvratakoṭibhiḥ ||20||
itiśrutvātvasauvipraṃ coktavānvīravikramaḥ |
śṛṇumevacanaṃ brahmanbālāstimamakanyakā ||21||
yadicchātebhavedvipradāsyāmividhipūrvakam |
nayamedakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ dāsyāmicān yathā nahi ||22||
 tasya itadvacanaṃ śrutvājagrāhadakṣiṇaṃ karam |
śvapacoharṣayuktovaiprovācavacanaṃ tviti ||23||
brāhmaṇa uvāca—
kṛtvāśubhakṣaṇaṃ mahyaṃ dehikanyāṃ śubhānvitām |
vilaṃ bebahuvighnaṃ syāditiśāstreṣu niścitam ||24||
vīravikrama uvāca—
tubhyaṃ śvaḥ kanyakāṃ brahmandāsyāmināsticān yathā |
dakṣiṇaṃ cakaraṃ datvānakuryātpuruṣādhamaḥ ||25||
sūta uvāca—
brāhmaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaśarmāṇaṃ cāhūyākathayanmune |
purohitamidaṃ sarvaṃ provācasaṃ vidaṃ dvija ||26||
 kathaṃ viprāyatekanyāṃ śūdrāyadātumicchasi |
ajṣātāyākulīnāyanadadasvaviśeṣataḥ ||27||
ūcustajjātayaḥ sarvejanakādyāstapodhana |
asmākaṃ vacanaṃ tātaśṛṇuṣvavīravikrama ||28||
najṣāyatekulaṃ yasya deśagotradhanaṃ tathā |
śīlaṃ vayas tasya kanyāsvajanairnacadīyate ||29||
sa uvāca—dvija-śreṣṭhadattaṃ medakṣiṇaṃ karam |
kadācidan yathā kartuṃ naśaknomica sarva-thā ||30||
ityuktvātānsaviprāyakanyāṃ dātuṃ pracakrame |
dṛṣṭvetijṣātayaḥ sarvevismayamadbhutaṃ yayuḥ ||31||
satyaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvāśaṃ khacakragadādharaḥ |
āvirbabhūvasahasācāruhyagaruḍaṃ mune ||32||
śrībhagavān uvāca—
dhanyaṃ tecakulaṃ dharmodhanyastejananīpitā |
dhanyaṃ tevacanaṃ satyaṃ dhanyaṃ tedakṣiṇaṃ karam ||33||
dhanyaṃ karmmacatejanmatrailokyenaivavidyate |
evaṃ tekarmaṇāsādhocoddhāraṃ kuruṣekulam ||34||
sūta uvāca—
evaṃ bruvatiśrīkṛṣṇevimānaṃ svarṇanirmitam |
āgataṃ harigaṇairyuktaṃ sarva-tragaruḍadhvajam ||35||
 sarvaṃ tasya kulaṃ brahmansaśvapākapurohitam |
rathecāropayāmāsaśaṃ khapadmadharaḥ svayaṃ ||36||
gṛhītvātānhariḥ sarvāngatovaikuṃ ṭhamandiram |
 tatra tasthauciraṃ tecakṛtvābhogaṃ sudurllabham ||37||
vacanaṃ laṃ ghayedyastuyastuvādakṣiṇaṃ karam |
sakulonirayaṃ yātisatyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ||38||
tasyānnaṃ tujalaṃ brahmannagrāhyaṃ pitṛdaivataiḥ |
tyaktvādharmogṛhaṃ tasya bhītyāyātidvijottama ||39||
datvāśāṃ yojanaḥ kuryānnairāśyaṃ caiva mūḍhadhīḥ |
sasvakānkoṭipuruṣāngṛhītvānarakaṃ vrajet ||40||
vacanaṃ laṃ ghayedyastudharmas tasya vilaṃ ghati |
nṛpāgnitaskarairviprasatyaṃ satyaṃ suniścitam ||41||
svargottaramimaṃ samyakśrutvāsvargottaraṃ vrajet |
jīvanmuktastvihāmutrakṛṣṇākhyaṃ dhāmacottamam ||42||
|| iti śrīpādmemahā-purāṇebrahmakhaṃ ḍesūtaśaunakasaṃ vāde
ṣaḍiṃ vaśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||26||
|| iti svargottarāparanāmakaṃ brahmakhaṇḍaṃ sampūrṇam ||
(|| iti śrī pādme mahā-purāṇe caturthaṃ brahmakhaṇḍaṃ samāptam ||)



||atha śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcamaṃ pātālakhaṇḍaṃ ārabhyate||

|| śrī-gaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī-kuladevatāyai namaḥ ||
|| śrī-guru-caraṇāravindābhyāṃ namaḥ ||

(1)
prathamo'dhyāyaḥ

rāmāśvamedha-prakaraṇaṃ

nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayam udīrayet ||1||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ— -
śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahā-bhāga svarga-khaṇḍaṃ manoharam |
tvatto 'dhunāvadāyuṣmaṣchrīrāma-caritaṃ hinaḥ ||2||
sūta uvāca 
athaikadā dharādhāraṃ pṛṣṭavān bhujageśvaram |
vātsyāyano munivaraḥ kathām etāṃ sunirmalām ||3||
śrī-vātsyāyana uvāca 
śeṣāśeṣa-kathās tvatto jagat-sarga-layādikāḥ |
bhū-golaś ca kha-golaś ca jyotiś-cakra-vinirṇayaḥ ||4||
mahat-tattvādi-sṛṣṭīnāṃ pṛthak-tattva-vinirṇayaḥ |
nānā-rāja-caritrāṇi kathitāni tvayānagha ||5||
sūrya-vaṃśa-bhavānāṃ ca rājṣāṃ cāritram adbhutam |
tatrāneka-mahā-pāpa-harā rāma-kṛtā kathā ||6||
 tasya vīrasyarāmasyahayamedhakathāśrutā |
saṃkṣepato mayā tvattas tām icchāmi sa-vistarām ||7||
yā śrutā saṃsmṛtā coktā mahā-pātaka-hāriṇī |
cintitārtha-pradātrī ca bhakta-citta-pratoṣadā ||8||
śeṣa uvāca— 
dhanyo’si dvija-varya tvaṃ yasya te matir īdṛśī |
raghu-vīra-pada-dvandva-makaranda-spṛhāvatī ||9||
vadanti munayaḥ sarve sādhūnāṃ saṅgamaṃ varam |
yasmāt pāpa-kṣaya-karī raghunātha-kathā bhavet ||10||
tvayā me'nugrahaḥ sṛṣṭo yad rāmaḥ smāritaḥ punaḥ |
surāsura-kirīṭaugha-maṇi-nīrājitāṅghrikaḥ ||11||
rāvaṇāri-kathā-vārddhaumaśakomā dṛśaḥ kiyān |
yatra brahmādayo devā mohitā na vidanty api ||12||
tathāpi bho mayā tubhyaṃ vaktavyaṃ svīya-śaktitaḥ |
pakṣiṇaḥ sva-gatiṃ śritvā khe gacchanti suvistare ||13||
caritaṃ raghunāthasya śatakoṭi-pravistaram |
yeṣāṃ vai yādṛśī buddhis te vadanty eva tādṛśaṃ ||14||
raghunātha satī kīrtir mad-buddhiṃ nirmalīmasām |
kariṣyati sva-samparkāt kanakaṃ tv analo yathā ||15||
sūta uvāca 
ity uktvā taṃ munivaraṃ dhyāna-stimita-locanaḥ |
jṣānenālokayāṃ cakre kathāṃ lokottarāṃ śubhāṃ ||16||
gadgada-svara-saṃyukto mahā-harṣāṅkitāṅgakaḥ |
kathayāmāsa viśadāṃ kathāṃ dāśaratheḥ punaḥ ||17||
śeṣa uvāca— 
laṅkeśvare vinihate deva-dānava-duḥkhade |
apsaro-gaṇa-vaktrābja-candramaḥ kānti-hartari ||18||
surāḥ sarve sukhaṃ prāpur indra-prabhṛtayas tadā |
sukhaṃ prāptāḥ stutiṃ cakrur dāsavat praṇatiṃ gatāḥ ||19||
laṅkāyāṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya dharma-yuktaṃ vibhīṣaṇam |
sītayā sahito rāmaḥ puṣpakaṃ samupāśritaḥ ||20||
sugrīva-hanumat-sītā-lakṣmaṇaiḥ -saṃyutas tadā |
vibhīṣaṇo’pi sacivair anvagād viraho tsukaḥ ||21||
laṅkāṃ sa paśyan bahudhā bhagna-prākāra-toraṇām |
dṛṣṭvā 'śoka-vanaṃ tatra sītā-sthānaṃ mumūrccha ha ||22||
śiṃ śapāṃ s tatra vṛkṣāṃś ca puṣpitān korakair yutān |
rākṣasībhiḥ samākīrṇān mṛtābhir hanumad-bhayāt ||23||
itthaṃ sarvaṃ vilokyāśu rāmaḥ prāyāt purīṃ prati |
brahmādi-devaiḥ sahitaḥ svīya-svīya-vimānakaiḥ ||24||
deva-dundubhi-nirghoṣāṣ chṛṇvaṣ chrotra-sukhāvahān |
tathaivāpsarasāṃ nṛtyaiḥ pūjyamāno raghūttamaḥ ||25||
sītāyai darśayan mārge tīrthāny āśramavanti ca |
munīṃś ca muni-putrāṃś ca muni-patnīḥ pati-vratāḥ ||26||
yatra yatra kṛtāvāsāḥ pūrvaṃ rāmeṇa dhīmatā |
tān sarvān darśayāmāsa lakṣmaṇena samanvitaḥ ||27||
ity evandarśayaṃ s tasyai rāmo 'drākṣīt svakāṃ purīṃ |
tasyāḥ punaḥ samīpe tu nandi-grāmaṃ dadarśa ha ||28||
yatra vai bharato rājā pālayan dharmam āsthitaḥ |
bhrātur viyoga-janitaṃ duḥkha-cihnaṃ vahan bahu ||29||
garta-śāyī brahmacārī jaṭā-valkala-saṃyutaḥ |
kṛśāṅga-yaṣṭir duḥkhārtaḥ kurvan rāma-kathāṃ muhuḥ ||30||
yavān nam api no bhuṅkte jalaṃ pibati no muhuḥ |
udyantaṃ savitāraṃ yo namaskṛtya bravīti ca ||31||
jagan-netra-sura-svāmin hara me duṣkṛtaṃ mahat |
mad-arthe rāmacandro’pi jagat-pūjyo vanaṃ yayau ||32||
sītayā sukumārāṅgyā sevyamāno'ṭavīṃ gataḥ |
yā sītā puṣpa-paryaṅke vṛntam āsādya duḥkhitā ||33||
yā sītā ravi-santāpaṅkadāpi prāpa no satī |
mad-arthe jānakīsācapratyaraṇyaṃ bhramatyaho ||34||
yā sītā rāja-vṛndaiś ca na dṛṣṭā nayanaiḥ kadā |
sā sītā dṛśyate nūnaṃ kirātaiḥ kāla-rūpibhiḥ ||35||
yā sītā madhuraṃ tv annam bhojitā na bubhukṣati |
sā sītādya vanasthāni phalāni prārthayaty aho ||36||
ity evam anvahaṃ sūryam upasthāya vadaty adaḥ |
prātaḥ prātar mahā-rājo bharato rāma-vallabhaḥ ||37||
yaś cocyamānaḥ sacivaiḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhair budhaiḥ |
nīti-jṣaiḥ śāstra-nipuṇair iti provāca tān nṛpaḥ ||38||
amātyā durbhagaṃ māṃ kiṃ prabrūta puruṣādhamam |
mad-arthe me'grajo rāmo vanaṃ prāpyāvasīdati ||39||
durbhagasya mama prasvāḥ pāpa-mārjanam ādarāt |
karomi rāmacandrāṅghriṃ smāraṃ smāraṃ sumantriṇaḥ ||40||
dhanyā sumitrā sutarāṃ vīrasūḥ svapati priyā |
yasyās tanūjo rāmasya caraṇau sevate'nvaham ||41||
yatra grāme sthito nūnaṃ bharato bhrātṛ-vatsalaḥ |
vilāpaṃ prakaroty uccais taṃ grāmaṃ sa dadarśa ha ||42||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe raghunāthasya bharatāvāsa-nandi-grāma-darśano nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||

(2)
dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ 
śeṣa uvāca— 
atha tad-darśanotkaṇṭhā-vihvalī-kṛta-cetasā |
punaḥ punaḥ smṛto bhrātā bharato dhārmikāgraṇīḥ ||1||
uvāca ca hanūmantaṃ balavantaṃ samīrajam |
prasphurad-daśana-vyāja-candra-kānti-hatāndhakaḥ ||2||
śṛṇu vīra hanūmaṃs tvaṃ mad-giraṃ bhrātṛ-noditām |
cirantana-viyogena gadgadī-kṛta-vihvalām ||3||
gacchataṃ bhrātaraṃ vīra samīraṇa-tanūdbhava |
mad-viyoga-kṛśāṃ yaṣṭiṃ vapuṣo bibhrataṃ haṭhāt ||4||
yo valkalaṃ parīdhatte jaṭān dhatte śiroruhe |
phalānāṃ bhakṣaṇam api na kuryād virahāturaḥ ||5||
para-strī yasya māteva loṣṭavat kāṣcanaṃ punaḥ |
prajāḥ putrān ivodrakṣed bāndhavo mama dharma-vit ||6||
mad-viyoga-ja-duḥkhāgni-jvālā-dagdha-kalevaram |
madā gamana-sandeśa-payo-vṛṣṭyāśu siṣcatam ||7||
sītayā sahitaṃ rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇena samanvitam |
sugrīvādi-kapīndraiś ca rakṣobhiḥ sa vibhīṣaṇaiḥ ||8||
prāptaṃ nivedaya sukhāt puṣpakāsana-saṃsthitam |
ye na me so'nujaḥ śīghraṃ sukham eti mad-āgamāt ||9||
iti śrutvā tato vākyaṃ raghu-vīrasya dhīmataḥ |
jagāma bharatāvāsaṃ nandi-grāmaṃ nideśa-kṛt ||10||
gatvā sa nandi-grāmaṃ tu mantri-vṛddhaiḥ susaṃyatam |
bharataṃ bhrātṛ-viraha-klinnan dhīmān dadarśa ha ||11||
kathayantaṃ mantri-vṛddhān rāmacandra-kathānakam |
tadīya-padā pāthoja-makaranda-sunirbharaḥ ||12||
namaścakāra bharataṃ dharmaṃ mūrti-yutaṃ kila |
vidhātrā sakalāṃśena sattvenaiva vinirmitam ||13||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bharataḥ śīghraṃ pratyutthāya kṛtāṣjaliḥ |
svāgataṃ ceti hovāca rāmasya kuśalaṃ vada ||14||
ity evaṃ vadatas tasya bhujo dakṣiṇato'sphurat |
hṛdayāc ca gataḥ śoko harṣāsraiḥ pūritānanaḥ ||15||
vilokya tādṛśaṃ bhūpaṃ praty uvāca kapīśvaraḥ |
nikaṭe hi puraḥ prāptaṃ viddhi rāmaṃ sa lakṣmaṇam ||16||
rāmāgamana-sandeśāmṛta-sikta-kalevaraḥ |
prāpayad dharṣa-pūraṃ hi sahasrāsyo na vedmy aham ||17||
jagāda mama tan nāsti yat tubhyaṃ dīyate mayā |
dāso’smi janma-paryantaṃ rāma-sandeśa-hārakaḥ ||18||
vasiṣṭho’pi gṛhītvārghyaṃ mantri-vṛddhāḥ suharṣitāḥ |
jagmus te rāmacandraṃ ca hanumad-darśitādhvanā ||19||
dṛṣṭvā dūrāt samāyāntaṃ rāmacandraṃ manoramam |
puṣpakāsana-madhya-sthaṃ sa sītaṃ saha-lakṣmaṇam ||20||
rāmo ’pi dṛṣṭvā bharataṃ pāda-cāreṇa saṅgatam |
jaṭā-valkala-kaupīna-paridhāna-samanvitam ||21||
amātyān bhrātṛ-veṣeṇa samaveṣān jaṭā-dharān |
nityaṃ tapaḥ-kliṣṭatayā kṛśa-rūpān dadarśa ha ||22||
rāmo ’pi cintayāmāsa dṛṣṭvā vai tādṛśaṃ nṛpam |
aho daśarathasyāyaṃ rāja-rājasya dhīmataḥ ||23||
putraḥ padātir āyāti jaṭā-valkala-veṣa-bhṛt |
na duḥkhaṃ tādṛśaṃ me'nyadvanamadhyaga tasya hi ||24||
yādṛśaṃ mad-viyogena caitasya parivartate |
aho paśyata me bhrātā prāṇāt priyatamaḥ sakhā ||25||
śrutvā māṃ nikaṭe prāptaṃ mantri-vṛddhaiḥ suharṣitaiḥ |
draṣṭuṃ māṃ bharato 'bhyeti vasiṣṭhena samanvitaḥ ||26||
iti bruvan nara-patiḥ puṣpakān nabhaso’ṅgaṇāt |
vibhīṣaṇa-hanūmadbhyāṃ lakṣmaṇena kṛtādaraḥ ||27||
yānād avatatārāśu-virahāt klinna-mānasaḥ |
bhrātar bhrātaḥ punar bhrātar bhrātar bhrātar vadan muhuḥ ||28||
dṛṣṭvā samuttīrṇam imaṃ rāmacandraṃ surair yutam |
bharato bhrātṛ-viraha-klinnandhīmān dadarśa ha ||
harṣāśrūṇi pramuṣcaṃś ca daṇḍavat praṇanāma ha ||29||
raghunātho’pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍavat patitaṃ bhuvi |
utthāpya jagṛhe dorbhyāṃ harṣāloka-samanvitaḥ ||30||
utthāpito’pi hi bhṛśaṃ nodatiṣṭhad rudan muhuḥ |
rāmacandra-padāmbhoja-grahaṇāsakta-bāhu-bhṛt ||31||
bharata uvāca 
durācārasya duṣṭasya pāpino me kṛpāṃ kuru |
rāmacandra mahā-bāho kāruṇyāt karuṇā-nidhe ||32||
yas te videhajā-pāṇi-sparśaṃ krūram amanyata |
sa eva caraṇo rāma vane babhrāma mat-kṛte ||33||
ity uktvāśru-mukho dīnaḥ parirabhya punaḥ punaḥ |
prāṣjaliḥ puratas tasthau harṣa-vihvalitānanaḥ ||34||
raghunāthas tam anujaṃ pariṣvajya kṛpā-nidhiḥ |
praṇamya ca mahā-mantri-mukhyān āpṛcchya sādaram ||35||
bharatena samaṃ bhrātrā puṣpakāsanam āsthitaḥ |
sītāṃ dadarśa bharato bhrātṛ-patnīm aninditām ||36||
anasūyām ivātreḥ kiṃ lopāmudrāṃ ghaṭodbhuvaḥ |
pativratāṃ janakajām amanyata nanāma ca ||37||
mātaḥ kṣamasva yad aghaṃ mayā kṛtam abuddhinā |
tvat-sadṛśyaḥ pati-parāḥ sarveṣāṃ sādhu-kārikāḥ ||38||
jānakyāpi mahā-bhāgā devaraṃ vīkṣya sādaram |
āśīrbhir abhiyujyātha samapṛcchad anāmayam ||39||
vimāna-varam ārūḍhās te sarve nabhaso’ṅgaṇe |
kṣaṇād ālokayāṣcakre nikaṭe svapituḥ purīṃ ||40||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe rāmāśvamedhe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde 
rāma-rājadhānī-darśano nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||

(3)
tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ 

śeṣa uvāca— 
dṛṣṭvā rāmo rājadhānīṃ nija-loka-nivāsinīm |
jaharṣa matimān vīraś cira-darśana-lālasaḥ ||1||
bharato ’pi svakaṃ mitraṃ sumukhaṃ nagaraṃ prati |
preṣayāmāsa sacivaṃ nagarotsava-siddhaye ||2||
bharata uvāca 
kurvantu lokās tvaritaṃ raghunāthāgamotsavam |
mandire mandire ramyaṃ kṛta-kautuka-citrakam ||3||
vipāṃsukā rāja-mārgāś candana-drava-siṣcitāḥ |
prasūna-bhara-saṃkḷptā hṛṣṭa-puṣṭa-janāvṛtāḥ ||4||
vicitra-varṇa-dhvaja-bhā-citritākhila-svāṅgaṇāḥ |
meghāgame dhanur iva paśyantv eva valī-mukhāḥ ||5||
pratigehaṃ tu lokānāṃ kārayantv agarūkṣaṇam |
yad dhūmaṃ vīkṣya śikhino nṛtyaṃ kurvantu līlayā ||6||
hastino mama śailābhā nādhoraṇa-suyantritān |
vicitrayantu bahuśo gairikādy-upadhātubhiḥ ||7||
vājinaś citritā bhūyaḥ suśobhantu mano-javāḥ |
yad vega-vīkṣaṇād eva garvanty ajati-svar-hayaḥ ||8||
kanyāḥ sahasraśo ramyāḥ sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣitāḥ |
gajopari-samārūḍhā muktābhir vikirantu ca ||9||
brāhmaṇyaḥ pātra-hastāś ca dūrvā-hāridra-saṃyutāḥ |
suvāsinyo mahā-rājaṃ rāmaṃ nīrājayantu tāḥ ||10||
kausalyā-putra-saṃyoga-sandeśa-vidhurā satī |
harṣaṃ prāpnotu sukṛśā tad-īkṣaṇa-sulālasā ||11||
ity evam ādi-racanāḥ pura-śobhā-vidhāyikāḥ |
karotu janatā hṛṣṭā rāmasyāgamanaṃ prati ||12||
śeṣa uvāca— 
iti śrutvā tato vākyaṃ sumukho mantra-vittamaḥ |
prayayau nagarīṃ kartuṃ kṛta-kautuka-toraṇām ||13||
gatvātha nagarīṃ tāṃ vai mantrī tu sumukhābhidhaḥ |
khyāpayāmāsa lokānāṃ rāmāgama-mahotsavam ||14||
lokāḥ śrutvā purīṃ prāptaṃ raghunāthaṃ suharṣitāḥ |
pūrvaṃ tadīya-viraha-tyakta-bhoga-sukhādayaḥ ||15||
brāhmaṇā veda-sampannāḥ pavitrā darbha-pāṇayaḥ |
dhautottarīya-valitā jagmuḥ śrī-raghu-nāyakam ||16||
kṣatriyā ye śūratamā dhanur-bāṇa-dharā varāḥ |
saṅgrāme bahuśo vīrā jetāro yayur apy amum ||17||
vaiśyā dhana-samṛddhāś ca mudrā-śobhita-pāṇayaḥ |
śubhra-vastra-parīdhānā abhijagmur nareśvaram ||18||
śūdrā dvijeṣu ye bhaktāḥ svīyācāra-suniṣṭhitāḥ |
vedācāra-ratā ye vai te'pi jagmuḥ purī-patim ||19||
ye ye vṛtti-karā lokāḥ sve sve karmaṇy adhiṣṭhitāḥ |
svakaṃ vastu-samādāya yayuḥ śrī-rāma-bhūpatim ||20||
itthaṃ bhūpati-sandeśāt pramodāplava-saṃyutāḥ |
nānā-kautuka-saṃyuktā ājagmur manujeśvaram ||21||
śeṣa uvāca— 
raghunātho’pi sakalair daivataiḥ sva-sva-yānagaiḥ |
parītaḥ praviveśoccaiḥ purīṃ racita-mohanām ||22||
plavaṅgāḥ plavanair yuktā ākāśa-patha-cāriṇaḥ |
sva-sva-śobhā-parītāṅgāś cānujagmuḥ purottamam ||23||
puṣpakād avaruhyāśu nara-yānam athāruhat |
sītayā sahito rāmaḥ parivāra-samāvṛtaḥ ||24||
ayodhyāṃ praviveśātha kṛta-kautuka-toraṇām |
hṛṣṭa-puṣṭa-janākīrṇām utsavaiḥ parībhūṣitām ||25||
vīṇā-paṇava-bheryādi-vāditrair āhatair bhṛśam |
śobhamānaḥ stūyamānaḥ sūta-māgadha-vandibhiḥ ||26||
jaya rāghava rāmeti jaya sūrya-kulāṅgada |
jaya dāśarathe deva jayatāl loka-nāyakaḥ ||27||
iti śṛṇvan śubhāṃ vācampaurāṇāṃ harṣitāṅginām |
rāma-darśana-saṃjāta-pulakodbheda-śobhinām ||28||
praviveśa varaṃ mārgaṃ rathyā-catvara-bhūṣitam |
candanodaka-saṃsiktaṃ puṣpa-pallava-saṃyutam ||29||
tadā paurāṅganāḥ kāścid gavākṣa-bilam āśritāḥ |
raghunātha-svarūpekṣā-jāta-kāmā athābruvan ||30||
paurāṅganā ūcuḥ— 
dhanyā abhūvan bata bhilla-kanyā-
vaneṣu yā rāma-mukhāravindam |
sva-locanendīvarakair athāpiban
sva-bhāgya-saṃjāta-mahodayā imāḥ ||31||
dhanyaṃ mukhaṃ paśyata vīra-dhāmnaḥ
śrī-rāma-devasya saroja-netram |
yad-darśanaṃ dhātṛ-mukhāḥ surā api
prāpur mahad-bhāgya-yutā vayaṃ tv aho ||32||
etan mukhaṃ paśyata cāru-hāsaṃ 
kirīṭa-saṃśobhi-nijottamāṅgam |
bandhūka-dhik-kāra-lasac-chavi-pradaṃ 
danta-cchadaṃ bibhratam ucca-nāsam ||33||
iti gaditavatīs tāḥ sneha-bhāreṇa rāmā
nalina-dala-sadṛkṣair netra-pātair nirīkṣya |
nikhila-gurur anūna-prema-bhāraṃ nṛlokaṃ 
janani-gṛham iyeṣa proṣitāṅgena hṛṣṭaḥ ||34||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe 
raghunāthasya pura-praveśanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||


(4)
caturtho'dhyāyaḥ

vātsyāyana uvāca 
bhujagādhīśvareśāna dharā-bhāra-dhara-kṣama |
śṛṇv ekaṃ saṃśayaṃ mahyaṃ kṛpayā kathayasva tam ||1||
raghunāthasya gamanaṃ vanaṃ prati yadā hy abhūt |
tadā prabhṛti dehena sthitā śūnyena cetasā ||2||
tad-viprayoga-vidhurā kṛśa-dehāti-duḥkhitā |
sumukhān mantriṇaḥ śrutvā raghunāthaṃ samāgatam ||3||
kathaṃ jaharṣa kim abhūt kīdṛśaṃ tatra cihnitam |
rāmacandrasya sandeśa-hartāraṃ kim uvāca sā ||4||
etan me saṃśayaṃ chindhi raghunātha-guṇodayam |
yathāvac chṛṇvate mahyaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ ||5||
śeṣa uvāca— 
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahā-bhāga dvija-varya-puraskṛta |
tan me nigadataḥ sākṣāc chṛṇuṣvaika-manāḥ kila ||6||
sā vai tad-vadanāmbhoja-cyutaṃ rāmāgamāmṛtam |
pītvā pītvā babhūvāho sthagitāṅgena vihvalā ||7||
kiṃ me svapno vimūḍhāyāḥ kiṃ vā bhrama-karaṃ vacaḥ |
mama vai manda-bhāgyāyāḥ kathaṃ rāmekṣaṇaṃ punaḥ ||8||
bahunā tapasā kṛtvā prāpto'yaṃ vai sutaḥ śiśuḥ |
kenacin mama pāpena viprayogaṅgataḥ punaḥ ||9||
sumantrin kuśalī rāmaḥ sītā-lakṣmaṇa-saṃyutaḥ |
kathaṃ māṃ smarate vīro vanacārī suduḥkhitām ||10||
iti sā vilalāpoccai raghunātha-smṛtiṃ gatā |
nanivedanijaṃ kiṣcitparakīyaṃ vimohitā ||
sumukho’pi tathā dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitāṃ mātaraṃ bhṛśam ||11||
vījayāmāsavāsograiḥ saṃjṣāmāpacasāpunaḥ |
 uvāca jananīṃ saumyaṃ vacoharṣakaraṃ muhuḥ ||12||
raghunāthāgamasmārahṛṣṭāṃ tāṃ vyadadhātpunaḥ |
mātar viddhi gṛhaṃ prāptaṃ raghunāthaṃ sa-lakṣmaṇam ||13||
sītayāsahitaṃ paśyacāśīrbhir abhiyuṃ kṣvaca |
ititathyaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā sumukhenaprabhāṣitam ||14||
yādṛśaṃ harṣamāpede tādṛśaṃ vedmy ahamnahi |
utthāyacājireprāptāromāṃ citatanūruhā ||15||
harṣavihvalitāṃ gyaśrumuṣcaṃ tīrāmama ikṣata |
tāvatsarāmo rājendronarayānamadhiśritaḥ ||16||
prāptaḥ svamāturbhavanaṃ kaikeyyāḥ sunayaḥ puraḥ |
kaikeyyapitrapābhāranamrārāmaṃ puraḥ sthitam ||17||
novācakiṣcinmahatīṃ cintāṃ prāptavatīmuhuḥ |
sūryavaṃśadhvajorāmo mātaraṃ vīkṣyalajjitām ||18||
 uvāca sāṃ tvayaṃ stāṃ cavākyair vinayamiśritaiḥ |
śrī-rāma uvāca 
mātarmayā vanaṃ gatvā sarvamācaritaṃ tathā ||19||
adhunākaravaikiṃ vā tvadājṣātojananyaho |
mayā nyūnaṃ kṛtaṃ nāsti kathaṃ māṃ nekṣyasepunaḥ ||20||
āśīrbhir abhinandyainaṃ bharataṃ māṃ cavīkṣaya |
iti śrutvā pitad-vākyaṃ sānamravadanānagha ||21||
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ praty uvāca rāmagacchasvamālayam |
rāmo ’pi śrutvā vacanaṃ jananyāḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||22||
namaskṛtya yayaugehaṃ sumitrāyāḥ kṛpānidhiḥ |
sumitrāputrasahitaṃ rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahā-manāḥ ||23||
ciraṃ jīva ciraṃ jīva hy āśīrbhir iti cābhyadhāt |
mātuścarāmabhadro’pi caraṇaupraṇipatyaca ||24||
pariṣvajyamudāyuktojagādavacanaṃ punaḥ |
ratnagarbhemama bhrātrākenāpinakṛtaṃ tathā ||25||
 yathā yamakaroddhīmānmama duḥkhāpanodanam ||26||
rāvaṇenahṛtāsītāmayā yatprāpyatepunaḥ |
mātas tat sarvam āviddhi lakṣmaṇasya viceṣṭitam ||27||
dattāmāśiṣamāgṛhyaśirasāyaṃ sumitrayā |
nijamātuścabhavanaṃ prayayauvibudhair vṛtaḥ ||28||
mātaraṃ vīkṣyahṛṣitāṃ nijadarśanalālasām |
svayānādavaruhyāśucaraṇāvagrahīddhariḥ ||29||
mātātaddarśanotkaṇṭhāvihvalīkṛtamānasā |
pariṣvajyapariṣvajyarāmaṃ mudamavāpasā ||30||
śarīreromaharṣo'bhūdgadgadāvāgabhūttadā |
harṣāśrūṇitusoṣṇānipravāhaṃ prāpurāpadāt ||31||
jananīṃ vīkṣyavinayītāṭaṃ kadvayavarjitām |
karākalpapadākalparahitāṃ bibhratīṃ tanum ||32||
kiṣcitsvadarśanāddhṛṣṭāṃ kṛśāṃ gīṃ tāṃ saśokabhāk |
duḥkhasyasamayonāyamitimatvājagādatām ||33||
śrī-rāma uvāca 
mātarmayā tvaccaraṇaucirakālaṃ nasevitau |
tataḥ kṣamasvāparādhaṃ bhāgyahīnasya vaimama ||34||
yeputrāmātāpitrornaśuśrūṣāyāṃ samutsukāḥ |
te mantavyāḥ parāmātaḥ kīṭakāretasobhavāḥ ||35||
kiṃ kurvejanakājṣātogatovaidaṇḍakaṃ vanam |
tatrāpitvatkṛpāpāṃ gāttīrṇo’smi duḥkhasāgaram ||36||
rāvaṇenahṛtāsītālaṅkāyāṃ gamitāpunaḥ |
tvatkṛpātomayā labdhātaṃ hatvārākṣaseśvaram ||37||
sīteyaṃ tvaccaraṇayoḥ patitāvaipativratā |
sambhāvayāśucakitāṃ tvatpādārpitamānasām ||38||
iti śrutvā tutad-vākyaṃ pādayo ḥ patitāṃ snuṣām |
āśīrbhir abhiyujyaināṃ babhāṣetāṃ pativratām ||39||
sītesvapatināsārddhaṃ ciraṃ vilasabhāmini |
putrauprasūyacakulaṃ svakaṃ pāvayapāvane ||40||
tvatsadṛśyaḥ patiparāḥ patiduḥkhasukhānugāḥ |
bhavanti duḥkhabhāginyonahisatyaṃ jagattraye ||41||
videhaputrisvakulaṃ tvayāpāvitamātmanā |
rāmapādābjayugulamanuyāṃ tyāmahā-vanam ||42||
kiṣcitraṃ yatpumāṃ sastuvairikoṭiprabhaṣjanāḥ |
yeṣāṃ gehe satī bhāryā sva-pati-priya-vāṣchikā ||43||
ity uktvā raghunāthasya bhāryām aṣcita-locanām |
tūṣṇīṃ babhūva hṛṣitā prahṛṣṭa-sva-tanūruhā ||44||
atha bhrātāsya bharataḥ pitrā dattaṃ nijaṃ mahat |
rājyaṃ nivedayāmāsa rāmacandrāya dhīmate ||45||
mantriṇasteprahṛṣṭāṃ gādaivajṣānmantra-kovidān |
āhūyasumuhūrtaṃ tepapracchuḥ paramādarāt ||46||
śubhemuhūrtesudineśubhanakṣatra-saṃyute |
abhiṣekaṃ mahā-rājyekārayāmāsurudyatāḥ ||47||
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ vyāghracarmaṇisundare |
likhitvoparirājendromahā-rājodhitasthivān ||48||
taddinād eva sādhūnāṃ manāṃ sipramudaṃ yayuḥ |
duṣṭānāṃ cetasoglānirabhavatparatāpinām ||49||
striyas tu patibhaktyācapativrataparāyaṇāḥ |
manasāpikadāpāpaṃ nācaranti janā mune ||50||
daityādevās tathā nāgāyakṣāsuramaho ragāḥ |
sarve nyāyapathesthitvārāmājṣāṃ śirasādadhuḥ ||51||
paropakaraṇeyuktāḥ svadharmasukhanirvṛtāḥ |
vidyāvinodagamitādinarātrikṣaṇāḥ śubhāḥ ||52||
vāto’pi mārgasaṃsthānāṃ balānnāharatemahān |
vāsāṃ syapitusūkṣmāṇi tatra caurakathānahi ||53||
dhanadohyarthināṃ rāmaḥ kāruṇyaścakṛpānidhiḥ |
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito nityaṃ gurudevastutiṃ vyadhāt ||54||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe 
raghuvarasya rājyābhiṣeko nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||

(5)
paṣcamo'dhyāyaḥ 
śeṣa uvāca— 
athābhiṣiktaṃ rāmaṃ tu tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ surāḥ |
rāvaṇābhidha-daityendra-vadha-harṣita-mānasāḥ ||1||
devā ūcuḥ— 
jaya dāśarathe surārti-haṣ jaya jaya dānava-vaṃśa-dāhaka |
jaya deva-varāṃ ganāgaṇa-grahaṇa-vyagra-karāri-dāraka ||2||
tava yad-danujendra-nāśanaṃ kavayo varṇayituṃ samutsukāḥ |
pralaye jagatāṃ tatīḥ punar grasase tvaṃ bhuvaneśa līlayā ||3||
jaya janma-jarādi-duḥkhakaiḥ parimukta-prabaloddharoddhara |
jaya dharma-karānvayāmbudhau kṛta-janman na jarāmarācyuta ||4||
tava deva-varasya nāmabhir bahu-pāpā api te pavitritāḥ |
kim u sādhu-dvija-varya pūrvakāḥ su-tanuṃ mānuṣatām upāgatāḥ ||5||
hara-viriṣci-nutaṃ tava pādayor yugalam īpsita-kāma-samṛddhi-dam |
hṛdi pavitra-yavādika-cihnitaiḥ suracitaṃ manasā spṛhayāmahe ||6||
yadi bhavān na dadhāty abhayaṃ bhuvo 
madana-mūrti-tiraskara-kānti-bhṛt |
sura-gaṇā hi kathaṃ sukhinaḥ punar 
nanu bhavanti ghṛṇāmaya-pāvana ||7||
yadā yadāsmān danujāhi-duḥkhadās
tadā tadā tvaṃ bhuvi janma-bhāg bhaveḥ |
ajo'vyayo'pī śavaro’pi sanvibho
svabhāvam āsthāya nijaṃ nijārcitaḥ ||8||
mṛta-sudhā-sadṛśair agha-nāśanaiḥ sucaritair avakīrya-mahītalam |
amanujair guṇa-śaṃsibhir īḍitaḥ praviśa cāśu punar hi svakaṃ padam ||9||
anādir ādyo jara-rūpa-dhārī hārī kirīṭī-makara-dhvajābhaḥ |
jayaṃ karotu prasabhaṃ hatāriḥ smarāri-saṃsevita-pāda-padmaḥ ||10||
ity uktvā te surāḥ sarve brahmendra-pramukhā muhuḥ |
praṇemur ari-nāśena prīṇitā raghu-nāyakam ||11||
iti stutyātisaṃhṛṣṭo raghunātho mahā-yaśāḥ |
provāca tān surān vīkṣya praṇatān nata-kandharān ||12||
śrī-rāma uvāca 
surā vṛṇuta me yūyaṃ varaṃ kiṣcit sudurlabham |
yaṃ ko’pi devo danujo na yakṣaḥ prāpa sādaraḥ ||13||
surā ūcuḥ— 
svāmin bhagavataḥ sarvaṃ prāptam asmābhir uttamam |
yad ayaṃ nihataḥ śatrur asmākaṃ tu daśānanaḥ ||14||
yadā yadā'suro'smākaṃ bādhāṃ paridadhāti bhoḥ |
tadā tadeti kartavyam etāvad vairināśanam ||15||
tathety uktvā punar vīraḥ provāca raghunandanaḥ |
śrī-rāma uvāca 
surāḥ śṛṇuta mad-vākyaṃ ādareṇa samanvitāḥ ||16||
bhavat-kṛtaṃ madīyair vaiguṇair grathitam adbhutam |
stotraṃ paṭhiṣyati muhuḥ prātar niśi sakṛn naraḥ ||17||
tasya vairi-parābhūtir na bhaviṣyati dāruṇā |
na ca dāridrya-saṃyogo na ca vyādhi-parābhavau ||18||
madīya-caraṇa-dvandve bhaktis teṣāṃ tu bhūyasī |
bhaviṣyati mudā yukte svāṃ te puṃsāṃ tu pāṭhataḥ ||19||
ity uktvā so'bhavat tūṣṇīṃ naradeva-śiromaṇiḥ |
surāḥ sarve prahṛṣṭās te yayur lokaṃ svakaṃ svakaṃ ||20||
raghunātho’pi bhrātṝṃs tān pālayaṃs tātavad budhān |
prajāḥ putrān iva svīyāllāṃ layaṃ loka-nāyakaḥ ||21||
yasmiṣ chāsati-lokānāṃ nākāla-maraṇaṃ nṝṇām |
narogādiparābhūtirgṛheṣu camahīyasī ||22||
netiḥ kadāpi ddaśyetavairijaṃ bhayamevaca |
vṛkṣāḥ sadaivaphalinomahībhūyiṣṭhadhānyakā ||23||
putrapautraparīvārasanāthīkṛtajīvanāḥ |
kāṃ tāsaṃyogajasukhairnirastavirahaklamāḥ ||24||
nityaṃ śrī-raghunāthasya pādapadmakathotsukāḥ |
kadāpi paranindās uvāca steṣāṃ bhavanti na ||25||
kāravo’pi kadāpāpaṃ nācaranti manasyaho |
raghunāthakarāghātaduḥkhaśaṃ kābhiśaṃsinaḥ ||26||
sītāpatimukhālokaniścalībhūtalocanāḥ |

ṛṣīṇāṃ śāpato'vāpto daityatvandanujāntaka ||21||
tasyānugraha-kartā tvaṃ na tu hantā dvijanmanaḥ |
evaṃ saṃcintya mā bhūyo nijaṃ śocitum arhasi ||22||
iti śrutvā tato vākyaṃ rāmaḥ para-puraṣjayaḥ |
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ gadgada-svara-bhāṣitam ||23||
śrī-rāma uvāca 
pātakaṃ dvividhaṃ poktaṃ jṣātājṣātavibhedataḥ |
jṣātaṃ yad buddhi-pūrvaṃ hi ajṣātaṃ tad vivarjitam ||24||
buddhi-pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma-bhogenaiva vinaśyati |
naśyed anuśayād anyad idaṃ śāstra-viniścitam ||25||
kurvato buddhi-pūrvaṃ me brahma-hatyāṃ suninditām |
na me duḥkhāpanodāya sādhu-vādaḥ susaṃmataḥ ||26||
prabrūhi tādṛśaṃ mahyaṃ yādṛśaṃ pāpa-dāhakam |
vrataṃ dānaṃ makhaṃ kiṣcit tīrtham ārādhanaṃ mahat ||27||
yena me vimalākīrtir lokān vai pāvayiṣyati |
pāpācārāpta-kāluṣyān brahma-hatyā-hata-prabhān ||28||
śeṣa uvāca— 
ity uktavantaṃ taṃ rāmaṃ jagāda sa tapo-nidhiḥ |
surāsuranamanmaulimaṇinīrājitāṅghrikam ||29||
śṛṇu rāma mahā-vīra lokānugraha-kāraka |
viprahatyāpanodāyatavayadvacanaṃ bruve ||30||
sarvaṃ sapāpantara-tiyo'śvamedhaṃ yajetavai |
tasmāt tvaṃ yajaviśvātmanvājimedhenaśobhinā ||31||
saptataṃ turmahībhartrātvayāsādhyomanīṣiṇā |
mahā-samṛddhiyuktenamahā-balasuśālinā ||32||
savājimedhoviprāṇāṃ hatyāyāḥ pāpanodanaḥ |
kṛtavānyaṃ mahā-rājodilīpastavapūrvajaḥ ||33||
śatakratuḥ śataṃ kṛtvākratūnāṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ |
padamāpāmarāvatyāṃ devadaityasusevitam ||34||
manuścasagarorājāmaruttonahuṣātmajaḥ |
ete te pūrvajāḥ sarve yajṣaṃ kṛtvāpadaṃ gatāḥ ||35||
tasmāt tvaṃ kururājendrasamartho'sisamaṃ tataḥ |
bhrātarolokapālābhāvartante tavabhāvukāḥ ||36||
ity uktam ākarṇya muneḥ sa bhāgyavān
raghūttamo brāhmaṇa-ghāta-bhītaḥ |
papraccha yāge sumatiṃ cikīrṣan
vidhiṃ purāvit parigīyamānaḥ ||37||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde 
rāmāśvamedhe raghunāthasyāgastyopadeśo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||8||

(9)
navamo'dhyāyaḥ 

śrī-rāma uvāca 
kīdṛśo'śvas tatra bhāvyaḥ kovidhis tatra pūjane |
 kathaṃ vāśakyatekartuṃ kejeyās tatra vairiṇaḥ ||1||
agastya uvāca— 
gaṅgājalasamānenavarṇenavapuṣāśubhaḥ |
karṇeśyāmomukheraktaḥ pītaḥ pucchesulakṣitaḥ ||2||
manovegaḥ sarvagatiruccaiḥ śravassamaprabhaḥ |
vājimedhehayaḥ proktaḥ śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ||3||
vaiśākhapūrṇamāsyāṃ tupūjayitvā yathā vidhi |
patraṃ likhitvābhāletusvanāmabalacihnitam ||4||
mocanīyaḥ prayatnena rakṣakaiḥ parirakṣitaḥ |
 yatra gacchatiyajṣāśvas tatra gacchetsurakṣakaḥ ||5||
yastaṃ balānnibadhnātisvavīryabaladarpitaḥ |
tasmāt prasabhamāneyaḥ parirakṣākarair hayaḥ ||6||
kartrātāvatsuvidhināsthātavyaṃ niyamādi ha |
mṛgaśṛṅgadharobhūtvābrahmacaryasamanvitaḥ ||7||
vrataṃ pālayamānasyayāvadvarṣamatikramet |
tāvad dīnāṃ dhakṛpaṇāḥ paritoṣyādhanādibhiḥ ||8||
annaṃ tubahuśo deyaṃ dhanaṃ vābhūrimāriṣa |
yadyatprārthayatedhīmāṃ stattadevadadātihi ||9||
evaṃ prakurvataḥ karmayajṣaḥ sampūrṇatāṃ gataḥ |
karotisarva-pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ ripunāśana ||10||
tasmād bhavānsamartho'stikaraṇepālane'rcane |
kṛtvākīrtiṃ suvimalāṃ pāvayānyāṣjanānnṛpa ||11||
śrī-rāma uvāca 
vilokayadvijaśreṣṭhavājiśālāṃ mamādhunā |
tādṛśāḥ santi novāśvāḥ śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ ||12||
iti śrutvā tutad-vākyaṃ agastyaḥ karuṇākaraḥ |
uttasthauvīkṣamāṇo'yaṃ yāgārhānvājinaḥ śubhān ||13||
gatvā tha tatra śālāyāṃ rāmacandrasamanvitaḥ |
dadarśāśvānvicitrāṃ gānmanovegānmahā-balān ||14||
avanitalagatāḥ kiṃ vā jirājasyavaṃśyāḥ kimatharaghupatīnāmekataḥ kīrtipiṇḍāḥ |
kimidamamṛtarāśirvāharūpeṇasiṃ dhormuniritimanasoṃ tarvismayaṃ prāpapaśyan ||15||
ekataḥ śoṇadehānāṃ vājināṃ paṅktiruttamā |
ekataḥ śyāmakarṇāścakastūrīkāntisaprabhāḥ ||16||
ekataḥ kanakābhāścatvanyatonīlavarṇinaḥ |
ekataḥ śabalair varṇair viśiṣṭair vājibhir vṛtāḥ ||17||
evaṃ paśyanmuniḥ sarvānkautukāviṣṭamānasaḥ |
yayāvan yatra tāndraṣṭuṃ yāgayogyānhayānmuniḥ ||18||
dadarśa tatra śataśobaddhāṃ stādṛśavarṇakān |
dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpedesamunirharṣitāṃ gakaḥ ||19||
ekataḥ śyāmakarṇāṃś casarvāṃ gaiḥ kṣīrasannibhān |
pītapucchānmukheraktāṣchubhalakṣaṇalakṣitān ||20||
nirīkṣyaparito'naghānvimalanīradhārānibhānmanojavanaśobhitānvimalakīrtipuṣjaprabhān |
payonidhiviśoṣakomunir uvāca sītāpatiṃ vicitrahayadarśanāddhṛṣitanetravaktraprabhaḥ ||21||
agastya uvāca— 
hayamedhakratauyogyānvāhāṃ stebahuśaḥ śubhān |
paśyatonetrayorme'dyatṛptirnāstiraghūttama ||22||
rāmacandramahā-bhāgasurāsuranamaskṛta |
yajṣaṃ kurumahā-rājahayamedhaṃ suvistaram ||23||
surapatirivasarvānyajṣasaṅghānkariṣyaṃ stapanaivasuparvārātitoyaṃ viśoṣyan |
hataripugaṇamukhyaṃ sāṃ parāyaṃ vijityakṣititalasukhabhogaṃ kurvidaṃ bhūribhāga ||24||
ity evaṃ vākyavādenaparituṣṭākhilendriyaḥ |
sarvānvaiyajṣasambhārānājahāramanoharān ||25||
munyanvitomahā-rājaḥ sarayūtīramāgataḥ |
suvarṇalāṃ galairbhūmiṃ vicakarṣamahīyasīm ||26||
vilikhyabhūmiṃ bahuśaścaturyojanasaṃmitām |
maṇḍapān racayāmāsa yajṣārthaṃ sa narottamaḥ ||27||
kuṇḍaṃ tuvidhivatkṛtvāyonimekhalayānvitam |
anekaratnaracitaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam ||28||
munīśvaromahā-bhāgovasiṣṭhaḥ sumahā-tapāḥ |
sarvaṃ tatkārayāmāsavedaśāstravidhiśritam ||29||
preṣitāstenamunināśiṣyāmunivarāśramān |
kathayāmāsurudyuktaṃ hayamedheraghūttamam ||30||
ākāritāstadāsarve ṛṣayastapatāṃ varāḥ |
ājagmuḥ parameśasyadarśanetvatilālasāḥ ||31||
nāradositanāmācaparvataḥ kapilomuniḥ |
jātūkarṇyoṃ 'girāvyāsa ārṣṭiṣeṇo'trirāsuriḥ ||32||
hārītoyājṣavalkyaścasaṃvartaḥ śukasaṃjṣitaḥ |
ity evam ādayo rāmahayamedhavaraṃ yayuḥ ||33||
tān sarvān pūjayāmāsaraghurājomahā-manāḥ |
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ arghyaviṣṭarakādibhiḥ ||34||
gāṃ hiraṇyaṃ dadautebhyaḥ prāyaśodṛṣṭavikramaḥ |
mahadbhāgyaṃ tvadyame'stiyadyūyaṃ darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||35||
śeṣa uvāca— 
evaṃ samākulebrahmannṛṣivaryasamāgame |
dharmavārtābabhūvāhovarṇāśramasusaṃmatā ||36||
vātsyāyana uvāca 
kādharmavārtātatrāsītiṃ kavākathitamadbhutam |
sādhavaḥ sarva-lokānāṃ kāruṇyātkimutābruvan ||37||
śeṣa uvāca— 
tānsametānmunīndṛṣṭvā rāmo dāśarathirmahān |
papracchasarva-dharmāṃś casarvavarṇāśramocitān ||38||
tetupṛṣṭāhirāmeṇadharmān procurmahā-guṇān |
tān pravakṣyāmitesarvān yathā vidhiśṛṇuṣvatān ||39||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ— 
brāhmaṇenasadākāryaṃ yajanādhyayanādikam |
vedān paṭhitvāvirajonaivagārhasthyamāviśet ||40||
brāhmaṇenasadātyājyaṃ nīcasevānujīvanam |
āpadgato’pi jīvetanaśvavṛttyākadācana ||41||
ṛtukālābhigamanandharmo'yaṃ gṛhiṇaḥ paraḥ |
strīṇāṃ varamanusmṛtyā'patyakāmothavābhavet ||42||
divābhigamanaṃ puṃsām anāyuṣyakaraṃ matam |
śrāddhāhaḥ sarvaparvāṇiyatastyājyānidhīmatā ||43||
 tatra gacchetstriyaṃ mohāddharmātpracyavateparāt |
ṛtu-kālābhigāmī yaḥ sva-dāra-nirataś ca yaḥ ||44||
sarvadā brahmacārīha vijṣeyaḥ sa gṛhāśramī |
ṛtuḥ ṣoḍaśa-yāminyaś catasras tāsu garhitāḥ ||45||
putra-dās tāsu yā yugmā ayugmāḥ kanyakā-pradāḥ |
tyaktvā candramasaṃ duṣṭaṃ maghāṃ mūlaṃ vihāya ca ||46||
śuciḥ sannirviśet patnīṃ puṃ-nāmarkṣe viśeṣataḥ |
śuciṃ putraṃ prasūyeta puruṣārtha-prasādhanam ||47||
ārṣevivāhegodvandvaṃ yaduktaṃ tatpraśasyate |
śulkamaṇvapikanyāyāḥ kanyākretustupāpakṛt ||48||
vāṇijyaṃ nṛpateḥ sevāvedānadhyayanaṃ tathā |
kuvivāhaḥ kriyālopaḥ kulapātanahetavaḥ ||49||
annodakapayomūlaphalair vāpigṛhāśramī |
godānenatuyatpuṇyaṃ pātrāyavidhipūrvakam ||50||
anarcito'tithirgehādbhagnāśo yasya gacchati |
ājanmasaṃcitātpuṇyātkṣaṇātsahibahirbhavet ||51||
pitṛdevamanuṣyebhyodattvāśnītāmṛtaṃ gṛhī |
svārthaṃ pacatyaghaṃ bhuṃ ktekevalaṃ svodaraṃ bhariḥ ||52||
ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamyorviśetpāpaṃ tailemāṃ sesadaivahi |
caturdaśyāṃ tathā māyāṃ tyajetakṣuramaṃ ganām ||53||
rajasvalāṃ nasevetanāśnīyātsahabhāryayā |
ekavāsānabhuṃ jītanabhuṃ jītotkaṭāsane ||54||
nāśnantīṃ striyam īkṣeta tejaḥ-kāmo narottamaḥ |
mukhenopadhamen nāgniṃ nagnāṃ nekṣeta yoṣitam ||55||
nāṅghrī pratāpayed agnau na vas tv aśuci nikṣipet |
prāṇi-hiṃsāṃ na kurvīta nāśnīyāt sandhyayor dvayoḥ ||56||
nācakṣīta dhayantīṅgāṃ nendra-cāpaṃ pradarśayet |
na divodgata-sāraṃ ca bhakṣayed dadhino niśi ||57||
strīṃ dharmiṇīṃ nābhivāden nādyādā tṛptirātriṣu |
tauryatrika-priyo na syāt kāṃsye pādau na dhāvayet ||58||
na dhārayed anya-bhuktaṃ vāsaś copānahāv api |
nabhinnabhājane'śnīyānnāśnītānnaṃ vidūṣitam ||59||
saṃviśennārdracaraṇonocchiṣṭaḥ kvacidāvrajet |
śayānovānacāśnīyānnocchiṣṭaḥ saṃspṛśecchiraḥ ||60||
namanuṣyas tu tiṃ kuryānnātmānamavamānayet |
abhyudyataṃ napraṇametparamarmāṇinovadet ||61||
evaṃ gārhasthyamāśrityavānaprasthāśramaṃ vrajet |
sastrīkovāgatastrīkovirajyetatataḥ param ||62||
ity evam ādayo dharmāgaditāṛṣibhistadā |
śrutārāmeṇamahatāsarva-lokahitaiṣiṇā ||63||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe
sarva-dharmopadeśonāmanavamo'dhyāyaḥ

(10)
daśamo'dhyāyaḥ

śeṣa uvāca— 
itthaṃ saṃśṛṇvatodharmānvasantaḥ samupasthitaḥ |
yatra yajṣakriyādīnāṃ prāraṃ bhaḥ sumahātmanām ||1||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ samayaṃ dhīmānvasiṣṭhaḥ kalaśodbhavaḥ |
rāmacandraṃ mahā-rājaṃ praty uvāca yathocitam ||2||
vasiṣṭha uvāca——
rāmacandramahā-bāhosamayaḥ paryabhūttava |
hayo yatra pramucyetayajṣārthaṃ paripūjitaḥ ||3||
sāmagrīkriyatāṃ tatra āhūyaṃ tāṃ dvijottamāḥ |
karotu pūjāṃ bhagavān brāhmaṇānāṃ yathocitām ||4||
dīnāṃ dhakṛpaṇānāṃ cadānaṃ svāṃ tesamutthitam |
dadātuvidhivatteṣāṃ pratipūjyādhimānyaca ||5||
bhavānkanakasatpatnyādīkṣito'travrataṃ cara |
bhūmiśāyībrahmacārīvasubhogavivarjitaḥ ||6||
mṛgaśṛṅgadharaḥ kaṭyāṃ mekhalājinadaṇḍabhṛt |
karotuyajṣasambhāraṃ sarvadravyasamanvitam ||7||
iti śrutvā mahadvākyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya yathā rthakam |
 uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ dhīmānnānā-rthaparibṛṃhitam ||8||
śrī-rāma uvāca— 
śṛṇulakṣmaṇamadvākyaṃ śrutvā tatkurusatvaram |
hayamānayayatnena vājimedhakriyocitam ||9||
śeṣa uvāca— 
śrutvā vākyaṃ raghupateḥ śatrujil lakṣmaṇas tadā |
senāpatim uvācedaṃ vaco-vividha-varṇanam ||10||

vīrākarṇayamevacaḥ sumadhuraṃ śrutvā tvarātaḥ punaḥ |
kāryaṃ tatkṣitipālamaulimukuṭairghṛṣṭāṅghrirāmājṣayā ||
senāṃ kālabalaprabhaṣjanabalaprodyatsamarthāṃ ginīṃ |
sajjāṃ sadrathahastipattisuhayārohair vidhehyanvitām ||11||
sajjīyatāṃ vāyujavāsturaṃ gāstaraṅgamālālalitāṅghripātāḥ |
sadaśvacārairbahuśastradhāribhiḥ saṃrohitāvairibalaprahāribhiḥ ||12||
saṃlakṣyatāṃ hastinaḥ parvatābhā ādhoraṇaiḥ prāsakuṃ tāgrahastaiḥ |
śūraiḥ sāstrairbhūridānopahārāḥ kṣībāṇastesarva-śastrāstrapūrṇāḥ ||13||
vitata-bahu-samṛddhi-bhrājamānā rathā me 
pavanaja vana-vegair vājibhir yujyamānāḥ |
vividha-ripu-vināśa-smārakairā yudhāstrair
bhṛta-valabhi-vibhāgā nīyatāṃ sūta-vṛndaiḥ ||14||
pattayaḥ śataśomahyamāyāṃ tvastrāgnyapāṇayaḥ |
hayamedhārhavāhasyarakṣaṇevitato dyamāḥ ||15||
ityākarṇyavacas tasya lakṣmaṇasyamahātmanaḥ |
senānīkālajinnāmākārayāmāsasajjatām ||16||
daśa-dhruva-kamaṇḍitolaghu-suroma-śobhānvito 
vivikta-gala-śukti-bhṛd-vitata-kaṇṭha-kośe maṇiḥ |
mukhe viśada-kānti-dhṛttva-sita-kānti-bhṛt-karṇayor 
vyarājata tad āha yo dhṛta-karāgra-raśmi-cchaṭaḥ ||17||
kalāsaṃśobhitamukhaḥ sphuradratnaviśobhitaḥ |
muktāphalānāṃ mālābhiḥ śobhitoniryayauhayaḥ ||18||
śvetātapatraracitaḥ sitacāmaraśobhitaḥ |
bahuśo bhāparītāṃ goniryayauhayarāṭtataḥ ||19||
agratomadhyataścaikepṛṣṭhataḥ sainikās tathā |
devāhariṃ yathā pūrvaṃ sevaṃ tesevanocitam ||20||
athasainyaṃ samāhūyasarvamājṣāpayattadā |
hastyaśvarathapādātavṛndaiḥ subahusaṃkulam ||21||
tatastataḥ sametānāṃ sainyānāṃ śrūyatedhvaniḥ |
tato dundubhinādo'bhūt tasmin puravaretadā ||22||
tanninādenaśūrāṇāṃ priyeṇamahatātadā |
kaṃ panti giriśṛṅgāṇiprāsādāvicalanti ca ||23||
heṣāravomahā-nāsīdvājināṃ muhyatāṃ nṛpa |
rathāṃ gaghātasaṅghuṣṭādharāsaṃcalatīvasā ||24||
calitairgajayūthaiś ca pṛthvīruddhāsamaṃ tataḥ |
rajastupracalat tatra janāntarddhānamādadhāt ||25||
nirjagāmama hāsainyaṃ chatraiḥ saṃchādyabhāskaram |
senānyākālajinnāmnāpreritaṃ janasaṃkulam ||26||
garjaṃ tastalavīrāgryāḥ kurvanto raṇasambhramam |
raghunāthasyayāgāyasajjāsteprayayurmudā ||27||
mṛga-mada-mayam aṅgeṣv aṅga-rāgaṃ dadhānāḥ 
kusuma-vimala-mālā-śobhita-svottamāṅgāḥ |
mukuṭa-kaṭaka-bhūṣā-bhūṣitāṅgāḥ samastāḥ 
prayayur avani-nātha-preritās te'pi sarve ||28||
ity evaṃ te mahā-rājaṃ yayuḥ senācarāvarāḥ |
dhanurdharāḥ pāśadharāḥ khaḍgadhārāḥ sphuṭakramāḥ ||29||
evaṃśanaiḥ śanaiḥ prāptomaṇḍapaṃ yāgacihnitam |
hayaḥ khurakṣatatalāṃ bhūmiṃ kurvannabhaḥ plavan ||30||
rāmo dṛṣṭvā hariṃ prāptaṃ bahusaṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ |
vasiṣṭhaṃ prerayāmāsakriyākartavyatāṃ prati ||31||
vasiṣṭhorāmamāhūyasvarṇapatnīsamanvitam |
prayogaṃ kārayāmāsabrahma-hatyāpanodanam ||32||
brahmacaryavratadharomṛgaśṛṅgaparigrahaḥ |
tatkarmakārayāmāsarāmaḥ parapuraṃ jayaḥ ||33||
prārebheyāgakarmārthaṃ kuṇḍaṃ maṇḍapasaṃmitam |
tatrācāryobhavaddhīmānvedaśāstravicāravit ||34||
vasiṣṭhoraghunāthasyakulapūrvagururmuniḥ |
brahmaṃ statrācaradbrahmakarmāgastyastapo-nidhiḥ ||35||
vālmīkirmuniradhvaryurmuniḥ kaṇvastudvārapaḥ |
aṣṭaudvārāṇitatrāsansatoraṇaśubhānivai ||36||
dvāridvāridvayaṃ viprabrāhmaṇasyādhimantra-vit |
pūrvadvārimuniśreṣṭhaudevalāsitasaṃjṣitau ||37||
dakṣiṇadvāribhūmānaukaśyapātrītaponidhī |
paścimadvāriṛṣabhaujātūkarṇyo'thajājaliḥ ||38||
uttaradvāritumunīdvaudvitaikatatāpasau |
evandvāravidhiṃ kṛtvāvasiṣṭhaḥ kalaśodbhavaḥ ||39||

gāṃ vipraṃ canamaskuryāvaiṣṇavandharma-saṃyutam |

viṣṇuḥ sarveśvaraḥ sākṣī sarva-vyāpaka-deha-bhṛt |

svadharma-niratā ye ca tān namaskurv ihānvitān ||68||
śive viṣṇau na vābhedo na ca brahma-maheśayoḥ |
teṣāṃ pāda-rajaḥ-pūtaṃ vahāmy agha-vināśanam ||69||
gaurī-gaṅgā-mahā-lakṣmīr yasya nāsti pṛthaktayā |
te mantavyā narāḥ sarve svarga-lokād ihāgatāḥ ||70||
śaraṇāgata-rakṣī ca māna-dāna-parāyaṇaḥ |
yathā-śakti hareḥ prītyai sa jṣeyo vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ||71||
yasya nāma mahā-pāpa-rāśiṃ dahati satvaram |
tadīya-caraṇa-dvandve bhaktir yasya sa vaiṣṇavaḥ ||72||
indriyāṇi vaśe yeṣāṃ mano’pi hari-cintakam |
tān namaskṛtya pūyāt sa hy ājanma-maraṇāntikāt ||73||
para-striyaṃ tvaṃ karavālavat tyajan
bhaver yaśo-bhūṣaṇa-bhūti-bhūmiḥ |
evaṃ mamādeśaṃ athācaraṃś ca 
labheḥ paraṃ dhāma suyogam īḍyam ||74||

sarajobibhratīvāsoveṇībhūtāṃś camūrddhajān |
aṅgaṃ camalapaṅkenasaṃchannaṃ śabalastanam ||39||
āviveśa saras tatra mudā śiva-jalāśayam |
sāntaḥ sarasiveśmasthāḥ śatānidaśakanyakāḥ ||40||
sarvāḥ kiśoravayasodadarśotpalagandhayaḥ |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śīghramutthāyaprocuḥ prāṃ jalayaḥ striyaḥ ||41||
vayaṃ karmakarīstubhyaṃ śādhinaḥ karavāmakim |
snānenatāmahā-rheṇasnāpayitvāmanasvinīm ||42||
dukūlenirmalenūtnedadurasyaicamānada |
bhūṣaṇāniparārghyānivarīyāṃ sidyumanti ca ||43||
annaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ pānaṃ caivāmṛtāsavam |
athādarśesvamātmānaṃ sragviṇaṃ virajoṃ baram ||44||
tābhiḥ kṛtasvastyayanaṃ kanyābhir bahumānitam |
hāreṇacamahā-rheṇarucakena ca bhūṣitam ||45||
niṣkagrīvaṃ valayinaṃ kvaṇatkāṣcananūpuram |
śroṇyoradhyastayākāṃ cyākāṃ canyābahuratnayā ||46||
subhruvāsudatāśuklasnigdhāpāṅgena ca kṣuṣā |
padmakośaspṛdhānīlairalakaiś ca lasanmukhaṃ ||47||
yadāsasmāradayitamṛṣīṇāṃ vallabhaṃ patim |
 tatra cāstesahastrībhir yatrāstesamunīśvaraḥ ||48||
bhartuḥ purastādātmānaṃ strīsahasravṛtaṃ tadā |
niśāmyatadyogagatiṃ saṃśayaṃ pratyapadyata ||49||
satāṃ kṛtamalasnānāṃ vibhrājaṃ tīmapūrvavat |
ātmanobibhratīṃ rūpaṃ saṃvītarucirastanīm ||50||
vidyādharīsahasreṇasevyamānāṃ suvāsasam |
jātabhāvovimānaṃ tadārohayadamitrahan ||51||
 tasmin naluptamahimāpriyayānuṣakto |
vidyādharībhir upacīrṇavapurvimāne ||
babhrājautkacakumudgaṇavānapīcya |
stārābhir āvṛtaivoḍupatirnabhaḥ sthaḥ ||52||
tenāṣṭalokapavihārakulācalendra-
droṇīṣvanaṅgasakhamārutasaubhagāsu ||
siddhair nutodyudhunipāta śiva-svanāsu |
reme ciraṃ dhanadaval lalanā varūthī ||53||
vaiśrambhake sura-vane nandane puṣpa-bhadrake |
mānase caitrarathye ca sa reme rāmayā rataḥ ||54||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe
cyavanasya tapo-bhoga-varṇanaṃ nāma paṣcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ

(16)
ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ

sumatir uvāca—
evaṃ tayā krīḍamānaḥ sarvatra dharaṇī-tale |

tato jṣātvātha tad vipraḥ sva-kāla-parivartinīm |

sukanyayādharmapatnyāsvācārapariniṣṭhayā ||6||

tvayājarāgrastamasaṃmataṃ patiṃ |
vihāyajāraṃ bhajase'mumadhvagam ||9||
kathaṃ matis te'vagatān yathā satāṃ 
kula-prasūteḥ kula-dūṣaṇaṃ tv idam |
bibharṣi jāraṃ yad apatrapākulaṃ 
pituḥ svabhartuścana yasya dhastamām ||10||

 uvāca tātajāmātātavaiṣabhṛgunandanaḥ ||11||

apaṅktipāvanaudevaukurvāṇaṃ paṅktigocarau |
śakraṃ vajradharaṃ dṛṣṭvā muniḥ svahananodyatam ||15||
huṃ kāramakaroddhīmānstambhayāmāsatadbhujam |
indraḥ stabdhabhujas tatra dṛṣṭaḥ sarvaiś ca māna vai ḥ ||16||
kopenaśvasamāno'hir yathā mantraniyaṃ tritaḥ |
tuṣṭāvasamuniṃ śakraḥ stabdhabāhustapo-nidhim ||17||
aśvibhyāṃ bhāgadānaṃ cakurvantaṃ nirbhayāntaram |
kathayāmāsabhoḥ svāmindīyatāmaśvinorbaliḥ ||18||
mayā navāryatetātakṣamasvāghaṃ mahatkṛtam |
ity uktaḥ samuniḥ kopaṃ jahautūrṇaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ||19||
indromuktabhujo’py āsīttadānīṃ puruṣarṣabha |
etadvīkṣyajanāḥ sarve kautukāviṣṭamānasāḥ ||20||
śaśaṃsurbrāhmaṇabalaṃ tetudevādidurlabham |
tato rājābahudhanaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo'dadanmahān ||21||
cakrecāvabhṛthasnānaṃ yāgāṃ teśatrutāpanaḥ |
tvayāpṛṣṭaṃ yadācakṣvacyavanasyamaho dayam ||22||
samayā kathitaḥ sarvastapoyogasamanvitaḥ |
namaskṛtvātapomūrtimimaṃ prāpyajayāśiṣaḥ ||23||
preṣayatvaṃ sapatnīkaṃ rāmayajṣemanorame |
śeṣa uvāca— 
evaṃ tukurvatorvārtāṃ hayaḥ prāpāśramaṃ prati ||24||
vidadhadvāyuvegenapṛthvīṃ khuravilakṣitām |
dūrvāṃ kurānmukhāgreṇacaraṃ s tatra mahā-śrame ||25||
munayoyāvadādāyadarbhānasnātuṃ gatānadīm |
śatrughnaḥ śatrusenāyāstāpanaḥ śūrasaṃmataḥ ||26||
tāvatprāpamunervāsaṃcyavanasyātiśobhitam |
gatvā tadāśramevīrodadarśacyavanaṃ munim ||27||
sukanyāyāḥ samīpasthaṃ tapomūrtimivasthitam |
vavandecaraṇau tasya svābhidhāṃ samudāharan ||28||
śatrughnohaṃ raghupaterbhrātāvāhasya pālakaḥ ||29||
namaskaromiyuṣmabhyaṃ mahā-pāpopaśāntaye |
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyajagādamunisattamaḥ ||30||
śatrughnatavakalyāṇaṃ bhūyānnaravararṣabha |
yajṣaṃ pālayamānasyakīrtistevipulābhavet ||31||
citraṃ paśyatabhoviprārāmo ’pi makhakārakaḥ |
yannāmasmaraṇādīnikurvanti pāpa-nāśanam ||32||
mahā-pātaka-saṃyuktāḥ paradāraratānarāḥ |
yannāmasmaraṇodyuktāmuktāyāṃ tiparāṃ gatim ||33||
pādapadmasamutthenareṇunāgrāvamūrtibhṛt |
tat-kṣaṇād gautamārdhāṅgī jātā mohana-rūpa-dhṛk ||34||
māmakī yasya rūpasyadhyānenapremanirbharā |
sarvapātakarāśiṃ sādagdhvāprāptāsurūpatām ||35||
daityā yasya manohārirūpaṃ pradhanamaṇḍale |
paśyantaḥ prāpure tasya rūpaṃ vikṛtivarjitam ||36||
yoginodhyānaniṣṭhāyeyaṃ dhyātvāyogamāsthitāḥ |
saṃsārabhayanirmuktāḥ prayātāḥ paramaṃ padam ||37||
dhanyo'hamadyarāmasyamukhaṃ drakṣyāmiśobhanam |
payojadalanetrāntaṃ sunasaṃsubhrusūnnatam ||38||
sājihvāraghunāthasyanāmakīrtanamādarāt |
karotiviparītāyāphaṇinorasanāsamā ||39||
adyaprāptaṃ tapaḥ puṇyamadyapūrṇāmanorathāḥ |
yaddrakṣyerāmacandrasyamukhaṃ brahmādidurlabham ||40||
tatpādareṇunāsvāṃ gaṃ pavitraṃ vidadhāmyaham |
vicitrataravārtābhiḥ pāvayerasanāṃ svakām ||41||
ity ādirāmacaraṇasmaraṇaprabuddha-
premavrajaprasṛtagadgadavāgudaśruḥ ||
śrī-rāmacandraraghupuṅgavadharmamūrte |
bhaktānukaṃ pakasamuddharasaṃsṛtermām ||42||
jalpannaśrukalāpūrṇomunīnāṃ puratas tadā |
nājṣāsīt tatra pārakyaṃ nijaṃ dhyānenasaṃsthitaḥ ||43||
śatrughnastaṃ muniṃ prāhasvāminnomakhasattamaḥ |
kriyatāṃ bhavatāpādarajasāsupavitritaḥ ||44||
mahadbhāgyaṃ raghupateryadyuṣmanmānasāntare |
tiṣṭhaty asaumahā-bāhuḥ sarva-lokasupūjitaḥ ||45||
ity uktaḥ saparīvāraḥ sarvāgniparisaṃvṛtaḥ |
jagāmacyavanas tatra pramodahradasamplutaḥ ||46||
hanūmāṃ staṃ padāyāntaṃ rāmabhaktamavekṣya ha |
śatrughnaṃ nijagādāsauvacovinaya-saṃyutaḥ ||47||
svāminkathayasitvaṃ cenmahā-puruṣasundaram |
rāmabhaktaṃ munivaraṃ nayāmisvapurīṃ aham ||48||
iti śrutvā mahadvākyaṃ kapivīrasyaśatruhā |
ādideśahanūmantaṃ gacchaprāpayataṃ munim ||49||
hanūmāṃ staṃ muniṃ svīyepṛṣṭha āropyavegavān |
sakuṭuṃ baṃ nināyāśuvāyuḥ khaivasarvagaḥ ||50||
āgataṃ taṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ |
arghyapādyādikaṃ cakreprītaḥ praṇayavihvalaḥ ||51||
dhanyo’smi munivar yasya darśanenatavādhunā |
pavitritomakhomahyaṃ sarvasambhārasambhṛtaḥ ||52||
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyacyavanomunisattamaḥ |
 uvāca premanirbhinnapulakāṃ go'tinirvṛtaḥ ||53||
svāminbrahmaṇyadevasyatavavāḍavapūjanam |
yuktamevamahā-rājadharmamārgaṃ prarakṣituḥ ||54||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe
cyavanāśrame haya-gamano nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16||

(17)

saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ

śeṣa uvāca— 
śatrughnaś cyavanasyātha dṛṣṭvā 'cintyaṃ tapo-balam |
praśaśaṃsa tapo brāhmaṃ sarva-lokaika-vanditam ||1||
aho paśyata yogasya siddhiṃ brāhmaṇa sattame |
yaḥ kṣaṇād eva duṣprāpaṃ tad-vimānam acīkarat ||2||
kva bhoga-siddhir mahatī munīnām amalātmanām |
kva tapo-bala-hīnānāṃ bhogecchā manujātmanām ||3||
iti svagatam āśaṃsaṣ chatrughnaś cyavanāśrame |
kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā jalaṃ pītvā sukha-sambhogam āptavān ||4||
hayas tasyāḥ payoṣṇy-ākhyā nadyāḥ puṇya-jalātmanaḥ |
payaḥ pītvā yayau mārge vāyu-vega-gatir mahān ||5||
yodhās tan-nirgamaṃ dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭhato'nuyayus tadā |
hastibhiḥ pattibhiḥ kecid rathaiḥ kecana vājibhiḥ ||6||
śatrughno'mātya-varyeṇa sumatyākhyena saṃyutaḥ |
pṛṣṭhato'nujagāmāśu rathena haya-śobhinā ||7||
gacchan vājī-puraṃ prāpto vimalākhyasya bhūpateḥ |
ratnātaṭākhyaṃ ca janair hṛṣṭa-puṣṭaiḥ samākulam ||8||
sa sevakād upaśrutya raghunātha-hayottamam |
puro’ntike hi samprāptaṃ sarva-yodha-samanvitam ||9||
tadā gajānāṃ saptatyā candra-varṇa-samānayā |
aśvānām ayutaiḥ sārdhaṃ rathānāṃ kāṣcana-tviṣām ||10||
sahasreṇa ca saṃyuktaḥ śatrughnaṃ pratijagmivān |
śatrughnaṃ sa namaskṛtya sarvān prāptān mahā-rathān ||11||
vasukośaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ rājyaṃ tasmai nivedya ca |
kiṃ karomīti rājā taṃ jagāda purataḥ sthitaḥ ||12||
rājāpi taṃ svīya-pade praṇamraṃ
dorbhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ sampariṣasvaje mahān |
jagāma sākaṃ tanaye sva-rājyaṃ 
nikṣipya sarvaṃ bahudhanvibhir vṛtaḥ ||13||
rāmacandrābhidhāṃ śrutvā sarva-śruti-manoharām |
sarve praṇamya taṃ vāhaṃ dadur vasu-mahā-dhanam ||14||
rājānaṃ pūjayitvā tu śatrughnaḥ parayā mudā |
senayā sahito 'gacchad vājinaḥ pṛṣṭhatas tadā ||15||
evaṃ sa gacchaṃs tan-mārge parvatāgryaṃ dadarśa ha |
sphāṭikaiḥ kānakai raupyai rājitaṃ prastha-rājibhiḥ ||16||
jala-nirjhara-saṃhrādaṃ nānā-dhātuka-bhū-talam |
gairikādika-sad-dhātu-lākṣā-raṅga-virājitam ||17||
yatra siddhāṃ ganāḥ siddhaiḥ saṃkrīḍanty akutobhayāḥ |
gandharvāpsaraso nāgā yatra krīḍanti līlayā ||18||
gaṅgā-taraṅga-saṃsparśa-śīta-vāyu-niṣevitam |
vīṇāraṇaddhaṃ saśuka-kvaṇa-sundara-śobhitam ||19||
parvataṃ vīkṣya śatrughna uvāca sumatiṃ tv idam |
tad-darśana-samudbhūta-vismayāviṣṭa-mānasaḥ ||20||
ko'yaṃ mahā-giri-varo vismāpayati me manaḥ |
mahā-rajata-sat-prastho mārge rājati me'dbhutaḥ ||21||
atra kiṃ devatā-vāso devānāṃ krīḍana-sthalam |
yad etan manasaḥ kṣobhaṃ karoti śrī-samuccayaiḥ ||22||
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya jagāda sumatis tadā |
vakṣyamāṇa-guṇāgāra-rāmacandra-padābja-dhīḥ ||23||
nīlo'yaṃ parvato rājan purato bhāti bhūmipa |
manoharair mahā-śṛṅgaiḥ sphāṭikāgraiḥ samantataḥ ||24||
enaṃ paśyanti no pāpāḥ para-dāra-ratā narāḥ |
viṣṇor guṇa-gaṇān ye vai na manyante narādhamāḥ ||25||
śruti-smṛti-samutthaṃ ye dharmaṃ sadbhiḥ susādhitam |
na manyante sva-buddhi-stha-hetu-vāda-vicāraṇāḥ ||26||
nīlī-vikraya-kartāro lākṣā-vikraya-kārakāḥ |
yo brāhmaṇo ghṛtādīni vikrīṇāti surāpakaḥ ||27||
kanyāṃ rūpeṇa sampannāṃ na dadyāt kula-śīline |
vikrīṇāti dravya-lobhāt pitā pāpena mohitaḥ ||28||
patnīṃ dūṣayate yas tu kula-śīlavatīṃ naraḥ |
svayam evātti madhuraṃ bandhubhyo na dadāti yaḥ ||29||
bhojane brāhmaṇārthe ca pāka-bhedaṃ karoti yaḥ |
kṛsaraṃ pāyasaṃ vāpi nārthinaṃ dāpayet kudhīḥ ||30||
atithīn avamanyante sūrya-tāpādi-tāpitān |
antarikṣa-bhujo ye ca ye ca viśvāsa-ghātakāḥ ||31||
na paśyanti mahā-rāja raghunātha-parāṅmukhāḥ |
asau puṇyo giri-varaḥ puruṣottama-śobhitaḥ ||32||
pavitrayati sarvān no darśanena manoharaḥ |
atra tiṣṭhati devānāṃ mukuṭair arcitāṅghrikaḥ ||33||
puṇyavadbhir darśanārhaḥ puṇyadaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
śrutayo neti netīti bruvāṇā na vidanti yam ||34||
yat-pāda-raja indrādi-devair mṛgyaṃ sudurlabham |
vedāntādibhir anyūnair vākyair vidanti yaṃ budhāḥ ||35||
so'tra śrīmān nīla-śaile vasate puruṣottamaḥ |
āruhyataṃ namaskṛtya sampūjya sukṛtādinā ||36||
naivedyaṃ bhakṣayitvā vai bhūpa bhūyāc caturbhujaḥ |
atrāpy udāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam ||37||
taṃ śṛṇuṣva mahā-rāja sarvāścarya-samanvitam |
ratna-grīvasya nṛpater yad vṛttaṃ sa kuṭumbinaḥ ||38||
caturbhujādikaṃ prāptaṃ deva-dānava-durlabham |
āsīt kāṣcī mahā-rāja-purī lokeṣu viśrutā ||39||
mahā-jana-parīvāra-samṛddha-bala-vāhanā |
yasyāṃ vasanti viprāgryāḥ ṣaṭ-karma-niratā bhṛśam ||40||
sarva-bhūta-hite yuktā rāma-bhaktiṣu lālasāḥ |
kṣatriyāraṇakartāraḥ saṅgrāme'pyapalāyinaḥ ||41||
paradāraparadravyaparadrohaparāṅmukhāḥ |
vaiśyāḥ kusīdakṛṣyādivāṇijyaśubhavṛttayaḥ ||42||
kurvanti raghunāthasya padāmbhoje ratiṃ sadā |
śūdrā brāhmaṇa-sevābhir gata-rātri-dināntarāḥ ||43||
kurvanti kathanaṃ rāma rāmeti rasanāgrataḥ |
prākṛtāḥ ke'pi no pāpaṃ kurvanti manasātra vai ||44||
dānaṃ dayā-damaḥ satyaṃ tatra tiṣṭhanti nityaśaḥ |
vadate na parābādhaṃ vākyaṃ ko’pi naro'naghaḥ ||45||
na pārakye dhane lobhaṃ kurvanti nahi pātakam |
evaṃ prajā mahā-rāja ratna-grīveṇa pālyate ||46||
ṣaṣṭhāṃ śaṃ tatra gṛhṇāti nānyaṃ lobha-vivarjitaḥ |
evaṃ pālayamānasya prajā dharmeṇa bhūpateḥ ||47||
gatāni bahuvarṣāṇi sarva-bhoga-vilāsinaḥ |
viśālākṣīṃ mahā-rāja ekadā hy ūcivān idam ||48||
pativratāṃ dharma-patnīṃ pati-vrata-parāyaṇām |
putrā jātā viśālākṣi prajā-rakṣā-dhurandharāḥ ||49||
parīvāro mahān mahyaṃ vartate vigata-jvaraḥ |
hastino mama śailābhā vājinaḥ pavanopamāḥ ||50||
rathāś ca suhayair yuktā vartante mama nityaśaḥ |
mahā-viṣṇu-prasādena kiṣcin nyūnaṃ mamāsti na ||51||
evaṃ manorathas tv ekas tiṣṭhate mānase mama |
paraṃ tīrthaṃ mayā nādya kṛtaṃ parama-śobhane ||52||
garbha-vāsa-virāmāya kṣamaṃ govinda-śobhitam |
vṛddho jāto'smy ahaṃ tāvad valī-palita-dehavān ||53||
kariṣyāmi manohāri-tīrtha-sevanam ādṛtaḥ |
yo naro janma-paryantaṃ svodarasya prapūrakaḥ ||54||
na karoti hareḥ pūjāṃ sa naro go-vṛṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tasmād gacchāmi bho bhadre tīrtha-yātrāṃ prati priye ||55||
sakuṭuṃ baḥ suten yasya dhuraṃ rāj yasya nirbhṛtām |
itivyavasyasandhyāyāṃ hariṃ dhyāyanniśāntare ||56||
adrākṣītsvapnamapyekaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tāpasaṃvaram |
prātarutthāyarājāsaukṛtvāsandhyādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||57||
sabhāṃ mantrijanaiḥ sārddhaṃ sukhamāsedivānmahān |
tāvadvipraṃ dadarśāthatāpasaṃkṛśadehinam ||58||
jaṭāvalkalakaupīnadhāriṇaṃ daṇḍapāṇinam |
anekatīrthasevābhiḥ kṛtapuṇyakalevaram ||59||
rājātaṃ vīkṣyaśirasāpraṇanāmama hābhujaḥ |
arghyapādyādikaṃ cakreprahṛṣṭātmāmahīpatiḥ ||60||
sukhopaviṣṭaṃ viśrāntaṃ papracchaviditaṃ dvijam |
svāmiṃ stvaddarśanānme'dyagataṃ dehasya pātakam ||61||
mahāṃ taḥ kṛpaṇān pātuṃ yāṃ titadgehamādarāt |
tasmāt kathayabhovipravṛddhasyamama samprati ||62||
kodevo garbhanāśāyakiṃ tīrthaṃ cakṣamaṃ bhavet |
yūyaṃ sarvagatāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ samādhidhyānatatparāḥ ||63||
sarva-tīrthāvagāhenakṛtapuṇyātmano'malāḥ |
 yathā vacchṛṇvatemahyaṃ śraddadhānāyavistarāt ||64||
kathayasva prasādenasarva-tīrthavicakṣaṇa |
brāhmaṇa uvāca——
śṛṇurājendravakṣyāmiyatpṛṣṭaṃ tīrthasevanam ||65||
kasyadevasyakṛpayā garbhanirvāraṇaṃ bhavet |
sevyaḥ śrī-rāmacandro'sausaṃsārajvaranāśakaḥ ||66||
pūjyaḥ sa evabhagavān puruṣottamasaṃjṣakaḥ |
nānā-puryomayā dṛṣṭāḥ sarva-pāpa-kṣayaṃ karāḥ ||67||
ayodhyāsarayūstāpī tathā dvāraṃ hareḥ param |
avaṃ tīvimalākāṃ cīrevāsāgaragāminī ||68||
gokarṇaṃ hāṭakākhyaṃ cahatyākoṭivināśanam |
mallikākhyomahā-śailomokṣadaḥ paśyatāṃ nṛṇām ||69||
yatrāṃ geṣu nṛṇāṃ toyaṃ śyāmaṃ vānirmalaṃ bhavet |
pātakasyāpahārīdaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tutīrthakam ||70||
mayā dvāravatīdṛṣṭāsurāsuraniṣevitā |
gomatī yatra vahatisākṣādbrahmajalāśubhā ||71||
 yatra svāpolayaḥ proktomṛtirmokṣaiti śrutiḥ |
yasyāṃ saṃvasatāṃ nṝṇāṃ nakaliḥ prabhavetkvacit ||72||
cakrāṃ kā yatra pāṣāṇāmānavā apicakriṇaḥ |
paśavaḥ kīṭapakṣyādyāḥ sarve cakraśarīriṇaḥ ||73||
trivikramovasedyasyāṃ sarva-lokaikapālakaḥ |
sāpurītumahā-puṇyairmayā dṛggocarīkṛtā ||74||
kurukṣetraṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ sarvahatyāpanodanam |
syamaṃ tapaṣcakaṃ yatra mahā-pātakanāśanam ||75||
vārāṇasīmayā dṛṣṭāviśvanāthakṛtālayā |
yatropadiśatemantraṃ tārakaṃ brahmasaṃjṣitam ||76||
yasyāṃ mṛtāḥ kīṭapataṃ gabhṛṅgāḥ |
paśvādayo vāsurayonayovā ||
svakarmasambhogasukhaṃ vihāya |
gacchanti kailāsamatītaduḥkhāḥ ||77||
maṇikarṇir yatra tīrthaṃ yasyāmuttaravāhinī |
karotisaṃsṛterbandhacchedaṃ pāpakṛtāmapi ||78||
kapardinaḥ kuṇḍalinaḥ sarpabhūṣādharāvarāḥ |
gajacarmaparīdhānāvasanti gataduḥkhakāḥ ||79||
kālabhairavanāmātrakaroti yamaśāsanam |
na karoti nṛṇāṃ vārtāṃ yamodaṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ ||80||
etādṛśīmayā dṛṣṭākāśīviśveśvarāṅkitā |
anekāny api tīrthāni mayā dṛṣṭāni bhūmipa ||81||
param ekaṃ mahac citraṃ yad dṛṣṭaṃ nīla-parvate |
puruṣottama-sānnidhye tan na kvāpy akṣi-gocaram ||82||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe
brāhmaṇa-samāgamo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||17||

(18)
aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ

brāhmaṇa uvāca——
rājaṃs tvaṃ śṛṇu yad vṛttaṃ nīle parvata-sattame |
yacchraddadhānāḥ puruṣāyāṃ tibrahmasanātanam ||1||
mayā paryaṭatā tatra gataṃ nīlābhidhegirau |
gaṅgāsāgaratoyenakṣālitaprāṃ gaṇemuhuḥ ||2||
tatra bhillā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ parvatāgre dhanur-bhṛtaḥ |
caturbhujāmūlaphalairbhakṣyairnirvāhitaklamāḥ ||3||
tadāmemanasikṣipraṃ saṃśayaḥ sumahā-nabhūt |
caturbhujāḥ kimetevaidhanurbāṇadharānarāḥ ||4||
vaikuṇṭhavāsināṃ rūpaṃ dṛśyatevijitātmanām |
kathametairupālabdhaṃ brahmādyairapidurlabham ||5||
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgapadmollasitapāṇayaḥ |
vanamālāparītāṅgāviṣṇubhaktāivāntike ||6||
saṃśayāviṣṭacittenamayā pṛṣṭaṃ tadānṛpa |
yūyaṃ kebatayuṣmābhir labdhaṃ cāturbhujaṃ katham ||7||
tadātairbahuhāsyaṃ tukṛtvāmāṃ pratibhāṣitam |
brāhmaṇo'yaṃ najānātipiṇḍamāhātmyaṃ adbhutam ||8||
iti śrutvā 'vadaṃ cāhaṃ kaḥ piṇḍaḥ kasyadīyate |
tanmama brūtadharmiṣṭhāścaturbhujaśarīriṇaḥ ||9||
tadāmadvākyaṃ ākarṇyakathitaṃ tairmahātmabhiḥ |
sarvaṃ tatra tuyadvṛttaṃ caturbhujabhavādikam ||10||
kirātā ūcuḥ—— 
śṛṇubrāhmaṇavṛttāntamasmākaṃ pṛthukaḥ śiśuḥ |
nityaṃ jaṃ būphalādīnibhakṣayankrīḍayācaran ||11||
ekadāramamāṇastugiriśṛṅgaṃ manoramam |
samārurohaśiśubhiḥ samaṃ tātparivāritaḥ ||12||
tadā tatra dadarśāhaṃ devāyatanamadbhutam |
gārutmatādimaṇibhiḥ khacitaṃ svarṇabhittikam ||13||
svakāṃ tyātimiraśreṇīṃ dārayadravivadbhṛśam |
dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpedekimidaṃ kasya vaigṛham ||14||
gatvā vilokayāmītikimidaṃ mahatāṃ padam |
itisaṃcintyagehāntarjagāmabahubhāgyataḥ ||15||
dadarśa tatra deveśaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam |
kirīṭahārakeyūragraiveyādyair virājitam ||16||
manoharāvataṃ saucadhārayaṃ taṃ sunirmalau |
pādapadmetulasikāgandhamattaṣaḍaṅghrike ||17||
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgapadmādyairmūrti-saṃyutaiḥ |
upāsitāṅghriṃ śrī-mūrtiṃ nāradādyaiḥ susevitam ||18||
kecidgāyanti nṛtyanti hasanti paramādbhutam |
prīṇayanti mahā-rājaṃ sarva-lokaikavanditam ||19||
hariṃ vīkṣyamadīyorbhas tatra saṃjagmivānmune |
devās tatra vidhāyoccaiḥ pūjāṃ dhūpādisaṃyatām ||20||
naivedyaṃ śrī-priyasyārthekṛtvānīrājanantataḥ |
jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ rājankṛpāṃ paśyaṃ ta ādarāt ||21||
mahā-bhāgyavaśāttenaprāptaṃ naivedyasikthakam |
patitaṃ brahmadevādyairdurlabhaṃ suramānuṣaiḥ ||22||
tadbhakṣaṇaṃ cakṛtvāthośrī-mūrtimavalokyaca |
caturbhujatvamāptaṃ vaipṛthukenasuśobhinā ||23||
tadāsmābhir gṛhaṃ prāptobālakovīkṣitomuhuḥ |
caturbhujatvaṃ samprāptaḥ śaṅkhacakrādidhārakaḥ ||24||
asmābhiḥ pṛṣṭame tasya kimetajjātamadbhutam |
tadāprovāca naḥ sarvānbālakaḥ paramādbhutam ||25||
śikharāgregataḥ pūrvaṃ tatra dṛṣṭaḥ sureśvaraḥ |
 tatra naivedyasikthaṃ tumayā prāptaṃ manoharam ||26||
 tasya bhakṣaṇamātreṇakāraṇenatusāmpratam |
caturbhujatvaṃ samprāptovismayenasamanvitaḥ ||27||
tac chrutvā tu vacas tasya sadyaḥ samprāptavismayaiḥ |
asmābhir apyasaudṛṣṭodevaḥ paramadurlabhaḥ ||28||
annādikaṃ tatra bhuktaṃ sarvasvādasamanvitam |
vayaṃ caturbhujājātād eva syakṛpayā punaḥ ||
gatvā tvamapidevasyadarśanaṃ kurusattama ||29||
bhuktvātatrānnasikthaṃ tubhavavipracaturbhujaḥ |
tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ yad āścaryaṃ tad uktaṃ vāḍavarṣabha ||30||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe 
brāhmaṇopadeśo nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18|| 

(19)

ūnaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

puruṣottama-māhātmyam

brāhmaṇa uvāca— 
iti śrutvā tu tad-vākyaṃ bhillānām aham adbhutam |
atyāścaryam idaṃ matvā prahṛṣṭo'bhavam ity uta ||1||
gaṅgā-sāgara-saṃyoge snātvā puṇya-kalevaraḥ |
śṛṅgam āruruhe tatra maṇi-māṇikya-citritam ||2||
tatrāpaśyaṃ mahā-rāja devandevādi-vanditam |
namaskṛtvā kṛtārtho'haṃ jātonna-prāśanena ca ||3||
caturbhujatvaṃ samprāptaḥ śaṅkha-cakrādi-cihnitam |
puruṣottama-darśanena na punar garbham āviśam ||4||
rājaṃs tvam api tatrāśu gaccha nīlābhidhaṃ girim |
kṛtārthaṃ kuru cātmānaṃ garbha-duḥkha-vivarjitam ||5||
ity ākarṇya vacas tasya vāḍa-vāg yasya dhīmataḥ |
papraccha hṛṣṭa-gātras tu tīrtha-yātrā-vidhiṃ munim ||6||
rājovāca—
sādhu viprāgryahe sādho tvayā proktaṃ mamānagha |
puruṣottama-māhātmyaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||7||
brūhi tat tīrtha-yātrāyāṃ vidhiṃ śruti-samanvitam |
vidhinā kena sampūrṇa-phala-prāptir nṛṇāṃ bhavet ||8||
brāhmaṇa uvāca— 
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi tīrtha-yātrā-vidhiṃ śubham |
yena samprāpyate devaḥ surāsura-namaskṛtaḥ ||9||
valī-palita-deho vā yauvanenānvito’pi vā |
jṣātvā mṛtyum anistīryaṃ hariṃ śaraṇam āvrajet ||10||
tat-kīrtane tac-chravaṇe vandane tasya pūjane |
matir eva prakartavyā nānyatra vanitādiṣu ||11||
sarvaṃ naśvaram ālokya kṣaṇa-sthāyi suduḥkhadam |
janma-mṛtyu-jarātītaṃ bhakti-vallabham acyutam ||12||
krodhāt kāmād bhayād dveṣāl lobhād dambhān naraḥ punaḥ |
yathā kathaṣcid vibhajan na sa duḥkhaṃ samaśnute ||13||
sa harir jāyate sādhu-saṅgamāt pāpa-varjitāt |
yeṣāṃ kṛpātaḥ puruṣā bhavanty asukha-varjitāḥ ||14||
te sādhavaḥ śānta-rāgāḥ kāma-lobha-vivarjitāḥ |
bruvanti yan-mahā-rāja tat saṃsāra-nivartakam ||15||
tīrtheṣu labhyate sādhū rāmacandra-parāyaṇaḥ |
yad-darśanaṃ nṛṇāṃ pāpa-rāśi-dāhāśuśukṣaṇiḥ ||16||
tasmāt tīrtheṣu gantavyaṃ naraiḥ saṃsāra-bhīrubhiḥ |
puṇyodakeṣu satataṃ sādhu-śreṇi-virājiṣu ||17||
tāni tīrthāni vidhinā dṛṣṭāni praharanty agham |
taṃ vidhiṃ nṛpa-śārdūla kuruṣva śruti-gocaram ||18||
virāgaṃ janayet pūrvaṃ kalatrādi-kuṭumbake |
asatya-bhūtaṃ taj jṣātvā hariṃ tu manasā smaret ||19||
krośa-mātraṃ tato gatvā rāma rāmeti ca bruvan |
tatra tīrthādiṣu snātvā kṣauraṃ kuryād vidhāna-vit ||20||
manuṣyāṇāṃ ca pāpāni tīrthāni pratigacchatām |
keśān āśritya tiṣṭhanti tasmād vapanam ācaret ||21||
tato daṇḍaṃ tu nirgranthiṃ kamaṇḍalum athājinam |
bibhṛyāl lobha-nirmuktas tīrtha-veṣa-dharo naraḥ ||22||
vidhinā gacchatāṃ nṝṇāṃ phalāvāptir viśeṣataḥ |
tasmāt sarva-prayatnena tīrtha-yātrā-vidhiṃ caret ||23||
yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaś caiva susaṃhitam |
vidyā tapaś ca kīrtiś ca sa tīrtha-phalam aśnute ||24||
hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa bhakta-vatsala gopate |
śaraṇya bhagavan viṣṇo māṃ pāhi bahu-saṃsṛteḥ ||25||
iti bruvan rasanayā manasā ca hariṃ smaran |
pādacārī gatiṃ kuryāt tīrthaṃ prati mahodayaḥ ||26||
yānena gacchan puruṣaḥ sama-bhāga-phalaṃ labhet |
upānadbhyāṃ caturthāṃśaṃ go-yāne go-vadhādikam ||27||
vyavahartā tṛtīyāṃśaṃse vayāṣṭama-bhāga-bhāk |
anicchayā vrajaṃs tatra tīrtham ardha-phalaṃ labhet ||28||
yathā yathaṃ prakartavyā tīrthānām abhiyātrikā |
pāpa-kṣayo bhavaty eva vidhi-dṛṣṭyā viśeṣataḥ ||29||
tatra sādhūnnamaskuryātpādavandanasevanaiḥ |
tad-dvārā hari-bhaktir hi prāpyate puruṣottame ||30||
ititīrthavidhiḥ proktaḥ samāsenanavistarāt |
evaṃ vidhiṃ samāśrityagacchatvaṃ puruṣottamam ||31||
tubhyaṃ tuṣṭomahā-rājadāsyatebhaktimacyutaḥ |
yathā saṃsāra-nirvāhaḥ kṣaṇād eva bhaviṣyati ||32||
tīrtha-yātrā-vidhiṃ śrutvā sarva-pātaka-nāśanam |
mucyate sarva-pāpebhya ugrebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabha ||33||
sumatir uvāca— 
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya vavande caraṇau mahān |
tat-tīrtha-darśanautsukya-vihvalīkṛta-mānasaḥ ||34||
ādideśa nijāmātyaṃ mantra-vittamam uttamam |
tīrtha-yātrecchayā sarvān sahanetuṃ mano dadhat ||35||
mantrin paura-janān sarvān ādiśatvaṃ mamājṣayā |
puruṣottama-pādābja-darśana-prīti-hetave ||36||
ye madīye pure lokā ye ca mad-vākya-kārakāḥ |
sarve niryāntu mat-puryā mayā saha narottamāḥ ||37||
ye tu mad-vākyaṃ ullaṅghya sthāsyanti puruṣā gṛhe |
te daṇḍyā yama-daṇḍena pāpino'dharma-hetavaḥ ||38||
kiṃ te na suta-vṛndena bāndhavaiḥ kiṃ sudurnayaiḥ |
yair na dṛṣṭaḥ sva-cakṣurbhyāṃ puṇyadaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||39||
sūkarī-yūthavat teṣāṃ prasūtir viṭ-prabhakṣikā |
yeṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrā vā hariṃ na śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||40||
yo devo nāma-mātreṇa sarvān pāvayituṃ kṣamaḥ |
taṃ namaskurutakṣipraṃ madīyāḥ prakṛtivrajāḥ ||41||
iti vākyaṃ manohāribhagavadguṇaguṃ phitam |
prajaharṣamahā-mātyauttamaḥ satyanāmadhṛk ||42||
hastinaṃ varamāropyapaṭahenavyaghoṣayat |
yadādiṣṭaṃ nṛpeṇehatīrtha-yātrāṃ samicchatā ||43||
gacchaṃ tutvaritālokārājṣāsahamahā-girim |
dṛśyatāṃ pāpasaṃhārīpuruṣottamanāmadhṛk ||44||
kriyatāṃ sarvasaṃsārasāgarogoṣpadaṃ punaḥ |
bhūṣyatāṃ śaṅkhacakrādicihnaiḥ svasvatanurnaraiḥ ||45||
ity ādighoṣayāmāsarājṣādiṣṭaṃ yadadbhutam |
sacivoraghunāthāṅghridhyānanirvāritaśramaḥ ||46||
tac chrutvātāḥ prajāḥ sarvā ānandarasasamplutāḥ |
manodadhuḥ svanistārepuruṣottamadarśanāt ||47||
niryayurbrāhmaṇās tatra śiṣyaiḥ sahasuveṣiṇaḥ |
āśiṣaṃ varadānāḍhyāṃ dadatobhūmipaṃ prati ||48||
kṣattriyādhanvinovīrāvaiśyāvastukrayāṣcitāḥ |
śūdrāḥ saṃsāranistāraharṣitasvīyavigrahāḥ ||49||
rajakāścarmakāḥ kṣaudrāḥ kirātābhittikārakāḥ |
sūcīvṛttyācajīvaṃ tastāṃ būlakrayakārakāḥ ||50||
tālavādyadharāyecayecaraṃ gopajīvinaḥ |
tailavikrayiṇaścaiva vastravikrayiṇas tathā ||51||
sūtāvadantaḥ paurāṇīṃ vārtāṃ harṣasamanvitāḥ |
māgadhābaṃ dinas tatra nirgatābhūmipājṣayā ||52||
bhiṣagvṛttyācajīvaṃ tas tathā pāśaka-kovidāḥ |
pākasvādurasābhijṣāhāsyavākyānuraṃ jakāḥ ||53||
##drajālikavidyādhrās tathā vārtāsukovidāḥ |
praśaṃsanto mahā-rājaṃ niryayuḥ puramadhyataḥ ||54||
rājāpi tatra nirvartyaprātaḥ sandhyādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
brāhmaṇaṃ tāpasaśreṣṭhamānināyasunirmalam ||55||
tadājṣayāmahā-rājonirjagāmapurādbahiḥ |
lokairanugatorājābabhaucandraivoḍubhiḥ ||56||
krośamātraṃ sagatvā thakṣauraṃ kṛtvāvidhānataḥ |
daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ bibhranmṛgacarma tathā śubham ||57||
śubhaveṣeṇa-saṃyuktoharidhyānaparāyaṇaḥ |
kāmakrodhādirahitaṃ manobibhranmahā-yaśāḥ ||58||
tadādundubhayobherya ānakāḥ paṇavās tathā |
śaṅkhavīṇādikāścaivādhmātāstadvādakairmuhuḥ ||59||
jayadeveśaduḥkhaghnapuruṣottamasaṃjṣita |
darśayasvatanuṃ mahyaṃ vadanto niryayurjanāḥ ||60||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe 
ratna-grīvasya tīrtha-prayāṇaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||19|| 

(20)
viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

sumatir uvāca— 
atha prayāte bhūpāle sarva-loka-samanvite |
mahā-bhāgair vaiṣṇavaiś ca gāyakaiḥ kṛṣṇa-kīrtanam ||1||
śuśrāvāsau mahā-rājo mārge govinda-kīrtanam |
jayamādhavabhaktānāṃ śaraṇyapuruṣottama ||2||
mārgetīrthānyanekānikurvanpaśyanmaho dayam |
tāpasabrāhmaṇātteṣāṃ mahimānamathāśṛṇot ||3||
vicitraviṣṇuvārtābhir vinoditamanānṛpaḥ |
mārgemārgemahā-viṣṇuṃ gāpayāmāsagāyakān ||4||

brāhmaṇānāṃ pratyagāramagnihotrabhavaḥ punaḥ |
dhūmas tatra punātyaṃ gapātakāplutamānasān ||6||
 uvāca sumatiṃ rājāśatrughnaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ |
tatpuraprekṣaṇodbhūtaharṣavismitamānasaḥ ||7||
śatrughna uvāca 
mantrinkathayakasyedaṃ puraṃ medṛṣṭigocaram |
karotimānasāhlādaṃ dharmeṇapratipālitam ||8||
śeṣa uvāca— 
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyaśatrughnasyamahīpateḥ |
 uvāca sumatiḥ sarvaṃ yathā tathamanuddhatam ||9||
sumatir uvāca— 
śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ svāminvaiṣṇavasyakathāḥ śubhāḥ |
yāḥ śrutvā mucyatepāpādbrahma-hatyāsamādapi ||10||
jīvanmuktovarīvartirāmāṅghryaṃ bujaṣaṭpadaḥ |
satyavānyajṣayajṣāṃ gajṣātākartā'vitāmahān ||11||
dhenuṃ prasādyabahubhir vratairyaṃ prāpatatpitā |
ṛtaṃ bharākhyojagatikhyātaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ||12||
gauḥ prasannādadauputramanekaguṇasaṃskṛtam |
satyavantaṃ suśobhāḍhyaṃ taṃ jānīhinṛpottamam ||13||
śatrughna uvāca 
kovāṛtaṃ bharorājākimarthaṃ dhenupūjanam |
 kathaṃ prāptaḥ sutas tasya vaiṣṇavoviṣṇusevakaḥ ||14||
sarvametatsamācakṣvavaiṣṇavasyakathānakam |
śrutaṃ haratijaṃ tūnāṃ mahā-pātakaparvatam ||15||
śeṣa uvāca— 
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyaśatrughnasyamahā-rthakam |
kathayāmāsaviśadaṃ tadutpattikathānakam ||16||
ṛtaṃ bharonarapatiranapatyaḥ purā'bhavat |
kalatrāṇibahūn yasya naputraṃ prāpateṣu vai ||17||
tadājābālināmānaṃ muniṃ daivādupāgatam |
prapacchakuśalodyuktaḥ saputrotpattikāraṇam ||18||
ṛtaṃ bhara uvāca 
svāminvandh yasya mebrūhi putrotpattikaraṃ vacaḥ |
yatkṛtvājāyate'patyaṃ mama vaṃśadharaṃ varam ||19||
taj jṣātvā bhavatobhavyaṃ prakuryāṃ niścitaṃ vacaḥ |
dānaṃ vrataṃ vātīrthaṃ vāmakhaṃ vāmunisattama ||20||
itirājṣovacaḥ śrutvā jagādamunisattamaḥ |
sutotpattikaraṃ vākyaṃ praṇa tasya sutārthinaḥ ||21||
apatyaprāptikāmasyasaṃtyupāyāstrayaḥ prabho |
viṣṇoḥ prasādo goś cāpi śivasyāpy athavā punaḥ ||22||
tasmāt tvaṃ kuru vai pūjāṃ dhenor deva-tanor nṛpa |
yasyāḥ pucche mukhe śṛṅge pṛṣṭhe devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||23||
sā tuṣṭā dāsyati kṣipraṃ vāṣchitaṃ dharma-saṃyutam |
evaṃ viditvā go-pūjāṃ vidhehi tvam ṛtambhara ||24||
yo vai nityaṃ pūjayati gāṃ gehe yavasādibhiḥ |
tasya devāś ca pitaro nityaṃ tṛptā bhavanti hi ||25||
yo vai gavāhnikaṃ dadyān niyamena śubha-vrataḥ |
tena satyena tasya syuḥ sarve pūrṇā manorathāḥ ||26||
tṛṣitāgaurgṛhebaddhāgehekanyārajasvalā |
devatācasanirmālyāhanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam ||27||
yo vai gāṃ pratiṣiddhyetacaraṃ tīṃ svaṃ tṛṇaṃ naraḥ |
 tasya pūrvecapitaraḥ kaṃ paṃ tepatanonmukhāḥ ||28||
yo vai yaṣṭyātāḍayatidhenuṃ martyovimūḍhadhīḥ |
dharmarājasyanagaraṃ sayātikaravarjitaḥ ||29||
yo vai daṃ śānvārayati tasya pūrvehyadhogatāḥ |
nṛtyanti matsutohyasmāṃ stārayiṣyati bhāgyavān ||30||
atraivodāharaṃ tīmamitihāsampurātanam |
janakasya purāvṛttaṃ dharmarājapure'dbhutam ||31||
ekadājanakorājāyogenāsūnsamatyajat |
tadāvimānaṃ samprāptaṃ kiṃ kiṇījālabhūṣitam ||32||
tadāruhyagatorājāsevakairūḍhadehavān |
mārgejagāmadharmasyasaṃyaminyāḥ puroṃ 'tike ||33||
tadānarakakoṭīṣupīḍyaṃ tepāpakāriṇaḥ |
janakasyāṃ gapavanaṃ prāpyasaukhyaṃ prapedire ||34||
nirayedāhajāpīḍājātaiṣāṃ sukhakāriṇī |
mahā-duḥkhaṃ tadānaṣṭaṃ janakasyāṃ gavāyunā ||35||
tadātaṃ nirgataṃ dṛṣṭvā jaṃ tavaḥ pāpapīḍitāḥ |
atyantaṃ cukruśurbhītāstadviyogamanicchavaḥ ||36||
ūcustekaruṇāṃ vācaṃ māgacchasukṛtinnitaḥ |
tvadaṃ gavāyusaṃsparśātsukhinaḥ syāmapīḍitāḥ ||37||
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyarājāparamadhārmikaḥ |
mānasecintayāmāsakaruṇāpūrapūritaḥ ||38||
cenmattaḥ prāṇināṃ saukhyaṃ bhavedihatadāpunaḥ |
atraivacapuresthāsye svarga eṣamanoramaḥ ||39||
evaṃ kṛtvānṛpastasthau tatra iva nirayāgrataḥ |
vidadhatprāṇināṃ saukhyamanukaṃ pitamānasaḥ ||40||
 tatra dharmastusamprāptonirayadvāriduḥkhade |
kārayanyātanāstīvrānānā-pātakakāriṇām ||41||
tadādadarśarājānaṃ janakaṃ dvārisaṃsthitam |
vimānenamahā-puṇyakāriṇaṃ dayayāyutam ||42||
tam uvāca pretapatirjanakaṃ sahasangirā |
rājankutastvaṃ samprāptaḥ sarva-dharmaśiromaṇiḥ ||43||
etatsthānaṃ pātakināṃ duṣṭānāṃ prāṇaghātinām |
nāyāṃ tipuruṣābhūpatvādṛśāḥ puṇyakāriṇaḥ ||44||
atrāyāṃ tinarāstevaiyeparadrohatatparāḥ |
parāpavādaniratāḥ paradravyaparāyaṇāḥ ||45||
yo vai kalatraṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ nijasevāparāyaṇam |
aparādhādṛtejahyātsa naro 'trasamāvrajet ||46||
mitraṃ vaṣcayateyas tu dhanalobhenalobhitaḥ |
āgatyātranaraḥ pīḍāṃ mattaḥ prāpnotidāruṇām ||47||
yorāmaṃ manasāvācākarmaṇādaṃ bhato’pi vā |
dveṣādvācopahāsādvānasmaratyevamūḍhadhīḥ ||48||
taṃ badhnāmipunastveṣu nikṣipyaśrapayāmica |
yaiḥ smṛtonaramānāthonarakakleśavārakaḥ ||49||
tāvatpāpaṃ manuṣyāṇāmaṃ geṣu nṛpatiṣṭhati |
yāvadrāmaṃ narasanāgṛṇātikalidurmateḥ ||50||
mahā-pāpakarārājanyebhavanti mahā-mate |
tānānayanti madbhṛtyāstvādṛśāndraṣṭumakṣamāḥ ||51||
tasmād gacchamahā-rājabhuṃ kṣvabhogānanekaśaḥ |
vimānavaramāruhyabhuṃ kṣvapuṇyamupārjitam ||52||
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyadharmarājasyatatpateḥ |
 uvāca dharmarājānaṃ karuṇāpūrapūritaḥ ||53||
janaka uvāca 
ahaṃ gacchāminonāthajīvānāmanukampayā |
madaṃ gavāyunāhyetesukhaṃ prāptāḥ smasaṃsthitāḥ ||54||
etānmuṣcasicedrājansarvānvainirayasthitān |
tato gacchāmisukhitaḥ svargaṃ puṇyajanāśritam ||55||
jābālir uvāca— 
iti vākyaṃ athāśrutyajanakaṃ praty uvāca saḥ |
pratyekaṃ nirdiśaṣjīvānnirayasthānanekaśaḥ ||56||
dharma uvāca— 
ayaṃ mitrakalatraṃ vaiviśvastamanujagmivān |
tasmād enaṃ lohaśaṃ kauvarṣāyutamapīpacam ||57||
paścādenaṃ sūkarāṇāṃ yonaunikṣipyadoṣiṇam |
mānuṣeṣvavatāryo'yaṃ ṣaṇḍhacihnenacihnitaḥ ||58||
anenaparadārāścabalādāliṃ gitāmuhuḥ |
tasmād ayaṃ pacyate'trarauraveśatahāyanam ||59||
ayaṃ tuparakīyaṃ svaṃ muṣitvābubhujekudhīḥ |
tasmād asyakarauchittvāpaceyaṃ pūyaśoṇite ||60||
ayaṃ sāyaṃ taneprāptamatithiṃ kṣudhayārditam |
vāṇyāpinākarot tasya pūjanaṃ svāgataṃ na ca ||61||
tasmād ayaṃ pātanīyastāmisreṃ dhanapūrite |
bhramaraiḥ pīḍitoyātuyātanāṃ śatahāyanam ||62||
ayaṃ tāvatparasyoccairnindāṃ kurvannalajjitaḥ |
ayamapyaśṛṇotkarṇauprerayanbahuśastutām ||63||
tasmād imāvandhakūpepatitauduḥkhaduḥkhitau |
ayaṃ mitradhrugudvignaḥ pacyaterauravebhṛśam ||64||
tasmād etān pāpabhogānkārayitvāvimocaye |
tvaṃ gaccha nara-śārdūla puṇya-rāśi-vidhāyakaḥ ||65||
jābālir uvāca——
evaṃ sanirdiśaṣjīvāṃ stūṣṇīmāsāghakāriṇaḥ |
provāca rāmabhakto'saukaruṇāpūritekṣaṇaḥ ||66||
janaka uvāca— 
kathaṃ nirayanirmuktirjīvānāṃ duḥkhināṃ bhavet |
tadāśukathayatvaṃ vaiyatkṛtvāsukhamāpnuyuḥ ||67||
dharma uvāca— 
naibhir ārādhitoviṣṇurnaibhis tasya kathāḥ śrutāḥ |
kathaṃ nirayanirmuktirbhavedvaipāpakāriṇām ||68||
yaditvaṃ mocayasyetānmahā-pāpakarānapi |
tarhyarpayamahā-rājapuṇyaṃ tatkathayāmiyat ||69||
ekadāprātarutthāyaśuddhabhāvenacetasā |
dhyātaḥ śrī-raghunātho'saumahā-pāpaharābhidhaḥ ||70||
rāmarāmetiyaccoktaṃ tvayāśuddhenacetasā |
tatpuṇyamarpayaitebhyoyenasyānnirayāccyutiḥ ||71||
jābālir uvāca— 
etac chrutvāvacas tasya dharmarājasyadhīmataḥ |
puṇyaṃ dadaumahā-rāja ājanmasamupārjitam ||72||
yadājanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyairaghunāthārcanodbhavaiḥ |
eteṣāṃ nirayānmuktirbhavatvatramanoramā ||73||
evaṃ kathayatas tasya jīvānirayasaṃsthitāḥ |
tat-kṣaṇānnirayānmuktājātādivyavapurdharāḥ ||74||
ūcustejanakaṃ rājaṃs tvatprasādādvayaṃ kṣaṇāt |
duḥkhadānnirayānmuktāyāsyāmaḥ paramaṃ padam ||75||
tāndṛṣṭvā sūryasaṃkāśānnarānnirayaniḥ sṛtān |
tutoṣacittesubhṛśaṃsarva-bhūtadayāparaḥ ||76||
tesarve prayayurlokaṃ divandevairalaṅkṛtam |
janakaṃ tupraśaṃsanto mahā-rājaṃ dayānidhim ||77||
iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe satyavadā-
khyānejanakenanarakasthaprāṇimocanaṃ nāmatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||30|| 

ekatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ 
jābālir uvāca— 
atha teṣu prayāteṣu narakastheṣu vainṛṣu |
rājāpapracchakīnāśaṃsarva-dharmavidāṃ varam ||1||
rājovāca—
dharmarājatvayāproktaṃ yatpātakakarānarāḥ |
āyāṃ titavasaṃsthānaṃ na ca dharmakathāratāḥ ||2||
madāgamanamatrābhūtkenapāpenadhārmika |
tadvaikathayasarvaṃ mepāpakāraṇamāditaḥ ||3||
iti śrutvā tutad-vākyaṃ dharmarājaḥ paraṃ tapa |
kathayāmāsa tasyai vaṃ yamapuryāgamaṃ tadā ||4||
dharmarāja uvāca 
rājaṃs tavamahatpuṇyaṃ naitādṛkkasyabhūtale |
raghunāthapadadvandvamakarandamadhuvrata ||5||
tvatkīrtisvardhunīsarvān pāpinomala-saṃyutān |
punātiparamāhlādakāriṇīduṣṭatāriṇī ||6||
 tathāpi pāpaleśastevartatenṛpasattama |
yenasaṃyaminīpārśvamāgataḥ puṇyapūritaḥ ||7||
ekadātucaraṃ tīṃ gāṃ vārayāmāsavaibhavān |
tenapāpavipākenanirayadvāradarśanam ||8||
idānīṃ pāpanirmuktobahupuṇyasamanvitaḥ |
bhuṃ kṣvabhogānsuvipulānnijapuṇyārjitānbahūn ||9||
eteṣāṃ karuṇāvārdhīraghunāthosukhaṃ haran |
saṃyaminyāmahā-mārgeprerayāmāsavaiṣṇavam ||10||
nāgamiṣyoyaditvaṃ vaimārgeṇānenasuvrata |
abhaviṣyat kathaṃ teṣāṃ nirayātparimocanam ||11||
tvādṛśāḥ paraduḥkhenaduḥkhitāḥ karuṇālayāḥ |
prāṇināṃ duḥkhavicchedaṃ kurvanty evamahā-mate ||12||
jābālir uvāca— 
evaṃ vadaṃ taṃ śamanaṃ praṇamyasadivaṃ gataḥ |
divyenasuvimānena apsarogaṇaśobhinā ||13||
tasmād gāvo'niśaṃ pūjyāmanasāpinagarhayet |
garhayannirayaṃ yātiyāvadindrāścaturdaśa ||14||
tasmāt tvaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭhagopūjāṃ vaisamācara |
sātuṣṭādāsyatikṣipraṃ putraṃ dharmaparāyaṇam ||15||
sumatir uvāca— 
tac chrutvādhenupūjāṃ sapapracchakathamādarāt |
pūjanīyāprayatnena kīdṛśaṃ kurutenaram ||16||
jābāliḥ kathayāmāsadhenupūjāṃ yathā vidhi |
pratyahaṃ vipinaṃ gaccheccāraṇārthaṃ vratītugoḥ ||17||
gaveyavāṃ stusambhojyagomayasthānsamāharet |
bhakṣaṇīyāyavāstetuputrakāmenabhūpate ||18||
sāyadāpibatetoyaṃ tadāpeyaṃ jalaṃ śuci |
soccaiḥ sthāneyadātiṣṭhettadānīṃ cāsanasthitaḥ ||19||
daṃ śānnivārayennityaṃ yavasaṃsvayamāharet |
evaṃ prakurvataḥ putraṃ dāsyatedharmatatparam ||20||
sumatir uvāca— 
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyaputrakāmaṛtaṃ bharaḥ |
vrataṃ cakāradharmātmādhenupūjāṃ samācaran ||21||
pratyahaṃ kurutegāṃ vaiyavasādyenatoṣitām |
daṃ śānnyavārayaddhīmānyavabhakṣakṛtādaraḥ ||22||
evandhenuṃ pūjayatogatāstudivasāghanāḥ |
vana-madhye tṛṇādīṃś cacaraṃ tīmakutobhayām ||23||
ekadānṛpatis tasya vanasyaśrī-nirīkṣaṇe |
nyastadṛṣṭiḥ saparitobabhrāmasakutūhalī ||24||
tadāgatyāhanadgāṃ vaipaṣcāsyaḥ kānanāntarāt |
krośaṃ tīṃ bahudhādīnāṃ siṃhabhāreṇaduḥkhitām ||25||
tadānṛpaḥ samāgatyavilokyanijamātaram |
siṃhenanihatāṃ paśyanrurodātīvavihvalaḥ ||26||
saduḥkhitaḥ samāgatyajābāliṃ munisattamam |
niṣkṛtiṃ tasya papracchagovadhasya pramādataḥ ||27||
ṛtaṃ bhara uvāca 
svāmiṃ stvadājṣayādhenuṃ pālayanvanamāsthitaḥ |
kutopyāgatyatāṃ siṃhojaghānādṛṣṭigocaraḥ ||28||
 tasya pāpasyaniṣkṛtyaikiṃ karomitvadājṣayā |
 kathaṃ vāvratasampūrtirmama putrapradāyinī ||29||
ity uktavantaṃ taṃ bhūpaṃ jagādamunisattamaḥ |
saṃtyupāyāmahīpālapāpasyāsyāpanuttaye ||30||
brahmaghnasyakṛtaghnasyasurāpasyamahā-mate |
prāyaścittānivartante sarva-pāpaharāṇica ||31||
kṛcchraiścāṃ drāyaṇairdānair vrataiḥ saniyamairyamaiḥ |
pāpānipralayaṃ yāṃ tiniyamādanutiṣṭhataḥ ||32||
dvayoścaniṣkṛtirnāstipāpapuṣjakṛtostayoḥ |
matyāgovadhakartuścanārāyaṇavinindituḥ ||33||
gavāṃ yomanasāduḥkhaṃ vāṃ cchatyadhamasattamaḥ |
sayātinirayasthānaṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ||34||
yo’pi devaṃ hariṃ nindetsakṛddurbhāgyavānnaraḥ |
sacāpinarakaṃ paśyetputrapautraparīvṛtaḥ ||35||
tasmāj jṣātvā hariṃ nindangoṣuduḥkhaṃ samācaran |
kadāpi narakānmuktiṃ naprāpnotinareśvara ||36||
ajñānaprāptagohatyāprāyaścittaṃ tuvidyate |
rāmabhaktaṃ tudhīmantaṃ yāhitvamṛtuparṇakam ||37||
savaisamadṛśaḥ sarvāṣchatrūnmitrāṇipaśyati |
tubhyaṃ kathiṣyati kṣipraṃ govadhasyāsyaniṣkṛtim ||38||
 tasya deśāṃ stvamākrāmaṃ stenanirvāsitaḥ purā |
vairibhāvaṃ parityajyagacchatvamṛtuparṇakam ||39||
sayadvadiṣyati kṣipraṃ tatkuruṣvasamāhitaḥ |
 yathā tvatkṛtapāpasyaniṣkṛtirhibhaviṣyati ||40||
satutadvacanaṃ śrutvā jagāmaṛtuparṇakam |
rāmabhaktaṃ ripaumitresamadṛṣṭyāsamaṃ jasam ||41||
satasmaikathayāmāsayajjātaṃ govadhādikam |
 tasya pāpasyaniṣkṛtyaihyupāyaṃ so’py acintayat ||42||
kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvāthataṃ rājāṛtuparṇaṛtaṃ bharam |
 uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ buddhimāndharma-kovidaḥ ||43||
ko'haṃ rājanmunīnāṃ vaipurataḥ śāstravedinām |
tānhitvākiṃ tumāṃ prāptomūrkhaṃ paṇḍitamāninam ||44||
tavamayyasticecchraddhātadākiṣcidbravīmyaham |
śṛṇuṣva nara-śārdūla gaditaṃ mama sādaraḥ ||45||
bhajaśrī-raghunāthaṃ tvaṃ karmaṇāmanasāgirā |
naiṣkāpaṭyenalokeśanto ṣayasvamahā-mate ||46||
satuṣṭodāsyatesarvaṃ tvaddhṛdi-sthaṃ manoratham |
ajñānakṛtagohatyāpāpa-nāśaṅkariṣyati ||47||
rāmaṃ smaraṃ stvandharmātmandhenuṃ pālayasattama |
dattvādvijāyakanakaṃ pāpaniṣkṛtimāpsyasi ||48||
sumatir uvāca— 
etac chrutvā tu tad-vākyaṃ ṛtaṃ bharanṛpastadā |
vidhāyarāmasmaraṇaṃ pūtātmāvratamācarat ||49||
pūrvavatpālayandhenuṃ jagāmavipinaṃ mahat |
rāmanāmasmarannityaṃ sarva-bhūtahiterataḥ ||50||
tasmaituṣṭātusurabhiḥ provāca paritoṣitā |
rājanvarayamattovaivaraṃ hṛtsthaṃ manoratham ||51||
tadāprovāca vairājāputraṃ dehimanoramam |
rāmabhaktaṃ pitṛrataṃ svadharmapratipālakam ||52||
tuṣṭādattvāvaraṃ sāpitasmairājṣesutārthine |
jagāmādarśanandevīkāmadhenuḥ kṛpāvatī ||53||
sakāleprāptavān putraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ rāmasevakam |
satyavatsaṃjṣayāyuktamakarot tatra tatpitā ||54||
satyavantaṃ sutaṃ labdhvāpitṛbhaktiparaṃ mahān |
paramaṃ harṣamāpedeśakratulyaparākramam ||55||
sarājādhārmikaṃ putraṃ prāpyaharṣeṇanirbharaḥ |
rājyaṃ tasmin mahann yasya jagāmatapasevanam ||56||

tvādṛśānbālakānbhūpāmādṛśāḥ kṛpayanti hi |
praharanti na ca itānvaitasmād gaccharaṇādbahiḥ ||27||
yāvattvaṃ namayā dṛṣṭaścakṣurbhyāṃ tāvadunmanāḥ |
sāmprataṃ tvāṃ prahartuṃ namanaḥ samabhikāṃ kṣati ||28||
yattvayāmatsutobāṇairbhinnomūrcchīkṛtaḥ punaḥ |
sarvaṃ mayā kṣāntamadyatavabāladhiyomahat ||29||
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyapuṣkalonijagādatam |
puṣkala uvāca 
bālo'haṃ tvaṃ mahā-vṛddhaḥ sarva-śastrāstra-kovidaḥ ||30||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ mataṃ caiva yebalādhikya-saṃyutāḥ |
ta evavṛddhābhūpāgryanavayovṛddhatāṃ gatāḥ ||31||
mayā temūrcchitaḥ putraḥ saśauryabaladarpitaḥ |
idānīṃ tvāmahaṃ śastraiḥ pātayiṣyāmisaṅgare ||32||
tasmāt tvaṃ yatnatastiṣṭharājansaṅgrāmamūrdhani |
rāmabhaktaṃ namāṃ kaścijjayatīndrapadesthitaḥ ||33||
itthaṃ bhāṣitamāśrutyapuṣkalasyanṛpāgraṇīḥ |
jahāsabālaṃ saṃvīkṣyakopaṣcavyadadhātpunaḥ ||34||
taṃ vaikupitamālakṣyabharatātmajaunmadaḥ |
jaghānaśaraviṃ śatyārājānaṃ hṛditīkṣṇayā ||35||

cicchedaparamakruddhaḥ śaraistīkṣṇairanekadhā ||36||
tadbāṇacchedanandṛṣṭvā bhāratiḥ paravīrahā |

vivyādhabhālebhūpālaputraḥ puṣkalasaṃjṣakaḥ |
 tatra lagnāvirejustetrikūṭaśikharāṇikim ||38||

hṛdayepuṣkalaṃ vīraṃ mahā-kopasamanvitaḥ ||

paramaṃ kopamāpannaḥ puṣkalobhūmipaṃ punaḥ ||40||
bāṇānāṃ śatakenāśubibhedaśitaparvaṇām |
tairbāṇaiḥ kavacaṃ bhinnaṃ kirīṭaḥ saśirastrakaḥ ||41||
rathodhanurmahatsajyaṃ chinnaṃ kopapariplavāt |
kṣatajenaparipluṣṭobāṇabhinnakalevaraḥ ||42||
anyaṃ syandanamāruhyajagāmabharatātmajam |
dhanyo’si vīrarāmasyacaraṇābjamadhuvrata ||43||
mahatkṛtaṃ karmate'dyayadahaṃ virathīkṛtaḥ |
prāṇānrakṣasvabhovīrasāmprataṃ mayiyuddhyati ||44||
sulabhānatavaprāṇāḥ kālarūpemayisthite |
ity uktvā vyahanadbāṇairasaṃkhyaiḥ śastra-kovidaḥ ||45||
bhūmaudiśicatadbāṇānānyaddṛśyeta tatra ha |
anekegajasāhasrābhinnā aśvāḥ samaṃ tataḥ ||46
