śoṇitaughāsarit tatra prasusrāvaraṇāṅgaṇe ||47||
yatronmadā hi mātaṅgā dṛśyante śaila-śṛṅgavat |
keśāḥ śaivāla-lakṣyās te muhuḥ prāṇi-śiraḥ-sthitāḥ ||48||
anekepāṇayaśchinnāvīrāṇāṃ mudrikāśriyaḥ |
dṛśyante ahivat tatra candanādikarūṣitāḥ ||49||
śirāṃ sicabhaṭāgryāṇāṃ kacchapābhāṃ vahanti vai |
māṃ sānipaṅkāyatrāsanvīrāṇāṃ mahatāntataḥ ||50||
evaṃ vyatikarevṛtteyoginyaḥ śataśoraṇe |
papuḥ pātreṇarudhiraṃ prāṇināṃ raṇapātinām ||51||
māṃ sānibubhujustāvaiharṣakautuka-saṃyutāḥ |
pītvā tuśoṇitaṃ tatra bhakṣitvāmāṃ samunmadāḥ ||52||
nanṛturjahasuḥ proccairujjaguḥ pradhanāṃ gaṇe |
piśācās tatra samareprāṇināṃ mastakānivai ||53||
dhṛtvākarābhyāṃ mattāṃ gāstālavadvādanodyatāḥ |
śivās tatra mahā-māṃsaṃ patitānāṃ raṇāṅgaṇe ||54||
bhakṣitvāvyanadanmattāḥ kātarāṇāṃ bhayapradāḥ |
kātarāstrāḥ samāpannāgatāḥ kuṃ jarakoṭare ||55||
bhakṣitāyoginībhistepāpināṃ kvāpinasthitiḥ |
etatkadanamālakṣyasvasain yasya rathāgraṇīḥ ||56||
puṣkalo’pi cakārātrakadanaṃ raṇa-maṇḍale |
bhidyaṃ te gaja-śīrṣāṇi patanti mauktikāni tu ||57||
dṛśyatelomabhiḥ pūrṇātāmraparṇīvatannadī |
puṣkalaprahitābāṇānṛṇāmaṃ geṣu saṅgatāḥ ||
kurvanti prāṇavicchedaṃ vīrāṇāmapisarvataḥ ||58||
sarve rudhirasiktāṃ gāḥ sarve cchinnanijāṃ gakāḥ |
dṛśyante kiṃ śukāyadvatsubhaṭāḥ pradhanāṃ gaṇe ||59||
e tasmin samayekruddhaḥ samābhāṣyamahīpatim |
jaghānabahubāṇaistaṃ roṣapūrapariplutaḥ ||60||
tadbāṇavedhabhinnāṃ goviśīrṇakavaconṛpaḥ |
mahā-balaṃ taṃ manvānaḥ prāharaccharakoṭibhiḥ ||61||
tairbāṇaiḥ kavacānmuktaṃ susrāvabahuśo ṇitam |
vapurbabhūvaruciraṃ śarapaṃ jaragocaram ||62||
śarapaṃ jaramadhyasthovihvalīkṛtamānasaḥ |
śarānnetuṃ casandhātuṃ nakṣamaḥ sacabhāratiḥ ||63||
rāmaṃ smṛtvādhanurdhṛtvākaresajjaṃ mahaddṛḍham |
mumocabāṇānniśitānvairivṛndanivāraṇān ||64||
tairbāṇaiḥ śarajālaṃ tadvidhūyamunipuṅgava |
śaṅkhaṃ pradhmāyasamarejagādagatabhīrnṛpam ||65||
puṣkala uvāca 
tvayākṛtaṃ mahatkarmayanmāṃ bāṇasya paṃ jare |
gocaraṃ kṛtavānvīravīratāpanamudbhaṭam ||66||
vṛddhatvānmama mānyosisāmprataṃ raṇa-maṇḍale |
paśyame'dyaparākrāntaṃ rājanvīramaṇemahat ||67||
bāṇatrayeṇabhovīramūrcchitaṃ karavainahi |
tarhipratijṣāṃ śṛṇuvaisarva-vīravimohinīm ||68||
gaṅgāṃ prāpyāpiyo vai tāṃ ninditvāpāpahāriṇīm |
namajjatimahā-pāpomahā-mūḍhaviceṣṭitaḥ ||69||
 tasya pāpaṃ mama ivāstucennatvāṃ raṇa-maṇḍale |
pātayemūrcchayāvīrasannaddhobhavabhūpate ||70||
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyapuṣkalasyanṛpottamaḥ |
cukopabhṛśamudvignaḥ sandadheniśitāṣcharān ||71||
teśarāhṛdayaṃ bhittvāgatāstebhāratermahat |
petuḥ kṣitāvadhoyadvadrāmabhaktiparāṅmukhāḥ ||72||
tataḥ śaraṃ mumocāsmai niśitaṃ vahnisaprabham |
lakṣīkṛtyamahadvakṣaḥ kapāṭataṭavistṛtam ||73||
sabāṇobhūmipatinādvidhāchinnaḥ śareṇahi |
papātaratha-madhye saravimaṇḍalavajjvalan ||74||
aparaṃ bāṇamādhattamātṛbhaktibhavaṃ tataḥ |
nidhāyapuṇyaṃ so’py eṣacicchedamahatāpunaḥ ||75||
tadākhinnaḥ sahṛdayekiṃ kartavyamitismaran |
rāmaṃ hṛdinijārtighnaṃ mumocaparamāstravit ||76||
sabāṇas tasya hṛdayelagna āśīviṣopamaḥ |
mūrcchāmaprāpayattaṃ vaijvalansūryasamaprabhaḥ ||77||
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ palāyanaparāyaṇam |
rājṣisaṃmūrcchitejātepuṣkalojayamāptavān ||78||
iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe vīramaṇeḥ 
parābhavonāmadvicatvāriṃ śattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||42|| 
tricatvāriṃ śattamo'dhyāyaḥ 
śeṣa uvāca— 
hanūmānvīrasiṃhaṃ tusamāgatyābravīdvacaḥ |
tiṣṭhayāsikutovīrajeṣyāmitvāṃ kṣaṇādi ha ||1||
evam uktaṃ samākarṇyaplavagasyavacomahat |
kopapūraparipluṣṭaḥ kārmukaṃ jaladasvanam ||2||
vinadyaghorānniśitānbāṇānmuṣcan babhauraṇe |
āṣāḍhejaladasyevadhārāsāremanoharaḥ ||3||
tāndṛṣṭvā niśitānbāṇānsvadehesuvilagnakān |
cukopahṛdaye'tyaṃ taṃ hanūmānaṃ janīsutaḥ ||4||
muṣṭinātāḍayāmāsahṛdayevajrasāriṇā |
samuṣṭināhatovīraḥ papātadharaṇītale ||5||
mūrcchitaṃ taṃ samālokyapitṛvyaṃ saśubhāṃ gadaḥ |
rukmāṃ gado’pi saṃmūrcchāṃ tyaktvāgādraṇa-maṇḍalam ||6||
bāṇānsamabhivarṣaṃ taumeghāvivamahā-svanau |
kurvaṃ taukadanaṃ ghoraṃ plavaṃ gaṃ pratijagmatuḥ ||7||
taudṛṣṭvā samarevīrausamāyātaukapīśvaraḥ |
lāṃ gūlena ca saṃveṣṭyasarathaucāpadhārakau ||8||
sphoṭayāmasabhūdeśetat-kṣaṇānmūrcchitāvubhau |
niśceṣṭausamabhūtāntaurudhirāraktadehakau ||9||
balamitraściraṃ yuddhaṃ vidhāyasumadenahi |
mūrcchāmaprāpayattaṃ vaibāṇaiḥ suśitaparvabhiḥ ||10||
puṣkalenakṣaṇānnītomūrcchāṃ caitanyavarjitām |
jayamāptaṃ tukaṭakaṃ śatrughnasyabhaṭārdanam ||11||
e tasmin samaye sāṃ baḥ syandanaṃ varamāsthitaḥ |
visphārayandhanurdivyamupādhāvadbhaṭānimān ||12||
jaṭājūṭāntaragatāṃ candrarekhāṃ vahanmahān |
sarpābhūṣāṃ manaḥ sparśāṃ dadhadājagavandhanuḥ ||13||
mūrcchitānsvajanāndṛṣṭvā bhaktārtighnomaheśvaraḥ |
yoddhuṃ prāyānmahā-sainyaiḥ śatrughnasyabhaṭānimān ||14||
sagaṇaḥ saparīvāraḥ kaṃ payanpṛthivītalam |

kopācchoṇatarenetrevahanpralayakārakaḥ |
paśyanvīrānbahumatīnpinākīdevavanditaḥ ||16||
tamāgataṃ maheśānaṃ vīkṣyarāmānujobalī |
jagāmasamareyoddhuṃ sarvadevaśiromaṇim ||17||
athāgataṃ tuśatrughnaṃ rudrovīkṣyapinākadhṛk |
 uvāca paramāpannaḥ kopaṃ saguṇacāpadhṛk ||18||
puṣkalenamahatkarmakṛtaṃ rāmāṅghrisevinā |
madbhaktaṃ yoraṇehatvāgataḥ samaramaṇḍalam ||19||
adyakvāstiparovīraḥ puṣkalaḥ paramāstravit |
taṃ hatvāsukhamāpsyāmisamarebhaktapīḍanam ||20||
śeṣa uvāca— 
ity uktvā vīrabhadraṃ sapreṣayāmāsapuṣkalam |
yāhitvaṃ samareyoddhuṃ puṣkalaṃ sevakārdanam ||21||
nandinaṃ preṣayāmāsahanūmantaṃ mahā-balam |
kuśadhvajaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ tubhṛṅgiṇaṃ casubāhukam ||22||
sumadaṃ caṇḍanāmānaṃ gaṇaṃ svīyaṃ samādiśat |
puṣkalastusamāyāntaṃ vīrabhadraṃ mahā-gaṇam ||23||
mahā-rudrasyasaṃvīkṣyayoddhuṃ prāyānmahā-manāḥ |
puṣkalaḥ paṣcabhir bāṇaistāḍayāmāsasaṃyuge ||24||
tairbāṇaiḥ kṣatagātrastutriśūlaṃ sasamādiśat |
satriśūlaṅkṣaṇācchittvāvyagarjatamahā-balaḥ ||25||
chinnaṃ svīyaṃ triśūlaṃ vaivīkṣyarudrānugobalī |
khaṭvāṃ genajaghānāśumastakebhāratiṃ dvija ||26||
khaṭvāṃ gābhihataḥ so'thamumūrcchakṣaṇamudbhaṭaḥ |
vihāyamūrcchāṃ sadvīraḥ puṣkalaḥ paramāstravit ||27||
śaraiścicchedakhaṭvāṃ gaṃ karasthaṃ tasya tat-kṣaṇāt |
vīrabhadraḥ svakecchinnekhaṭvāṃ gekarasaṃsthite ||28||
paramakrodhamāpannobabhaṃ jarathinoratham |
bhaṃ ktvārathaṃ tuvīrasya padātiṃ cavidhāyasaḥ ||29||
bāhuyuddhenayuyudhepuṣkalenamahātmanā |
sapuṣkalorathanty aktvācūrṇitaṃ tenavegataḥ ||30||
muṣṭinātāḍayāmāsavīrabhadraṃ mahā-balaḥ |
anyonyaṃ muṣṭibhir ghnaṃ tāvūrubhir jānubhis tathā ||31||
parasparavadhodyuktauparasparajayaiṣiṇau |
evaṃ caturdinamabhūdrātriṃ divamapīśayoḥ ||32||
nakopi tatra hīyetanajīyetamahā-balaḥ |
paṣcametudinevṛttevīrabhadromahā-balaḥ ||33||
gṛhītvānabhauḍḍīnomahā-vīraṃ tupuṣkalam |
 tatra yuddhaṃ tayorāsīddevāsuravimohanam ||34||
muṣṭinācaraṇāghātairbāhubhiḥ sukhurairmahat |
tadātyaṃ taṃ prakupitaḥ puṣkalovīrabhadrakam ||35||

tatprahāreṇavyathitovīrabhadromahā-balaḥ ||36||

tāḍayitvāmahīdeśepuṣkalaṃ sumahā-balaḥ ||37||
triśūlena ca kartāśuśirojvalitakuṇḍalam |

hāhākāromahā-nāsītpuṣkalepatiteraṇe ||39||

teśaśaṃśuścaśatrughnaṃ puṣkalaṃ patitaṃ raṇe ||40||
nihataṃ vīrabhadreṇamaheśvaragaṇena vai |

śatrughnaṃ samarevīraṃ śocaṃ taṃ puṣkalehate |
reśatrughnaraṇeśokaṃ mākṛthāḥ sumahā-bala ||43||
vīrāṇāṃ raṇa-madhye tupātanaṃ kīrtaye smṛtam |
dhanyovīraḥ puṣkalākhyoyaścavaidinapaṣcakam ||44||

kṣaṇādvinihatāyenadaityāstripurasainikāḥ |
tasmād yuddhyasvarājendraśokanty aktvāmahā-bala ||46||
yatnāttiṣṭhādyavīrāgryamayiyoddharisaṃsthite |

āttasajjadhanurbāṇaiḥ pracacchādamaheśvaram |
tebāṇāḥ suraśīrṣaṇyavapuṣaṃ kṣatavikṣatam ||48||
akurvatamahaccitraṃ bhaktarakṣārthamāgatam |
tebāṇāḥ śaṅkarasyāpibāṇānabhasisaṃsthitāḥ ||49||
vyāpyaitatsakalaṃ viśvaṃ citrakārimunerapi |
tadbāṇayoryuddhabalaṃ vīkṣyasarvatra menire ||50||

ākāśetuvimānānisaṃśrityasvapurasthitāḥ ||51||

asāvapimahā-rājarāmacandrasyacānujaḥ |

brahmasaṃjṣaṃ mahā-devaṃ haṃ tuṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ ||55||
savijṣāyamahāstraṃ tanmuktaṃ śatrughna vai riṇā |
hasannapyapibattenamuktaṃ brahmaśiromahat ||56||

tenabāṇenaśatrughnomūrcchitoraṇa-maṇḍale ||58||
hāhābhūtamabhūtsarvaṃ kaṭakaṃ bhaṭasevitam |

subāhusumadonmukhyāḥ svabāhubaladarpitāḥ |
patitaṃ mūrcchayāvīkṣyaśatrughnaṃ śarapīḍitam ||60||
puṣkalaṃ turathesthāpyasevakaiḥ parirakṣitum |
hanūmān āgato yoddhuṃ śivaṃ saṃhāra-kārakam ||61||
śrī-rāma-smaraṇaṃ yodhān svīyān vipra praharṣitān |
prakurvan roṣitas tīvraṃ lāṅgūlaṃ ca prakampayan ||62||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe

śeṣa uvāca— 
āgatyasavidherudraṃ samarāṃ gaṇamūrdhani |
jagādahanumānvīraḥ saṃjihīrṣuḥ surādhipam ||1||
hanūmān uvāca—
tvaṃ yadācaraserudradharmasya pratikūlanam |
tasmāt tvāṃ śāstumicchāmirāmabhaktavadhodyatam ||2||
mayā purāśrutaṃ devaṛṣibhir bahudhoditam |
raghunāthapadasmārīnityaṃ rudraḥ pinākabhṛt ||3||
tatsarvaṃ tumṛṣājātaṃ śatrughnaṃ pratiyudhyataḥ |
puṣkalomehataḥ śūraḥ śatrughno’pi vimūrcchitaḥ ||4||
tasmāt tvāṃ pātayāmyad yatra ilokyapralayodyatam |
yatnāttiṣṭhasvabhoḥ śarvarāmabhaktiparāṅmukhaḥ ||5||
śeṣa uvāca— 
ity uktavantaṃ plavagaṃ provāca samaheśvaraḥ |
dhanyo'sivīravaryastvaṃ bhavānvadatinomṛṣā ||6||
matsvāmīrāmacandro'yaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ |
tadaśvamānayāmāsaśutrughnaḥ paravīrahā ||7||
tadrakṣārthaṃ samāyātas tadbhaktyātuvaśīkṛtaḥ |
 yathā kathaṣcid bhakto'saurakṣyaḥ svātmāitisthitiḥ ||8||
raghunāthaḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvāvilokayatunistrapam |
māṃ svabhaktasuduḥkhenakiṣcitkopaṃ dadhanmahān ||9||
śeṣa uvāca— 
evaṃ vadaticaṇḍīśehanūmānkupitobhṛśam |
śilāmādāyamahatīṃ tāḍayāmāsatadratham ||10||

daṃ daśūkecapatitodaṃ daśūkaiḥ sadaśyate ||33||
evaṃ rājannanekevainarakāḥ pāpakāriṇām |
pāpaṅkṛtvāprayāṃ tyetepīḍāṃ yāṃ tisudāruṇām ||34||
yairnaśrutārāmakathānaparopakṛtiḥ kṛtā |
teṣāṃ sarvāṇiduḥkhānibhavanti narakāntare ||35||
atra yasya sukhaṃ svargebhūyāt tasyai tīryate |
yeduḥkhinorogayutānarakādāgatāścate ||36||
śeṣa uvāca— 
etac chrutvāmahīpālaḥ kaṃ pamānaḥ kṣaṇekṣaṇe |
papracchabhūyastaṃ vipraṃ sarvasaṃśayanuttaye ||37||
tat-tat-pāpasyacihnānikathayasva mahā-mune |
kenapāpenakiṣcihnaṃ bhūlokeupajāyate ||38||
iti śrutvā tutad-vākyaṃ muniḥ provāca bhūpatim |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmicihnānipāpakāriṇām ||39||
śaunaka uvāca 
surāpaḥ śyāmadaṃ taścanarakāṃ teprajāyate |
abhakṣyabhakṣakārīcajāyategulmakodaraḥ ||40||
udakyāvīkṣitaṃ bhuktvājāyatekṛmilodaraḥ |
śvamārjārādisaṃspṛṣṭaṃ bhuktvādur-gandhimānbhavet ||41||
anivedyasurādibhyobhuṃ jānojāyatenaraḥ |
udarerogavānduḥkhīmahā-rogaprapīḍitaḥ ||42||
parānnavighnakaraṇādajīrṇamabhijāyate |
maṃ dodarāgnirbhavatisatidravyekadannadaḥ ||43||
viṣadaśchardirogīsyānmārgahāpādarogavān |
piśunonarakasyāṃ tejāyateśvāsakāsavān ||44||
dhūrto'pasmārarogīsyācchūlīcaparatāpanaḥ |
dāvāgnidāyakaścaiva raktātīsāravānbhavet ||45||
surālayejalevāpiśakṛtkṣepaṅkaroti yaḥ |
gudarogobhavet tasya pāparūpaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||46||
garbhapātanajārogāḥ kṣayamehajalodarāḥ |
pratimābhaṅgakārīca apratiṣṭhaścajāyate ||47||
duṣṭavādīkhaṇḍitaḥ syātkhalvāṭaḥ paranindakaḥ |
sabhāyāṃ pakṣapātīcajāyatepakṣaghātavān ||48||
paroktahāsyakṛtkāṇaḥ kunakhīviprahemahṛt |
tuṃ dīvarītāmracauraḥ kāṃ syahṛtpuṇḍarīkikaḥ ||49||
trapuhārīcapuruṣojāyatepiṃ gamūrddhajaḥ |
śīsahārīcapuruṣojāyateśīrṣarogavān ||50||
ghṛtacaurastupuruṣojāyatenetrarogavān |
lohahārīcapuruṣobarbarāṃ gaḥ prajāyate ||51||
carmahā-rīcapuruṣojāyatemedasāvṛtaḥ |
madhucaurastupuruṣojāyatebastigandhavān ||52||
tailacauryeṇabhavatinaraḥ kaṇḍvātipīḍitaḥ |
āmānnaharaṇāccaiva daṃ tahīnaḥ prajāyate ||53||
pakvānna-haraṇāc caiva jihvā-roga-yuto bhavet |
mātṛ-gāmī ca puruṣo jāyate liṅga-varjitaḥ ||54||
guru-jāyābhigamanān mūtra-kṛcchraḥ prajāyate |
bhaginīṃ caiva gamane pīta-kuṣṭhaḥ prajāyate ||55||
sva-sutā-gamane caiva rakta-kuṣṭhaḥ prajāyate |
bhrātṛ-bhāryābhigamane gulma-kuṣṭhaḥ prajāyate ||56||
svāmi-gamyādi-gamane jāyate dadru-maṇḍalam |
viśvasta-bhāryā-gamane gaja-carmā prajāyate ||57||
pitṛ-ṣvasr-abhigamane dakṣināṅge vraṇī bhavet |
mātulānyās tu gamane vāmāṅge vraṇavān bhavet ||58||
pitṛvya-patnī-gamane kaṭau kuṣṭhaḥ prajāyate |
mitra-bhāryābhigamane mṛta-bhāryaḥ prajāyate ||59||
sva-gotra-strī-prasaṅgena jāyate ca bhagaṃ daraḥ |
tapasvinī-prasaṅgena prameho jāyate nare ||60||
śrotriya-strī-prasaṅgena jāyate nāsikā-vraṇī |
dīkṣita-strī-prasaṅgena jāyate duṣṭa-rakta-sṛk ||61||
sva-jātijāyā-gamane jāyate hṛdaya-vraṇī |
jāty-unnata-strī-gamane jāyate mastaka-vraṇī ||62||
paśu-yonau ca gamanān mūtra-ghātaḥ prajāyate |
ete doṣā narāṇāṃ syur narakānte na saṃśayaḥ ||63||
strīṇām api bhavanty ete tat-tat-puruṣa-saṅgamāt |
evaṃ rājan hi cihnāni kīrtitāni supāpinām ||64||
dāna-puṇya-prasaṅgena tīrthādi-kriyayā tathā |
rāmasya caritaṃ śrutvā tapasā vā kṣayaṃ vrajet ||65||
sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ hari-kīrti-dhunī nṛṇām |
kṣālayet pāpināṃ paṅkaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||66||
yonāv amanyeta hariṃ tasya yāgā vidhi-śrutāḥ |
tīrthāny api supuṇyāni pāvituṃ na kṣamāṇi tam ||67||
hasate kīrtyamānaṃ yaś caritraṃ jñāna-durbalaḥ |
na tasya narakān muktiḥ kalpānte'pi bhaviṣyati ||68||
yāhi rājan vimokṣārthaṃ hayasyānucaraiḥ saha |
śrāvaya śrīśa-caritaṃ yato vāha-gatir bhavet ||69||
śeṣa uvāca— 
iti śrutvā prahṛṣṭo'bhūc chatrughnaḥ para-vīra-hā |
praṇamyataṃ parikramya yayau sevaka-saṃyutaḥ ||70||
tatra gatvā sa-hanumān haya-varyasya pārśvataḥ |
uvāca rāma-caritaṃ mahā-durgati-nāśakam ||71||
yāhi deva-vimānaṃ svaṃ rāma-kīrtana-puṇyataḥ |
svairaṃ carasva loke tvaṃ mukto bhava kuyonitaḥ ||72||
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya śatrughno yāvad-āsthitaḥ |
tāvad dadarśa vimalaṃ devaṃ vaimānikaṃ varam ||73||
sa uvāca vimukto'haṃ rāma-kīrtana-saṃśruteḥ |
yāmi svaṃ bhavanaṃ rājann ājṣāpaya mahā-mate ||74||
ity uktvā prayayau devo vimāne sve paristhitaḥ |
tadā vismayam āpus te śatrughnena sahānugāḥ ||75||
tato vāho vinirmukto gātra-stambhāc ca bhū-talāt |
yayau tad vipinaṃ sarvaṃ bhraman pakṣi-samākulam ||76||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe rāmāśvamedhe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde 
haya-nirmuktir nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||48||

(49)
ekonapaṣcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ

śeṣa uvāca—
māsāḥ saptābhavaṃ s tasya hayavar yasya helayā |
caratobhārataṃ varṣamanekanṛpapūritam ||1||
sapūjitobhūpavaraiḥ parītyavarabhāratam |
parīvṛtovīravaraiḥ śatrughnādibhir udbhaṭaiḥ ||2||
sababhrāmabahūndeśānhimālayasamīpataḥ |
nakopitaṃ nijagrāhahayaṃ rāmabalaṃ smaran ||3||
aṃ gavaṃ gakaliṃ gānāṃ rājabhiḥ saṃstutohayaḥ |
jagāmarājṣonagaresurathasyamanohare ||4||
kuṇḍalaṃ nāmanagaraṃ aditer yatra kuṇḍalam |
karṇayoḥ patitaṃ bhūmauharṣabhayasukaṃ payoḥ ||5||
 yatra dharmavyatikrāṃ tiṃ na karoti kadāpi nā |
śrī-rāmasmaraṇaṃ premṇākarotijanatānvaham ||6||
aśvatthānāṃ tuyatrārcātulasyāḥ pratyahaṃ nṛbhiḥ |
kriyateraghunāthasyasevakaiḥ pāpavarjitaiḥ ||7||
 yatra devālayāramyārāghavapratimāyutāḥ |
pūjyaṃ tepratyahaṃ śuddhacittaiḥ kapaṭavarjitaiḥ ||8||
vācināmaharer yatra na vai kalahasaṃkathā |
hṛdidhyānaṃ tu tasyai vana ca kāmaphalasmṛtiḥ ||9||
devanaṃ yatra rāmasyavārttābhiḥ pūtadehinām |
na jātu cinnṛṇāmastisatyavyasanamāninām ||10||
 tasmin vasatidharmātmāsurathaḥ satyavānbalī |
raghunāthapadasmārahṛṣṭacittaḥ paronmadaḥ ||11||
kiṃ varṇayāmirāmasyasevakaṃ surathaṃ varam |
yasyāśeṣaguṇābhūmauvistṛtāḥ pāvayanty agham ||12||
sevakās tasya bhūpasya paryaṭantaḥ kadācana |
apaśyanhayamedhasyahayaṃ candana ca rcitam ||13||
tedṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ prāptāhayapatramalokayan |
spaṣṭākṣarasamāyuktaṃ candanādikacarcitam ||14||
 jṣātvā rāmeṇasaṃmuktaṃ hayaṃ netramanoharam |
hṛṣṭārājṣesabhāsthāyakathayāmāsurutsukāḥ ||15||
svāminnayodhyānagarīpatistasyāsturāghavaḥ |
hayamedhakratoryogyohayomuktaḥ paribhraman ||16||
satepurasyanikaṭe prāptaḥ sevaka-saṃyutaḥ |
gṛhāṇatvaṃ mahā-rājahayaṃ taṃ sumanoharam ||17||
śeṣa uvāca— 
iti śrutvā nijaproktaṃ vākyaṃ harṣapariplutaḥ |
 uvāca vīrānbalinomeghagaṃ bhariyāgirā ||18||
suratha uvāca 
dhanyāvayaṃ rāmamukhaṃ paśyāmaḥ sahasevakāḥ |
grahīṣyāmihayaṃ tasya bhaṭakoṭiparīvṛtam ||19||
tadāmokṣyāmivāhaṃ taṃ yadārāmaḥ samāvrajet |
kṛtārthaṃ mama bhaktasya ciraṃ dhyānara tasya vai ||20||
śeṣa uvāca— 
ittham uktvāmahīpālaḥ sevakānsvayamādiśat |
gṛhṇaṃ tuvāhaṃ prasabhaṃ mocyonāśvo'kṣigocaraḥ ||21||
anenasumahāṃ ṃ llābhobhaviṣyati tumematam |
yadrāmacaraṇauprekṣebrahmaśakrādidurlabhau ||22||
sa evadhanyaḥ svajanaḥ putrovābāndhavo'thavā |
paśurvāvāhanaṃ vāpirāmāptiryenasambhavet ||23||
tasmād gṛhītvākratvaśvaṃ svarṇapatreṇaśobhitam |
badhnaṃ tuvājiśālāyāṃ kāmavegaṃ manoramam ||24||
ity uktāstetato gatvā vāhaṃ rāmasyaśobhitam |
gṛhītvātarasārājṣedaduḥ sarvaṃśubhāṃ ginam ||25||
rājāprāpyamudācāśvaṃ rāmasyadanujārdanaḥ |
sevakān prāhabalinodharmakṛtyavicakṣaṇaḥ ||26||
vātsyāyanamahā-buddheśṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ |
na tasya viṣayekaścitparadāraratonaraḥ ||27||
naparadravyanirato na ca kāmeṣu lampaṭaḥ |
najihvābhir atonmārgekīrttayedrāma-kīrtanāt ||28||
yaḥ sevakānnṛpovaktiyūyaṃ sevārthamāgatāḥ |
kathayaṃ tubhavacceṣṭāndharmakarma-viśāradāḥ ||29||
ekapatnīvratadharānaparadravyalolupāḥ |
parāpavādāniratāna ca vedotpathaṃ gatāḥ ||30||
śrī-rāmasmaraṇādīnikurvanti pratyahaṃ bhaṭāḥ |
tānahaṃ rāmasevārthaṃ rakṣāmyaṃ takakopavān ||31||
etadviruddhadharmāṇoyenarāḥ pāpa-saṃyutāḥ |
tānahaṃ viṣayemahyaṃ vāsayāminadurmatīn ||32||
 tasya deśenapāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpaṅkurvanti mānase |
haridhyānahatāśeṣapātakāmoda-saṃyutāḥ ||33||
yadaivamabhavaddeśorājādharmeṇa-saṃyutaḥ |
tadātatsthānarāḥ sarve mṛtāgacchanti nirvṛtim ||34||
yamānucaranirveśonābhavatsaurathepure |
tadāyamomunerūpaṃ dhṛtvāprāgānmahīśvaram ||35||
valkalāṃ baradhārīcajaṭāśobhitaśīrṣakaḥ |
surathaṃ tusabhā-madhye dadarśaharisevakam ||36||
tulasīmastake yasya vācināmahareḥ param |
dharmakarmaratāṃ vārttāṃ śrāvayaṃ taṃ nijāṣjanān ||37||
tadāmuniṃ nṛpodṛṣṭvā tapomūrtimivasthitam |
vavandecaraṇau tasya pādyādikamathākarot ||38||
sukhopaviṣṭaṃ viśrāntaṃ muniṃ prāhanṛpāgraṇīḥ |
dhanyamadyajanurmahyaṃ dhanyamadyagṛhaṃ mama ||39||
kathāḥ kathayatānmahyaṃ rāmasyavividhāvarāḥ |
yāḥ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpahānirbhaviṣyati padepade ||40||
ittham uktaṃ samākarṇyajahāsasamunirbhṛśam |
daṃ tān pradarśayansarvāṃ stālāsphālitapāṇikaḥ ||41||
hasaṃtaṃ taṃ muniṃ prāhahasanekāraṇaṃ kimu |
kathayasva prasādena yathā syānmanasaḥ sukham ||42||
tato munirnṛpaṃ prāhaśṛṇu rājan dhiyāyutaḥ |
yadahaṃ te'bhidhāsyāmismitekāraṇam uttamam ||43||
tvayāproktaṃ hareḥ kīrtiṃ kathayasva mamāgrataḥ |
kohariḥ kasyavākīrtiḥ sarve karmavaśānarāḥ ||44||
karmaṇāprāpyatesvargaḥ karmaṇānarakaṃ vrajet |
karmaṇaivabhavetsarvaṃ putrapautrādikaṃ bahu ||45||
śakraḥ śataṃ kratūnāṃ tukṛtvāgātparamaṃ padam |
brahmāpikarmaṇālokaṃ prāpyasatyākhyamadbhutam ||46||
anekekarmaṇāsiddhāmarudādayaīśinaḥ |
kurvantibhogasaukhyaṃ ca apsarogaṇasevitāḥ ||47||
tasmāt kuruṣvayajṣādīnyajasvakiladevatāḥ |
 yathā tevimalākīrtirbhaviṣyati mahītale ||48||
iti śrutvā tutad-vākyaṃ kopakṣubhitamānasaḥ |
 uvāca rāmaikamanāvipraṃ karma-viśāradam ||49||
mābrūhi karmaṇovārtāṃ kṣayiṣṇuphaladāyinīm |
gacchamannagaropāṃ tādbahirlokavigarhitaḥ ||50||
indraḥ patiṣyati kṣipraṃ patiṣyaty apipadmajaḥ |
napatiṣyanti manujārāmasyabhajanotsukāḥ ||51||
paśyadhruvaṃ caprahlādaṃ vibhīṣaṇamathādbhutam |
yecānyerāmabhaktāvaikadāpi napatanti te ||52||
yerāmaniṃ dakāduṣṭāstānimeyamakiṃ karāḥ |
tāḍayiṣyanti lohasyamudgaraiḥ pāśabandhanaiḥ ||53||
brāhmaṇatvāddehadaṇḍaṃ nakuryāṃ tedvijādhama |
gacchagacchamadālokāttāḍayiṣyāmicān yathā ||54||
ittham uktavatiśreṣṭhebhūpesurathasaṃjṣite |
sevakābāhunādhṛtvāniṣkāsayitumudyatāḥ ||55||
tadāyamonijaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvālokaikavanditam |
prāhabhūpaṃ pratuṣṭo’smi yācasvaharisevaka ||56||
mayā pralobhitovāgbhir bahvībhir apisuvrata |
calitosinarāmasyasevāyāḥ sādhusevitaḥ ||57||
tadāprovāca bhūmīśoyamaṃ dṛṣṭvā sutoṣitam |
 uvāca yadituṣṭosidehimevaram uttamam ||58||
tāvanmama na vai mṛtyuryāvadrāmasamāgamaḥ |
nabhayaṃ mebhavattohikadācanahidharmarāṭ ||59||
tadovācayamobhūpamidaṃ tavabhaviṣyati |
sarvaṃ tvadīpsitaṃ tathyaṃ kariṣyati raghoḥ patiḥ ||60||
ity uktvā ntarhitodharmo jagāmasvapuraṃ prati |
praśasya tasya caritaṃ haribhaktiparātmanaḥ ||61||
sarājādhārmikorāmasevakaḥ parayā mudā |
gṛhītvāśvaṃ praty uvāca sevakānharisevakān ||62||
mayā gṛhītovāho'saurāghavasyamahīpateḥ |
sajjībhavantu sarvatra yūyaṃ raṇa-viśāradāḥ ||63||
itiproktāstutesarve bhaṭārājṣomahā-balāḥ |
sajjībhūtāḥ kṣaṇād eva sabhāyāṃ jagmurutsukāḥ ||64||
rājṣovīrādaśasutāścampakomohakas tathā |
ripuṣjayo'tidurvāraḥ pratāpībalamodakaḥ ||65||
haryakṣaḥ sahadevaścabhūridevaḥ sutāpanaḥ |
itirājṣodaśasutāḥ sajjībhūtāraṇāṅgaṇe ||66||
yātumicchāmakurvaṃ stemaho tsāhasamanvitāḥ |
rājāpisvarathaṃ citraṃ hemaśobhāvinirmitam ||67||
āhvayāmāsasujavair vājibhiḥ samalaṅkṛtam |
raṇotsāhena-saṃyuktaḥ sarvasainyaparīvṛtaḥ ||68||
sabhāyāṃ sevakānsarvāndiśannāstemahīpatiḥ ||69||
iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śeṣa-vātsyāyana-saṃvāde rāmāśvamedhe suratha-
rājṣāhayagrahaṇaṃ nāma ekonapaṣcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||49|| 

paṣcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ 
śeṣa uvāca— 
atharāmānujovegātsamāgatyasvasevakān |
papraccha kutra vāho'sauyājṣikaḥ sumanoharaḥ ||1||
tadātevacanaṃ procuḥ śatrughnaṃ sumahā-balāḥ |
najānīmobhaṭāḥ keciddhayaṃ nītvāgatāḥ pure ||2||
vayaṃ cadhikkṛtāḥ sarve balibhīrājasevakaiḥ |
atrapramāṇaṃ bhagavān itikartavyatāṃ prati ||3||
tac chrutvāvacanaṃ teṣāṃ śatrughnaḥ kupitobhṛśam |
daśanroṣātsvadaśanāṣjihvayālelihanmuhuḥ ||4||
 uvāca vīromadvāhaṃ hṛtvā kutra gamiṣyasi |
idānīṃ pātayebāṇaiḥ puraṃ janasamanvitam ||5||
ity uktvā sumatiṃ prāhakasyedaṃ puṭabhedanam |
kovartate'syādhipatiryomevāhamajīharat ||6||
śeṣa uvāca— 
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇyabhūpateḥ kopa-saṃyutam |
jagādamantrīsugirāsphuṭākṣarasamanvitam ||7||
viddhīdaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ nāmanagaraṃ sumanoharam |
asminvasatidharmātmāsurathaḥ kṣattriyobalī ||8||
nityaṃ dharmaparorāmacaraṇadvandvasevakaḥ |
manasākarmaṇāvācāhanūmānivasevakaḥ ||9||
caritān yasya śataśovartante dharmakāriṇaḥ |
mahā-balaparīvāraḥ surathaḥ sarvaśobhanaḥ ||10||
mahadyuddhaṃ bhavedatrahṛtaścedvāhasattamaḥ |
anekeprapatiṣyanti vīrāraṇa-viśāradāḥ ||11||
evam uktaṃ samāśrutyaśatrughnaḥ sacivaṃ prati |
 uvāca punar apyevaṃ vacanaṃ vadatāṃ varaḥ ||12||
śatrughna uvāca 
kathamatraprakartavyaṃ rāmāśvo'nenaceddhṛtaḥ |
nāyātiyoddhuṃ prabalaṅkaṭakaṃ vīrasevitam ||13||
sumatir uvāca— 
dūtaḥ preṣyomahā-rājarājānaṃ prativāgmikaḥ |
yadvākyenasamāyātibalenabalināṃ varaḥ ||14||
nocedajñānatovāhodhṛtaḥ kenāpimāninā |
arpayiṣyati naḥ sādhumaśvaṃ kratuvaraṃ śubham ||15||
iti śrutvā tutad-vākyaṃ śatrughnobuddhimānbalī |
aṃ gadaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ vinayānvitam ||16||
śatrughna uvāca 
yāhitvaṃ nikaṭasthevaisurathasyamahā-pure |
dūtatvenatato gatvā prabrūhi nṛpatiṃ prati ||17||
tvayādhṛtorāmavāhojñānato'jñānatopivā |
arpayatunavāyātupradhanaṃ vīra-saṃyutam ||18||
rāmasyadautyaṃ laṅkāyāṃ rāvaṇaṃ pratiyatkṛtam |

vṛndāvana-māhātmyaṃ 

(69)
ekonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ—
samyak śruto mahā-bhāga tvatto rāmāśvamedhakaḥ |
idānīṃ vada māhātmyaṃ śrī-kṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ||1||
sūta uvāca—
śṛṇvantu muni-śārdūlāḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-caritāmṛtam |
śivā papraccha bhūteśaṃ yat tad vaḥ kīrtayāmy aham ||2||
ekadā pārvatī devī śivaṃ saṃsnigdha-mānasā |
praṇayena namaskṛtya provāca vacanaṃ tv idam ||3||
pārvaty uvāca—
ananta-koṭi-brahmāṇḍa-tad-bāhyābhyantara-sthiteḥ |
viṣṇoḥ sthānaṃ paraṃ teṣāṃ pradhānaṃ varam uttamam ||4||
yat paraṃ nāsti kṛṣṇasya priyaṃ sthānaṃ manoramam |
tat sarvaṃ śrotum icchāmi kathayasva mahā-prabho ||5||
īśvara uvāca—
guhyād guhyataraṃ guhyaṃ paramānanda-kārakam |
atyadbhutaṃ rahaḥ sthānam ānandaṃ paramaṃ param ||6||
durlabhānāṃ ca paramaṃ durlabhaṃ mohanaṃ param |
sarva-śakti-mayaṃ devi sarva-sthāneṣu gopitam ||7||
sātvatāṃs thāna-mūrddhanyaṃ viṣṇor atyanta-durlabham |
nityaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma brahmāṇḍopari-saṃsthitam ||8||
pūrṇa-brahma sukhaiśvaryaṃ nityam ānandam avyayam |
vaikuṇṭhādi tadaṃśāṃśaṃ svayaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ bhuvi ||9||
golokaiśvaryaṃ yat kiṣcid gokule tat-pratiṣṭhitam |
vaikuṇṭha-vaibhavaṃ yad vai dvārikāyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||10||
yad brahma paramaiśvaryaṃ nityaṃ vṛndāvanāśrayam |
kṛṣṇa-dhāma paraṃ teṣāṃ vana--madhye viśeṣataḥ ||11||
tasmāt trailokya-madhye tu pṛthvī dhanyeti viśrutā |
yasmān māthurakaṃ nāma viṣṇor ekānta-vallabham ||12||
sva-sthānam adhikaṃ nāma-dheyaṃ māthura-maṇḍalam |
nigūḍhaṃ vividhaṃ sthānaṃ pury-abhyantara-saṃsthitam ||13||
sahasra-patra-kamalākāraṃ māthura-maṇḍalam |
viṣṇu-cakra-paribhrāmād dhāma vaiṣṇavam adbhutam ||14||
karṇikā-parṇa-vistāraṃ rahasya-drumam īritam |
pradhānaṃ dvādaśāraṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ kramāt ||15||
bhadra-śrī-loha-bhāṇḍīra-mahā-tāla-khadīrakāḥ |
bakulaṃ kumudaṃ kāmyaṃ madhu vṛndā vanaṃ tathā ||16||
dvādaśaitāvatī saṃkhyā kālindyāḥ sapta-paścime |
pūrve paṣca-vanaṃ proktaṃ tatrāsti guhyam uttamam ||17||
mahāraṇyaṃ gokulākhyaṃ madhu vṛndā-vanaṃ tathā |
anyac copavanaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣṇa-krīḍā-rasa-sthalam ||18||
kadamba-khaṇḍanaṃ nanda-vanaṃ nandīśvaraṃ tathā |
nanda-nandana-khaṇḍaṃ ca palāśāśoka-ketakī ||19||
sugandha-mānasaṃ kailamamṛtaṃ bhojana-sthalam |
sukha-prasādhanaṃ vatsa-haraṇaṃ śeṣa-śāyikam ||20||
śyāma-pūrvo dadhi-grāmaś cakra-bhānu-puraṃ tathā |
saṃketaṃ dvipadaṃ caiva bāla-krīḍana-dhūsaram ||21||
kāma-drumaṃ sulalitam utsukaṃ cāpi kānanam |
nānā-vidha-rasa-krīḍā nānā-līlā-rasa-sthalam ||22||
nāga-vistāra-viṣṭambhaṃ rahasya-drumam īritam |
sahasra-patra-kamalaṃ gokulākhyaṃ mahat-padam ||23||
karṇikā tan mahad dhāma govinda-sthānam uttamam |
tatropari svarṇa-pīṭhe maṇi-maṇḍapa-maṇḍitam ||24||
karṇikāyāṃ kramād dikṣu vidikṣu dalam īritam |
yad dalaṃ dakṣiṇe proktaṃ paraṃ guhyottamottamam ||25||
tasmin dale mahā-pīṭhaṃ nigamāgama-durgamam |
yogīndrair api duṣprāpaṃ sarvātmā yac ca gokulam ||26||
dvitīyaṃ dalam āgneyyāṃ tad rahasya-dalaṃ tathā |
saṃketaṃ dvipadaṃ caiva kuṭī dvau tat-kule sthitau ||27||
pūrvaṃ dalaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca pradhāna-sthānam uttamam |
gaṅgādi-sarva-tīrthānāṃ sparśāc chata-guṇaṃ smṛtam ||28||
caturthaṃ dalam aiśānyāṃ siddha-pīṭhe'pi tat- padam |
vyāyāmanūtanāgopī tatra kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ labhet ||29||
vastrālaṅkāraharaṇaṃ taddalesamudāhṛtam |
uttarepaṣcamaṃ proktaṃ dalaṃ sarvadalottamam ||30||
dvādaśādityamatraivadalaṃ cakarṇikāsamam |
vāyavyāṃ tu dalaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tatra kālī-hradaḥ smṛtaḥ ||31||
dalottamottamaṃ caiva pradhānaṃ sthānam ucyate |
sarvottama-dalaṃ caiva paścime saptamaṃ smṛtam ||32||
yajṣa-patnī-gaṇānāṃ ca tad-īpsita-vara-pradam |
atrāsuro’pi nirvāṇaṃ prāpa tridaśa-durlabham ||33||
brahma-mohanam atraiva dalaṃ brahma-hradāvaham |
nair ṛtyāṃ tu dalaṃ proktam aṣṭamaṃ vyoma-ghātanam ||34||
śaṅkhacūḍa-vadhas tatra nānā-keli-rasa-sthalam |
śrutam aṣṭa-dalaṃ proktaṃ vṛndāraṇyāntara-sthitam ||35||
śrīmad-vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ yamunāyāḥ pradakṣiṇam |
śiva-liṅgam adhiṣṭhānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ gopīśvarābhidham ||36||
tad-bāhye ṣoḍaśa-dalaṃ śriyā pūrṇaṃ tam īśvaram |
sarvāsu dikṣu yat proktaṃ prādakṣiṇyād yathā kramam ||37||
mahat-padaṃ mahad-dhāma sva-dhāmādhāva-saṃjṣakam |
prathamaika-dalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ māhātmyaṃ karṇikā-samam ||38||
tatra govardhana-girau ramye nitya-rasāśraye |
karṇikāyāṃ mahā-līlā tal-līlā-rasa-gahvarau ||39||
yatra kṛṣṇo nitya-vṛndā-kānanasya patir bhavet |
kṛṣṇo govindatāṃ prāptaḥ kim anyair bahu-bhāṣitaiḥ ||40||
dalaṃ tṛtīyam ākhyātaṃ sarva-śreṣṭhottamottamam |
caturthaṃ dalam ākhyātaṃ mahādbhuta-rasa-sthalam ||41||
nandīśvara-vanaṃ ramyaṃ tatra nandālayaḥ smṛtaḥ |
karṇikā-dala-māhātmyaṃ paṣcamaṃ dalam ucyate ||42||
adhiṣṭhātā'tra gopālo dhenu-pālana-tat-paraḥ |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ dalaṃ yad ākhyātaṃ tatra nanda-vanaṃ smṛtam ||43||
saptamaṃ bakulāraṇyaṃ dalaṃ ramyaṃ prakīrtitam |
tatrāṣṭamaṃ tāla-vanaṃ tatra dhenu-vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||44||
navamaṃ kumudāraṇyaṃ dalaṃ ramyaṃ prakīrtitam |
kāmāraṇyaṃ ca daśamaṃ padhānaṃ sarva-kāraṇam ||45||
brahma-prasādhanaṃ tatra viṣṇu-cchadma-pradarśanam |
kṛṣṇa-krīḍā-rasa-sthānaṃ pradhānaṃ dalam ucyate ||46||
dalam ekādaśaṃ proktaṃ bhaktānugraha-kāraṇam |
nirmāṇaṃ setu-bandhasya nānā-vana-maya-sthalam ||47||
bhāṇḍīraṃ dvādaśa-dalaṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ manoharam |
kṛṣṇaḥ krīḍā-ratas tatra śrī-dāmādibhir āvṛtaḥ ||48||
trayodaśaṃ dalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatra bhadra-varaṃ smṛtam |
caturdaśa-dalaṃ proktaṃ sarva-siddhi-prada-sthalam ||49||
śrī-vanaṃ tatra ruciraṃ sarvaiśvaryasya kāraṇam |
kṛṣṇa-krīḍā-dala-mayaṃ śrī-kānti-kīrti-vardhanam ||50||
dalaṃ paṣcadaśaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatra loha-vanaṃ smṛtam |
kathitaṃ ṣoḍaśa-dalaṃ māhātmyaṃ karṇikā-samam ||51||
mahā-vanaṃ tatra gītaṃ tatrāsti guhyam uttamam |
bāla-krīḍā-ratas tatra vatsa-pālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||52||
pūtanādi-vadhas tatra yamalārjuna-bhaṣjanam |
adhiṣṭhātā tatra bāla-gopālaḥ paṣcamābdikaḥ ||53||
nāmnā dāmodaraḥ proktaḥ premānanda-rasārṇavaḥ |
dalaṃ prasiddham ākhyātaṃ sarva-śreṣṭha-dalottamam ||54||
kṛṣṇa-krīḍā ca kiṣjalkī vihāra-dalam ucyate |
siddha-pradhāna-kiṣjalka-dalaṃ ca samudāhṛtam ||55||
pārvaty uvāca—
vṛndāraṇyasya māhātmyaṃ rahasyaṃ vā kim adbhutam |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi kathayasva mahā-prabho ||56||
īśvara uvāca—
kathitaṃ te priyatame guhyād guhyottamottamam |
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ yad durlabhānāṃ ca durlabham ||57||
trailokya-gopitaṃ devi deveśvara-supūjitam |
brahmādi-vāṣchitaṃ sthānaṃ sura-siddhādi-sevitam ||58||
yogīndrā hi sadā bhaktyā tasya dhyānaika-tat-parāḥ |
apsarobhiś ca gandharvair nṛtya-gīta-nirantaram ||59||
śrīmad-vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ pūrṇānanda-rasāśrayam |
bhūri-cintāmaṇis toyam amṛtaṃ rasa-pūritam ||60||
vṛkṣaṃ guru-drumaṃ tatra surabhī-vṛnda-sevitam |
strīṃ lakṣmīṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ tad-daśāṃśa-samudbhavam ||61||
tatra kaiśora-vayasaṃ nityam ānanda-vigraham |
gati-nāṭyaṃ kalālāpa-smita-vaktraṃ nirantaram ||62||
śuddha-sattvaiḥ prema-pūrṇair vaiṣṇavais tad-vanāśritam |
pūrṇa-brahma sukhe magnaṃ sphurat-tan-mūrti-tan-mayam ||63||
matta-kokila-bhṛṅgādyaiḥ kūjat-kala-manoharam |
kapola-śuka-saṅgītam unmattāli-sahasrakam ||64||
bhujaṅga-śatru-nṛtyāḍhyaṃ sakalāmoda-vibhramam |
nānā-varṇaiś ca kusumais tad-reṇu-paripūritam ||65||
pūrṇendu-nityābhyudayaṃ sūrya-mandāṃśusevitam |
aduḥkhaṃ duḥkha-vicchedaṃ jarā-maraṇa-varjitam ||66||
akrodhaṃ gata-mātsaryam abhinnam anahaṅkṛtam |
pūrṇānandāmṛta-rasam pūrṇa-prema-sukhārṇavam ||67||
guṇātītaṃ mahad-dhāma pūrṇa-prema-svarūpakam |
vṛkṣādi-pulakair yatra premānandāśru-varṣitam ||68||
kiṃ punaś cetanā-yuktair viṣṇu-bhaktaiḥ kim ucyate |
govindāṅghri-rajaḥ sparśān nityaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ bhuvi ||69||
sahasra-dala-padmasya vṛndāraṇyaṃ varāṭakam |
yasya sparśana-mātreṇa pṛthvī dhanyā jagat-traye ||70||
guhyād guhyataraṃ ramyaṃ madhye vṛndāvanaṃ bhuvi |
akṣaraṃ paramānandaṃ govinda-sthānam avyayam ||71||
govinda-dehato'bhinnaṃ pūrṇa-brahma sukhāśrayam |
muktis tatra rajaḥ sparśāt tan-māhātmyaṃ kim ucyate ||72||
tasmāt sarvātmanā devi hṛdi-sthaṃ tad vanaṃ kuru |
vṛndāvana-vihāreṣu kṛṣṇaṃ kaiśora-vigraham ||73||
kālindī cākarod yasya karṇikāyāṃ pradakṣiṇām |
līlā-nirvāṇa-gambhīraṃ jalaṃ saurabha-mohanam ||74||
ānandāmṛta-tan-miśra-makaranda-ghanālayam |
padmotpalādyaiḥ kusumair nānā-varṇa-samujjavalam ||75||
cakravākādi-vihagair maṣju-nānā-kala-svanaiḥ |
śobhamānaṃ jalaṃ ramyantaraṃ gāti-manoramam ||76||
tasyobhaya-taṭī-ramyā śuddha-kāṣcana-nirmitā |
gaṅgā-koṭi-guṇā proktā yatra sparśa-varāṭakaḥ ||77||
karṇikāyāṃ koṭi-guṇo yatra krīḍā-rato hariḥ |
kālindī-karṇikā kṛṣṇam abhinnam eka-vigraham ||78||
pārvaty uvāca— 
govindasya kim āścaryaṃ saundaryākṛta-vigraha |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi kathayasva dayā-nidhe ||79||
īśvara uvāca— 
madhye vṛndāvane ramye-maṣju-maṣjīra-śobhite |
yojanāśrita-sad-vṛkṣa-śākhā-pallava-maṇḍite ||80||
tan-madhye maṣju-bhavane yoga-pīṭhaṃ samujjavalam |
tad-aṣṭa-koṇa-nirmāṇaṃ nānā-dīpti-manoharam ||81||
tasyopari ca māṇikya-ratna-siṃhāsanaṃ śubham |
tasmin naṣṭa-dalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ sukhāśrayam ||82||
govindasya paraṃ sthānaṃ kim asya mahimocyate |
śrīmad-govinda-mantra-stha-ballavī-vṛnda-sevitam ||83||
divya-vraja-vayo-rūpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vṛndāvaneśvaram |
vrajendraṃ santataiśvaryaṃ vraja-bālaika-vallabham ||84||
yauvanodbhinna-kaiśoraṃ vayasādbhuta-vigraham |
anādim ādiṃ sarveṣāṃ nanda-gopa-priyātmajam ||85||
śruti-mṛgyam ajaṃ nityaṃ gopī-jana-manoharam |
paraṃ dhāma paraṃ rūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ gokuleśvaram ||86||
ballavī-nandanaṃ dhyāyen nirguṇasyaika-kāraṇam |
suśrīmantaṃ navaṃ svacchaṃ śyāma-dhāma manoharam ||87||
navīna-nīrada-śreṇī-susnigdhaṃ maṣju-kuṇḍalam |
phullendīvara-sat-kānti-sukha-sparśaṃ sukhāvaham ||88||
dalitāṃ jana-puṣjābha-cikkaṇaṃ śyāma-mohanam |
susnigdha-nīla-kuṭilāśeṣa-saurabha-kuntalam ||89||
tad-ūrdhvaṃ dakṣiṇe kāle śyāma-cūḍā-manoharam |
nānā-varṇojjvalaṃ rājac-chikhaṇḍi-dala-maṇḍitam ||90||
mandāra-maṣju-go-pucchā-cūḍaṃ cāru-vibhūṣaṇam |
kvacid bṛhad-dala-śreṇī-mukuṭenābhimaṇḍitam ||91||
aneka-maṇi-māṇikya-kirīṭa-bhūṣaṇaṃ kvacit |
lolālaka-vṛtaṃ rājat-koṭi-candra-samānanam ||92||
kastūrī-tilakaṃ bhrājan-maṣju-go-rocanānvitam |
nīlendīvara-susnigdha-sudīrgha-dala-locanam ||93||
ānṛtyad-bhrū-latāśleṣa-smitaṃ sāci-nirīkṣaṇam |
sucārūnnata-saundarya-nāsāgrāti-manoharam ||94||
nāsāgra-gaja-muktāṃśu-mugdhīkṛta-jagat-trayam |
sindūrāruṇa-susnigdhādharauṣṭha-sumanoharam ||95||
nānā-varṇollasat-svarṇa-makarākṛti-kuṇḍalam |
tad-raśmi-puṣja-sad-gaṇḍa-mukurābha-lasad-dyutim ||96||
karṇotpala-sumandāra-makarottaṃsa-bhūṣitam |
śrī-vatsa-kaustubhoraskaṃ muktā-hāra-sphurad-galam ||97||
vilasad-divya-māṇikyaṃ maṣju-kāṣcana-miśritam |
kare kaṅkaṇa-keyūraṃ kiṅkiṇī-kaṭi-śobhitam ||98||
maṣju-maṣjīra-saundarya-śrīmad-aṅghri-virājitam |
karpūrāguru-kastūrī-vilasac-candanādikam ||99||
gorocanādi-saṃmiśra-divyāṅga-rāga-citritam |
snigdha-pīta-paṭī-rājat-prapadāṃ dolitāṃ janam ||100||
gambhīra-nābhi-kamalaṃ roma-rājī-nata-srajam |
suvṛtta-jānu-yugalaṃ pāda-padma-manoharam ||101||
dhvaja-vajrāṅkuśāmbhoja-karāṅghri-tala-śobhitam |
nakhendu-kiraṇa-śreṇī-pūrṇa-brahmaika-kāraṇam ||102||
kecid vadanti tasyāṃśaṃ brahma cid-rūpam advayam |
tad-daśāṃśaṃ mahā-viṣṇuṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||103||
yogīndraiḥ sanakādyaiś ca tad eva hṛdi cintyate |
tri-bhaṅgaṃ lalitāśeṣa-nirmāṇa-sāra-nirmitam ||104||
tiryag-grīva-jitānanta-koṭi-kandarpa-sundaram |
vāmāṃsārpita-sad-gaṇḍa-sphurat-kāṣcana-kuṇḍalam ||105||
sahāpāṅgekṣaṇa-smeraṃ koṭi-manmatha-sundaram |
kuṣcitādhara-vinyasta-vaṃśī-maṣju-kala-svanaiḥ ||106||
jagat-trayaṃ mohayantaṃ magnaṃ prema-sudhārṇave |
śrī-pārvaty uvāca—
paramaṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ govindākhyaṃ mahat-padam ||107||
vṛndāvaneśvaraṃ nityaṃ nirguṇasyaika-kāraṇam |
tat tad rahasya-māhātmyaṃ kim āścaryaṃ ca sundaram ||108||
tad brūhi devadeveśa śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ prabho |
īśvara uvāca—
yad-aṅghri-nakha-candrāṃśu-mahimānto na gamyate ||109||
tan-māhātmyaṃ kiyad devi procyate tvaṃ mudā śṛṇu |
ananta-koṭi-brahmāṇḍe ananta-triguṇocchraye ||110||
tat-kalā-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśā brahma-viṣṇu-maheśvarāḥ |
sṛṣṭi-sthity-ādinā yuktās tiṣṭhanti tasya vaibhavāḥ ||111||
tad-rūpa-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśāḥ kalāḥ kandarpa-vigrahāḥ |
jagan-mohaṃ prakurvanti tad-aṇḍāntara-saṃsthitāḥ ||112||
tad-deha-vilasat-kānti-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśako vibhuḥ |
tat-prakāśasya koṭy-aṃśa-raśmayo ravi-vigrahāḥ ||113||
tasya sva-deha-kiraṇaiḥ parānanda-rasāmṛtaiḥ |
paramāmoda-cid-rūpair nirguṇasyaika-kāraṇaiḥ ||114||
tad-aṃśa-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśā jīvanti kiraṇātmakāḥ |
tad-aṅghri-paṅkaja-dvandva-nakha-candra-maṇi-prabhāḥ ||115||
āhuḥ pūrṇa-brahmaṇo’pi kāraṇaṃ veda-durgamam |
tad-aṃśa-saurabhānanta-koṭy-aṃśo viśva-mohanaḥ ||116||
tat-sparśa-puṣpa-gandhādi-nānā-saurabha-sambhavaḥ |
tat-priyā prakṛtis tv ādyā rādhikā kṛṣṇa-vallabhā ||117||
tat-kalā-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśā durgādyās tri-guṇātmikāḥ |
tasyā aṅghri-rajasaḥ sparśāt koṭi-viṣṇuḥ prajāyate ||118||

ekona-saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

pārvaty uvāca—
yad-ākarṇanam etasya ye vā pāriṣadāḥ prabhoḥ |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi kathayasva dayā-nidhe ||1||
īśvara uvāca— 
rādhayā saha govindaṃ svarṇa-siṃhāsane sthitam |
pūrvokta-rūpa-lāvaṇyaṃ divya-bhūṣāmbara-srajam ||2||
tri-bhaṅgī-maṣju-susnigdhaṃ gopī-locana-tārakam |
tad-bāhye yoga-pīṭhe ca svarṇa-siṃhāsanāvṛte ||3||
pratyaṅga-rabhasāveśāḥ pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ |
lalitādyāḥ prakṛty-aṃśā mūla-prakṛtī rādhikā ||4||
saṃmukhe lalitā devī śyāmalā vāyu-koṇake |
uttare śrīmatī dhanyā aiśānyāṃ śrī-hari-priyā ||5||
viśākhā ca tathā pūrve śaibyā cāgnau tataḥ param |
padmā ca dakṣiṇe paścān nair ṛte kramaśaḥ sthitāḥ ||6||
yoga-pīṭhe kesarāgre cāru candrāvatī priyā |
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ puṇyāḥ pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ ||7||
pradhāna-prakṛtis tv ādyā rādhā candrāvatī samā |
candrāvalī citrarekhā candrā madana-sundarī ||8||
priyā ca śrī-madhumatī candrarekhā haripriyā |
ṣoḍaśādyāḥ prakṛtayaḥ pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ ||9||
vṛndāvaneśvarī rādhā tathā candrāvalī priyā |
abhinna-guṇa-lāvaṇya-saundaryāś cāru-locanāḥ ||10||
manoharā mugdha-veṣāḥ kiśorī-vayasojjvalāḥ |
agretanās tathā cānyā gopa-kanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||11||
śuddha-kāṣcana-puṣjābhāḥ suprasannāḥ sulocanāḥ |
tad-rūpa-hṛdayārūḍhās tad-āśleṣasam utsukāḥ ||12||
śyāmāmṛta-rase magnāḥ sphurat-tad-bhāva-mānasāḥ |
netrotpalārcite kṛṣṇa-pādābje'rpita-cetasaḥ ||13||
śruti-kanyās tato dakṣe sahasrāyuta-saṃyutāḥ |
jagan-mugdhīkṛtākārā hṛd-varti-kṛṣṇa-lālasāḥ ||14||
nānā-sattva-svarālāpa-mugdhīkṛta-jagat-trayāḥ |
tatra gūḍha-rahasyāni gāyantyaḥ prema-vihvalāḥ ||15||
deva-kanyās tataḥ savye divya-veṣā rasojjvalāḥ |
nānā-vaidigadhya-nipuṇā divya-bhāva-bharānvitāḥ ||16||
saundaryātiśayenāḍhyāḥ kaṭākṣāti-manoharāḥ |
nirlajjās tatra govinde tad-aṅga-sparśanodyatāḥ ||17||
tad-bhāva-magna-manasaḥ smita-sāci-nirīkṣaṇāḥ |
mandirasya tato bāhye priyayā viśadāvṛte ||18||
samāna-veṣa-vayasaḥ samāna-bala-pauruṣāḥ |
samāna-guṇa-karmāṇaḥ samānābharaṇa-priyāḥ ||19||
samāna-svara-saṅgīta-veṇu-vādana-tat-parāḥ |
śrīdāmā paścime dvāre vasudāmā tathottare ||20||
sudāmā ca tathā pūrve kiṅkiṇī cāpi dakṣiṇe |
tad-bāhye svarṇa-pīṭhe ca suvarṇa-mandirāvṛte ||21||
svarṇa-vedy-antara-sthe tu svarṇābharaṇa-bhūṣite |
stokakṛṣṇaṃ subhadrādyair gopālair ayutāyutaiḥ ||22||
śṛṅgavīṇā-veṇu-vetra-vayo-veṣākṛti-svaraiḥ |
tad-guṇa-dhyāna-saṃyuktair gāyadbhir api vihvalaiḥ ||23||
citrārpitaiś citra-rūpaiḥ sadānandāśru-varṣibhiḥ |
pulakākula-sarvāṅgair yogīndrair iva vismitaiḥ ||24||
kṣaraty ayobhir govindair asaṃkhyātair upāvṛtam |
tad-bāhye svarṇa-prākāre koṭi-sūrya-samujjavale ||25||
catur-dikṣu mahodyānaṃ maṣju-saurabha-mohite |
paścime saṃmukhe śrīmat-pārijāta-drumāśraye ||26||
tad-adhas tu svarṇa-pīṭhe svarṇa-maṇḍana-maṇḍite |
tan-madhye maṇi-māṇikya-divya-siṃhāsanojjvale ||27||
tatropari parānandaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagat-prabhum |
triguṇātīta-cid-rūpaṃ sarva-kāraṇa-kāraṇam ||28||
indranīla-ghana-śyāmaṃ nīla-kuṣcita-kuntalam |
padma-patra-viśālākṣaṃ makarākṛti-kuṇḍalam ||29||
catur-bhujaṃ tu cakrāsi-gadā-śaṃkhāmbujāyudham |
ādyantara-hitaṃ nityaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣottamam ||30||
jyotī-rūpaṃ mahad-dhāma-purāṇaṃ vana-mālinam |
pītāmbara-dharaṃ snigdhaṃ divya-bhūṣaṇa-bhūṣitam ||31||
divyānulepanaṃ rājac-citritāṅga-manoharam |
rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca nāgnajitī sulakṣaṇā ||32||
mitravindānuvindā sunandā jāmbavatī priyā |
suśīlā cāṣṭa-mahilā vāsudeva-priyās tataḥ ||33||
udbhrājitāḥ pāriṣadā vṛtayor bhakti-tatparāḥ |
uttare sumahodyāne hari-candana-saṃśraye ||34||
tatrādhastu svarṇa-pīṭhe maṇi-maṇḍapa-maṇḍite |
tan-madhye hema-nirmāṇa-dale siṃhāsanojjavale ||35||
tatraiva saha revatyā saṅkarṣaṇa-halāyudham |
īśvarasya priyānaṃ tam abhinna-guṇa-rūpiṇam ||36||
śuddha-sphaṭika-saṃkāśaṃ raktāmbuja-dalekṣaṇam |
nīla-paṭṭa-dharaṃ snigdhaṃ divya-bhūṣā-srag-ambaram ||37||
madhu-pāne sad-āsaktaṃ madhu-ghūrṇita-locanam |
pravīra-dakṣiṇe bhāge maṣjunābhyantara-sthite ||38||
saṃtānavṛkṣamūletumaṇimandiramaṇḍitam |
tan-madhye maṇimāṇikyadivyasiṃhāsanojjvale ||39||
pradyumnaṃ caratīdevaṃ tatroparisukhasthitam |
jaganmohanasaundaryyasāraśreṇīrasātmakam ||40||
asitāṃ bhojapuṣjābhamaravindadalekṣaṇam |
divyālaṅkārabhūṣābhir divya-gandhānulepanam ||41||
jaganmugdhīkṛtāśeṣasaundaryāścaryavigraham |
pūrvodyānemahā-raṇyesuradrumasamāśraye ||42||
tatrādhastusvarṇapīṭhehemama ṇḍapamaṇḍite |
 tasya -madhye sthirerājaddivyasiṃhāsanojjvale ||43||
divyoṣayāsamaṃ śrīmad-aniruddhaṃ jagatpatim |
sāṃ drānandaghanaśyāmaṃ susnigdhaṃ nīlakuntalam ||44||
subhrūnnatalatābhaṃ gīṃ sukapolaṃ sunāsikam |
sugrīvaṃ sundaraṃ vakṣomanoharamanoharam ||45||
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ kaṇṭhabhūṣāvibhūṣitam |
maṣju-maṣjīramādhuryādatisaundaryavigraham ||46||
priyabhṛtyagaṇārādhyaṃ yatra saṅgītakapriyam |
pūrṇa-brahma sadānandaṃ śuddhasatvasvarūpakam ||47||
tasyodrdhvecāntarikṣecaviṣṇuṃ sarve śvareśvaram |
anādimādicidrūpaṣcidānandaṃ paraṃ vibhum ||48||
triguṇātītamavyaktaṃ nityamakṣayam avyayam |
sameghapuṣjamādhuryasaundaryaśyāmavigraham ||49||
nīlakuṣcitasusnigdhakeśapāśātisundaram |
aravindadalasnigdhasudīrghacārulocanam ||50||
kirīṭakuṇḍalodgaṇḍaśuddhasatvātmabhir vṛtam |
ātmārāmaiścacidrūpaistanmūrtidhyānatatparaiḥ ||51||
hṛdayārūḍhataddhyānair nāsāgranyastalocanaiḥ |
kriyate'haitukībhaktiḥ kāyahṛdvṛttibhāṣitaiḥ ||52||
tatsavyeyakṣagandharvasiddhavidyādharādibhiḥ |
sukāntair apsaraḥ saṅghair nṛtyasaṅgītatatparaiḥ ||53||
tadaṃ gabhajanaṃ kāmaṃ vāṃ chadbhiḥ kṛṣṇalālasaiḥ |
tadagrevaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvaiścāntarikṣesukhāsane ||54||
prahlādanāradādyaiścakumāraśukavaiṣṇavaiḥ |
janakādyair lasadbhāvair hṛdbāhyasphūrtitatparaiḥ ||55||
pulakākulasarvāṃ gaiḥ sphuratpremasamākulaiḥ |
rahasyāmṛtasaṃsiktair arddhayugmākṣaromanuḥ ||56||
mantracūḍāmaṇiḥ proktaḥ sarvamantraikakāraṇam |
sarvadevasyamantrāṇāṃ kaiśoraṃ mantrahetukam ||57||
sarvakaiśoramantrāṇāṃ hetuścūḍāmaṇirmanuḥ |
japaṃ kurvanti manasāpūrṇapremasukhāśrayāḥ ||58||
vāṃ chanti tatpadāmbhojeniścalaṃ premasādhanam |
tadbāhyesphaṭikādyuccaprāvāresumanohare ||59||
kuṅkumaiḥ sitaraktādyaiścaturdikṣusamākulaiḥ |
śuklaṃ caturbhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ paścimedvārapālakam ||60||
śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-padmakirīṭādivibhūṣitam |
raktaṃ caturbhujaṃ padma-śaṃkha-cakra-gadāyudham ||61||
kirīṭa-kuṇḍaloddīpta-dvāra-pālakam uttare |
gauraṃ catur-bhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ śuṅkha-cakra-gadāyudham ||62||
kirīṭa-kuṇḍalādyaiś ca śobhitaṃ vana-mālinam |
pūrva-dvāre dvāra-pālaṃ gauraṃ viṣṇuṃ prakīrtitam ||63||
kṛṣṇa-varṇaṃ catur-bāhuṃ śaṃkha-cakrādi-bhūṣaṇam |
dakṣiṇa-dvāra-pālaṃ tu śrī-viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇa-varṇakam ||64||
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caritaṃ hy etad yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ śuciḥ |
śṛṇuyād vāpi yo bhaktyā govinde labhate ratim ||65||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe kṛṣṇa-carite saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||70||

(71)

eka-saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

śrī-devy uvāca—
bhagavansarvabhūteśasarvātmansarvasambhava |
deveśvaramahā-devasarvajṣakaruṇākara ||1||
tvayānukaṃ pitaivāhaṃ bhūyo’py āhānukaṃ payā |
trailokyamohanāmantrāstvayāmekathitāḥ prabho ||2||
tenadevenagopībhir mahā-mohanarūpiṇā |
kenakenaviśeṣaṇacikrīḍetadvadasvame ||3||
mahā-deva uvāca— 
ekadāvādayanvīṇāṃ nāradomunipuṅgavaḥ |
kṛṣṇāvatāramājṣāyaprayayaunandagokulam ||4||
gatvā tatra mahā-yogamayeśaṃ vibhumacyutam |
bālanāṭyadharaṃ devadarśanaṃ nandaveśmani ||5||
sukomalapaṭāstīrṇahemaparyaṃ kikopari |
śayānaṃ gopakanyābhiḥ prekṣamāṇaṃ sadāmudam ||6||
atīvasukumārāṃ gaṃ mugdhaṃ mugdhavilokanam |
visrastanīlakuṭilakuntalāvanimaṇḍalam ||7||
kiṣciitsmatāṃ kuravyaṃ jadekadviradakuḍmalam |
svaprabhābhir bhāsayaṃ taṃ samaṃ tādbhavanodaram ||8||
digvāsasaṃsamālokyaso'tiharṣamavāpa ha |
sambhāṣyagopatiṃ nandamāhasarvaprabhupriyaḥ ||9||
nārāyaṇaparāṇāṃ tujīvanaṃ hyatidurlabham |
asyaprabhāvamatulaṃ najānaṃ tīhakecana ||10||
bhavabrahmādayo 'p yasmin ratiṃ vāṃ cchantiśāśvatīm |
caritaṃ cāsyabālasyasarveṣāmevaharṣaṇam ||11||
mudāgāyanti śṛṇvanti cābhinandanti tādṛśāḥ |
asiṃ mastavasute'cintyaprabhāvesnigdhamānasāḥ ||12||
narāḥ santi na teṣāṃ vaibhavabādhābhaviṣyati |
muṃ cehaparalokecchāḥ sarvāballavasattama ||13||
ekāntenaikabhāvenabāle'sminprītimācara |
ity uktvā nandabhavanānniṣkrāṃ tomunipuṅgavaḥ ||14||
tenārcitoviṣṇubuddhyāpraṇamyacavisarjitaḥ |
athāsaucintayāmāsamahā-bhāgavatomuniḥ ||15||
asyakāṃ tābhagavatīlakṣmīrnārāyaṇeharau |
vidhāya gopikā-rūpaṃ krīḍārthaṃ śārṅga-dhanvanaḥ ||16||
avaśyam avatīrṇā sā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
tām ahaṃ vicinomy adya gehe gehe vrajaukasām ||17||
vimṛśyaivaṃ muni-varo gehāni vraja-vāsinām |
praviveśātithir bhūtvā viṣṇu-buddhyā supūjitaḥ ||18||
sarveṣāṃ ballavādīnāṃ ratiṃ nanda-sute parām |
dṛṣṭvā muni-varaḥ sarvān manasā praṇanāma ha ||19||
gopālānāṃ gṛhe bālāṃ dadarśa śveta-rūpiṇīm |
sa dṛṣṭvā tarkayāmāsa ramā hy eṣān asaṃśayaḥ ||20||
praviveśa tato dhīmān nanda-sakhyur mahātmanaḥ |
kasyacid gopa-varyasya bhānu-nāmno gṛhaṃ mahat ||21||
arcito vidhivat tena so’py apṛcchan mahā-manāḥ |
sādho tvam asi vikhyāto dharma-niṣṭhatayā bhuvi ||22||
tavāhaṃ dhana-dhānyādi-samṛddhiṃ saṃvibhāvaye |
kaccit te yogyaḥ putro'sti kanyā vā śubha-lakṣaṇā ||23||
yatas te kīrtir akhilaṃ lokaṃ vyāpya bhaviṣyati |
ity ukto muni-varyeṇa bhānur ānīya putrakam ||24||
mahā-tejasvinaṃ dṛptaṃ nāradāyābhyavādayat |
dṛṣṭvā muni-varas taṃ tu rūpeṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi ||25||
padma-patra-viśālākṣaṃ sugrīvaṃ sundara-bhruvam |
cāru-dantaṃ cāru-karṇaṃ sarvāvayava-sundaram ||26||
taṃ samāśliṣya bāhubhyāṃ snehāśrūṇi vimucya ca |
tataḥ sa-gadgadaṃ prāha praṇayena mahā-muniḥ ||27||
nārada uvāca—-
ayaṃ śiśus te bhavitāsu sakhā rāma-kṛṣṇayoḥ |
vihariṣyati tābhyāṃ ca rātriṃ divam atandritaḥ ||28||
tata ābhāṣyataṃ gopa-pravaraṃ muni-puṅgavaḥ |
yad āgantuṃ manaś cakre tatra iva ṃ bhānur abravīt ||29||
ekāsti putrikā devadeva patny-upamā mama |
kanīyasī śiśor asya jaḍāndha-badhirākṛtiḥ ||30||
utsāhād vṛddhaye yāce tvāṃ varaṃ bhagavattama |
prasanna-dṛṣṭi-mātreṇa susthirāṃ kuru-bālikām ||31||
śrutvaivaṃ nārado vākyaṃ kautukākṛṣṭa-mānasaḥ |
atha praviśya bhavanaṃ luṭhantīṃ bhūtale sutām ||32||
utthāpyāṃ ke nidhāyātisneha-vihvala-mānasaḥ |
bhānur apy āyayau bhakti-namro muni-varāntikam ||33||
atha bhāgavata-śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇasyātipriyo muniḥ |
dṛṣṭvā tasyāḥ paraṃ rūpam adṛṣṭāśrutam adbhutam ||34||
abhūt pūrva-samaṃ mugdho hari-premā mahā-muniḥ |
vigāhya paramānanda-sindhum eka-rasāyanam ||35||
muhūrta-dvitayaṃ tatra munir āsīc chilopamaḥ |
munīndraḥ pratibuddhas tu śanair unmīlya locane ||36||
mahā-vismayam āpannas tūṣṇīm eva sthito'bhavat |
antarhṛdi mahā-buddhir evam evaṃ vyacintayat ||37||
bhrāntaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu mayā svacchanda-cāriṇā |
asyārūpeṇa sadṛśī dṛṣṭvā naiva ca kutracit ||38||
brahma-loke rudra-loka indra-loke ca me gatiḥ |
na ko’pi śobhā-koṭy-aṃśaḥ kutrāpy asyāvilokitaḥ ||39||
mahā-māyā bhagavatī dṛṣṭā śailendra-nandinī |
yasyā rūpeṇa sakalaṃ muhyate sa-carācaram ||40||
sāpy asyāḥ sukumārāṅgī lakṣmīṃ nāpnoti karhicit |
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī kānti-vidyādyāś ca vara-striyaḥ ||41||
chāyām api spṛśanty asyāḥ kadācin naiva dṛśyate |
viṣṇor yan mohinī-rūpaṃ haro yena vimohitaḥ ||42||
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca tad api kuto'syāḥ sadṛśaṃ bhavet |
tato 'syās tattvam ājṣātuṃ na me śaktiḥ kathaṣcana ||43||
anye cāpi na jānanti prāyeṇaināṃ hareḥ priyām |
asyāḥ sandarśanād eva govinda-caraṇāmbuje ||44||
yā premarddhir abhūt sā me bhūta-pūrvā na karhicit |
ekānte naumi bhavatīṃ darśayitvā tivaibhavam ||45||
kṛṣṇasya sambhavaty asyā rūpaṃ parama-tuṣṭaye |
vimṛśyaivaṃ munir gopa-pravaraṃ preṣya kutracit ||46||
nibhṛte parituṣṭāva bālikāṃ divya-rūpiṇīm |
api devi mahā-yoga-māyeśvari mahā-prabhe ||47||
mahā-mohana-divyāṅgi mahā-mādhurya-varṣiṇi |
mahādbhuta-rasānanda-śithilī-kṛta-mānase ||48||
mahā-bhāgyena kenāpi gatāsi mama dṛk-patham |
nityam antarmukhā dṛṣṭis tava devi vibhāvyate ||49||
antar eva mahā-nanda paritṛptaiva lakṣyase |
prasannaṃ madhuraṃ saumyam idaṃ sumukhaṃ aṇḍanam ||50||
vyanakti paramāścaryaṃ kam apy antaḥ sukhodayam |
rajaḥ sambandhi-kalikā-śaktis tat vātiśobhane ||51||
sṛṣṭi-sthiti-samāhāra-rūpiṇī tvam adhiṣṭhitā |
tattvaṃ viśuddha-sattvāśu-śaktir vidyātmikā-parā ||52||
paramānanda-sandohaṃ dadhatī vaiṣṇavaṃ param |
kā tvayāścarya-vibhave brahma-rudrādi-durgame ||53||
yogīndrāṇāṃ dhyāna-pathaṃ na tvaṃ spṛśasi karhicit |
icchā-śaktir jñāna-śaktiḥ kriyā-śaktis taveśituḥ ||54||
tavāṃśa-mātram ity evaṃ manīṣā me pravartate |
māyā-vibhūtayo'cintyās tan māyārbhaka-māyinaḥ ||55||
pareśasya mahā-viṣṇos tāḥ sarvās te kalākalāḥ |
ānanda-rūpiṇī śaktis tvam īśvari na saṃśayaḥ ||56||
tvayā ca krīḍate kṛṣṇo nūnaṃ vṛndāvane vane |
kaumāreṇaiva rūpeṇa tvaṃ viśvasya ca mohinī ||57||
tāruṇya-vayasā spṛṣṭaṃ kīdṛk te rūpam adbhutam |
kīdṛśaṃ tava lāvaṇyaṃ līlā-hāsekṣaṇānvitam ||58||
hari-mānuṣa-lobhena vapur āścarya-maṇḍitam |
draṣṭuṃ tad aham icchāmi rūpaṃ te hari-vallabhe ||59||
yena nanda-sutaḥ kṛṣṇo mohaṃ samupayāsyati |
idānīṃ mama kāruṇyān nijaṃ rūpaṃ maheśvari ||60||
praṇatāya prapannāya prakāśayitum arhasi |
ity uktā muni-varyeṇa tad-anuvrata-cetasā ||61||
mahā-māheśvarīṃ natvāmahā-nandamayīṃ parām |
mahā-prema-tarotkaṇṭhā-vyākulāṅgīṃ śubhekṣaṇām ||62||
īkṣamāṇena govindam evaṃ varṇayatā sthitam |
jaya kṛṣṇa mano-hāriṣ jaya vṛndāvana-priya ||63||
jaya bhrū-bhaṅga-lalita jaya veṇu-ravākula |
jaya barhakṛtottaṃsa jaya gopī-vimohana ||64||
jaya kuṅkuma-liptāṅga jaya ratna-vibhūṣaṇa |
kadāhaṃ tvat-prasādena anayā divya-rūpayā ||65||
sahitaṃ nava-tāruṇya mano-hāri-vapuḥ śriyā |
vilokayiṣye kaiśore mohanaṃ tvāṃ jagat-pate ||66||
evaṃ kīrtayatas tasya tat-kṣaṇād eva sā punaḥ |
babhūva dadhatī divyaṃ rūpam atyanta-mohanam ||67||
catur-daśābda-vayasā saṃmitaṃ lalitaṃ param |
samānavayasaś cānyās tadaiva vraja-bālikāḥ ||68||
āgatya veṣṭayāmāsur divya-bhūṣāmbara-srajaḥ |
munīndraḥ sa tu niśceṣṭo babhūvāścarya-mohitaḥ ||69||
bālāyās tās tadā sakhyaś caraṇāmbu-kaṇair munim |
niṣicya bodhayāmāsur ūcuś ca kṛpayānvitāḥ ||70||
muni-varya mahā-bhāga mahā-yogeśvareśvara |
tvayaiva parayā bhaktyā bhagavān harir īśvaraḥ ||71||
nūnam ārādhito devo bhaktānāṃ kāma-pūrakaḥ |
yad iyaṃ brahma-rudrādyair devaiḥ siddha-munīśvaraiḥ ||72||
mahā-bhāgavataiś cānyair durdarśā durgamāpi ca |
atyadbhuta-vayo-rūpa-mohinī hari-vallabhā ||73||
kenāpy acintya-bhāgyena tava dṛṣṭi-pathaṃ gatā |
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha viprarṣe dhair yam ālambya satvaram ||74||
enāṃ pradakṣiṇī-kṛtya namaskuru punaḥ punaḥ |
kiṃ na paśyasi cārvaṅgīm atyanta-vyākulām iva ||75||
asminn eva kṣaṇe nūnam antardhānaṃ gamiṣyati |
nānayā saha saṃlāpaḥ kathaṣcit te bhaviṣyati ||76||
darśanaṃ ca punar nāsyāḥ prāpsyasi brahma-vittama |
kiṃ tu vṛndāvane kāpi bhāty aśoka-latā śubhā ||77||
sarva-kāle'pi puṣpāḍhyā sarva-dig-vyāpi saurabhā |
govardhanād adūreṇa kusumākhya-saras-taṭe ||78||
tan-mūle hy ardha-rātre ca drakṣyasy asmān aśeṣataḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tāsāṃ sneha-vihvala-cetasām ||79||
yāvat pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamed daṇḍavan muniḥ |
muhūrta-dvitayaṃ bālāṃ nānā-nirmāṇa-śobhanām ||80||
āhūya bhānuṃ provāca nāradaḥ sarva-śobhanām |
evaṃ prabhāvā bāleyaṃ na sādhyā daivatair api ||81||
kiṃ tu yad gṛham etasyāḥ pada-cihna-vibhūṣitam |
tatra nārāyaṇo devaḥ svayaṃ vasati mādhavaḥ ||82||
lakṣmīś ca vasate nityaṃ sarvābhiḥ sarva-siddhibhiḥ |
adya enāṃ varārohāṃ sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣaṇām ||83||
devīm iva parāṃ gehe rakṣa-yatnena sattama |
ity uktvā manasaivaināṃ mahā-bhāgavatottamaḥ ||84||
tad-rūpam eva saṃsmṛtya praviṣṭo gahanaṃ vanam |
aśoka-latikā-mūlam āsādya muni-sattamaḥ ||85||
pratīkṣamāṇo devīṃ tāṃ tatra ivāgamanaṃ niśi |
sthito'tra prema-vikalaś cintayan kṛṣṇa-vallabhām ||86||
atha madhya-niśābhāge yuvatyaḥ paramādbhutāḥ |
pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathānyāś ca vicitrābharaṇa-srajaḥ ||87||
dṛṣṭvā manasi sambhrānto daṇḍavat patito bhuvi |
parivārya muniṃ sarvās tāḥ praviviśuḥ śubhāḥ ||88||
praṣṭu-kāmo’pi sa muniḥ kiṣcit svābhimataṃ priyam |
nāśakat prema-lāvaṇya-priya-bhāṣā-pradharṣitaḥ ||89||
athāgatā muni-śreṣṭhaṃ kṛtāṣjalim avasthitam |
bhakti-bhārā nata-grīvaṃ sa-vismayaṃ sa-sambhramam ||90||
suvinītatamaṃ prāha tatra iva karuṇānvitā |
aśokamālinī nāmnā aśoka-vana-devatā ||91||
aśokamāliny uvāca—-
aśoka-kakalikāyāṃ tu vasāmy asyāṃ mahā-mune |
raktāmbara-dharā nityaṃ rakta-mālānulepanā ||92||
rakta-sindūra-kalikā raktotpalavataṃsinī |
rakta-māṇikya-keyūra-mukuṭādi-vibhūṣitā ||93||
ekadā priyayā sārdhaṃ viharantyo madhūtsave |
tatraiva militā gopa-bālikāś citra-vāsasaḥ ||94||
ahaṃ cāśoka-mālābhir gopa-veṣa-dharaṃ harim |
ramā-rūpāś catāḥ sarvā bhaktyā samyag apūjayam ||95||
tataḥ prabhṛti caitāsāṃ madhye tiṣṭhāmi sarvadā |
bhūṣābhir vividhābhiś ca toṣayitvā ramā-patim ||96||
parātparam ahaṃ sarvaṃ vijānāmīha sarvataḥ |
go-gopa-gopikādīnāṃ rahasyaṃ cāpi vedmy aham ||97||
tava jijṣāsitaṃ sarvaṃ hṛdi pratyabhibhāṣitam |
tāṃ devīm adbhutākārām adbhutānanda-dāyinīm ||98||
hareḥ priyāṃ hiraṇyābhāṃ hīrakojjvala-mudrikām |
kathaṃ paśyāmi lolākṣīṃ kathaṃ vā tat-padāmbujam ||99||
ārādhyate'tibhaktyeti tvayā brahman vimarśitam |
tatra te kathayiṣyāmi vṛttāntaṃ sumahātmanām ||100||
mānase sarasi sthitvā tapas tīvram upeyuṣām |
japatāṃ siddha-mantrāṃś ca dhyāyatāṃ harim īśvaram ||101||
munīnāṃ kāṅkṣatāṃ nityaṃ tasyā eva padāmbujam |
eka-saptati-sāhasraṃ saṃkhyātānāṃ mahaujasām ||102||
tat te'haṃ kathayāmy adya tad rahasyaṃ paraṃ vane ||103||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śrī-rādhā-kṛṣṇa-māhātmye
ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

īśvara uvāca—
tadekāgramanābhūtvāśṛṇudevivarānane |
āsīdugratapānāmamunirekodṛḍhavrataḥ ||1||
sāgnikohyagnibhakṣaś ca cacārātyadbhutaṃ tapaḥ |
jajāpaparamaṃ jāpyaṃ mantraṃ paṣcadaśākṣaram ||2||
kāmamantreṇapuṭitaṃ kāmaṃ kāmavarapradāt |
kṛṣṇāyetipadaṃ svāhāsahitaṃ siddhidaṃ param ||3||
dadhyaucaśyāmalaṅkṛṣṇaṃ rāsonmattaṃ varotsukam |
pītapaṭṭadharaṃ veṇuṃ kareṇādharamarpitam ||4||
navayauvanasampannaṃ karṣaṃ taṃ pāṇināpriyām |
evaṃ dhyānaparaḥ kalpaśatāṃ tedehamutsṛjan ||5||
sunandanāmagopasyakanyābhūtsamahā-muniḥ |
sunandetisamākhyātāyāvīṇāṃ bibhratīkare ||6||
muniranyaḥ satyatapāitikhyātomahā-vrataḥ |
saśuṣkapatraṃ bhuṃ kteyaḥ prajajāpaparaṃ manum ||7||
ratyanta-ṃ kāmabījenapuṭitaṃ cadaśākṣaram |
sapradadhyaumunivaraścitraveṣadharaṃ harim ||8||
dhṛtvāramāyādorvallīdvitayaṃ kaṃ kaṇojjvalam |
nṛtyaṃ tamunmadaṃ taṃ casaṃśliṣyaṃ taṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||9||
hasaṃtamuccair ānandataraṃ ##jaṭharāmbare |
dadhataṃ veṇumājānuvaijayanty āvirājitam ||10||
svedāṃ bhaḥ kaṇasaṃsiktalalāṭavalitānanam |
tyaktvātyaktvāsavaidehaṃ tapasācamahā-muniḥ ||11||
daśakalpāntarejātohyayaṃ nandavanādi ha |
subhadranāmnogopasyakanyābhadretiviśrutā ||12||
yasyāḥ pṛṣṭhataledivyaṃ vyajanaṃ paridṛśyate |
haridhāmābhidhānastukaścidāsīnmahā-muniḥ ||13||
so’py atapyattapaḥ kṛchraṃ nityaṃ patraikabhojanam |
āśusiddhikaraṃ mantraṃ viṃ śatyarṇaṃ prajaptavān ||14||
anantara-ṃ kāmabījādadhyārūḍhaṃ tadevatu |
māyātatpuratovyomahaṃ sāsṛgadyuticandrakam ||15||
tato daśākṣaraṃ paścānnamoyuktaṃ smarādikam |
dadhyauvṛndāvaneramyemādhavīmaṇḍapeprabhum ||16||
uttānaśāyinaṃ cārupallavāstaraṇopari |
kayācidatikāmārttaballavyāraktanetrayā ||17||

tad-ante gokule jātā nanda-bhrātur gṛhe svayam ||151||
lavaṅgā iti tan-nāma kṛṣṇeṅgita-nirīkṣaṇā |
yasyā haste pradṛśyeta mukhaṃ mārjana-yantrakam ||152||
iti te kathitāḥ kāścit pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ ||153||
hari-vividha-rasādyair yuktam adhyāyam etad 
vraja vara-tanayābhiś cāru-hāsekṣaṇābhiḥ |
paṭhati ya iha bhaktyā pāṭhayed vā manuṣyo 
vrajati bhagavataḥ śrī-vāsudevasya dhāma ||154||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe
śrī-kṛṣṇa-māhātmye 
dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||72||

(73)
trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

[mathurā-māhātmyam]

īśvara uvāca—
yat tvayā pṛṣṭam āścaryaṃ tan mayā bhāṣitaṃ kramāt |
yatra muhyanti brahmādyās tatra ko vā na muhyati ||1||
tathāpi te pravakṣyāmi yad uktaṃ paramarṣiṇā |
mahā-rājam ambarīṣaṃ viṣṇu-bhaktaṃ śivānvitam ||2||
badary-āśramam āsādya samāsīnaṃ jitendriyam |
rājā praṇamya tuṣṭāva viṣṇu-dharma-vivitsayā ||3||
veda-vyāsaṃ mahā-bhāgaṃ sarvajṣaṃ puruṣottamam |
##tvaṃ saṃsāra-duṣpāre paritrātum ihārhasi ||4||
viṣayeṣu virakto’smi n amastebhyonamokhilam |
yat tat padam anudvignaṃ saccidānanda-vigraham ||5||
paraṃ brahma parākāśam anākāśam anāmayam |
yat sākṣātkṛtya munayo bhavāṃ bhodhiṃ taranti hi ||6||
tatrāhaṃ manasonityaṃ kathaṃ gatimavāpnuyām |
vyāsa uvāca—
atigopyaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ yan mayā na śukaṃ prati ||7||
gaditaṃ sva-sutaṃ kiṃ tu tvāṃ vakṣyāmi hari-priyam |
āsīd idaṃ paraṃ viśvaṃ yad rūpaṃ yat pratiṣṭhitam ||8||
avyākṛtam avyathitaṃ tad īśvara-mayaṃ śṛṇu |
mayā kṛtaṃ tapaḥ pūrvaṃ bahu-varṣa-sahasrakam ||9||
phala-mūla-palāśāmbu-vāyv-āhāra-niṣeviṇā |
tato mām āha bhagavān sva-dhyāna-nirataṃ hariḥ ||10||
kasminn arthe cikīrṣā te vivitsā vā mahā-mate |
prasanno’smi vṛṇuṣva tvaṃ varaṃ ca varadarṣabhāt ||11||
mad-darśanāntaḥ saṃsāra iti satyaṃ bravīmi te |
tato 'ham abruvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pulakotphulla-vigrahaḥ ||12||
tvām ahaṃ draṣṭum icchāmi cakṣurbhyāṃ madhusūdana |
yat tat satyaṃ paraṃ brahma jagaj-yoniṃ jagat-patim ||13||
vadanti vedaśirasaś cākṣuṣaṃ nātham adbhutam |
śrī-bhagavān uvāca——
brahmaṇaivaṃ purā pṛṣṭaḥ prārthitaś ca yathā purā ||14||
yad avocam ahaṃ tasmai tat tubhyam api kathyate |
mām eke prakṛtiṃ prāhuḥ puruṣaṃ ca tatheśvaram ||15||
dharmam eke dhanaṃ caike mokṣam eke'kutobhayam |
śūnyam eke bhāvam eke śivam eke sadāśivam ||16||
apare vedaśirasi sthitam ekaṃ sanātanam |
sad-bhāvaṃ vikriyā-hīnaṃ sac-cid-ānanda-vigraham ||17||
paśyādya darśayiṣyāmi svarūpaṃ veda-gopitam |
tato 'paśyaṃ bhūpa bālam ahaṃ kālāmbuda-prabham ||18||
gopa-kanyāvṛtaṃ gopaṃ hasantaṃ gopa-bālakaiḥ |
kadamba-mūla āsīnaṃ pīta-vāsasam adbhutam ||19||
vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma nava-pallava-maṇḍitam |
kokila-bhramarārāvaṃ mano-bhava-manoharam ||20||
nadīm apaśyaṃ kālindīm indīvara-dala-prabhām |
govardhanam athāpaśyaṃ kṛṣṇa-rāma-karoddhṛtam ||21||
mahendra-darpanāśāya-go-gopāla-sukhāvaham |
gopālam abalā-saṅga-muditaṃ veṇu-vādinam ||22|
dṛṣṭvātihṛṣṭo hy abhavaṃ sarva-bhūṣaṇa-bhūṣaṇam |
tato mām āha bhagavān vṛndāvana-caraḥ svayam ||23||
yad idaṃ me tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ divyaṃ sanātanam |
niṣkalaṃ niṣkrayaṃ śāntaṃ sac-cid-ānanda-vigraham ||24||
pūrṇaṃ padma-palāśākṣaṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ mama |
idam eva vadanty ete vedāḥ kāraṇa-kāraṇam ||25||
satyaṃ nityaṃ parānandaṃ cid-ghanaṃ śāśvataṃ śivam |
nityāṃ me mathurāṃ viddhi vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ tathā ||26||
yamunāṃ gopa-kanyāś ca tathā gopāla-bālakāḥ |
mamāvatāro nityo'yam atra mā saṃśayaṃ kṛthāḥ ||27||
mameṣṭā hi sadārādhā sarvajṣo'haṃ parāt paraḥ |
sarva-kāmaś ca sarve śaḥ sarvānandaḥ parāt paraḥ ||28||
mayi sarvam idaṃ viśvaṃ bhāti māyā vijṛmbhitam |
tato'ham abruvaṃ devaṃ jagat-kāraṇa-kāraṇam ||29||
kāś ca gopyas tu ke gopā vṛkṣo'yaṃ kīdṛśo mataḥ |
vanaṃ kiṃ kokilādyāś ca nadī keyaṃ giriś ca kaḥ ||30||
ko'sau veṇur mahā-bhāgo lokānandaika-bhājanam |
bhagavān āha māṃ prītaḥ prasanna-vadanāmbujaḥ ||31||
gopyas tu śrutayo jṣeyā ṛco vai gopa-kanyakāḥ |
deva-kanyāś ca rājendra tapo-yuktā mumukṣavaḥ ||32||
gopālā munayaḥ sarve vaikuṇṭhānanda-mūrtayaḥ |
kalpa-vṛkṣaḥ kadambo'yaṃ parānandaika-bhājanam ||33||
vanam ānandakākhyaṃ hi mahā-pātaka-nāśanam |
siddhāścasādhyāgandharvāḥ kokilādyāna saṃśayaḥ ||34||
kecidānandahṛdayaṃ sākṣādyamunayātanum |
anādirharidāso'yaṃ bhūdharonātrasaṃśayaḥ ||35||
veṇuryaḥ śṛṇutaṃ vipraṃ tavāpividitaṃ tathā |
dvija āsīcchāntamanāstapaḥ śāṃ tiparāyaṇaḥ ||36||
nāmnādevavratodāntaḥ karmakāṇḍaviśāradaḥ |
savaiṣṇavajanavrātamadhyavartīkriyāparaḥ | ||37||
sakadācanaśuśrāvayajṣeśo'stītibhūpate |
tasya gehamathābhyāgāddvijomadgataniścayaḥ ||38||
samadbhaktaḥ kvacitpūjāṃ tulasīdalavāriṇā |
kṛtavāṃs tadgṛhekiṣcitphalaṃ mūlaṃ nyavedayat ||39||
snānavāriphalaṅkiṣcittasmaimatyādadausudhīḥ |
aśraddhayāsmitaṃ kṛtvāso’py agṛhṇāddvijanmanaḥ ||40||
tenapāpenasaṃjātaṃ veṇutvamatidāruṇam |
tenapuṇyenatasyāthamadīyapriyatāṃ gataḥ ||41||
amunāsopirājendraketumānivarājate |
yugāṃ tetadviṣṇuparobhūtvābrahmasamāpsyati ||42||
aho na jānanti narād urāśayāḥ 
purīṃ madīyāṃ paramāṃ sanātanīm |
surendra-nāgendra-munīndra-saṃstutāṃ 
manoramāṃ tāṃ mathurāṃ purātanīm ||43||
kāśyādayo yadyapi santi puryas 
tāsāṃ tu -madhye mathuraiva dhanyā |
yaj janma-mauṣjī-vrata-mṛtyu-dāhair 
nṛṇāṃ caturddhā vidadhāti muktim ||44||
yadā viśuddhāstapa ādinā janāḥ 
śubhāśayā dhyāna-dhanānirantaram |
tadaiva paśyanti mamottamāṃ purīṃ 
na cān yathā kalpa-śatair dvijottamāḥ ||45||
mathurā-vāsino dhanyā mānyā api divaukasām |
agaṇya-mahimānas te sarva eva catur-bhujāḥ ||46||
mathurā-vāsino ye tu doṣān paśyanti mānavāḥ |
teṣu doṣaṃ na paśyanti janma-mṛtyu-sahasrajam ||47||
adhunā api te dhanyā mathurāṃ ye smaranti te |
 yatra bhūteśvaro devo mokṣadaḥ pāpinām api ||48||
mama priyatamo nityaṃ devo bhūteśvaraḥ paraḥ |
yaḥ kadāpi mama prītyai na saṃtyajati tāṃ purīṃ ||49||
bhūteśvaraṃ yo na namen na pūjayen 
na vāsmared duścarito manuṣyaḥ |
naināṃ sa paśyen mathurāṃ madīyāṃ 
svayaṃ prakāśāṃ para-devatākhyām ||50||
na kathaṃ mayi bhaktiṃ sa labhate pāpa-pūruṣaḥ |
yo madīyaṃ paraṃ bhaktaṃ śivaṃ sampūjayen na hi ||51||
man-māyā-mohita-dhiyaḥ prāyas te mānavādhamāḥ |
bhūteśvaraṃ na namanti na smaranti stuvanti ye ||52||
bālako’pi dhruvo yatra mamārādhana-tat-paraḥ |
prāpasthānaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ yatna-yuktaṃ pitāmahaiḥ ||53||
tāṃ purīṃ prāpya mathurāṃ madīyāṃ sura-durlabhām |
khaṣjo bhūtvāndhako vāpi prāṇān eva parityajet ||54||
vedavyāsa mahā-bhāga mā kṛthāḥ saṃśayaṃ kvacit |
rahasyaṃ vedaśirasāṃ yan mayā te prakāśitam ||55||
imaṃ bhagavatā proktam adhyāyaṃ yaḥ paṭhec chuciḥ |
śṛṇuyād vāpi yo bhaktyā muktis tasyāpi śāśvatī ||56||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe 
vṛndāvanādi-mathurā-māhātmya-kathanaṃ nāma 
trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||73||

(74)
catuḥ -saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

īśvara uvāca—
ekadā rahasi śrī-mān uddhavo bhagavat-priyaḥ |
sanat-kumāram ekānte hy apṛcchat pārṣadaḥ prabho ||1||
yatra krīḍati govindo nityaṃ nitya-surāspade |
gopāṅganābhir yat sthānaṃ kutra vā kīdṛśaṃ param ||2||
tat tat krīḍana-vṛttāntam anyad yad yat tad adbhutam |
jṣātaṃ cet tava tat kathyaṃ sneho meyadi vartate ||3||
sanat-kumāra uvāca—
kadācid yamunā-kūle kasyāpi ca taros tale |
suvṛttenopaviṣṭena bhagavat-pārṣadena vai ||4||
yad raho 'nubhavas tasya pārthenāpi mahātmanā |
dṛṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yad yat tat prasaṅgāt kathitaṃ mayi ||5||
tat te'haṃ kathayāmy etac chṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ param |
kiṃ tv etad yatra kutrāpi na prakāśyaṃ kadācana ||6||
arjuna uvāca—
śaṅkarādyair viriṣcy-ādyair adṛṣṭam aśrutaṃ ca yat |
sarvam etat kṛpāṃ bhodhe kṛpayā kathaya prabho ||7||
kiṃ tvayā kathitaṃ pūrvam ābhīryas tava vallabhāḥ |
tās tāḥ kati vidhā deva kati vā saṅkhyayā punaḥ ||8||
nāmāni kati vā tāsāṃ kā vā kutra vyavasthitāḥ |
tāsāṃ vā kati karmāṇi vayo-veṣaś ca kaḥ prabho ||9||
kābhiḥ sārddhaṃ kva vā deva vihariṣyasi bho rahaḥ |
nitye nitya-sukhe nitya-vibhave ca vane vane ||10||
tat sthānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ kutra śāśvataṃ paramaṃ mahat |
kṛpā cet tādṛśī tan me sarvaṃ vaktum ihārhasi ||11||
yad apṛṣṭaṃ mayā py evam ajṣātaṃ yad rahas tava |
ārtārtighna mahā-bhāga sarvaṃ tat kathayiṣyasi ||12||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
tatsthānaṃ vallabhāstāmevihārastādṛśomama |
api prāṇa-samānānāṃ satyaṃ puṃsām agocaraḥ ||13||
kathite dṛṣṭum utkaṇṭhā tava vatsa bhaviṣyati |
brahmādīnām adṛśyaṃ yat kiṃ tad anya-janasya vai ||14||
tasmād virama vatsaitat kiṃ nu tena vinā tava |
evaṃ bhagavatas tasya śrutvā vākyaṃ su-dāruṇam ||15||
dīnaḥ pādāmbuja-dvandve daṇḍavat patito'rjunaḥ |
tato vihasya bhagavān dorbhyāṃ utthāpya taṃ vibhuḥ ||16||
 uvāca— parama-premṇā bhaktāya bhakta-vatsalaḥ |
tat kiṃ tat kathane nātra draṣṭavyaṃ cet tvayā hi yat ||17||
yasyāṃ sarvaṃ samutpannaṃ yasyām adyāpi tiṣṭhati |
layam eṣyati tāṃ devīṃ śrī-mat-tripura-sundarīm ||18||
ārādhya parayā bhaktyā tasyai svaṃ ca nivedaya |
tāṃ vinaitat padaṃ dātuṃ na śaknomi kadācana ||19||
śrutvaitad bhagavad-vākyaṃ pārtho harṣākulekṣaṇaḥ |
śrī-matyās tripurādevyā yayau śrī-pādukā-talam ||20||
 tatra gatvā dadarśaināṃ śrī-cintāmaṇi-vedikām |
nānā--ratnair viracitaiḥ sopānair atiśobhitām ||21||
 tatra kalpa-taruṃ nānā-puṣpaiḥ phala-bhavair natam |
sarvartu-komala-dalaiḥ snavan-mādhvīka-śīkaraiḥ ||22||
varṣadbhir vāyunālolaiḥ pallavair ujjvalīkṛtam |
śukaiścakokilagaṇaiḥ sārikābhiḥ kapotakaiḥ ||23||
līlācakorakair amyaiḥ pakṣibhiś ca nināditam |
 yatra guṣjad-bhṛṅga-rāja-kolāhala-samākulam ||24||
maṇibhir bhāsvarair udyaddāvānalamanoharam |
śrī-ratna-mandiraṃ divyaṃ tale tasya mahā-dbhutam ||25||
ratna-siṃhāsanaṃ tatra mahā-haimābhimohanam |
 tatra bālārka-saṃkāśāṃ nānālaṅkāra-bhūṣitām ||26||
navayauvanasampannāṃ sṛṇipāśadhanuḥ śaraiḥ |
rājaccaturbhujalatāṃ suprasannāṃ manoharām ||27||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādikirīṭamaṇiraśmibhiḥ |
virājita-padāmbhojā-maṇimādibhir āvṛtām ||28||
prasanna-vadanāṃ devīṃ varadāṃ bhakta-vatsalām |
arjuno'ham iti jṣātaḥ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||29||
vihitāṣjalir ekānte sthito bhakti-bharānvitaḥ |
sātasyopāsitaṃ jṣātvā prasādaṃ ca kṛpā-nidhiḥ ||30||
 uvāca— kṛpayā devī tasya smaraṇa-vihvalā |
bhagavaty uvāca—
kiṃ vā dānaṃ tvayā vatsa kṛtaṃ pātrāya durlabham ||31||
iṣṭaṃ yajṣena kenātra tapo vā kim anuṣṭhitam |
bhagavaty amalā bhaktiḥ kā vā prāk samupārjjitā ||32||
kiṃ vāsmin durlabhaṃ loke kiṃ vā karma śubhaṃ mahat |
prasādas tvayi yenāyaṃ prapanne ca mudā kila ||33||
gūḍhātigūḍhaścānanyalabhyobhagavatākṛtaḥ |
naitādṛṅ-martya-lokānāṃ na ca bhū-tala-vāsinām ||34||
svargināṃ devatādīnāṃ tapasvīśvara-yoginām |
bhaktānāṃ naiva sarveṣāṃ naiva naiva ca naiva ca ||35||
prasādas tu kṛto vatsa tava viśvātmanā yathā |
tad ehi bhaja buddhvaiva kula-kuṇḍaṃ saro mama ||36||
sarva-kāma-pradā devī tv anayā saha gamyatām |
 tatra iva vidhivat snātvā drutam āgamyatām i ha ||37||
tadaiva tatra gatvā sa snātvā pārthas tathā gataḥ |
āgataṃ taṃ kṛta-snānaṃ nyāsa-mudrārpaṇādikam ||38||
kārayitvā tato devyā tasya vai dakṣiṇa-śrutau |
sadyaḥ siddhikarībālāvidyānigaditāparā ||39||
hakārārddhaparādvīpādvitīyāviśvabhūṣitā |
anuṣṭhānaṃ ca pūjāṃ cajapaṣcalakṣasaṃkhyakam ||40||
korakaiḥ karavīrāṇāṃ prayogaṃ ca yathā tatham |
nirvartyatamuvācedaṃ kṛpayā parameśvarī ||41||
anenaivavidhānenakriyatāṃ madupāsanam |
tato mayiprasannāyāntavānugrahakāraṇāt ||42||
tatastu tatra paryyaṃ teṣvadhikārobhaviṣyati |
ityayaṃ niyamaḥ pūrvaṃ svayaṃ bhagavatākṛtaḥ ||43||
śrutvaivamarjunastenavarmaṇātāṃ samarcayat |
tataḥ pūjāṃ japaṣcaiva kṛtvādevīprasāditā ||44||
kṛtvātataḥ śubhaṃ homaṃ snānaṃ cavidhinātataḥ |
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ prāptaprāyamanoratham ||45||
karasthāṃ sarvasiddhiṃ casapārthaḥ samama nyata |
asminnavasaredevītamāgatyasmitānanā ||46||
 uvāca— gacchavatsatvamadhunātadgṛhāntare |
tataḥ sasambhramaḥ pārthaḥ samutthāyamudānvitaḥ ||47||
asaṃkhyaharṣapūrṇātmādaṇḍavattāṃ nanāma ha |
ājṣaptastutayāsārddhaṃ devīva yasya yārjunaḥ ||48||
gatorādhāpatisthānaṃ yatsiddhair apyagocaram |
tataś ca saupādiṣṭogolokāduparisthitam ||49||
sthiraṃ vāyudhṛtaṃ nityaṃ satyaṃ sarvasukhāspadam |
nityaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāmanityarāsamaho tsavam ||50||
apaśyatparamaṃ guhyaṃ pūrṇapremarasātmakam |
tasyāhivacanādevalocanair vīkṣyatadrahaḥ ||51||
vivaśaḥ patitas tatra vivṛddhapremavihvalaḥ |
tataḥ kṛcchrāllabdhasaṃjṣodorbhyāṃ utthāpitastayā ||52||
sāṃ tvanāvacanaistasyāḥ kathaṣcit sthair yamāgataḥ |
tatastapaḥ kimanyanmekartavyaṃ vidyatevada ||53||
ititaddarśanotkaṇṭhābhareṇataralo'bhavat |
tatastayākare tasya dhṛtvātatpadadakṣiṇe ||54||
pratipedesudeśenagatvā coktamidaṃ vacaḥ |
snānā-yaitacchubhaṃ pārthaviśatvaṃ jalavistaram ||55||
sahasradalapadmasthasaṃsthānaṃ madhyakorakam |
catuḥ -saraś ca turdhāramāścaryakulasaṃkulam ||56||
asyāntarepraviśyāthaviśeṣamihapaśyasi |
e tasya dakṣiṇedeśa eṣacātrasarovaraḥ ||57||
madhumādhvīkapānaṃ yannāmnāmalayanirjharaḥ |
etaccaphullamudyānaṃ vasaṃtemadanotsavam ||58||
kurute yatra govindovasaṃtakusumocitam |
yatrāvatāraṃ kṛṣṇasyastuvanty evadivāniśam ||59||
bhavedyatsmaraṇādevamuneḥ svāṃ tesmarāṃ kuraḥ |
tato 'sminsarasi snātvā gatvā pūrvasarastaṭam ||60||
upaspṛśyajalaṃ tasya sādhayasvamanoratham |
tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā tasmin sarasitajjale ||61||
kalhārakumudāṃ bhojaraktanīlotpalacyutaiḥ |
parāgair aṃ jitemaṣju-vāsitemadhubindubhiḥ ||62||
tuṃ dilekalahaṃ sādinādair āṃ dolitetataḥ |
ratnābaddhacatustīremaṃ dānilataraṃ gite ||63||
magnejalāntaḥ pārthetu tatra ivāntardadhe'thasā |
utthāyaparitovīkṣyasambhrāṃ tācāruhāsinī ||64||
sadyaḥ śuddhasvarṇaraśmigaurakāntatanūlatām |
sphuratkiśoravarṣīyāṃ śāradendunibhānanām ||65||
sunīlakuṭilasnigdhavilasadratnakuntalām |
sindūrabindukiraṇaprojjvalālakapaṭṭikām ||66||
