|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe arjunyanunayo
nāma catuḥ-saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||74||

(75)
paṣcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

pārvaty uvāca—
vṛndāvana-rahasyaṃ ca bahudhā kathitaṃ vibho |
kena puṇya-viśeṣeṇa nāradaḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ ||1||
īśvara uvāca—
ekadāścaryavṛttāntaṃ mayā jijṣāsitaṃ purā |
brahmaṇākathitaṃ guhyaṃ śrutaṃ kṛṣṇamukhāmbujāt ||2||
nāradaḥ pṛṣṭavānmahyaṃ tadāhaṃ prāptavānidam |
ahaṃ vaktuṃ naśaknomitanmāhātmyaṃ kathaṃ cana ||3||
kiṃ kurveśapanaṃ tasya smṛtvāsīdāmimānase |
iti śrutvā mama vacodurmanāḥ so'bhavadyadā ||4||
tadābrahmāṇamāhūya ahamādiṣṭavānpriye |
tvayā yat kathitaṃ mahyaṃ nāradāya vadasva tat ||5||
brahmātadāmama vaconiśamyasahanāradaḥ |
jagāmakṛṣṇasavidhaṃ natvāpṛcchattadevatu ||6||
brahmovāca-
kimidaṃ dvātriṃ śadvanaṃ vṛndāraṇyaṃ viśāṃ pate |
śrotum icchāmi bhagavanyadiyogyo’smi mevada ||7||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
idaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ mama dhāmaivakevalam |
yatremepaśavaḥ sākṣādvṛkṣāḥ kīṭānarāmarāḥ ||8||
yevasanti mamāṃ tyetemṛtāyāṃ timamāṃ tikam |
atrayāgopapatnyaś ca nivasanti mamālaye ||9||
yoginyastāstuevaṃ himama devāḥ parāyaṇāḥ |
paṣcayojanamevaṃ hivanaṃ medevarūpakam ||10||
kālindīyaṃ suṣumnākhyāparamāmṛtavāhinī |
 yatra devāścabhūtānivartaṃ tesūkṣmarūpataḥ ||11||
sarvatovyāpakaścāhaṃ natyakṣyāmivanaṃ kvacit |
āvirbhāvastirobhāvobhavedatrayugeyuge ||12||
tejomayamidaṃ sthānamadṛśyaṃ carmacakṣuṣām |
rahasyaṃ meprabhāvaṃ capaśyavṛndāvanaṃ yuge ||13||
brahmādīnāṃ devatānāṃ nadṛśyaṃ tat kathaṃ cana |
īśvara uvāca—
tacchrutvānāradonatvākṛṣṇaṃ brahmāṇam eva ca ||14||
ājagāmahabhūrlokemiśrakaṃ naimiṣaṃ vanam |
tatrāsausatkṛtaś cāpi śaunakādyair munīśvaraiḥ ||15||
pṛṣṭaścāpyāgatobrahmankutastvamadhunāvada |
tacchrutvānāradaḥ prāhagolokādāgato'smyaham ||16||
śrutvā kṛṣṇamukhāṃ bhojādvṛndāvanarahasyakam |
nārada uvāca—
 tatra nānā-vidhāḥ praśnāḥ kṛtāś caiva punaḥ punaḥ ||17||
samastāmanavas tatra yogāś caiva mayā śrutāḥ |
tānevakathayiṣyāmi yathā praśnaṃ catattvataḥ ||18||
śaunakādaya ūcuḥ—
vṛndāraṇyarahasyaṃ hiyaduktaṃ brahmaṇā tvayi |
tadasmākaṃ samācakṣvayadyasmāsukṛpātava ||19||
nārada uvāca—
kadācitsarayūtīredṛṣṭo'smābhiś ca gautamaḥ |
manasvīcamahā-duḥkhīcintākulitacetanaḥ ||20||
māṃ dṛṣṭvā gautamo devaḥ papātadharaṇītale |
uttiṣṭhavatsavatsetitamuvācāhamevahi ||21||
 kathaṃ bhavānmanasvītiprocyatāṃ yadirocate |
gautama uvāca—
śrutaṃ tavamukhādevakṛṣṇatattvaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ ||22||
dvārakākhyaṃ māthurākhyaṃ rahasyaṃ bahuśo mayā |
vṛndāvanarahasyaṃ tunaśrutaṃ tvanmukhāmbujāt ||23||
yatomemanasaḥ sthair yyaṃ bhaviṣyati casadguro |
nārada uvāca—
idaṃ tuparamaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyātirahasyakam ||24||
purāmebrahmaṇāproktaṃ tādṛgvṛndāvanodbhavam |
rahasyaṃ vadadeveśavṛndāraṇ yasya mepitaḥ ||25||
itijijṣāsitaṃ śrutvā kṣaṇaṃ maunīsacābhavat |
tato mā''hamahā-viṣṇuṃ gacchavatsaprabhuṃ mama ||26||
mayā pi tatra gantavyaṃ tvayāsahana saṃśayaḥ |
ity uktvā māṃ gṛhītvācagatoviṣṇoścadhāmani ||27||
mahā-viṣṇaucakathitaṃ mayoktaṃ yattadevahi |
tacchrutvācaṃ ahā-viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ bhuvamathādiśat ||28||
tvamevādeśatomahyaṃ nītvāvaināradaṃ munim |
snānā-yaviniyuṃ kṣvāmuṃ sarasyamṛtasaṃjṣake ||29||
mahā-viṣṇusamādiṣṭaḥ svayaṃ bhūrmāṃ tathā karot |
tatrāmṛtasaraścāhaṃ praviśyasnānamācaram ||30||
tatkṣaṇāttatsaraḥ pāreyoṣitāṃ savidhe'bhavam |
sarvalakṣaṇasapannāyoṣidrūpātivismitā ||31||
māṃ dṛṣṭvā tāḥ samāyāṃ tīmapṛcchaṃś camuhurmuhuḥ |
striya ūcuḥ—
kātvaṃ kutaḥ samāyātākathayātmaviceṣṭitam ||32||
tāsāṃ priyakathāṃ śrutvā mayoktaṃ tanniśāmaya |
kutaḥ ko'haṃ samāyātaḥ kathaṃ vāyoṣidākṛtiḥ ||33||
svapnavaddṛśyatesarvaṃ kiṃ vā mugdho’smi bhūtale |
tacchrutvāmadvaco devīprovāca ṃ adhurasvanaiḥ ||34||
vṛndānāmnīpurīceyaṃ kṛṣṇacandrapriyāsadā |
ahaṃ calalitādevīturyātītācaniṣkalā ||35||
ity uktvā camahā-devīkaruṇāsāṃ dramānasā |
māṃ pratyāhapunar devīsamāgacchamayā sa ha ||36||
anyāścayoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapādaparāyaṇāḥ |
tāścamāṃ pravadanty evaṃ samāgacchānayāsa ha ||37||
tato nukṛṣṇacandrasyacaturdaśākṣaromanuḥ |
kṛpayā kathitastasyādevyāś cāpi mahātmanaḥ ||38||
tatkṣaṇādevatatsāmyamalabhaṃ vividhopamā |
tābhiḥ sahagatās tatra yatra kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ ||39||
kevalaṃ saccidānandaḥ svayaṃ yoṣinmayaḥ prabhuḥ |
yoṣidānandahṛdayodṛṣṭvā māṃ prābravīnmuhuḥ ||40||
samāgacchapriyekāntebhaktyāmāṃ pariraṃ bhaya |
remevarṣapramāṇena tatra caiva dvijottama ||41||
tadoktaṃ ramaṇeśenatāṃ devīṃ rādhikāṃ prati |
iyaṃ meprakṛtis tatra cāsīnnāradarūpadhṛk ||42||
nītvāmṛtasaroramyaṃ snānā-rthaṃ saṃniyojaya |
tayāmeramaṇasyāṃ tegaditaṃ priyabhāṣitam ||43||
ahaṃ calalitādevīrādhikāyācagīyate |
ahaṃ cavāsudevākhyonityaṃ kāmakalātmakaḥ ||44||
satyaṃ yoṣitsvarūpo'haṃ yoṣiccāhaṃ sanātanī |
ahaṃ calalitādevīpuṃ rūpākṛṣṇavigrahā ||45||
āvayorantara-ṃ nāstisatyaṃ satyaṃ hinārada |
evaṃ yovettimetattvaṃ samayaṃ ca tathā manum ||46||
sasamācārasaṃketaṃ lalitāvatsamepriyaḥ |
idaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāmarahasyaṃ mama vaigṛham ||47||
naprakāśyaṃ kadā kutra vaktavyaṃ napaśaukvacit |
tato 'nurādhikādevīmāṃ nītvātatsarovare ||48||
sthitvāsākṛṣṇacandrasyacaraṇāṃ tegatāpunaḥ |
tato nimajjanādevanārado'hamupāgataḥ ||49||
vīṇāhastogānaparastadrahasyaṃ muhurmudā |
svayaṃ bhuvaṃ namaskṛtya tatrāgāṃ viṣṇupārṣadam ||50||
svayaṃ bhuvā tathā dṛṣṭaṃ noktaṃ kiṣcittadāpunaḥ |
ititekathitaṃ vatsasugopyaṃ camayā tvayi ||51||
tvayāpikṛṣṇacandrasyakevalaṃ dhāmacitkalam |
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena māturjāraivapriyam ||52||
 yathā proktaṃ mayā śiṣyegautamesarahasyakam |
 tathā bhavatsukārtsnyenakathitaṃ cātigopitam ||53||
 yatra kutra kadācittuprakāśyaṃ munipuṃ gavāḥ |
tadāśāpobhavedviprāḥ kṛṣṇacandrasyaniścitam ||54||
imaṃ kṛṣṇasyalīlābhir yutamadhyāyam uttamam |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpisayātiparamaṃ padam ||55||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vṛndāvana-māhātmye
nāradīyānunayepaṣcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||75||

(76)
ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

īśvara uvāca—
atra śiśupālaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā danta-vaktraḥ kṛṣṇena yoddhuṃ mathurām ājagāma ||1||
kṛṣṇas tu tac chrutvā ratham āruhya tena saha mathurām āyayau ||2||
atha taṃ hatvā yamunām uttīrya nanda-vrajaṃ gatvā pitarāv abhivādyāśvāsya tābhyāṃ āliṅgitaḥ sakala-gopa-vṛddhān pariṣvajya tān āśvāsya bahu-vastrābharaṇādibhis tatra-sthān sarvān santarpayāmāsa ||3||
kālindyāḥ puline ramye puṇya-vṛkṣa-samākīrṇe gopa-strībhir ahar-niśaṃ krīḍā-sukhena tri-rātraṃ tatra samuvāsa ||4||
 tatra sthale nanda-gopādayaḥ sarve janāḥ putra-dāra-sahitāḥ paśu-pakṣi-mṛgādayo 'pi vāsudeva-prasādena-divya-rūpa-dharā vimāna-samārūḍhāḥ paramaṃ lokaṃ vaikuṇṭham avāpuḥ ||5||
śrī-kṛṣṇas tu nanda-gopa-vrajaukasāṃ sarveṣāṃ nirāmayaṃ svapadaṃ datvā deva-gaṇaiḥ stūyamānaḥ śrīmatīṃ dvārāvatīṃ viveśa ||6||
 tatra vasudevo grasena saṅkarṣaṇa-pradyumnāniruddhākrūrādibhiḥ pratyahaṃ sampūjitaḥ ṣoḍaśa-sahasrāṣṭādhika-mahiṣībhiś ca viśvarūpa-dharo divya-ratna-maya-latā-gṛhāntareṣu sura-taru-kusumācita-ślakṣṇatara-paryaṃ keṣu ramayāmāsa ||7||
evaṃ hitārthāya sarva-devānāṃ samasta-bhū-bhāra-vināśāya yadu-vaṃśe'vatīrya sakala-rākṣasa-vināśaṃ kṛta-mahāntam urvībhāraṃ nāśayitvā nanda-vraja-dvārikā-vāsinaḥ sthāvara-jaṅgamān bhava-bandhanān mocayitvā -parameśāśvate yogi-dhyeye ramye dhāmni saṃsthāpya nityaṃ divya-mahiṣyādibhiḥ saṃsevyamāno
vāsudevo 'khileṣūvāca ||8||
asīda-vyākṛtaṃ brahma karakāghṛtayor iva |
prakṛti-stho guṇān mukto dravībhūtvā divaṃ gataḥ ||9||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vṛndāvana-mahātmye pārvatī-
śiva-saṃvāde ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||76||

(77)
saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ

pārvaty uvāca—
vistareṇa samācakṣva nāmārthapadagauravam |
īśvarasyasvarūpaṣcatatsthānānāṃ vibhūtayaḥ ||1||
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ dhāmavyūhabhedās tathā hareḥ |
nirvāṇākhyāhitattvenamama sarvaṃ sureśvara ||2||
īśvara uvāca—
sāre vṛndāvane kṛṣṇaṃ gopī-koṭibhir āvṛtam |
tatra gaṅgā parā śaktis tat-stham ānanda-kānanam ||3||
nānā-sukusumāmoda-samīra-surabhī-kṛtam |
kalinda-tanayādivya-taraṅga-rāga-śītalam ||4||
sanakādyair bhāgavataiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ muni-puṅgavaiḥ |
āhlādi-madhurārāvair go-vṛndair abhimaṇḍitam ||5||
ramyasragbhūṣaṇopetair nṛtyadbhir bālakair vṛtam |
tatra śrī-mānkalpatarurjāṃ būnadaparicchadaḥ ||6||
nānā-ratnapravālāḍhyonānā-maṇiphalojjvalaḥ |
tasya mūleratnavedīratnadīdhitidīpitā ||7||
tatra trayīmayaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanamanuttamam |
tatrāsīnaṃ jagannāthaṃ triguṇātītam avyayam ||8||
koṭicandrapratīkāśaṃ koṭibhāskarabhāsvaram |
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ bhāsayantaṃ diśodaśa ||9||
trinetraṃ dvibhujaṅgauraṃ taptajāṃ būnadaprabham |
śliṣyamāṇamaṃ ganābhiḥ sadāmānaṃ casarvaśaḥ ||10||
brahmādyaiḥ sanakādyaiścadhyeyaṃ bhaktavaśīkṛtam |
sadāghūrṇitanetrābhir nṛtyaṃ tībhir maho tsavaiḥ ||11||
cumbaṃ tībhir hasaṃtībhiḥ śliṣyaṃ tībhir muhurmuhuḥ |
avāptagopīdehābhiḥ śrutibhiḥ koṭikoṭibhiḥ ||12||
tatpādāmbujamādhvīkacittābhiḥ paritovṛtam |
tāsāṃ tu-madhye yādevītaptacāmīkaraprabhā ||13||
dyotamānādiśaḥ sarvāḥ kurvatīvidyudujjvalāḥ |
pradhānaṃ yābhagavatīyayāsarvamidaṃ tatam ||14||
sṛṣṭisthityantar- ūpāyāvidyāvidyātrayīparā |
svarūpāśaktirupācamāyārūpācacinmayī ||15||
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ dehakāraṇakāraṇam |
carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ yanmāyāpariraṃ bhitam ||16||
vṛndāvaneśvarīnāmnārādhādhātrānukāraṇāt |
tāmāliṅgyavasaṃtaṃ taṃ mudāvṛndāvaneśvaram ||17||
anyonyacumbanāśleṣamadāveśavighūrṇitam |
dhyāyedevaṃ kṛṣṇadevaṃ sacasiddhimavāpnuyāt ||18||
mantrarājamimaṃ guhyaṃ tasya mantraṃ camantra-vit |
yojapecchṛṇuyādvāpisamahātmāsudurllabhaḥ ||19||
rāiṃ dhakācitrarekhācacandrāmadanasundarī |
śrī-priyāśrīmad-humatīśaśirekhāharipriyā ||20||
suvarṇaśobhāsaṃmohāpremaromāṃ carājitā |
vaivarṇyasveda-saṃyuktābhāvāsaktāpriyaṃ vadā ||21||
suvarṇamālinīśāṃ tāsurāsarasikā tathā |
sarvastrījīvanādīnavatsalāvimalāśayā ||22||
nipītanāmapīyūṣāsārādhāparikīrtitā |
sudīrghasmita-saṃyuktātaptacāmīkaraprabhā ||23||
mūrcchatpremanadīrādhāvaraṇālocanāṃ janā |
māyāmātsarya-saṃyuktādānasāmrājyajīvanā ||24||
suratotsavasaṅgrāmācitrarekhāprakīrtitā |
gaurāṃ gīnātidīrghācasadāvādanatatparā ||25||
dainyānurāganaṭanāmūrcchāromāṃ cavihvalā |
haridakṣiṇapārśvasthāsarvamantrapriyā tathā ||26||
anaṃ galobhamādhuryācandrāsāparikīrtitā |
salīlamaṃ tharagatirmaṣju-mudritalocanā ||27||
premadhārojjvalākīrṇādalitāṃ janaśobhanā |
kṛṣṇānurāgarasikārāsadhvanisamutsukā ||28||
ahaṃ kārasamāyuktāmukhaninditacandramāḥ |
madhurālāpacaturājitendriyaśiromaṇiḥ ||29||
sundarasmita-saṃyuktāsāvaimadanasundarī |
viviktarāsarasikāśyāmāśyāmamanoharā ||30||
premṇāpremakaṭākṣeṇahareścittavimohanī |
jitendriyājitakrodhāsāpriyāparikīrtitā ||31||
sutaptasvarṇagaurāṃ gīlīlāgamanasundarī |
smarotthapremaromāṃ cavaicitramadhurākṛtiḥ ||32||
sundarasmita-saṃyuktamukhaninditacandramāḥ |
madhurālāpacaturājitendriyaśiromaṇiḥ ||33||
kīrtitāsāmadhumatīpremasādhanatatparā |
saṃmohajvararomāṃ capremadhārāsamanvitā ||34||
dānadhūlivinodācarāsadhvanimahā-naṭī |
śaśirekhācavijṣeyāgopālapreyasīsadā ||35||
kṛṣṇātmā sottamā śyāmā madhu-piGgala-locanā |
tat-pāda-prema-saṃmohāt kvacit pulaka-cumbitā ||36||
śiva-kuṇḍe śivānandā nandinī dehikā-taṭe |
rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane ||37||
devakī mathurāyāṃ tu jātā me parameśvarī |
candra-kūṭe tathā sītā vindhye vindhya-nivāsinī ||38||
vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī vimalā puruṣottame |
vṛndāvanādhipatyaṃ ca dattaṃ tasyai prasīdatā ||39||
kṛṣṇe nānyatra devī tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane |
nityānanda-tanuḥ śaurir yo'śarīrīti bhāṣyate ||40||
vāyv-agni-nāka-bhūmīnām aGgādhiṣṭhita-devatā |
nirūpyate brahmaṇo’pi tathā govinda-vigrahaḥ ||41||
sendriyo’pi yathā sūryas tejasā nopalakṣyate |
tathā kānti-yutaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kālaṃ mohayati dhruvam ||42||
na tasya prākṛtīmūrtirmedomāṃ sāsthisambhavā |
yogīcaiveśvaraścānyaḥ sarvātmānityavigrahaḥ ||43||
kāṭhinyaṃ devayogenakarakāghṛtayoriva |
kṛṣṇasyāmitatattvasyapādapṛṣṭhaṃ nadevatā ||44||
vṛndāvanarajovṛṃ de tatra syurviṣṇukoṭayaḥ |
ānandakiraṇevṛndavyāptaviśvakalānidhiḥ ||45||
guṇātmatātmani yathā jīvāstatkiraṇāṃ gakāḥ |
bhujadvayavṛtaḥ kṛṣṇonakadāciccaturbhujaḥ ||46||
gopyaikayāvṛtas tatra parikrīḍati sarvadā |
govinda eva puruṣo brahmādyāḥ striya eva ca ||47||
tata eva svabhāvo’yaṃ prakṛter bhāva īśvaraḥ |
puruṣaḥ prakṛtiś cādyau rādhā-vṛndāvaneśvarau ||48||
prakṛter vikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vinā vṛndāvaneśvaram ||49||
samudbhavenaivasamudbhavedidaṃ bhedaṃ gataṃ tasya vināśatohi |
svarṇasyanāśonahividyate tathā matsyādināśe'pinakṛṣṇavicyutiḥ ||50||
triguṇādiprapaṣco'yaṃ vṛndāvanavihāriṇaḥ |
ūrmīvābdhes-taraṅgasya yathābdhir naiva jāyate ||51||
narādhikāsamānārīnakṛṣṇasadṛśaḥ pumān |
vayaḥ paraṃ nakaiśorātsvabhāvaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ||52||
dhyeyaṃ kaiśorakaṃ dhyeyaṃ vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam |
śyāmamevaparaṃ rūpamādidevaṃ parorasaḥ ||53||
bālyaṃ paṣcamavarṣāntaṃ paugaṇḍaṃ daśamāvadhi |
aṣṭapaṣcakakaiśoraṃ sīmāpaṣcadaśāvadhi ||54||
yauvanodbhinnakaiśoraṃ navayauvanamucyate |
tadvayas tasya sarvasvaṃ prapaṣcamitaradvayaḥ ||55||
bālyapaugaṇḍakaiśoraṃ vayovaṃ demanoharam |
bālagopālagopālaṃ smaragopālarūpiṇam ||56||
vaṃ demadanagopālaṅkaiśorākāramadbhutam |
yamāhuryauvanodbhinnaśrī-manmadanamohanam ||57||
akhaṇḍātulapīyūṣarasānandamahā-rṇavam |
jayatiśrī-patergūḍhaṃ vapuḥ kaiśorarūpiṇaḥ ||58||
ekamapyavyayaṃ pūrvaṃ ballavīvṛndamadhyagam |
dhyānagamyaṃ prapaśyanti rucibhedātpṛthagdhiyaḥ ||59||
yannakhendurucirbrah-madhye yaṃ brahmādibhiḥ suraiḥ |
guṇatrayamatītaṃ taṃ vaṃ devṛndāvaneśvaram ||60||
vṛndāvanaparityāgogovindasya navidyate |
an yatra yadvapustattukṛtrimaṃ tanna saṃśayaḥ ||61||
sulabhaṃ vraja-nārīṇāṃ durllabhaṃ tan mumukṣuṇām |
taṃ bhaje nanda-sūnuṃ yan-nakha-tejaḥ paraṃ manuḥ ||62||
pārvaty uvāca— 
bhukti-mukti-spṛhā yāvat piśācī hṛdi vartate |
tāvat prema-sukhasyātra katham abhyudayo bhavet ||63||
īśvara uvāca—
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā bhadre yan me manasi vartate |
tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sāvadhānā niśāmaya ||64||
smṛtvā guṇān smaran nāma gānaṃ vāmana-raṣjanam |
bodhayaty ātmanātmānaṃ satataṃ premṇi līyate ||65||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vṛndāvana-māhātmye 
pārvatī-śiva-saṃvāde śrī-kṛṣṇa-rūpa-varṇanaṃ nāma 
saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||77||

(78)
aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

pārvaty uvāca—
vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca yad dharmaṃ sarvaṃ tathyaṃ ca me vada |
yat kṛtvā mānavāḥ sarve bhavāmbhodhiṃ taranti hi ||1||
īśvara uvāca—
atha dvādaśadhā śuddhir vaiṣṇavānām ihocyate |
gṛhopalepanaṃ caiva tathā nu gamanaṃ hareḥ ||2||
bhaktyā pradakṣiṇā caiva pādayoḥ śodhanaṃ punaḥ |
pūjārthaṃ patra-puṣpāṇāṃ bhaktyaivottolanaṃ hareḥ ||3||
karayoḥ sarva-śuddhīnām iyaṃ śuddhir viśiṣyate |
tan-nāma-kīrtanaṃ caiva guṇānām api kīrtanam ||4||
bhaktyā śrī-kṛṣṇa-devasya vacasaḥ śuddhir iṣyate |
tat-kathā-śravaṇaṃ caiva tasyotsava-nirīkṣaṇam ||5||
śrotrayor netrayoś caiva śuddhiḥ samyag ihocyate |
pādodakaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ mālānām api dhāraṇam ||6||
ucyate śirasaḥ śuddhiḥ praṇatasya hareḥ puraḥ |
āghrāṇaṃ tasya puṣpāder nirmālyasya tathā priye ||7||
viśuddhiḥ syād antarasya ghrāṇasyāpi vidhīyate |
yatra puṣpādikaṃ yac ca kṛṣṇa-pāda-yugārpitam ||8||
tad ekaṃ pāvanaṃ loke tad dhi sarvaṃ viśodhayet |
pūjā ca paṣcadhā proktā tāsāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣva me ||9||
abhigamanam upādānaṃ yogaḥ svādhyāya eva ca |
ijyā-paṣca-prakārārcā krameṇa kathayāmi te ||10||
tattvābhigamanaṃ nāma devatā-sthāna-mārjanam |
upale paṣca-nirmālya-dūrīkaraṇam eva ca ||11||
upādānaṃ nāma gandha-puṣpādi-cayanaṃ tathā |
yogo nāma sva-devasya svātmanaivātma-bhāvanā ||12||
svādhyāyo nāma mantrārthānusandhā-pūrvako japaḥ |
sūkta-stotrādi-pāṭhaś ca hareḥ saṅkīrtanaṃ tathā ||13||
tattvādi-śāstrābhyāsaś ca svādhyāyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
ijyā nāma sva-devasya pūjanaṃ ca yathārthataḥ ||14||
iti paṣca-prakārārcā kathitā tava suvrate |
sārṣṭi-sāmīpya-sālokya-sāyujya-sārūpya-dā kramāt ||15||
prasaṅgāt kathayiṣyāmi śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
keśavādeś caturbāhor dakṣiṇordhva-kara-kramāt ||16||
śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-padmī keśavākhyo gadādharaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ padma-gadā-cakra-aṅkhāyudhaiḥ kramāt ||17||
mādhavaś cakra-śaṅkhābhyāṃ padmena gadayā bhavet |
gadābja-śaṅkha-cakrī ca govindākhyo gadādharaḥ ||18||
padma-śaṅkhāri-gadine viṣṇu-rūpāya te namaḥ |
sa-śaṅkhābja-gadā-cakra-madhusūdana-mūrtaye ||19||
namo gadāri-śaṅkhābja-yukta-trivikramāya ca |
sāri-kaumodakī-padma-śaṅkha-vāmana-mūrtaye ||20||
cakrābja-śaṅkha-gadine namaḥ śrīdhara-mūrtaye |
hṛṣīkeśa-sārigadā-śaṅkha-padmin namo’stu te ||21||
sābja-śaṅkha-gadā-cakra-padmanābhasva-mūrtaye |
dāmodaraśaṅkha-gadā-cakra-padmin namo’stu te ||22||
śaṅkhābja-cakra-gadine namaḥ saṅkarṣaṇāya ca |
sāri-śaṅkha-gadābjāya vāsudeva namo’stu te ||23||
śaṅkha-cakra-gadābjāya dhṛta-pradyumna-mūrtaye |
namo'niruddhāya gadā-śaṅkhābjāri-vidhāriṇe ||24||
sābja-śaṅkha-gadā-cakra-puruṣottama-mūrtaye |
namo'dhokṣaja-rūpāya gadā-śaṅkhāri-padmine ||25||
nṛsiṃha-mūrtaye padma-gadā-śaṅkhāri-dhāriṇe |
padmāri-śaṅkha-gadine namo’stv acyuta-mūrtaye ||26||
sa-gadābjāri-śaṅkhāya namaḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-mūrtaye |
śālagrāma-śilā-dvāra gata-lagna-dvi-cakra-dhṛk ||27||
śuklābha-rekhaḥ śobhāḍhyaḥ sa devaḥ śrī-gadādharaḥ |
lagna-dvi-cakro raktābhaḥ pūrva-bhāgas tu puṣkalaḥ ||28||
saṅkarṣaṇo'tha pradyumnaḥ sūkṣma-cakras tu pītakaḥ |
sudīrgha-suṣira-cchidro hy aniruddhas tu vartulaḥ ||29||
nīlo dvāre tri-rekhaś ca atha nārāyaṇo'sitaḥ |
madhye gadākṛtī rekhā nābhi-padmaṃ mahonnatam ||30||
pṛthu-cakro nṛsiṃho yaḥ kapilo yas tribindukaḥ |
athavā paṣca-bindos tu pūjanaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ ||31||
varāhaḥ sa triliṅgo yo viṣama-dvaya-cakrakaḥ |
nīlas tri-rekhaḥ sthūlo'tha kūrma-mūrtiḥ sa bindukaḥ ||32||
kṛṣṇaḥ sa vartulāvarta-pāṇḍuro dhṛta-pṛṣṭhakaḥ |
śrīdharaḥ paṣca-rekhaś ca vanamālī gadāṅkitaḥ ||33||
vāmano vartulo nāma madhya-cakraḥ sa-nīlakaḥ |
nānā-varṇān eka-mūrtināga-bhogī tv anantakaḥ ||34||
sthūlo dāmodaro nīlo madhye cakraḥ sa-nīlakaḥ |
saṅkarṣaṇa-dvārakovyād atha brahmā sulohitaḥ ||35||
sudīrgha-rekhā suṣira eka-cakrāmbujaḥ pṛthuḥ |
pṛthu-cakraḥ sthūla-chidraḥ kṛṣṇo binduś ca bindumān ||36||
hayagrīvo’ṅkuśākāraḥ paṣca-rekhaḥ sa-kaustubhaḥ |
vaikuṇṭho mallavad bhāti eka-cakram ayositaḥ ||37||
matsyo dīrghāmbujākāro dīrgha-rekhaś ca pāṇḍuraḥ |
rāma-cakro dakṣa-rekho yaḥ śyāmaḥ sa trivikramaḥ ||38||
śālagrāma-dvārakāyāṃ sthitāya gadine namaḥ |
ekena lakṣito yo’vyād gadādhārī sudarśanaḥ ||39||
lakṣmī-nārāyaṇo dvābhyāṃ tribhiś caiva trivikramaḥ |
caturbhiś ca catur-vyūho vāsudevaś ca paṣcabhiḥ ||40||
pradyumnaḥ ṣaḍbhir evāvyāt saṅkarṣaṇaś ca saptabhiḥ |
puruṣottamo'ṣṭabhiś ca syān nava-vyūho navo hitaḥ ||41||
daśāvatāro daśabhir aniruddho'vatād atha |
dvādaśātmā dvādaśabhir ata ūrdhvam anantakaḥ ||42||
brahmā catur-mukho daṇḍī kamaṇḍalu-srag-unnataḥ |
maheśvaraḥ paṣca-vaktro daśa-bāhur vṛṣadhvajaḥ ||43||
yathā yudhas tathā gaurī caṇḍikā ca sarasvatī |
mahā-lakṣmīr mātaraś ca padma-hasto divākaraḥ ||44||
gajāsyaś ca gaja-skandhaḥ ṣaṇmukho nekadhā gaṇāḥ |
ete sthitāḥ sthāpitāḥ syuḥ prasāde vātha pūjitāḥ ||45||
dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣā hi prāpyante puruṣeṇa ca ||46||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śālagrāma-nirṇayo
nāmāṣṭa-saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||78||

(79)
navasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

īśvara uvāca—
śālagrāme maṇau yantre maṇḍale  pratimāsu ca |
nityaṃ tu śrī-hareḥ pūjā kevale bhavanena tu ||1||
gaṇḍakyām eka-deśe tu śālagrāma-sthalaṃ mahat |
pāṣāṇaṃ tad-bhavaṃ pātu śālagrāmam iti sthitam ||2||
śālagrāma-śilā-sparśāt koṭi-janmāgha-nāśanam |
kiṃ punaḥ pūjanaṃ tatra hareḥ sāṃnidhya-kāraṇam ||3||
śālagrāmaika-yajanāc chata-liṅgī-phalaṃ labhet |
bahubhir janmabhiḥ puṇyair yadi kṛṣṇa-śilāṃ labhet ||4||
goṣpadena ca cihnena janus tena samāpyate |
ādau śilāṃ parīkṣeta snigdhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ca mecakām ||5||
ākṛṣṇā madhyamā proktā miśrā-miśra-phala-pradā |
sadā kāṣṭhe sthito vahnir mathanena prakāśyate ||6||
yathā tathā harir vyāpī śālagrāme pratīyate |
pratyahaṃ dvādaśa-śilāḥ śālagrāmasya yo'rcayet ||7||
dvāravatyāḥ śilā yuktāḥ sa vaikuṇṭhe mahīyate |
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ tu gahvaraṃ lakṣate naraḥ ||8||
pitaras tasya tiṣṭhanti tṛptāḥ kalpāntakaṃ divi |
vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ tatra yatra dvārāvatī-śilā ||9||
mṛto viṣṇu-puraṃ yāti tat-tīrthaṃ yojana-trayam |
japaḥ pūjā ca homaś ca sarvaṃ koṭi-guṇaṃ bhavet ||10||
manaskāma-samābhīṣṭaṃ krośa-mātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
kīṭako’pi mṛtiṃ yāti vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ yataḥ ||11||
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ yo mūlyam udghāṭayen naraḥ |
vikretācānumaṃ tācayaḥ parīkṣānumodakaḥ ||12||
sarve tenarakaṃ yāṃ tiyāvatsūryaś ca samplavaḥ |
atastadvarjayeddevicakrakrayaṇavikrayam ||13||
śālagrāmodbhavo devo yo devo dvārakodbhavaḥ |
ubhayoḥ saṅgamo yatra muktis tatra na saṃśayaḥ ||14||
dvārakodbhava-cakrāḍhyo bahu-cakreṇa cihnitaḥ |
cakrāsanaśilākāracitsvarūponiraṃ janaḥ ||15||
namo'stvoṃ kārarūpāyasadānandasvarūpiṇe |
śālagrāma-mahā-bhāga bhaktasyānugrahaṃ kuru ||16||
tavānugrahakāmasyaṛṇagras tasya meprabho |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmitilakasyavidhiṃ mudā ||17||
yacchrutvāmānavāḥ sarve viṣṇusārūpyamāpnuyuḥ |
lalāṭekeśavaṃ vidyātkaṇṭheśrī-puruṣottamam ||18||
nābhaunārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ hṛdaye tathā |
dāmodaraṃ vāmapārśvedakṣiṇecatrivikramam ||19||
mūrdhnicaiva hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ capṛṣṭhataḥ |
karṇayor yamunāṃ gaṅgāṃ bāhvoḥ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ tathā ||20||
 yathā sthāneṣu tuṣyanti devatādvādasasmṛtāḥ |
dvādaśaitānināmānikartavyetilakepaṭhet ||21||
sarva-pāpa-viśuddhātmā viṣṇu-lokaṃ sa gacchati |
ūrdhva-puṇḍram ūrdhva-rekhaṃ lalāṭe yasya dṛśyate ||22||
cāṇḍālo’pi sa śuddhātmā pūjya eva na saṃśayaḥ |
yasyordhva-puṇḍraṃ dṛśyeta na lalāṭe narasya hi ||23||
tad-darśanaṃ na kartavyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūryaṃ nirīkṣayet |
tri-puṇḍraṃ yasya viprasya ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ na dṛśyate ||24||
taṃ dṛṣṭvāpy athavā spṛṣṭvā sa-cailaṃ snānam ācaret |
sāntarālaṃ prakartavyaṃ puṇḍraṃ hari-padākṛti ||25||
nirantarālaṃ yaḥ kuryād ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ dvijādhamaḥ |
lalāṭe tasya satataṃ śunaḥ pādo na saṃśayaḥ ||26||
nāsādikeśaparyantamūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ suśobhanam |
madhye chidrasamāyuktaṃ taṃ vidyāddharimandiram ||27||
vāmabhāgesthitobrahmādakṣiṇetusadāśivaḥ |
madhye viṣṇuṃ vijānīyāttasmānmadhyaṃ nalepayet ||28||
vīkṣyādarśejalevāpiyovidadhyātprayatnataḥ |
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ mahā-bhāgaḥ sayātiparamāṃ gatim ||29||
agnirāpaś ca vedāścacandrādityau tathā nilaḥ |
viprāṇāṃ nityametehikarṇetiṣṭhanti dakṣiṇe ||30||
gaṅgācadakṣiṇeśrotrenāsikāyāṃ hutāśanaḥ |
ubhayorapisaṃsparśāttatkṣaṇādevaśudhyati ||31||
kṛtvācaivodakaṃ śaṅkhevaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām |
tulasīmiśritaṃ dadyātpibenmūrdhnābhivaṃ dayet ||32||
prāśnīyātprokṣayeddehaṃ putramitraparigraham |
viṣṇoḥ pādodakaṃ pītaṃ koṭijanmāghanāśanam ||33||
tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ pāpaṃ bhūmaubindunipātanāt |
jalaśaṅkhaṃ karekṛtvāstutvānatvāpradakṣiṇam ||34||
satataṃ dhāryatevāritenāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam |
śaṅkho yasya gṛhenāstighaṇṭāvāgaruḍānvitā ||35||
purato vāsudevasya na sa bhāgavataḥ kalau |
yānair vā pādukābhir vā yānaṃ bhagavato gṛhe ||36||
devotsaveṣv asevā ca apraṇāmas tad-agrataḥ |
ucchiṣṭe caiva cāśauce bhagavad-vandanādikam ||37||
ekahastapraṇāmaś ca tatpurastātpradakṣiṇam |
pādaprasāraṇaṃ cāgre tathā paryaṃ kasevanam ||38||
śayanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ cāpimithyābhāṣaṇam eva ca |
uccair bhāṣāmithojalporodanāni cavigrahaḥ ||39||
nigrahānugrahaucaiva strīṣucakrūrabhāṣaṇam |
kevalāvaraṇaṃ caiva paraniṃ dāparastutiḥ ||40||
aślīlabhāṣaṇaṃ caiva adhovāyuvimokṣaṇam |
śaktaugauṇopacāraś ca aniveditabhakṣaṇam ||41||
tat-tat-kālodbhavānāṃ caphalādīnāmanarpaṇam |
viniyuktāvaśiṣṭasyapradānaṃ vyaṃ janasyayat ||42||
spaṣṭīkṛtyāśanaṃ caiva paraniṃ dāparastutiḥ |
guraumaunaṃ nijastotraṃ devatāniṃ danaṃ tathā ||43||
aparādhās tathā viṣṇordvātriṃ śatparikīrtitāḥ ||44||
aparādhasahasrāṇikriyaṃ te'harniśaṃ mayā |
tavāhamitimāṃ matvākṣamasvamadhusūdana ||45||
itimantraṃ samuccāryapraṇameddaṇḍavadbhuvi |
aparādhasahasrāṇikṣamatesarvadāhariḥ ||46||
sāyaṃ prātardvijātīnāṃ śrutyuktamaśanaṃ tathā |
viṣṇu-bhaktāvaśiṣṭasyadinapāpātpramucyate ||47||
annaṃ brahmārasoviṣṇuḥ khādayenmāṃ samuccaran |
evaṃ jṣātvā tuyobhuṃ kteso'nnadoṣair nalipyate ||48||
alābuṃ vartulākāraṃ masūraṃ casavalkalam |
tālaṃ śuklaṃ cavṛṃ tākaṃ nakhādedvaiṣṇavonaraḥ ||49||
vaṭāśvatthārkapatreṣu kuṃ bhītiṃ dukapatrayoḥ |
kovidārekadaṃ becanakhādedvaiṣṇanonaraḥ ||50||
śrāvaṇevarjayecchākaṃ dadhibhādrapadetyajet |
āśvinemāsidugdhaṃ cakārttikecāmiṣanty ajet ||51||
dagdhamannaṃ tujaṃ bīraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam |
bījapūraṃ caśākaṃ capratyakṣalavaṇaṃ tathā ||52||
yadidaivāccabhuṃ jītatadātannāmasaṃsmaret |
haimanti kaṃ sitāsvinnandhānyaṃ mudgāstilāyavāḥ ||53||
kalāpakaṃ gunīvārāḥ śākaṃ cahilamocikā |
kālaśākaṃ cavāstūkaṃ mūlakaṃ raktaketarat ||54||
lavaṇesiṃ dhusāmudregavyecadadhisarpiṣī |
payonuddhṛtasāraṃ capanasāmraharītakī ||55||
pippalījīrakaṃ caiva nāgaraṃ gakatiṃ tiḍī |
kadalīlavalīdhātrīphalānyaguḍamaikṣavam ||56||
atailapakvaṃ munayohaviṣyānnaṃ pracakṣate |
tulasīpatrapuṣpādyair mālyaṃ vahatiyonaraḥ ||57||
viṣṇuṃ tamapijānīyātsatyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
dhātrīvṛkṣaṃ samāropyaviṣṇutulyobhavennaraḥ ||58||
kurukṣetraṃ vijānīyātsārddhaṃ hastaśa tatra yam |
tulasīkāṣṭhaghaṭitair udrākṣākārakāritaiḥ ||59||
nirmitāṃ mālikāṃ kaṇṭhenidhāyārcanamārabhet |
 tathā malakamālāṃ casamyakpuṣkaramālikām ||60||
kaṇṭhemālāṃ cayatnena dhārayedviṣṇupūjakaḥ |
nirmālyaṃ tulasīmālāṃ śirasyapicadhārayet ||61||
nirmālyacandanenāṃ gamaṃ kayet tasya nāmabhiḥ |
lalāṭe ca gadādhāryā mūrdhni cāpaṃ śaras tathā ||62||
nandakaṃ caiva hṛn-madhye śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ bhujadvaye |
śaṅkha-cakrānvitovipraḥ śmaśānemriyateyadi ||63||
prayāgeyāgatiḥ proktāsāgatis tasya niścitā |
yodhṛtvātulasīpatraṃ śirasāviṣṇutat-paraḥ ||64||
karotisarvakāryāṇiphalamāpnoticākṣayam |
tulasīkāṣṭhamālābhir bhūṣitaḥ karma ācaran ||65||
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ cakṛtaṃ koṭi-guṇaṃ bhavet |
nivedyakeśavemālāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhanirmitām ||66||
vahateyonarobhaktyā tasya naśyatipātakam |
pādyādibhir athābhyarcyaimaṃ mantramudīrayet ||67||
yādṛṣṭānikhilāghasaṅghaśamanīspṛṣṭāvapuḥ pāvanī |
rogāṇāmabhivanditānirasanīsiktāntakatrāsinī ||
pratyāsattividhāyinībhagavataḥ kṛṣṇasyasaṃropitā | nyastātaccaraṇevimuktiphaladā tasyai tulasyainamaḥ ||68||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vṛndāvana-māhātmye devīśvara-saṃvāde
tilakādi-nirṇayo nāma navasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||79||

(80)
aśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

pārvaty uvāca—
ghorekaliyugeprāpteviṣayagrāhasaṃkule |
putradāradhanādyārtaistat kathaṃ dhāryatevibho ||1||
tad-upāyaṃ mahā-deva kathayasva kṛpā-nidhe |
īśvara uvāca—
harer nāmaharer nāmaharer nāmaivakevalam ||2||
harerāmahare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetimaṃ galam |
evaṃ vadanti yenityaṃ nahitānbādhatekaliḥ ||3||
antar- āntarakarmāṇikṛtvānāmāni casmaret |
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇetikṛṣṇetyāhapunaḥ punaḥ ||4||
mannāmacaiva tvannāmayojayitvā vyatikramāt |
so’pi pāpātpramucyetatūlarāśerivānalaḥ ||5||
jayādyetattvayāvāpyathavā śrī-śabdapūrvakam |
taccamemaṃ galaṃ nāmajapanpāpātpramucyate ||6||
divāniśicasamdhyāyāṃ sarvakāleṣu saṃsmaret |
aharniśaṃsmaranrāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaticakṣuṣā ||7||
aśucirvāśucirvāpisarvakāleṣu sarvadā |
nāmasaṃsmaraṇādevasaṃsārānmucyatekṣaṇāt ||8||
nānā-parādhayuk tasya nāmāpicaharatyagham |
yajṣavratatapodānaṃ sāṅgaṃ naivakalauyuge ||9||
gaṅgā-snānaṃ harer nāma nirapāyam idaṃ dvayam ||10||
hatyā-yutaṃ pāpa-sahasram ugraṃ 
gurv-aṅganā-koṭi-niṣevaṇaṃ ca |
steyān yathānyāni hareḥ priyeṇa 
govinda-nāmnā na ca santi bhadre ||11||
apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato’pi vā |
yaḥ smaret puṇḍīkākṣaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ||12||
nāma-saṃsmaraṇād eva tathā tasyārtha-cintanāt |
sauvarṇīṃ rājatīṃ vāpi tathā paiṣṭīṃ srag-ākṛtim ||13||
pādayoś cihnitāṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ caiva samārabhet |
dakṣiṇasya pado’ṅguṣṭha-mūle cakraṃ bibharti yaḥ ||14||
 tatra namrajanasyāpisaṃsāracchedanāya ca |
madhyamāṃ gulimūletudhattekamalamacyutaḥ ||15||
dhyātṛcittadvirephāṇāṃ lobhanāyātiśobhanam |
padmasyādhodhvajaṃ dhattesarvānarthajayadhvajam ||16||
kaniṣṭhāmūlatovajraṃ bhaktapāpaughabhedanam |
pārśva-madhye’ṅkuśaṃ bhaktacitterabhasakāraṇam ||17||
bhogasampanmayaṃ dhatteyavamaṃ guṣṭhaparvaṇi |
mūlegadāṃ ca pāpādribhedanīṃ sarvadehinām ||18||
sarvavidyāprakāśāyadhattesabhagavān ajaḥ |
padmādīnyapicihnāni tatra dakṣeṇayatpunaḥ ||19||
vāmapādevasetso'yaṃ bibharttikaruṇānidhiḥ |
tasmād govindamāhātmyaṃ ānandarasasundaram ||20||
śṛṇuyātkīrttayennityaṃ sanirmuktona saṃśayaḥ |
māsakṛtyaṃ pravakṣyāmiviṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ param ||21||
jyeṣṭhetusnāpanaṃ kuryācchrīviṣṇoryatnataḥ śuciḥ |
dainandinaṃ tuduritaṃ pakṣamāsarttuvarṣajam ||22||
brahmahatyāsahasrāṇijṣātājṣātakṛtāni ca |
svarṇasteyasurāpānagurutalpāyutāni ca ||23||
koṭikoṭisahasrāṇihyupapāpāniyāni ca |
sarvāṇyathapraṇaśyanti paurṇamāsyāṃ tuvāsare ||24||
āsiṃ cedacyutaṃ mūrdhnitadaitatkalaśodakam |
puruṣasūktenamantreṇapāvamānībhir eva ca ||25||
nālikerodakenātha tathā tālaphalāṃ bunā |
ratnodakena-gandhena tathā puṣpodakena ca ||26||
paṣcopacārair ārādhya yathā vibhavavistaraiḥ |
ghaṃ ghaṇṭāyainamaitighaṇṭāvādyaṃ pradāpayet ||27||
patitasya mahādhvāna-nyasta-pātaka-saṃcaye |
pāhi māṃ pāpinaṃ ghora-saṃsārārṇava-pātinam ||28||
ya evaṃ kurute vidvān brāhmaṇaḥ śrotriyaḥ śuciḥ |
sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyetaviṣṇulokaṃ sagacchati ||29||
āṣāḍha-śuklaikādaśyāṃ kuryāt svāpa-mahotsavam |
āṣāḍhe ca rathaṃ kuryāc chrāvaṇe śravaṇāvidhim ||30||
bhādre ca janma-divasa upavāsa-paro bhavet |
prasuptasya parīvartam āśvine māsi kārayet ||31||
utthānaṃ śrī-hareḥ kuryād an yathā viṣṇudrohakṛt |
śubhecaivāśvinemāsimahā-māyāṃ capūjayet ||32||
sauvarṇīṃ rājatīṃ vāpiviṣṇurūpāṃ baliṃ vinā |
hiṃ sādveṣaunakartavyaudharmātmāviṣṇupūjakaḥ ||33||
kārtikepuṣyamāsecakāmataḥ puṇyamācaret |
dāmodarāyadīpaṣcaprāṃ śusthānepradāpayet ||34||
saptavartipramāṇenadīpaḥ syāccaturaṃ gulaḥ |
pakṣāṃ tecaprakartavyādīpamālāvaliḥ śubhā ||35||
mārgaśīrṣesitepakṣeṣaṣṭhyāṃ casitavastrakaiḥ |
pūjayejjagadīśaṃ cabrahmāṇaṃ caviśeṣataḥ ||36||
pauṣepuṣpābhiṣekaṃ cavarjayeccandanaṃ ślatham |
saṃkrāṃ tyāṃ māghamāsecasādhivāsitataṇḍulāt ||37||
naivedyaṃ viṣṇavedadyādimaṃ mantramudīrayet |
brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyādevadevapuraḥ sthitān ||38||
abhyarcyabhagavadbhaktāndvijāṃś cabhagavaddhiyā |
e kasmin bhojitebhaktekoṭirbhavatibhojitā ||39||
viprabhojanamātreṇavyaṃ gaṃ sāṅ-gandhruvaṃ bhavet |
paṣcamyāṃ śuklapakṣetusnāpayitvā cakeśavam ||40||
pūjayitvā vidhānenacūtapallava-saṃyutaiḥ |
phalacūrṇaiścavividhair vāsitaiḥ paṭasādhitaiḥ ||41||
kānanaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ capradīptaṃ dīpadīpitam |
drākṣekṣuraṃ bhājaṃ bīranāgaraṃ gaṃ capūgakam ||42||
nālikeraṃ cadhātrīṃ capanasaṃcaharītakīm |
anyaiścavṛkṣakhaṇḍaiścasarvartukusumānvitaiḥ ||43||
anyaiścavividhaiś caiva phalapuṣpasamanvitaiḥ |
vitānaiḥ kusumoddāmair vāripūrṇaghaṭais tathā ||44||
cūtaśākhopaśākhābhiḥ śobhitaṃ chatracāmaraiḥ |
jayakṛṣṇetisaṃsmṛtyapradakṣiṇapurassaram ||45||
viśeṣataḥ kali-yuge dolotsavo vidhīyate |
phālgunecacaturdaśyāmaṣṭameyāmasaṃjṣake ||46||
athavā paurṇamāsyāṃ tupratipatsamdhisaṃjṣake |
pūjayed vidhivad bhaktyā phalgu-cūrṇaiś catur-vidhaiḥ ||47||
sita-raktair gaura-pītaiḥ karpūrādi-vimiśritaiḥ |
haridrārāgayogāccaraṃ garūpair manoharaiḥ ||48||
anyair vāraṃ garūpaiścaprīṇayetparameśvaram |
ekādaśyāṃ samārabhyapaṣcamyāntaṃ samāpayet ||49||
paṣcāhāni try-ahānivā dolotsavo vidhīyate |
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dolamānaṃ sakṛnnarāḥ ||50||
dṛṣṭvā parādhanicayair muktāstenātrasaṃśayaḥ |
nikṣipyajalapātrecamāsimādhavasaṃjṣake ||51||
sauvarṇapātreraupyevātāmrevāpyathamṛṇmaye |
toya-sthaṃ yo'rcayed devaṃ śālagrāma-samudbhavam ||52||
pratimāṃ vā mahā-bhāge tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate |
damanāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā śrī-viṣṇau ca samarpayet ||53||
vaiśākhe śrāvaṇe bhādre kartavyaṃ vā tad-arpaṇam |
pūrve pūrve tu vātasthe damanādiṣu karmasu ||54||
prakartavyaṃ vidhānena an yathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet |
vaiśākhe ca tṛtīyāyāṃ jala-madhye viśeṣataḥ ||55||
athavā maṇḍale kuryān maṇḍape vā bṛhad-vane |
sugandha-candanenāṅgaṃ supuṣṭaṃ ca dine dine ||56||
yathā prayatnataḥ kuryāt kṛśāṅgasyeva puṣṭidam |
candanāguru-hrībera-kṛṣṇa-kuṅkuma-rocanā ||57||
jaṭāmāṃ sīmurā caiva viṣṇor gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ |
tais tair gandha-yutaiś cāpi viṣṇor aṅgāni lepayet ||58||
dhṛṣṭaṃ ca tulasī-kāṣṭhaṃ karpūrāguru-yogataḥ |
athavā kesarair yojyaṃ hari-candanam ucyate ||59||
yātrā kāle ca ye kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyā paśyanti mānavāḥ |
na teṣāṃ punar āvṛttiḥ kalpa-koṭi-śatair api ||60||
sugandha-miśritais toyair deva-devaṃ galanti ye |
athavā puṣpa-madhye tu sthāpayej jagad-īśvaram ||61||
vṛndāvanaṃ tatra gatvā upaskṛtya phalāni ca |
viṣṇu-bhaktena yogyena bhojayet tad aśeṣataḥ ||62||
nārikelaphalaṃ bījakośaṃ coddhṛtyadāpayet |
ghoṇṭāphalaṃ capanasaṃkośamuddhṛtyadāpayet ||63||
dadhnāvimiśritaṃ cānnaṃ ghṛtenāplutyadāpayet |
pācitaṃ piṣṭakaṃ pūpamaṣṭādaśaghṛtena ca ||64||
tailaiścaitilasaṃmiśraiḥ phalaṃ pakvaṃ pradāpayet |
yadyadevātmanaḥ prītaṃ tattadīśāyadāpayet ||65||
datvānaivedyavastrādinādadīta kathaṃ cana |
tyaktaṃ caviṣṇumuddiśyatadbhaktebhyoviśeṣataḥ ||66||
ititekathitaṃ kiṣcitsamāsenamaheśvari |
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena svayonirivapārvati ||67||
śrī-kṛṣṇarūpaguṇavarṇanaśāstravargabodhādhikāraihacedalamanyapāṭhaiḥ |
tatpremabhāvarasabhaktivilāsanāmahā-reṣu cetkhalumanaḥ kimukāminībhiḥ ||68||
tac cetasā prabhajatāṃ vrajabālakendraṃ 
vṛndāvana-kṣiti-talaṃ yamunā-jalaṃ ca |
tal-lokanātha-pada-paṅkaja-dhūli-miśra-
liptaṃ vapuḥ kila vṛthāgaru-candanādyaiḥ ||69||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe umā-maheśvara-saṃvāde vṛndāvana-
māhātmye aśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||80||

(81)
ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

ṛṣayaūcuḥ
sūtajīvaciraṃ sādhośrī-kṛṣṇacaritāmṛtam |
tvayāprakāśitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhavatāraṇam ||1||
śrī-kṛṣṇalīlāṃ nikhilāṃ brūhi dainandinīṃ prabho |
yayākarṇitayāsādhokṛṣṇebhaktirvivarddhate ||2||
guroḥ śiṣ yasya mantrasyavidhānaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak |
vadāsmākaṃ mahā-bhāgatvaṃ hinaḥ paramaḥ suhṛt ||3||
sūta uvāca—
ekadā yamunā-tīre samāsīnaṃ jagad-gurum |
nāradaḥ praṇipatyāha devadevaṃ sadāśivam ||4||
nārada uvāca—
deva-deva mahā-deva sarvajṣa jagadīśvara |
bhagavaddharmatattvajṣakṛṣṇamantravidāṃ vara ||5||
kṛṣṇamantrāmayā labdhāstvatto yecapituḥ pare |
tesarve sādhitāstatvānmantrarājādayo mayā ||6||
bahuvarṣasahasraistuśākamūlaphalāśinā |
śuṣkaparṇāṃ buvāyvādibhojinācanirāśinā ||7||
strīṇāṃ samdarśanālāpavarjinābhūmiśāyinā |
kāmādiṣaḍguṇaṃ jitvābāhyendriyaniyamyatā ||8||
evaṃ kṛte'pinaivātmāsaṃtuṣṭomama śaṅkara |
tadbrūhi yatprasidhyetasaṃskārādyair vināprabho ||9||
sakṛduccāraṇādevadadātiphalam uttamam |
yadiyogyo’smi deveśatadāmekṛpayā vada ||10||
śiva uvāca—
sādhupṛṣṭaṃ mahā-bhāgatvayālokahitaiṣiṇā |
sugopyamapivakṣyāmimantracintāmaṇiṃ tava ||11||
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ yadguhyānāṃ guhyam uttamam |
namayā kathitaṃ devyaināgrajebhyaḥ purātava ||12||
vakṣyāmiyugalaṃ tubhyaṃ kṛṣṇamantramanuttamam |
mantracintāmaṇirnāmayugalaṃ dvayam eva ca ||13||
paryāyā asyamantrasya tathā paṣcapadītica |
gopījanapadaṃ vallabhāntaṃ tucaraṇāniti ||14||
śaraṇaṃ caprapadyeca eṣapaṣcapadātmakaḥ |
mantracintāmaṇiḥ proktaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇomahā-manuḥ ||15||
namogopījanetyuktvāvallabhābhyāṃ vadettataḥ |
padadvayātmakomantrodaśārṇaḥ khalukathyate ||16||
etāṃ paṣcapadīṃ japtvāśraddhayāśraddhayāsakṛt |
kṛṣṇapriyāṇāṃ sānnidhyaṃ gacchatyevana saṃśayaḥ ||17||
napuraś ca raṇaprekṣānāsyanyāsavidhikramaḥ |
nadeśakālaniyamonārimitrādiśodhanam ||18||
sarve 'dhikāriṇaścātracaṇḍālāṃ tāmunīśvara |
striyaḥ śūdrādayaś cāpi jaḍamūkādipaṃ gavaḥ ||19||
anyehūṇāḥ kirātāścapuliṃ dāḥ puṣkasās tathā |
ābhīrāyavanāḥ kaṃ kāḥ khasādyāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ||20||
daṃ bhāhaṃ kāraparamāḥ pāpāḥ paiśunyatatparāḥ |
gobrāhmaṇādihaṃ tāromaho papātakānvitāḥ ||21||
jñāna vai rāgyarahitāḥ śravaṇādivivarjitāḥ |
etecānyecasarve syurmanorasyādhikāriṇaḥ ||22||
yadibhaktirbhavedeṣāṃ kṛṣṇesarve śvareśvare |
tadādhikāriṇaḥ sarve nānyathā muni-sattama ||23||
yājṣikodānanirataḥ sarvataṃ tropasevakaḥ |
satyavādīyatirvāpivedavedāṃ gapāragaḥ ||24||
brahmaniṣṭhaḥ kulīnovātapasvīvratatat-paraḥ |
atrādhikārīnabhavetkṛṣṇabhaktivivarjitaḥ ||25||
tasmād akṛṣṇabhaktāyakṛtaghnāyanamānine |
na ca śraddhāvihīnāyavaktavyaṃ nāstikāya ca ||26||
nacāśuśrūṣavevācyaṃ nāsaṃvatsarasevine |
śrī-kṛṣṇe'nanyabhaktāyadaṃ bhalobhavivarjine ||27||
kāmakrodhavimuktāyadeyametatprayatnataḥ |
ṛṣiścaivāhame tasya gāyatrīchaṃ daucyate ||28||
devatāballavīkāṃ tomantrasyaparikīrtitaḥ |
sapri yasya harerdāsyeviniyogaudāhṛtaḥ ||29||
ācakrādyais tathā mantraiḥ paṣcāṃ gāniprakalpayet |
athavā pisvabījenakarāṃ ganyāsakaucaret ||30||
mantrasyaprathamovarṇobindunāmūrdhnibhūṣitaḥ |
gamity evaṃ bhavedbījaṃ namaḥ śaktirihoditā ||31||
anti mārṇair daśāṃ gānitair eva ca tathā rcanam |
gandhapuṣpādibhistaccajalair evāpyasambhave ||32||
nyāsapūrvavidhānenakartavyaṃ harituṣṭaye |
ata evāsyamantrasyanyāsādyanyevadanti ca ||33||
sakṛduccāraṇādevakṛtakṛtyatvadāyinaḥ |
 tathāpi daśadhānityaṃ japādyarthaṃ pravinyaset ||34||
athadhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmimantrasyāsyadvijottama |
pītāmbaraṃ ghana-śyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ vanamālinam ||35||
barhi-barha-kṛtottaṃsaṃ śaśi-koṭi-nibhānanam |
ghūrṇāyamāna-nayanaṃ karṇikārāvataṃsinam ||36||
abhitaś candanenātha madhye kuṅkuma-bindunā |
racitaṃ tilakaṃ bhāle bibhrataṃ maṇḍalākṛtim ||37||
taruṇāditya-saṃkāśaṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ virājitam |
gharmāmbu-kaṇikā-rājad-darpaṇābha-kapolakam ||38||
priyāsya-nyasta-nayanaṃ līlā-pāṅgonnata-bhruvam |
agra-bhāga-nyasta-muktā-visphurat-procca-nāsikam ||39||
daśana-jyotsnayārājat-pakva-bimba-phalādharam |
keyūrāṅgada-sad-ratna-mudrikābhir lasat-karam ||40||
bibhrataṃ muralīṃ vāme pāṇau padmaṃ tathaiva ca |
kāṣcī-dāma-sphuran-madhyaṃ nūpurābhyāṃ lasat-padam ||41||
rati-keli-rasāveśa-capalaṃ capalekṣaṇam |
hasantaṃ priyayā sārdhaṃ hāsayantaṃ ca tāṃ muhuḥ ||42||
itthaṃ kalpa-taror mūle ratna-siṃhāsanopari |
vṛndāraṇye smaret kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsthitaṃ priyayā saha ||43||
vāma-pārśve sthitāṃ tasya rādhikāṃ ca smaret tataḥ |
nīla-colaka-saṃvītāṃ tapta-hema-sama-prabhām ||44||
paṭṭāṣcalenāvṛtārdha-susmerānana-paṅkajām |
kānta-vaktre nyasta-netrāṃ cakorī-caṣcalekṣaṇām ||45||
aṅguṣṭha-tarjanībhyāṃ ca nija-kānta-mukhāmbuje |
arpayantīṃ pūga-phalaṃ parṇa-cūrṇa-samanvitam ||46||
muktāhāra-sphurac-cārupīnonnata-payodharām |
kṣīṇa-madhyāṃ pṛthu-śroṇīṃ kiṅkiṇī-jāla-maṇḍitām ||47||
ratna-tāṭaṅka-keyūra-mudrā-valaya-dhāriṇīm |
raṇat-kaṭaka-maṣjīra-ratna-pādāṃ gulīyakām ||48||
lāvaṇya-sāra-mugdhāṅgīṃ sarvāvayava-sundarīm |
ānanda-rasa-saṃmagnāṃ prasannāṃ nava-yauvanām ||49||
sakhyaś ca tasyā viprendra tat-samāna-vayo-guṇāḥ |
tat-sevana-parābhāvyāś cāmara-vyajanādibhiḥ ||50||
atha tubhyaṃ pravakṣyāmimantrārthaṃ śṛṇunārada |
bahiraṃ gaiḥ prapaṣcasyasvāṃ śair māyādiśaktibhiḥ ||51||
antara-ṃ gais tathā nityavibhūtais taiścidādibhiḥ |
gopanāducyategopīrādhikākṛṣṇa-vallabhā ||
devīkṛṣṇamayīproktārādhikāparadevatā ||52||
sarvalakṣmīsvarūpāsākṛṣṇāhlādasvarūpiṇī |
tataḥ sāprocyateviprahlādinītimanīṣibhiḥ ||53||
tatkalākoṭikoṭyaṃ śadurgādyāstriguṇātmikāḥ |
sātusākṣānmahā-lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇonārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||54||
naitayorvidyatebhedaḥ svalpo’pi muni-sattama |
iyaṃ durgāharīrudraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śakraiyaṃ śacī ||55||
sāvitrīyaṃ harirbrahmādhūmorṇāsauyamohariḥ |
bahunākiṃ muniśreṣṭhavinātābhyāṃ n akiṣcana ||56||
cidacillakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ rādhākṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat |
itthaṃ sarvaṃ tayorevavibhūtiṃ viddhinārada ||57||
naśakyate mayā vaktuṃ varṣakoṭi-śatair api |
trailokyepṛthivīmānyājaṃ būdvīpaṃ tato varam ||58||
tatrāpibhārataṃ varṣaṃ tatrāpimathurāpurī |
 tatra vṛndāvanaṃ nāma tatra gopīkadambakam ||59||
 tatra rādhāsakhīvargastatrāpirādhikāvarā |
sāṃ nidhyādhikyatastasyā ādhikyaṃ syādyathottaram ||60||
pṛthivīprabhṛtīnāṃ tunānyatkiṣcidihoditam |
saiṣāhirādhikāgopījanastasyāḥ sakhīgaṇaḥ ||61||
tasyāḥ sakhīsamūhasyavallabhauprāṇanāyakau |
rādhākṛṣṇautayoḥ pādāḥ śaraṇaṃ syādihāśraye ||62||
prapadyegatavānasmijīvo'haṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ |
so'haṃ yaḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptomama tasya yadastica ||63||
sarvaṃ tābhyāntadarthaṃ hitadbhogyaṃ nahyahaṃ mama |
ityasaukathitovipramantrasyārthaḥ samāsataḥ ||64||
yugalārthas tathā nyāsaḥ prapattiḥ śaraṇāgatiḥ |
ātmārpaṇamimepaṣcaparyāyāste mayoditāḥ ||65||
ayamevacintanīyodivānaktamataṃ dritaiḥ ||66||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vṛndāvana-māhātmye
ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||81||

(82)
dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

śiva uvāca—
atha dīkṣā-vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nārada-tattvataḥ |
śravaṇād eva mucyeta vinā tasya vidhānataḥ ||1||
āviriṣcyāj jagat sarvaṃ vijṣāya naśvaraṃ budhaḥ |
ādhyātmikādi-trividha-duḥkham evānubhūya ca ||2||
anityatvāc ca sarveṣāṃ sukhānāṃ muni-sattama |
duḥkha-pakṣe vinikṣipya tāni tebhyo vivarjitaḥ ||3||
virajya saṃsṛter hānau sādhanāni vicintayet |
anuttama-sukhasyāpi samprāptau bhṛśa-nirvṛtaḥ ||4||
narāṇāṃ duṣkaratvaṃ hi vijṣāya ca mahā-matiḥ |
bhṛśam ārtas tato vipra māṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet ||5||
śānto vimatsaraḥ kṛṣṇe bhakto'nanya-prayojanaḥ |
ananya-sādhanaḥ śrīmān kāma-lobha-vivarjitaḥ ||6||
śrī-kṛṣṇa-rasa-tattvajṣaḥ kṛṣṇa-mantra-vidāṃ varaḥ |
kṛṣṇa-mantrāśrayo nityaṃ mantra-bhaktaḥ sadā śuciḥ ||7||
sad-dharma-śāsako nityaṃ sad-ācāra-niyojakaḥ |
sampradāyī kṛpā-pūrṇo virāgī gurur ucyate ||8||
evam ādi-guṇaḥ prāyaḥ śuśrūṣur guru-pādayoḥ |
gurau nitānta-bhaktaś ca mumukṣuḥ śiṣya ucyate ||9||
yat sākṣāt sevanaṃ tasya premṇā bhāgavato bhavet |
sa mokṣaḥ procyate prājṣair vedavedāṃ gavedibhiḥ ||10||
āśritya sva-guroḥ pādau nija-vṛttaṃ nivedayet |
sa sandehān apākṛtya bodhayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ||11||
sva-pāda-praṇataṃ śāntaṃ śuśrūṣuṃ nija-pādayoḥ |
atihṛṣṭa-manāḥ śiṣyaṃ manum adhyāpayet param ||12||
candanena mṛdāvāpi vilikhed bāhu-mūlayoḥ |
vāma-dakṣiṇayor vipra śaṅkha-cakre yathā kramam ||13||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tataḥ kuryād bhālādiṣu vidhānataḥ |
tato mantra-dvayaṃ tasya dakṣa-karṇe vinirdiśet ||14||
mantrārthaṃ ca vadet tasmai yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
dāsa-śabda-yutaṃ nāma dhāryaṃ tasya prayatnataḥ ||15||
tato 'tibhaktyā sa-snehaṃ vaiṣṇavān bhojayed budhaḥ |
śrī-guruṃ pūjayec cāpi vastrālaṅkaraṇādibhiḥ ||16||
sarvasvaṃ gurave dadyāt tad-ardhaṃ vāmahā-mune |
sva-deham api nikṣipya gurau stheyam akiṣcanaiḥ ||17||
ya etaiḥ paṣcabhir vidvān saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛto bhavet |
dāsya-bhāgī sa kṛṣṇasya nānyathā kalpa-koṭibhiḥ ||18||
aṅkanaṃ cordhva-puṇḍraś ca mantro nāma-vidhāraṇam |
paṣcamo yāga ity uktāḥ saṃskārāḥ pūrva-sūribhiḥ ||19||
aṅkanaṃ śaṅkha-cakrādyaiḥ sa-cchidraṃ puṇḍram ucyate |
dāsa-śabda-yutaṃ nāma mantro yugala-saṃjṣakaḥ ||20||
guru-vaiṣṇavayoḥ pūjā yāga ity abhidhīyate |
ete parama-saṃskārā mayā te parikīrtitāḥ ||21||
atha tubhyaṃ prapannānāṃ dharmān vakṣyāmi nārada |
yān āsthāya gamiṣyanti hari-dhāma-narāḥ kalau ||22||
itthaṃ guror labdha-mantro guru-bhakti-parāyaṇaḥ |
sevamāno guruṃ nityaṃ tat-kṛpāṃ bhāvayet sudhīḥ ||23||
satāṃ dharmāṃs tataḥ śikṣet prapannānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
sveṣṭa-deva-dhiyā nityaṃ vaiṣṇavān paritoṣayet ||24||
tāḍanaṃ bhartsanaṃ kāmi-bhogyatvena yathā striyaḥ |
gṛhṇanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca tat-tad-grāhyaṃ tathā budhaiḥ ||25||
aihikyāmuṣmikī-cintā naiva kāryā kadācana |
aihikaṃ tu sadā bhāvyaṃ pūrvācarita-karmaṇā ||26||
āmuṣmikaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaḥ svayam eva kariṣyati |
ato hi tat-kṛte tyājyaḥ prayatnaḥ sarvathā naraiḥ ||27||
sarvopāya-parityāgaḥ kṛṣṇīyātmatayārcanam |
suciraṃ proṣite kānte yathā pati-parāyaṇā ||28||
priyānurāgiṇī dīnā tasya saṅgaika-kāṅkṣiṇī |
tad-guṇān bhāvayen nityaṃ gāyaty api śṛṇoti ca ||29||
śrī-kṛṣṇa-guṇa-līlādi-smaraṇādi tathā caret |
na punaḥ sādhanatvena kāryaṃ tat tu kadācana ||30||
ciraṃ proṣyāgataṃ kāntaṃ prāpya kānta-dhiyā yathā |
cumbantīvāśliṣyantīva netrāntena pibanty api ||31||
brahmānanda-gate vāśu sevate parayā mudā |
śrīmad-arcāvatāreṇa tathā paricared dharim ||32||
ananya-śaraṇo nityaṃ tathaivānanya-sādhanaḥ |
ananya-sādhanārthatvāt syād ananya-prayojanaḥ ||33||
nānyaṃ ca pūjayed devaṃ na namet taṃ smaren na ca |
na ca paśyen nagāyec ca na ca nindet kadācana ||34||
nānyocchiṣṭaṃ ca bhuṣjīta nānya-śeṣaṃ ca dhārayet |
avaiṣṇavānāṃ sambhāṣā-vandanādi-vivarjayet ||35||
īśa-vaiṣṇavayor nindāṃ śṛṇuyān na kadācana |
karṇau pidhāya gantavyaṃ śaktau daṇḍaṃ samācaret ||36||
āśritya cātakīṃ vṛttiṃ deha-pātāvadhi dvija |
dvayasyārthaṃ bhāvayitvā stheyam ity eva me matiḥ ||37||
saraḥ-samudra-nadyādīn vihāya cātako yathā |
tṛṣito mriyate vāpi yācate vā payodharam ||38||
evam eva prayatnena sādhanāni vicintayet |
sveṣṭa-devaḥ sadā yācyo gatis tvaṃ me bhaver iti ||39||
sveṣṭa-deva tadīyānāṃ guror api viśeṣataḥ |
ānukūlye sadā stheyaṃ prātikūlyaṃ vivarjayet ||40||
sakṛt prapanno vakṣyāmi kalyāṇa-guṇatāntayoḥ |
vicintya viśvased etau mām imāv uddhariṣyataḥ ||41||
saṃsāra-sāgarān nātha mitra-putra-gṛhākulāt |
goptārau me yuvām eva prapanna-bhaya-bhaṣjanau ||42||
yo’haṃ mamāsti yat kiṣcid iha-loke paratra ca |
tat sarvaṃ bhavator adya caraṇeṣu samarcitam ||43||
aham asmy aparādhānām ālayas tyakta-sādhanaḥ |
agatiścatato nāthaubhavaṃ tāvevamegatiḥ ||44||
tavāsmirādhikākāntakarmaṇāmanasāgirā |
kṛṣṇakāṃ tetavaivāsmiyuvāmevagatirmama ||45||
śaraṇaṃ vāṃ prapanno’smi karuṇānikarākarau |
prasādaṃ kurutaṃ dāsyaṃ mayiduṣṭe'parādhini ||46||
ity evaṃ japatānityaṃ sthātavyaṃ padyapaṣcakam |
acirādevataddāsyamicchatāmuni-sattama ||47||
bāhyadharmāmayā hyetesaṃkṣepeṇopavarṇitāḥ |
āntaraḥ paramodharmaḥ prapannānā-mathocyate ||48||
kṛṣṇapriyāsakhībhāvaṃ samāśrityaprayatnataḥ |
tayoḥ sevāṃ prakurvītadivānaktamataṃ dritaḥ ||49||
uktomantrastadaṃ gāni tathā tasyādhikāriṇaḥ |
taddharmāśca tathā tebhyaḥ phalaṃ mantrasyanārada ||50||
anutiṣṭhatvamapyetattayordāsyamavāpsyasi |
svādhikārakṣayeviprasamdehonātrakaś ca na ||51||
sakṛnmātraprapannāyatavāsmīticayācate |
nijadāsyaṃ harirdadyānname'trāstivicāraṇā ||52||
atratevarṇayiṣyāmirahasyaṃ paramādbhutam |
śrutapūrvaṃ mayā kṛṣṇātsākṣādbhagavataḥ param ||53||
eṣatekathitodharma āntaromuni-sattama |
guhyādeṣaguhyatamogopanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||54||
mantraratnamahaṃ pūrvaṃ japankailāsamūrddhani |
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devamavasaṅgahanevane ||55||
tatastubhagavāṃs tuṣṭaḥ prādurāsamamāgrataḥ |
vriyatāṃ varaity ukte mayā pyudghāṭyalocane ||56||
dṛṣṭo devaḥ priyāsārddhaṃ saṃsthitogaruḍopari |
praṇipatyāvocamahaṃ varadaṃ kamalāpatim ||57||
yadrūpaṃ tekṛpāsiṃ dhoparamānandadāyakam |
sarvānandāśrayaṃ nityaṃ mūrtimatsarvato'dhikam ||58||
nirguṇaṃ niiṣkrayaṃ śāntaṃ yadbrahmetividurbudhāḥ |
tadahaṃ draṣṭumicchāmicakṣurbhyāṃ parameśvara ||59||
tato māmāhabhagavān prapannaṃ kamalāpatiḥ |
tadadyadrakṣyaserūpaṃ yattemanasikāṅkṣitam ||60||
yamunā paścime tīre gaccha vṛndāvanaṃ mama |
ity uktvāntardadhe devaḥ priyā-sārdhaṃ jagat-patiḥ ||61||
aham apy āgatas tarhi yamunāyās taṭaṃ śubham |
tatra kṛṣṇam apaśyaṃ ca sarva-deveśvareśvaram ||62||
gopa-veṣa-dharaṃ kāntaṃ kiśora-vayasānvitam |
priyāskandhe suvinyasta-vāma-hastaṃ manoharam ||63||
hasantaṃ hāsayatantāṃ madhye gopī-kadambake |
snigdha-megha-samābhāsaṃ kalyāṇa-guṇa-mandiram ||64||
prahasya ca tataḥ kṛṣṇo mām āhāmṛta-bhāṣaṇaḥ |
ahaṃ te darśanaṃ yāto jṣātvā rudra tavepsitam ||65||
yad adya me tvayā dṛṣṭam idaṃ rūpam alaukikam |
ghanībhūtāmala-prema-saccidānanda-vigraham ||66||
nīrūpaṃ nirguṇaṃ vyāpi kriyā-hīnaṃ parāt-param |
vadanty upaniṣat-saṅghā idam eva mamānagham ||67||
prakṛty-uttha-guṇābhāvād anantatvāt tatheśvaram |
asiddhatvān mad-guṇānāṃ nirguṇaṃ māṃ vadanti hi ||68||
adṛśyatvān mamaitasya rūpasya carma-cakṣuṣā |
arūpaṃ māṃ vadanty ete vedāḥ sarve maheśvara ||69||
vyāpakatvāc cid-aṃśena brahmeti ca vidur budhāḥ |
akartṛtvāt prapaṣcasya niṣkrayaṃ māṃ vadanti hi ||70||
māyā-guṇair yato me’ṃśāḥ kurvanti sarjanādikam |
na karomi svayaṃ kiṣcit sṛṣṭy-ādikam ahaṃ śiva ||71||
aham āsāṃ mahā-deva gopīnāṃ prema-vihvalaḥ |
kriyāntaraṃ na jānāmi nātmānam api nārada ||72||
viharāmy anayā nityam asyāḥ prema-vaśīkṛtaḥ |
imāṃ tu mat-priyāṃ viddhi rādhikāṃ para-devatām ||73||
asyāś ca paritaḥ paśya sakhyaḥ śata-sahasraśaḥ |
nityāḥ sarvā imā rudra yathāhaṃ nitya-vigrahaḥ ||74||
gopā gāvo gopikāś ca sadā vṛndāvanaṃ mama |
sarvam etan nityam eva cidānanda-rasātmakam ||75||
idam ānanda-kandākhyaṃ viddhi vṛndāvanaṃ mama |
yasmin praveśa-mātreṇa na punaḥ saṃsṛtiṃ viśet ||76||
mad-vanaṃ prāpya yo mūḍhaḥ punar anyatra gacchati |
sa ātmahā-bhaved eva satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam ||77||
vṛndāvanaṃ parityajya naiva gacchāmy ahaṃ kvacit |
nivasāmy anayā sārdham aham atraiva sarvadā ||78||
ity evaṃ sarvam ākhyātaṃ yat te rudra hṛdi sthitam |
kathayasva mamedānīṃ kim anyac chrotum icchasi ||79||
tatas tam abravaṃ devam ahaṃ ca muni-sattama |
īdṛśas tvaṃ kathaṃ labhyas tam upāyaṃ vadasva me ||80||
tato mām āha bhagavān sādhu rudra tavoditam |
atiguhyatamaṃ hy etad gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||81||
sakṛd āvāṃ prapanno yas tyaktopāya upāsate |
gopī-bhāvena deveśa sa mām eti na cetaraḥ ||82||
sakṛd āvāṃ prapanno vā mat-priyāmekikām uta |
sevate’nanya-bhāvena sa mām eti na saṃśayaḥ ||83||
yo mām eva prapannaś ca mat-priyāṃ na maheśvara |
na kadāpi sa cāpnoti mām evaṃ te mayoditam ||84||
sakṛd eva prapanno yas tavāsmīti vaded api |
sādhanena vināpy eva mām āpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ||85||
tasmāt sarva-prayatnena mat-priyāṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet |
āśritya mat-priyāṃ rudra māṃ vaśīkartum arhasi ||86||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mayā te parikīrtitam |
tvayāpy etan mahā-deva gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||87||
tvam apy enāṃ samāśritya rādhikāṃ mama vallabhām |
japan me yugalaṃ mantraṃ sadā tiṣṭha madālaye ||88||
śiva uvāca—
ity uktvā dakṣiṇe karṇe mama kṛṣṇo dayā-nidhiḥ |
upadiśya paraṃ mantraṃ saṃskārāṃś ca vidhāya hi ||89||
sa-gaṇo’ntardadhe vipra tatraiva mama paśyataḥ |
aham apy atra tiṣṭhāmi tad ārabhya nirantaram ||90||
sarvam etan mayā tubhyaṃ sāṅgam eva prakīrtitam |
adhunā vada viprendra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi ||91||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vṛndāvana-māhātmye
dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||82||

(83)
tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
bhagavansarvamākhyātaṃ yadyatpṛṣṭaṃ mayā guro |
adhunāśrotum icchāmi bhāvamārgamanuttamam ||1||
śiva uvāca—
sādhu vipra tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ sarva-loka-hitaiṣiṇā |
rahasyam api vakṣyāmi tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||2||
dāsyaḥ sakhāyaḥ pitarau preyasyaś ca harer iha |
sarve nityā muni-śreṣṭha vasanti guṇa-śālinaḥ ||3||
yathā prakaṭa-līlāyāṃ purāṇeṣu prakīrtitāḥ |
tathā te nitya-līlāyāṃ santi vṛndāvane bhuvi ||4||
gamanāgamane nityaṃ karoti vana-goṣṭhayoḥ |
gocāraṇaṃ vayasyaiś ca vinā'sura-vighātanam ||5||
karakīyābhimāninyas tathā tasya priyā-janāḥ |
pracchannenaiva bhāvena ramayanti nija-priyam ||6||
ātmānaṃ cintayet tatra tāsāṃ madhye manoramām |
rūpa-yauvana-sampannāṃ kiśorīṃ pramadākṛtim ||7||
nānā-śilpa-kalābhijṣāṃ kṛṣṇa-bhogānurūpiṇīm |
prārthitām api kṛṣṇena tatra bhoga-parāṅ-mukhīm ||8||
rādhikānucarīṃ tatra tat-sevana-parāyaṇām |
kṛṣṇād apy adhikaṃ prema rādhikāyāṃ prakurvatīm ||9||
prītyānudivasaṃyatnāt tayoḥ saṅgama-kāriṇīm |
tat-sevana-sukhāhlāda-bhāvenātisunirvṛtām ||10||
ity ātmānaṃ vicintyaiva tatra sevāṃ samācaret |
brāhmaṃ muhūrttam ārabhya yāvat syāt tu mahā-niśā ||11||
nārada uvāca—
harer dainandinīṃ līlāṃ śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ |
līlām ajānatā sevyo manasā tu kathaṃ hariḥ ||12||
śiva uvāca—
nāhaṃ jānāmi tāṃ līlāṃ harer nārada tattvataḥ |
vṛndādevīm ito gaccha sā te līlāṃ pravakṣyati ||13||
avidūraitaḥ sthānāt keśī-tīrtha-samīpataḥ |
sakhī-saṅgha-vṛtā sāste govinda-paricārikā ||14||
sūta uvāca—
ity uktastaṃ parikramya hṛṣṭo na tvā punaḥ punaḥ |
vṛndāśramaṃ jagāmātha nārado muni-sattamaḥ ||15||
vṛndāpināradaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyacapunaḥ punaḥ |
 uvāca— camuniśreṣṭhakathamatrāgatistava ||16||
nārada uvāca—
tvatto veditumicchāminaityakaṃ caritaṃ hareḥ |
tadāditomama brūhi yadiyogyo’smi śobhane ||17||
vṛndovāca-
rahasyamapivakṣyāmikṛṣṇabhaktosinārada |
naprakāśyaṃ tvayāpyetadguhyādguhyataraṃ mahat ||18||
-madhye vṛndāvaneramyepaṣcāśatkuṃ jamaṇḍite |
kalpavṛkṣanikuṣjetudivyaratnamayegṛhe ||19||
nidritautiṣṭhatastalpenibiḍāliṅgitaumithaḥ |
madājṣākāribhiḥ paścātpakṣibhir bodhitāvapi ||20||
gāḍhāliṅganajānandamāptautadbhaṅgakātarau |
namanaḥ kurutastalpātsamutthātuṃ manāgapi ||21||
tataś ca sārikāsaṅghaiḥ śukādyaiḥ paritomuhuḥ |
bodhitauvividhair vākyaiḥ svatalpādudatiṣṭhatām ||22||
upaviṣṭautato dṛṣṭvā sakhyastalpemudānvitau |
praviśyasevāṃ kurvanti tatkālehyucitāntayoḥ ||23||
punaś ca sārikāvākyaistāvutthāyasvatalpataḥ |
gacchataḥ svasvabhavanaṃ bhītyutkaṇṭhākulautataḥ ||24||
prātaś ca bodhitomātrātalpādutthāyasatvaraḥ |
kṛtvākṛṣṇodaṃ takāṣṭhaṃ baladevasamanvitaḥ ||25||
mātrānumoditoyātigośālāṃ sakhibhir vṛtaḥ |
rādhāpibodhitāvipravayasyābhiḥ svatalpataḥ ||26||
utthāyadaṃ takāṣṭhādikṛtvābhyaṃ gaṃ samācaret |
snānavedīṃ tato gatvā snāpitāsānijālibhiḥ ||27||
bhūṣāgṛhevrajet tatra vayasyābhūṣayanty api |
bhūṣaṇair vividhair divyair gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ||28||
tataḥ sakhījanaistasyāḥ śvaśrūṃ samprārthyayatnataḥ |
kartuṃ āhūyatesvannaṃ sasakhīsāyaśodayā ||29||
nārada uvāca—
kathamāhūyatedevipākārthaṃ tuyaśodayā |
satīṣupākakartrīṣurohiṇīpramukhāsvapi ||30||
vṛṃ dovāca-
pūrvaṃ durvāsasādattovaras tasyai mahā-mune |
itikātyāyanīvaktrācchrutamāsīnmayā purā ||31||
tvayāyatpacyatedevitadannaṃ madanugrahāt |
miṣṭaṃ syādamṛtasparddhibhokturāyuṣkaraṃ tathā ||32||
ityāhvayatitāṃ nityaṃ yaśodāputravatsalā |
āyuṣmānmebhavetputraḥ svādulobhāt tathā satī ||33||
śrutvā numoditāhṛṣṭāsāpinandālayaṃ vrajet |
sasakhīprakarā tatra gatvā pākaṃ karotica ||34||
kṛṣṇo’pi dugdhvāgāḥ kāściddohayitvā janaiḥ parāḥ |
āgacchatipiturvākyātsvagṛhaṃ sakhibhir vṛtaḥ ||35||
abhyaṃ gamardanaṃ kṛtvādāsaiḥ saṃsnāpitomudā |
dhautavastradharaḥ sragvīcandanāktakalevaraḥ ||36||
dviphālabaddhacikurair grīvābhāloparisphuran |
candrākārasphuradbhālatilakālakaraṃ jitaḥ ||37||
kaṃ kaṇāṃ gadakeyūraratnamudrālasatkaraḥ |
muktāhārasphuradvakṣāmakarākṛti-kuṇḍalaḥ ||38||
muhurākāritomātrāpraviśedbhojanālayam |
avalaṃ byakaraṃ sakhyurbaladevamanuvrataḥ ||39||
bhuṃ kte'thavividhānnānibhrātrācasakhibhir vṛtaḥ |
hāsayanvividhair hāsyaiḥ sakhīṃ stair hasatisvayam ||40||
itthaṃ bhuktvā tathā camyadivyakhaṭvoparikṣaṇam |
viśramyasevakair dattaṃ tāṃ būlaṃ vibhajannadan ||41||
gopaveṣadharaḥ kṛṣṇodhenuvṛndapurassaraḥ |
vrajavāsijanaiḥ prītyāsarvair anugataḥ pathi ||42||
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ natvānetrāṃ tenāpitaṃ gaṇam |
 yathā yogyaṃ tathā cānyānvinivartyavanaṃ vrajet ||43||
vanaṃ praviśyasakhibhiḥ krīḍayitvā kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
vihārair vividhais tatra vanevikrīḍatemudā ||44||
vaṃ cayitvā tataḥ sarvāndvitraiḥ priyasakhair vṛtaḥ |
saṃketakaṃ vrajeddharṣātpriyāsamdarśanotsukaḥ ||45||
sāpikṛṣṇaṃ vanaṃ yātaṃ dṛṣṭvā svaṃ gṛhamāgatā |
sūryādipūjāvyājenakusumāhṛtaye tathā ||46||
vaṃ cayitvā gurūnyātipriyasaṅgecchayāvanam |
itthaṃ taubahuyatnena militvākānanetataḥ ||47||
vihārair vividhais tatra dinaṃ vikrīḍatomudā |
dolāyāṃ casamārūḍhausakhibhir dolitaukvacit ||48||
kvāpiveṇuṃ karasrastaṃ priyayāpahnutaṃ hariḥ |
anveṣayannupālabdhovipralabdhapriyāgaṇaiḥ ||49||
hasitair bahudhātābhir hāsitas tatra tiṣṭhati |
vasaṃtavāyunājuṣṭaṃ vanakhaṇḍaṃ mudākvacit ||50||
praviśyacandanāṃ bhobhiḥ kuṅkumādijalair api |
niṣiṃ catoyaṃ tramuktaistatpaṃ kair liṃ patomithaḥ ||51||
sakhyo’py evaṃ niṣiṃ canti tāścatausiṣcataḥ punaḥ |
vasaṃtavāyujuṣṭeṣu vanakhaḍeṣu sarvataḥ ||52||
tat-tat-kālocitair nānā-vihāraiḥ sagaṇaudvija |

upaviśyāsanedivyemadhupānaṃ pracakratuḥ |

riraṃ sūviśataḥ kuṣjaṃ skhaladvāṅmanasaupathi ||55||
krīḍataś ca tatas tatra kariṇīyūthapau yathā |
sakhyo’pi madhubhir mattānidrayāpīḍitekṣaṇāḥ ||56||
abhitomaṣju-kuṣjeṣu sarvāevāpiśiiśyare |
pṛthagekenavapuṣākṛṣṇo’pi yugapadvibhuḥ ||57||
sarvāsāṃ saṃnidhiṃ gacchetpriyayāpreritomuhuḥ |
ramayitvā catāḥ sarvāḥ kariṇīrgajarāḍiva ||58||
priyayāca tathā tābhiḥ krīḍārthaṃ casarovrajet |
jalasekair mithas tatra krīḍataḥ sagaṇautataḥ ||59||
vāsaḥ srakcandanair divyair bhūṣaṇair apibhūṣitau |
 tatra iva sarasastīredivyaratnamayegṛhe ||60||
prāgevaphalamūlānikalpitānimayā mune |
haristuprathamaṃ bhuktvākāntayāpariveṣṭitaḥ ||61||
dvitrābhiḥ sevitogacchecchayyāṃ puṣpavinirmitām |
tāṃ būlair vyajanais tatra pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ||62||
sevyamānohasaṃstābhir modatepreyasīṃ smaran |
rādhikāpiharausuptesagaṇāmuditāntarā ||63||
api tatra gataprāṇātaducchiṣṭaṃ bhunaktica |
kiṣcidevatato bhuktvāvrajecchayyāniketanam ||64||
draṣṭuṃ kāntamukhāṃ bhojaṃ cakorīvaniśākaram |
tāṃ būlacarvitaṃ tasya tatra tyābhir niveditam ||65||
tāṃ būlānyapicāśnātivibhajaṃ tīpriyāliṣu |
kṛṣṇo’pi tāsāṃ śuśrūṣuḥ svacchaṃ daṃ bhāṣitaṃ mithaḥ ||66||
prāptanidraivābhātivinidro’pi paṭāvṛtaḥ |
tāścakṣvelīkṣaṇaṃ kṛtvākutaścidanumānataḥ ||67||
vidaśyarasanāṃ dadbhiḥ paśyanty o'nyonyamānanam |
vilīnāivalajjābdhaukṣaṇamūcurn akiṣcana ||68||
kṣaṇādevatato vastraṃ dūrīkṛtyatadaṃ gataḥ |
sādhunidrāṃ gato'sītihāsayanty ohasanti ca ||69||
evaṃ tair vividhair hāsyair amamāṇaugaṇaiḥ sa ha |
anubhūyakṣaṇaṃ nidrāsukhaṃ camuni-sattama ||70||
upaviśyāsanedivyesagaṇauvistṛtemudā |
paṇīkṛtyamithohāracumbāśleṣaparicchadān ||71||
akṣair vikrīḍataḥ premṇānarmālāpapurassaram |
parājito’pi priyayājitohamitivaibruvan ||72||
hārādigrahaṇetasyāḥ pravṛttastāḍyatetayā |
tayaivaṃ tāḍitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kareṇāsyasaroruhe ||73||
viṣaṇṇamānasobhūtvāgaṃ tuṃ prakurutematim |
jito’smi cettvayādevigṛhyatāṃ yatpaṇīkṛtam ||74||
cumbanādimayā dattamity uktvā sā tathā caret |
kauṭilyaṃ tadbhruvordraṣṭuṃ śrotuṃ tadbhartsanaṃ vacaḥ ||75||
tataḥ sārīśukānāṃ caśrutvā vāgāhavaṃ mithaḥ |
nirgacchatastataḥ sthānādgaṃ tukāmaugṛhaṃ prati ||76||
kṛṣṇaḥ kāṃ tāmanujṣāpyagavāmabhimukhaṃ vrajet |
sātusūryagṛhaṃ gacchetsakhīmaṇḍala-saṃyutā ||77||
kiyaddūraṃ tato gatvā parāvṛtyahariṃ punaḥ |
vipraveṣaṃ samāsthāyayātisūryagṛhaṃ prati ||78||
sūryaṃ prapūjayet tatra prārthitastatsakhījanaiḥ |
tadaivakalpitair vedaiḥ parihāsavigarbhitaiḥ ||79||
tatastājṣāpitaṃ kāntaṃ parijṣāyavicakṣaṇāḥ |
ānandasāgaremagrānaviduḥ svaṃ nacāparam ||80||
vihārair vividhair evaṃ sārddhayāmadvayaṃ mune |
nītvāgṛhaṃ vrajeyustāḥ sacakṛṣṇogavāṃ vrajet ||81||
saṅgamyasvasakhīnkṛṣṇogṛhītvāgāḥ samaṃ tataḥ |
āgacchativrajaṃ harṣānnādayanmuralīṃ mune ||82||
tato nandādayaḥ sarve śrutvā veṇuravaṃ hareḥ |
godhūlipaṭalavyāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpinabhastalam ||83||
visṛjyasarvakarmāṇistriyobālādayo 'pica |
kṛṣṇasyābhimukhaṃ yāṃ titaddarśanasamutsukāḥ ||84||
rājamārgevrajadvāri yatra sarve vrajaukasaḥ |
kṛṣṇo’pi tānsamāgamya yathā vadanupūrvaśaḥ ||85||
darśanasparśanair vācāsmitapūrvāvalokanaiḥ |
gopavṛddhānnamaskāraiḥ kāyikair vācikair api ||86||
aṣṭāṃ gapātaiḥ pitaraurohiṇīmapinārada |
netrāntasūcitenaivavinayenapriyāṃ tathā ||87||
evaṃ taistad yathā yogyaṃ vrajaukobhiḥ prapūjitaḥ |
gavālaye tathā gāścasampraveśyasamaṃ tataḥ ||88||
pitṛbhyāṃ arthitoyātibhrātrāsahanijālayam |
 snātvā pītvā tatra kiṣcidbhuktvāmātrānumoditaḥ ||89||
gavālayaṃ punar yāti dogdhu-kāmo gavāṃ payaḥ |
tāś ca dugdhvā dohayitvā pāyayitvā ca kāścana ||90||
pitrāsārddhaṃ gṛhaṃ yāti tatra bhāvaśatānugaḥ |
 tatra pitrāpitṛvyaiścatatputraiścabalena ca ||91||
bhunaktivividhānnāni carvyacoṣyādikāni ca |
tanmatiḥ prārthanātpūrvaṃ rādhikācatadaiva ha ||92||
prasthāpayetsakhīdvārāpakvānnānitadālayam |
ślāghayaṃś caharistānibhuktvāpitrādibhiḥ sa ha ||93||
sabhāgṛhaṃ vrajettaiścajuṣṭaṃ baṃ dijanādibhiḥ |
pakvānnānigṛhītvāyāḥ sakhyas tatra purāgatāḥ ||94||
bahūnicapunastānipradattāniyaśodayā |
sakhyas tatra tayādattaṃ kṛṣṇocchiṣṭaṃ nayanti ca ||95||
sarvaṃ tābhiḥ samānīyarādhikāyainivedyate |
sāpibhuktvāsakhīvargayutātadanupūrvaśaḥ ||96||
sakhībhir maṇḍitātiṣṭhedabhisarttuṃ samudyatā |
prasthāpyate mayā kācidita evatataḥ sakhī ||97||
tayābhisāritā sātha yamunāyāḥ samīpataḥ |
kalpa-vṛkṣa-nikuṣje'smin divya-ratna-maye gṛhe ||98||
sita-kṛṣṇa-niśā-yogya-veṣāyāti-sakhī-vṛtā |
kṛṣṇo’pi vividhaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā kautūhalaṃ tataḥ ||99||
kātyāyanyā manojṣāni śrutvā saṅgītakāny api |
dhanadhānyādibhistāścaprīṇayitvā vidhānataḥ ||100||
janair ārādhitomātrāyātisakhyāniketanam |
mātariprasthitāyāṃ cabhojayitvā tato gṛham ||101||
saṃketakaṃ kāntayātrasamāgacchedalakṣitaḥ |
militvā tāv ubhāv atra krīḍato vana-rājiṣu ||102||
vihārair vividhai rāsa-lāsya-hāsa-purassaraiḥ |
sārddhayāmadvayaṃ nītvārātrerevaṃ vihārataḥ ||103||
suṣupsūviśataḥ kuṃ jaṃ pakṣiṇībhir alakṣitau |
ekāntekusumaiḥ kḷptekelitalpemanohare ||104||
suptāvātiṣṭhatas tatra sevyamānaunijālibhiḥ |
iti te sarvam ākhyātaṃ naityikaṃ caritaṃ hareḥ ||105||
pāpino’pi vimucyante śravaṇād asya nārada |
nārada uvāca—
dhanyo'smy anugṛhīto’smi tvayā devi na saṃśayaḥ ||106||
harer dainandinī līlā yato me'dya prakāśitā |
sūta uvāca—
ity uktvā tāṃ parikramyatayācāpiprapūjitaḥ ||107||
antar- dhānaṃ gatobrahmannāradomuni-sattamaḥ |
mayā pyetaccānupūrvyātsarvamevaprakīrtitam ||108||
japennityaṃ prayatnena mantrayugmama nuttamam |
kṛṣṇavaktrādidaṃ labdhaṃ purārudreṇayatnataḥ ||109||
tenoktaṃ nāradāyāpināradenamamoditam |
saṃskārāṃś cavidhāyaivamayā pyetattavoditam ||110||
tvayāpyetadgopanīyaṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam |
śaunaka uvāca—
kṛtakṛtyo bhavaṃ sākṣāttvatprasādādahaṃ guro ||111||
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ yattvayāmahyaṃ prakāśitam |
sūta uvāca—
dharmānetānupātiṣṭhaṣjalpanmantramaharniśam ||112||
acirādevataddāsyamavāpsyasina saṃśayaḥ |
mayāpi gamyate brahman nityam āyatanaṃ vibhoḥ ||113||
guror guror bhānujāyāḥ kūle gopīśvarasya ca ||114||
idaṃ caritraṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ 
proktaṃ maheśena mahānubhāvam |
śṛṇvanti ye bhakti-yutā manuṣyās 
te yānti nityaṃ padam acyutasya ||115||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam ārogyābhīṣṭa-siddhidam |
svargāpavarga-sampatti-kāraṇaṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||116||
bhaktyā paṭhanti ye nityaṃ mānavā viṣṇu-tat-parāḥ |
na teṣāṃ punar āvṛttir viṣṇu-lokāt kathaṃcana ||117||

|| samāptaṃ vṛndānamāhātmyaṃ || 


vaiśākha-māsa-māhātmyam

(84)
caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ -
sūtasūtamahā-bhāgaromaharṣaṇanandana |
kathāramyātvayāproktālokasyānandadāyinī ||1||
śrī-kṛṣṇasyamahā-bhāgacaritaṃ mahadadbhutam |
śrutaṃ sarvaṃ tvayāproktaṃ nirvṛtistenacābhavat ||2||
aho śrī-kṛṣṇa-māhātmyaṃ bhaktānāṃ gati-dāyakam |
yatas tena mahā-bhāga nirvṛtiṃ ko na cāpnuyāt ||3||
ataḥ punar apiśrī-matkṛṣṇasyacaritaṃ mahat |
śrotum icchāmahecānyadvratadānārhaṇādikam ||4||
snānaṃ vāpimahā-bhāga yathā yenakṛtaṃ purā |
tatsarvaṃ vistarādbrūhi yathā nonirvṛtirbhavet ||5||
sūta uvāca—
sādhupṛṣṭaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhālokānāṃ tāraṇaṃ param |
yūyaṃ kṛtārthāḥ kṛṣṇasyabhaktyāsampūrṇamānasāḥ ||6||
śrī-kṛṣṇacaritaṃ puṇyaṃ sādhūnāṃ harṣadaṃ param |
pravakṣyāmidvijaśreṣṭhāmahadākhyānam uttamam ||7||
ekadānāradolokānparyaṭanbhagavatpriyaḥ |
mathurāyām ambarīṣaṃ kṛṣṇārādhana-tat-param ||8||
mahā-bhāgaṃ vrata-paraṃ dadarśa muni-sattamaḥ |
sa āgataṃ muni-varaṃ sātkṛtya muni-sattamaḥ ||9||
bhavantaiva papraccha śraddhayā hṛṣṭa-mānasaḥ |
ambarīṣa uvāca—
yanmuneparamaṃ brahmavedavādibhir ucyate ||10||
sadevaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ |
yo'mūrtomūrtimānīśovyakto'vyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ ||11||
sarvabhūtamayo'cintyodhyātavyaḥ sa kathaṃ hariḥ |
 yasmin sarvamidaṃ viśvamotaṃ protaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||12||
avyaktamekaṃ paramaṃ paramātmetiviśrutam |
yatojanmādijagatoyonirmāyasvayaṃ bhuvam ||13||
dadautasmaicanigamānātmanyevavyavasthitān |
kathamārādhyateso'yaṃ samagrapuruṣārthadaḥ ||14||
yogināmapidurgamyastadetatkṛpayā vada |
anārādhitagovindānavidanti hitodayam ||15||
natapoyajṣadānānā-ṃ labhatephalam uttamam |
anāsvādita-govinda-padāmbuja-rasaś ca yaḥ ||16||
manoratha-pathātītaṃ sphītaṃ nākalayet phalam |
harer ārādhanaṃ hitvā duritaugha-nivāraṇam ||17||
nānyat paśyāmi jantūnāṃ prāyaścittaṃ paraṃ mune |
yad bhrū-nartana-vartinyaḥ śrūyante siddhayo'khilāḥ ||18||
katham ārādhyate so'yaṃ keśavaḥ kleśa-nāśanaḥ |
upāsyate sa bhagavān kathaṃ nārāyaṇo naraiḥ ||19||
prītaś ca sarvam etan me hitāya jagato vada |
bhakti-priyo'sau bhagavān kayā bhaktyā prasīdati ||20||
kathaṃ tasmin bhaved bhaktiḥ sarvair ārādhyate katham |
vaiṣṇavo’si hares tasya priyo'si paramārtha-vit ||21||
tena tvām eva pṛcchāmi brahman brahmavid uttama |
śrotāram atha vaktāraṃ praṣṭāraṃ puruṣaṃ hareḥ ||22||
praśnaḥ punāti kṛṣṇasya tad-aṅghri-salilaṃ yathā |
durlabho mānuṣo deho dehināṃ kṣaṇa-bhaṅguraḥ ||23||
tatrāpi durlabhaṃ manye vaikuṇṭha-priya-darśanam |
saṃsāre’smin kṣaṇārdho’pi sat-saṅgaḥ śevadhir nṛṇām ||24||
yasmād avāpyate sarvaṃ puruṣārtha-catuṣṭayam |
bhagavan bhavato yātrā svastaye sarva-dehinām ||25||
bālānāṃ tu yathā pitror uttama-śloka-vartmanām |
bhūtānāṃ deva caritaṃ duḥkhāya ca sukhāya ca ||26||
sukhāyaiva hi sādhūnāṃ tvādṛśām acyutātmanām |
bhajanti ye yathā devāndevā api tathaiva tān ||27||
chāyevakarmasacivāḥ sādhavodīnavatsalāḥ |
tasmāt tvaṃ bhagavanmahyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmamādiśa ||28||
yasyopadeśadānenalabhatevedajaṃ phalam |
nārada uvāca—
sādhupṛṣṭaṃ mahīpālaviṣṇubhaktimatātvayā ||29||
jānatāparamaṃ dharmamekaṃ mādhavasevanam |
 yasmin nārādhiteviṣṇauviśvamārādhitaṃ bhavet ||30||
tuṣṭe carācaraṃ tuṣṭaṃ sarva-deva-maye harau |
yasya smaraṇa-mātreṇa mahā-pātaka-saṃhatiḥ ||31||
tatkṣaṇānnāśamāyātisasevyoharirevahi |
ko'nurājanniṃ driyavānmukundacaraṇāṃ bujam ||32||
nabhajetsarvatomṛtyurupāsyamṛṣidaivataiḥ |
śruto'nupaṭhitodhyāta ādṛtaścānumoditaḥ ||33||
sadyaḥ punātisaddharmovīroviśvadruho’pi hi |
yoyaṃ kāraṇakāryādikāraṇasyāpikāraṇam ||34||
ananyakāraṇaṃ yogījagajjīvojaganmayaḥ |
aṇurbṛhatkṛśaḥ sthūlonirguṇoguṇabhṛnmahān ||35||
ajojanmalayātītodhyātavyaḥ sahariḥ sadā |
samyagetadvyavasitaṃ bhavatāpuruṣarṣabha ||36||
yatpṛcchasebhāgavatāndharmāṃ stvaṃ viśvabhāvanān |
prasaṅgena satām ātma-manaḥ śruti-rasāyanāḥ ||37||
bhavanti kīrtanīyasya kathāḥ kṛṣṇasya nirmalāḥ |
bhāvasādhyohyayaṃ devaḥ svayaṃ jānātitadbhavān ||38||

ambarīṣa uvāca—
sādhu sādhu muni-śreṣṭha lokānugraha-kāraka |
viṣṇor dhyānaṃ tvayā proktaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca yat ||1||
adhunā lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhakteḥ sādhu-kṛpākara |
yādṛśī kriyate yena yathā yatra yadā tathā ||2||
sūta uvāca—
ity uktam ākarṇya nṛpottamasya 
muniḥ prahṛṣṭo nijagāda bhūpam |
śṛṇuṣva rājan nikhilāgha-hāriṇīṃ 
bhaktiṃ hares te pravadāmi samyak ||3||
atha bhaktiṃ pravakṣyāmi vividhāṃ pāpa-nāśinīm |
vividhā bhaktir uddiṣṭā mano-vāk-kāya-sambhavā ||4||
laukikī vaidikī cāpi bhaved ādhyātmikī tathā |
dhyāna-dhāraṇayā buddhyā vedānāṃ smaraṇaṃ hi yat ||5||
viṣṇuprītikarīcaiṣāmānasībhaktirucyate |
mantra-veda-samuccārair aviśrānta-vicintanaiḥ ||6||

vratopavāsa-niyamaiḥ paṣcendriyaja##naca ||7||
kāyikī saiva nirdiṣṭā bhaktiḥ sarvārtha-sādhinī |
bhūṣaṇair hema-ratnāṅkaiś citrābhir vāgbhir eva ca ||8||
vāsaḥ pratisaraiḥ sūtraiḥ pāvaka-vyajanocchritaiḥ |
nṛtya-vāditra-gītaiś ca sarva-baly-upahārakaiḥ ||9||
bhakṣya-bhojyānnapānaiś ca yā pūjā kriyate naraiḥ |
nārāyaṇaṃ samuddiśya bhaktiḥ sā laukikī matā ||10||
kāyikī saiva nirdiṣṭā bhaktiḥ sarvārtha-sādhikī |
ṛg-yajuḥ sāmajāpyānisaṃ hitādhyayanāni ca ||11||

darśecapaurṇamāsyāṃ cakartavyaṃ cāgnihotrakam |

iṣṭirdhṛtiḥ somapānaṃ yājṣiyaṃ karma sarva-śaḥ |
agnibhūmyanilākāśadyutiśaṃ karabhāskaram ||14||
tamuddiśyakṛtaṃ karmatat sarvaṃ viṣṇudaivatam |
ādhyātmikītivividhābrahmabhaktisthitānṛpa ||15||
sāṃ khyākhyāṃ yogasaṃ jātāṃ śṛṇubhūpayathoditām |
caturviṃ śatitattvānipradhānādīnisaṅkhyayā ||16||
acetanānibhogyānipuruṣaḥ paṣcaviṃ śakaḥ |
cetanaḥ sasamuddiṣṭokartābhoktācakarmaṇām ||17||
ātmānityovyayaś ca ivaadhiṣṭhātāprayojakaḥ |
puruṣo'vyaktanityaḥ syātkāraṇaṃ camaheśvaraḥ ||18||
tattvasargobhāvasargobhūtasargaś ca tattvataḥ |
saṅkhyāyāḥ parisaṅkhyāyāḥ pradhānaṃ caguṇātmakam ||19||
jṣātvāsādharmyavaidharmyaṃ pradhānaṃ cavidharmica |

 sarva-trakartṛtābrahmapuruṣasyāpyakartṛtā ||21||

svargārohaṇaniḥśreṇīsatatānandakāriṇī |
anekaduritodgārahāriṇīdurgatāriṇī ||54||
śrīmaheśajaṭājūṭavāsinīduḥkhanāśinī |
bhajamānajanasvāntakāntakelivināśinī ||55||
sagarānvayanirvāṇakāriṇīdharmadhāriṇī |
trimārgacāriṇīdevīlokālaṃ kṛtikāriṇī ||56||
darśanasparśanasnānakīrttanadhyānasevanaiḥ |
puṇyānapuṇyānpuruṣānpāvayaṃ tīsahasraśaḥ ||57||
gaṅgāgaṅgetigaṅgetiyaistrisandhyamitīritam |
sudūrasthaiścatatpāpaṃ hanti janmatrayārjitam ||58||
yojanānāṃ sahasreṣu gaṅgāṃ yaḥ smaratenaraḥ |
apiduṣkṛtakarmāsaulabhateparamāṃ gatim ||59||
vaiśākheśuklasaptamyāṃ durlabhāsāviśeṣataḥ |
prāpyate jagatī-pāla hari-vipra-prasādataḥ ||60||
na mādhava-samo māso na mādhava-samo vibhuḥ |
gato hi duritāmbhodhau majjamāna-janasya yaḥ ||61||
dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ yad bhaktyā māsi mādhave |
tad akṣayaṃ bhaved bhūpa puṇyaṃ koṭi-śatādhikam ||62||
yathā deveṣu viśvātmā devo nārāyaṇo hariḥ |
yathā japyeṣu gāyatrī-saritāṃ jāhnavī tathā ||63||
yathomā sarva-nārīṇāṃ tapatāṃ bhāskaro yathā |
ārogya-lābho lābhānāṃ dvipadāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā ||64||
paropakāraḥ puṇyānāṃ vidyānāṃ nigamo yathā |
mantrāṇāṃ praṇavo yadvad dhyānānām ātma-cintanam ||65||
satyaṃ sva-dharma-vartitvaṃ tapasāṃ ca yathā varam |
śaucānām artha-śaucaṃ ca dānānām abhayaṃ yathā ||66||
guṇānāṃ ca yathā lobha-kṣayo mukhyo guṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
māsānāṃ pravaro māsas tathāsau mādhavo mataḥ ||67||
tatra yat kriyate śrāddhaṃ yajṣa-dānam upoṣaṇam |
tapo'dhyayana-pūjādi tad akṣaya-phalaṃ smṛtam ||68||
vaiśākhāntāni pāpāni sūryāntāni tamāṃsi ca |
parāpakāra-paiśunya-prāntāni sukṛtāni ca ||69||
kārttike māsi yat kiṃcit tulā-saṃsthe divākare |
snāna-dānādikaṃ rājaṃs tat-parārdha-guṇaṃ bhavet ||70||
tasmāt sahasra-guṇitaṃ māghe makara-ge ravau |
tato’pi  śata-saṅkhyātaṃ vaiśākhe meṣa-ge ravau ||71||
te dhanyās te sukṛtino narā vaiśākha-māsi ye |
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena pūjayanti madhu-dviṣam ||72||
prātaḥ snānaṃ ca vaiśākhe yajṣa-dānam upoṣaṇam |
haviṣyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca mahā-pātaka-nāśanam ||73||
punaḥ kali-yuge rājann etad gopyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
aśvamedhādikaṃ yasmān māhātmyaṃ mādhavasya yat ||74||
aśvamedha-makhaḥ puṇyaḥ kalau naiva pravartate |
eṣa mādhava-māsasya haya-medha-samo vidhiḥ ||75||
aśvamedhasya yat puṇyaṃ svarga-mokṣa-phala-pradam |
na vetsyanti kalau pāpā janā durita-buddhayaḥ ||76||
tasmin bhavair naraiḥ pāpair gantavyaṃ narakārṇave |
atas tu viralas tasya pracāro ye na nirmitaḥ ||77||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vaiśākha-māsa-māhātmye ṣcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||85||

sūta uvāca—
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā  nāradasya mahātmanaḥ |
ambarīṣaś ca rājarṣir vismito vākyam abravīt ||1||
ambarīṣa uvāca—
mārgaśīrṣādikānmāsānhitvāpuṇyānmahā-mune |

kovidhis tatra kiṃ dānaṃ kiṃ tapaḥ kācadevatā ||3||

rājyalābhādayo'pyete yathā tavasamāgamaḥ ||11||

athamaṃ damṛdusmerasphuraddaṃ taprabhānugaḥ |

śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi hitāya jagatas tava |

bhavanti bhagavad-bhāva-bhāvitā dharma-kāGkṣiṇaḥ ||17||
mādhave māsi yaiḥ snātaṃ prātar niyama-saṃyutaiḥ |
te koṭi-varṣa-paryantaṃ krīḍante nandane vane ||18||
yathā na vāridhi-samo loke ko'pi jalāśayaḥ |
tathā māsonavaiśākhasadṛśomādhavapriyaḥ ||19||

kiṃ kiṃ na durlabhataraṃ prāpyate māsi mādhave |
snānena parameśasya pūjanena yathā vidhi ||23||
na dattaṃ na hutaṃ japtaṃ na tīrthe maraṇaṃ kṛtam |
yair hi nārāyaṇo naiva dhyāto nikhila-pāpahā ||24||

adattvā mriyate yo hi tasya dravyaṃ nirarthakam |
tīrtha-snānādi-tapasā sat-kule janma labhyate ||26||

vaiśākha-snāna-māhātmyād api paṣca-dinātmakāt ||27||

suputraḥ sukulaṃ bhūpadhanadhānyaṃ varastriyaḥ ||28||

sadādāne'dhikāprītiraudāryaṃ dhairyamuttamam ||29||
prasādāt tasya devasyaviṣṇoścaivamahātmanaḥ |
nārāyaṇasyajāyaṃ tesiddhayobhūpavāṃ cchitāḥ ||30||
ūrje māsi tapo-māsi mādhave mādhava-priye |

viśeṣeṇa samabhyarcya dattvā dānāni śaktitaḥ |
##hikaṃ sukhamāsādyanaroharipadaṃ vrajet ||32||
aneka-janmārjitapātakāvalīvilīyatemādhavamajjanena |

evaṃ jṣātvāmahā-bhāgamadhusūdanamarcaya ||38||

evaṃ vidhi-yuto martyaḥ snātvā dvādaśa-vatsaram ||45||
udyāpanaṃ carec chaktyā madhusūdana-tuṣṭaye |
idaṃ mādhava-māsasya māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||46||
yat purā brahmaṇo vaktrāc chrutam āsīn mayā nṛpa ||47||

sūta uvāca—

anicchayāpidahatispṛṣṭohutavaho yathā |
 tathā dahatigovindanāmavyājādapīritam ||8||

 tathā pibahubhiḥ puṇyairduritaṃ yātidāruṇam |

 yathā lpanāśomahatāmahannāśas tathā lpataḥ ||21||

priyāvākyaṃ sasaṃ śrutyadevaśarmāmahā-matiḥ |
 uvācavacanaṃ prītoduḥkhito'pisatīsakhaḥ ||49||
devaśarmovāca—
yattvayācintitaṃ bhadrekiṃ cidduḥkhasyakāraṇam |

sambandhaḥ kīdṛśobhadretanmevistaratovada |

nyāsasvāmīsuputro'bhūnnyāsāpahārakasyaca |

(90)
navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

devaśarmovāca—
pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tvayākhyātaṃ mamaivatat |
śūdratvenahivipreṃ dramayaivaṃ dhanamarjitam ||1||

yattvayāceṣṭitaṃ pūrvaṃ dharmakarmakṛtaṃ dvija |

brāhmaṇaikaḥ sudharmātmāsadācāraḥ supaṃ ḍitaḥ |
viṣṇubhaktastudharmātmānityaṃ viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ ||6||

aṭamānaḥ samāyātastavagehemahā-matiḥ ||7||
 tasya darśanamātreṇasamutpannasudhīstava |
yatodharmagategehesatāmāgamanaṃ bhavet ||8||
kiṃ kiṃ nalabhyatevipravipravaiṣṇavasevayā |
durlabhaṃ yaccalokesyānmokṣasthānamapisthiram ||9||
yācitaṃ sthānamekaṃ vaivāsārthaṃ tenasattama |
tavaiva bhāryayā dattaṃ tvayā ca saha putrakaiḥ ||10||
eyatāmeyatāṃ brahmansukhenacagṛhemama |
vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ puṇyamity uvācapunaḥ punaḥ ||11||
sukhenasthīyatāmatragṛho'yaṃ tavasuvrata |
adyadhanyo'smyahaṃ puṇyoadyatīrthamahaṃ gataḥ ||12||
adyatīrthaphalaṃ prāptaṃ mayātevipradarśanāt |
gavāṃ sthānaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ vāsasthānaṃ pradarśitam ||13||
aṃ gasaṃ vāhanaṃ samyakpādaucaivapramarditau |
kṣālitaucapunastoyaiḥ snātaḥ pādodakenahi ||14||
sadyoghṛtaṃ dadhikṣīramanyamanyaṃ pradattavān |
brāhmaṇāyatadātasmaitvaṃ tathā 'dṛṣṭanoditaḥ ||15||
evaṃ santo ṣitoviprastvayaivasahabhāryayā |
putraiḥ sārdhaṃ mahā-bhāgovaiṣṇavojñānapaṃ ḍitaḥ ||16||
atha prabhāte vimale snānārthaṃ māsi mādhave |
gaṅgāyāṃ gacchatā tena tuṣṭena dayayādhipam ||17||
vaiśākha-snāna-māhātmyam upadiṣṭaṃ tavāgrataḥ |
kāritas tu yathā nyāyaṃ sa-bhāryā-tanayo bhavān ||18||
 yathā navāridhisamolokeko’pi jalāśayaḥ |
 tathā māsonavaiśākhasadṛśomādhavapriyaḥ ||19||
tāvatpāpānitiṣṭhanti niṣpratyūhaṃ kalevare |

 tasya vākyaṃ samākarṇyavaiśākhesevanaṃ kṛtam |
tuṣṭenamanasāviprapūjitomadhusūdanaḥ ||21||
avaśiṣṭadinānyevapaṣcamāsasya tasya vai |
ekādaśīṃ samārabhyasnānaṃ cavidhivatkṛtam ||22||
brāhmaṇasyaprasaṅgenarevāṃ cānudinetvayā |
prātaḥ snānaṃ kṛtaṃ vipra vaiśākhe māsi tāvatā ||23||
pūjito deva-deveśo madhuhā parameśvaraḥ |
naivāptaḥ sakalo māsaḥ snānārthaṃ tava pūrvataḥ ||24||
evaṃ snānaṃ tvayā cīrṇam api paṣca-dinātmakam |
tena puṇyena saṅgatyā brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ||25||
govindasya prasādena tvaṃ tu brāhmaṇatāṃ gataḥ |
tvayātanmāsayogenaprāptametanmahatkulam ||26||
durlabhaṃ bhūmi-devānāṃ satya-dharma-samanvitam |
bhāryāpisusatīprāptāsādhvī sarva-guṇānvitā ||27||
cyavanasyagṛhotpannā sarva-jṣābrahmavādinī |
rūpamevaparaṃ strīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ camahā-mune ||28||
śīlamevadvitīyaṃ catṛtīyaṃ satyam eva ca |
sadāryatvaṃ caturthaṃ tupaṣcamaṃ puṇyamuttamam ||29||
madhuratvaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ śuddhatvaṃ saptamaṃ mahat |
bāhyāntaḥ satataṃ strīṇāṃ sarvābharaṇasaptamam ||30||
aṣṭamaṃ tupataubhāvaḥ śuśrūṣānavamaṃ kila |
sahiṣṇutācadaśamaṃ ratirekādaśaṃ tathā ||31||
pativratatvaṃ vipreṃ dradvādaśaṃ yoṣitāṃ smṛtam |
etaiḥ sambhūṣitābhāryāsādhvītebrahmavādinī ||32||
vaiśākhasnānayogenalabdhāpuṇyenasādaram |
kiṃ kiṃ nadurlabhataraṃ prāpyatemāsi mādhave ||33||
snānenaparameśasyapūjanena yathā vidhi |
athamohapramugdhositṛṣṇayāvyāpitaṃ maṃ naḥ ||34||
pūrvajanmanitevipradravyamevaprasaṃ citam |
na dattaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo hi dīneṣv anyeṣu vai tvayā ||35||
na bandhu-vargo no putra-dāreṣu ca kathaṃ ca na |
mriyamāṇenabhavatālobhaevahicintitaḥ ||36||
na dattaṃ na hutaṃ japtaṃ na tīrthe maraṇaṃ kṛtam |
na hi nārāyaṇo devo dhyānenākhila-pāpahā ||37||
dravyeṣu vidyamāneṣu kṛpaṇojāyatenaraḥ |
adatvāmriyateyastutatoduḥkhataraṃ nukim ||38||
tīrtha-snānādi-tapasā kule janmaiva labhyate |
nodattenavināviprakiṃ cidevopatiṣṭhati ||39||
 tasya pāpasyabhāvenadaridratvamupāgatam |
aputravānbhavāṣjātaḥ satataṃ duḥkhapīḍitaḥ ||40||
vaiśākhasnānamāhātmyādapipaṣcadinātmakāt |
tadaivaharipūjāyāḥ saṅgatyābrāhmaṇasyaca ||41||
labdhaṃ janma kule vipra vipratvam api durlabham |
suputraś ca kulaṃ vipraṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varastriyaḥ ||42||
sujanmamaraṇaṃ caivasubhogaḥ sukham eva ca |
sadādāne'dhikābuddhiraudāryaṃ dhairyamuttamam ||43||
prasādāt tasya devasyaviṣṇoścaivamahātmanaḥ |
nārāyaṇasyajāyaṃ tesiddhayovipravāṣchitāḥ ||44||
ūrje māsi tapo-māsi mādhave mādhava-priye |
snātvā dāmodaraṃ bhaktyā mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam ||45||
viśeṣeṇa samabhyarcya dattvā dānāni bhaktitaḥ |
##hikaṃ sukhamāsādyajanoyātitatoharim ||46||
aneka-janmārjitapātakāvalīvilīyatemādhavamajjanena |
sūryodayevipra yathā tamisrāvacaḥ svayaṃ bhūridamādideśa ||47||
cakāraviṣṇurvimalaṃ vicāraṃ māsaṃ vidhiṃ mādhavamekamādau |
yamasyaguptaṃ manasāviciṃ tyamanuṣyalokairgamituṃ canāke ||48||
tasmād asmin samāyāte mādhave māsi mādhave |
snātvā puṇyajaletīrtheravāvanudite'dhunā ||49||
pūjayitvā vidhānena mukundaṃ madhusūdanam |
putrapautradhanaṃ śreyovāṃ chitānisukhāni ca ||50||
anubhūyatatastvaṃ tesvargamakṣayamāpsyasi |
pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yattvayāpariceṣṭitam ||51||
tanmayākathitaṃ vipratavāgrepariceṣṭitam |
evaṃ jṣātvāmahā-bhāgavaiśākhecaviśeṣataḥ ||52||
snātvā samyagvidhānenamadhusūdanamarcaya |
devamārādhyagovindaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam ||53||
prāpsyasitvaṃ sukhaṃ putraṃ dhanāniharimavyayam ||54||
nārada uvāca—
brahmātmajenāpimahā-nubhāvaḥ savipravaryaḥ paribodhitohi |
harṣeṇayuktaḥ samahā-nubhāvobhaktyāvasiṣṭhaṃ praṇipatya tatra ||55||
āmaṃ tryavipraṃ sajagāmagehaṃ tāṃ prāhabhāryāṃ sumanāṃ maharṣiḥ |
sarvaṃ hivṛttaṃ mamapūrvaceṣṭitaṃ tenaivavipreṇatavaprasādāt ||56||
bhadre vasiṣṭhena vikāśa-nītam 
adyaiva mohaḥ parināśito me |
ārādhayiṣye madhusūdanaṃ tu 
śrī-mādhave māsi nimajjya bhaktyā ||57||
nārada uvāca—
ākarṇyavākyaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ sumaṃ galaṃ maṃ galahetumuccaiḥ |
harṣeṇayuktātam uvācakāntaṃ dhanyosivipreṇavibodhitastvam ||58||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vaiśākha-māsa-māhātmyedevaśarmopākhyāne navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||90||

(91)
ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
devaśarmāmahā-prājṣaḥ samaṃ sumanasātayā |
tīrthekanakhalepuṇyegaṅgāyāmativiśrute ||1||
vaiśākhevidhināsnānaṃ cakremeṣasthiteravau |
pūjayāmāsavidhivanmadhusūdanamacyutam ||2||
yamaiḥ saniyamairyuktaḥ śaktyākiṃ ciddadautataḥ |
haviṣyabhugbhūmiśāyībrahmacaryavratasthitaḥ ||3||
kṛcchrāditapasākṣāmodhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi |
 tatra prāpyasavaiśākhīṃ datvāmadhutilādikam ||4||
viprebhyobhojanaṃ datvābhaktyādhenuṃ sadakṣiṇām |
acchidraṃ prārthayāmāsa tatra snānasyabhūsurān ||5||
sāpisādhvīcasuśroṇīpatibhaktiparāyaṇā |
patiṃ śuśrūṣatenityaṃ snātvā sampūjyakeśavam ||6||
taudaṃ patītatoyātausvagehaṃ sādhuharṣitam |
kṛtakṛtyāvathātmānaumanyamānāvasaṃ śayam ||7||
tenapuṇyaprabhāveṇakālenakiyatākila |
babhūvuramitās tasya dhanadhānyānisampadaḥ ||8||
tanayāvinayopetāścatvāraḥ śrutikovidāḥ |
dharmajṣāvaiṣṇavānityaṃ pitṛmātṛparāyaṇāḥ ||9||
babhūvuramitaprajṣāḥ puruṣārthāyabodhitāḥ |
vikhyātāvidhitattvajṣābrahmajṣābrahmatatparāḥ ||10||
samagraguṇasampannāḥ sampratiṣṭhanti kīrtayaḥ ||11||
tau daṃpatī suta-samagra-samṛddha-saukhyaṃ 
puṇyodayaṃ samupayujyatataś cireṇa |
sthānaṃ paraṃ paramam-īyatur asya bhaktyā
śrī-mādhave ca sukṛtasya nṛpa-prasādāt ||12||
yathaiva mādhavaḥ sākṣād vidyā-lakṣmī-dhavaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tathaiva mādhavo māso madhusūdana-vallabhaḥ ||13||
idaṃ mādhavamāhātmyaṃ kiṃ citsaṃ kṣepato'nagha |
mayātekathitaṃ vīrayatpurācapituḥ śrutam ||14||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe nāradāmbarīṣa-saṃvāde vaiśākha-māsa-māhātmyeekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||91||

(92)
dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ 

sūta uvāca—
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā nāradasyasabhūpatiḥ |
praṇamyavismitaḥ prāhaciṃ tayanmanasāharim ||1||

 kathaṃ mādhavamāsasyasnānenaivāpaso'dhamaḥ ||3||
na yajṣa-dānair na tapobhir ugrair
na puṇya-saṃjṣair aparair apīśa |
asmādṛśo bhūpatayo'rthavanto 
na te labhante'vani-daivatatvam ||4||
sagādhisūnurvividhaṃ tapo'piciraṃ vidhāyāniśamevaghoram |
kṛcchreṇalebheśatavarṣapūrṇairaho kathaṣcid bahubhiḥ prayatnaiḥ ||5||
 kathaṃ savarṇādhamaeṣapāpaḥ svadharmahīnodhanavānadātā |
puṇyādanāyāsakṛtādamuṣmādalpādihāvāpasarāmatattvam ||6||
nārada uvāca—

 tathā pigatayaḥ sūkṣmādurjṣeyādharmatattvataḥ ||7||

na tasya phaladānasyaśrūyatekālaniścayaḥ |

 tathā pibahubhiḥ puṇyairduritaṃ yātidāruṇam |

siṃ havyāghrādimūtrādauprayāsābahulāstataḥ ||15||

 yathā lpanāśomahatāmahannāśas tathā lpataḥ ||18||

ajāmilo'pibhūpāladāsyāḥ patiritismṛtaḥ ||19||

mriyamāṇaḥ sutāhvānaṃ cakrenārāyaṇetica ||20||
 tathā yannāmagrahaṇātpadaṃ lebhesudurlabham |
anicchayāpidahatispṛṣṭohutavaho yathā ||21||
 tathā dahatigovindanāmavyājādapīritam ||22||
hatyāyutaṃ śapanahāsahasramugraṃ gurvaṃ ganākoṭiniṣevaṇaṃ ca |

viṣṇubhaktimayaṃ vīrayatkiṃ citkriyate'lpakam |

sandeho na ca kartavyo mādhave māsi mādhavam |
samārādhyajanobhaktyātattadvāṃ chitamāpnuyāt ||25||

eko'pitriṣulokeṣu samagrepsitadāyakaḥ ||29||
puṇyenagāṃ genajalenakāledeśebudhaḥ snānaparaḥ kathaṣcit |

sūta uvāca—
yātuṃ tamudyataṃ natvāmuniṃ rājātatomudā |

 yathā temādhavomāsovallabhomadhusūdana |

 sarva-yajṣamayaśrīmannekaṃ niścityamevada |

sūta uvāca—

evamuktetuvacanedharmarājenasadvijaḥ |

brāhmaṇa uvāca—
yat kṛtvā sumahat-puṇyaṃ svargaḥ syād brūhi tan mama |

vrajanti kena vai svargaṃ tat sarvaṃ kṛpayā vada |
yama uvāca—
karmaṇā manasā vācā ye dharma-vimukhā narāḥ ||49||

kula-deśocitaṃ karma yas tyaktvānyat samācaret ||51||

ayājya-yājakaś caiva yājyānāṃ ca vivarjakaḥ ||52||

adattvā pitṛ-devebhyo viprebhyo martya-bandhuṣu ||53||

avaiśvadevaṃ bhuJjītasa yāti narakaṃ ciram |

ādyaṃ puruṣam īśānaṃ sarva-loka-maheśvaram ||71||

āśācchedaṃ cakurvanti tenarānarakaukasaḥ |
āgatānbhojanārthaṃ cabrāhmaṇānvṛttikarśitān ||73||

vrataṃ rakṣanti yekopācchriyaṃ rakṣanti matsarāt ||96||

śukle'sitecayevipratenarāḥ svargagāminaḥ |

naro nirdhūya tat tūrṇaṃ prītaḥ svar-gatimān bhavet |

upoṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāt pakṣayor ubhayor api ||107||

martyalokecanaṃ dāyāṃ dhanyāstekeśavapriyāḥ ||123||

utpādyaputrānsaṃsthāpyapitṛpaitāmahepade ||127||

śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ cakarmaṇāṃ phalasaJcaye ||130||

bhaktyāyaḥ kuruteśrāddhaṃ sanūnaṃ suralokabhāk ||134||

icchānivṛttiścasukhocitānāṃ dayācabhūteṣu divaṃ nayanti ||135||
