sūta uvāca—
etac chrutvā vacas tasya dharmarājasya bhūsuraḥ |
punaḥ papraccha māsasya mādhavasya vidhiṃ śubham ||1||
brāhmaṇa uvāca—
dharmarāja mahā-bhāga samyag guhyaṃ prakāśitam |
mādhava-snāna-jaṃ puṇyaṃ narāṇāṃ muktidaṃ param ||2||
mādhavaṃ mādhave māsi snātvā prātaḥ samāhitaḥ |
kathaṃ sampūjayed devaṃ kaiḥ puṣpais tad vidhiṃ vada ||3||
dharmarāja uvāca—
sarveṣāṃ patra-jātīnāṃ tulasī keśava-priyā |
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā ||4||
vāsudevādayo devā vasanti tulasī-dale |
sarvadā sarva-kāleṣu tulasī viṣṇu-vallabhā ||5||
tyaktvā tu mālatī-puṣpaṃ muktvā ca sarasīruham |
gṛhītvā tulasī-patraṃ bhaktyā mādhavam arcayet ||6||
tasya puṇya-phalaṃ vaktum alaṃ śeṣo'pi no bhavet |
asnātvā tulasīṃ chittvā devārthaṃ pitṛ-karmaṇi ||7||
tat sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ yāti paṣcagavyena śudhyati |
dāridrya-duḥkha-bhogādi-pāpāni subahūny api ||8||
tulasī harate kṣipraṃ rogān iva harītakī |
tulasī kṛṣṇa-gaurākhyā tayābhyarcya madhudviṣam ||9||
viśeṣeṇa harer bhakto naro nārāyaṇo bhavet |
mādhavaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ tulasyā yo'rcayed yataḥ ||10||
trisandhyaṃ madhuhantāraṃ nāsti tasya punar-bhavaḥ |
alābhepuṣpapatrāṇāmannādyenāpipūjayet ||11||
śālitaṃ ḍulagodhūmairyavairvāpihariṃ sadā |
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānenamādhave mādhavapriye ||12||
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṃś catarppayetsacarācaram |
yo'śvatthamūlaṃ vaisiṃ cettoyenabahunāsadā ||13||

yo'śvatthamarcayeddevamudakenasamaṃ tataḥ ||
kulānāmayutaṃ tenatāritaṃ syānnasaṃ śayaḥ ||14||
alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇīcaduḥsvapnodurvicintita|

tarpitāḥ pitarastenatenaviṣṇuḥ samarcitaḥ |
yo'śvatthamarcayedvīrograhāstenaivapūjitāḥ ||16||
śvetāśvapuṣpāṇi tathā śamīṃ cahutāśanaṃ candanamarkabiṃ bam |
aśvatthavṛkṣaṃ casamālabhetatataś ca kuryānnijajātidharmān ||17||
kaṃ ḍūyanaṃ cagogrāsaṃsnātvā pippalatarppaṇam |
kṛtvāgovindapūjāṃ canasadurgatimāpnuyāt ||18||
trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ ca dina-trayam |
sarvāśakto’pi vidhinā nārī vā puruṣo’pi vā ||19||
pūrvokta-niyamair yuktaḥ prātaḥ snātvā ca śaktitaḥ |
vimuktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ svargam akṣayam aśnute ||20||
vaiśākhyām api śaktyā vā bhojayed brāhmaṇān daśa |
trirātramutthitaḥ snātvā sakṛccaprayataḥ śuciḥ ||21||
gaurānvāyadivākṛṣṇāṃ stilānakṣaudreṇasaṃyutān |
datvādvādaśaviprebhyastenaivasvastivācayet ||22||
prīyatāṃ dharmarājomepitṝndevāṃś catarppayet |
yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādevanaśyati ||23||
ayutāyutaṃ catiṣṭhetsasvargaloke yathā sukham |
māmevatunapaśyetsapūjito'khiladaivataiḥ ||24||
pākānnodakakuṃ bhādipitṛdaivatatuṣṭaye |
trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ cadinatrayam ||25||
yodadyādbhaktitovipramahā-pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
suvarṇatilapātraistubrāhmaṇāṣchaktito'nvaham ||26||

vāṣchantam ujjhitatarānya-samasta-saṅgam ||55||
nānā-vidha-śruti-guṇānvita-sapta-rāga-
grāma-trayī-gata-mano-hara-mūrchanābhiḥ |
samprīṇayantam uditābhir api prabhaktyā
saṃcintayan nabha-simāṃ druhiṇa-prasūtam ||56||
iti dhyātvā''tmānaṃ paṭu-viśada-dhīr nanda-tanayaṃ 
naro buddhyaivā'rgha-prabhṛtibhir anindyopahṛtibhiḥ |
yajed bhūyo bhaktyā sva-vapuṣi bahiṣṭhaiś ca vibhavair
iti proktaṃ sarvaṃ yad abhilaṣitaṃ bhū-sura-varāḥ ||57||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe vaiśākha-māhātmye

||103||

|| vaiśākha-māhātmyaṃ samāptam ||

śiva-rāghava-saṃvādaḥ

(104)
caturuttara-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ—
bhūyo vada mahā-bhāga rāma-cāritram adbhutam |
rāma-māhātmya sarvasvaṃ bhaktānāṃ prīti-dāyakam ||1||
sūta uvāca—
aśvamedhaṃ kratu-varaṃ kṛtvā dāśarathir yathā ||2||
pravṛtto loka-kṛtyeṣu śāstra-kṛtyeṣu kovidaḥ |
ayodhyāṃ gantu-kāmena śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā ||3||
pārvatyā saha devena uṣitaḥ sarayū-taṭe |
munayas taṃ samabhyety aśaṅkaraṃ viśva-rūpiṇam ||4||
kaśyapādyā mahātmānaḥ papracchur amitaujasam |
svāgataṃ te muni-śreṣṭha sabhāryaḥ kuta āgataḥ ||5||
kim āgamana-kṛtyaṃ te kaṃ deśaṃ gantum udyataḥ |
śaṅkara uvāca—
ahaṃ śambhur iti khyāto vipro hima-giri-sthitaḥ ||6||
draṣṭuṃ ca rāghavaṃ gacche mama kāryaṃ mahattataḥ |
mā māhvayatirājāsau purāṇa-śravaṇe rataḥ ||7||
āgacchantu bhavanto 'pi rāghavaḥ parituṣyati |
tatas te munayaḥ śambhur yayū rāma-didṛkṣayā ||8||
tān āgatān vasiṣṭhas tu jṣātvā rāmāya coktavān |
tataḥ satvaram utthāya niryayau sa purohitaḥ ||9||
arghya-pādyādikaiḥ sarvān pūjayāmāsa tān ṛṣīn |
gṛha-rājaṃ tataḥ sarvān prāveśayad arindamaḥ ||10||
pratyekam āsanaṃ dattvā svāgatoktyāsana-sthitān |
krameṇa raghu-śārdūlaḥ pūjayāmāsa tān ṛṣīn ||11||
vācā madhurayā prīṇann idam āhāsana-sthitān |
śrī-rāma uvāca—
adya me sa-phalaṃ janma-prāptam adya-tapaḥ phalam ||12||
adyābhyāsasya vidyānāṃ phala-kālo'yam āgataḥ |
adya me pitaras tuṣṭā rājyaṃ ca saphalaṃ mama ||13||
adya me saphalaṃ vṛttam adya me saphalaṃ śrutam |
evaṃ vadantaṃ rājānaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ kaśyapādayaḥ ||14||
ūcuḥ priyataraṃ vākyaṃ rāmaṃ rājīva-locanam |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ 
ayaṃ śambhur dvijaḥ prāptaḥ sarva-śāstra-viśāradaḥ ||15||
veda-vedāṅga-tattva-jṣaḥ sarva-bhūta-hite rataḥ |
kailāsa-vāsī satataṃ tapase kṛta-niścayaḥ ||16||
brahmaṇā brahma-varcaske tulyo brahma-vidāṃ varaḥ |
hariṇā brahma-vātsalye prasāde śaṅkaropamaḥ ||17||
evaṃ vidho mahā-tejāḥ śambhur brāhmaṇa-puṅgavaḥ |
aṣṭādaśa-purāṇa-jṣo mīmāṃsā-nyāya-kovidaḥ ||18||
tvadbhāgyagauravādevaprāpto'yaṃ munisattamaḥ |
tvayāhūtomunivaraḥ kailāsādāgataḥ prabho ||19||
ataḥ pṛcchamahā-bhāgapurāṇākhyānamuttamam |
śrotukāmāvayaṃ prāptāstvāmadyaraghunaṃ dana ||20||
aṃ taṃ ga tasya vedānāṃ sarva- śāstrārthavedinaḥ |
puṃ so'śrutapurāṇasyanasamyagyātidarśanam ||21||
sūta uvāca—
evamuktoraghuśreṣṭhomunibhistattvadarśibhiḥ |
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhepurāṇaśravaṇotsukaḥ ||22||
śrī-rāma uvāca—
liṅgārcana-prakāraṃ ca liṅga-māhātmyam eva ca |
maheśa-nāma-māhātmyaṃ pūjā-māhātmyam eva ca ||23||
namaskārasya māhātmyaṃ dṛṣṭi-māhātmyam eva ca |
jala-dānasya māhātmyaṃ dhūpa-dānasya sattama ||24||
dīpa-gandhādi-dānasya puṣpa-māhātmyam eva ca |
nānākhyānetihāsānāṃ kathāṃ pāpa-praṇāśinīm ||25||
dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣāṃś ca tad-upāyāṃś ca suvrata |
tat sarvaṃ śrotum icchāmi tvatto muni-varottama ||26||
śambhur uvāca—
rāma rāma mahā-bāho puṇyavān asi rāghava |
rājyāsaktasya te jātā purāṇa-śravaṇe ratiḥ ||27||
syān mahat-sevayā rāma puṇya-tīrtha-niṣevaṇāt |
sā jihvā yā śivaṃ gāyet tac-cittaṃ yat tad-arpitam ||28||
tāv eva kevalau ślāghyau yau tat-pūjā-karau karau |
sujanma-deham atyarthaṃ tad evāśeṣa-janmasu ||29||
yad evotpulako bhāsi hara-nāmānukīrtanāt |
kṛtārtho'si mahā-rāja tat-praśnānugatā matiḥ ||30||
anantaraṃ samājagmur jāṅghikāḥ satvara-śramāḥ |
tat-karāt patrikāṃ gṛhya papāṭha raghu-sattamaḥ ||31||
manasā'cintayad rāmaḥ katham etad abhūd iti |
rāmaṃ śambhus tadā prāha devyā brāhmaṇa-veṣavān ||32||
kiṃ cintayasi kākutstha muniṣv agre vasatsv api |
tad vākyaṃ rāghavaḥ śrutvā papraccha muni-puṅgavān ||33||
śrī-rāma uvāca—
bibhīṣaṇaḥ katham asau baddhaḥ śṛṅkhalayā nṛbhiḥ |
mat-sthāpitaṃ śivaṃ liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeśvaraṃ tv aho ||34||
drāviḍaiḥ kuṭilair duṣṭair ātmanā tad vicāryatām |
vicārya muni-varyās teneśās taj jṣātum alpataḥ ||35||
na jānīma iti prāhū rāmaṃ rāmas tadābravīt |
purāṇaṃ vīkṣya vidhinā tat sarvaṃ brūta sattamāḥ ||36||
bhavad-ajñāna-hetuś ca vicāryas tad-anantaram |
kiṃ kiṃ purāṇaṃ prekṣyaṃ syād varjanīyaṃ tathaiva kim ||37||
praśastaḥ kīdṛśaḥ ślokas tad anyaḥ kīdṛśo bhavet |
kīdṛśeṣu ca kāryeṣu kīdṛśaḥ pūjakas tathā ||38||
pūjā ca kīdṛśair bhaktaiḥ kāryā nirṇaya-darśane |
iti rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā te dvija-sattamāḥ ||39||
pratyūcus taṃ raghu-śreṣṭhaṃ cintā-vyākula-mānasam |
na vaktāro varaṃ rāma vīkṣatāṃ tu purāṇavit ||40||
tac chrutvā rāghavaḥ śambhuṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ |
so’pi tad vākyam ākarṇya pratyuvāca mahā-matiḥ ||41||
śambhur uvāca—
purāṇa-jīvī-pūjārhaḥ sva-śākhādhyayanaḥ śuciḥ |
mīmāṃsā-tattva-vijñānaḥ śrotriyo'nṛta-dūṣakaḥ ||42||
deveṣu ca samasteṣu sama-dṛṣṭiḥ śive rataḥ |
śatarudriyajāpī ca sāgnikaś cātivācakaḥ ||43||
yajur-vedī viśeṣeṇa pūjayet pustakaṃ sudhīḥ |
śrī-tāla-patra-likhitaṃ deva-lipy-anvitaṃ śubham ||44||
bandhādyati prapaṣcaṃ yad yugapat praṇavākṣaram |
prāg ūrdhvaṃ rekhayoḥ prānte praṇavasyāgra-yojikā ||45||
rekhābhave devam ekā akāras tasya pārśvataḥ |
śirobhāgam upakramya sa koṇādhaḥ pralambinī ||46||
ākāraḥ sa hi vijṣeyaḥ paṭṭikād akṣa-rekhayā |
vāme ṣaḍvakra-bindūdvāvikāraitikīrtitaḥ ||47||
tasya vāmaśirorekhālambinyāīudāhṛtaḥ |
sarvākṣareśirorekhāavakrāpraṇavaṃ vinā ||48||
tasyāṃ tulambarekhānyātadaṃ tecalavitravat |
ukāraḥ sahivikhyātolavitradvayatastadū ||49||
evamanyānisarvāṇiakṣarāṇyāhabhāratī |
lipyānayaivalikhitaṃ purāṇaṃ tupraśasyaste ||50||
brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca mārtaṇḍaṃ nāraderitam |
mārkaṇḍeyam athāgneyaṃ kaurmaṃ vāmanam eva ca ||51||
gāruḍaṃ laiGgam ākhyātaṃ skāndaṃ mātsyaṃ nṛsiṃhakam |
tathaiva gaditaṃ rāma purāṇaṃ kāpilaṃ tathā ||52||
vārāhaṃ brahma-vaivartaṃ śakuneṣu praśasyate |
śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ daurgaṃ bhaviṣyottaram eva ca ||53||
bhaviṣyaṃ copasaṃjṣāni tv anyāni ca vivarjayet |
vimucya pustakaṃ ratna-pīṭhe nikṣipya saṃskṛtam ||54||
dhauta-vastra-dharaḥ snātvā śucira-krodhano'jvaraḥ |
ādāv ātmānam abhyarcya kṛtvā saṅkalpam eva ca ||55||
aṅkuśaṃ cākṣa-sūtraṃ ca pāśaṃ pustakam eva ca |
dhārayantīṃ sitāṃ dhyāyet prasannāsyāṃ sarasvatīm ||56||
go-kṣīra-sadṛśākāraṃ tri-netraṃ vṛṣa-vāhanam |
sahāsa-vadanaṃ śāntaṃ śuklāmbara-dharaṃ śivam ||57||

anyaiḥ samasta-lokaiś ca saṃsevita-padāmbujam ||60||

āpo vā idam ity etat kalaśasyābhimantraṇam ||61||

tat sad-brahmeti mantreṇa praśasya praṇave na tu ||62||
ātmānaṃ sarva-pātrāṇi tata āvāhayed iti |
yad vāg iti tṛce bhāratī ṣoḍaśārcanam ||63||
puruṣa-sūktena vā kuryād gāyatryā vā samarcayet |

oṃ namo bhagavatyai dūrvāyai iti ||65||
sa loka-pāla-pūjā syād atha kanyā-samarcanam |
vatsarāt paṣcakād ūrdhvaṃ daśa-varṣād adhaḥ śubhāḥ ||66||

satyaṃ brūhi priyaṃ brūhi bhagavati sarasvati namas te namas ta iti ||69||
gāyatryānukramārthāt tu dūrvā-yugmaṃ tu kārayet |
sannidhau pustakasyādhaḥ sahasra-paramety ṛcā ||70||
dūrvā-yugma-trayaṃ dadyāt tasyā haste-vicakṣaṇaḥ |
sā prakṣipet pustasandhau śalākā-trayam anv anu ||71||
visṛjyatāṃ punar dadyāc chivābhyāṃ nama ity atha |
patrayor madhyamaḥ ślokaḥ kārya-siddher hi sūcakaḥ ||72||
pūrva-patre samāptiḥ syāc chlokasya yadi rāghava |
para-patre paṭhec chlokaṃ vivicyārtham udīrayet ||73||
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ paṭhet prājṣo vyākhyāsec ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
tvarehanahikartavyākupyatitvarayātugīḥ ||74||

natatparyuṣitaṃ proktamapūpādigamiṣyati |

atharāmodaśabhirbāṇairāvaṇaṃ savraṇaṃ cakāra ||260||
anayoratidāruṇamanyonyaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ||261||
rāvaṇodaśabhirbāṇairvivyādha ||262||
atha rāmabāṇaiśca kṣataśarīro rākṣasaḥ palāyanaparo'bhavat ||263||
vānarā lakṣmaṇaś ca koṭikoṭirākṣasānaghnan ||264||
atha parasminnahani vibhīṣaṇo rāvaṇaṃ vicāryedam uvāca ||265||
tṛtīyopāyakālo'yaṃ caturthaṃ na vicāraya |
caturtho viparīto na śastaḥ śastārthakāriṇaḥ ||266||
parasya cā''tmanaḥ śaktiṃ viditvā cā''tmano'dhikām |
tadā yuddhaṃ praśastaṃ syādviparītaṃ vināśakam ||267||
rāmeṇa balinānaiva yuddhaṃ te durbalasya ca |
ekeṣu vālihantā'sau vālirjṣātastvayā purā ||268||
mārīcamekabāṇena bhavānapi palāyitaḥ |
nihatā rākṣasāḥ śūrā indrajicca suto hataḥ ||269||
vareṇyatritayaṃ bhagnaṃ tena yuddhaṃ ca naiva te |
dāsabhāvamatho vā'pi dattvā sītāmathā'pnuhi ||270||
gopurasthaṃ tathā dāru paṣcavaktramatheṣu ṇā |
ciccheda paṣcadhā tena rāmastvāṃ mārayiṣyati ||271||
tvadarthaṃ bahavo naṣṭā nāśameṣyanti cāpare |
eko nyāyaḥ sukhārthāya na ca mauḍhyaṃ sahodara ||272||
mānuṣīṃ mṛtyusaṃ yuktāmanicchantīṃ pativratām |
patnīṃ balavataścāpi pūjayitvā visarjaya ||273||
anicchantyāḥ samāyoge bhavedduḥkhaparaṃ parā |
durgandhamalasaṃ yukto nārīsaṅgo jugupsitaḥ ||274||
viraktiratha cejjātā duḥkhāyākāryavartanam |
anurāgoyadi bhavenmaraṇaṃ narakaṃ tataḥ ||275||
ātmano maraṇaṃ vyarthaṃ tasyāścādya samāgame | 
tyāgo vā maraṇaṃ tāta dharmapatnyās tathā bhavet | ||276||
evamādi tathā 'nyacca kaśmalaṃ sambhaviṣyati |
anyadākhyāmi te vākyaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca priyaṃ hitam ||277||
gatvā rāmāntikaṃ natvā stutvā vijṣāpya rāghavam |
kṣama rāma mahā-vīra śaraṇāgatavatsala ||278||
tāmasā rākṣasāḥ sarve vayamete supāpinaḥ |
sītāpahārajaṃ doṣaṃ tyaktvā putrānavehi naḥ ||279||
tvadadhīnā vayaṃ rāma rakṣa vā mārayecchayā |
ityudīrya puras tasya rāghavasya sthitā vayam ||280||
sthirāyuṣo bhaviṣyāmaḥ sthirarājyā daśānana |
athā''ha rāvaṇo vākyamaho no rākṣaso bhavān ||281||
na śūro rājadharmaṃ ca na ca jānāsi śāśvatam |
paranārīparadravyapararājyaniṣevayā ||282||
śūrāṇāmuttamo dharmo na ṣaṇḍhānāṃ bhavādṛśām |
śatrupakṣaṃ samāliṅgya  nirgacchecchā hi cennṛpa ||283||
atha bibhīṣaṇo mandiraṃ gatvā rāmāntikaṃ gatvā taṃ śaraṇamabhajat ||284||
atha rāvaṇaḥ purānnirgatya rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇavānarai rākṣasā api yuyudhire ||285||
atha rāvaṇaṃ mahā-balaṃ hantumaśaktorāmo vibhīṣaṇamukhamavalokya tad ukta cihna-padaṃ bāṇena nirbhidyāmārayat ||286||
atha kumbhakarṇo mahā-gadām ādāya sarvaṃ niṣpādya vānarān anekaśo bhakṣayitvā rāmottamāṅgaṃ gadayāhan ||287||
atha rāmo niśitabāṇaśatena tamahanmamāra kumbhakarṇaḥ ||288||
atha vibhīṣaṇena rāvaṇādeḥ śrāddhādikaṃ kārayitvā śivālayaṃ tannāmnā kārayitvā tameva laṅkārājye vibhīṣaṇamabhiṣicya sītāmagnipraveśaśuddhāmumāmaheśvarābhyāṃ namayitvā purahareṇa dattākhilāmṛtabalāyuṣyaḥ supuṣpakamāruhya jaladhimuttīrya pārāvārataṭe senāṃ samavasthāpya śivapratiṣṭhāṃ tatra kṛtvā munibhirdevairabhyarcito'yodhyāmagamat ||289||
atha bharatādisamupeto nāgarairvasiṣṭhena munibhiścābhyarcitaḥ svagṛhamagamat ||290||
ātmanā''gatānindrādidevānāsanādinā'bhyarcya vānarānsampūjyamuktajaṭo'bhiṣikto rājye rāvaṇavadhaharṣitā devā rāmam ūcuḥ ||291||
tvayā''tmarājye sthāpitā vayaṃ naḥ sarva- dā paripālaya tvamādinārāyaṇo devonikhiladuṣṭanigrahārthamavatīrṇo rāvaṇaṃ sabāndhavaṃ hatvā lokatrayarakṣako'si śriyā saha sukhī bhavetyudīrya svargaṃ gatāḥ ||292||
athāyodhyāvāsino rāmaṃ praharṣitā ūcuḥ ||293||
hatvā śatrūnsamāyāto dṛṣṭvā prāpto'si vai śivam |
diṣṭyā tvaṃ rājase rāma diṣṭyā pālayase prajāḥ ||294||
tvayāyajṣāḥ kariṣyaṃ te tvayā dharmovivardhate |
itipauravacaḥ śrutvārāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ||295||
vastrādibhirathosarvānnāgarānsamapūjayat |
munīn uvācadharmātmāpūjayitvākhilairjanaiḥ ||296||
kaccittapaḥ samṛddhaṃ vaḥ kaccidyajṣaḥ svanuṣṭhitaḥ |
kaccitsvadāraniratāḥ kaccidīśobhipūjyate ||297||
kaccitsuprajasobhāryāḥ kaccit sarvaṃ sukhottaram ||298||
munaya ūcuḥ—
tvayirājanikākutstha sarvaṃ svasthaṃ tapasvinām |
gacchāmahepadamitaḥ kiṃ vātvaṃ manyasenṛpa ||299||
rāma uvāca—
 yasya viprāḥ prasīdanti tasya śambhuḥ prasīdati |

tatkṛtvābhojanamihagantum arhāanantar- am |

abhivardhyatamāśīrbhirhṛṣṭāḥ svaṃ svaṃ padaṃ yayuḥ |
rāmo'piparamaprītaḥ sabhāryaś ca sahānujaḥ ||302||
akaṃ ṭakaṃ sakṛtavānrājyaṃ sarva- janapriyaḥ |

yaścāpi kīrtayet tasya evametadudīritam ||305||

 tasya putraḥ sampātiritikhyātaḥ |
cauryyārjitaiḥ śaṅkaraṃ pūjayāmāsa ||212||
tāvubhāve kasmin divasemamratuḥ gatauśivalokaṃ vīrabhadreṇabhāṣitauca ||213||
bhorūpakaanyāyārjitenadravyeṇabhavatāpūjākṛtāghaṃ ṭādikaṃ catenabhāvenavyaṃ gobhūtvācauragaṇobha-viṣyasi ||214||
śivapadavacanādvyaktaṃ nāmāśravaṇāt |
śrotraṃ tasya svanenadhvastaṃ bhavatinodarśanametāvatādevatvayeśvarapūjāsamyakkṛtā ||215||
atobhaktiścabhaviṣyativīrabhadrastvanaśanaṃ nāmagaṇaṃ kvacidvicaraṃ tamityādideśa ||216||
tauca tathā bhūtauśivaloke'tiṣṭhatām ||217||
śambhur uvāca— 
athopahatadravyapūjākathāṃ hanūmatemaheśabhāṣitāṃ kathayiṣyāmi ||218||
śṛṇurāghavapramathānāṃ caritramekaikasyakarmavipākaṃ kathayiṣyāmi ||219||
upahatāṃ gagaṇavyākhyākriyatāmitihanūmatpṛṣṭaḥ | śiva uvāca ||220||
tadupahatadravyaṃ jñānatoyaīśvare'rpayiṣyatietaduktaṃ jṣānino'taḥ śṛṇuḥ ||221||
eṣasarvāṃ gasvedilaḥ sarva- kālaṃ sarvāṃ gasvedilaḥ svedārdravasanaḥ svedasampāditālpapravāhaśarīronāsāgranipatitasvedabinduḥsparśāyogyodṛśyate ||222||
sapurāsvedakaraṇeśvarārcanaṃ kṛtavān | 
atretihāsaṅkīrtṣyāmi ||223||
cekitāniritikhyātobrāhmaṇaḥ karṣakobhavat |
sanityaṃ kṛṣimutpādyaprātaḥ snātvācanityaśaḥ ||224||
madhyāhnakālesamprāptesaṃ japanbrāhmaṇastvasau |
annamānayamekṣipramitibhāryāmabhāṣata ||225||
tayānītenacānnenavegenaśivapūjanam |
kṛtavānarkasaṃ taptaḥ svedilaḥ sarva- daivatu ||226||
gandhapuṣpākṣatādyaiścasvedabindu-samanvitaiḥ |
athasāyaṃ dineprāptekṣālitāṃ gaḥ suśobhanaḥ ||227||
pūjayāmāsadeveśaṅkālasambhavasādhanaiḥ |
mamārāthamahā-buddhiḥ śivalokaṃ gataś ca saḥ ||228||
vīrabhadreṇacāpyuktobhavatvaṃ svedilogaṇaḥ |
svedaspṛṣṭapadārthaiścapurāśambhuḥ prapūjitaḥ ||229||
nityaṃ svedasamāyuktastenasvedagaṇobhava |
śambhur uvāca—
vīreṇāthasamādiṣṭaḥ prāptorāmagaṇastvayam ||230||
amuṃ ghaṃ ṭāmukhaṃ paśyāyaṃ purāvaiśyovibhāvasonāmadhārmikomahā-dānakarttānityaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ kārayitvākṛtānuṣṭhānaḥ prātaḥ kāleśivaṃ namaskṛtyakusumaiḥ sampūjya kiṃ citpradeśaṃ gomayenopalipyapadmādikamarjayitvādevāyasamarpyaupahataghaṃ ṭānādaṃ kṛtavān ||231||
rāma uvāca—
kathamupahataghaṃ ṭā ||232||
śambhur uvāca—
āsītpurābalaḥ kaścitsomaityabhiviśrutaḥ |
 tasya putraś ca maṃ dākhyodaśavarṣavayāabhūt ||233||
sacāgnipakvakulmāṣānghaṃ ṭāyāṃ prākṣipannṛpa |
tānabhakṣayadapyeṣatenacopahatābhavat ||234||
gṛhītumathataṃ vaiśyaṃ yatamāno'bravīdidam |
athavaiśyaḥ svayaṃ tatra niścityadravyaśodhanam ||235||
laukikekṛtavāṃ ṃ llokevyavahārapadaś ca tām |
etenapāpa-yogenagaṇoghaṃ ṭāmukho'bhavat ||236||
rāma uvāca—
dravyaśuddherviśuddhāsā kathaṃ pāpasyakāraṇam |
samyaguktaṃ dravyaśuddhyai kathaṃ nadravyaśodhinī ||237||
śambhur uvāca—
nalaukikavyavahṛtautavābhaktobhaviṣyati |
sayāticaśivasthānaṃ vaktācāpi tathā bhavet ||238||
sūta uvāca—
yaś ca vaktikathāmetāṃ satenasadṛśo bhuvi |
guhyādguhyatamaṃ viprāḥ śivajñānapradaṃ bhavet ||239||
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ puṇyāyuṣyatamaṃ mahat |
yaidaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyāśivalokemahīyate ||240||
purāṇavaktredātavyaṃ vastraṃ gohemabhūṣaṇam |
bhūmiḥ sasyaphalopetādeyāśaktyanusārataḥ ||241||
śivarāghavasaṃ vādaṃ sarvāghaughanikṛṃ tanam |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpisayātiparamaṃ padam ||242||

|| iti śrī-padma-purāṇe pātāla-khaṇḍe śiva-rāghava-saṃvāde 
upari-bhāge rāma-mokṣo 
nāma saptadaśādhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||117|| 

samāptaṃ paṣcamaṃ pātālakhaṇḍam ||5||

|| iti śrīpadmapurāṇe paṣcamaṃ pātālakhaṇḍaṃ samāptam || 



|| śrī-padma-purāṇam ||

(||atha śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe ṣaṣṭham uttara-khaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate||)

jālandharopakhyānaḥ

(1)
prathamo’dhyāyaḥ

|| auṃ śrī-viṣṇave namaḥ ||
|| auṃ śrī-veda-vyāsāya namaḥ ||

auṃ nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayam udīrayet ||1||
ajñāna-timirāndhasya jṣānāṣjana-śalākayā |
cakṣur unmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrī-gurave namaḥ ||2||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ—
śrutaṃ pātāla-khaṇḍaṃ ca tvayākhyātaṃ vidāṃ vara |
nānākhyāna-samāyuktaṃ paramānanda-dāyakam ||3||
adhunā śrotum icchāmo bhagavad-bhakti-vardhanam |
pādme yac cheṣam astīhatad brūhi kṛpayā guro ||4||
sūta uvāca—-
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yad uktaṃ śaṅkareṇa hi |
pṛcchate nāradāyaiva vijñānaṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||5||
ekadā nārado lokān paryaṭan bhagavat-priyaḥ |
gato’dri-mandaraṃ śambhuṃ praṣṭuṃ kiṃcin mano-gatam ||6||
tatrāsīnam umānāthaṃ praṇipatya śivājṣayā |
upaviṣṭaḥ samādiṣṭa āsane’bhimukho vibhoḥ ||7||
nārada uvāca—
papraccha idam eveśaṃ yan māṃ pṛcchatha sattamāḥ |
bhagavan deva-deveśa pārvatīśa jagad-guro ||8||
bhagavat-tattva-vijñānaṃ yena syāt tan mamādiśa |
śiva uvāca—
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi purāṇaṃ veda-saṃmitam ||9||
yac chrutvā sarva-pāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
prathamottara-kīrtiḥ syāt parvatākhyānam eva ca ||10||
jālandharaṃ tathākhyānaṃ śrī-śailākhyaṃ tataḥ param |
haridvārasya vyākhyānaṃ viṣṇu-pādodbhavāṃ tathā ||11||
prayāga-tīrthaṃ te vakṣye daśāśvamedhikaṃ ca tat |
tulasī-mahimā caiva śaṅkha-cakra-gadādikam ||12||
dvārakāyās tathākhyānaṃ mahotsava-vidhis tataḥ |
taḍāka-jaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ vāpī-kūpa-prapādikam ||13||
gāṇapatyaṃ tato vakṣye vaiṣṇavāgamam eva ca |
jīrṇoddhārasya māhātmyaṃ mandākinī-samāgamam ||14||
sābhramatyāstumāhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ tīrajaṃ tathā |
strī-śūdrāṇāṃ tathādharmaṃ tathātyājyaiś ca dhāraṇam ||15||
umāmaheśasaṃvāde proktaṃ nāma-sahasrakam |
kailāsāttatsamānītaṃ nāradenāgrajanmanā ||16||
lokānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ cakṣatriyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
strī-śūdrāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇapaṭhitavyaṃ samāhitaiḥ ||17||
idaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ puṇyamāyuṣyavardhanam |
paṭhitavyaṃ viśeṣeṇa viṣṇoḥ sāyujyam āpnuyāt ||18||
viṣṇor nāma-sahasraṃ tat-pāvanaṃ bhuvi-viśrutam |
caturviṃśati-mūrtīnāṃ sthānakānīha saṃvadet ||19||
teṣāṃ ca mātāpitarāv antaraṃ ca bravīmy aham |
gotraṃ vedāṃś ca teṣāṃ vai karmāṇīha tathaiva ca ||20||
striyas teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā vijñāna-darśanāt |
caturviṃśaty ekādaśīnāṃ dvādaśīnāṃ prabhāvatām ||21||
godāvaryāś ca māhātmyaṃ śaṅkha-cakrādi-dhāraṇam |
brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣeṇa dhāraṇaṃ vidhi-pūrvakam ||22||
yamunāyāś ca māhātmyaṃ gaṇḍikāyās tathā mune |
vetravatyās tu māhātmyaṃ vacmy ahaṃ te na saṃśayaḥ ||23||
gilli-tīrthodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ śilā-kṣetraṃ mahac ca yat |
tat sarvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi khaṇḍe uttara-saṃjṣake ||24||
arbudeśvara-māhātmyaṃ tatra tīrthādikaṃ ca yat |
sarasvatyāś ca māhātmyaṃ siddha-kṣetrādikaṃ ca yat ||25||
padma-nābha-samutpattiṃ tulasyāś caiva dhāraṇam |
gopī-candana-māhātmyaṃ paṭṭa-pūjāṃ tathaiva ca ||26||
niraṣjanasya māhātmyaṃ tathā vijñāna-darśanam |
tatra dīpa-pradānaṃ ca dhūpa-dānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||27||
kārttikasyātha māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ māghajaṃ tathā |
sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ vidhi-pūrvakam ||28||
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi jagannāthākhyam uttamam |
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate loko brahma-hatyādi-pātakāt ||29||
yatra siddhaṃ tathā bhuktaṃ pāralaukika-dāyakam |
brāhmaṇāyatra bhuṣjanti vedaśāstra viśāradaḥ ||30||
anyeṣāṃ caiva lokānāṃ kākathā caiva suvrata |
paṣcaviṃśatyatranāgānartakyovividhās tathā ||31||
brahmahatyābālahatyāgavāṃ hatyātathaiva ca |
tāḥ sarvāvilayaṃ yānti jagannāthasyadarśanāt ||32||
jagannāthetyuccaraṣjaturmahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate |
viṣṇoḥ pūjanakaṃ puṣpais tanmāhātmyamapibruve ||33||
parvatānāṃ varṇanaṃ cadeśānāṃ varṇanaṃ tathā |
gopūjanādimāhātmyaṃ siddhānāṃ caiva pūjanam ||34||
sikthedatte tu yatpuṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ pravadāmy aham |
kadalīgarbhadānaṃ cavṛkṣadānaṃ tataḥ param ||35||
aśvadānaṃ hastidānaṃ japamāhātmya muttamam |
mantradīkṣāgamaṃ caiva gurorlakṣaṇam eva ca ||36||
śiṣyasyalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yathāpaurāṇikāviduḥ |
caraṇodakamāhātmyaṃ pitṛśrāddhādikaṃ ca yat ||37||
pitṛkṣayāhadānaṃ canīlotsargavidhis tataḥ |
grahaṇaṃ candrasūryasyatatradānaṃ cayadbhavet ||38||
śālagrāmasyadānasya māhātmyaṃ mālyagandhayoḥ |
daśamyaikādaśīvedhaṃ dvādaśīharivāsaram ||39||
teṣāṃ caiva tumāhātmyaṃ rudranāmādikaṃ ca yat |
mathurāyāś ca māhātmyaṃ kurukṣetrādikaṃ tathā ||40|| 
setubandhasyacākhyānaṃ śrīrāmeśvarajaṃ tathā |
tryaṃ bakasyacamāhātmyaṃ paṣcavaṭyāśca yatphalam ||41||
daṇḍakāraṇyamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇuvāḍavasattama |
daṇḍakāraṇyamāhātmyaṃ nṛsiṃ hotpattikāraṇam ||42||
gītāyāś caiva māhātmyaṃ tathā bhāgavatasya ca |
kāliṃ dyāś caiva māhātmyamindraprasthasyavarṇanam ||43||
rukmāṃ gadacaritraṃ tumahimāvaiṣṇavasyaca |
vaiṣṇavehyekabhukte tu śṛṇuvāḍavasattama ||44||
sasāgarāṃ capṛthivīṃ dattvā caiva tuyatphalam |
tat phalaṃ samavāpnotibhuktehyeketuvaiṣṇave ||45||
sātvikāḥ sattva sampannārājasāḥ kāmukāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tāmasāadhamāḥ proktāvaiṣṇavānāṃ tulakṣaṇam ||46||
brāhmaṇāvaiṣṇavāyetuvedadharmaparāyaṇāḥ |
teṣāṃ māhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi yathoktaṃ caiva nārada ||47||
viṣṇunindāratāyevaidravyalobhenasattama |
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ tuvakṣyāmisāṃ prataṃ ṛṣisattama ||48||
jvālāmukhyās tathākhyānaṃ himaśailekṣaṇaṃ tathā |
brahmotpattistuvaiyatrataṃ pradeśaṃ vadāmy aham ||49||
kāyasthānāṃ samutpatirgayāvyākhyānam eva ca |
gadādharasvarūpaṣcaphalguvarṇanam eva ca ||50||
eteṣāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ pādmedṛṣṭaṃ tathāśrutam |
mahābodhasvarūpaṣcasakalkeryaśa eva ca ||51||
rāmagayāyāmāhātmyaṃ tathāpretaśilābhavam |
brahmaṇaśca tathākhyānaṃ śilākhyānaṃ vadāmy aham ||52||
brahmayones tathākhyānamakṣayākhyavaṭasyaca |
śrāddhetatramahatpuṇyaṃ yattatsarvaṃ vadāmy aham ||53||
maheśvarakṛtāmbhaktiṃ viṣṇunācamahātmanā |
adyāpikāśyāṃ japatimahārudrohyanāmayam ||54||
māhātmyaṃ ca tatovakṣyesāgarasyahinārada |
tilatarpaṇajaṃ puṇyaṃ yavajaṃ puṇyam eva ca ||55||
tulasīdala saṃyuktaṃ tarpaṇaṃ devajaṃ tathā |
tanmāhātmyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoktaṃ brahmaṇāmama ||56||
śaṅkhanādasya māhātmyaṃ puṇyaṃ cā saṃkhya saṃjṣakam ||57||
ravervārasya māhātmyaṃ yogasyaviṣṇu saṃjṣinaḥ |
vaidhṛtasyacamāhātmyaṃ vyatīpātasyavaitathā ||58||
etatsarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoktaṃ caiva nārada |
annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ tathaiva ca ||59||
śayyādānaṃ cagodānaṃ tathāvṛṣabham eva ca |
janmāṣṭamyāś ca māhātmyaṃ matsya māhātmyam eva ca ||60||
kūrma-māhātmyaṃ tat proktaṃ vārāhasya tathaiva ca |
māhātmyaṃ ca gavādīnāṃ dānānāṃ pravadāmy aham ||61||
prahlādamukhabhaktāyeyekecidbhuviviśrutāḥ |
tanmāhātmyaṃ tatovakṣyeśṛṇudevarṣisattama ||62||
jāgaremahimā caiva dīpadānekṛteca yat |
prahareṣu pṛthakpūjāphalaṃ devarṣisattama ||63||
parśurāmasyacākhyānaṃ reṇukāyāvadhas tathā |
brāhmaṇānāṃ bhūmidānaṃ rāmeṇaivaca yatkṛtam ||64||
rāmasyāśramajaṃ puṇyaṃ vadāmy ahamaśeṣataḥ |
narmadāyās tathākhyānaṃ puṇyapūjanayos tathā ||65||
dānaṃ vedapurāṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ nirūpaṇam |
hiraṇyadānapuṇyaṃ cabrahmāṇḍadānam eva ca ||66||
padmapurāṇadānaṃ cakhaṇḍānāṃ vyaktayas tathā |
prathamaṃ sṛṣṭikhaṇḍaṃ cadvitīyaṃ bhūmikhaṇḍakam ||67||
svargakhaṇḍaṃ tṛtīyaṃ caturyaṃ pātāla saṃjṣakam |
uttaraṃ paṣcamaṃ proktaṃ khaṇḍānyanukrameṇavai ||68||
etatpadmapurāṇaṃ tuvyāsenatumahātmanā |
kṛtaṃ lokahitārthāyabrāhmaṇaśreyasetathā ||69||
śūdrāṇāṃ puṇyajananaṃ tīvradāridryanāśanam |
mokṣadaṃ sukhadaṃ cāśukalyāṇapradamavyayam |
śrutvādānaṃ tathākuryādvidhinātatranārada ||70||

|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe maheśa-nārada-saṃvāde bīja-samuccayo nāma 
prathamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1||

(2)
dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ 

maheśa uvāca—
ekalakṣaṃ paṣcaviṃśat-sahasrā parvatās tathā |
teṣāṃ madhye mahatpuṇyaṃ badrikāśramam uttamam ||1||
naranārāyaṇodevoyatra tiṣṭhatinārada |
tasyasvarūpaṃ tejaśca vakṣyāmīhacasāṃ patam ||2||
himaparvataśṛṃ gecakṛṣṇākāratayādvija |
dvaupuruṣautatravartetenaranārāyaṇāvubhau ||3||
śvetaekastupuruṣaḥ kṛṣṇohyekatamaḥ punaḥ |
tenamārgeṇayeyānti himācalakṛtodyamāḥ ||4||
piṃ galaśvetavarṇaścajaṭādhārīmahāprabhuḥ |
kṛṣṇonārāyaṇohyeṣajagadādirmahāprabhuḥ ||5||
caturbāhurmahānśrīmānvyakto’vyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ |
uttarāyaṇemahāpūjājāyatetatrasuvrata ||6||
ṣaṇmāsādikaparyaṃ taṃ pūjānaivacajāyate |
himavyāptaṃ tadājātaṃ yāvadvaidakṣiṇaṃ bhavet ||7||
ataetādṛśodevonabhūtonabhaviṣyati |
tatradevāva santīhaṛṣīṇāṃ cāśramās tathā ||8||
agnihotrāṇivedāścadhvaniḥ praśrūyatesadā |
tasyavaidarśanaṃ kāryaṃ koṭihatyāvināśanam ||9||
alakanaṃ dāyatragaṅgātatrasnānaṃ samācaret |
kṛtvāsnānaṃ tuvaitatramahāpāpāt pramucyate ||10||
yatraviśveśvarodevastiṣṭhatyevana saṃśayaḥ |
ekasminnavasarebrahmansutapastaptavānaham ||11||
tadānārāyaṇodevobhaktānāṃ hikṛpākaraḥ |
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣādīśvarogaruḍadhvajaḥ |
suprasanno’bravīnmāṃ vaivaraṃ varayasuvrata ||12||
śrī-nārāyaṇa uvāca—
yadyadīpsasidevatvaṃ taṃ taṃ kāmandadāmy aham |
tvaṃ kailāsavibhuḥ sākṣādrudrovaiviśvapālakaḥ ||13||
rudra uvāca—
alaṃ gṛhṇāmibhodevasuprasannojanārdana |
dvauvaraumamadīyetāṃ yadidātuṃ tvamicchasi ||14||
tavabhaktiḥ sadaivāstubhaktarājo bhavāmy aham |
sarvelokābruvaṃ tvevamayaṃ bhaktaḥ sadaivahi ||15||
tavaprasādāddeveśamuktidātābhavāmy aham |
yelokāmāṃ bhajiṣyanti teṣāṃ dātāna saṃśayaḥ ||16||
viṣṇu-bhaktaitikhyātoloke caiva bhavāmy aham |
yasyāhaṃ varadātātutasyamuktirbhavetprabho ||17||
jaṭilobhasmaliptāṃ gohy ahaṃ vaitava saṃnidhau |
tavacaraṇaprasādenalokekhyāto bhavāmy aham ||18||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
nāradomāpati-saṃvāde badarī-nārāyaṇa-māhātmye
rudraprasādo nāma dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ 
||2||

(4)
caturtho’dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
krameṇavarddhamāno’saubālyabhāvesabālakaḥ |
nipatyamārutot saṃgesāgaraṃ pratidhāvati ||1||
ānīyacakresacapaṃ jarasthānkrīḍāparaḥkesariṇāṃ kiśorān |
siṃ hādinebhādiniyuddhamevaṃ yudhopayogīvatadīyavīryam ||2||
tasmādākāśamutpatyakhecarānpātayedbhuvi |
garjitairbhīṣayāmāsasvargaṃ hisahasāgaram ||3||

mannivāsocitaṃ sthānaṃ dehitātātivistṛtam ||7||
 saṃbuddhyavacanaṃ sūnoḥ sajagādamahārṇavaḥ |
putradāsyāmy ahaṃ rājyaṃ tavavābhuvidurlabham ||8||
anaṃ taraṃ daityaguruḥ samudraṃ bhārgavogataḥ |
tamāgataṃ vilokyābdhirvidhināsamapūjayat ||9||
athanadipatidatteprāptasauṃ daryaniryanmaṇimahasisatasminnāsanesanniviṣṭaḥ |
rucirarucisumeroḥ sundareśṛṃ gabhāgekamalajaivakānti ṃ kiṃ ciduccairjahāra ||10||
kṛtāṃ jalipuṭobhūtvāvyājahārārṇavaḥkavim |
diṣṭyātavātrāgamanaṃ vadakiṃ karavāṇy aham ||11||
tadādaityakulācāryaḥ prāhataṃ sāgaraṃ kaviḥ |
kiṃ tenajātujātenamāturyauvanahāriṇā ||12||
prarohatinayaḥ svasyavaṃ śasyāgredhvajoyathā |
tavātmajovikrameṇatrailokyaṃ bhokṣyatidhruvam ||13||

ajayaścāpyavadhyaśca tatrastho’yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||15||
evam ukto’rṇavaḥ prītyābhārgaveṇāthalīlayā |
apāsarpatsutaprītyai jalesthalamadarśayat ||16||
śatayojanavistīrṇamāyataṃ caśatatrayam |
deśaṃ jālandharaṃ puṇyaṃ tasyanāmnaivaviśrutam ||17||
daityavaryaṃ samāhūyamayaṃ provācasāgaraḥ |
puraṃ jālandharepīṭhekurujālandharāyavai ||18||
aṃ bhodhinaivamuktastucakreratnamayaṃ puram |
prākāragopuradvāraṃ sopānagṛhabhūmikam ||19||
yatrendranīla-sambaddha-prāsāda-tala-saṃsthitāḥ |
menire jaladodyogaṃ tāṇḍava-sthāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ ||20||
yatrapravālamāṇikyabhavanotthāmarīcayaḥ |
sevyaṃ teśakunaiścūtarucirāṃ kuraśaṃ kayā ||21||
yatrakāṃ canaharmyeṣu tviṣovahniṣukātarāḥ |
vilokyaprapalāyaṃ tedāvaśaṃ kāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ ||22||
yatrasphaṭikaśālotthaprabhā saṃmiśritādiśaḥ |
vibhānti mandarodbhrāṃ tāḥ saphenārṇava saṃnibhāḥ ||23||
yatramohaṃ svaharmyeṣu vibhātāloka saṃsthitāḥ |
cakrirelalanāḥ pūrṇasāṃ dhyacandropamānanāḥ ||24||
yatrendranīpakādaṃ bapavanodyānamoditāḥ |
cittaṃ viśaṃ tyonārīṇāṃ cakriremohanajvaram ||25||
yatralekhyagataṃ nṝṇāṃ vilokyasurataṃ janaḥ |
 saṃyātidviguṇaṃ nūnaṃ nijakāṃ tāratodyamaḥ ||26||
yatravātāyanoddhūtadhūpadhūmasyalekhayaḥ |
nabhobabhūvatadgaṅgākāliṃ dī saṃgamopamam ||27||

yatrāniśambhramabhrāṃ tāḥ sūryavāhāḥ prapīḍitāḥ |
viśrāmaṃ yānti madhyāhneprāsādaśirasisthitāḥ ||29||
yatrakutracaharmyeṣu bibhratyomālatīsrajaḥ |
rātrau saṃbhūtanakṣatrāivarejurvarāṃ ganāḥ ||30||
yatrahāṭakahiṃ dolaśṛṃ khalāgharṣaṇodbhavaḥ |
cakārasundarīṃ śabdaḥ sphuṭaṃ merubhuvobhuvam ||31||
sākaṃ saridbhiḥ putrasyośanasāsahasāgaraḥ |
tatrābhiṣekamakarodvāditrairnijagarjitaiḥ ||32||
yāḥ skaṃ dasyajagādatārakajayedevaḥ svayaṃ bhūḥ svayaṃ svaḥ sāmrājyamahotsave’picaśacīkāṃ tasyavācaspatiḥ ||
tābhiścitraviṃ riṃ civaktrasarasīhaṃ sībhirāśāsmahevāṇībhirvasudhā

mahāpadmasahasraṃ tusainyamātmodarodbhavam |
jālandharāyaputrāyadadaubhīmaṃ mahodadhiḥ ||34||

śastrāstravidyāanyāścavidhināabdhisūnave |

tatojālandharaṃ putramabhiṣicyārṇavoyayau |
svasthānaṃ divyadehenanadībhiḥ parivāritaḥ ||37||
dṛṣṭvājālandharodivyapuraṃ gopuramaṇḍitam |
vyacarat saha śukreṇa dvija saṃghaiḥ supūjitaḥ ||38||
etasminnaṃ taredaityāḥ pātālasthāmahābalāḥ |
prāptājālandharaṃ sarvekālanemipurogamāḥ ||39||

tasyaśuṃ bhāsuraṃ daityaṃ senāpatimakalpayan ||40||
balaṃ svavaśagaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvābhuvisthiraṃ jalam |
jālandharastadārājyaṃ pitṛdattaṃ cakārasaḥ ||41||
atrāṃ tare’psarāḥkācitsvarṇetyāsītpurādivi |
tasyāḥkrauṃ caprasādenavṛndānāmasutābhavat ||42||
dhātrāvibhava saṃyuktaṃ sauṃ daryaṃ yatkṛtaṃ pṛthak |
tattadekagatandraṣṭuṃ vṛndāgātraṃ vinirmitam ||43||
tāṃ vṛndāmaticārvaṃ gīṃ pramadāṃ janamohinīm |
svarṇājālandharasyārthedadauśukrāyayācate ||44||
śukra uvāca—
kaṃ darpasyajagannetraśastreṇāścaryakāriṇā |
rūpeṇānenaraṃ bhorudīrghāyuḥ sukhinībhava ||45||
nirmāyasvayamevavismitamanāḥ sauṃ daryasāreṇa yaṃ |
svavyāpārapariśramasyakalaśaṃ vedhāḥ samāropayat |
kaṃ darpaṃ puruṣaṃ striyovidadhateyasminnadṛṣṭesatidraṣṭavyāvadhi
rūpamāpnuhipatiṃ taṃ dīrghanetraṃ bhaṭam ||46||
upayemevivāhenagāṃ dharveṇārṇavātmajaḥ |
vṛndāntaudaṃ patījātaujanānaṃ dakaraunṛpa ||47||
caṃ calatvaṃ parityaktaṃ tayājālandharo’pihi |
vṛttenavṛddhakāryeṇacakamenaparastriyam ||48||
kadācitsasabhāsīnodṛṣṭvārāhuṃ śirohṛtam|
kasmātkāyārddhaśeṣo’yaṃ itipapracchabhārgavam ||49||
satasyakathayāmāsapūrvavṛttāṃ tamāditaḥ |
yathānirmathitodevaiḥkṣīrodo’mṛtakāraṇāt ||50||
tacchrutvāvismitovākyaṃ prāhajālandharo’suraḥ |
prasādasumukhorāhuṃ kāmarūpo bhavādhunā ||51||
itiśukrasyamaṃ treṇasindhusūnuḥ pratāpavān |
pitṛvyaṃ saṃsmaranvīravigrahaṃ tvakarotsuraiḥ ||52||

(5)
paṣcamo’dhyāyaḥ 

yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
kaḥ pitṛvyaḥ sindhusūnoḥ kiṃ vṛttaṃ tasyavigrahe |
yuyudhesakathaṃ daityastanmekathayanārada ||1||
nārada uvāca—
śṛṇutvaṃ nṛpaśārdūlapitṛvyaḥ kṣīrasāgaraḥ |

dūta uvāca—
jālandharasyadūto’haṃ āgataḥśakra saṃnidhau |

ititasyavacaḥ śrutvātadaivatuśacīpatim |

dauvārikomahendreṇapratyuktodūtamānaya |

durvāraṇodevasa##praviṣṭaḥ pravyalokayat |
hariṃ devais tuyastriṃśatkoṭibhiḥ pariveṣṭitam ||9||
svarṇasiṃ hāsanaṃ divyaṃ cāmarānilasevitam |
śacīpremarasotphullanayanābjasahasrakam ||10||
durvāraṇo’thadeveśaṃ vilokyaguruṇāsaha |
praṇanāmātmagarveṇaprahasannayanaśriyam ||11||
nirdiṣṭamāsanaṃ bhejedūtojālandharasyasaḥ |
kasyatvaṃ kenakāryeṇaprāptaḥ prāhetitaṃ hariḥ ||12||
dūtojālandharasyāhaṃ sajagādapurandaram |
sarājāsarvalokānāṃ tasyājṣāṃ śṛṇumanmukhāt ||13||
pitṛvyomamadugdhābdhistvayākasmādviloḍitaḥ |
mandarādrividhānenahṛtaṃ kośaṃ mahādhanam ||14||
śrīcandrāmṛtanāgāśvaṃ tanmaṇiṃ vidrumādikam |
dehisarvaṃ tathāsvargaṃ śīghraṃ tyajapurandara ||15||
satvaṃ madvacanāttūrṇaṃ kurusarvaṃ yathocitam |
taṃ kṣamāpayabhūpālayadijīvitum icchasi ||16||
athaprahasyamaghavāprāhadurvāraṇaṃ prati |
śṛṇudūtasamāsenasindhormathanakāraṇam ||17||
purāhimavataḥ sūnurmainākonāmameripuḥ |

rudrastrinetrajaṃ tejas tatonirmuktavānsvayam ||20||
devāścamumucuḥ sarvesakrodhaṃ tejasāṃ cayam |
atrāṃ taresmṛtaḥ prāptohareṇamadhusūdanaḥ ||21||
kiṃ karomītitenoktaḥśivaḥ prāhajanārdanam |
viṣṇojālandharaḥkasmānnahataḥ saṃgaretvayā ||22||
kathaṃ surānparityajyakṣīrābdhiṃ śayituṃ gataḥ ||23||
śrīviṣṇur uvāca—
yaditaṃ hanmideveśaśrīḥkathaṃ mamavallabhā |
tasmāt tvaṃ pārvatī-kānta jahi jālandharaṃ raṇe ||24||
tejastvaṃ krodhajaṃ muṃ cetyaktaḥśarveṇakeśavaḥ |
mumocavaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥtatsarvaṃ samavarddhata |
tejaḥ pravṛddhaṃ ta##ṣṭvāvyāpakaṃ prāhakeśavam ||25||
śaṅkara uvāca—
etenatejasāśīghraṃ mamāstraṃ kartumarhatha |
viśvakarmādayastaccaśrutvāśaṅkarabhāṣitam ||26||
nirīkṣyacatadā’nyo’nyaṃ kiṃ kurmaitiśaṃ kitāḥ |
dṛṣṭvātūṣṇīṃ sthitāṃ stāṃś cajṣātvātanmanasisthitam ||27||
tadāhabhagavānbrahmāanālokyaṃ hidaivataiḥ |
soḍhuṃ naśaktāstetejodhartuṃ kena ca śakyate ||28||
tataḥ prahasyabhagavānutpatyoparitejasaḥ |
vāmāṃ ghripāṣṇināśambhurnanartabhramarīcayam ||29||
tatodevāmahendrādyāstejasopariśaṅkaram |
nṛtyamānaṃ tadādṛṣṭvāmudāvādyānyavādayan ||30||
tadāprabhṛtinṛtyeṣu bhrāmyatebhramarīcayam |
athacakraṃ samutpannaṃ śambhornartanamardanāt ||31||
āralakṣatrayopetaṃ asthikoṭisamākulam |
śarvāṃ ghrikaṣaṇāttasyatejasonisṛtāḥkaṇāḥ ||32||
viśvakarmācatenāstraṃ vimānānicanir mame |
tatas tenirjjarābhītyādṛṣṭvācakraṃ sudarśanam ||33||
trāhitrāhītideveśaṃ pratyūcustesurānnṛpa |
pṛthvīkāṭhinyamādāyalohānāmapitejasām ||34||
yadviśvakarmaṇākośaṃ kṛtaṃ bhasmīkṛtaṃ ca tat |
sṛṣṭenatena ca kreṇadagdhaḥkālo’patatkṣitau ||35||
tatas tadbrahmaṇohastedadaucakraṃ sadhūrjaṭiḥ |
cakrārcirnicayaiḥkūrcaṃ dṛṣṭvādagdhamumāpatiḥ ||36||
hasitvābrahmaṇohastādgṛhītvāsatvaraṃ śivaḥ |
dadhaukakṣāpuṭecakraṃ nidhānaṃ nirdhanoyathā ||37||
tatonadṛśyatecakraṃ śivakakṣāpuṭesthitam |
mahāmūrkhasya yaddattaṃ dānaṃ tasyaphalaṃ yathā ||38||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ uttara-khaṇḍe 
yudhiṣṭhira-nārada-saṃvāde jālandharopākhyāne 
sarva-deva-tejomaya-cakrotpattir nāma
navamo’dhyāyaḥ ||9||

daśamo’dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
atrottaremayāgatvākathitaṃ sindhusūnave |

śrutvetthaṃ madvacorājaṃ s tataḥ papracchaso’suraḥ ||1||
jālandhara uvāca—
kimastiśūlinogeheratnajātaṃ mahāmune |
tanmamācakṣvasakalaṃ nāstiyuddhaṃ nirāmiṣam ||2||

bhūtirgātrevṛṣojīrṇaḥ phaṇinoṃ ‘gegaleviṣam |

suptāmaṃ taḥ purāddevīṃ prasthāpyacasakhīvṛtām ||17||

tatohastepragṛhyāmuṃ dūtaṃ naṃ dīmahābalaḥ ||18||
ānayāmāsadevānāṃ madhyeśambhumadarśayat |

ucchvāsocchvāsanirmuṃ catpṛdākugaṇasevitam |
sarva-devagaṇopetaṃ sevitaṃ gaṇakoṭibhiḥ ||21||

tataḥ kīrtimukhenāthasvāṃ gaṃ sarvaṃ cabhakṣitam ||40||

tatsāha santadādṛṣṭvābhaktiṃ kīrttimukhasyaca ||41||

svarbhānurapideveśaṃ punaḥ provācavismitaḥ ||44||
spṛśanti tvāṃ kathaṃ bhāvaṃ ḥ svādhīnaṃ yoginaṃ balāt |

 saṃgopayasiyogīndragaurīramyāṃ prayacchame ||47||
skaṃ dalaṃ bodarābhyāṃ tvaṃ putrābhyāṃ sahito’dhunā |
bhikṣāpātraṃ gṛhītvātubhramanityaṃ gṛhegṛhe ||48||
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tatrarāhurāheśvaraṃ prati |
bhagavānapitacchrutvānottaraṃ kiṃ cidabravīt ||49||

evamācaritabhraṣṭaṃ tvaṃ śikṣayitumarhasi |

 sampūjyapreṣayāmāsarāhuṃ naṃ dīgaṇāgraṇīḥ |
athajālandharaṃ gatvākathayāmāsavistarāt |

nārada uvāca—

bahavodaityarājānaḥśailamāruruhurdrutam ||48||

sainyakolāhalasteṣāṃ pūrayāmāsarodasī ||49||
nārada uvāca—
athaivamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvādaityasainyaṃ mahattadā |
atyuccesagireḥśṛṃ gesthāpyagaurīṃ sakhīvṛtām ||50||
bhagavāṃś cagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sannaddhairyuddhadurmadaiḥ |
triṃ śanmahābjasāhasraiḥ pramathānāṃ vṛtaḥśivaḥ ||51||
uvācanaṃ dinaṃ śambhurgaṇānāmadhipaṃ tvayā ||
prahartavyomahādaityovīrojālandharoraṇe ||52||
mahākālādibhiḥśūrairyāhitvaṃ parivāritaḥ |
tāvadājautvayātasmādyoddhavyamatipauruṣāt ||53||
yāvadyuddhenārijayomamavīrabhaviṣyati |
itiśambhorvacaḥśrutvāsacasārathimabravīt ||54||
kākatuṇḍarathaṃ me’dyasamānayamahāmate |
naṃ dinovacanaṃ śrutvāsopisyaṃ danamāharat ||55||
dvātriṃ śadaśva saṃyuktaṃ cakraṣoḍaśa saṃyutam |
ṣaṣṭidhvajasamopetaṃ dvātriṃ śadyojanāyutam ||56||
sarvaśastraiśca sampūrṇaṃ prāptaṃ ##grāmikaṃ ratham |
naṃ dinaścakrarakṣārthaṃ putrau##davināyakau ||57||
samādiṣṭauśaṅkareṇasannaddhautausvavāhanau |
gaṇaiḥ parivṛtonaṃ dīvāgbhiḥ sampūjyaṃ ceśvaram ||58||
naṃ dīrathaṃ samāruhyaniryayaudānavānprati |
virājatetasyamūrdhnichatraṃ dvādaśayojanam ||59||
yāvatsaniryayaunaṃ dītāvattedānavāḥ puraḥ |
śailoparisamārūḍhādānavāghoradarśanāḥ ||60||
gaṇānāmāyudhais tīkṣṇaiḥnihatāḥ patitābhuvi |
hanyamānāgaṇairdaityās tatyajurdūratogirim ||61||
tatodhūmasamaṃ tasmādavaruhyaśiloccayāt |
jaghnurdaityānśitaiḥśastrairgaṇārājanmahābalān ||62||
amarairācitaṃ dṛṣṭvārurudhurdaityasainikāḥ |
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ gaṇānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ||63||
śaravarṣamathātyugraṃ dānavānāṃ divaukasām |
tataḥ samastānmātaṃ gāṣjaghnuḥśikhimukhāraṇe ||64||
rathānhayānpadātīṃ ścakākatuṇḍāmahābalāḥ |
hatānāṃ daitya saṃghāṃ nāṃ saṃgarebhṛśamāyinām ||65||
śirobhirgaganaṃ vyāptaṃ prahasadbhirbhayāvahaiḥ |
muktakeśāruṇamukhairbhīmadaṃ ṣṭrāvilocanaiḥ ||66||
siṃ haiḥkabandhajaṃ ghorukaṭipṛṣṭhanikṛṃ tanaiḥ |
citāsarvatravasudhākabandhairudhirāruṇaiḥ ||67||
tatovirāvaḥ sumahānbabhūvadaityeśvarāṇāṃ dhvajinīṣudhāvatām |
śambhor gaṇaiḥ pātita-sainikānāṃ 
yathārṇavānāṃ nadatāṃ yuga-kṣaye ||68||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcāśat-sahasra saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe 
nārada-yudhiṣṭhira-saṃvāde jālandharopākhyāne 
daitya-sainya-parājayo nāma 
ekādaśo’dhyāyaḥ 
||11||

(12)
dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
daitya-sainyaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvāgaṇairnaṃ dipurogamaiḥ |
kruddhāḥśuṃ bhādayodaityāḥ samājagmurgaṇānprati ||1||
tataḥśuṃ bhomahādaityonaṃ dinaṃ pratyayudhyata |
mahākālaṃ niśuṃ bho’thakālolokeśvaraṃ raṇe ||2||
puṣpadaṃ taṃ śailaromāmālyavaṃ taṃ mahābalaḥ |
kolāhaloraṇerājanprāptomāyābalena ca ||3||
caṇḍaṃ bhayānakonāmarāhuḥ skaṃ damadhāvata |
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ sarparomācaghargharomadanaṃ tathā ||4||
śubhaṃ ketumukhohaṃ tuṃ yayaujaṃ bhovināyakam |
hā sampātālaketuścabhṛṃ gīśaṃ romakaṇṭakaḥ ||5||
yuyudhuḥkoṭiśorudragaṇadaityāḥ parasparam |
paśyatorubhayos tatrasvāminorititeyudhi ||6||
dṛḍhaprahāriṇojaghnurgaṇādaityāḥśarairatha |
naṃ dīmumocatānbāṇānmahāsāroyathānage ||7||

yathāparṇacayair vātomandarasyevakaṃ daram ||8||
śuṃ bho’thakārmukaṃ tyaktvārathāttaṃ pratyadhāvata |
utpāṭyacagiriṃ tenajaghānahṛdinaṃ dinaḥ ||9||
naṃ dinohṛdayaṃ bhittvācūrṇayitvārathaṃ raṇe |
papātabhūmausagirirvajraṃ prāpyagiriṃ yathā ||10||
mūrcchāṃ prāpyakṣaṇāt saṃjṣāṃ vegavānsapalāyitaḥ |
mahākāloniśuṃ bhenamudgareṇahatohṛdi ||11||
āgatyadaityaṃ gadayājaghānamukuṭopari |
tatprahāramaciṃ tyāthaniśuṃ bho’pimahābalaḥ ||12||
taṃ gṛhītvācaraṇayormahākālaṃ mahābalaḥ |
bhrāmayitvākaratalāccikṣepacananādaca ||13||
satadvaktrānilaṃ pītvānanādarudhirāruṇaḥ |
puṣpadaṃ taḥśailaromṇācāhatomuṣṭināmukhe ||14||
gadayāśailaromāṇaṃ hatvābhūmaunyapātayat |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāpatitaṃ bhūmaugiriketurmahābalaḥ ||15||
puṣpadaṃ taṃ mahābhīmaṃ mudgareṇavyapothayat |
puṣpaṃ daṃ to’thakhaṅgenagiriketoḥśiro’chinat ||16||
gṛhītvācarmakhaṅgaṃ cagiriketoradhāvata |
śirastaṃ prāhakiṃ yāsimāṃ tyaktvāsamarārthinam ||17||
śirohīnecakāye’sminkiṃ tudhāvannalajjase |
ity ukteśirasātenakabandhenatupādayoḥ ||18||
vidhṛtaḥ puṣpadaṃ taścakukṣautīkṣṇāsinācchit |
niścakrāmāsuraḥkukṣeḥśataśīrṣomahābalaḥ ||19||
dviśatākṣisamāyuktaḥśatadvayabhujākulaḥ |
bhramattasyaśirorājankabandhopāṃ tamāgamat ||20||
tacchiraḥ prāptamālokyapuṣpadaṃ to’sinācchinat |
tatobhūkaṃ panonāmajvarodaityobhayāvahaḥ ||21||
puṣpaṃ daṃ tastadātatradvābhyāṃ rājanvimarditaḥ |
jvareṇatena ca kliṣṭoduḥ sahenātiveginā ||22||
tyaktvāśivagaṇaḥ saṃkhyaṃ kaṃ pamānogiriṃ yayau |
kolāhalomahādhanvīmālyavaṃ taṃ śarais tribhiḥ ||23||
vivyādhaskaṃ dhayorbhālemālyavāṃś ca tato’suram |
bāṇāhatomālyavatāśastrairnānāvidhaiḥśitaiḥ ||24||
kolāhalaḥ prahṛtavāndarśayannātmalāghavam |
so’pihetivyathāṃ tyaktvāmālyavāṃś cagaṇāgraṇīḥ ||25||
giriṃ gṛhītvātenājaukolāhalamathāhanat |
niścakrāmajvarastasmājjvalanonāmabhīṣaṇaḥ ||26||
triśīrṣonavahastaścanavapādo’tipiṃ galaḥ |
sajvaromohayāmāsamālyavaṃ taṃ svatejasā ||27||
mālyavānsamaraṃ tyaktvāparā##togiriṃ yayau |
caṇḍirbhayānakenājaupāśenahṛdayehataḥ ||28||
hayovinirgatastasmātkṣiptaḥ so’picasāgare |
kārttike yo raṇe rāhuṃ śitair bāṇaiḥ samāhanat ||29||
ācchādyaśarajālaiścaśīghraṃ śaktiṃ mumocaha |
āpataṃ tīṃ mahāśaktiṃ jvalaṃ tīmivatejasā ||30||
dṛṣṭvārāhuḥkhamutpatyakarābhyāṃ jagṛhedrutam |
satāṃ śaktiṃ gṛhītvātuvinadyoccaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||31||
svarbhānuḥśirasonopitasyaśaktyā jaghānatam |
vakṣasyabhihateśaktyā taddehānnirgatāsarit ||32||
tayā samplāvitaḥ putromahādevasya saṃyuge |
kathaṃ citsānadīruddhāsamaṃ pūrogiriṃ yayau ||33||
śrutvārṇavajojvarataḥ kaṭakakadaṃ basyakarkaśaṃ virutam |
susvaravacanavidagdhaṃ tamapicakokilāpatiṃ nasasmāra ||34||
śaraiḥkiraṃ taṃ dahanamasinābarbaro’vadhīt |
kūṣmāṇḍonihatomūrdhnisarparomṇāthamuṣṭinā ||35||
pātālaketunāhāsomudgareṇasamāhataḥ |
tasyadehādviniṣkramyahastīmudgaramābhunak ||36||
śuṇḍāyāṃ muṣṭighātenahataḥ pātālaketunā |
āyudhairjarjaraṃ cakrebhṛṃ gīśaṃ romakaṇṭakaḥ ||37||
bhṛṃ gīśo’piraṇādbhītastvarannevagiriṃ yayau |
sahasādhūmravarṇaścaśubhraḥketumukhe’patat ||38||
gaṇaṃ gilitavāndaityomahākāyomahānanaḥ |
hāhākāromahānāsīdgiliteketunāraṇe ||39||
jṛṃ bhasyaniśitair vāṇaiiśchannāṃ go’thavināyakaḥ |
śuṇḍādaṇḍaṃ paraśunātasyacicchedadanti naḥ ||40||
jṛṃ bhāsurojaghānāthaśaktyā laṃ bodarodaram |
mūṣako’piśarair bhinnaḥ praviveśaguhāmukham ||41||
vināyakaḥ prahārārttovilalāpākuloraṇe |
hāmātastātahābhrātarhāmūṣakamamapriya ||42||
gaṇeśakraṃ ditaṃ śrutvābhagavatyātayātadā |
sametyakūṭādanyasmātpārvatyoktaḥśivastadā ||43||
heraṃ bovadhyatedaityaiḥ skaṃ do’pivinipātitaḥ |
śivakiṃ krīḍaseśailerakṣaputraugaṇānapi ||44||
sadāśūlādiśastrāṇāṃ dhṛtānāmadyavaikṣaṇaḥ |
athagauryāvacaḥśrutvāvīrabhadraṃ śivo’bravīt ||45||
vṛṣaḥ sajjīyatāṃ śīghramity uktesatadākarot |
babandhamukuṭaṃ tasyaśṛṃ gayorbhāskaraprabham ||46||
kaṇṭheghaṇṭāśataṃ baddhvākarṇayordarpaṇaudhṛtau |
skaṃ dhecakiṃ kiṇījālaṃ caraṇenūpuraṃ mahat ||47||
pucchecāmarasāhasraṃ tasyapāśāṣṭakaṃ mukhe |
kalyāṇīcatadādevīśarvapārśvevyasthitā ||48||
pāśāṣṭakena saṃyuktātatrakhaṅgadharāṃ bikā |
nyastānisarvaśastrāṇisavṛṣaḥ sajjitobabhau ||49||
pārvatyābhūṣitaḥ so’thanijayāghaṇṭamālayā |
kṛtaṃ catilakaṃ devyāproktaḥ satkṛtipūrvakam ||50||
harastvayānamoktavyovṛṣendraraṇa saṃkaṭe |
āgantavyamarīnjitvāśambhunāsaha saṃgare ||51||
iti śrutvāvacodevyāharovṛṣamathāruhat |
dhṛtvāyudhasahasraṃ tunijālaṃ kārabhūṣitaḥ |
raṇaṃ gacchāmitāṃ prāhapārvatīṃ pratisādaram ||52||
īśvara uvāca—
tvanti ṣṭhasisvarūpāṇiekākinyapisaspṛhā |
bhāminīdurabhiprāyādānavāhisamāgatāḥ ||53||
tasmāttvayātmanaivātmārakṣaṇīyovarānane |
ity uktvāvṛṣabhārūḍhoyayaurudroraṇāṃ gaṇam ||54||
triṃ śanmahābjasāhasraiḥ pramathānāṃ vṛtaḥśivaḥ |
vīrabhadrorathenāśusiṃ hayuktenasatvaraḥ ||55||
vāmapārśvaṃ maheśasyaśūrorakṣatipārthiva |
maṇibhadro’śvayuktenarathenaparavīrahā ||56||
dakṣiṇaṃ dhūrjaṭeḥ pārśvaṃ saṃrakṣatidhanurddharaḥ |
tuṃ gāduttīryaśailendrādraṇaṃ prāptogaṇaiḥ saha ||57||
dṛṣṭvājagarjustedaityāmaheśānaṃ vṛṣasthitaṃ |
tato mahānninādo’bhūddaityapramathasenayoḥ ||58||
tayorabhūnmithorājan sampramardo’thadāruṇaḥ |
tatonaṃ dīmahākālaḥkālaskaṃ daumahābalaḥ ||59||
mālyavānpuṣpadaṃ taścavṛṣalīsvarṇadanti kaḥ |
caṇḍīśomadana##ḍaḥkūṣmāṇḍoguptalomakaḥ ||60||
yeyepūrvaṃ raṇebhagnāḥ prāptāsteraṇa saṃkaṭam |
śivasyapuratodaityāyuyudhustemahābalāḥ ||61||
gaṇadānavayodhānāṃ saṃgrāmo’bhūdbhayāvahaḥ |
tatogaṇānāṃ vidrāvyasainyaṃ tecamahābalāḥ ||62||
raṇe saṃbeṣṭayāmāsuḥśaraughaiḥ sarvataḥ śivam |
śūlaiḥkuṃ tairgadābhiścamudgaraiḥ parighair api ||63||
indriyāṇiyathātmānaṃ viṣayaiḥ paṣcapaṣcabhiḥ |
jaghānātharaṇedaityāṣchaṃ bhurbāṇaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ |
yathāśumāghaḥ pāpānihanti snānenatatkṣaṇāt ||64||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe 
nārada-yudhiṣṭhira-samvāde jālandharopākhyāne 
śrī-mahā-deva-raṇam āgamanaṃ nāma
dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ

(13)
trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
tatojālandharaḥśrutvādaityakolāhalaṃ raṇe |
ājagāmarathārūḍhoyatradevaḥ sadāśivaḥ ||1||
sārathiṃ khaṅgaromāṇaṃ kopātsatvaramabravīt |
 sampreṣayarathaṃ śīghraṃ sahasrahayayojitam ||2||
hanmitaṃ tāpa saṃśauryājjaṭābhasmāsthibhūṣitam |
vṛṣārūḍhasyakāśaktiḥ paṅgoryuddhemayāsaha ||3||
nārada uvāca—
ity uktvākhaṅgaromāṇamābhāṣyaca tathoddhataḥ |
gṛhītvākārmukaṃ ghoraṃ rathenādhāvatadrutam ||4||
taṃ rurodhatadāyāṃ taṃ vīrabhadraḥśitaiḥśaraiḥ |
nirucchvāsīkṛtenāpisakāyenaśarair vṛtaḥ ||5||
devairyadyapitulyo’bhūdbhūteśasyaparigrahaḥ |
tathāpikiṃ kapālānitulāṃ yānti kalānidheḥ ||6||
vivyādha maṇibhadro’pi śaraiḥ sāgara-nandanam |
pāśena maṇibhadraṃ tu hatvovāceśvaraṃ vacaḥ ||7||
ehiyoddhuṃ mahādevaśastrābhyāso’stiteyadi |
tvaṃ māṃ praharanatvāhamādauhanmijaṭādharam ||8||
itibruvaṃ taṃ taṃ garvādvīrabhadro’thasāyakaiḥ |
pūrayāmāsa saṃkruddhoyathāpadmaṃ raviḥkaraiḥ ||9||
maṇibhadro’thagadayāsainyaṃ tasyasamāhanat |
rathoparirathaṃ vīraturagaṃ turagopari ||10||
gajoparigajaṃ hatvāpātayāmāsabhūtale |
raktapaṃ kāruṇābhūmiḥ saṃjātādurgamākṣaṇāt ||11||
śailāccagaṇamukhyāścadānavāṣjaghnurāhave |
patanti dānavāḥśūrāgataprāṇāmahītale ||12||
ruṇḍadordaṇḍamuṇḍaiścakaripṛṣṭhakarorubhiḥ |
patanti dānavāḥśūrāpūritāvasudhānṛpa ||13||

evaṃ vidhaṃ raṇedṛṣṭvāharamatyaṃ tadurjayam |
bhuvaneca tathānyānidṛṣṭavāṃ ṃ llakṣaṇānisaḥ ||14||
tejo’nyadevanakṣatraśaśāṃ kasakalādiṣu |
uddhāṭitajagatkośamanyadevaravermahaḥ ||15||
bhagnaḥ punaścinti tavāṃ s tatojālandharonṛpa |
nadṛṣṭāsāmayāgaurīyāṃ māmāhātināradaḥ ||16||
sāṃ prataṃ śāśvatesthānekathandrakṣyāmyumāṃ sthitām |
tāṃ hidraṣṭuṃ vrajāmyādaupaścādyotsyāmiśambhunā ||17||
ciṃ tayitvetimanasādaityaṃ prāhārṇavātmajaḥ |
śuṃ bhaṃ caṇḍajayevīramamatulyaparākrama ||18||
dhṛtvāmatsadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ kartumarhasi |
tavayuddhasyabhāro’yaṃ śibirasyabalasyaca ||19||
ahaṃ yāsyāmitāndraṣṭuṃ gaurīṃ maccittahāriṇīm |
ity uktvāthadadautasmaisvāṃ gāduttāryamaṇḍanam ||20||
varmaśastrādikaṃ datvārathaṃ sārathi saṃyutam |
durvāraṇenasahitaḥ sainyaṃ muktvodadheḥ sutaḥ ||21||
alakṣitas tatogatvāguhāṃ guptāṃ tupārthiva |
mānasottaraśailasyahararūpaṃ dadhārasaḥ ||22||
dhṛtvādurvāraṇerūpaṃ naṃ dinaḥ sadṛśaṃ tathā |
athāruruhatuḥśailaṃ chadmaśaṅkaranaṃ dinau ||23||
yatrāstiśikharegaurīsakhibhiḥ sahitānṛpa |
tamāyāṃ taṃ śarair bhinnaṃ skaṃ dhamālambyanaṃ dinaḥ ||24||
raktāktamaṃ baraṃ dṛṣṭvābhavānīvismitābhavat |
sakhyastasyājayādyāstāḥjagmustaṃ saṃbhramānvitāḥ ||25||
śaṅkarasyānti kaṃ gatvāpapracchustaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ |
kiṃ jātaṃ tavadeveśakenatvaṃ saṃgarejitaḥ ||26||
saśalyastvaṃ kathaṃ nātha saṃsārīvaprarodiṣi |
ity uktaḥ pradadautābhyobhūṣaṇānipṛthakpṛthak ||27||
uttāryaśanakairaṃ gāt vāsukiprabhṛtīnica |
gaṇeśaskaṃ daśirasīcchinnekukṣauvilokyaca ||28||
hāskaṃ dahāgaṇeśetihārudretyaṃ bikārudat |
tasyāḥ sakhyas tataḥ sarvāruruduḥśokakarśitāḥ ||29||
atrābravījjayāṃ naṃ dītvamenaṃ paripālaya |
maṇibhadrovīrabhadraḥ puṣpadaṃ taścavīryavān ||30||
daṃ bhanodhūmatimiraḥ kūṣmāṇḍādyāraṇehatāḥ |
caṇḍībhṛṃ gīkirīṭiścamahākālaścaśṛṃ khalī ||31||
caṇḍīśoguptanetraścakālādyāścahatāraṇe |
vināyakasyaskaṃ dasyaśirasībhramatāmayā ||32||
dṛṣṭemahāraṇedeviity uktvāthapurokṣipat |
tacchrutvānaṃ dinovākyaṃ śirasīgṛhyaputrayoḥ ||33||
pārvatīvilalāpoccaiḥ putraputretijalpatī |
tārakārekathaṃ yuddhehatastvaṃ sindhusūnunā ||34||
tvaṃ hitrivāsarodevaiḥ senāpatyo’bhiṣecitaḥ |
tadātvayākathaṃ vīratārakākhyonipātitaḥ ||35||
nīlakaṇṭhenakiṃ tyaktoyatastvaṃ patitobhuvi |
snuṣāmukhaṃ nadṛṣṭaṃ camayāputrāvabhāgyayā ||36||
nabhogāvatsatebhuktā saṃsārasyāpiyebhavan |
tātaheraṃ bavighneśalaṃ bodaragajānana ||37||
raṇāṃ gaṇekenaputrasiddhaiḥ pūjyonipātitaḥ |
vāhano’saukutovatsamūṣakaḥkenahiṃ sitaḥ ||38||
evaṃ vilapatīgaurīśivaṃ prāhasuduḥkhitam |
sākṣādrudro’sideveśaharastvaṃ mābhayaṃ kuru ||39||
vṛṣabhaḥkvagatodevahatojālandhareṇavai |
śarajarjaradehasyakiṃ karomipriyaṃ tava ||40||
tataḥśrutvāvacodevyāniśvasyovācaśaṅkaraḥ |
dīrghaṃ vinihatauputrauvṛthāśocasikiṃ priye ||41||
adhunāteṃ ga saṃgenadevimāṃ trātumarhasi |
śaṅkarasyavacaḥśrutvā’samayocitamāturam |
pratyuvācāṃ bikādevaṃ babhāṣenocitaṃ vacaḥ ||42||
mahāviṣādepatitebhaye ca kṛtesamādhauvamanemahājvare |
śrāddheprayāṇeguruvṛddhasannidhauratiṃ budhāḥśaṅkaravarjayanti ||43||
kathaṃ māṃ duḥkhaduḥkhārtāṃ putraśokenapīḍitām |
mlānāṃ bāṣpaparimlānāṃ samprārthayasicāturām ||44||
bhavānyāitivākyāniśrutvāmāyāmaheśvaraḥ |
uvācasvārthamuddiśyagauryārūpeṇamohitaḥ ||45||
puruṣasyārtiyuktasyanayacchanti ratiṃ striyaḥ |
tathaivarauraveghorepatiṣyatina saṃśayaḥ ||46||
gaṇaśūnyaḥ putraśūnyodhīśūnyo’haṃ varānane |
sāmprataṃ gṛhya-śūnyo’haṃ sarva-śūnyo’smi bhāmini ||47||
sujīvitaṃ vihīno’haṃ tvāṃ paṣṭum iha cāgataḥ |
svaṃ gṛhaṃ tupraviśyāśutyajāmiprakṛtiṃ svakām ||48||
uttiṣṭhanaṃ din saṃyāvastīrthebhavapuraḥ saraḥ |
tvaṃ yāhisvecchayākāṃ teprakṛtiṃ svāṃ parityaja ||49||
itimāyāmaheśasyavacaḥśrutvāṃ bikātataḥ |
dīrghaṃ dadhyomahāśvā saṃśokena ca jaḍīkṛtā ||50||
tasyaivaṃ paramekṣobhekiṃ cinnovācasākṣaṇam |
yayā saṃmohitaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃ gamam ||
saiva saṃmohitātenanajāneduḥkhamātmanaḥ ||51||

nāśvaṃ prāpustadāte vai khanyamānemahārṇave ||37||
tatraikamādipuruṣaṃ dadṛśustetvarānvitāḥ |
tamādipuruṣaṃ devaṃ kapilaṃ jagatāṃ prabhum ||38||
tasyacakṣuḥ samutpannavahnināpratibudhyataḥ |
dagdhāḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇicatvāraste’vaśeṣitāḥ ||39||
hṛṣīketuḥ suketuśca tathādharmarathoparaḥ |
śūraḥ paṣcajanaś caiva tasyavaṃ śakarādvija ||40||
prādāccatasmaibhagavānhariḥ paṣcavarānsvayam |
vaṃ śaṃ mokṣaṃ sukīrtiṣcasamudraṃ tanayaṃ vibhuḥ ||41||
sāgaratvaṃ calebhethakarmaṇātenatasyavai |
tam āśvamedhikaṃ so’śvaṃ samudrād upalabdhavān |
ājahārāśvamedhānāṃ śataṃ sa ca mahāyaśāḥ ||42||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
uttara-khaṇḍe viṃśo’dhyāyaḥ 
||20||

mahādeva uvāca—
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ jāgarasya ca |
yac chrutvā muktim āpnoti mahā-pāpīna saṃśayaḥ ||1||
nārada uvāca—
aho viśveśvaro viṣṇuḥ pavitrī-karaṇaḥ sadā |
tasyopavāsa-māhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ hi tvan-mukhāc chiva ||2||
tathāpi śrotum icchāmi māhātmyaṃ jāgarasya tu | 
kīdṛk jāgara-māhātmyaṃ rātro bhaktis tu kīdṛśī ||3||
prahareṣu ca yā pūjā vada viśveśvara prabho |
tvaṃ lokeṣu sadā pūjyas tvaṃ hi devo janārdanaḥ |
tvaṃ hi viśveśvaro devo yato bhaktir janārdane ||4||
sarveṣāṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ ca śreṣṭha umāpatiḥ |
loke’smin sarvadā bhaktyā tavākhyā vartate sadā ||5||
ato yena prakāreṇa lokānāṃ muktir eva ca |
viśveśvara vada tvaṃ tu māhātmyaṃ jāgarasya tu ||6||
mahādeva uvāca—
ekādaśyāṃ jano viṣṇuṃ rātrau sampūjya bhaktitaḥ |
kuryāj jāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ purato vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha ||7||
gītaṃ vādyaṃ tathā nṛtyaṃ purāṇa-paṭhanaṃ tathā |
dhūpaṃ dīpaJca naivedyaṃ puṣpaṅgandhānulepanam ||8||
phalam arghaṃ tathā śraddhā dānam indriya-saṃyamam |
satyānvitaṃ ca viprendra vaco-yuktaṃ kriyānvitam ||9||
vinidraṃ ca mudā yukto yaḥ karoti naraḥ sadā |
sarva-pāpa-vinirmukto jāyate viṣṇu-vallabhaḥ ||10||
rātrau jāgaraṇe prāpte nidrāṃ kurvanti vaiṣṇavāḥ |
hāritaṃ copavāsaṃ tair vrataṃ vai viṣṇu-saṃjṣakam ||11||
ye kurvanti narāḥ prājṣa jāgare viṣṇu-saṃjṣake |
jāgaraṃ kṛṣṇa-bhāvena na svapanti kadācana ||12||
kṛṣṇasya nāma manasā vadanti ca punaḥ punaḥ |
te tu dhanyatamā jṣeyā asyāṃ rātrau viśeṣataḥ ||13||

tat phalaṃ koṭi-guṇitaṃ tasya saṅkhyā na vidyate ||15||
nartanaṃ kurute yas tu keśavāgre narottamaḥ |
na phalaṃ hīyate tasya ājanma-maraṇāntikam ||16||
sāścaryaṃ caiva sotsāhaṃ pāpālāpādi-varjitam |
pradakṣiṇa-samāyuktaṃ namaskāra-puraḥsaram ||17||

yāmeyā me mahābhāga kuryād ārātrikaṃ hareḥ ||18||

jāgaraṃ vāsare viṣṇor līyate paramātmani ||20||
dhanavān vitta-śāṭhye na yaḥ karoti prajāgaram |

viṣṇu-jāgaraṇe prāpte upahāsaṃ karoti yaḥ |

upahāsa-paraḥ prāptaḥ sa vai cāṇḍāla ucyate ||23||

dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣāṇāṃ prāpnoti padam avyayam ||24||
veda-śāstra-rato nityaṃ nityaṃ vai yajṣa-yājakaḥ |
rātrau jāgaraṇe prāpte nindāṃ kurvan vrajaty adhaḥ ||25||
mama pūjāṃ prakurvāṇo viṣṇu-nindāsu tat-paraḥ |
ekaviṃśat-kulenaiva narakaṃ pratipadyate ||26||
(viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ śivo viṣṇur eka-mūrtir dvidhā sthitāḥ)| 
tasmāt sarva-prakāreṇa naiva nindāṃ prakārayet 
daṣṭāḥ kali-bhujaṅgena svapanti madhuhāhani ||27||

prāptā ekādaśī yeṣāṃ kalau jāgaraṇaṃ vinā ||28||
te vinaṣṭā na sandeho yasmāj jīvitam adhruvam |

abhāve vācakasyātha gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ tu kārayet ||30||

aśvamedha-sahasrasya vājapeyā yutasya ca ||31||
puṇyaṃ koṭi-guṇaṃ vatsa viṣṇor jāgaraṇe kṛte |
pitṛ-pakṣe mātṛ-pakṣe bhāryā pakṣe tu vāḍava ||32||
kulānuddharatecaitānkṛtvājāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ |
upoṣaṇadineviddhejāgaraṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ ||33||
vṛthādānādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaghneṣu kṛtaṃ yathā |
upoṣaṇadineviddheprārabdhejāgaresthitim ||34||
vihāya sthānaṃ tad viṣṇuḥ śāpaṃ dattvā pragacchati |
aviddhevāsareviṣṇor ye kurvanti prajāgaram ||35||
teṣāṃ madhye tu tuṣṭaḥ san nṛtyaṃ tu kurute hariḥ |
yāvad-dināni kurute jāgaraṃ keśavāgrataḥ ||36||
yugāni tāni tāvanti viṣṇu-loke mahīyate |
yāvad-dināni vasate vinā jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||37||
tāvadvarṣa-sahasrāṇi rauravānnanivartate |
ekadaśyāṃ śayānastuvinājāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ ||38||
mūkavattiṣṭhateyovaigānaṃ pāṭhaṃ navācaret |
saptajanmānimūkatvaṃ jāyate’jāgarehareḥ ||39||
yonanṛtyatimūḍhātmāpuratojāgarehareḥ |
paṅgutvaṃ tasya jānīyāt sapta-janmāni vāḍava ||40||
yaḥ punaḥ kurute gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ |
brāhmaṃ padaṃ madīyaṃ ca satyaṃ vai tasya vaiṣṇavam ||41||
yaḥ prabodhayate lokān viṣṇor jāgaraṇe rataḥ |
vasec ciraṃ tu vaikuṇṭhe pitṛbhiḥ saha vaiṣṇavaḥ ||42||
matiṃ prayacchate yas tu harer jāgaraṇaṃ prati |
ṣaṣṭi-varṣa-sahasrāṇi śvetadvīpe vasen naraḥ ||43||
yat kiṃcit kriyate pāpaṃ koṭi-janmani mānavaiḥ |
śrī-kṛṣṇa-jāgare sarvaṃ rātrau naśyati vāḍava ||44||
śālagrāma-śilāgre ye kurvanti prati jāgaram |
yāme yāme phalaṃ proktaṃ koṭy-aindava-samudbhavam ||45||
samprāpte vāsare viṣṇor ye na kurvanti jāgaram |
vṛthā syāt tat-kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca nindayā ||46||
kāmārthau sampadaḥ putrāḥ kīrtir lokāś ca śāśvatāḥ |
yajṣāyutair na labhyante dvādaśī-jāgaraṃ vinā ||47||
matir na jāyate yasya dvādaśyāṃ jāgaraṃ prati |
nahitasyādhikāro’sti pūjane keśavasya hi ||48||
yāvat padāni calati keśavāyatanaṃ prati |
aśvamedha-samāni syuḥ jāgarārthaṃ pragacchataḥ ||49||
pādayoḥ patitaṃ yāvad dharaṇyāṃ pāṃśu gacchatām |
tāvad varṣa-sahasrāṇi jāgaro vasate divi ||50||
tasmād gṛhāt pragantavyaṃ jāgare keśavālaye |
kalaumalavināśāyadvādaśīdvādaśīṣuca ||51||
parāpavāda saṃyuktaṃ manaḥ prāsādavarjitam |
śāstrahīnamagāṃ dharvaṃ tathādīpavivarjitam ||52||
śaktyopacārarahitamudāsīnaṃ sanindanam |
kaliyuktaṃ viśeṣeṇajāgaraṃ navadhāmatam ||53||
saśāstraṃ jāgaraṃ yaccanṛtyagāṃ dharva saṃyutam |
savādyaṃ tālā saṃyuktaṃ sadīpaṃ madhubhiryutam ||54||
uccārais tusamāyuktaṃ yathoktairbhakti-bhāvitaiḥ |
prasannaṃ tuṣṭijananaṃ saṃmūḍhaṃ lokaraṃ janam ||55||
guṇairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ jāgaraṃ mādhavapriyam |
kartavyaṃ tatprayatnena pakṣayoḥśuklakṛṣṇayoḥ ||56||
kiṃ vratairbahubhiścīrṇais tīrthavāsenatasyakim |
dvādaśīvāsare prāpte nakuryājjāgaraṃ hareḥ ||57||
pravāsenatyajedyas tu pathisvinno’pivāḍava |
jāgaraṃ vāsudevasya dvādaśyāṃ tu sa me priyaḥ ||58||
mad-bhakto na hareḥ kuryāj jāgaraṃ pāpa-mohitaḥ |
vyarthaṃ mat-pūjanaṃ tasya mat-pūjyaṃ yo na pūjayet ||59||
na śaivo na ca sauro’sau na śākto gaṇa-sevakaḥ |
yo bhuṅkte vāsare viṣṇor jṣeyaḥ paśv-adhiko hi saḥ ||60||
vipriyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena duṣṭenaiva  ca pāpinā |
mad-bhakti-balam āśritya yo bhuṅkte vai harer dine ||61||
sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ veṣṭitaṃ pāpa-koṭibhiḥ |
mucyante vāsareviṣṇor ye kurvanti prajāgaram ||62||
kūrparaṃ yamadūtānāṃ dattaṃ tenayamasyaca |
kṛtvājāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇor aviddhaṃ dvādaśīvratam ||63||
svargāpekṣāmuni-śreṣṭhamuktātenaiva  saṃśayaḥ |
vāṣchitaṃ nārakaṃ saukhyaṃ viddhaṃ kṛtvāharerdinam ||64||
nihatāḥ pitarastenadevānāṃ vaivadhaḥkṛtaḥ |
dattaṃ rājyaṃ tudaityānāṃ kṛtvāviddhaṃ harerdinam ||65||
yonṛtyatiprahṛṣṭātmākṛtvāvaikaratāḍanam |
gītaṃ kurvanmukhenāpidarśayankautukānbahūn ||66||
puratovāsudevasyarātrau jāgaraṇesthitaḥ |
paṭhankṛṣṇacaritrāṇiraṃ jayanvaiṣṇavāngaṇān ||67||
mukhenakurute vādyaṃ samprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ |
darśayanvividhānbhṛtyānsvecchālāpānprakārayan ||68||
bhāvairetairnaroyas tu kurute jāgarehareḥ |
nimiṣenimiṣepuṇyaṃ tīrthakoṭiphalaṃ smṛtam ||69||
anudvignamanāyas tu dhūpanīrājanaṃ hareḥ |
kurute jāgarerātrausaptadvīpādhipo bhavet ||70||
yānikānicapāpānibrahmahatyāsamānica |
kṛṣṇāhajāgarāttānivilayaṃ yānti khaṇḍaśaḥ ||71||
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvesamāptavaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekatodeva-devasyajāgaraḥkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||72||
tatrakāśīpuṣkaraṃ caprayāgaṃ naimiṣaṃ gayā |
śālagrāmamahākṣetramarbudāraṇyam eva ca ||73||
pauṣkaraṃ mathurātatrasarva-tīrthāni caiva hi |
yajṣāvedāścacatvārovrajanti harijāgaram ||74||
gaṅgā sarasvatī tāpī yamunā ca śatadrukā |
candrabhāgā vitastā ca nadyaḥ sarvās tu tatra vai ||75||
sarāṃ sicahradāḥ sarvesamudrāḥ sarvaevahi |
ekādaśyāṃ dvija-śreṣṭha gacchanti kṛṣṇa-jāgaram ||76||
spṛhaṇīyāhidevānāṃ yenarāḥkṛṣṇajāgare |
nṛtyanti gītaṃ kurvanti vīṇāvādyapraharṣitāḥ ||77||
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā sampūjyacamahāharim |
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā sva-śaktyā vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha ||78||
mahādeva uvāca—
śṛṇubrahmanpravakṣyāmidvādaśīmāhātmyamuttamam |
dvādaśītusadājṣeyāputradāmokṣadāyinī ||79||
prātaḥ snātvāhariṃ pūjyaupavā saṃsamarpayet |
ajñānatimirāṃ dhasyavratenānenakeśava ||80||
prasīdasumukhobhūtvājñānadṛṣṭiprado bhava |
pāraṇaṃ ca tataḥ kuryādyathā saṃbhavamagrataḥ ||81||
ataūrdhvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ tukārayecca yathāvidhi |
yadātudvādaśīsvalpāpāraṇenabhaveddvija ||82||
tadārātrautukartavyaṃ pāraṇaṃ muktimicchatā |
tadānarātridoṣaḥ syānniṣiddhaṃ nabhavetkvacit ||83||
yad uktaṃ niśinasnāyānmahāniśinabhojayet |
tat-pūrva-para-yāmābhyāṃ dinavat karma kārayet ||84||
yadābhavatisvalpātudvādaśīpāraṇedine |
uṣaḥkāledvayaṃ kuryātprātarmadhyāhnikaṃ tathā ||85||
dvādaśīsādhitāyenanareṇabhuvisarvadā |
tasyapuṇyamahaṃ vaktuṃ nasamarthoviśeṣataḥ ||86||
sādhayitvākhilānkāmānprāpnuyuścamahājanāḥ |
aṃ barīṣādayaḥ sarveyebhaktābhuviviśrutāḥ ||87||
dvādaśīṃ sādhayitvātutegatāviṣṇusadmani |
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ yad uktaṃ tumayātava ||88||
nāsti viṣṇusamodevonatithirdvādaśīsamā |
atradattaṃ cabhuktaṃ ca tathāpūjādikaṃ ca yat ||89||
tatsarvaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yātipūjitemādhavesati |
kiṃ punar bahunoktenabhaktānāṃ vallabhohariḥ ||90||
pradadātyakhilānkāmānyāvadābhūta##plavam |
dvādaśyāṃ caiva yad dattaṃ tat sarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ||91||
kurukṣetreṣu yad dattaṃ niṣphalaṃ naiva jāyate |
tadvac ca dvādaśī-dattaṃ bhaved devarṣi-sattama ||92||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe
umāpati-nārada-saṃvāde dvādaśī-ekādaśī-jāgaraṇa-mahimā nāma
saptatriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ

ātmavittānusāreṇatilānvastrāṇidāpayet ||49||
labhate caiva mārogyaṃ narojanmanijanmani |
na dāridryaṃ na kaṣṭatvaṃ na ca daurbhāgyam eva ca ||50||
sambhaved vai dvija-śreṣṭha ṣaṭ-tilā-samupoṣaṇāt |
anenavidhinābhūpatiladātāna saṃśayaḥ ||51||
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair  anāyāsena mānavaḥ |
dānaṃ ca vidhivat pātre sarva-pātaka-nāśanam |
nānarthaḥ kaścin nāyāsaḥ śarīre nṛpa-sattama ||52||

|| iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe 
umāpati-nārada-saṃvāde māgha-kṛṣṇā-ṣaṭ-tilaikādaśī nāma 
dvicatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ

(43)

ko bhavānnahijānīmaḥkasmātkāraṇatāṃ gataḥ |

mahimānaṃ kathayamevāsudeva namo’stu te ||1||

saubhāgyadāyinīrājannihalokeparatraca |

gajadānādbhūmidānanti ladānaṃ tato’dhikam ||10||

annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ nabhūtaṃ nabhaviṣyati ||11||

tat phalaṃ samavāpnotinaraḥkṛtvāvarūthinīm |
kanyāvittenajīvanti yenarāḥ pāpamohitāḥ ||14||
puṇyakṣayaṃ tegacchanti nirayaṃ yātanāmayam |
tasmāt sarva-prayatnena nagrāhyaṃ kanyakādhanam ||15||
yaścagṛhṇātilobhenakanyāṃ krītvācataddhanam |
so’nyajanmanirājendraoturbhavatiniścitam ||16||
ka##puṇyenayodadyādyathāśaktisvalaṃ kṛtām |
tatpuṇya saṃkhyāṃ nṛpatecitraguptonaśaknuyāt ||17||
tattulyaṃ phalamāpnotinaraḥkṛtvāvarūthinīm |
kāṃsyaṃ māṃ saṃmasūrāṃś cacaṇakānkodravāṃ s tathā ||18||
śākaṃ madhuparānnaṃ capunar bhojanamaithune |
vaiṣṇavo vrata-kartā ca daśamyāṃ daśa varjayet ||19||
dyūtaṃ krīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ danta-dhāvanam |
parāpavādaṃ paiśunyaṃ steyaṃ hiṃ sāṃ tathāratim ||20||
krodhaṃ caivānṛtaṃ vākyam ekādaśyāṃ vivarjayet |
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ patita-bhāṣaṇam ||21||
vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca punar bhojana-maithunam |
vṛṣa-pṛṣṭhaṃ masūrānnaṃ dvādaśyāṃ parivarjayet ||22||
anena vidhinā rājan vihitā yair varūthinī |
sarva-pāpa-kṣayaṃ kṛtvā dadyāt prānte’kṣayāṃ gatim |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjito madhusūdanaḥ ||23||
sarva-pāpa-vinirmuktās te yānti paramāṃ gatim |
tasmāt sarva-prayatnena  kartavyā pāpa-bhīrubhiḥ ||24||
kṣapāritanayādbhītonaraḥkuryādvarūthinīm |
paṭhanācchravaṇādrājangosahasraphalaṃ labhet |
sarva-pāpa-vinirmukto viṣṇu-loke mahīyate ||25||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām
umāpati-nārada-saṃvāde vaiśākha-kṛṣṇa-varūthinī ekādaśī nāma
aṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ

punar baddhaḥ punas tyaktaḥ punar baddhaḥ sa sambhramaiḥ |

āmiṣāhāraniratovanetiṣṭhatisarvadā |

bhobhobrahmandvija-śreṣṭhadayāṃ kṛtvāmamopari |

sayātinarakaṃ ghoraṃ svīyadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||8||

(51)
ekapaṣcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ-

yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
aparāyāś ca māhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ janārdana |
jyeṣṭhasyaśukla-pakṣetusyādyātāṃ vadamānada ||1||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
enāṃ vakṣyatidharmātmāvyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ |
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajṣovedavedāṃ gapāragaḥ ||2||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
śrutāmemānavādharmāvāsiṣṭhāścaśrutāmayā |
dvaipāyanayathāvattvaṃ vaiṣṇavānvaktumarhasi ||3||
śrī-veda-vyāsa uvāca—
śrutās tu mānavā dharmā vaidikāś ca śrutās tvayā |
kalau yuge naśakyaṃ tete vai kartuṃ narādhipa ||4||
sukhopāyamalpadhanamalpakleśaṃ mahāphalam |
purāṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sāra-bhūtaṃ mahāmate ||5||
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṣjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
dvādaśyāṃ tu śucir bhūtvā puṣpaiḥ sampūjya keśavam ||6||
annaṃ bhuṣjīta satkṛtya paścād vipra-puraḥ-saram |
sūtake’pi na bhoktavyaṃ nāśauce ca janādhipa ||7||
yāvaj-jīvaṃ vratam idaṃ kartavyaṃ puruṣarṣabha |
svargatiṃ prāptum icchadbhir atra naivāsti saṃśayaḥ ||8||
āpa pāpā durācārāḥ pāpiṣṭhā dharma-varjitāḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṣjānā na te yānti yamāntikam ||9||
iti tad-vacanaṃ śrutvā kampito’śvattha-patravat |
bhīmaseno mahā-bāhur natvovāca guruṃ prati ||10||
bhīmasena uvāca—
pitāmaha mahābuddhe śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
yudhiṣṭhiraś ca kuntī ca tathā drupada-nandinī ||11||
arjuno nakulaś caiva sahadevas tathaiva ca |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṣjanti kadācid api suvratāḥ ||12||
te māṃ bruvanti vai nityaṃ mā bhuṅkṣva tvaṃ vṛkodara |
ahaṃ tā na bruvaṃ tāta bubhukṣā duḥsahā mama ||13||
dānaṃ dāsyāmi vidhivat pūjayiṣyāmi keśavam |
bhīmasena vacaḥ śrutvā vyāso vacanam abravīt ||14||
vyāsa uvāca—
yadi svargam abhīṣṭaṃ tena rakaṃ duṣṭam eva ca |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api ||15||
bhīmasena uvāca—
pitāmaha mahā-buddhe kathayāmi tavāgrataḥ |
eka-bhaktena śaknomi upavāse kutaḥ prabho ||16||
vṛko’pi nāma yo vahniḥ sa sadā jaṭhare mama |
ativelaṃ yadā śnāmi tadā samupaśāmyati ||17||
naikaṃ śaknomy ahaṃ kartum upavāsaṃ mahāmune |
yenaiva prāpyate svargas tat kartāsmi yathā-tatham |
tad ekaṃ vada niścitya yena śreyo’ham āpnuyām ||18||
vyāsa uvāca—
vṛṣasthe mithunasthe vā yadā caikādaśī bhavet |
jyeṣṭha-māse prayatnena  sopoṣyodaka-varjitā ||19||
gaṇḍūṣācamanaṃ vāri varjayitvodakaṃ budhaḥ |
upabhuṣjīta naiveha vrata-bhaṅgo’nyathā bhavet ||20||
udayād udayaṃ yāvad varjayitvodakaṃ naraḥ |
śrūyatāṃ samavāpnoti dvādaśa-dvādaśī-phalam ||21||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvādaśyāṃ snānam ācaret |
jalaṃ suvarṇaṃ dattvā ca dvijātibhyo yathā-vidhi ||22||
bhuṣjīta kṛta-kṛtyas tu brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito vaśī |
evaṃ kṛte ca yat puṇyaṃ bhīmasena śṛṇuṣva tat ||23||
saṃvatsare tu yāś caiva ekādaśyo bhavanti hi |
tāsāṃ phalam avāpnoti hy atra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ ||24||
iti māṃ keśavaḥ prāha śaṅkha-cakra-gadādharaḥ |
sarvān parityajya pumān mām ekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet ||25||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāras tataḥ pāpāt pramucyate |
dravya-śuddhiḥ kalau nāsti saṃskāraḥ smārta eva ca ||26||
vaidikas tu kutaś cāpi prāpte duṣṭe kalau yuge  |
kiṃ nu te bahunoktena vāyu-putra punaḥ punaḥ ||27||
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṣjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe jyeṣṭhe māsy udakaṃ vinā ||28||
puṇyaṃ phalam avāpnoti tac chṛṇuṣva vṛkodara |
saṃvatsare tu yā proktāḥ śuklaḥ kṛṣṇā vṛkodara ||29||
upoṣitā hi sarvāḥ syur ekādaśyo na saṃśayaḥ |
dhana-dhānya-pradā puṇyā putrārogya-śubha-pradā ||30||
upoṣitā nara-vyāghra iti satyaṃ bravīmi te |
yama-dūtā mahā-kāyāḥ karālāḥ kṛṣṇa-rūpiṇaḥ ||31||
daṇḍa-pāśa-dharā raudrā nopasarpanti taṃ naram |
pītāmbara-dharā saumyāś cakra-hastā manojavāḥ ||32||
antakāle nayanty ete vaiṣṇavān vaiṣṇavī-purīm |
tasmāt sarva-prayatnena  upoṣyodaka-varjitā ||33||
jala-dhenuṃ tadā dattvā sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
tatas tvam asyāṃ kaunteya sopavāso’rcanaṃ hareḥ ||34||
kuru sarva-prayatnena sarva-pāpa-praśāntaye |
svapne na me’parādho’sti danta-rāgatayāpi vā ||35||
bhokṣye pare’hni deveśa hy aśanaṃ vāsarād dhareḥ |
ity uccārya tato mantra upavāsa-paro bhavet ||36||
sarva-pāpa-vināśāya śraddhādama-samanvitaḥ |

nāgavallyāstuniyamekarpūraṃ sahariṇyakam ||18||
kālekāledvija-śreṣṭhayatkṛtaṃ niyamenatu |
tattaddeyaṃ viśeṣeṇaparalokagatīpsayā ||19||
ādausnānādikaṃ kṛtvāviṣṇor agreprakāśayet |
anādinidhanodevaḥśaṅkha-cakra-gadādharaḥ |
tasyāgre kena kurvanti yato viṣṇus tu pāpahā ||20||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe umāpati-nārada-saṃvāde 
cāturmāsyodyāpanaṃ nāma 
paṣcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||65||

(66)
ṣaṭṣaṣṭhitamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
yamasyārādhanaṃ brūhi mad-dhitārthaṃ surottama |
kathaṃ nagamyatedevanareṇanarakāṃ tare ||1||
śrūyateyamaloketusadāvaitaraṇīnadī |
anādhṛṣyātvapārācadustarābahuśoṇitā ||2||
dustarāsarva-bhūtānāṃ sākathaṃ sutarābhavet |
bhayametanmahādevayamalokaṃ pratiprabho ||3||
tasyanirmocanārthāyabrūhikṛtyamaśeṣataḥ |
bhagavandeva-deveśakṛpāṃ kṛtvāmamopari ||4||
mahādeva uvāca—
dvāravatyāṃ purā vipra-snāto’haṃ lavaṇāmbhasi |
dadṛśe muni-māyāṃ taṃ mudgalaṃ nāma vāḍava ||5||
jvalantam iva cādityaṃ tapasā dyotatāṅgakam |
māṃ praṇamya muniḥ prāha mudgalo vismayānvitaḥ ||6||
mudgala uvāca— 
akasmānmūrcchitodevapatito’smidharātale |
prajvalanti mamāṃ gānigṛhītoyamakiṃ karaiḥ ||7||
balādākṛṣyamāṇo’haṃ puruṣoṃ guṣṭhamātrakaḥ |
baddhoyamabhaṭairgāḍhaṃ nīto’smiśamanānti kam ||8||
kṣaṇātsabhāyāṃ paśyāmi yamaṃ piṃ galalocanam |
kṛṣṇamukhaṃ mahāraudraṃ mṛtyuvyādhiśatānvitam ||9||
vātapittaśleṣmadoṣairmūrtimadbhistusevitam |
kāyaśoṣajvarātaṃ kasphoṭikālūtakādibhiḥ ||10||
jvālāṃ gamardaśīrṣārtibhagaṃ darabalakṣayaiḥ |
kaṇṭhamālākṣirogaiścamūtrakṛcchrajvaravraṇaiḥ ||11||
vimūrcchikāgalagrāhahṛdrogairbhūtataskaraiḥ |
itthaṃ bahuvidhairaudrairnānārūpairbhayaṃ karaiḥ ||12||
kapālaśirohastaiśca saṃgrāmenaraketathā |
rākṣasairdānavairghorairupaviṣṭaiḥ puraḥ sthitaiḥ ||13||
dharmādhikāribhiścātracitraguptādilekhakaiḥ |
vyāghrasiṃ havarāhaiścaśikhāsarpaiḥ sudurddharaiḥ ||14||
vṛścikairdaṃ ṣṭribhirbhūtaiḥkīṭakairmatkuṇādibhiḥ |
vṛkacitrādiśunakaiḥkaṃ kairgṛdhraiścajaṃ bukaiḥ ||15||
taskarairbhūtadāridrairmāribhirḍākinīgrahaiḥ |
muktakeśaiḥśvāsakāsairbhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaiḥ ||16||
bṛhatpratāpairnobhītaiḥśāsakaiḥ pāpakarmaṇām |
yamaḥ sabhāyāṃ śuśubhesevyamānaḥ parigrahaiḥ ||17||
bhīmāṭavikajīvaiśca yathāvyālāṃ janogiriḥ |
tatoviśveśvaraḥ prāhasamayaḥ kiṃ karānprati ||18||
nāmabhrāntairbhavadbhiścasamānītaḥkathaṃ muniḥ |
bhīmakasyātmajogrāmekauṇḍinyemudgalābhidhaḥ ||19||
kṣīṇāyuḥkṣatriyaḥ so’stiāneyomucyatāmasau |
śrutvaitattegatāstasmādāyātāḥ punarevate ||20||
dharmarājaṃ punaḥ prāhuḥ sarveteyamakiṃ karāḥ |
tatrāsmābhirgatairdehīkṣīṇāyurnopalakṣitaḥ ||21||
yama uvāca—
kiṃ kāraṇamadṛśyāsteprāyeṇabhavatāṃ narāḥ |
sukṛtādvādaśīyais tukhyātāvaitaraṇīnadī ||22||
ujjayinyāṃ prayāgevā yamunāyāṃ ca ye’mṛtāḥ |
tila-hasti-hiraṇyādi-dattaṃ yais tu gavāhnikam ||23||
dūtā ūcuḥ—
tadvrataṃ kīdṛśaṃ brahmanbrūhisarvamaśeṣataḥ |
kiṃ tatradevakartavyaṃ puruṣais tavatoṣadam ||24||
yenakṛtānaraśreṣṭhadvādaśīkṛṣṇa-pakṣajā |
upavāsecatenaiva kathaṃ pāpāt pramucyate ||25||
tadvrataṃ kenavidhinākartavyaṃ ca yathāvada |
suprasannenavaktavyaṃ dayāṃ kṛtvādayānidhe ||26||
śrīmudgala uvāca—
dūtānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvāuvācamadhuraṃ tadā |
sarvaṃ vadāmibhodūtāyathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam ||27||
yama uvāca—
mārgaśīrṣādimāsetuyāimāḥkṛṣṇa-pakṣajāḥ |
tāsupūrvāsuvidhivaddūtāvaitaraṇīvratam ||28||
pratimā saṃcakartavyaṃ yāvadvarṣaṃ bhaveddhruvam |
yāṃ tukṛtvātubhodūtāmucyatenātra saṃśayaḥ ||29||
upavāsasyaniyamaḥkartavyoviṣṇutuṣṭidaḥ |
adya me deva-deveśa upavāso bhaviṣyati ||30||
dvādaśyāṃ pūjya govindaṃ bhakti-bhāva-samanvitam |
svapnendriyasya vai kalyād bhojanaṃ yac ca maithunam ||31||
tat sarvaṃ kṣama me deva kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari |
evaṃ vai niyamaṃ kṛtvā madhyāhne tīrtham āvrajet ||32||
mṛd-go-maya-tilān nītvā gantavyaṃ vidhi-pūrvakam |
snānaṃ tatra prakartavyaṃ vrata sampūrṇa-hetave ||33||
aśvakrāntetimaṃ treṇasnānaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ |
aśvakrānterathakrānteviṣṇukrāntevasundhare ||34||
mṛttikeharamepāpaṃ yanmayāpūrva saṃcitam |
tayāhatenapāpenasarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||35||
kāśyāṃ caiva tu saṃbhūtāstilāvaiviṣṇurūpiṇaḥ |
tilasnānenagovindaḥ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati ||36||
viṣṇudehodbhavādevimahāpāpāpahāriṇī |
sarvaṃ pāpaṃ haratvaṃ vaisarveṣāṃ hi namo’stu te ||37||
tulasīpatrakaṃ dhṛtvānāmoccāraṇapūrvakam |
snānaṃ sukṛtibhiḥ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhi-pūrvakam ||38||
evaṃ snātvāsamuttīryaparidhāyasuvāsasī |
tarpayitvāpitṝndevāṃ s tatoviṣṇos tu pūjanam ||39||
 saṃsthāpyacāvraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ paṣcapallava saṃyutam |
paṣcaratnasamopetaṃ divyasraggandhavāsitam ||40||
jalapūrṇaṃ sadravyaṃ catāmrapātrasamanvitam |
tatrasthaṃ śrīdharaṃ devaṃ deva-devaṃ taponidhim ||41||
pūrṇenavidhinārājankuryātpūjāṃ garīyasīm |
mṛdgomayādiracitaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayecchubham ||42||
taṇḍulaiḥśukladhautaiścaaśmapiṣṭaiścakārayet |
dharmarājaḥ prakartavyohastādyavayavānvitaḥ ||43||
nadīṃ vaitaraṇīṃ tāmrāṃ sthāpayitvātadagrataḥ |
pūjayeccapṛthaksamyaksamāvāhanapūrvakam ||44||
āvāhayāmideveśaṃ yamaṃ vaiviśvarūpiṇam |
ihābhyehimahābhāgasānnidhyaṃ kurukeśava ||45||
idaṃ pādyaṃ śriyaḥ kāṃ tasopaviṣṭaṃ hareprabho |
viśvodyānaratonityaṃ kṛpāṃ kurumamopari ||46||
bhūtidāyanamaḥ pādāvaśokāyacajānunī |
urūnamaḥśivāyetiviśvamūrtenamaḥkaṭim ||47||
kaṃ darpāyanamomeḍhramādityāyaphalaṃ tathā |
dāmodarāya jaṭharaṃ vāsudevāya vai stanau ||48||
śrīdharāyamukhaṃ keśānkeśavāyetivainamaḥ |
pṛṣṭhaṃ śārṅgadharāyeti caraṇauvaradāya ca ||49||
svanāmnāśaṅkhacakrāsigadāparaśupāṇaye |
sarvātmanenamas tubhyaṃ śiraityabhidhīyate ||50||
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ ca vāmanam |
rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca buddhaṃ kalkiṃ namo’stu te ||51||
sarva-pāpaughanāśārthaṃ pūjayāmi namo namaḥ |
ebhiścasarvaśomantrair viṣṇuṃ dhyātvāprapūjayet ||52||
dharmarāja namas te’stu dharma-rāja namo’stu te |
dakṣiṇāśā-pate tubhyaṃ namo mahiṣa-vāhana ||53||
citragupta namas tubhyaṃ vicitrāya namo namaḥ |
narakārti-praśānty-arthaṃ kāmāny accha mamepsitān ||54||
yamāya dharma-rājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca |
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarva-bhūta-kṣayāya ca ||55||
vṛkodarāya citrāya citraguptāya vai namaḥ |
nīlāya caiva dadhnāya nityaṃ kuryān namo namaḥ ||56||
evaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ pūjyonāmabhirdharmarāṭprabhuḥ|
vaitaraṇīsuduḥ pārepāpaighnasarva-kāmade ||57||
ihābhyehimahābhāgegṛhāṇārghaṃ mayākṛtam |
yamadvārapatheghorekhyātāvaitaraṇīnadī ||58||
tasyāmuddharaṇārthāyajanma-mṛtyujarātigā |
yādustarāduṣkṛtibhiḥ sarvaprāṇibhayāpahā ||59||
yasyāṃ bhayātpramajjanti prāṇinoyātanāparāḥ |
tartukāmastutāṃ ghoraṃ jayādevi namo namaḥ ||60||
tasyāṃ devādhitiṣṭhanti yāsāvaitaraṇīnadī |
sācāpipūjitābhaktyā prītyarthaṃ keśavasyaca ||61||
yasyāstaṭepraviśanti ṛṣayaḥ pitaras tathā |
sācāpisindhurūpeṇapūjitāpāpahārikā ||62||
tarītuṃ tāṃ pradāsyāmisarva-pāpa-vimuktaye |
puṇyārthaṃ sampravakṣyāmitubhyaṃ vaitaraṇīnadīm ||63||
mayāsipūjitābhaktyā prītyarthaṃ keśavasyaca |
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇajagannātha saṃsārāduddharasvamām ||64||
nāmagrahaṇamātreṇasarvaṃ pāpaṃ harasvame |
yajṣopavītaṃ paramaṃ kāritaṃ nava-tantubhiḥ ||65||
pratigṛhṇīṣvadeveśaprītoyacchamamepsitam |
idaṃ tavacatāmbūlaṃ yathāśaktyā suśobhanam ||66||
pratigṛhṇīṣvadeveśamāmuddharabhavārṇavāt |
paṣcavartīpradīpo’yaṃ deveśārārtikaṃ tava ||67||
mohāṃ dhakāradyumaṇebhaktiyukto bhavārtihṛt |
paramānnaṃ supakvānnaṃ samastarasa saṃyutam ||68||
niveditaṃ mayābhaktyā bhagavanpratigṛhyatām |
dvādaśākṣaramaṃ treṇayathā saṃkhyajapena ca ||69||
prīyatāṃ meśriyaḥ kāṃ taḥ prītoyacchatuvāṣchitam |
paṣcagāvaḥ samutpannāmathyamānemahodadhau ||70||
tāsāṃ madhyetuyānaṃ dātasyaidhenvai namo namaḥ |
gāṃ sampūjyavidhānenaarghyaṃ dadyātsamāhitaḥ ||71||
sarva-kāmadughedevisarvāntakanivāriṇī |
ārogyaṃ santatiṃ dīrghāṃ dehinaṃ dinimesadā ||72||
pūjitācavasiṣṭhenaviśvāmitreṇadhīmatā |
kapileharamepāpaṃ yanmayāpūrva saṃcitam ||73||
gāvomamāgrataḥ santugāvome santupṛṣṭhataḥ |
nākemāmupatiṣṭhaṃ tuhemaśṛṃ gīpayomucaḥ ||74||
surabhyaḥ saurabheyāścasaritaḥ sāgarāyathā |
sarva-devamayedevisubhadrebhaktavatsale ||75||
evaṃ sampūjyavidhivaddadyādgoṣugavāhnikam |
saurabheyaḥ sarvahitāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpa-nāśanāḥ ||76||
pratigṛhṇaṃ tumegrā saṃgāvastrailokyamātaraḥ |
gaṃ gadāyainamobhūtyaisarva-pāpa-prahāṇaye ||77||
anenaiva tumaṃ treṇagadāṃ vaidhārayedbudhaḥ |
paṃ namaḥ padmanābhāyapadmaṃ vaidhārayetsudhīḥ ||78||
caṃ cakrarūpiṇeviṣṇodhāraṇaṃ cakrajaṃ smṛtam |
śaṃ śaṅkharūpiṇetubhyaṃ namo’stusukhakāriṇe ||79||
maṃ treṇānena vaidūtādhāraṇaṃ śaṅkhajaṃ smṛtam |
caturṇāmāyudhānāṃ tudhāraṇaṃ munibhiḥ smṛtam ||80||
agnihotraṃ yathānityaṃ vedasyādhyayanaṃ tathā |
brāhmaṇasyatathaivedaṃ taptamudrādidhāraṇam ||81||
candanenasugandhenagopikā-candanenatu |
dhāraṇaṃ caviśeṣeṇabrāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ ||82||
cāṇḍālo’pibhavecchuddhodhāraṇāccana saṃśayaḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ puṇḍramṛjuṃ saumyaṃ sacihnaṃ dhārayedyadi ||83||
sacāṇḍālo’piśuddhātmāpūjyaevasadādvijaiḥ |
cāṇḍālānāṃ gṛhedūtāstulasīyatradṛśyate ||84||
tatratyā tulasī grāhyā bhakti-bhāvena cetasā ||85||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe uttara-khaṇḍe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām 
umāpati-nārada-saṃvāde yamārādhanaṃ nāma 
ṣaṭ-ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||66||

(67)
saptaṣaṣṭhitamo’dhyāyaḥ

maheśvara uvāca—
iti śrutaṃ dharma-mukhān mudgalo dvija-sattamaḥ |
kathayitvā mamāgre vai gato yādṛcchiko mune ||1||
gopikā-candanaṃ yatra tiṣṭhate vai dvijottama |
tad-gṛhaṃ tīrtha-rūpaJca viṣṇunā bhāṣitaṃ kila ||2||
śoka-mohau na tatrāstāṃ na bhavaty aśubhaṃ kvacit |
gopikā-candanaṃ yasya tiṣṭhati dvija-sadmani ||3||
sukhinaḥ pūrvajās teṣāṃ santatir vardhate sadā |
gopikā-candanaṃ yasya vartate’har-niśaṃ gṛhe ||4||
gopī-puṣkarajā mṛtsnā pavitrā kāya-śodhinī |
udvartanād vinaśyanti vyādhayo hy ādhayaś caye ||5||
ato dehe dhṛtaṃ pumbhir muktidaṃ sarva-kāmikam |
tāvad garjanti tīrthāni tāvat kṣetrāṇi sarvadā ||6||
gopikā-candanaṃ yāvan na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ dvija |
idaṃ dhyeyam idaṃ pūjyaṃ mala-doṣa-vināśanam ||7||
yasya saṃsparśanād eva pūto bhavati mānavaḥ |
anta-kāle tu martyānāṃ muktidaṃ pāvanaṃ param ||8||
kiṃ vadāmi dvija-śreṣṭha muktidaṃ gopi-candanam |
viṣṇos tu tulasī-kāṣṭhaṃ tathā vai mūla-mṛttikā ||9||
gopikā-candanaṃ caiva tathā vai hari-candanam |
catvāri hy etāni saṃmīlya aṅgam udvartayet sudhīḥ ||10||
tena tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jambū-dvīpeṣu sarvadā |
tilakaṃ kurute yas tu gopikā-candana-dravaiḥ ||11||
sarva-pāpa-vinirmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam |
pituḥ śrāddhādikaṃ tena gayāṃ gatvā tu vai kṛtam ||12||
yena vā puruṣeṇāpi vidhṛtaṃ gopi-candanam |
madyapo brahmahā caiva go-ghno vā bālahā tathā |
mucyate tat-kṣaṇād eva gopī-candana-dhāraṇāt ||13||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām
umāpati-nārada-saṃvāde gopī-candana-māhātmye 
saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||67||

(68)
aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ

maheśvara uvāca—
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmivaiṣṇavānāṃ calakṣaṇam ||1||
yac chrutvā mucyatelokobrahatyādipātakāt |
teṣāṃ vailakṣaṇaṃ yādṛksvarūpaṃ yādṛśambhavet ||2||
tādṛśaṃ muniśārdūlaśṛṇututvaṃ vacmisāṃ pratam |
viṣṇor ayaṃ yatohyāsīttasmādvaiṣṇavaucyate ||3||
sarveṣāṃ caiva varṇānāṃ vaiṣṇavaḥśreṣṭhaucyate |
yeṣāṃ puṇyatamāhārasteṣāṃ vaṃ śetuvaiṣṇavaḥ ||4||
kṣamādayātapaḥ satyaṃ yeṣāṃ vaitiṣṭhatidvija |
teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇapāpaṃ naśyatitūlavat ||5||
hiṃ sādharmādvinirmuktāyasyaviṣṇausthitāmatiḥ |
śaṅkha-cakra-gadāpadmaṃ nityaṃ vaidhārayettuyaḥ ||6||
tulasīkāṣṭhajāṃ mālāṃ kaṇṭhevaidhārayedyataḥ |
tilakānidvādaśadhānityaṃ vaidhārayedbudhaḥ ||7||
dharmādharmaṃ tujānātiyaḥ savaiṣṇavaucyate |
veda-śāstra-rato nityaṃ nityaṃ vai yajṣa-yājakaḥ ||8||
utsavāṃś cacaturviṃśatkurvanti capunaḥ punaḥ |
teṣāṃ kulaṃ dhanyatamaṃ teṣāṃ vaiyaśaucyate ||9||
te vai lokedhanyatamājātābhāgavatānarāḥ |
eka eva kule yasya jāto bhāgavato naraḥ ||10||
tat kulaṃ tāritaṃ tena bhūyo bhūyaś ca vāḍava |
aṇḍajāudbhijāś caiva yejarāyujayonayaḥ ||11||
te tu sarve’pivijṣeyāḥśaṅkha-cakra-gadādharāḥ |
yeṣāṃ darśanamātreṇabrahmahāśuddhyatesadā ||12||
kiṃ tuvakṣyāmidevarṣetebhyo dhanyatamābhuvi |
vaiṣṇavā ye tu dṛśyante bhuvane’smin mahā-mune ||13||
te vai viṣṇu-samāś caiva jṣātavyās tattva-kovidaiḥ |
kalau dhanyatamā loke śrutā me nātra saṃśayaḥ ||14||
viṣṇoḥ pūjākṛtātenasarveṣāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtam |
mahādānaṃ kṛtaṃ tenapūjitāyena vaiṣṇavāḥ ||15||
phalaṃ patraṃ tathāśākamannaṃ vāvastram eva ca |
vaiṣṇavebhyaḥ prayacchanti tedhanyābhuvisarvadā ||16||
arcitovaiṣṇavoyais tusarveṣāṃ caiva pūjanam |
kṛtaṃ yairarcitoviṣṇuste vai dhanyatamāmatāḥ ||17||
teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇaśuddhyatepātakānnaraḥ |
kimanyadbahunoktenabhūyobhūyaścavāḍava ||18||
atovaidarśanaṃ teṣāṃ sparśanesukhadāyakam |
yathāviṣṇus tathācāyaṃ nāṃ taraṃ vartatekvacit ||19||
itijṣātvātubhovatsasarvadāpūjayedbudhaḥ |
ekaevatuyair viprovaiṣṇavobhuvibhojyate |
sahasraṃ bhojitaṃ tenadvijānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||20||

saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ- 

maheśvara uvāca—
caitretucaṃ pakenaiva jātīpuṣpeṇavāpunaḥ |

kadaṃ bakusumaṃ labdhvāprīto bhavatilokakṛt ||11||
tulasīkṛṣṇatulasīvaṃ julair vāsureśvari |
sarvadāpūjitoviṣṇuḥkaṣṭaṃ haratinityaśaḥ ||12||
śrāvaṇemāsi samprāpteye’rcayanti janārdanam |
atasīpuṣpamādāyatathādūrvādalenatu ||13||
nānāpuṣpair viśeṣeṇapūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ |
dadātivipulānkāmānyāvadābhūta samplavam ||14||
bhādramāsetu samprāpteśṛṇutvaṃ naganaṃ dini |
caṃ pakair vāśvetapuṣpairaktasindūrakais tathā ||15||

āśvinevaiśubhemāsekartavyaṃ viṣṇupūjanam ||16||
yūthikānavajātībhis tathānānāvidhaiḥśubhaiḥ |
pūjanīyaḥ prayatnena bhakti-pūrvaṃ sadājanaiḥ ||17||
padmānyevasamānīyaye’rcayanti janārdanam |
