atha kārttika-māhātmyam

(88)
aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ

sūta uvāca—
ataḥ paraṃ kārttika-māhātmyaṃ prastūyate |
ekadā dvārakām āgād ṛṣiḥ kṛṣṇa-didṛkṣayā |
puṣpāṇy ādāya divyāni kalpa-vṛkṣotthitāni ca ||1||
nāradaṃ svāgatenāsau kṛṣṇaḥ sat-kāram ācarat |
idam arghyam idaṃ pādyam ity uvācāsanaṃ dadat ||2||
nāradas tāni puṣpāṇi kṛṣṇāyopājahāra ca |
kṛṣṇaḥ ṣoḍaśa-sāhasra-strībhyas tāni vyabhajyata ||3||
vismṛtya satyabhāmāṃ tu sarvābhyas tāny adāt prabhuḥ |
satyabhāmā tataḥ kruddhā krodhāgāraṃ samāviśat ||4||
samājṣāya tataḥ kṛṣṇas tatra gatvā samāhitaḥ |
satyabhāmāṃ mānayitvā garuḍaṃ manasā smaran ||5||
smṛta-mātras-tu garuḍas tadā gatyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ |
āruhya vegāt patraṃ tam ity uvāca priyāṃ prabhuḥ ||6||
satye tvaṃ mā kṛthāḥ krodhaṃ tvat-kṛte devataiḥ saha |
virudhya deva-rājānaṃ ropayiṣyeta vāṅgaṇe ||7||
kalpa-drumaṃ mahā-bhāge’parādhaṃ me kṣamāṃ kuru |
iti kṛtvā pratijṣāṃ tu kṛṣṇaḥ sa satyabhāmayā ||8||
deva-lokam agāt tūrṇaṃ yatra devaḥ sa vṛtrahā |
yācitaḥ kalpa-vṛkṣārtham uttaraṃ dattavān prabhum ||9||
nāyaṃ deva-drumo bhūmyāṃ prāptuṃ yogyas tvayā prabho |
tadā kruddho mahābāhur vṛkṣam utpāṭya mūlataḥ ||10||
vāham āropayāmāsa vegena balavattaraḥ |
tadā vajra-dharo vegād vajram udyamya vīryavān ||11||
garuḍaṃ tāḍayāmāsa kalpa-vṛkṣaṃ tyajer iti |
tadā patra-rathaḥ patraṃ kuliśasyāpi gauravāt ||12||
ekaṃ visarjayāmāsa tvarayā prajagāma ca |
tena vajra-prahāreṇa trayo bhūva-patatriṇaḥ ||13||
mayūro nakulaś cāṣaḥ kṛṣṇo dvārāvatīm agāt |
āgatya satyabhāmāyā gṛhe cainam aropayat |
tadaiva nārado’bhyāgāt satyayā mānito bahu ||14||
satyabhāmovāca—
īdṛśaḥ kalpa-vṛkṣo’yaṃ patir etādṛśaḥ prabhuḥ |
bhave bhave kathaṃ prāpyas tad ākhyātu bhavān mama ||15||
iti pṛṣṭas tadā prāha nārado muni-sattamaḥ |
prāpyate satyabhāme’yaṃ tulā-puruṣa-dānataḥ ||16||
satyabhāmā tadā kṛṣṇaṃ kalpa-vṛkṣa-samanvitam |
nāradāyaiva sā prādāt tolayitvā vidhānataḥ |
sarvopaskaram ākṛṣya nāradas tri-divaṃ yayau ||17||
sūta uvāca—
śriyaḥ patim athāmantrya gate devarṣi-sattame |
harṣotphullā nanā satyā vāsudevam athābravīt ||18||
satyabhāmovāca—
dhanyāsmi kṛtakṛtyāsmi saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ ca me |
majjan mani-nidāne ca dhanyau tau pitarau mama ||19||
yau māṃ trailoka-subhagāṃ janayāmāsatur dhruvam |
ṣoḍaśa-strī-sahasrāṇāṃ vallabhāhaṃ yatas tava ||20||
yasmān mayādi-puruṣaḥ kalpa-vṛkṣa-samanvitaḥ |
yathokta-vidhinā samyaṅ nāradāya samarpitaḥ ||21||
yad-vārtām api jānanti bhūmi-saṃsthāna-jantavaḥ |
so’yaṃ kalpa-drumo gehe mama tiṣṭhati sāmpratam ||22||
trailokyādhipateś cāhaṃ śrīpater ativallabhā |
ato’haṃ praṣṭum icchāmi kiṣcit tvāṃ madhusūdana ||23||
yadi tvaṃ mat-priya-karaḥ kathayasvātra vistarāt |
śrutvā tac ca punaś cāhaṃ karomi hi tam ātmanaḥ ||24||
yathā-kalpaṃ tvayā deva viyuktāsyāṃ na karhicit |
sūta uvāca—
iti priyā-vacaḥ śrutvā smerāsyo’yaṃ gadāgrajaḥ ||25||
satyākarekaraṃ kṛtvāgamatkalpatarostalam |
niṣiddhyānucaraṃ lokaṃ savilā saṃpriyānvitaḥ ||26||
prahasyasatyāmāmantryaprovācajagatāṃ patiḥ |
tatprītiparitoṣārthaṃ lasatpulakitāṃ gajaḥ ||27||
kṛṣṇa uvāca—
na me tvattaḥ priyatamā kācid anyā nitambinī |
ṣoḍaśa-strī-sahasrāṇāṃ priye prāṇa-samā hy asi ||28||
tvadarthaṃ devarājenavirodhodaivataiḥ saha |
tvayāyatprārthitaṃ kāṃ teśṛṇuyaccamahadbhavet ||29||
adeyamatha vākāryamakathyamapiyatpunaḥ |
tvatkṛtaṃ tukathaṃ praśnaṃ katha yāminatupriye |
pṛcchasvasarvaṃ katha yeyattemanasivartate ||30||
satyovāca-
dānaṃ vrataṃ tapovāpikiṃ tupūrvaṃ mayākṛtam |
yenāhaṃ martyajāmartyebhavānīvā’bhavaṃ kila ||31||
tavāṅgārddhaharānityaṃ garuḍoparigāminī |
indrādidevatāvāsamagamaṃ ca tvayāsaha ||32||
atastvāṃ praṣṭum icchāmikiṃ kṛtaṃ tumayāśubham |
janmāṃ tare ca kiṃ śīlākācāhaṃ kasyakanyakā ||33||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
śṛṇuṣva ikamanāḥkāṃ teyattvaṃ vaipūrvajanmani |
puṇyaṃ vrataṃ kṛtavatītatsarvaṃ kathayāmi te ||34||
āsītkṛtayugasyāṃ temāyāpuryāṃ dvijottamaḥ |
ātreyodevaśarmetivedavedāṃ gapāragaḥ ||35||
ātitheyo’gniśuśrūṣuḥ sauravrataparāyaṇaḥ |
sūryamārādhayannityaṃ sākṣātsūryyaivāparaḥ ||36||
tasyātivayasaścāsīnnāmnāguṇavatīsutā |
aputraḥ sasvaśiṣyāyacandranāmnedadausutām ||37||
tamevaputravan menesacataṃ pitṛvadvaśī |
taukadācidvanaṃ yātaukuśedhmaharaṇārthinau ||38||
himādripādajavaneceratustauyatastataḥ |
tautatorākṣa saṃghoramāyāṃ taṃ samapaśyatām ||39||
bhayavihvalasarvāṃ gāvasamarthaupalāyitum |
nihatau rakṣasā tena kṛtānta-sama-rūpiṇā ||40||
tau tu kṣetra-prabhāveṇa dharma-śīlatayā punaḥ |
vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ nītau mad-gaṇair mat-samīpagaiḥ ||41||
yāvaj jīvantu yat tābhyāṃ sūrya-pūjādikaṃ kṛtam |
tena vai karmaṇā tābhyāṃ suprīto’haṃ kilābhavam ||42||
śaivāḥ saurāś ca gāṇeśā vaiṣṇavāḥ śakti-pūjakāḥ |
mām eva prāpnuvantīha varṣāmbhaḥ sāgaraṃ yathā ||43||
eko’haṃ paṣcadhā jātaḥ krīḍayan nāmabhiḥ kila |
deva-datto yathā kaścit putrādy-āhvāna-nāmabhiḥ ||44||
tataś ca tau mad-bhavanādhivāsinau
vimānayānau ravi-varcasāv ubhau |
mat-tulya-rūpau mama sannidhānagau 
divyāṅganā candana-bhoga-bhoginau ||45||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ
śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||88||

(89)
ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 

śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
tato guṇavatī śrutvā rakṣasān iha tāv ubhau |
pitṛ-bhartaja-duḥkhārtā karuṇaṃ paryadevayat ||1||
guṇavaty uvāca—
hā nātha hāpitas tyaktvā gacchataṃ kva mayā vinā |
bālāhaṃ kiṃ karomy adya hy anāthā bhavatā vinā ||2||
ko nu mām āsthitāṃ gehe bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ |
akiṣcit-kuśalāṃ snehāt pālayiṣyati duḥkhitām ||3||
hata-bhāgyā gata-sukhā hateśā hata-jīvitā |
śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajāmy adya tvan-nāthā bata bāliśā ||4||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
evaṃ bahu-vilapyātha kurarīva bhṛśāturā |
papāta bhūmau vikalā rambhā vāta-hatā yathā ||5||
cirād āśvasya sā bhūmau vilapya karuṇaṃ bahu |
nimagnā duḥkha-jaladhau śokārtā samavartata ||6||
sāgrahopaskarān sarvān vikrīya śubha-karma-kṛt |
tayoś cakre yathā-śakti pāralaukika-sat-kriyām ||7||
tasminn eva purevāsaṃ cakre prabhṛti-jīvitam |
viṣṇu-bhakti-parā śāntā satya-śaucā jitendriyā ||8||
vrata-dvayaṃ tayā samyag ājanma-maraṇāt kṛtam |
ekādaśī-vrataṃ samyak sevanaṃ kārttikasya ca ||9||
etad-vrata-dravyaṃ kānte mamātīva priyaGkaram |
bhukti-mukti-karaṃ samyak putra saṃpatti-kārakam ||10||
kārttike māsi ye nityaṃ tulā saṃsthe divākare |
prātaḥ snāsyanti te muktā mahā-pātakino’pi ca ||11||
saṃmārjanaṃ gṛhe viṣṇoḥ svastikādi-nivedanam |
viṣṇu-pūjāṃ prakurvanti jīvan-muktāś ca te narāḥ ||12||
snānaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ dīpaṃ tulasī-vana-sevanam |
kārttike ye prakurvanti te narā viṣṇu-mūrtayaḥ ||13||
itthaṃ dina-trayam api kārttike ye prakurvate |
devānām api te vandyāḥ kiṃ yair ājanmataḥ kṛtam ||14||
itthaṃ guṇavatī samyak pratyabdaṃ pratinīyate |
nityaṃ viṣṇoḥ parikare bhaktā tat-para-mānasā ||15||
kadācij jarasā sātha kṛśāṅgī jvara-pīḍitā |
snātuṃ gaṅgāṃ gatā kānte kathaṣcic chanakais tathā ||16||
yāvaj jalāntara-gatā kampitā śīta-pīḍitā |
tāvat sā vihvalāpaśyad vimānaṃ prāptam ambarāt ||17||
śaṃkha-cakra-gadā-padma-hastair āsannam ambarāt |
viṣṇu-rūpa-dharaiḥ samyag vainateya-dhvajāṅkitaiḥ ||18||
ārohayan vimānaṃ tam apsaro-gaṇa-sevitam |
cāmarair vījyamānāṃ tāṃ vaikuṇṭham anayan gaṇāḥ ||19||
atha sā tad-vimānasthā jvalad-agni-śikhopamā |
kārttika-vrata-puṇyena mat-sānnidhya-gatābhavat ||20||
atha brahmādi-devānāṃ yathā prārthanayābhuvam |
āgacchatā gaṇāḥ sarve yātās te’pi mayā saha ||21||
ete hi yādavāḥ sarve mad-gaṇā eva bhāmini |
pitā te deva-śarmābhūt satrājid adhipohya yam ||22||
yaś candra-śarmāso’krūras tvaṃ sā guṇavatī śubhe |
kārttika-vrata-puṇyena bahu-mat-prīti-vardhanī ||23||
mama dvāre tvayā pūrvaṃ tulasī-vāṭikā kṛtā |
tasmād ayaṃ kalpa-vṛkṣas tavāṅgaṇataḥ śubhe ||24||
kārttike dīpamānaṃ ca yat tvayā tu kṛtaṃ purā |
tvad-deha-geha-saṃstheyaṃ tasmāl lakṣmī sthirābhavat ||25||
yac ca vratādikaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇave bhartṛ-rūpiṇe |
niveditavatī tasmān mama bhāryā tvam āgatā ||26||
ājanma-maraṇāt pūrvaṃ kārttike yad vrataṃ kṛtam |
kadācid api tenaiva mad-viyogaṃ na paśyasi ||27||
evaṃ ye kārttike māsi narā vrata-parāyaṇāḥ |
mat-sānnidhyaṃ gatās te’pi prītidā tvaṃ yathā mama ||28||
yajṣa-dāna-vrata-tapaḥ-kāriṇo mānavāḥ khalu |
kārttika-vrata-puṇyasya nāpnuvanti kalām api ||29||
itthaṃ niśamya bhuvanādhipates tadānīṃ 
prāk-puṇya-janma-bhava-vaibhava-jāta-harṣā |
viśveśvaraṃ tribhuvanaika-nidāna-bhūtaṃ 
kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya vacanaṃ nijagāda satyā ||30||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
satyā-pūrva-janma-varṇanaṃ nāmaikonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||89||

(90)
navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ
 
satyovāca—
sarve’pikālāvayavāstavakālasvarūpiṇaḥ |
samānās tu kathaṃ nātha māsānāṃ kārttiko varaḥ ||1||
ekādaśī-tithīnāṃ ca māsānāṃ kārttikaḥ priyaḥ |
kathaṃ te deva-deveśa kāraṇaṃ kiṃ ca kathyatām ||2||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayāsatyeśṛṇuṣva ikāgramānasā |
pṛthor vainyasya saṃvādaṃ devarṣer nāradasya ca ||3||
evam eva purāpṛṣṭonāradaḥ pṛthunāpriye |
uvāca— kārttikādhikye kāraṇaṃ sarvavin muniḥ ||4||
nārada uvāca—
śaṃkhanāmābhavatpūrvamasuraḥ sāgarātmajaḥ |
trilokīmatha neśaktomahābalaparākramaḥ ||5||
jitvā devān nirākṛtya svarga-lokān mahāsuraḥ |
indrādi-loka-pālānām adhikārāṃs tathāharat ||6||
tad-bhayād atha te devāḥ suvarṇādri-guhāṃ gatāḥ |
nyavasan bahu-varṣāṇi sāvarodhāḥ sa-vāsavāḥ ||7||
suvarṇādri-guhā-durga-saṃsthitās tridaśā yadā |
tad-vaśyāna babhūvus te tadā daityo vyacārayat ||8||
hṛtādhikārās tri-daśāmayā yady api nirjitāḥ |
bhavanti bala-yuktās te karaṇīyaṃ mamātrakim ||9||
adya jṣātaṃ mayā devā veda-mantra-balānvitāḥ |
tān hariṣye tataḥ sarve bala-hīnā bhavanti hi ||10||
iti matvā tato daityo viṣṇum ālakṣya nidritam |
satya-lokāj jahārāśu vedānāṃ ca gaṇaṃ prabhuḥ ||11||
nītās tu tena te vedās tad-bhayāt te nirākraman |
toye niviviśus te’tra yajṣa-mantra-samanvitāḥ ||12||
tān-mārgamāṇaḥ śaṅkho’pi samudrāntargato bhraman |
na dadarśa tato daityaḥ kvacid ekatra saṃsthitān ||13||
atha brahmāsuraiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaraṇam anvayāt |
pūjopakaraṇaṃ gṛhya vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ gataḥ ||14||
tatra tasya prabodhāya gīta-vādyādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
cakrur devā gandha-puṣpa-dhūpa-dīpān muhur muhuḥ ||15||
atha prabuddho bhagavāṃs tad-bhakti-paritoṣitaḥ |
dadṛśe taiḥ surais tatra sahasrārka-sama-dyutiḥ ||16||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ saṃpūjya tridaśās tadā |
daṇḍavat patitā bhūmau tān uvācātha keśavaḥ ||17||
viṣṇur uvāca—
varado’haṃ suragaṇāgītavādyādimaṃ galaiḥ |
mano’bhilaṣitānkāmānsarvānevadadāmivaḥ ||18||
iṣasyaśuklaikādaśyāyāvadudbodhinībhavet |
niśāturyāṃ śaśeṣeṇagītavādyādimaṃ galaiḥ ||19||
kurvanti manujānityaṃ bhavadbhiryadyathākṛtam |
tematpriyakarānityaṃ matsāṃ nidhyaṃ vrajanti hi ||20||
pādyārghācamanīyādyairbhavadbhiryadyathākṛtam |
tadadbhutaguṇaṃ yasmājjātaṃ vaḥ sukhakāraṇam ||21||
vedāḥśaṃkhahṛtāḥ sarvetiṣṭhanty udaka saṃsthitāḥ |
tānānayāmy ahaṃ devāhatvāsāgaranandanam ||22||
adyaprabhṛtivedāstumantrabījamakhānvitāḥ |
pratyabdaṃ kārttike māsi viśramaṃ tv apsu sarvadā ||23||
adyaprabhṛty ahamapibhavāmijalamadhyagaḥ |
bhavaṃ to’pimayāsārddhamāyāṃ tusamunīśvarāḥ ||24||
kāle’sminn eva kurvanti prātaḥ-snānaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
tesarvayajṣāvabhṛthaiḥ susnātāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ ||25||
yekārttike vrataṃ samyaṅnityaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ |
tedehāṃ tetvayāśakraprāpyāmadbhavanaṃ sadā ||26||
vighnebhyorakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ yayākāryaṃ mamājṣayā |
deyātvayācavaruṇaputrapautrādi saṃtatiḥ ||27||
dhanavṛddhirdhanādhyakṣatvayākāryāmamājṣayā |
mama rūpadharāḥ sākṣājjīvan muktāś ca tenarāḥ ||28||
ājanmama raṇādyaiś cakṛtametadvratottamam |
yathoktavidhināsamyaktemānyābhavatāmapi ||29||
ekādaśyāṃ yataś cāhaṃ bhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ |
ataś ca iṣātithirmānyāsadaivaprītidāmama ||30||
vratadvayaṃ samyag idaṃ naraiḥ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasyasānnidhyadamastinānyat |
dānānitīrthānitapāṃ siyajṣāḥ svarlokadānenasadāsurottamāḥ ||31||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
śaṃkhāsura-vadha udyamo nāma navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||90||

(91)
ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
ity uktvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥśapharītulyarūpadhṛk |
sapapātāṃ jalau vindhyenivāsekaśyapasyaca ||1||
sataṃ kamaṇḍalaukṣipraṃ kṛpayākṣiptavānmuniḥ |
tāvatsanamama utatratataḥkūpenyaveśayat ||2||
tatrāpinamama utāvatkāsāreprākṣipatsatām |
evaṃ sasāgarekṣiptastatraso’pyanvavarddhata ||3||
tato’vadhīt sataṃ śaṅkhaṃ viṣṇur vai matsya-rūpa-dhṛk |
atha taṃ sva-kare dhṛtvā badarī-vanam āgataḥ ||4||
tatrāhūyaṛṣīnsarvānidamājṣāpayadvibhuḥ |
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
jalāṃ tareviśīrṇāṃ stuyūyaṃ vedānpramārjatha ||5||
ānayadhvaṃ ca tvaritāḥ sarahasyaṃ jalāṃ tarāt |
tāvatprayāgetiṣṭhāmidevatāgaṇa saṃyutaḥ ||6||
nārada uvāca—
tatas taiḥ sarvamunibhis tapobalasamanvi## |
uddhāritāḥṣaḍaṃ gāstevedāyajṣasamanvitāḥ ||7||
teṣuyāvan mitaṃ yenalabdhaṃ tāvan mitasya hi |
sasaevaṛṣirjātastadāprabhṛtipārthiva ||8||
atha sarve’pi saṃgamyaprayāgaṃ munayoyayuḥ |
viṣṇavesavidhātretelabdhānvedānnyavedayan ||9||
labdhvāvedānsayajṣāṃ stubrahmāharṣasamanvitaḥ |
ayajaccāśvamedhenadevarṣigaṇa saṃvṛtaḥ ||10||
yajṣātedevadeveśasiddhapannagaguhyakāḥ |
nipatyadaṇḍavad bhūmau vijṣaptiṃ tatracakrire ||11||
devā ūcuḥ—
devadevajagannāthavijṣaptiṃ śṛṇunaḥ prabho |
harṣakālo’yamasmākaṃ tasmāttvaṃ varadobhava ||12||
sthāne’sminnṛṣayovedānnaṣṭānprāpuḥ punaḥ svayam |
yajṣabhāgānvayaṃ prāptāstvatprasādādramāpate ||13||
sthānametadapiśreṣṭhaṃ pṛthivyāṃ puṇyavarddhanam |
bhukti-mukti-pradaṃ cāstuprasādādbhavataḥ sadā ||14||
kālo’pyayaṃ mahāpuṇyobrahmaghnādiviśuddhikṛt |
dattākṣayakaraścāstubarametadvadasvanaḥ ||15||
śrīviṣṇur uvāca—
mamāpyetanmataṃ devāyadbhavadbhirudāhṛtam |
tattathāstulabhatvetadbrahmakṣetramitiprathām ||16||
sūryavaṃ śodbhavorājāgaṅgāmatrānayiṣyati |
sāsūryakanyayācātrakāliṃ dyā saṃgamiṣyati ||17||
yūyaṃ ca sarvebrahmādyānivasadhvaṃ mayāsaha |
tīrtharāje’tivikhyātaṃ tīrthametadbhaviṣyati ||18||
dānaṃ tapovrataṃ homojapapūjādikāḥkriyāḥ |
anaṃ taphaladāḥ saṃtumatsāṃ nidhyapradāḥ sadā ||19||
brahma-hatyādipāpānibahujanmakṛtānyapi |
darśanādasyatīrthasyavināśaṃ yāṃ tutat-kṣaṇāt ||20||
dehatyāgaṃ tathādhīrāḥkurvanti mama sannidhau |
mattanuṃ praviśaṃ tyevapunarjanmaninonarāḥ ||21||
pitṝnnirdiśyayeśrāddhaṃ kurvaṃ tyatrasamāgatāḥ |
teṣāṃ pitṛgaṇāḥ sarveyāṃ tutematsalokatām ||22||
kālo’pyeṣamahāpuṇyaphalado’stusadānṛṇām |
sūryyemakarageprātaḥ snāyināṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||23||
makarastharavaumāgheprātaḥ snānaṃ prakurvatām |
darśanādevapāpāniyānti sūryādyathātamaḥ ||24||
salokatvaṃ sarūpatvaṃ samīpatvaṃ trayaṃ kramāt |
nṛṇāṃ dadāmy ahaṃ snānānmāghemakarageravau ||25||
yūyaṃ munīśvarāḥ sarveśṛṇudhvaṃ varado’smivaḥ |
badarīvanamadhye’haṃ sadātiṣṭhāmisarvagaḥ ||26||
anyatra daśabhir varṣais tapasā vāpyate phalam |
tad atra divasaikena bhavadbhiḥ prāpyate sadā ||27||
sthānasyadarśanaṃ tasya yekurvanti narottamāḥ |
jīvan muktāstadāteṣupāpaṃ naivāvatiṣṭhate ||28||
sūta uvāca—
evaṃ devāndevadevastaduktvā tatraivāṃ tarddhānamāgātsavedhāḥ |
devāḥ sarve’pyaṃ śakais tatratasthuścāṃ tarddhānaṃ prāpurindrādayaste ||29||
imāṃ ca gāthāṃ śṛṇuyānnarottamoyaḥśrāvayedvāpiviśuddhacittaḥ |
satīrtharājaṃ badarīvanaṃ yatkṛtvāphalaṃ māṃ samavāpnuyāc ca ||30||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
śaṃkhāsura-vadho vedāgame prayāga-māhātmyaṃ 
nāmaikanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||91||

(92)
dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 

pṛthur uvāca—
mahāphalaṃ tvayāproktaṃ munekārttikamāghayoḥ |
tayoḥ snānavidhiṃ samyaṅniyamānapinārada |
udyāpanavidhiṃ caivaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi ||1||
nārada uvāca—
tvaṃ viṣṇor aṃśa-saṃjāto nājṣātaṃ vidyate tava |
tathāpivadataḥ samyaṅmāhātmyaṃ śṛṇuvenaja ||2||
āśvinasyatumāsasyayāśuklaikādaśībhavet |
kārttika-vrataniyamaṃ tasyāṃ kuryād atandritaḥ ||3||
rātryāṃ turyāṃ śaśeṣāyāṃ mudotiṣṭhatsadāvratī |
nairṛtyāṃ saṃvrajedvāsādbahiḥ sodakabhājanaḥ ||4||
divā saṃdhyāsukarṇasthabrahmasūtraudaṅmukhaḥ |
aṃ tardhāyatṛṇaṃ bhūmau śiraḥ prāvṛtyavāsasā ||5||
vaktraṃ niyamyayatnenaṣṭhīvanaśvāsavarjitaḥ |
kuryānmūtrapurīṣe ca rātrauceddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||6||
gṛhītaśiśnaścotthāyagṛhītvāśucimṛttikām |
gandhalepakṣayakaraṃ śaucaṃ kuryād atandritaḥ ||7||
ekāliṅgegudepaṣcatathāvāmakaredaśa |
ubhayoḥ saptadātavyās tathātisrastupādayoḥ ||8||
etaddvitriguṇaṃ proktaṃ brahmacārivanasthayoḥ |
yateścaturguṇaṃ rātrautadarddhaṃ śaucamācaret ||9||
tadarddhamapimārgasthaḥ strī-śūdrāṇāṃ tadarddhakam |
śaucakarmavi-hīnasyasakalāniṣphalāḥkriyāḥ ||10||
mukhaśuddhivi-hīnasyanomantrāḥ phaladāḥ smṛtāḥ |
daṃ tajihvāviśuddhiṃ ca tataḥ kuryātprayatnataḥ ||11||
āyurbalaṃ yaśovarcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūnica |
brahmaprajṣāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvannodehivanaspate ||12||
itimantraṃ samuccāryadvādaśāṃ gulakaṃ sadā |
samidhākṣīravṛkṣāsyakṣayāhopoṣaṇaṃ vinā ||13||
pratipaddarśanavamīṣaṣṭhīścārkadinaṃ vinā |
candrasūryoparāge ca nakuryād daṃ tadhāvanam ||14||
kaṇṭakīvṛkṣakārpāsanirguṇḍībrahmavṛkṣajam |
bilvairaṇḍavigandhāḍhyaṃ varjayed daṃ tadhāvanam ||15||
tatoviṣṇoḥ śivasyāpigṛhaṃ gacchetprasannadhīḥ |
gandha-puṣpasutāmbūlāngṛhītvābhaktitat-paraḥ ||16||
tatradevasyapādyārghādyupacārānpṛthak pṛthak |
kṛtvāstutvāpunarnatvākuryād gītādimaṃ galam ||17||
tālaveṇumṛdaṃ gādidhvaniyuktānsanṛttakān |
puṣpairgandhaiḥ satāmbūlairgāyanānapicārcayet ||18||
devālayegānaparāyatasteviṣṇumūrtayaḥ |
tapāṃ siyajṣa-dānānikṛtāni cajagadguroḥ ||19||
tuṣṭidānikalaunityaṃ bhaktyādevasyasatpateḥ |
kvatvaṃ vasasideveśamayāpṛṣṭastupārthiva ||20||
viṣṇur evaṃ tadāprāhamad-bhaktiparitoṣitaḥ |
nāhaṃ vasāmivaikuṭheyogināṃ hṛdayena ca ||21||
mad-bhaktāyatragāyanti tatratiṣṭhāminārada |
satpurāṇakathāṃ śrutvā mad-bhaktānāṃ ca gāyanam ||22||
necchanti yenarāmūḍhāmaddveṣyāstebhavanti hi |
teṣāṃ pūjādikaṃ gandha-puṣpādikrayatenaraiḥ ||23||
tenaprītiṃ tathāyāminatathāmatprapūjanāt |
śirīṣonmattagirijāmallikāśālmalībhavaiḥ ||24||
arkajaiḥ karṇikāraiś caviṣṇur nārcyas tathākṣataiḥ |
japā-kunda-śirīṣaiś ca yūthikā-mālatī-bhavaiḥ ||25||
ketakī-bhava-puṣpaiś ca naivārcyaḥ śaGkaras tathā |
gaṇeśaṃ tulasī-patrair durgā naiva ca dūrvayā ||26||
muni-puṣpais tathā sūryaṃ lakṣmī-kāmo na cārcayet |
sugandhīni praśastāni pūjāyāṃ sarvadaiva tu ||27||
evaṃ pūjā-vidhiṃ kṛtvā deva-devaṃ kṣamāpayet |
mantra-hīnaṃ kriyā-hīnaṃ bhakti-hīnaṃ sureśvara ||28||
yat pūjitaṃ mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ tad astu me |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat praṇipatya ca ||29||
punaḥ 	kṣamāpayed devaṃ gāyanādyaṃ kṣamāpayet |
viṣṇoḥ śivasyāpi ca pūjanādikaṃ 
kurvanti samyaṅ niśi kārttike ye |
nirdhūta-pāpāḥ saha pūrvajais te
prayānti viṣṇor bhavanaṃ manuṣyāḥ ||30||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
niyama-varṇanaṃ nāma 
dvi-navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||92||

[93]
trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
nāḍīdvayāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ rātraugacchejjalāśayam |
tilagandhākṣataiḥ puṣpairdīpādyaiḥ sahitaḥśuciḥ ||1||
mānuṣedevakhāte ca nadyāṃ nadyośca saṃgame |
kramāddaśaguṇaṃ snānaṃ tīrthe’naṃ taphalaṃ smṛtam ||2||
viṣṇuṃ smṛtvātataḥ kuryāt saṃkalpaṃ savanasyatu |
tīrthādidevatādibhyaḥkramādarghādidāpayet ||3||
auṃ namaḥkamalanābhāyanamastejalaśāyine |
namas te’stu hṛṣīkeśa-gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo ’stute ||4||
vaikuṇṭhe ca prayāge ca tathā badarikāśrame |
yato viṣṇur vicakrametredhāsani dadhe padam ||5||
ato devāmāmavaṃ yato viṣṇur vicakrame |
tair eva sahitaiḥ sarvair muni-deva-samanvitaiḥ ||6||
kārttike’haṃ kariṣyāmi prātaḥ snānaṃ surottama |
prīty-arthaṃ deva deveśa dāmodara mayā saha ||7||
dhyātvāhaṃ tvāṃ ca deveśa jale’smin snātum udyataḥ |
tava prasādāt pāpaṃ me dāmodara vinaśyatu ||8||
nitya-naimittike kṛṣṇe kārttike pāpa-nāśane |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rādhayā sahito hare ||9||
vratinā kārttike māsi snātasya vidhivan mama |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rādhayā sahitohare ||10||
smṛtvā bhāgīrathīṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ sūryaṃ jale viśet |
nābhi-mātre jale tiṣṭhan vratī snāyād yathā-vidhi ||11||
tilāmalaka-cūrṇena gṛhī snānaṃ samācaret |
vana-sthānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca tulasī-mūla-mṛttikā ||12||
saptamī-daśa-navamī dvitīyā-daśamīṣu ca |
trayodaśyāṃ ca na snāyād dhātrī-phala-tilaiḥ saha ||13||
ādau kuryān mala-snānaṃ mantra-snānaṃ tataḥ param |
strī-śūdrāṇāṃ na vedoktair mantrais teṣāṃ purāṇa-jaiḥ ||14||
snāna-mantrāḥ—
tridhābhūd deva-kāryāya yaḥ purā bhakti-bhāvataḥ |
sa viṣṇuḥ sarva-pāpaghnaḥ punātu kṛpayātra mām ||15||
viṣṇor ājṣām anuprāpya kārttika-vrata-kāraṇāt |
rakṣantu devās te sarve māṃ punantu sadaiva te ||16||
veda-mantrāḥ sa-bījās tu sa-rahasyāḥ sa-vīryakāḥ |
kaśyapādyāś ca munayo māṃ punantu sadaiva te ||17||
gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvās tīrthāni jala-dāna-dāḥ |
sa-sapta-sāgarāḥ sarve māṃ punantu jalāśayāḥ ||18||
pativratās tv adityādyā yakṣāḥ siddhāḥ sa-pannagāḥ |
oṣadhyaḥ parvatāś cāśu māṃ punantu trilokajāḥ ||19||
ebhiḥ snātvā vratī mantrair hasta-nyasta-pavitrakaḥ |
devarṣīn mānava-pitṝṃs tarpayec ca yathā-vidhi ||20||
yāvantaḥ kārttike māsi vartante pitṛ-tarpaṇe |
tilās tat-saṃkhyakābdāni pitaraḥ svarga-vāsinaḥ ||21||
tato jalād viniṣkramya śuci-vastrāvṛto vratī |
prātaḥ-kāloditaṃ karma samāpyārced dhariṃ punaḥ ||22||
tīrthādi-devān saṃsmṛtya punar arcāṃ pradāpayet |
gandha-puṣpa-phalair yukto bhakti-tat-para-mānasaḥ ||23||
argha-mantraḥ—
vratinaḥ kārttike māsi snātasya vidhivan mama |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ danujendra-niṣūdana ||24||
tataś ca brāhmaṇān bhaktyā bhojayed veda-pāragān |
gandha-puṣpaiḥ sa-tāmbūlaiḥ praṇamec ca punaḥ punaḥ ||25||
tīrthāni dakṣiṇe pāde vedāś ca mukham āśritāḥ |
sarvāṅge saṃsthitā devāḥ pūjitāḥ syur dvijārcanāt ||26||
avyakta-rūpiṇo viṣṇoḥ svarūpaṃ brāhmaṇā bhuvi |
nāvamānyāno virodhyāḥ kadācic chubham icchatā ||27||
tāṃ vai hari-priyāṃ devi tulasīm arcayed vratī |
pradakṣiṇa-namaskārān kuryād ekāgra-mānasaḥ ||28||
devais tvaṃ nirmitā pūrvam arcitāsi munīśvaraiḥ |
namo namas te tulasi pāpaṃ hara hari-priye ||29||
tato viṣṇu-kathāṃ śrutvā paurāṇīṃ snigdha-mānasaḥ |
taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ muniṃ vipraṃ pūjayed bhaktimān vratī ||30||
evaṃ pūrṇa-vidhiṃ samyak pūrvoktaṃ bhaktimān naraḥ |
karoti yaḥ sa labhate nārāyaṇa-salokatām ||31||
rogāpahaṃ pāpa-vināśa-kṛt paraṃ 
sad-buddhidaṃ putra-dhanādi-sādhanam |
mukter nidānaṃ nahi kārttika-vratād
viṣṇu-priyād anyatamaṃ hi bhū-tale ||32||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
snāna-vidhi-varṇano nāma trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||93||

(94)
caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca— 
kārttika-vratināṃ puṃsāṃ niyamāya prakīrtitāḥ |
tān śṛṇuṣva mayā rājan kathyamānān samantataḥ ||1||
sarvāmiṣāṇi māṃsāni kṣaudraṃ sauvīrakaṃ tathā |
rāja-māṣādikaṃ cāpi naivādyāt kārttika-vratī ||2||
dvidalanti latailaṃ ca tathānnam aśru-dūṣitam |
bhāva-duṣṭaṃ śabda-duṣṭaṃ varjayet kārttika-vratī ||3||
parānnaṃ ca para-drohaṃ para-dārā-gamaṃ tathā |
tīrthe pratigṛhaṃ nāpi gṛhṇīyāt kārttika-vratī ||4||
devadeva dvijānāṃ ca guroś ca vratinas tathā |
strī-rāja-mahatāṃ nindāṃ varjayet kārttike vratī ||5||
prāṇy-aṅgam āmiṣaṃ cūrṇaṃ phalejaṃ vīram āmiṣam |
dhānye masūrikā proktā cānnaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā ||6||
ajā-go-mahiṣī-kṣīrād anya-dugdhādi cāmiṣam |
dvija-krītā-rasāḥ sarve lavaṇaṃ bhūmijaṃ tathā ||7||
tāmra-pātra-sthitaṃ gavyaṃ jalaṃ palvala-saṃsthitam |
ātmārthaṃ pācitaṃ cānnam āmiṣaṃ tat smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ ||8||
brahmacaryam adhaḥ suptiḥ patrāvalyāṃ ca bhojanam |
caturtha-kāle bhuṣjīta kuryā devaṃ sadā vratī ||9||
narakasya caturdaśyāṃ tailābhyaṅgaṃ ca kārayet |
anyatra kārttika-snāyi tailābhyaṅgaṃ na kārayet ||10||
palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ śigruchatrākaṃ gṛṃ janaṃ tathā |
nālikāṃ mūlakaṃ hiṃ guṃ varjayet kārttika-vratī ||11||
alābuṃ cāpi vṛntākaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ bṛhatīphalam |
śleṣmātakaṃ kapitthaṃ ca varjayed vaiṣṇava-vratī ||12||
rajasvalāṃ tyaja mleccha-patita-vrātyakaiḥ saha |
dvijāti-veda-bāhyaiś ca na vadet kārttika-vratī ||13||
śvabhir dṛṣṭaṃ ca kākaiś ca sūtakānnaṃ ca varjayet |
dviḥ pācitaṃ ca dagdhānnaṃ varjayet kārttika-vratī ||14||
(tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathā śayyāṃ parānnaṃ kāṃsya-bhojanam |
kārttike varjayed yas tu paripūrṇa-vratī bhavet |) 
etāni varjayen nityaṃ vratī sarva-vrateṣv api |
kṛcchrādyaṃ cāpi kurvīta sva-śaktyā viṣṇu-tuṣṭaye ||15||
kramāt kūṣmāṇḍa-vṛntākaṃ bṛhatī-mūlakaṃ tathā |
śrī-phalaṃ ca kaliṅgaṃ ca phalaṃ dhātrī-bhavaṃ tathā ||16||
nārikeraṃ mahā-lābuṃ paṭolaṃ badarī-phalam |
carma-vaikatakaṃ cāpi bisaṃ vai kaṭ-ṃ tathā ||17||
śākāny etāni varjyāni kramāt pratipadādiṣu |
dhātrī-phalaṃ ravau tadvad varjayet sarvadā gṛhī ||18||
ebhyo’pi varjaye kaṃcid yad viṣṇu-prītaye naraḥ |
tat punar brāhmaṇe dattvā bhakṣayet sarvadaiva hi ||19||
evam eva hi māghe’pi kuryād vai niyamān vratī |
hari-jāgaraṇaṃ tatra vidhi-proktaṃ ca kārayet ||20||
yathokta-kāriṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kārttika-vratinaṃ naram |
yamadūtāḥ palāyante gajāḥ siṃhārditā yathā ||21||
varaṃ viṣṇu-vrataṃ hy etad atha yajṣa-śatādhikam |
yajṣa-kṛt prāpnuyāt svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ kārttika-vratī ||22||
bhukti-mukti-pradānīha yāni kṣetrāṇi bhūtale |
vasanti tāni tad-gehe kārttikra-vrata-kāriṇaḥ ||23||
duḥsvapnaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcin mano-vāk-kāya-karmajam |
kārttika-vratinaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilayaṃ yānti tat-kṣaṇāt ||24||
kārttika-vratinaḥ puṃso viṣṇu-vākya-praṇoditāḥ |
rakṣāṃ kurvanti śakrādyā rājṣo vai kiṅkarā yathā ||25||
viṣṇu-vrata-karā nityaṃ yatra tiṣṭhanti pūjitāḥ |
graha-bhūta-piśācādyā naiva tiṣṭhanti tatra vai ||26||
kārttika-vratinaḥ puṇyaṃ yathokta-vrata-kāriṇaḥ |
na samartho bhaved vaktuṃ brahmāpīha catur-mukhaḥ ||27||
viṣṇu-priyaṃ sakala-kalmaṣa-nāśanaṃ ca 
sarvatra putra-dhana-dhānya-samṛddhi-kāri |
ūrje vrataṃ sa-niyamaṃ kurute manuṣyaḥ 
kiṃ tasya tīrtha-pariśīlana-sevayā ca ||28||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
niyama-varṇano nāma catur-navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||94||

(94)
paṣca-navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
athorja-vratinaḥ samyag udyāpana-vidhiṃ nṛpa |
tac chṛṇuṣva mayākhyātaṃ kiṃ vidhānaṃ samāsataḥ ||1||
ūrja-śukla-caturdaśyāṃ kuryād udyāpanaṃ vratī |
vrata-saṃpūrṇatārthāya viṣṇu-prīty-artham eva ca ||2||
tulasyā upariṣṭāt tu kuryān maṇḍapikāṃ śubhām |
sutoraṇāṃ catur-dvārāṃ puṣpa-cāmara-śobhitām ||3||
dvāreṣu dvāra-pālāṃś ca pūjayen mṛn-mayān pṛthak |
puṇya-śīlaṃ suśīlaṃ ca jayaṃ vijayam eva ca ||4||
tulasī-mūla-deśe ca sarvato-bhadram ālikhet |
caturbhir varṇakaiḥ samyak śobhāḍhyaṃ samalaṅkṛtam ||5||
tasyopariṣṭāt sa-pidhānaṃ paṣca-ratna-samanvitam |
mahā-phalena saṃyuktaṃ kumbhaṃ tatra nidhāya ca ||6||
pūjayet tatra deveśaṃ śaṃkha-cakra-gadādharam |
kauśeya-pīta-vasanaṃ yuktaṃ jaladhi-kanyayā ||7||
indrādi-loka-pālāṃś ca pūjayen maṇḍale vratī |
dvādaśyāṃ pratibuddhaḥ sa trayodaśyāṃ yataḥ suraiḥ ||8||
dṛṣṭo’rcitaś caturdaśyāṃ tasmāt pūjyas tathādhikam |
tasyām upavased bhaktyā śāntaḥ prayata-mānasaḥ ||9||
pūjayed deva-deveśaṃ sauvarṇaṃ gurv-anujṣayā |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir nānā-bhakṣya-samanvitaiḥ ||10||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gīta-vādyādi-maṅgalaiḥ |
gītaṃ kurvanti ye bhaktyā jāgare cakra-pāṇinaḥ ||11||
janmāntara-śatodbhūtais te muktāḥ pāpa-saṣcayaiḥ |
jāgare vāsare viṣṇor gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kurvatām ||12||
go-sahasraṃ ca dadatāṃ tat phalaṃ samudāhṛtam |
gīta-nṛtyādikaṃ kurvan darśayet kautukāni ca ||13||
purato vāsudevasya rātrau yo hari-jāgare |
paṭhan viṣṇu-caritrāṇi yo raṣjayati vaiṣṇavān ||14||
mukhena kurute vādyaṃ svecchālāpāṃś ca darśayan |
bhāvair etair naro yas tu kurute hari-jāgaram ||15||
dine dine tasya puṇyaṃ tīrtha-koṭi-samaṃ smṛtam |
tatas tu paurṇamāsyāṃ vai sapatnīkān dvijottamān ||16||
triṃśan-mitān anekān vā sva-śaktyā vā nimantrayet |
varān dattvā yato viṣṇur matsya-rūpī abhūt tadā ||17||
tasyāṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tad-akṣaya-phalaṃ smṛtam |
atas tān bhojayed viprān pāyasānnādinā vratī ||18||
ato devā iti dvābhyāṃ juhuyāt tila-pāyasam |
prīty-arthaṃ deva-devasya devānāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak ||19||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathā-śakti pra dadyāt praṇamec ca tān |
punar devaṃ samabhyarcya devāṃś ca tulasīṃ tathā ||20||
tato gāṃ kapilāṃ tatra pūjayed vidhivad vratī |
guruṃ vratopadeṣṭāraṃ vastrālaṅkaraṇādibhiḥ ||21||
sapatnīkaṃ samabhyarcya gāṃ ca tasmai pradāpayet |
yuṣmat-prasādād deveśaḥ prasanno me bhavet tadā ||22||
vratād asmāc ca yat pāpaṃ sapta-janma-kṛtaṃ mayā |
tat sarvaṃ nāśamāyātu sthirā me cāstu santatiḥ ||23||
manorathāś ca saphalāḥ santu nityaṃ mamārcanāt |
dehāṃ te vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyām atidurlabham ||24||
iti kṣamāpya tān viprān prasādya ca visarjayet |
tām arcāṃ gurave dadyād ratna-yuktāṃ tadā vratī ||25||
tadā suhṛd-guru-yutaḥ svayaṃ bhuṣjati bhaktimān |
kārttike vātha tapasi vidhir evaṃ vidhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||26||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyak kārttikasya vrataṃ naraḥ |
vipāpmāsa-vinirmukto viṣṇu-sānnidhya-go bhavet ||27||
sarva-vrataiḥ sarva-tīrthaiḥ sarva-dānaiś ca yat phalam |
tat-koṭi-guṇitaṃ jṣeyaṃ samyag asya vidhānataḥ ||28||
te dhanyās te mahā-puṇyās teṣāṃ sarva-phalodayaḥ |
viṣṇu-bhakti-ratā ye syuḥ kārttike vrata-kāriṇaḥ ||29||
deha-sthitāni pāpāni vitarkaṃ yānti tad-bhayāt |
kva yāsyāmo vadanty evaṃ yady ayaṃ vrata-kṛn naraḥ ||30||
ity ūrja-vrata-niyamān śṛṇoti bhaktā 
ye caitat kathayanti caiva vaiṣṇavāgre |
te samyag vrata-karaṇāt phalaṃ labheran
tat sarvaṃ kaluṣa-vināśanaṃ labhante ||31||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyāṃ 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
udyāpana-varṇano nāma paṣca-navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||95||

kailāsamagamadrāhuḥ sarvaśukleṃ duvarcasam ||15||

niveditastadādeśānnaṃ dinācapraveśitaḥ |
tryaṃ bakābhrūlatā saṃjṣāpreritovākyamabravīt ||16||
rāhur uvāca—
deva pannaga-sevyasya trailokyādhipateḥ prabhoḥ |
sarvaratneśvarasyatvamājṣāṃ śṛṇuvṛṣadhvaja ||17||
śmaśānavāsinonityaṃ muṇḍamālādharasyaca |
digambarasyatebhāryākathaṃ haimavatīśubhā ||18||
ahaṃ ratnādhinātho’smisācastrīratna saṃjṣakā |
tasmānmama ivasāyogyānaivabhikṣāśinastava ||19||
nārada uvāca—
vadatyevaṃ tadārāhaubhrūmadhyācchūlapāṇinaḥ |
abhavatpuruṣoraudrastīvrāśanisamasvanaḥ ||20||
siṃhāsyaḥ pracalajjihvaḥ sajvalannayanomahān |
ūrdhvakeśaḥśuṣkatanurnṛsiṃhaivacāparaḥ ||21||
sataṃ khāditumārebhedṛṣṭvārāhurbhayāturaḥ |
adhāvadativegenabahiḥ sacadadhāratam ||22||
sacarāhurmahābāhurmeghagaṃ bhīrayāgirā |
uvāca—devadeveśaṃ pāhimāṃ śaraṇāgatam ||23||
brāhmaṇaṃ māṃ mahādevakhādituṃ samupāgataḥ |
etasmādrakṣadeveśaśaraṇāgatavatsala ||24||
mahādevovacaḥśrutvā brāhmaṇasyatadābravīt |
naivāsauvadhyatāmetidūto’yaṃ paravānyataḥ ||25||
muṃ cetipuruṣaḥśrutvā rāhuṃ tatyājasoṃ bare |
rāhuṃ tyaktvāsaṣuruṣomahādevaṃ vyajijṣapat ||26||
puruṣa uvāca—
kṣudhā māṃ bādhate svāmin kṣut-kṣāmaś cāsmi sarvathā |
kiṃ bhakṣyaṃ mama deveśatadājṣāpayamāṃ prabho ||27||
īśvara uvāca—
 saṃbhakṣayātmanaḥśīghraṃ māṃ saṃtvaṃ hastapādayoḥ ||28||
nārada uvāca—
saśivenaivamājṣaptaścakhādapuruṣaḥ svayam |
hastapādodbhavaṃ māṃ saṃśiraḥśeṣoyadābhavat ||29||
dṛṣṭvāśiro’vaśeṣaṃ tusuprasannaḥ sadāśivaḥ |
puruṣaṃ bhīma-karmāṇaṃ tamuvāca—savismayaḥ ||30||
īśvara uvāca—
tvaṃ kīrtimukha saṃjṣohibhavamaddvāragaḥ sadā |
tvadarcāṃ naivakurvanti naivatematpriyaṃ karāḥ ||31||
nārada uvāca—
tadāprabhṛtidevasyadvārekīrtimukhaḥ sthitaḥ |
nārcayaṃ tīhayepūrvaṃ teṣāmarcāvṛthābhavet ||32||
rāhurvimuktoyastenaso’patadbarbarasthale |
ataḥ sabarbarodbhūtaiti bhūmau pṛthāṃ gataḥ ||33||
tataś ca rāhuḥ punarevajātamātmānamasminnitimanyamānaḥ |
sametyasarvaṃ katha yāṃ babhūvajalandharāyeśaviceṣṭitaṃ tat ||34||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
dūta-saṃvādo jālandharopākhyānaṃ nāma navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||99||

(100)
śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
jālandharastutacchrutvākopākulitavigrahaḥ |
nirjagāmāśudaityānāṃ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ ||1||
gatastasyāgrataḥśukrorāhurdṛṣṭisthito’bhavat |
mukuṭaścāpatad bhūmau vegātpraskhalitastadā ||2||
daityasainyavṛtais tatravimānānāṃ śatais tadā |
vyarājatanabhaḥ pūrṇaṃ prāvṛṣīvabalāhakaiḥ ||3||
tasyodyogaṃ tadādṛṣṭvādevāḥśakrapurogamāḥ |
alakṣitatvarājagmuḥśūlinaṃ tevyajijṣapan ||4||
devā ūcuḥ— 
najānāsikathaṃ svāmindevāvijṣāpayanti bho |
tadasmadrakṣaṇārthāyajahisāgaranandanam ||5||
nārada uvāca—
itidevavacaḥśrutvā prahasyavṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
mahāviṣṇuṃ samāhūyavacanaṃ cedamabravīt ||6||
īśvara uvāca—
jālandharaḥkathaṃ viṣṇonahataḥ saṃgaretvayā |
tadbhayāccāpayāto’sityaktvāvaikuṇṭhamātmanaḥ ||7||
bhagavān uvāca—
tavāṃ śa saṃbhavatvāc cabhrātṛtvāc catathāśriyaḥ |
namayānihataḥ saṃkhyetvamenaṃ jahidānavam ||8||
īśvara uvāca—
nāyamebhirmahātejāḥśastrāstrairvadhyatemayā |
devaiḥ sarvaiḥ svatejoṃ śaḥśastrārthedīyatāṃ mama ||9||
nārada uvāca—
atha viṣṇumukhādevāḥ svatejāṃ sidadustadā |
tānyekatvaṃ gatānīśodṛṣṭvātejomahāṃ stadā ||10||
tenākaronmahādevaḥ sahasāśastramuttamam |
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāmajvālāmālātibhīṣaṇam ||11||
tejaḥ-śeṣeṇa ca tadā vajraṃ ca kṛtavān haraḥ |
tāvajjalandharodṛṣṭaḥkailāsatalabhūmiṣu ||12||
hastyaśvaratha pattīnāṃ koṭībhiḥ parivāritaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāharṣitāḥ sarvedevājagmuryathāgatam ||13||
gaṇāścasamanahyaṃ tayuddhāyātitvarānvitāḥ |
naṃ dībhavaktrasenānīmukhāḥ sarveśivājṣayā ||14||
avaterurgaṇāḥ sarvekailāsādyuddhadurmadāḥ |
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ kailāsopatyakābhuvi ||15||
pramathādhipadaityānāṃ ghoraṃ śastrāstra saṃkulam |
bherīmṛdaṃ gaśaṃkhaughanisvanairvīraharṣaṇaiḥ ||16||
gajāśvaratha śabdaiś canāditābhūrvyakaṃ pata |
śaktitomarabāṇaughairmuśalaprāsapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||17||
vyarājatanabhaḥ pūrṇamulkābhiriva saṃvṛtam |
nihatair atha nāgāśvaiḥ sarvābhūmirvyarājata ||18||
vajrāhatāścalaśiraḥśakalairiva saṃvṛtā |
pramathāhatadaityaughairdaityāhatagaṇais tathā ||19||
vasāsṛṅmāṃ sapaṃ kādyairbhūragamyābhavattadā |
pramathāhatadaityaughānbhārgavaḥ samajīvayat ||20|
yuddhepunaḥ punaś caiva mṛta saṃjīvanībalāt |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāvyākulībhūtvāgaṇāḥ sarvebhayārditāḥ ||21||
śaśaṃ surdevadeveśaṃ tatsarvaṃ śukraceṣṭitam |
atha rudramukhātkṛtyābabhūvātīvabhīṣaṇā ||22||
tālajaṃ ghodarīvakrāstanāpīḍitabhūruhā |
sāyuddhabhūmimāsādyabhakṣayaṃ tīmahāsurān ||23||
bhārgavaṃ svakaredhṛtvājagāmāṃ tarhitābhavat |
vidhṛtaṃ bhārgavaṃ dṛṣṭvādaityasainyagaṇāstadā ||24||
pramlānavadanādarpānnijaghnuryuddhadurmadāḥ |
athābhajyatadaityānāṃ senāgaṇabhayārditā ||25||
vāyuvegahatāyadvatprakīrṇatṛṇa saṃhatiḥ |
bhagnāṃ gatabhayātsenāṃ dṛṣṭvāharṣaṃ gaṇāyayuḥ ||26||
niśumbhaśumbhasenānyaukālanemiścavīryavān |
trayastevārayāmāsurgaṇasenāṃ mahābalāḥ ||27||
muṃ ca taḥśaravarṣāṇiprāvṛṣīvabalāhakāḥ |
tatodaityaśaraughāsteśalabhānāmivavrajāḥ ||28||
rurudhuḥkhaṃ diśaḥ sarvāgaṇasenāmakaṃ payan |
gaṇāḥśaraśatair bhinnārudhirāsāravarṣiṇaḥ ||29||
va saṃtekiṃ śukābhāsānaprājṣāyatakiṃ ca na |
patitāḥ pātyamānāścachinnābhinnāstadāgaṇāḥ ||30|
tyaktvā saṃgrāmabhūmiṃ tesarve’pivimukhābhavan ||31||
tataḥ prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ vilokyagajāsyanaṃ dīśvarakārttike yāḥ |
cirānvitādaityavarānprasahyanivārayāmāsuramarṣaṇāste ||32||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
daityasenā-vadho nāma śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

(101)
ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
tegaṇādhipatīndṛṣṭvānaṃ dībhamukhaṣaṇmukhān |
amarṣādabhyadhāvaṃ tadvaṃ dvayuddhāyadānavāḥ ||1||
naṃ dinaṃ kālanemiścaśumbholambodaraṃ tathā |
niśumbhaḥṣaṇmukhaṃ vegādabhyadhāvatadaṃ śitaḥ ||2||
niśumbhaḥkārttike yasyamayūraṃ paṣcabhiḥ śaraiḥ |
hṛdi vivyādha vegena mūrchitaḥ sa papāta ca ||3||
tataḥśaktidharaḥśaktiṃ yāvajjagrāharoṣitaḥ |
tāvanniśumbhovegenasvaśaktyātamapātayat ||4||
tatonaṃ dīśvarobāṇaiḥ kālanemimavidhyata |
saptabhiścahayānketūṃ stribhiḥ sārathimacchinat ||5||
kālanemistu saṃkruddhodhanuścicchedanaṃ dinaḥ |
tadapāsyasaśūlenataṃ vakṣasyahanaddṛḍham ||6||
saśūlabhinnahṛdayohatāśvohatasārathiḥ |
adreḥśikharamāmucyaśailādriṃ so’pyapātayat ||7||
atha śumbhogaṇeśaścaratha mūṣakavāhanau |
yudhyamānauśaravrātaiḥ parasparamavidhyatām ||8||
atha śumbhaṃ gaṇādhyakṣo hṛdi vivyādha patriṇā |
sārathiṃ paṣcabhirbāṇaiḥ pātayāmāsabhūtale ||9||
tataḥśumbho’tikruddho’pibāṇaṣaṣṭyāgaṇādhipam |
mūṣakaṃ ca tribhirviddhvānanādajaladasvanaḥ ||10||
mūṣakaḥśarabhinnāṃ gaścacālakṛtavedanaḥ |
lambodaraḥ samuttīryapadātirabhavannṛpa ||11||
tato lambodaraḥ śumbhaṃ hatvā paraśunā hṛdi |
apātayattadā bhūmau mūṣakaṃ cāruhatpunaḥ ||12||
kālanemirniśumbhaścaubhaulambodaraṃ śaraiḥ |
yugapajjaghnatuḥkopāttotreṇevamahādvipam ||13||
taṃ pīḍyamānamālokyavīrabhadromahābalaḥ |
abhyadhāvatavegenabhūtakoṭiyutastadā ||14||
kūṣmāṇḍābhairavāścāpi vetālāyoginīgaṇāḥ |
piśācāyoginī saṃghāgaṇāścāpi tamanvayuḥ ||15||
tataḥkilakilāśabdaiḥ siṃhanādaiḥ saghurghuraiḥ |
vināditāḍamarukaiḥ pṛthivīsamakaṃ pata ||16||
tatobhūtānidhāvanti bhakṣayanti smadānavān |
utpatanti patanti smananṛtuścaraṇāṃ gaṇe ||17||
naṃ dīcakārttike yaścasamāyātautvarānvitau |
nijaghnatūraṇedaityānniraṃ taraśaravrajaiḥ ||18||
chinnabhinnāhatair daityaiḥ pātitair bhartsitais tathā |
vyākulāsābhavatsenāviṣaṇṇavadanātadā ||19||
pravidhvastāṃ tataḥ senāṃ dṛṣṭvāsāgaranandanaḥ |
rathenātipatākenagaṇānabhiyayaubalī ||20||
hastyaśvaratha saṃhrādaḥ##khabherīravastadā |
abhavatsiṃhanādaścasenayorubhayostadā ||21||
jālandharaśaravrātair nīhārapaṭalairiva |
dyāvāpṛthivyorācchannamaṃ taraṃ samapadyata ||22||
gaṇeśaṃ paṣcabhirvidhvāśailādrimapipaṣcabhiḥ |
vīrabhadraṃ ca viṃśatyānanādajaladasvanaḥ ||23||
kārttike yastatodaityaṃ śaktyāvivyādhasatvaraḥ |
vyāghūrṇaḥśaktinirbhinnaḥkiṃ cidvyākulamānasaḥ ||24||
tataḥkrodhaparītākṣaḥkārttike yaṃ jalandharaḥ |
gadayātāḍayāmāsasacabhūmitale’patat ||25||
tathaivanaṃ dinaṃ vegādapātayatabhūtale |
tatogaṇeśvaraḥkruddhogadāṃ paraśunācchinat ||26||
vīrabhadras tribhir bāṇair hṛdi vivyādha dānavam |
saptabhiś ca hayān ketūn dhanuś channaṃ ca cicchide ||27||
tato’tikruddho daityendraḥ śaktim udyamya dāruṇām |
gaṇeśaṃ pātayāmāsa ratham anyaṃ samāruhat ||28||
abhyayād atha vegena vīrabhadraṃ ruṣānvitaḥ |
tatas tau sūrya saṃkāśau yuyudhāte parasparam ||29||
vīrabhadras tasya hayāṃs tathā bāṇair apātayat |
dhanuś ciccheda daityendro yuyudhe parighāyudhaḥ ||30||
sa vīrabhadraṃ tvarayābhigamya 
jaghāna daityaḥ parighena mūrdhni |
sa cāpi daityaḥ pravibhinna-mūrddhā
papāta bhūmau rudhiraṃ samudgiran ||31||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
daityasenā-parābhavo nāma ekādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||101||

(102)
dvyadhika śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
patitaṃ vīrabhadraṃ tudṛṃ ṣṭvārudragaṇābhayāt |
āgatās teraṇaṃ hitvākrośamānāmaheśvaram ||1||
atha kolāhalaṃ śrutvā gaṇānāṃ ca ndraśekharaḥ ||2||
abhyayādvṛṣamārūḍhaḥ saṃgrāmaṃ prahasanniva |
rudramāyāṃ tamālokyasiṃhanādairgaṇāḥ punaḥ ||3||
nivṛttāḥ saṃgaredetyānnijaghnuḥśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ |
daityāścabhīṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ dṛṣṭvāsarvevidudruvuḥ ||4||
kārttika-vratinaṃ dṛṣṭvāpātakānīvatadbhayāt |
atha jālandharodaityānvidrutānprekṣya saṃgare ||5||
roṣādadhāvaccaṇḍīśaṃ muṃ ca nbāṇānsahasraśaḥ |
śumbhoniśubho’śvamukhaḥkālanemirbalāhakaḥ ||6||
khaṅgaromāpracaṇḍaścaghasmaraścaśivaṃ yayuḥ |
bāṇāṃ dhakāra saṃcchannaṃ dṛṣṭvāgaṇabalaṃ śivaḥ ||7||
tadbāṇajālaṃ vicchidyasvabāṇairāvṛṇonnabhaḥ |
daityāṃś cabāṇavātyābhiḥ pīḍitānakarottadā ||8||
pracaṇḍajālabāṇaughairapātayatabhūtale |
khaṅgaromṇaḥśiraḥkopāttathāparaśunācchinat ||9||
balāhakasyacaśiraḥkhaṇṭvāgenākaroddvidhā |
baddhvācaghasmaraṃ daityaṃ pāśenābhyahanādbhuvi ||10||
vṛṣabheṇahatāḥkecitkecidbāṇairnirākṛtāḥ |
naśekurasurāḥ sthātuṃ gajāḥ siṃhārditāyathā ||11||
tataḥkopaparītātmāvegādrudraṃ jalandharaḥ |
āhvayāmāsasamaretīvrāśanisamasvanaḥ ||12||
jalandhara uvāca—
yudhyasvādyamayāsārddhaṃ kimebhirnihitais tava |
yaccakiṃ cidbalaṃ te’stitaddarśayajaṭādhara ||13||
nārada uvāca—
ity uktvā bāṇasaptatyājaghānavṛṣabhadhvajam |
tānaprāptānśitair bāṇaiś cicchedaprahasanniva ||14||
tatohayānadhvajaṃ chatraṃ dhanuścicchedasaptabhiḥ |
sacchinnadhanvāvirathogadāmādāyavīryavān ||15||
abhyadhāvacchivastāvadgadābāṇairdvidhākarot |
tathāpimuṣṭimudyamyayayaurudrajighāṃ sayā ||16||
tāvacchivenabāṇaughaiḥ krośamātramapākṛtaḥ |
tatojālandharodaityomatvārudraṃ balādhikam ||17||
sasarjamāyāṃ gāṃ dharvīmadbhutāṃ rudramohinīm |
tatojaguścananṛturgandharvāpsarasāṃ ragaṇāḥ ||18||
tālaveṇumṛdaṃ gāṃś cavādayaṃ taḥ parasparam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāmahadāścaryaṃ rudronādavimohitaḥ ||19||
patitānyapiśastrāṇikarebhyonavivedasaḥ |
ekāgrabhūtamālokyarudraṃ daityojalandharaḥ ||20||
kāmārtaḥ saṣjagāmāśuyatragaurīsthitābhavat |
yuddheśumbhaniśumbhākhyausthāpayitvāmahābalau ||21||
daśadordaṇḍapaṃ cāsyastrinetraścajaṭādharaḥ |
mahāvṛṣabhamārūḍhaḥ sababhūvajalandharaḥ ||22||
atha rudraṃ samāyāntam ālokya bhava-vallabhā |
abhyāyayausakhīmadhyāttaddarśanapathe’bhavat ||23||
yāvaddadarśacārvagīṃ pārvatīṃ danujeśvaraḥ |
tāvatsavīryaṃ mumucejaḍāṃ gaścābhavattadā ||24||
atha jṣātvātadāgaurīdānavaṃ bhayavihvalā |
jagāmāṃ tarhitātāvatsātadottaramānasam ||25||
tāmadṛṣṭvātadādaityaḥkṣaṇādvidyullatāmiva |
javenāyātpunaryuddhaṃ yatradevovṛṣadhvajaḥ ||26||
pārvatyapimahāviṣṇuṃ sasmāramanasātadā |
tāvaddadarśataṃ devīsopaviṣṭaṃ samīpagam ||27||
pārvatyuvāca—
viṣṇojalandharodaityaḥkṛtavānparamādbhutam |
tatkiṃ naviditaṃ te’sticeṣṭitaṃ tasya durmateḥ ||28||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
tenaivadarśitaḥ paṃ thāvayamapyanvayāmahe |
nānyathāsabhavedvadhyaḥ pātivratyātsurakṣitaḥ ||29||
nārada uvāca—
jagāmaviṣṇur ity uktvā punarjālandharaṃ puram |
atha rudraścagandharvānugataḥ saṃgaresthitaḥ ||30||
aṃ tarddhānagatāṃ māyāṃ dṛṣṭvātububudhetadā |
tataḥśivovismitamānasaḥ punarjagāmayuddhāyajalandharaṃ ruṣā ||31||
sacāpi daityaḥ punarāgataṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvāśaraughaiḥ samavākiradraṇe ||32||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
daitya-kapaṭa-varṇano nāma-dvy-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||102||

(103)
try-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
viṣṇur jālandharaṃ gatvātaddaityapuṭabhedanam |
pātivratyasyabhaṃ gāyavṛndāyāścākaronmatim ||1||
atha vṛndārakādevīsvapnamadhyedadarśaha |
bhartāraṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ tailābhyaktaṃ digambaram ||2||
kṛṣṇaprasūnabhūṣāḍhyaṃ kravyādagaṇasevitam |
dakṣiṇāśāṃ gataṃ muṇḍaṃ tamasāvyāvṛtaṃ tadā ||3||
svapuraṃ sāgaremagnaṃ sahasaivātmanāsaha |
tataḥ prabuddhāsābālāsvasvapnaṃ pravicinvatī ||4||
dadarśoditamādityaṃ sacchidraṃ niścalaṃ muhuḥ |
tadaniṣṭamitijṣātvārudatībhayavihvalā ||5||
kutracinnālabhaccharmagopurāṭṭālabhūmiṣu |
tataḥ sakhīdvayayutānagarodyānamāgamat ||6||
tatrāpisāgatābālānālabhatkutracitsukham |
vanādvanāṃ taraṃ yātānaivavedātmanastadā ||7||
tatobhramaṃ tesābālādadarśātivibhīṣaṇau |
rākṣasausiṃhavadanaudaṃṣṭrānayanabhīṣaṇau ||8||
taudṛṣṭvāvihvalātīvapalāyanaparātadā |
dadarśatāpa saṃśāntaṃ saśiṣyaṃ maunamāsthitam ||9||
tatas tatkaṇṭhaāsajyanijāṃ bāhulatāṃ bhayāt |
munemāṃ rakṣaśaraṇamāgatāmityabhāṣata ||10||
munistāṃ vihvalāṃ dṛṣṭvārākṣasānugatāṃ tadā |
huṃ kāreṇaivataughoraucakāravimukhauruṣā ||11||
yaddhuṃ kārabhayatrastaudṛṣṭvātaugaganaṃ gatau |
praṇamyadaṇḍavad bhūmau vṛndāvacanam abravīt ||12||
vṛndovāca—
rakṣitāhaṃ tvayāghorādbhayāttasmātkṛpānidhe |
kiṃ cidvijṣaptum icchāmikṛpayātanniśāmaya ||13||
jalandharohimebhartārudraṃ yoddhuṃ gataḥ prabho |
satatrāstikathaṃ yuddhetanmekatha yasuvrata ||14||
nārada uvāca—
##nistadvākyamākarṇyakṛpayordhvamavaikṣata |
tāvatkapīśāvāyātautaṃ praṇamyāgrataḥ sthitau ||15||
tatas tadbhrūlatā saṃjṣāniyuktaugaganaṃ gatau |
gatvākṣaṇārddhādāgatyavānarāvagrataḥ sthitau ||16||
śiraḥkabaṃ dhahastautaudṛṣṭvābdhitanayasyasā |
papātamūrchitā bhūmau bhartṛvyasanaduḥkhitā ||17||
kamaṇḍalujalaiḥ siktāmunināśvāsitātadā |
svabhartṛbhālesābhālaṃ kṛtvākhinnārurodaha ||18||
vṛndovāca—-
yaḥ purā sukha-saṃvādair vinoda yasmiṃ vibho |
sa kathaṃ na vadasy adya vallabhāṃ mām anāgasam ||19||
yena devāḥ sa-gandharvā nirjitā hariṇā saha |
sa kathaṃ tāpasena tvaṃ trailokya-vijayī hataḥ ||20||
nārada uvāca—
ruditveti tadā vṛndā taṃ muniṃ vākyam abravīt |
vṛndovāca—
kṛpā-nidhe muni-śreṣṭha jīvanaṃ me’sya supriyam ||21||
tvam evāsya punaḥ śakto jīvanāya mato mama |
atha tad-vākyam ākarṇya prahasya munir abravīt ||22||
munir uvāca—
nāyaṃ jīvayituṃ śakyo rudreṇa nihato yudhi |
tathāpi tvat-kṛpāviṣṭa evaṃ saṃjīvayāmy aham ||23||
nārada uvāca—
ity uktvā ntar dadhe yāvat tāvat sāgara-nandanaḥ |
vṛndām āliṅgya tad-vaktraṃ cucumbe prīta-mānasaḥ ||24||
atha vṛndāpi bhartāraṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣita-mānasā |
reme tad-vana-madhyasthā tad-yuktā bahu-vāsaram ||25||
kadācit suratasyānte dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ tam eva hi |
nirbhartsya krodha-saṃyuktā vṛndā-vacanam abravīt ||26||
vṛndovāca—
dhik tavedaṃ hare śīlaṃ para-dārābhigāminaḥ |
jṣāto’si tvaṃ mayā samyaṅ māyā-pratyakṣa-tāpasaḥ ||27||
yau tvayā māyayā dvāsthau svakīyau darśitau mama |
tāv eva rākṣasau bhūtvā bhāryāṃ tava hariṣyatha ||28||
tvaṃ cāpi bhāryā duḥkhārto vanekapi sahāyavān |
bhrama sarveśvareṇāyaṃ yas te śiṣyatvam āgataḥ ||29||
ity uktvā  sā tadā vṛndā prāviśad dhavya-vāhanam |
viṣṇunā vāryamāṇāpi tasminn āsakta-mānasā ||30||
tato haris tām anu saṃsmaran muhur 
vṛndācitā-bhasma-rajo’vaguṇṭhitaḥ |
tatraiva tasthau muni-siddha-saṃghaiḥ 
prabodhyamāno’pi yayau na śāntim ||31||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
vṛndācitāgni-praveśo nāma try-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||103||

(104)
catur-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

nārada uvāca—
tato jalandharo dṛṣṭvā rudram adbhuta-vikramam |
cakāra māyayā gaurīṃ try-ambakaṃ mohayaṃs tadā ||1||
rathoparigatāṃ dṛṣṭvā rudantīṃ ca tadā śivaḥ |
śumbha-niśumbha-daityaiś ca vadhyamānāṃ dadarśa saḥ ||2||
gaurīṃ tathā-vidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā śivo’py udvigna-mānasaḥ |
avāṅ-mukhaḥ sthitas tūṣṇīṃ vismṛtya sva-parākramam ||3||
tato jalandharo vegāt tribhir vivyādha sāyakaiḥ |
āpuṅkha-magnais taṃ rudraṃ śirasy urasi codare ||4||
tato jajṣe satāṃ māyāṃ viṣṇunā samprabodhitaḥ |
raudra-rūpa-dharo jāto jvālā-mālāti-bhīṣaṇaḥ ||5||
tasyātīva mahā-raudraṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāsurāḥ |
na śekuḥ pramukhe sthātuṃ bhejire ca diśo daśa ||6||
tataḥ śāpaṃ dadau devas tayoḥ śumbha-niśumbhayoḥ |
mama yuddhād apakrāntau gauryā vadhyau bhaviṣyathaḥ ||7||
punar jalandharo vegād vavarṣa niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ |
bāṇāndhakāra-saṃcchannaṃ yathā bhūmi-talaṃ mahat ||8||
yāvad rudraḥ praciccheda tasya bāṇāṃs tvarānvitaḥ |
tāvat sa parigheṇāśu jaghāna vṛṣabhaṃ balī ||9||
vṛṣas tena prahāreṇa parāvṛtto raṇāṅgaṇāt |
rudreṇākṛṣyamāṇo’pi na tasthau raṇa-bhūmiṣu ||10||
tataḥ parama-saṅkruddho rudro raudra-vapur-dharaḥ |
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ vegāccikṣepādityavarcasam ||11||
pradahadrodasīvegāttadāsādyajalandharam |
jahāratacchiraḥkāyānmahadāyatalocanam ||12||
rathātkāyaḥ papātorvyāṃ nādayanvasudhātalam |
tejaścanirgataṃ dehāttadrudrelayamāgamat ||13||
dṛṣṭvādehodbhavaṃ tejastadgaurīśelayaṃ gatam |
atha cendrādayodevāharṣādutphullalocanāḥ ||14||
praṇamyaśirasārudraṃ śaśaṃ surviṣṇuceṣṭitam |
devā ūcuḥ—
mahādevatvayādevārakṣitāḥśatrujādbhayāt ||15||
kiṃ cidanyatsamudbhūtaṃ tatrakiṃ karavāmahai |
vṛndālāvaṇya saṃbhrāṃ toviṣṇustiṣṭhatimohitaḥ ||16||
īśvara uvāca—
gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ devāviṣṇor mohāpanuttaye |
śaraṇyāṃ mohinīṃ māyāṃ sāvaḥkāryaṃ kariṣyati ||17||
nārada uvāca—
ity uktvā ṃ tardadhedevaḥ sahabhūtagaṇais tathā |
devāścatuṣṭuvurmūlaprakṛtiṃ bhakta-vatsalām ||18||
devā ūcuḥ— 
yadudbhavāḥ satvarajastamoguṇāḥ sargasthitidhvaṃ sanidāna kāraṇam |
yadicchayāviśvamidaṃ bhavābhavautanotiśuddhāṃ prakṛtiṃ natāḥ smatām ||19||
yehitrayoviṃśatibhedi saṃjṣitājagatyaśeṣesamadhiṣṭhitāpurā |
yadrūpakarmāṇijaḍāstrayo’pitedevāvidurnaprakṛtiṃ natāḥ smatām ||20||
yadbhaktiyuktāḥ puruṣāstunityaṃ dāridryavyāmohaparābhavādikam |
naprāpnuvantyevahibhakta-vatsalāṃ sadaivaviṣṇoḥ prakṛtiṃ natāḥ smatām ||21||
nārada uvāca—
stotrametattri saṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedekāgramānasaḥ |
dāridramohaduḥkhāninakadācitspṛśanti tam ||22||
itistuvantastedevāstejomaṇḍalamāsthitām |
dadṛśurgaganetatrajvālāvyāptadigaṃ tarām ||23||
tanmadhyādbhāratīṃ sarvedadṛśurvyomacāriṇīm |
ahamevatridhābhinnātiṣṭhāmitrividhairguṇaiḥ ||24||
gaurīlakṣmīsvarācetirajaḥ sattvatamoguṇaiḥ |
tatragacchatataṃ kāryaṃ vidhāsyanti cavaḥ surāḥ ||25||
nārada uvāca—
śṛṇvatāmitidevānāmaṃ tarddhānamagānmahaḥ |
devānāṃ vismayotphullanetrāṇāṃ tattadānṛpa ||26||
tataḥ sarve’pitedevāgatvātadvākyanoditāḥ |
gaurīṃ lakṣmīṃ svarāṃ caivapraṇemurbhaktitat-parāḥ ||27||
tatas tās tān surān dṛṣṭvā praṇatān bhakta-vatsalāḥ |
bījāni pradadus tebhyo vākyāny ūcuś ca bhūmipa ||28||
devya ūcuḥ—
imāni kṣetra-bījāniviṣṇur yatrāvatiṣṭhati |
nirvapadhvaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhavatāṃ siddhim eṣyati ||29||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
jālandhara-vadho nāma catur-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

(105)
paṣcādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 

nārada uvāca—
kṣiptebhyastatrabījebhyovanaspatyastrayobhavan |
dhātrī ca mālatī caiva tulasī ca nṛpottama ||1||
dhātry-udbhavā smṛtā dhātrī mābhavā mālatī smṛtā |
gaurī bhavā ca tulasī tamaḥ-sattva-rajo-guṇāḥ ||2||
strīrūpiṇyauvanaspatyaudṛṣṭvāviṣṇustadānṛpa |
uttasthausaṃbhramādvṛndārūpātiśayamohitaḥ ||3||
dadarśa tās tadā mohāt kāmāsaktena cetasā |
taṃ cāpi tulasī-dhātryau rāgeṇaivāvalokatām ||4||
yaccalakṣmyāpurābījaṃ māyayaivasamarpitam |
tasmāttadudbhavānārītasminnīrṣyāyutābhavat ||5||
ataḥ sābarbarītyākhyāmādhavasyātigarhitā |
dhātrītulasyaitadrāgāttasya prītipradesadā ||6||
tatovismṛtaduḥkho’sauviṣṇustābhyāṃ sahaivatu |
vaikuṇṭhamagamaddhṛṣṭaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ||7||
kārttiko dyāpaneviṣṇostasmātpūjā-vidhīyate |
tulasī-mūla-deśe tu prītidā sā yataḥ smṛtā ||8||
tulasī-kānanaṃ rājan gṛhe yasyāvatiṣṭhate |
tad-gṛhaṃ tīrtha-rūpaṃ tu nāyānti yama-kiṅkarāḥ ||9||
sarva-pāpa-haraṃ puṇyaṃ kāmadaṃ tulasī-vanam |
ropayanti nara-śreṣṭhā na te paśyanti bhāskarim ||10||
darśanaṃ narmadāyās tu gaṅgā-snānaṃ tathaiva ca |
tulasī-vana-saṃsargaḥ samam etat trayaṃ smṛtam ||11||
ropaṇāt pālanāt sekād darśanāt sparśanān nṛṇām |
tulasī dahate pāpaṃ vāṅ-manaḥ-kāya-saṃcitam ||12||
tulasī-maṣjarībhir yaḥ kuryād dhari-harārcanam |
na sa garbha-gṛhaṃ yāti mukti-bhāgī na saṃśayaḥ ||13||
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā |
vāsudevādayo devās tiṣṭhanti tulasī-dale ||14||
tulasī-maṣjarī-yukto yadi prāṇān vimuṣcati |
viṣṇoḥ sāyujyam āpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ nṛpottama ||15||
tulasī-mṛttikā-lipto yas tu prāṇān vimuṣcanti |
yamo’pi nekṣituṃ śakto yuktaṃ pāpa-śatair api ||16||
tulasī-kāṣṭha-jaṃ yas tu candanaṃ dhārayen naraḥ |
tad-dehaṃ na spṛśet pāpaṃ kriyamāṇam apīhayat ||17||
tulasī-vipina-cchāyā yatra yatra bhaven nṛpa |
tatra śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam ||18||
dhātrīchāyāsuyaḥ kuryātpiṇḍadānaṃ nṛpottama |
tṛptiṃ ca yānti pitaras tasya yenarakesthitāḥ ||19||
mūrdhnipāṇaumukhe caivadehe ca nṛpasattama |
dhatte dhātrī-phalaṃ yas tu savijṣeyohariḥ svayam ||20||
dhātrī-phalaṃ ca tulasī-mṛttikā-dvārakodbhavā |
yasya dehe sthitā nityaṃ sajīvan mukta ucyate ||21||
dhātrī-phala-vimiśrais tu tulasī-dala-miśritaiḥ |
jalaiḥ snāti naras tasya gaṅgā-snāna-phalaṃ smṛtam ||22||
devārcanaṃ naraḥ kuryād dhātrī-patraiḥ phalair api |
suvarṇapuṣpairvividhairarcanasyāpnuyātphalam ||23||
tīrthāni munayo devā yajṣāḥ sarve’pi kārttike |
nityaṃ dhātrīṃ samāśritya tiṣṭhanty arke tulāśrite ||24||
dvādaśyāṃ tulasī-patraṃ dhātrī-patraṃ tu kārttike |
lunāti sa naro gacchen nirayān atigarhitān ||25||
dhātrī-chāyāṃ samāśritya kārttike ‘nnaṃ bhunakti yaḥ |
anna-saṃsargajaṃ pāpam āvarṣaṃ tasya naśyati ||26||
dhātrī-mūle tu yo viṣṇuṃ kārttike ‘rcayate naraḥ |
viṣṇu-kṣetreṣu sarveṣu pūjitas tena sarvadā ||27||
dhātrī-tulasyor māhātmyam api devaś caturmukhaḥ |
na samartho bhaved vaktuṃ yathā devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ||28||
dhātrī-tulasy-udbhava-kāraṇaṃ ca 
śṛṇoti yaḥ śrāvayate ca bhaktyā |
vidhūta-pāpmā saha pūrvajaiś ca 
svargaṃ vrajaty agrya-vimāna-saṃsthaḥ ||29||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
dhātrī-tulasyor māhātmyaṃ nāma 
paṣcādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ
||105||

(106)
ṣaḍadhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

pṛthar uvāca—
setihāsamimaṃ brahmanmāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tvayā |
atyāścarya-karaṃ samyak tulasyās tu śrutaṃ mahat ||1||
yadūrja-vratinaḥ puṃsaḥ phalaṃ mahadudāhṛtam |
tatpunarbrūhimāhātmyaṃ kenacīrṇamidaṃ katha m ||2||
nārada uvāca—
āsītsahyādriviṣayekaravīrapurepurā |
brāhmaṇodharmavitkaściddharmadatto’tiviśrutaḥ ||3||
viṣṇu-vratakaraḥśaśvadviṣṇu-pūjārataḥ sadā |
dvādaśākṣaravidyāyāṃ japaniṣṭho’tithipriyaḥ ||4||
kadācitkārttike māsiharijāgaraṇāyasaḥ |
rātryāturyāṃ śaśeṣā##jagāmaharimandiram ||5||
hari-pūjopakaraṇān pragṛhya vrajatā tadā |
tena dṛṣṭā samāyātā rākṣasī bhīma-niḥsvanā ||6||
vakra-daṃṣṭrānanā-jihvā nimagnārakta-locanā |
digambarā śuṣka-māṃsālamboṣṭhī gharghara-svanā ||7||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaya-vitrastaḥ kampitāvayavas tadā |
pūjopakaraṇair vegāt payobhiś cāhanad bhayāt ||8||
saṃsmṛtya ca harer nāma tulasī-yuta-vāriṇā |
sāhatāpātakaṃ tasmāttasyāḥ sarvamagātkṣayam ||9||
atha saṃsmṛtyasāpūrvajanmakarmavipākajam |
svāṃ daśāmabravītsarvāṃ daṇḍavattaṃ praṇamyasā ||10||
kalahovāca—
pūrvakarmavipākenadaśāmetāṃ gatāhyaham |
tatkathaṃ tupunarviprayāmyuttamagatiṃ śubhām ||11||
nārada uvāca—
tāṃ dṛṣṭvāpraṇatāmagrevadamānāṃ svakarmatat |
atīvavismitoviprastadāvacanam abravīt ||12||
dharmadatta uvāca—
kenakarmavipākenatvaṃ daśāmīdṛśīṃ gatā |
kutastvaṃ kācakiṃ śīlātatsarvaṃ katha yasvame ||13||
kalahovāca
saurāṣṭranagarebrahmanbhikṣunāmābhavad dvijaḥ |
tasyā’haṃ gṛhiṇīpūrvaṃ kalahākhyātiniṣṭhurā ||14||
nakadācinmayābharturvacasāpiśubhaṃ kṛtam |
nārpitaṃ tasya miṣṭānnaṃ bharturvacanabhaṃ gayā ||15||
kalahapriyayānityaṃ bhayodvignastadādvijaḥ |
pariṇetuṃ tadā’nyāṃ samatiṃ ca krepatirmama ||16||
tatogaraṃ samādāyaprāṇāstyaktāmayādvija |
atha badhvābadhyamānāṃ māṃ vininyuryamānugāḥ ||17||
yamaś ca māṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā citraguptam apṛcchata |
yama uvāca—
anayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ karmacitraguptavilokaya ||18||
prāpnotveṣākarmaphalaṃ śubhaṃ vāśubham eva ca |
citraguptastatovākyaṃ bhartsayansam uvāca—ha ||19||
citragupta uvāca—
anayā tu śubhaṃ karma-kṛtaṃ kiṃcin na vidyate |
miṣṭānnaṃ bhuktamanayānabhartaritadarpitam ||20||
ataś ca valgulīyonyāṃ svaviṣṭhādāvatiṣṭhatu |
bhartur dveṣakarītveṣānityaṃ kalahakāriṇī ||21||
viṣṭhādāśūkarīyonyāṃ tatas tiṣṭhatviyaṃ hare |
pākabhāṇḍesadābhuktaṃ nityaṃ ca ivānayāyataḥ ||22||
tasmāddoṣādbiḍālītusvajātāpatyabhakṣiṇī |
bhartāramanayoddiśyahyātmaghātaḥkṛtoyataḥ ||23||
tasmātpretapiśāceṣutiṣṭhatveṣātiniṃ ditā |
tataś caivamaruṃ deśaṃ prāpitavyābhaṭaiḥ saha ||24||
tatrapretaśarīrākhyāciranti ṣṭhatviyaṃ tataḥ |
itthaṃ yonitrayaṃ tveṣābhunaktvāśubhakāriṇī ||25||
kalahovāca-
sāhaṃ paṣcaśatābdānipretadehesthitākila |
kṣutṛḍbhyāṃ pīḍitānityaṃ duḥkhitāsvenakarmaṇā ||26||
tataḥkṣutpīḍitānityaṃ śarīraṃ vaṇijastvaham |
āyātādakṣiṇaṃ deśaṃ kṛṣṇāveṇyāstusaṃgame ||27||
tattīrasaṃśritāyāvattāvattasya śarīrataḥ |
śivaviṣṇugaṇairdūramapākṛṣṭābalādaham ||28||
tataḥkṣutkṣāmayādṛṣṭobhramaṃ tyātvaṃ mayādvija |
prakṣipta-tulasī-vāri-saṃsarga-gata-pāpayā ||29||
tatkṛpāṃ kuruviprendrakathaṃ muktimiyāmy aham |
yonitrayādatibhayādasmāc capretadehataḥ ||30||
itthaṃ niśamyakalahāvacanaṃ dvijaścatatkarmapākabhavavismayaduḥkhayuktaḥ |
tadglānidarśanakṛpācalacittavṛttirdhyātvāciraṃ savacanaṃ nijagādaduḥkhāt ||31||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye 
kalahopākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaḍ-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||106||

(107)

saptādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

dharmadatta uvāca—
vilayaṃ yānti pāpānitīrthadānavratādibhiḥ |
pretadehasthitāyāsteteṣunaivādhikāritā ||1||
tvadglānidarśanādasmāitkhannaṃ ca mama mānasam |
naivanirvṛtimāyātitvāmanuddhṛtyaduḥkhitām ||2||
pātakaṃ ca tavātyugraṃ yonitrayavipākadam |
naivānyaiḥ kṣīyatepuṇyaiḥ pretatvaṃ cātigarhitam ||3||
tasmādājanmajanitaṃ yanmayākārttika-vratam |
tatpuṇyasyārddhabhāgenasadgatiṃ tvamavāpnuhi ||4||
kārttika-vrata-puṇyena na sāmyaṃ yānti sarvathā |
yajṣa-dānāni tīrthāni vratāny api yato dhruvam ||5||
nārada uvāca—
ity uktvā dharma-datto’sau yāvat tām abhyaṣecayat |
tulasī-miśra-toyena śrāvayan dvādaśākṣaram ||6||
tāvatpretatvanirmuktājvaladagniśikhopamā |
divyavapurdharājātālāvaṇyādbhāsitādiśaḥ ||7||
tataḥ sādaṇḍavad bhūmau praṇanāmāthataṃ dvijam |
uvāca ca tadā vākyaṃ harṣa-gadgada bhāṣiṇī ||8||
kalahovāca
tvatprasādāddvijaśreṣṭhavimuktānirayādaham |
pāpābdhaumaṣjamānāyāstvaṃ nobhūto’simedhruvam ||9||
nārada uvāca—
itthaṃ sāvadatīvipraṃ dadarśāyātamaṃ barāt |
vimānaṃ bhāsvaraṃ yuktaṃ viṣṇur ūpadharairgaṇaiḥ ||10||
atha sātadvimānāgryadvāsthābhyāmadhirohitā |
puṇyaśīlasuśīlābhyāmapsarogaṇasevitam ||11|
tadvimānaṃ tadāpaśyaddharmadattaḥ savismayaḥ |
papātadaṇḍavad bhūmau dṛṣṭvātaupuṇyarūpiṇau ||12||
puṇyaśīlasuśīlautamutthāpyapraṇataṃ dvijam |
abhyanaṃ dayatāṃ vākyamūcaturddharmaśālinau ||13||
gaṇāūcatuḥ— 
sādhu sādhu dvijaśreṣṭhayastvaṃ viṣṇur ataḥ sadā |
dīnānukaṃ pīdharmajṣoviṣṇu-vrataparāyaṇaḥ ||14||
ājanmasacchubhaṃ hy etadyattvayākārttika-vratam |
kṛtaṃ tasyārddhadānenayadasyāḥ pūrvasaṃcitam ||15||
janmāṃ taraśatodbhūtaṃ pāpaṃ tadvilayaṃ gatam |
harijāgaraṇādyaiś cavimānamidamāgamat ||16||
vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sānnidhyaṃ ca svarūpatā |
tedhanyāḥkṛtakṛtyāsteteṣāṃ ca saphalobhavaḥ ||17||
yairbhaktyārādhitoviṣṇur dharmadattatvayāyathā |
samyag ārādhitoviṣṇuḥkiṃ nayacchatidehinām ||18||
auttānacaraṇiryenadhruvatvesthāpitaḥ purā |
yannāma smaraṇādevadehinoyānti sadgatim ||19||
grāhagṛhītonāgendroyannāma smaraṇātpurā |
vimuktaḥ sannidhiṃ prāptojātoyojayasaṃjṣakaḥ ||20||
atastvayārcitoviṣṇuḥ svasānnidhyaṃ pradāsyati ||
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇibhāryādvayayutasya te ||21||
tataḥ puṇyakṣayejāteyadāyāsyasibhūtale |
sūryavaṃ śodbhavorājāvikhyātastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||22||
nāmnādaśaratha statrabhāryādvayayutaḥ punaḥ |
tṛtīyaṃ yānayācāpi yātepuṇyārddhabhāginī ||23||
tatrāpitavasānnidhyaṃ viṣṇur yāsyatibhūtale |
ātmānaṃ tavaputratveprakalpyāmarakāryakṛt ||24||
tavājanmavratādasmādviṣṇusaṃtuṣṭikārakāt |
nayajñānacadānāninatīrthānyadhikānite ||25||
dhanyo’sivipraprayatastvayaitadbrataṃ kṛtaṃ tuṣṭikaraṃ jagadguroḥ |
yadardhabhāgāc caphalānmurāreḥ praṇīyatesmābhiriyaṃ salokatām ||26||
iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye 
śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde kalahopākhyānonāma saptādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||107||
aṣṭādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ
nārada uvāca—
itthaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmadattaḥ savismayaḥ |
praṇamyadaṇḍavad bhūmau vākyametad uvāca—ha ||1||
dharmadatta uvāca—
ārādhayanti sarve’piviṣṇuṃ bhaktārtināśinam |
yajṣairdānairvratais tīrthais tapobhiścayathāvidhi ||2||
viṣṇuprītikaraṃ teṣāṃ viṣṇusānnidhyakārakam |
yatkṛtvātānicīrṇānisarvāṇyapibhavanti hi ||3||
gaṇāv ūcatuḥ— 
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayāvipraśṛṇuṣva ikāgramānasaḥ |
setihāsāṃ kathāṃ viprakathyamānāṃ purābhavām ||4||
kāṃ tipuryāṃ purācolacakravartīnṛpo’bhavat |
yasyanāmnācatedeśāścolākhyāabhavankila ||5||
yasminaśāsatibhūcakraṃ daridronaivaduḥkhitaḥ |
pāpabuddhiḥ sarugvāpinaivakaścidabhūnnaraḥ ||6||
yasyāpyatyaṃ tayajṣasyatāmraparṇītaṭāvubhau |
suvarṇayūpaiḥ śobhāḍhyāvāstāṃ ca itrarathopamau ||7||
sakadācidagādrājāhyanaṃ taśayanaṃ dvija |
yatrāsaujagatāṃ nāthoyoganidrāmupāsate ||8||
tatraśrīramaṇaṃ devaṃ saṃpūjyavidhivannṛpaḥ |
maṇimuktāphalair divyaiḥ svarṇapuṣpaiś caśobhanaiḥ ||9||
praṇamyadaṇḍavadyāvadupaviṣṭaḥ satatra vai |
tāvadbrāhmaṇamāyāṃ tamapaśyaddevasannidhau ||10||
devārcanārthamāyāṃ taṃ tulasyudakapāṇinam |
svapurīvāsinaṃ tatraviṣṇu-dāsāvayaṃ dvijam ||11||
tatrābhyetyasaviprarṣirdevadevamapūjayat |
viṣṇu-sūktena saṃsnāpya tulasī-maṣjarī-dalaiḥ ||12||
tulasī-pūjayā tasya ratna-pūjāṃ tathā kṛtām |
ācchāditāṃ samālokyarājākruddho’bravīdbacaḥ ||13||
rājovāca
māṇikyasvarṇapūjātraśobhāḍhyāyāmayākṛtā |
viṣṇu-dāsa kathaṃ seyam ācchannā tulasī-dalaiḥ ||14||
viṣṇu-bhaktiṃ na jānāsi varāko’si mato mama |
yas tv imām atiśobhāḍhyāṃ pūjām ācchādayasy aho ||15||
iti tad-vacanaṃ śrutvā sa-krodhaḥ sa dvijottamaḥ |
rājṣo gauravam ullaṅghya jagāda vacanaṃ tadā ||16||
viṣṇu-dāsa uvāca—
rājan muktiṃ na jānāsi garvito’si nṛpa-śriyā |
kiṃ svid viṣṇu-vrataṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ vadasva tat ||17||
gaṇāv ūcatuḥ— 
tad brāhmaṇa-vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya sa nṛpottamaḥ |
viṣṇu-dāsaṃ tadā garvād uvāca— vacanaṃ dvija ||18||
itthaṃ cet kathyase vipra viṣṇu-bhaktyātigarvitaḥ |
bhaktis te kiyatī viṣṇor daridrasyādhanasya ca ||19||
yajṣa-dānādikaṃ caiva viṣṇu-tuṣṭi-karaṃ kṛtam |
nāpi devālayaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā vipra kvacit kṛtam ||20||
īdṛśasyāpitegarvaeṣatiṣṭhatibhaktitaḥ |
tacchṛṇvaṃ tuvacome’dyasarvepyetedvijottamāḥ ||21||
sākṣātkāramahaṃ viṣṇoreṣavādogamiṣyati |
yathātusarve’pitatobhaktiṃ jṣāsyatha cāvayoḥ ||22||
gaṇāv ūcatuḥ— 
ity uktvā sanṛpogacchannijaṃ rājagṛhaṃ dvijaḥ |
ārebhevaiṣṇavaṃ satraṃ kṛtvācāryaṃ tumudgalam ||23||
ṛṣisaṃghasamājuṣṭaṃ babhūvabahudakṣiṇam |
yadvadbrahmakṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ gayākṣetresamṛddhimat ||24||
viṣṇu-dāso’pitatraivatasthaudevālayevratī ||
paṣcaitānniyamānkṛtvāviṣṇu-tuṣṭikarānsadā 25||
māghorjayor vrataṃ samyak tulasī-vana-pālanam |
ekādaśī-vrataṃ jāpyaṃ dvādaśākṣara-vidyayā ||26||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirgītanṛtyādimaṃ galaiḥ |
nityaṃ viṣṇos tathāpūjāṃ vratānyetāniso’karot ||27||
nityaṃ saṃsmaraṇaṃ viṣṇorgacchanbhuṃ jansvapannapi |
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ viṣṇumapaśyatsamadarśanaḥ ||28||
māghakārttikayornityaṃ viśeṣaniyamānapi |
akarodviṣṇu-tuṣṭyarthaṃ sodyāpanavidhiṃ tathā ||29||
evaṃ samārādhayatoḥśriyaḥ patiṃ tayos tu coleśvaraviṣṇu-dāsayoḥ |
agādanehābahutadbratasthayostanniṣṭhakarmendriyakarmaṇostayoḥ ||30||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye 
śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde kalahopākhyāne 
aṣṭādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||108||

(109)
navādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

gaṇāv ūcatuḥ—
kadācidviṣṇu-dāso’thakṛtvānityavidhiṃ dvijaḥ |
pākakarmākarodyāvadaharatkopyalakṣitaḥ ||1||
tamadṛṣṭvāpyasaupākaṃ punarnaivākarottadā |
sāyaṃ kālārcanasyāsauvratabhaṃ gabhayāddvijaḥ ||2||
dvitīye’hritataḥ pākaṃ kṛtvāyāvatsaviṣṇave |
upahārārpaṇaṃ kartuṃ tāvat ko’py aharat punaḥ ||3||
evaṃ saptadinaṃ tasya pākaṃ ko’py aharad dvija |
jātaḥ savismayaḥ so’thamanasyevavyacārayat ||4||
aho nityaṃ samabhyetya kaḥ pākaṃ harate mama |
kṣetra-saṃnyāsināṃ sthānam atyājyaṃ sarvathā mayā ||5||
punaḥ pākaṃ vidhāyātrabhujyateyadicenmayā |
sāyaṃ kālārcanaṃ ca itat-parityājyaṃ kathaṃ mayā ||6||
kiṣcitpākaṃ vidhāyaitadbhoktavyaṃ tumayānahi |
anirvedyaharausarvaṃ vaiṣṇavairnaivabhujyate ||7||
upoṣito’haṃ ca katha nti ṣṭhāmyatravratasthitaḥ |
adyasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ samyakpākasyātrakaromy aham ||8||
itipākaṃ vidhāyāsautatraivālakṣitaḥ sthitaḥ |
tāvaddadarśacāṇḍālaṃ pākānnaharaṇesthitam ||9||
kṣutkṣāmaṃ dīnavadanamasthicarmāvaśeṣitam |
tamālokyadvijāgryobhūtkṛpayāpannamānasaḥ ||10||
vilokyānnaharaṃ viprastiṣṭhatiṣṭhetyabhāṣata |
katha mattibhavānarūkṣaṃ ghṛtametad-gṛhāṇabhoḥ ||11||
itthaṃ bruvantaṃ viprāgryaṃ āyāṃ taṃ ca vilokyasaḥ |
vegādadhāvattadbhītyāmūrcchitaścapapātaha ||12||
bhītaṃ taṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvācāṇḍālaṃ sadvijottamaḥ |
vegādabhyetyakṛpayāsvavastrāṃ tair avījayat ||13||
athotthitaṃ tamevāsauviṣṇu-dāsovyalokayat |
sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śaṃ khacakragadādharam ||14||
pītāṃ baraṃ ca turbāhuṃ śrīvatsāṃ kaṃ kirīṭinam |
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ kaustubhoraḥ sthalaṃ vibhum ||15||
taṃ dṛṣṭvāsātvikairbhāvairāvṛtodvijasattamaḥ |
stotuṃ cāpi namaskartuṃ tadānālaṃ babhūvasaḥ ||16||
atha śakrādayodevāstatraivābhyāyayustadā |
gandharvāpsarasaścāpi jaguścananṛturmudā ||17||
vimānaśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ devarṣigaṇasaṃkulam |
gītavāditranirghoṣaṃ sthānaṃ tadabhavattadā ||18||
tatoviṣṇuḥ samāliṅgya svabhaktaṃ sātvikaṃ tathā |
sāyujyamātmanodattvānayadvaikuṇṭhamandiram ||19||
vimānavarasaṃsthānamāsthitaṃ viṣṇusannidhau |
dīkṣitaścolanṛpatirviṣṇu-dāsaṃdadarśaha ||20||
vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ yāṃ taṃ viṣṇu-dāsaṃvilokyasaḥ |
svaguruṃ mudgalaṃ vegādāhvayetthaṃ vaco’bravīt ||21||
cola uvāca—
yat spardhayā mayā caitad yajṣa-dānādikaṃ kṛtam |
sa viṣṇu-rūpa-dhṛg vipro yāti vaikuṇṭha-mandiram ||22||
dīkṣitena mayā samyak satre’smin viṣṇave tvayā |
hutam agnau kṛtā viprā dānādyaiḥ pūrṇa-mānasāḥ ||23||
naivādyāpi same devaḥ prasanno jāyate dhruvam |
bhaktyaiva tasya viprasya sākṣāt-kāraṃ dadau hariḥ ||24||
tasmād dānaiś ca yajṣaiś ca naiva viṣṇuḥ prasīdati |
bhaktir eva paraṃ tasya nidānaṃ darśane vibhoḥ ||25||
gaṇāv ūcatuḥ— 
ity uktvā bhāgineyaṃ svam abhiṣicya nṛpāsane |
ābālyād dīkṣito yajṣe sā putratvam agād yataḥ ||26||
tasmād adyāpi tad-deśe sadā rājyāṃśa-bhāginaḥ |
svasreyā evajāyaṃ tetatkṛtācāravartinaḥ ||27||
yajṣavāṭaṃ tato’bhyetyavahnikuṇḍāgrataḥ sthitaḥ |
triruccairvyājahārāśuviṣṇuṃ saṃbodhayaṃ stadā ||28||
viṣṇo bhaktiṃ sthirāṃ dehi mano-vāk-kāya-karmabhiḥ |
ity uktvā  so’patad vahnau sarveṣām eva paśyatām ||29||
mudgalastutadākrodhācchikhāmutpāṭayatsvakām |
tatas tvadyāpitadgotremudgalāviśikhābhavan ||30||
tāvadāvirabhūdviṣṇuḥkuṇḍāgnau bhakta-vatsalaḥ |
tam āliṅgyavimānāgryaṃ samārohayadacyutaḥ ||31||
tam āliṅgyātmasārūpyaṃ dattvāvaikuṇṭhamandiram |
tenaivasahadeveśojagāmatridaśairvṛtaḥ ||32||
nārada uvāca—
yo viṣṇu-dāsaḥ sa tu puṇya-śīlo
yaś cola-bhūpaḥ sa suśīla-nāmā |
etāv ubhau tat-sama-rūpa-bhājau
dvāḥ-sthau kṛtau tena ramā-priyeṇa ||33||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ 
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
kalahopākhyānaṃ nāma navādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||109||

(110)
daśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

dharma-datta uvāca—
jayaś ca vijayaś caiva viṣṇor dvāsthau mayā śrutau |
kiṃ tu tābhyāṃ purā cīrṇaṃ yasmāt tad-rūpa-dhāriṇau ||1||
gaṇāv ūcatuḥ—
tṛṇa-bindos tu kanyāyāṃ devahūtyāṃ purādvija |
kardamasya tu dṛṣṭyaiva putrau dvau sambabhūvatuḥ ||2||
jyeṣṭho jayaḥ kaniṣṭho’bhūd vijayaś ceti nāmataḥ |
anyasyām abhavat paścāt kapilo yoga-dharma-vit ||3||
jayaś ca vijayaś caiva viṣṇu-bhakti-ratau sadā |
saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ dharmaśīlaubabhūvatuḥ ||4||
nityamaṣṭākṣarījāpyauviṣṇu-vratakarāvubhau |
sākṣātkāraṃ dadauviṣṇustayornityārcanesadā ||5||
maruttenakadācittāvāhūtauyajṣakarmaṇi |
jagmaturyajṣakuśalaudevarṣigaṇasevitau ||6||
jayastatrābhavadbrahmāyājakovijayo’bhavat |
tatoyajṣavidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca cakratuḥ ||7||
maruto’vabhṛthasnātastābhyāṃ vittaṃ dadaubahu |
tatsamādāyatauvittaṃ jagmatuḥ svāśramaṃ prati ||8||
yajanāyatadāviṣṇos tu ṣṭyarthaṃ tautadāmune |
taddhanaṃ vibhajaṃ tovaipasparddhāteparasparam ||9||
jayo’bravītsamobhāgaḥkriyatāmititatrasaḥ |
vijayaścābravīttatrayallabdhaṃ yenatasya tat ||10||
tatojayo’śapatkrodhādvijayaṃ kṣubdhamānasaḥ |
gṛhītvānadadāsyetattasmādgrāhobhavetitam ||11||
vijayas tasya taṃ śāpaṃ śrutvā so’py aśapac ca tam |
mada-bhrānto’śapad yasmāt tasmān mātaṃ gatāṃ vraja ||12||
tautathācakhyaturviṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvānityārcanevibhum |
śāpayos tu nivṛttiṃ tauyayācāteramāpatim ||13||
bhaktāv āvāṃ kathaṃ deva grāhamāṃ tagayonigau |
bhaviṣyāvaḥ kṛpā-sindho tac-chāpo vinivartyatām ||14||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
mad-bhaktayor vaco’satyaṃ na kadācid bhaviṣyati |
mayāpi nānyathā kartuṃ śakyate tat kadācana ||15||
prahlāda-vacanāt stambhe’py āvirbhūto hy ahaṃ purā |
tathāmbarīṣa-vākyena jāto mārge svayaṃ kila ||16||
tasmād dhruvam imau śāpāv anubhūya svayaṃ kṛtau |
labhetāṃ mat-padaṃ nityam ity uktvāntardadhe hariḥ ||17||
gaṇāv ūcatuḥ— 
tatas taugrāhamātaṃ gābabhūtāṃ gaṇḍakītaṭe |
jātismaraucatadyonyāmapiviṣṇuvratesthitau ||18||
kadācitsagajaḥ snātuṃ kārttike gaṇḍakīṃ gataḥ |
tāvajjagrāhacagrāhaḥ saṃsmaraṣchāpakāraṇam ||19||
grāhagṛhīto’saunāgaḥ saṃsmāraśrīpatiṃ tadā |
tāvadāvirabhūdviṣṇuḥśaṃ khacakragadādharaḥ ||20||
##tatas taugrāhamātaṃ gaucakraṃ kṣiptvāsamuddhṛtau |
dattvācanijasārūpyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamanayadvibhuḥ ||21||
tadāprabhṛtitatsthānaṃ harikṣetramitiśrutam |
cakrasaṃgharṣaṇādyasminpāṣāṇo’pihilāṃ chitaḥ ||22||
tāvimauviśrutaulokejayaś ca vijayaścaha |
nityaṃ viṣṇupriyaudvāḥ sthaupṛṣṭauyauhitvayādvija ||23||
atastvamapidharmajṣanityaṃ viṣṇuvratesthitaḥ |
tyaktamātsaryadaṃ bhohibhavasvasamadarśanaḥ ||24||
tulāmakarameṣeṣuprātaḥ snāyīsadābhava |
