tṛtīyaḥkrakacohyeṣanirayoghoradarśanaḥ |
yatremekrakacairmartyāḥ pāṭyaṃ tepāpakāriṇaḥ ||9||
asipatravanādyais tuṣaṭprakārovyavasthitaḥ |
patnīputrādibhiryevaiviyogaṃ kārayanti hi ||10||
iṣṭairanyair apiparānpacyante taimenarāḥ |
asipatraiś chidyamānāchedabhītyāpalāyitāḥ ||11||
pacyante pāpinaḥ paśyakraṃ damānāitastataḥ |
argalākhyomahāghoraścaturthonirayohyayam ||12||
paśyanānāvidhaiḥ pāśairābadhyayamakiṃ karaiḥ |
mudgarādyairvadhyamānāḥkraṃ daṃ tete ca pāpinaḥ ||13||
sajjanānbrāhmaṇādyāṃ ścaviruṃ dhaṃ tīhayenarāḥ |
kaṇṭhagrahādyais tepāpāḥ pacyante yamakiṃ karaiḥ ||14||
asāvapihiṣaḍbhedovadhabhedādibhiḥ sthitaḥ |
kūṭaśālmalināmānaṃ nirayaṃ paśyapaṣcamam ||15||
yatrāṃ gāranibhā eteśālmalyādyāḥ sthitādvija |
yatraṣoḍhāvipacyante yātanābhirimenarāḥ ||16||
paradārāparadravyaparadroharatāḥ sadā |
raktapūyamimaṃ paśyaṣaṣṭhaṃ nirayamadbhutam ||17||
adhomukhāvipacyante yatrapāpakṛtonarāḥ |
abhakṣyabhakṣakānindāpaiśunyādiratāime ||18||
bhajyamānāvadhyamānāḥkraṃ daṃ tebhairavānsvarān |
ṣaṭprakārairvigandhāḍhyair asāvapicasaṃsthitaḥ ||19||
kumbhīpākaḥ saptamo’yaṃ nirayoghoradarśanaḥ |
ṣoḍhāstailādibhirdravyerdhaneśvaravilokaya ||20||
mahāpātakinoyatrakvathyaṃ teyamakiṃ karaiḥ |
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇisonmajjananimajjanaiḥ ||21||
catvāriṃ śanmitānetāndyvadhikānpaśyarauravān |
akāmātpātakaṃ śuṣkaṃ kāmādārdramudāhṛtam ||22||
ārdraśuṣkādibhiḥ pāpairdviprakārānavasthitān |
caturaśītisaṃkhyākaiḥ pṛthagbhedairavasthitān ||23||
yatprakīrṇamapāṃ kteyaṃ malinīkaraṇaṃ tathā |
jṣātibhraṃ śakaraṃ tadvadupapātakasaṃjṣakam ||24||
atipāpaṃ mahāpāpaṃ saptadhāpātakaṃ smṛtam |
ebhiḥ saptasupacyante nirayeṣuyathākramam ||25||
kārttika-vratibhiryasmātsaṃsargohyabhavattava |
tatpuṇyopacayādetenirhṛtānirayāḥkhalu ||26||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
darśayitvetinirayānpretapastamathāharat |
dhaneśvaraṃ yakṣalokaṃ paścādāsītsatatrahi ||27||
dhanadasyānugaḥ so’yaṃ dhanayakṣetisasmṛtaḥ |
yadākhyāyākarottīrthamayodhyāyāṃ tugādhijaḥ ||28||
evaṃ prabhāvaḥkhalukārttiko ‘yaṃ muktipradomuktikaraścayasmāt |
prayātyanekārjitapātako’pivratasthasaṃdarśanato’pimuktim ||29||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye 
dhaneśvaropākhyāne caturdaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||114||

(115)
paṣcadaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

sūta uvāca—
ity uktvā vāsudevo’sausatyabhāmāmatipriyām |
sāyaṃ saṃdhyādikaṃ kartuṃ jagāmajananīgṛham ||1||
evaṃ prabhāvaḥ proktoyaṃ kārttikaḥ pāpa-nāśanaḥ |
viṣṇupriyakaronityaṃ bhukti-mukti-pradaḥ sadā ||2||
harijāgaraṇaṃ prātaḥ snānaṃ tulasisevanam |
udyāpanaṃ dīpa-dānaṃ vratānyetānikārttike ||3||
paṣcakairvratakairebhiḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ kārttika-vratam |
phalaṃ prāpnotitatproktaṃ bhukti-mukti-phala-pradam ||4||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
viṣṇoḥ priyo’tiphaladaḥ prokto’yaṃ romaharṣaṇe |
kārttikasyavidhiḥ samyakpāvanaḥ pāpa-nāśanaḥ ||5||
avaśyamevakartavyaḥ prāpyaduḥkhanivāraṇaḥ |
mokṣārthibhirnaraḥ samyag bhogakāmairathāpivā ||6||
evaṃ sthiteyathākaścidbratasthaḥ saṃkaṭesthitaḥ |
durgāraṇyasthitovāpivyādhibhiḥ paripīḍitaḥ |
kathaṃ tenaprakartavyaṃ kārttika-vratakaṃ śubham ||7||
sūta uvāca—
yasmādatyaṃ taphaladaṃ kartavyaṃ tuyathānaraiḥ |
tatsarvaṃ katha yiṣye’haṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṃ gavāḥ ||8||
viṣṇoḥ śivasyavākuryād ālayeharijāgaram |
śivaviṣṇugrahābhāvesarvadevālayeṣv api ||9||
durgāraṇyasthitoyaścayadivāyadgatobhavet |
kuryāt tadāśvattha-mūle tulasīnāṃ vaneṣv api ||10||
viṣṇunāma pradhānānāṃ gāyanādviṣṇusannidhau |
gosahasrapradānasyaphalaṃ prāpnotimānavaḥ ||11||
vādyakṛtpuruṣaścāpi vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet |
sarvatīrthāvagāhotthaṃ nartakaḥ phalamāpnuyāt ||12||
sarvametallabhetpuṇyaṃ teṣāṃ tudravyadaḥ pumān |
praśaṃ sādarśanābhyāṃ hitatṣaḍaṃ śamavāpnuyāt ||13||
āpadgatoyadāpyaṃ bhonalabhetsnapanāyasaḥ |
vyādhitovāpunaḥ kuryād viṣṇornāmāpamārjanam ||14||
udyāpanavidhiṃ kartuṃ naśaktoyovratesthitaḥ |
brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyāvratasaṃpūrṇahetave ||15||
yasmādatyaṃ taphaladonatyājyaḥ sarvadā naraiḥ |
avyaktarūpiṇoviṣṇoḥ svarūpaṃ brāhmaṇābhuvi ||16||
tatsaṃtuṣṭyāsusaṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvadā syāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
aśaktodīpa-dānetuparadīpaṃ prabodhayet ||17||
teṣāṃ vārakṣa##kuryād vātādibhyaḥ prayatnataḥ |
abhāve tulasīnāṃ tu pūjayed vaiṣṇavaṃ dvijam ||18||
yasmātsaṃnihītoviṣṇuḥ svabhakteṣveva sarvadā |
sarvābhāvevratī kuryād brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmapi ||19||
sevāṃ vāśvatthavaṭayorvratasaṃpūrṇahetave ||20||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ 
kathaṃ tvayāśvatthavaṭaugobrāhmaṇasamaukṛtau |
sarvebhyo’pitarubhyastaukasmātpūjyataraukṛtau ||21||
sūta uvāca—
aśvattharūpībhagavānviṣṇur evana saṃśayaḥ |
rudrarūpīvaṭastadvatpālāśobrahmarūpadhṛk ||22||
darśanaṃ pūjanaṃ sevāteṣāṃ pāpaharāsmṛtā |
duḥkhāpadyvādhiduṣṭānāṃ vināśakaraṇīdhruvam ||23||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ vṛkṣatvamāpannābrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
etatkatha yasarvajṣasaṃśayo’tramahānhinaḥ ||24||
sūta uvāca—
pārvatīśivayordevaiḥ surataṃ kurvatoḥkila |
agnirbrāhmaṇarūpeṇapreṣitovighnakṛtpurā ||25||
tataḥ sāpārvatīkruddhāśaśāpatridivaukasaḥ |
ratotsavasukhabhraṃ śātkaṃ pamānāruṣātadā ||26||
pārvaty uvāca—
kṛmikīṭādayopyetejānanti surataṃ sukham |
tadvighnakaraṇāddevāhyudbhijjatvamavāpsyatha ||27||
sūta uvāca—
evaṃ sāpārvatīdevānaśapatkruddhamānasā |
tasmādvṛkṣatvamāpannāḥ sarvedevagaṇāḥkila ||28||
tasmādimauviṣṇumaheśvarāvubhaubabhūvaturbodhivaṭaumunīśvarāḥ |
bodhistvagādārkidinespṛśatvamaspṛśyatāmarkajaviṣṭiyogāt ||29||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye 
aśvattha-vaṭa-praśaṃsanaṃ nāma 
paṣcadaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||115||

(116)
ṣoḍaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ—
aspṛśyatvekathaṃ jātaḥ sūtabodhitarustvayam |
spṛśyatvaṃ ca kathaṃ prāptas tathācaśanivāsare |
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ vaktumarhatinobhavān ||1||
sūta uvāca—
samudramatha nādyāniratnānyāpuḥ sureśvarāḥ |
śriyaṃ ca kaustubhaṃ teṣāṃ viṣṇavepradaduḥsurāḥ ||2||
yāvadaṃ gīcakārāsaulakṣmīṃ bhāryārthamātmanaḥ |
tāvadvijṣāpayāmāsalakṣmīstaṃ ca krapāṇinam ||3||
lakṣmīr uvāca—
asaṃskṛtyakathaṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ tvaṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ praṇīyase |
tasmānmamāgrajāmetāmalakṣmīṃ madhusūdana ||4||
vivāhyanayamāṃ paścādeṣadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||5||
sūta uvāca—
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saviṣṇur lokabhāvanaḥ |
uddālakāya munaye sudīrgha-tapase tadā ||6||
ātmavākyānurodhenatāmalakṣmīṃ dadaukila |
sthūlāsyāṃ śubhradaśanāṃ rājatīṃ bibhratīṃ tanum ||7||
vitatāṃ raktanayanāṃ rūkṣapiṃ gaśiroruhām |
samunirviṣṇuvākyāttāmaṃ gīkṛtyasvamāśramam ||8||
vedadhvanisamāyuktamānayāmāsadharmavit |
homadhūmasugandhāḍhyaṃ vidyāghoṣavināditam ||9||
āśramaṃ taṃ samālokyavyathitāsābravīdidam |
jyeṣṭhovāca
nahivāso’nurūpo’yaṃ vedadhvaniyutomama |
nātrāgamiṣye bho brahman nayasvānyatra mā ciram ||10||
uddālaka uvāca—
kathaṃ nāyāsikiṃ vātravartatesaṃmataṃ tava |
tavayogyācavasatiḥkābhavec ca vadasvatat ||11||
jyeṣṭhovāca
vedadhvanirbhavedyasminnatithīnāṃ ca pūjanam |
yajṣa-dānādikaṃ vāpinaivatatravasāmy aham ||12||
parasparānurāgeṇadāṃ patyaṃ yatravartate |
pitṛdevārcanaṃ yatranaivatatrasāmy aham ||13||
durodararatāyatraparadravyāpahāriṇaḥ |
paradāraratāścāpi tatrasthāneratirmama ||14||
govadhomadyapānaṃ ca yatrasaṃjāyateniśam |
brahma-hatyādipāpānitasminsthāneratirmama |
vṛddhasajjanaviprāṇāṃ yatrasyādapamānanam |
niṣṭhuraṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ yatratatranityaṃ vasāmy aham ||15||
sūta uvāca—
iti tad-vacanaṃ śrutvā viṣaṇṇavadano’bhavat |
uddālakamunirviṣṇorvākyaṃ smṛtvānacocivān ||16||
so’gacchadyatratatrāsyapūjāmālokyasābravīt |
nāyāmītitataḥ so’pibhramādatyāturo’bhavat |
uddālakastatovākyaṃ tāmalakṣmīm uvāca—ha ||17||
uddālaka uvāca—
aśvatthavṛkṣamūle’sminnalaikṣmasthīyatāṃ kṣaṇam |
āvāsasthānamālokyayāvadāyāmyahaṃ punaḥ ||18||
sūta uvāca—
ititatrasasaṃsthāpyajagāmoddālakastadā |
pratīkṣaṃ tīciraṃ tatrayadātannadarśasā ||19||
tadārurodakaruṇaṃ bhartṛtyāgenaduḥkhitā |
tatrasthāṃ rudatīlakṣmīṃ rvaikuṇṭhabhuvane’śṛṇot ||20||
tadāvijṣāpayāmāsaviṣṇumudvignamānasā ||21||
lakṣmīr uvāca—
svāminmadbhaginījyeṣṭhābhartṛtyāgenaduḥkhitā |
tāmāśvāsayituṃ yāhikṛpāloyadyahaṃ priyā ||22||
sūta uvāca—
lakṣmyāsahatatoviṣṇustatrāgacchatkṛpānvitaḥ |
āśvāsayadalakṣmīṃ tāmidaṃ vacanam abravīt ||23||
śrīviṣṇur uvāca—
aśvatthavṛkṣamāsādyasadā’laikṣmasthirābhava |
mamāṃ śasaṃbhavohyeṣaāvāsastemayākṛtaḥ ||24||
pratyahaṃ ye’rcayiṣyanti tvāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ gṛhadharmiṇaḥ |
teṣviyaṃ śrīḥkaniṣṭhātebhaginīniścalāstuvai ||25||
sūta uvāca—
ityūrjasyacamāhātmyaṃ yeśṛṇvanti paṭhanti ca |
teṣāṃ viṣṇupurevāsobhavedābhūtasaṃplavam ||26||
rogāpahaṃ pātakanāśakṛtparaṃ subuddhidaṃ putradhanādisādhanam |
mukternidānaṃ nahikārttikādvaiviṣṇupriyādanyadihāstibhūtale ||27||
viṣṇupriyaṃ sakalakalmaṣanāśanaṃ ca satputrapautradhanadhānyasamṛddhikāri |
ūrja-vrataṃ saniyamaṃ kurutemanuṣyaḥkiṃ tasya tīrthapariśīlanasevayāca ||28||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
alakṣmy-upākhyānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ
||116||

(117)
saptadaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

sūta uvāca—
itisarvaṃ samākarṇyasatrājitasutātadā |
harervākyaṃ mahā-bhāgāsatyāvacanam abravīt ||1||
satyovāca
kārttikasyacamāhātmyaṃ naśrutaṃ vistarātprabho |
sarveṣāmevamāsānāṃ kārttikaḥ pravaraḥkatha m ||2||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayāsatyekārttika-vratamādarāt |
śaunakāyapurāproktaṃ sūtenasumahātmanā ||3||
sūta uvāca—
śrūyatāṃ tatpravakṣyāmietatpraśnottaraṃ śubham |
īśvareṇapurāproktaṃ pṛcchateṣaṇmukhāyavai ||4||
kārttikeya uvāca—
bahūnipadmanābhasyarahasyāniśrutāni ca |
yathāhiprocyamānānivaiṣṇavenatvayāprabho ||5||
saṃsārasāgareprāptāduḥkhorulaharīvṛte |
teṣāmuttāraṇārthāyakatha yasvaprayatnataḥ ||6||
kārttikasyavidhiś caiva snānasyavadatāṃ vara |
yenaduḥ##budhiṃ tātasaṃtariṣyanti mānavāḥ ||7||
phalaṃ vaiṣṇavadharmasyakatha yasvasuvistaram |
yenadharmaprabhāvenapadaṃ gacchativaiṣṇavam ||8||
dīpa-dānasyamāhātmyaṃ muni-puṣpasyasuvrata |
gopī-candana-māhātmyaṃ tulasyās tu tathā vibho ||9||
mālatī-puṣpa-māhātmyaṃ vāri-jānāṃ tathā vada |
dhātrī-phalānāṃ māhātmyaṃ tathā damanakasya ca ||10||
ketakī-puṣpa-māhātmyaṃ naivedyasya parantapa |
tīrthodakasya māhātmyaṃ māgha-snāna-phalaṃ vibho ||11||
phalaṃ brūhi sura-śreṣṭha brahma-patreṣu bhojanāt |
nīrājana-phalaṃ sthāṇo paradīpa-pravedhanāt ||12||
puṣkara-kṣetra-māhātmyaṃ śūkarasya tathā vibho |
śālagrāmasya māhātmyaṃ svastikasya vidhānakam ||13||
dānānāṃ ca phalaṃ brūhi parānnasya ca varjanāt |
māsopavāsasya phalaṃ khaṭvāyā mokṣaṇād vibho ||14||
dīpāvalyāś ca māhātmyaṃ prabodhinyāś ca suvrata |
paṣca-bhīṣmasya māhātmyaṃ katha yasva suvistarāt ||15||
īśvara uvāca—
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vatsa lokoddharaṇa-hetave |
katha yāmi na sandehas tvat-samo nāsti vaiṣṇavaḥ ||16||
sat-putreṇa tvayā vatsa tārito’haṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
niścalā keśave bhaktis tvayi tiṣṭhati sarvadā ||17||
narebhyo vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmaṃ yo dadāti dvijottamaḥ |
sa-sāgara-mahī-dāne tat-puṇyaṃ labhate hi saḥ ||18||
kārttikasya ca māsasya koṭy-aṃśenāpi nārhati |
ekataḥ sarva-tīrthāni sarva-dānāni caikataḥ ||19||
ekato go-pradānāni sarve yajṣāḥ sa-dakṣiṇāḥ |
ekataḥ puṣkare vāsaṃ kurukṣetre himālaye ||20||
ekato mathurā-tīrthe vārāṇasyāṃ ca śūkare |
ekataḥ kārttiko vatsa sarvadā keśava-priyaḥ ||21||
sūta uvāca—
ity uktvā  muni-śārdūla punar vākyaṃ jagau haraḥ |
kārttika-snāna-māhātmyaṃ katha yiṣye suvistarāt ||22||
īśvara uvāca—
brāhmaṃ kṛta-yugaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatriyaṃ svayam |
dvāparaṃ vaiśyam ityāhuḥ śūdraṃ kali-yugaṃ smṛtam ||23||
kalau vatsa manuṣyāṇāṃ śaithilyaṃ snāna-karmaṇi |
tathāpi katha yiṣyāmi snānaṃ kārttika-māghayoḥ ||24||
yasya hastau ca pādau na vāṅ-manaś ca susaṃyatam |
vidyā tapaś ca kīrtiś ca sa tīrtha-phala-bhāṅ naraḥ ||25||
aśraddadhānaḥ pāpātmā nāstikaś chinna-mānasaḥ |
hetu-vādī ca paṣcaite na tīrtha-phala-bhāginaḥ ||26||
prātar utthāya yo vipras tīrtha-snāyī sadā bhavet |
sarva-pāpa-vinirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||27||
snānaṃ ca tur-vidhaṃ proktaṃ snāna-vidbhiḥ ṣaḍ-ānana |
vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ divyaṃ brāhmyaṃ ceti tathā smṛtam ||28||
vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ-snānaṃ vāruṇaṃ sāgarādiṣu |
brāhmyaṃ brāhmaṇa-mantroktaṃ divyaṃ meghāmbu-bhāskaram ||29||
snānānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tatra vāruṇam |
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo mantravat-snānam ācaret ||30||
tūṣṇīm eva hi śūdrasya strīṇāṃ caiva ṣaḍ-ānana |
bālā ca taruṇī vṛddhā nara-nārī-napuṃsakāḥ ||31||
pāpaiḥ sarvaiḥ pramucyante snānāt kārttika-māghayoḥ |
snātā vai kārttike lokāḥ prāpnuvantīpsitaṃ phalam ||32||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
śrī-śiva-ṣaḍānana-saṃvāde saptadaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||117||

(118)
aṣṭādaśādhika-śatatamo’dhayāyaḥ

sūta uvāca—
punaḥ provāca bhagavān mahā-devo vṛṣa-dhvajaḥ |
śrotāram upasaṅgamya bhakti-yuktaṃ ṣaḍānanam ||1||
īśvara uvāca—
kārttiko vaiṣṇavo māsaḥ sarva-māseṣu cottamaḥ |
asmin māse trayastriṃśad devāḥ sannihitāḥ kalau ||2||
ūrje māsi mahā-bhāgau bhojanāni dvijātaye |
tila-dhenuṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca rajataṃ bhūmi-vāsasī ||3||
go-pradānāni dāsyanti sarva-bhāvena suvrata |
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ kanyā-dānaṃ viśiṣyate ||4||
brāhmaṇāyātra ye kanyāṃ dāsyanti vidhivan narāḥ |
vaikuṇṭhe vasatis teṣāṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||5||
roma-kāle tu saṃprāpte somo bhuṅkte tu kanyakām |
ṛtu-kāle tu gandharvā vahnis tu kuca-darśane ||6||
tāvad vivāhayet kanyāṃ yāvan na rtumatī bhavet |
vivāhas tv aṣṭa-varṣāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ śasyate budhaiḥ ||7||
dātavyā śrotriyāyaiva brāhmaṇāya tapasvine |
sākṣād adhīta-vedāya vidhinā brahmacāriṇe ||8||
kanyāvara-pramāṇāyā eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
yāvanti caiva romāṇi kanyāyāś ca tanau suta ||9||
tāvad varṣa-sahasrāṇi rudra-loke mahīyate |
sahasram eva dhenūnāṃ śataṃ cānuḍuhāṃ samam ||10||
daśānuḍutsamaṃ yānaṃ daśayā na samo hayaḥ |
haya-dāna-sahasrebhyo gaja-dānaṃ viśiṣyate ||11||
gaja-dāna-sahasrāṇāṃ svarṇa-dānaṃ ca tat-samam |
svarṇa-bhāra-sahasrāṇāṃ vidyā-dānaṃ ca tat-samam ||12||
vidyā-dānāt koṭi-guṇaṃ bhūmi-dānaṃ viśiṣyate |
bhūmi-dāna-sahasrebhyo go-pradānaṃ viśiṣyate ||13||
go-pradāna-sahasrebhyo hy anna-dānaṃ viśiṣyate |
annādhāram idaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvara-jaṅgamam ||14||
tasmād deyaṃ prayatnena kārttike śikhi-vāhana |
trīṇi tulya-pradānāni trīṇi tulya-phalāni ca ||15||
kārttikeya uvāca—
anyān api mahādeva dharmān me vaktum arhasi |
yān kṛtvā sarva-pāpāni prakṣālya tridaśo bhavet ||16||
sūta uvāca—
iti pṛṣṭas tadā śambhuḥ punar vaktuṃ pracakrame |
yāvat kiṃ bahudhā stutvā tac chṛṇudhvaṃ tapo-dhanāḥ ||17||
īśvara uvāca—
parānnaṃ varjayed yas tu kārttike niyame kṛte |
parānna-varjanād eva labhec cāndrāyaṇaṃ phalam ||18||
taṃ prāptaṃ kārttikaṃ dṛṣṭvā parānnaṃ yas tu varjayet |
dine dine tu kṛcchrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||19||
kārttike varjayet tailaṃ kārttike varjayen madhu |
kārttike varjayet kāṃsyaṃ saṃghānnaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||20||
rākṣasīṃ yonim āpnoti sakṛn māṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt |
ṣaṣṭi-varṣa-sahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ paripacyate ||21||
tan mukto jāyate pāpo viṣṭhāśī grāma-sūkaraḥ |
pravṛttānāṃ tu bhakṣāṇāṃ kārttike niyame kṛte ||22||
avaśyaṃ viṣṇu-rūpatvaṃ prāpyate mokṣadaṃ padam |
na kārttika-samo māso na daivaṃ keśavāt param ||23||
na veda-sadṛśaṃ śāstraṃ na tīrthaṃ gaṅgayā samam |
na satyaṃ na samaṃ vṛttaṃ na kṛtena samaṃ yugam ||24||
na tṛptī rasanā tulyā na dāna-sadṛśaṃ sukham |
na dharma-sadṛśaṃ mitraṃ na jyotiś cakṣuṣā samam ||25||
avrate na kṣiped yas tu māsaṃ dāmodara-priyam |
karma-bhraṣṭaḥ sa vijṣeyo hīna-yoniṣu jāyate ||26||
kārttikaḥ pravaro māso vaiṣṇavānāṃ sadā priyaḥ |
samudra-gānadī puṇyā durlabhā snāna-śālinām ||27||
kula-śīlavatī kanyā durlabhā dampatī nṛṇām |
durlabhā jananī loke pitā caiva viśeṣataḥ ||28||
durlabhaṃ sādhu-san-mānaṃ durlabho dhārmikaḥ sutaḥ |
durlabho dvārikā-vāso durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇa-darśanam ||29||
durlabhaṃ gomatī-snānaṃ durlabhaṃ kārttika-vratam |
brāhmaṇebhyo mahīṃ dattvā grahaṇe candra-sūryayoḥ ||30||
yat phalaṃ labhate vatsa tat phalaṃ bhūmi-śāyinaḥ |
bhojanaṃ dvijadaṃ patyoḥ pūjayec ca vilepanaiḥ ||31||
kambalāni ca ratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca |
tūlikāś ca pradātavyāḥ pracchādana-paṭaiḥ saha ||32||
upānahāv ātapatraṃ kārttike dehi pāvake |
yaḥ karoti naro nityaṃ kārttike patra-bhojanam ||33||
na durgatim avāpnoti yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
sarva-kāma-phalaṃ tasya sarva-tīrtha-phalaṃ labhet ||34||
na cāpi narakaṃ paśyed brahma-patreṣu bhojanāt |
brahmā eṣa smṛtaḥ sākṣāt pālāśaḥ sarva-kāmadaḥ ||35||
madhyamaṃ varjayet patraṃ kārttike śikhivāhana |
brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca trayo devās tri-patrake ||36||
aiśvaraṃ varjayet patraṃ brahmā viṣṇur anuttamaḥ |
sarva-puṇyam avāpnoti śeṣa-patreṣu bhojanāt ||37||
bhojanān madhya-patre tu kapilā payasas tathā |
prāśanānmuniśārdūlanaronarakamāpnuyāt ||38||
ajṣānād bhuṃ jate yas tu śūdro vā kapilā-payaḥ |
kapilāṃ brāhmaṇe dattvā śuddho bhavati kārttike ||39||
tila-dānaṃ nadī-snānaṃ sarvadā -sādhu-darśanam |
bhojanaṃ brahma-patreṣu kārttike mukti-dāyakam ||40||
maunīpālāśabhojīcajalasnāyīsadākṣamī |
kārttike kṣitiśāyīcahanyātpāpaṃ yugārjitam ||41||
jāgaraṃ kārttike māsiyaḥ karotyaruṇodaye |
dāmodarāgre senānīrgosahasraphalaṃ labhet ||42||
pitṛpakṣe’nnadānenajyeṣṭhāṣāḍhe ca vāriṇā |
kārttike tatphalaṃ puṃsāṃ paradīpaprabodhanāt ||43||
bodhanātparadīpasyavaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sevanāt |
kārttike phalam āpnoti rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ||44||
nadīsnānaṃ kathāviṣṇorvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśanam |
nabhavetkārttike yasyaharetpuṇyaṃ daśābdikam ||45||
puṣkaraṃ yaḥ smaretprājṣaḥkarmaṇāmanasāgirā |
kārttike muniśārdūlalakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||46||
prayāgomāghamāsetupuṣkaraṃ kārttike tathā |
avaṃ tīmādhavemāsihanyātpāpaṃ yugārjitam ||47||
dhanyās te mānavā loke kali-kāle viśeṣataḥ |
kurvanti skanda nityaṃ ye sarvathā hari-sevanam ||48||
kiṃ dattair bahubhiḥ piṇḍair gayā-śrāddhādibhir mune |
tāritās tena pitaro narakāc ca na saṃśayaḥ ||49||
kṣīrādi-snapanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kriyate pitṛ-kāraṇāt |
kalpa-koṭiṃ divaṃ prāpya vasanti tridaśaiḥ saha ||50||
kārttike nārcito yais tu kṛṣṇas tu kamalekṣaṇaḥ |
janma-koṭiṣu viprendra na teṣāṃ kamalā-gṛhe ||51||
daṣṭā##ṣṭā vinaṣṭās te patitāḥ kalikaṃ dare |
yairnārcito harir  bhaktyā kamalair asitaiḥ sitaiḥ ||52||
padmenaikena deveśaṃ yo’rcayet kamalā-patim |
varṣāyuta-sahasrasya pāpasya kurute kṣayam ||53||
aparādha-sahasrāṇi tathā sapta-śatāni ca |
padmenaikena deveśaḥ kṣameta praṇato’rcitaḥ ||54||
tulasī-patra-lakṣeṇa kārttike yo’rcayed dharim |
patre patre muni-śreṣṭha mauktikaṃ labhate phalam ||55||
tulasī-gandha-miśraṃ tu yat kiṣcit kriyate suta |
kalpa-koṭi-sahasrāṇi prīto bhavati keśavaḥ ||56||
mukhe śirasi dehe tu kṛṣṇottīrṇāṃ tu yo vahet |
tulasīṃ ṣaṇmukha-prītyā na tasya spṛśate kaliḥ ||57||
kṛṣṇottīrṇais tu nirmālyair yogātraṃ parimārjayet |
sarva-rogais tathā pāpair mukto bhavati ṣaṇmukha ||58||
viṣṇor aGgāra-śeṣeṇa yasyāGgaṃ spṛśate suta |
duritāni vinaśyanti vyādhayo yānti saṃkṣayam ||59||
śaGkhodakaṃ harer bhaktir nirmālyaṃ pādayor jalam |
candanaṃ dhūpa-śeṣaṃ tu brahma-hatyāpahārakam ||60||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye 
śrī-śiva-kārttike ya-saṃvāde praśnottaro nāma 
aṣṭādaśādhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||118||

(119)
ekonaviṃśaty-adhika śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

īśvara uvāca—
māgha-snānasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhāgavatottama |
tvat-samo nāsti loke’smin viṣṇu-bhakto mahā-mate ||1||
cakra-tīrthe hariṃ dṛṣṭvā mathurāyāṃ ca keśavam |
yat phalaṃ labhate martyo māgha-snānena tat phalam ||2||
jitendriyaḥ śānta-manāḥ sadācāreṇa saṃyutaḥ |
snānaṃ karoti yo māghe saṃsārī na bhavet punaḥ ||3||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
śūkarasyacamāhātmyaṃ katha yiṣyetavāgrataḥ |
yasyavijñānamātreṇasānnidhyaṃ mama sarvadā ||4||
sūta uvāca—
ity uktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ satyāyaibahudhājagau |
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmitac chṛṇudhvaṃ tapodhanāḥ ||5||
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
paṣcayojanavistīrṇeśūkareharimandire |
yasminvasatiyojīvogardabho’pi caturbhujaḥ ||6||
trīṇihastasahasrāṇitrīṇihastaśatāni ca |
trayohastāśūkarasya parimāṇaṃ vidhīyate ||7||
ṣaṣṭi-varṣa-sahasrāṇi yo’nyatra kurute tapaḥ |
tatphalaṃ labhatedevipraharārddhenaśūkare ||8||
sannihatyāṃ kurukṣetrerāhugrastedivākare |
tulāpuruṣadānenatatphalaṃ parikīrtitam ||9||
kāśyāṃ daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ veṇyāṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet |
sahasraguṇitaṃ proktaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame ||10||
anaṃ taṃ caivavijṣeyaṃ śūkareharimandire |
anyatra dadate lakṣaṃ saṃvidhānena kārttika ||11||
ihaivaikenadattenaśūkaretatsamaṃ bhavet |
śūkare ca tathāveṇyāṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame ||12||
sakṛdevanaraḥ snātvā brahma-hatyāṃ vyapohati |
alarkeṇapurāprāptāsaptadvīpāvasundharā |
śūkarakṣetramāhātmyaṃ śrutvā caivaṣaḍānana ||13||
(mārga-śīrṣasya dvādaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ vraja putraka) |
kārttikeya uvāca— 
bhagavanśrotum icchāmivratānāmuttamaṃ vratam |
vidhiṃ māsopavāsasyaphalaṃ cāsyayathocitam ||14||
yathāvidhinaraiḥ kāryāvratacaryāyathābhavet |
ārabhyateyathāpūrvaṃ samāpyaṃ hiyathāvidhi ||15||
yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ tukartavyaṃ tatprabrūhimaheśvara |
vratametatsukhaśrīdaṃ vistareṇamamānagha ||16||
śrī-rudra uvāca—
pāvakesādhusarvaṃ teyatpṛṣṭaṃ prabruve’nagha |
bhaktyāmatimatāṃ śreṣṭhaśṛṇuṣva gadatomama ||17||
surāṇāṃ ca yathāviṣṇustapatāṃ ca yathāraviḥ |
meruḥśikhariṇāṃ yadvadvainateyaścapakṣiṇām ||18||
tīrthānāṃ tuyathāgaṅgāprajānāṃ tuyathāvaṇik |
śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavratānāṃ tutadvan māsopavāsanam ||19||
sarvavrateṣuyatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣucaiva hi |
 sarvadā nodbhavaṃ caivalabhenmāsopavāsakṛt ||20||
agniṣṭomādibhiryajṣairvividhairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ |
natatpuṇyamavāpnotiyanmāsaparilaṃ ghanāt ||21||
tenajaptaṃ hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ svadhā |
yaḥ karoti vidhānena naro māsam upoṣaṇam ||22||
uddiśyavaiṣṇavaṃ yajṣamāmabhyarcyajanārdanam |
gurorājṣāṃ tatolabdhvākuryānmāsopavāsanam ||23||
vaiṣṇavāniyathoktānikṛtvāsarvavratānitu |
dvādaśyādīnipuṇyānitatomāsamupāvaset ||24||
atikṛcchraṃ ca pārākaṃ kṛtvācāndrāyaṇaṃ tataḥ |
māsopavāsaṃkurvītagurorviprājṣayātataḥ ||25||
āśvinasyāmalepakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ |
vratamenaṃ tugṛhṇīyādyāvatriṃ śaddinānitu ||26||
vāsudevaṃ samabhyarcyakārttikaṃ sakalaṃ naraḥ |
māsaṃcopavasedyas tu samuktiphalabhāgbhavet ||27||
acyutasyālayebhaktyātrikālaṃ kumudaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
mālatīndīvarair budhnaiḥ kamalaiś ca sugandhibhiḥ ||28||
kusumośīrakarpū rairvilipyavaracandanaiḥ |
naivedyāpūpadīpādyair arcayec ca janārdanam ||29||
manasākarmaṇāvācāpūjayed garuḍadhvajam |
kurvannaraḥ strīvidhavābṛhadbhaktir jitendriyaḥ ||30||
nāmnāmevatathālāpaṃ viṣṇoḥ kuryād aharniśam |
bhaktyāviṣṇoḥ stutirvācyāmithyālāpavivarjitā ||31||
sarvasatvadayāyuktaḥśāṃ tavṛttirahiṃ sakaḥ |
suptobāhyāsanasthovāvāsudevaṃ prakīrtayet ||32||
smṛtyālokanagandhādisvādanaṃ parikīrtanam |
annasyavarjayed vāsaṃgrāsānāṃ saṃpramokṣaṇam ||33||
gātrābhyaṃ gaṃ śirobhyaṃ gaṃ tāmbūlaṃ savilepanam |
vratasthovarjayet sarvaṃ yaccānyaccanirākṛtam ||34||
navratasthaḥ spṛśetkiṃ cidvikarmasthaṃ nacālayet |
devatāyatanetiṣṭhannagṛhasthaścaretdhruvam ||35||
kṛtvāmāsopavāsaṃtuyathoktavidhinānaraḥ |
nārīvāvidhavāsādhvīvāsudevaṃ samarcayet ||36||
anyūnādhikamevaṃ tuvrataṃ triṃ śaddinairidam |
kṛtvāmāsopavāsaṃtusaṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ ||37||
tato’rcayed eva puṇyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ garuḍa-dhvajam |
pūjayet puṣpa-mālābhir gandha-dhūpa-vilepanaiḥ ||38||
vastrālaṃ kāravādyaiś catoṣayedacyutaṃ naraḥ |
saṃsnāpayeddhariṃ bhaktyātīrthacandanavāribhiḥ ||39||
candanenānuliptāṃ gandhūpapuṣpairalaṅkṛtam |
vastradānādibhiś caiva bhojayitvādvijottamān ||40||
dadyāc cadakṣiṇāṃ tebhyaḥ praṇipatyakṣamāpayet |
evaṃ māsopavāsāddhikṛtvābhyarcyajanārdanam ||41||
bhojayitvādvijāṃ ś caiva viṣṇu-lokemahīyate |
evaṃ māsopavāsāṃ tekṛtvāviprāntrayodaśa ||42||
niryāpayettatas tānvaividhināyenatac chṛṇu |
kārayedvaiṣṇavaṃ yajṣamekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ||43||
pūjayitvātudeveśamācāryānujṣayāharim |
arcayitvā yathā śaktyā hy abhivādya guruṃ tathā ||44||
tato’nubhojayed viprān namaskāra-puraḥ-saram |
viśuddha-kula-cāritra-viṣṇu-pūjana-tat-parān ||45||
pūjayitvā tathā sarvān bhojayitvā trayodaśa |
tāmbūla-vastra-yugmāni bhojanācchādanāni ca ||46||
yoga-paṭṭāni sūtrāṇi brahma-sūtrāṇi caiva hi |
dadyāc caiva dvijāgryebhyaḥ pūjayitvā praṇamya ca ||47||
tato’nupūjayec chaktyā śayyāṃ staraṇa-saṃskṛtām |
sācchādanāṃ śubhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sopasopadhānām alaṅkṛtām ||48||
kārayitvātmano mūrtiṃ kāṣcanīṃ tu sva-śaktitaḥ |
nyaset tasyāṃ tu śayyāyām arcayitvā srag-ādibhiḥ ||49||
āsanaṃ pādukāṃ chatraṃ vastra-yugmam upānahau |
pavitrāṇi ca puṣpāṇi śayyāyām upakalpayet ||50||
evaṃ śayyāṃ tu saṃkalpa praṇipatya ca tān dvijān |
prārthayec cānumodārthaṃ viṣṇu-lokaṃ vrajāmy aham ||51||
tato vrajen nara-śreṣṭho viṣṇoḥ sthānam anāma yam |
maṇḍapa-sthāṃ stutān viprān iti vācyaṃ muhur muhuḥ ||52||
mantra-hīnaṃ kriyā-hīnaṃ sarva-hīnaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
sarvaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ yā tu bhavad-vākya-prasādataḥ |
vidhir māsopavāsasya yathāvat parikīrtitaḥ ||53||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde māsopavāsa-katha naṃ nāma 
ekonaviṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ
||119||

(120)
viṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhayāyaḥ

sūta uvāca—
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya punaḥ papraccha pāvakiḥ |
śālagrāmārcanaṃ bhūyas tac chṛṇudhvaṃ tapo-dhanāḥ ||1||
kārttikeya uvāca—
bhagavan yogināṃ śreṣṭha sarve dharmāḥ śrutā mayā |
śālagrāmārcanaṃ brūhi vistareṇa mama prabho ||2||
īśvara uvāca—
sādhu sādhu mahā-prājṣa yan māṃ hi paripṛcchasi |
tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ mama vatsala ||3||
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ tu trailokyaṃ sa-carācaram |
mahāśaya mahāsena nityaṃ tiṣṭhati saṃhitam ||4||
dṛṣṭaṃ praṇamitaṃ yena snāpitaṃ pūjitaṃ tathā |
yajṣa-koṭi-guṇaṃ puṇyaṃ gavāṃ koṭi-phalaṃ labhet ||5||
chinnas tena tathā vatsa garbha-vāsaḥ sudāruṇaḥ |
pītaṃ yena sadā viṣṇoḥ śālagrāma-śilā-jalam ||6||
kāmāsakto’pi yo nityaṃ bhakti-bhāva-vivarjitaḥ |
śālagrāma-śilāṃ putra pūjayitvācyuto bhavet ||7||
śālagrāma-śilā-bimbaṃ hatvā koṭi-vināśanam |
smṛtaṃ saṅkīrtitaṃ dhyātaṃ pūjitaṃ ca namaskṛtam ||8||
śālagrāma-śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā yānti pāpāny anekaśaḥ |
siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā yānti vane mṛga-gaṇā bhayāt ||9||
namaskāraṃ tu manujaḥ śālagrāma-śilārcane |
bhaktyā vā yadi vā’bhaktyā kṛtvā muktim avāpnuyāt ||10||
vaivasvata-bhayaṃ nāsti tathā maraṇa-janmanoḥ |
yaḥ karoti naro nityaṃ śālagrāma-śilārcanam ||11||
gandha-pādyārgha-naivedyair dīpair dhūpair vilepanaiḥ |
gītair vādyais tathā stotraiḥ śālagrāma-śilārcanam ||12||
kurute mānavo yas tu kalau bhakti-parāyaṇaḥ |
kalpa-koṭi-sahasrāṇi ramate viṣṇu-sadmani ||13||
śālagrāma-namaskāro bhāvenāpi naraiḥ kṛtaḥ |
mānuṣatvaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ mad-bhaktā ye narā bhuvi ||14||
mad-bhaktās tīvra-pāpiṣṭhā mat-prabhuṃ na namanti ye |
sa yāti hy andha-tāmisre nirayaṃ mama ghātakaḥ ||16||
mal-liṅga-sparśanaṃ kāryaṃ nānyāśuddhir vidhīyate |
yā tithir dayitā viṣṇoḥ sā tithir mama vallabhā ||17||
yas tāṃ nopavasen martyaḥ sa pāpī śvapacādhikaḥ |
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ tu sadā putra vasāmy aham ||18||
dattaṃ devena tuṣṭena sva-sthānaṃ mama bhaktitaḥ |
padma-koṭi-sahasrais tu pūjite mayi yat phalam ||19||
tat phalaṃ koṭi-guṇitaṃ śālagrāma-śilārcanāt |
pūjito ‘haṃ na tair martyair namito’haṃ na tair naraiḥ ||20||
na kṛtaṃ martya-loke yaiḥ śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
śālagrāma-śilāgre tu yaḥ karoti mamārcanam ||21||
tenārcito’haṃ senānīr yugānām ekaviṃśatim |
kim arcitair liṅga-śatair viṣṇu-bhakti-vivarjitaiḥ ||22||
śālagrāma-śilā-bimbaṃ nārcitaṃ yadi putraka |
anarhaṃ mama naivedyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam ||23||
śālagrāma-śilāgre tu sarvaṃ yāti pavitratām |
bhuktvā nya-deva-naivedyaṃ dvijaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca ret ||24||
bhuktvā  keśava-naivedyaṃ yajṣa-koṭi-phalaṃ labhet |
pādodakena devasya hatyā-koṭi-samanvitāḥ ||25||
śuddhyanti nātra sandehas tathā śaṅkhodakena hi |
yo hi māheśvaro bhūtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca na pūjayet ||26||
dveṣṭā ca yāti narakaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
jyeṣṭhāśramī gṛhe yasya muhūrtam api viśramet ||27||
pitā mahā-yugāny aṣṭau bhavaty amṛta-bhojinaḥ |
saṃsāre duḥkha-kāntāre nimajjyante narādhamāḥ ||28||
varṣa-koṭi-sahasrāṇi kṛṣṇārādhana-varjitāḥ |
snehād abhyarcitair liṅgaiḥ śālagrāma-samudbhavaiḥ ||29||
muktiṃ prayānti manujā yoga-sāṅkhyena varjitāḥ |
mal-liṅga-koṭibhir dṛṣṭair yat phalaṃ pūjitaiḥ stutaiḥ ||30||
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ tu ekasyām iha tad bhavet |
dvādaśaiva śilā yo vai śālagrāma-samudbhavāḥ ||31||
arcayed vaiṣṇavo nityaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ nibodha me |
koṭi-liṅga-sahasrais tu pūjitair jāhnavī-taṭe ||32||
kāśī-vāse yugāny aṣṭau dinenaikena tad bhavet |
kiṃ punar bahunā yas tu pujayed vaiṣṇavo naraḥ ||33||
nāhaṃ brahmādayo devāḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ samīhate |
tasmād bhaktyā ca mad-bhaktaiḥ prīty-arthaṃ mama putraka ||34||
kartavyaṃ mama tad-bhaktyā śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
śālagrāma-śilā-rūpī yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ ||35|	
tatra devāsurā yakṣā bhuvanāni caturdaśa ||36||
surāṇāṃ kīrtanaiḥ sarvaiḥ koṭibhiś ca phalaṃ labhet |
tat phalaṃ kīrtanād eva keśave sukṛtaṃ kalau ||37||
śālagrāma-śilāgre tu sakṛt piṇḍena tarpitāḥ |
vasanti pitaras tasya na saṅkhyā tatra vidyate ||38||
ye pibanti narā bhaktyā śālagrāma-śilā-jalam |
paṣca-gavya-sahasrais tu prāśitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||39||
prāyaścitte samutpanne kiṃ dānaiḥ kim upoṣaṇaiḥ |
cāndrāyaṇaiḥ sucīrṇaiś ca pītvā pādodakaṃ hareḥ ||40||
yaḥ karoti taḍāge tu pratimāṃ jala-śāyinīm |
koṭibhiś cāpi kiṃ kāryam anya-devaiś ca pūjitaiḥ ||41||
viṣṇu-mukhyās tu vai devās tatra jalpanti vai saha |
pramāṇam asti sarvasya sukṛtasya hi putraka ||42||
phala-pramāṇaṃ naivāsti śālagrāma-śilārcane |
yo dadāti śilāṃ viṣṇoḥ śālagrāma-samudbhavām ||43||
viprāya viṣṇu-bhaktāya teneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ śataiḥ |
gṛhe’pi vasatas tasya gaṅgā-snānaṃ dine dine ||44||
sastrātaḥ sarva-tīrtheṣu sarva-yajṣeṣu dīkṣitaḥ |
śālagrāma-śilā-toyair abhiṣekaṃ samācaret ||45||
svarge martye ca pātāle pāṣāṇāḥ santi vai guha |
śālagrāma-śilā-grāvṇā nāsti nāsti samā punaḥ ||46||
mānuṣe durlabhe loke saphalaṃ tasya jīvitam |
tila-prastha-śataṃ bhaktyā yo dadāti dine dine ||47||
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti śālagrāma-śilārcanāt |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ mūlaṃ dūrvā-dalaṃ tathā ||48||
jāyate meruṇā tulyaṃ śālagrāme samarpitam |
vidhi-hīno’pi yaḥ kaścit kriyā-mantra-vivarjitaḥ ||49||
cakrāṅka-bhuja āpnoti samyak-śāstroditaṃ phalam |
yat tu pūrvaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ keśave kleśa-nāśanam ||50||
tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tava snehena putraka |
kva tvaṃ vasasi he viṣṇo kim ādhāraḥ kim āśrayaḥ ||51||
kathaṃ vā prīyase deva tat sarvaṃ kathayasva me |
śrī-kṛṣṇa uvāca—
nivasāmi sadā śambho śālagrāmodbhave’śmani ||52||
tatraiva ratha-cakrāṅke yāni nāmāni me śṛṇu |
dvāra-deśe same cakre dṛśyete nāntaraṃ yadi |
vāsudevaḥ sa vijṣeyaḥ śuklaś caivātiśobhanaḥ ||53||
pradyumnaḥ sūrya-vaktras tu nīla-dīptis tathaiva ca |
suṣiraṃ cchidra-bahulaṃ dīrghākāraṃ tu tad bhavet ||54||
aniruddhas tu pītābho vartulaś cātiśobhanaḥ |
rekhā-trayāṅkito dvāri dṛṣṭa-padmena cihnavat ||55||
śyāmo nārāyaṇo devo nābhi-cakre tathonnate |
dīrgha-reṣā-samopeto dakṣiṇe suṣirānvitaḥ ||56||
ūrdhvaṃ mukhaṃ ca jānīyāt sundaraṃ hari-rūpiṇam |
kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva arthadaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||57||
parameṣṭhī ca śuklābhaḥ padma-cakra-samanvitaḥ |
bimbākṛtis tathā pṛṣṭhe suṣiraṃ cātipuṣkalam ||58||
kṛṣṇa-varṇas tathā viṣṇur mūle cakre suśobhane |
dvāropari tathā rekhā lakṣyate madhya-deśataḥ ||59||
kapilo narasiṃhaś ca pṛthu-cakraḥ suśobhitaḥ |
brahmacaryeṇa pūjyo’sāv anyathā vighnado bhavet ||60||
vārāhaḥ śakti-liṅgas tu cakre ca viṣame smṛte |
indra-nīla-nibhaḥ sthūlas tri-rekho nābhitaḥ śubhaḥ ||61||
dīrghā kāṣcana-varṇā yā bindu-traya-vibhūṣitā |
matsyākhyā sā śilā jṣeyā bhukti-mukti-phala-pradā ||62||
kūrmas tathonnataḥ pṛṣṭhe vartulaś cakra-pūritaḥ |
haritaṃ varṇam ādhatte kaustubhena tu cihnitaḥ ||63||
hayagrīvo hayākāro rekhā-paṣcaka-bhūṣitaḥ |
bahu-bindu-samākīrṇaḥ pṛṣṭhe nīlaṃ ca rūpakam ||64||
vaikuṇṭham avibhinnāṅgaṃ cakram ekaṃ tathā dhvajam |
dvāropari tathā rekhā guṣjākārā suśobhanā ||65||
śrīdharas tu tathā devaś cihnito vanamālayā |
kadamba-kusumākāro rekhā-paṣcaka-bhūṣitaḥ ||66||
vartulaś cātihrasvaś ca vāmanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
atasī-kusuma-prakhyo bindunā pariśobhitaḥ ||67||
sudarśanas tato devaḥ śyāma-varṇo mahā-dyutiḥ |
vāma-pārśve gadā-cakre rekhā caiva tu dakṣiṇe ||68||
dāmodaras tathā sthūlo madhye cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
dūrvābhaṃ dvāra-saṅkīrṇaṃ pīta-rekhaṃ tathaiva ca ||69||
nānā-varṇo hy anantas tu nānā-bhogena cihnitaḥ |
aneka-mūrtiko bhinnaḥ sarva-kāma-phala-pradaḥ ||70||
vidikṣu dikṣu sarvāsu yasyordhvaṃ dṛśyate mukham |
puruṣottamaḥ sa vijṣeyo bhukti-mukti-phala-pradaḥ ||71||
dṛśyate śikhare liṅgaṃ śālagrāma-śilodbhavam |
yasya yogeśvaro devo brahma-hatyāṃ vyapohati ||72||
āraktaḥ padmanābhas tu paṅkajaṃ vaktra-saṃyutam |
tasyābhyarcanato nityaṃ daridras tv īśvaro bhavet ||73||
cakrāṅkitaṃ hiraṇyāṅgaṃ raśmi-jālaṃ vinirdiśet |
suvarṇa-rekhā-bahulaṃ sphāṭika-dyuti-śobhitam ||74||
atisnigdhā siddhi-karī kṛṣṇā kīrtiṃ dadāti ca |
pāṇḍurā pāpa-dahanī pitā putra-phala-pradā ||75||
nīlā prayacchatī lakṣmīṃ raktā roga-pradāyinī |
rūkṣā udvega-jananī vakrā dāridrya-bhāginī ||76||
ekaṃ sudarśanaṃ jṣeyaṃ lakṣmī-nārāyaṇaṃ dvayam |
tṛtīyaṃ cācyutaṃ vidyāc caturthaṃ tu janārdanam ||77||
paṣcamaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ pradyumnam eva ca |
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ saptamaṃ ca aṣṭamaṃ puruṣottamam ||78||
navamaṃ ca nava-vyūhaṃ daśamaṃ tu tad-ātmakam |
ekādaśaṃ cāniruddhaṃ dvādaśaṃ dvādaśātmakam ||79||
ata ūrdhvaṃ tu cakrāṇi dṛśyante’nanta-saṃjṣake |
khaṇḍite truṭite bhagne śālagrāme na doṣa-bhāk ||80||
iṣṭā ca yasya yā mūrtiḥ satāṃ yatnena pūjayet |
skandhe kṛtvā tu yo’dhvānaṃ vahate śaila-nāyakam ||81||
tasya vaśyaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sa-carācaram |
śālagrāma-śilā yatra tatra saṃnihito hariḥ ||82||
tatra dānaṃ japaḥ snānaṃ vārāṇasyāḥ śatādhikam |
kurukṣetre prayāge ca naimiṣe puṣkare tathā ||83||
tatra koṭi-guṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ mahā-phalam |
brahma-hatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ yat kiṣcit kurute naraḥ ||84||
tat sarvaṃ nirdahaty āśu śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
śālagrāmodbhavo devo yatra dvārāvatī bhavaḥ ||85||
ubhayoḥ saṅgamo yatra muktis tatra na saṃśayaḥ |
brahmacāri-gṛhasthaiś ca vānaprasthaiś ca bhikṣubhiḥ ||86||
bhoktavyaṃ viṣṇu-naivedyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
tat-pūjanena mantrāś ca na japo na ca bhāvanā ||87||
na stutir nāpi cācāraḥ śālagrāma-śilārcane |
śālagrāma-śilāgre tu kṛtvā svastikam ādarāt ||88||
kārttike tu viśeṣeṇa punāty ā-saptamaṃ kulam |
aṇu-mātraṃ tu yaḥ kuryān maṇḍalaṃ keśavāgrataḥ ||89||
mṛdā dhātu-vikāraiś ca kalpa-koṭiṃ divaṃ vaset |
yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇam agni-hotram upāsate ||90||
kārttike svastikaṃ kṛtvā samam etan na saṃśayaḥ |
agamyāgamane caiva hy abhakṣasya tu bhakṣaṇe ||91||
tat pāpaṃ nāśam āyāti maṇḍayitvā harer gṛham |
maṇḍalaṃ kurute nityaṃ yā nārī keśavāgrataḥ |
sapta-janmāni vaidhavyaṃ na prāpnoti kadācana ||92||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
śāligrāma-māhātmyaṃ nāma 
viṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||120||

(121)
ekaviṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

īśvara uvāca—
dhātrī-cchāyāṃ samāśritya kuryāt piṇḍaṃ tu yo guha |
muktiṃ prayānti pitaraḥ prasādān mādhavasya tu ||1||
mūrdhni pāṇau mukhe caiva dehe caiva tu yo naraḥ |
dhatte dhātrī-phalaṃ vatsa-dhātrī-phala-vibhūṣitaḥ ||2||
dhātrī-phala-kṛtāhāro naro nārāyaṇo bhavet |
yaḥ kaścid vaiṣṇavo loke dhatte dhātrī-phalaṃ guha ||3||
priyo bhavati devānāṃ manuṣyāṇaṃ ca kā kathā |
na jahyāt tulasī-mālāṃ dhātrī-mālāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||4||
yāvat tiṣṭhati kaṇṭha-sthā dhātrī-mālā narasya hi |
tāvat tasya śarīre tu pratiṣṭhati ca keśavaḥ ||5||
dhātrīṃ phalaṃ tu tulasī-mṛttikā-dvārakodbhavā |
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya tritayaṃ yasya veśmani ||6||
yāvad dināni vahate dhātrī-mālāṃ kalau naraḥ |
tāvad-yuga-sahasrāṇi vaikuṇṭhe vasatir bhavet ||7||
mālā-yugmaṃ vahed yas tu dhātrī-tulasi-saṃbhavam |
vahate kaṇṭha-deśe tu kalpa-koṭi-ṃ divaṃ vaset ||8||
saṃniyamyendriya-grāmaṃ śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
yaḥ kuryān mānavo bhaktyā puṣpe puṣpe’śvamedha-jam ||9||
surāṇāṃ ca yathā viṣṇuḥ puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī tathā |
tulasyānudinaṃ devaṃ yo’rcayed garuḍa-dhvajam ||10||
janma-duḥkha-jarārogair mukto’sau muktim āpnuyāt |
tulasī-mālayā viṣṇuḥ pūjito yena kārttike ||11||
yamākṣara-kṛtāṃ mālāṃ sphuṭaṃ śauriḥ pramārjati |
śrī-candanaṃ sa-karpūram aguruṃ ca sa-kuṅkumam ||12||
ketakī-dīpa-dānaṃ ca sarvadā keśava-priyam |
kārttike ketakī-puṣpaṃ dattaṃ yena kalau yuge ||13||
dīpa-dānaṃ mahāsena-kulānāṃ tārayec chatam |
saro-ruhāṇi tulasī ketakī muni-puṣpakam ||14||
kārttike ca dināny eva dīpa-dānaṃ tu paṣcamam |
ketakī-mālayā yena kārttike puṣpa-maṇḍapam ||15||
keśavasya kṛtaṃ vatsa vasatir divi tasya ca |
ketakī-puṣpakenaiva pūjito garuḍa-dhvajaḥ ||16||
samāḥ sahasraṃ suprīto jāyate madhusūdanaḥ |
arcayitvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ kusumaiḥ ketakī-bhavaiḥ ||17||
puṇyaṃ tad-bhavanaṃ yāti keśavasya śivaṃ guha |
damanakenāpi deveśaṃ samprāpte madhu-mādhave ||18||
samabhyarcya muni-śreṣṭha arcanāl labhate phalam |
agasti-kusumair devaṃ yo’rcayeta janārdanam ||19||
darśanāt tasya bho vipra narakāgniḥ praṇaśyati |
na tat karoti viprarṣe tapasā toṣito hariḥ ||20||
yat karoti mahāsena muni-puṣpair alaṅkṛtaḥ |
vihāya sarva-puṣpāṇi muni-puṣpeṇa keśavam ||21||
kārttike yo’rcayed bhaktyā vāji-medha-phalaṃ labhet |
muni-puṣpa-kṛtāṃ mālāṃ yo dadāti janārdane ||22||
devendro’pi muni-śreṣṭha kurute tasya sat-kathām |
gavām ayuta-dānena yat phalaṃ prāpyate guha ||23||
muni-puṣpeṇa caikena kārttike labhate phalam |
kaustubhena yathā prīto yathā ca vanamālayā ||24||
tulasī-dalena saṃprītaḥ kārttike ca tathā hariḥ ||
(sūta uvāca—)
praśrayāvanataṃ dṛṣṭvā kumāraṃ bhakti-tat-param ||25||
punaḥ provāca bhagavān mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
(īśvara uvāca—)
śṛṇu dīpasya māhātmyaṃ kārttike śikhi vāhana ||26||
pitaraś caiva vāṣchanti sadā pitṛ-gaṇair vṛtāḥ |
bhaviṣyati kule’smākampitṛ-bhaktaḥ suputrakaḥ ||27||
kārttike dīpa-dānena yas toṣayati keśavam |
ghṛtena dīpako yasya tila-tailena vā punaḥ ||28||
jvalate yasya senānīr aśvamedhena tasya kim |
teneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ tīrthāvagāhanam ||29||
dīpa-dānaṃ kṛtaṃ yena kārttike keśavāgrataḥ |
kṛṣṇa-pakṣe viśeṣeṇa putra paṣca-dināni ca ||30||
puṇyāni teṣu yo datte dīpaṃ so’kṣayam āpnuyāt |
ekādaśyāṃ parair dattaṃ dīpaṃ prajvālya mūṣikā ||31||
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya parāṃ gatim avāpa sā |
lubdhako’pi caturdaśyāṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram ||32||
nirbhakṣaḥ paramaṃ prāpya viṣṇu-lokaṃ jagāma saḥ |
śvapākasyāśrayād vaiśyā dīpaṃ kṛtvā paraiḥ kṛtam ||33||
śuddhā līlāvatī bhūtvā jagāma svargam akṣayam |
gopaḥ kaścid amāvasyāṃ pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ||34||
muhur muhur jayety uktvā  rāja-rājeśvaro’bhavat |
tasmād dīpāḥ pradātavyā rātrāv astamate ravau ||35||
gṛheṣu sarva-goṣṭheṣu sarveṣv āyataneṣu ca |
devālayeṣu devānāṃ śmaśāneṣu saraḥsu ca ||36||
ghṛtādinā śubhārthāya yāvat paṣca-dināni ca |
pāpinaḥ pitaro ye ca lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ |
te’pi yānti parāṃ muktiṃ dīpa-dānasya puṇyataḥ ||37||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye 
dīpa-gandha-dhātrī-māhātmya-varṇano nāma 
ekaviṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ 
||121||

(122)
dvāviṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

kārttikeya uvāca—
dīpāvaliphalaṃ nāthaviśeṣādbrūhisāṃ pratam |
kimarthaṃ kriyatesātutasyāḥkādevatābhavet ||1||
kiṃ ca tatrabhaveddeyaṃ kiṃ nadeyaṃ vadaprabho |
praharṣaḥko’tranirdiṣṭaḥkrīḍākātraprakīrtitā ||2||
sūta uvāca—
itiskaṃ davacaḥśrutvā bhagavānkāmaśoṣaṇaḥ |
sādhūktvākārttikaṃ viprāḥ prahasannidamabravīt ||3||
śrīśiva uvāca—
kārttikasyāsitepakṣetrayodaśyāṃ tupāvake |
yamadīpaṃ bahirdadyādapamṛtyurvinaśyati ||4||
mṛtyunā pāśa-hastena kālena bhāryayā saha |
trayodaśīdīpa-dānātsūryajaḥ prīyatāmiti ||5||
kārttike kṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ vidhūdaye |
avaśyamevakartavyaṃ snānaṃ ca pāpabhīrubhiḥ ||6||
pūrvaviddhācaturdaśyākārttikasyasitetare |
pakṣepratyūṣasamayesnānaṃ kuryād ataṃ dritaḥ ||7||
tailelakṣmīrjalegaṅgādīpāvalyāṃ ca turdaśīm |
prāptaḥ snānaṃ hiyaḥ kuryād yamalokaṃ napaśyati ||8||
apāmārgas tathātuṃ bīprapunnāṭaṃ ca vāhvalam |
bhrāmayetsnānamadhyetunarakasyakṣayāyavai ||9||
sītāloṣṭasamāyuktasakaṇṭakadalānvita |
harapāpamapāmārgabhrāmyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||10||
apāmārgaṃ prapunnāṭaṃ bhrāmayecchirasopari |
tataś ca tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yamarājasyanāma bhiḥ ||11||
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca |
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarva-bhūta-kṣayāya ca ||12||
audumbarāya dadhnāya nīlāya parameṣṭhine |
vṛkodarāya citrāya citraguptāya vai namaḥ ||13||
narakāya pradātavyo dīpaḥ saṃpūjya devatāḥ |
tataḥ pradoṣa-samaye dīpān dadyān manoharān ||14||
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhavaneṣuviśeṣataḥ |
kūṭāgāreṣucaityeṣusabhāsucanadīṣuca ||15||
prākārodyānavāpīṣupratolīniṣkuṭeṣuca |
maṃ durāsuviviktāsuhastiśālāsucaiva hi ||16||
evaṃ prabhātasamayehyamāvāsyāṃ tupāvakaṃ |
snātvā devānpitṝnbhaktyāsaṃpūjyāthapraṇamyaca ||17||
kṛtvātupārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ |
bhojyairnānāvidhairviprānbhojayitvākṣamāpayet ||18||
tatoparāhṇasamayepoṣayennāgarānpriya |
teṣāṃ goṣṭhīṃ ca mānaṃ ca kṛtvāsaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ ||19||
vaktṛṇāṃ vatsaraṃ yāvatprītirutpadyateguha |
aprabuddheharaupūrvaṃ strībhirlakṣmīḥ prabodhayet ||20||
prabodhasamayelakṣmīṃ bodhayitvātusustriyā |
pumānvaivatsaraṃ yāvallakṣmīstaṃ naivamuṣcati ||21||
abhayaṃ prāpyaviprebhyoviṣṇubhītāsuradviṣaḥ |
suptaṃ kṣīrodadhaujṣātvālakṣmīṃ padmāśritāṃ tathā ||22||
tvaṃ jyotiḥśrīraviścandrovidyutsauvarṇatārakaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirdīpajyotiḥ sthitātuyā ||23||
yālakṣmīrdivasepuṇyedīpāvalyāṃ ca bhūtale |
gavāṃ goṣṭhetukārttikyāṃ sālakṣmīrvaradāmama ||24||
śaṃ karaścabhavānīcakrīḍayādyūtamāsthitau |
bhavānyābhyarcitā lakṣmīr dhenu-rūpeṇa saṃsthitā ||25||
gauryā jitvā purā śambhur nagno dyūte visarjitaḥ |
ato’yaṃ śaṅkaro duḥkhī gaurī nityaṃ sukhe sthitā ||26||
pratha maṃ vijayoyasyatasya saṃvatsaraṃ sukham |
evaṃ gateniśīthetujanenidrārdhalocane ||27||
tāvannagaranārībhis tūryaḍiṇḍimavādanaiḥ |
niṣkāsyateprahṛṣṭābhiralakṣmīścagṛhāṃ gaṇāt ||28||
parājayeviruddhaṃ syātpratipadyuditeravau |
prātargovarddhanaḥ pūjyodyūtaṃ rātrausamācaret ||29||
bhūṣaṇīyās tathāgāvovarjyāvahanadohanāt |
govardhana-dharādhāra gokula-trāṇa-kāraka ||30||
viṣṇu-bāhu-kṛtocchrāya gavāṃ koṭi-prado bhava |
yā lakṣmīr loka-pālānāṃ dhenu-rūpeṇa saṃsthitā ||31||
ghṛtaṃ vahati yajṣānāṃ mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
agrataḥ santu me gāvo gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
gāvo me hṛdaye santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham ||32||
iti govardhana-pūjā ||
sadbhāvenaivasaṃtoṣyadevānsatpuruṣānnarān |
itareṣāmannapānairvākyadānenapaṇḍitān ||33||
vastrais tāmbūladīpaiś capuṣpakarpūrakuṃ kumaiḥ |
bhakṣyairuccāvacairbhojyair aṃ taḥ puranivāsinaḥ ||34||
grāmarṣabhaṃ ca dānaiś casāmaṃ tānnṛpatirdhanaiḥ |
padātijanasaṃ##ścagraiveyaiḥ kaṭakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||35||
svānamātyāṃ ścatānrājātoṣayetsvajanānpṛthak |
yathārthaṃ toṣayitvātutatomallānnaṭāṃs tathā  ||36||
vṛṣabhāṃ ścamahokṣāṃ ścayuddhyamānānparaiḥ saha |
rājānyāṃ ścāpi yodhāṃ ścapadātīnsasamalaṅkṛtān ||37||
maṃ cārūḍhaḥ svayaṃ paśyennaṭanartakacāraṇān |
yodhayedvāsayec caivagomahiṣyādikaṃ ca yat ||38||
vatsānākarṣayedgobhiruktipratyuktivādanāt |
tatoparāhṇasamayepūrvasyāṃ diśipāvake ||39||
mārgapālīṃ prabadhnīyāddurgastaṃ bhe’thapādape |
kuśakāśamayīṃ divyāṃ laṃ bakairbahubhirguha ||40||
vīkṣayitvāgajānaśvānmārgapālyāstalenayet |
gāvairvṛṣāṃ ścamahiṣānmahiṣīrghaṇṭikotkaṭāḥ ||41||
kṛtahomairdvijendrais tubadhnīyānmārgapālikām |
namaskāraṃ tataḥ kuryānmantreṇānenasuvrataḥ ||42||
mārgapālinamas tubhyaṃ sarvalokasukhaprade |
mārgapālītaleskaṃ dayānti gāvomahāvṛṣāḥ ||43||
rājānorājaputrāścabrāhmaṇāścaviśeṣataḥ |
mārgapālīṃ samullaṃ ghyanirujaḥ sukhinohite ||44||
kṛtvaitatsarvameveharātraudaityapaterbaleḥ |
pūjāṃ kuryāttataḥ sākṣād bhūmau maṇḍalakekṛte ||45||
balimālikhyadaityendraṃ varṇakaiḥ paṣcaraṃ gakaiḥ |
sarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ vindhyāvalisamanvitam |46||
kūṣmāṇḍamayajaṃ bhorumadhudānavasaṃvṛtam |
saṃpūrṇaṃ hṛṣṭavadanaṃ kirīṭotkaṭakuṇḍalam ||47||
dvibhujaṃ daityarājānaṃ kārayitvāsvakepunaḥ |
gṛhasyamadhyeśālāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ tato’rcayet ||48||
mātṛbhrātṛjanaiḥ sārddhaṃ saṃtuṣṭobaṃ dhubhiḥ saha |
kamalaiḥ kumudaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kalhāra-raktakotpalaiḥ ||49||
gandha-puṣpān na naivedyaiḥ sakṣīrair guḍa-pāyasaiḥ |
madyamāṃ sasurālehyacoṣyabhakṣyopahārakaiḥ ||50||
mantreṇānenarājendraḥ samantrīsapurohitaḥ |
pūjāṃ kariṣyate yo vai saukhyaṃ syāt tasya vatsaram ||51||
balirāja namas tubhyaṃ virocana-suta prabho |
bhaviṣyendra surārāte pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||52||
evaṃ pūjā-vidhiṃ kṛtvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ |
kārayed vai kṣaṇaṃ rātrau naṭa-nartaka gāyakaiḥ ||53||
lokaiś cāpi gṛhasyānte saparyāṃ śukla-taṇḍulaiḥ |
saṃsthāpya bali-rājānaṃ phalaiḥ puṣpaiś ca pūjayet ||54||
balimuddiśyavaitatrakāryaṃ sarvaṃ ca pāvake |
yāniyānyakṣayānyāhuṛṣayastatvadarśinaḥ ||55||
yadatradīyatedānaṃ svalpaṃ vāyadivābahu |
tadakṣayaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ śubham ||56||
rātrauyenakariṣyanti tavapūjāṃ balernarāḥ |
teṣāmaśrotriyaṃ dharmaṃ sarvaṃ tvāmupatiṣṭhatu ||57||
viṣṇunācasvayaṃ vatsatuṣṭenabalayepunaḥ |
upakārakaraṃ dattamasurāṇāṃ mahotsavam ||58||
tadāprabhṛtisenānepravṛttākaumudīsadā |
sarvopadravavidrāvāsarvavighnavināśinī ||59||
lokaśokaharākāmyādhanapuṣṭisukhāvahā |
kuśabdenamahījṣeyāmudaharṣetatodvayam ||60||
dhātutvenigamaiś caivatenaiṣākaumudīsmṛtā |
kaumodaṃ tejanāyasmānnānābhāvaiḥ parasparam ||61||
hṛṣṭatuṣṭāḥ sukhāpannāstenaiṣākaumudīsmṛtā |
kumudānibaleryasyāṃ dīyaṃ tetenaṣaṇmukha ||62||
aghārthaṃ pārthivaiḥ putratenaiṣākaumudīsmṛtā |
ekamevamahorātraṃ varṣevarṣe ca kārttike ||63||
dattaṃ dānavarājasyaādarśamivabhūtala |
yaḥ karoti nṛporājyetasya vyādhibhayaṃ kutaḥ ||64||
subhikṣaṃ kṣemamārogyaṃ tasya saṃpadanuttamā |
nīrujaścajanāḥ sarvesarvopadravavarjitāḥ ||65||
kaumudīkriyatetasmādbhāvaṃ kartuṃ mahītale |
yoyādṛśenabhāvenatiṣṭhatyasyāṃ ca ṣaṇamukha ||66||
harṣaduḥkhādibhāvenatasya varṣaṃ prayātihi |
ruditerodatevarṣaṃ hṛṣṭevarṣaṃ praharṣitam ||67||
bhuktebhoktābhavedvarṣaṃ svasthesvasthaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tasmātprahṛṣṭaiḥ kartavyākaumudīcaśubhairnaraiḥ ||68|
vaiṣṇavīdānavīceyanti thiḥ proktācakārttike ||69||
dīpotsavaṃ janita-sarva-jana-prasādaṃ 
kurvanti ye śubhatayā bali-rāja-pūjām |
dānopabhoga-sukha-buddhimatāṃ kulānāṃ 
harṣaṃ prayāti sakalaṃ prabhudaṃ ca varṣam ||70||
skandaitāstithayonūnaṃ dvitīyādyāścaviśrutāḥ |
māsaiś caturbhiś ca tataḥ prāvṛṭ-kāle śubhāvahāḥ ||71||
pratha māśrāvaṇemāsitathābhādrapadeparā |
tṛtīyāśvayujemāsicaturthīkārttike bhavet ||72||
kaluṣāśrāvaṇemāsitathābhādropademalā |
āśvinepretasaṃcārākārttike yāmyakāmatā ||73||
guha uvāca—
kasmātsākaluṣāproktākasmātsānirmalāmatā |
kasmātsāpretasaṃcārākasmādyāmyāprakīrtitā ||74||
sūta uvāca—
itiskaṃ davacaḥśrutvā bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ |
 uvāca—vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ prahasanvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ||75||
maheśa uvāca—
purāvṛtravadhevṛtteprāpterājyepuraṃ dare |
brahma-hatyāpanodārthamaśvamedhaḥ pravartitaḥ ||76||
krodhādindreṇavajreṇabrahma-hatyāniṣūditā |
ṣaḍvidhāsākṣitaukṣiptāvṛkṣatoyamahītale ||77||
nāryāṃ bhrūṇahaṇivahnausaṃvibhajyayathākramam |
tatpāpaśravaṇātpūrvaṃ dvitīyāyādinena ca ||78||
nārīvṛkṣanadībhūmivahnibhrūṇahanas tathā |
kaluṣībhavanaṃ jātohyatorthaṃ kaluṣāsmṛtā ||79||
madhukaiṭabhayoraktepurāmagnānumedinī |
aṣṭāṃ gulāpavitrāsānārīṇāṃ turajomalam ||80||
nadyaḥ prāvṛṇmalāsarvāvahnirūrdhvaṃ maṣīmalaḥ |
niryāsamalināvṛkṣāḥ saṃgādrbhūṇahanomalāḥ ||81||
kaluṣāni caraṃ tyasyāṃ tenaiṣākaluṣāmatā |
devarṣipitṛdharmāṇāṃ niṃ dakānāstikāḥśaṭhāḥ ||82||
teṣāṃ sāvāṅmalātpūtādvitīyātenanirmalā |
anadhyāyeṣuśāstrāṇipāṭhayanti paṭhanti ca ||83||
sāṅkhyakāstārkikāḥśrautāsteṣāṃ śabdāpaśabdajāt |
malātpūtādvitīyāyāṃ tatorthenirmalācasā ||84||
kṛṣṇasyajanmanāvatsatrailokyaṃ pāvitaṃ bhavet |
nabhasyetevinirdiṣṭānirmalāsātithirbudhaiḥ ||85||
agniṣvāttābarhiṣadaājyapāḥ somapās tathā |
pitṝnpitāmahānpretasaṃcārātpretasaṃcarā ||86||
pretāstupitaraḥ proktāsteṣāṃ tasyāṃ tusaṃcaraḥ |
putra-pautres tu dauhitraiḥ svadhā mantrais tu pūjitāḥ ||87||
śrāddhadāna-makhais tṛptā yānty ataḥ preta saṣcarā |
mahālaye tu pretānāṃ saṣcāro bhuvi dṛśyate ||88||
tenaiṣā preta-saṣcārā kīrtitā śikhi-vāhana |
yamasya kriyate pūjā yato’syāṃ pāvake naraiḥ ||89||
tenaiṣā yāmyakā proktā satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam |
etat kārttika-māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti narottamāḥ ||90||
kārttika-snānajaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāṃ bhavati niścitam ||91||
kārttike ca dvitīyāyāṃ pūrvāhṇe yamam arcayet |
bhānujāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā yama-lokaṃ na paśyati ||92||
kārttike śukla-pakṣe tu dvitīyāyāṃ tu śaunaka |
yamo yamunayā pūrvaṃ bhojitaḥ sva-gṛhe’rcitaḥ ||93||
dvitīyāyāṃ mahotsargo nārakīyāś ca tarpitāḥ |
pāpebhyo vipra-yuktās te muktāḥ sarva-nibandhanāt ||94||
āśaṃsitāś ca santuṣṭāḥ sthitāḥ sarve yadṛcchayā |
teṣāṃ mahotsavo vṛtto yama-rāṣṭra-sukhāvahaḥ ||95||
atoyam advitīyeyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā |
tasmānnijagṛhevipranabhoktavyaṃ tatobudhaiḥ ||96||
snehenabhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ puṣṭivarddhanaṃ |
dānāni capradeyānibhaginībhyovidhānataḥ ||97||
svarṇālaṃ kāravastrāṇipūjāsatkārasaṃyutam |
bhoktavyaṃ sahajāyāścabhaginyāhastataḥ param ||98||
sarvāsubhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ balavarddhanam |
ūrjeśukladvitīyāyāṃ pūjitastarpitoyamaḥ ||99||
mahiṣāsanamārūḍhodaṇḍamudgarabhṛtprabhuḥ |
veṣṭitaḥkiṃ karaihṛṣṭais tasmaiyāmyātmanenamaḥ ||100||
yairbhaginyaḥ suvāsinyovastradānāditoṣitāḥ |
nateṣāṃ vatsaraṃ yāvatkalahonariporbhayam ||101||
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dharmakāmārthasādhanam |
vyākhyātaṃ sakalaṃ putrasarahasyaṃ mayānagha ||102||
yasyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarāja-devaḥ 
saṃbhojitaḥ pratitithau svasṛ-sauhṛdena |
tasmāt svasuḥ kara-talād iha yo bhunakti 
prāpnoti vitta-śubha-saṃpadam uttamāṃ saḥ ||103||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām

(123)
trayoviṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

kārttikeya uvāca—
bhagavaṣcchrotum icchāmivratānāmuttamaṃ vratam |
viiṃ dhaṃ māsopavāsasyaphalaṃ cāsyayathoditam ||1||
yathāvidhinaraiḥ kāryāvratacaryāyathābhavet |
ārabhyateyathāpūrvaṃ samāpyaṃ hiyathāvidhi ||2||
yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ tukartavyaṃ tatprabrūhimaheśvara |
vratametatsuraśreṣṭhavistareṇamamānagha ||3||
śrī-rudra uvāca—
sādhupāvakisarvaṃ teyatpṛṣṭaṃ prabruve’nagha |
bhaktyāmatimatāṃ śreṣṭhaśṛṇuṣva gadatomama ||4||
surāṇāṃ ca yathāviṣṇustapatāṃ ca yathāraviḥ |
meruḥśikhariṇāṃ yadvadvainateyaścapakṣiṇām ||5||
tīrthānāṃ tuyathāgaṅgāprajānāṃ tuyathāvaṇik |
śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavratānāṃ tutadvan māsopavāsanam ||6||
sarvavrateṣuyatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣucaiva hi |
sarvadā nodbhavaṃ caivalabhenmāsopavāsakṛt ||7||
agniṣṭomādibhiryajṣairvividhairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ |
natatpuṇyamavāpnotiyanmāsaparilaṃ ghanāt ||8||
tenajaptaṃ hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtāsvadhā |
yaḥ karoti vidhānena naro māsam upoṣaṇam ||9||
uddiśyavaiṣṇavaṃ yajṣaṃ samabhyarcyajanārdanam |
gurorājṣāṃ tatolabdhvākuryānmāsopavāsanam ||10||
vaiṣṇavāniyathoktānikṛtvāsarvavratānitu |
dvādaśyādīnipuṇyānitatomāsamupāvaset ||11||
atikṛcchṝṃ ca pārākaṃ kṛtvācāndrāyaṇaṃ tataḥ |
māsopavāsaṃkurvītajṣātvādehabalābalam ||12||
vānaprasthoyatirvāpinārīvāvidhavāmune |
māsopavāsaṃkurvītagurorviprājṣayātataḥ ||13||
āśvinasyāmalepakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ |
vratametattugṛhṇiyādyāvattriṃ śaddinānitu ||14||
vāsudevaṃ samabhyarcyakārttikaṃ sakalaṃ naraḥ |
māsaṃcopavasedyas tu samuktiphalabhāgbhavet ||15||
acyutasyālayebhaktyātrikālaṃ kumudaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
mālatīndīvaraiḥ padmaiḥ kamalais tu sugandhibhiḥ ||16||
kuṃ kumośīrakarpūrairvilipyavaracandanaiḥ |
naivedyadhūpadīpādyair arcayec ca janārdanam ||17||
manasākarmaṇāvācāpūjayed garuḍadhvajam |
kurvannarastrīvidhavābṛhadbhaktir jitendriyaḥ ||18||
nāmnāmevatathālāpaṃ viṣṇoḥ kuryād aharniśam |
bhaktyāviṣṇos tu tirvācyāmithyālāpavivarjitā ||19||
sarvasatvadayāyuktaḥśāṃ tavṛttirahiṃ sakaḥ |
suptobāhyāsanasthovāvāsudevaṃ prakīrtayet ||20||
smṛtvālokanagandhādisvāditaṃ parikīrtitam |
annasyavarjayed rgāsaṃgrāsānāṃ sampramokṣaṇam ||21||
gātrābhyaṃ gaṃ śirobhyaṃ gaṃ tāmbūlaṃ savilepanam |
vratasthovarjayet sarvaṃ yaccānyaccanirākṛtam ||22||
navratasthaḥ spṛśetkiṃ cidvikarmasthaṃ nacālayet |
devatāyatanetiṣṭhangṛhasthaścācaredravratam ||23||
kṛtvāmāsopavāsaṃtuyathoktavidhinānaraḥ |
nārīvāvidhavāsādhvīvāsudevaṃ samarcayet ||24||
anyūnādhikamevaṃ tuvrataṃ triṃ śaddinairiti |
kṛtvāmāsopavāsaṃtusaṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ ||25||
tato’rcayed eva puṇyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ garuḍa-dhvajam |
pūjayet puṣpa-mālābhir gandha-dhūpa-vilepanaiḥ ||26||
vastrālaṃ kāravādyaiś catoṣayedacyutaṃ naraḥ |
saṃsnāpayeddhariṃ bhaktyātīrthacandanavāribhiḥ ||27||
candanenānuliptāṃ gandhūpapuṣpairalaṅkṛtam |
vastradānādibhiś caiva bhojayitvādvijottamān ||28||
dadyāc cadakṣiṇāṃ tebhyaḥ praṇipatyakṣamāpayet |
viprānakṣamāpayitvātuvisṛjyābhyarcyapūjyaca ||29||
evaṃ vittānusāreṇabhaktiyuktenaśaktitaḥ |
evaṃ māsopavāsānhikṛtvābhyarcajanārdanam ||30||
bhojayitvādvijāṃ ś caiva viṣṇu-lokemahīyate |
evaṃ māsopavāsāṃ tevṛtvāviprāṃ strayodaśa ||31||
niryāpayettatas tānvaividhināyenatac chṛṇu |
kārayedvaiṣṇavaṃ yajṣamekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ||32||
pūjayitvātudeveśamācāryānujṣayāharim |
arcayitvā yathā śaktyā hy abhivādya guruṃ tathā ||33||
tato’nu bhojayed viprān namaskāra-puraḥ-saram |
viśuddhakulacāritrānviṣṇu-pūjanatat-parān ||34||
pūjayitvātathāsarvānbhojayitvātrayodaśa |
tāmbūlavastrayugmānibhojanācchādanāni ca ||35||
yogapaṭṭānisūtrāṇibrahmasūtrāṇicaiva hi |
dattvācaivadvijāgryebhyaḥ pūjayitvāpraṇamyaca ||36||
tatonupūjayed bhaktyāśayyāstaraṇasaṃskṛtām |
sācchādanāṃ śubhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sopadhānāma laṃ kṛtām ||37||
kārayitvātmanomūrtikāṣcanīṃ tusvaśaktitaḥ |
nyaset tasyāṃ tu śayyāyām arcayitvā srag-ādibhiḥ ||38||
āsanaṃ pādukā-chatraṃ vastra-yugmam upānahau |
pavitrāṇi ca puṣpāṇi śayyāyām upakalpayet ||39||
evaṃ śayyāṃ tu saṃkalpya praṇipatya ca tān dvijān |
prārthayec cānumodārthaṃ viṣṇu-lokaṃ vrajāmy aham ||40||
tato vrajen naraḥ preṣṭhaṃ viṣṇoḥ sthānam anāma yam |
maṇḍapa-sthāṃ stutān viprān iti vācyaṃ muhur muhuḥ ||41||
mantra--hīnaṃ bhakti--hīnaṃ kriyā--hīnaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātu bhavad-vākya-prasādataḥ |
vidhir māsopavāsasya yathāvat parikīrtitaḥ ||42||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde 
māsopavāsa-katha naṃ nāma 
trayoviṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ

īśvara uvāca—
prabodhinyāścamāhātmyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyavarddhanam |

dadātyupoṣitāviprahelayāharibodhinī ||6||

yathoktenavidhānenapaṣcarātroditenavai |

namo nārāyaṇāyeti kārttike yo’rcayed dharim |
sa mukto nārakair duḥkhaiḥ padaṃ gacchaty anāmayam ||19||
harer nāma sahasraṃ ca gajarājasya mokṣaṇam |
kārttike paṭhate yas tu punar-janma na vindati ||20||
yuga-koṭi-sahasrāṇi manvantara-śatāni ca |
dvādaśyāṃ kārttike māsi jāgarī vasate divi ||21||
kule tasya ca saṃjātāḥ śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ |
prāpnuvanti padaṃ viṣṇos tasmāt kurvīta jāgaram ||22||

śvetadvīpe tu vasate pitṛbhiḥ saha bhāmini ||23||
naivedya-dānaṃ haraye kārttike dina-saṃkṣaye |
yugānivasatesvargetāvanti munisattamāḥ ||24||
akṣayaṃ muni-śārdūla mālatī kamalārcanam |

itiarghyamantraḥ ||

māgha-māhātmyam

(125)
paṣca-viṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ—
sūta sūta mahābhāga tvayā loka-hitaiṣiṇā |
kathitaṃ kārttikākhyānaṃ bhukti-mukti-pradāyakam ||1||
adhunā māgha-māhātmyaṃ vadano loma-harṣaṇe |
śrutena ye na lokānāṃ saṃśayaḥ kṣīyate mahān ||2||
purā kena mahābhāga loke'smin samprakāśitam |
māgha-snānasya māhātmyaṃ setihāsaṃ tadādiśa ||3||
sūta uvāca—
sādhu sādhu muni-śreṣṭhā yūyaṃ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇaḥ |
yat pṛcchatha mudā yuktā bhaktyā kṛṣṇa-kathā muhuḥ ||4||
kathayiṣyāmi māghasya māhātmyaṃ puṇya-vardhanam |
pāpa-ghnaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ puṃsāṃ snātānāṃ cāruṇodaye ||5||
ekadā pārvatī viprāḥ śaGkaraṃ loka-śaGkaram |
papraccha vinayopetā spṛṣṭvā tac-caraṇāmbujam ||6||
pārvaty uvāca—
deva-deva mahādeva bhaktānām abhaya-prada |
prasīda nātha viśveśa yat pṛcche tad vadādhunā ||7||
śrutā nānā-vidhā dharmās tvattaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā vibho |
adhunā śrotum icchāmi māhātmyaṃ māghajaṃ vada ||8||
tat tu kena purā cīrṇaṃ ko vidhiḥ kā ca devatā |

 tatra vratenadātavyaṃ sānnaṃ copaskarānvitam |

kārtavīrya uvāca— 
bhagavan rākṣasaḥ ko'sau sā kā kāṣcana-mālinī ||58||

śṛṇurājanvicitraṃ tvamitihāsampurātanam |
yasya smaraṇa-mātreṇa vājapeya-phalaṃ labhet ||60||

prayāge māgha-māse sā snātvā yāti harālayam ||61||

candrānanāsukeśīcapīnonnatapayodharā ||63||

kā tvaṃ kamala-patrākṣi kuta āgamyate tvayā ||64||
ārdraṃ ca vasanaṃ kasmāt sārdrā te kabarī kutaḥ |
kutra āgamyate bhīru kutas te khecarī-gatiḥ ||65||
kena puṇyena vā bhadre tava tejo-mayaṃ vapuḥ |
atīva-rūpa-sampannaṃ sambhūtaṃ ca manoharam ||66||
tvad-vastra-bindu-pātena mama mūrdhni sulocane |
kṣaṇena hy agamacchāntiṃ krūraṃ me mānasaṃ sadā ||67||
nīrasya mahimā ko'yam etad vyākhyātum arhasi |
tvaṃ me śīlavatī bhāsinā kṛtir nirguṇā bhavet ||68||
apsarā uvāca—
śrūyatām apsarāś cāhaṃ bho rakṣaḥ kāma-rūpiṇī |
prayāgataś cāgatā'haṃ nāmnā kāṣcana-mālinī ||69||
ārdraḥ parikaro me'taḥ susnātā'haṃ sitāsite |
gantavyaṃ tu mayā rakṣaḥ kailāse tu nagottame ||70||
tatrāste pārvatī-nāthaḥ surāsura-supūjitaḥ |
veṇī-vāri-prabhāveṇa rakṣas te krūratāgatā ||71||
jātāhaṃ yena puṇyena gandharvasya sumedhasaḥ |
kanyakā divya-rūpā tu tat sarvaṃ kathayāmi te ||72||
kaliṅgādhipaterājṣastvahamāsīccaveśyakā |

taj-janmani mayā rakṣo bhuktvā bhogān yathecchayā ||74||
mohitaṃ tat pūraṃ sarvaṃ mayā yauvana-sampadā |
ratnāni ca vicitrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni dhanāni ca ||75||
vāsāṃsi citra-rūpāṇi karpūrāguru-candanam |
etac copārjitaṃ sarvaṃ mayā mohana-rūpayā ||76||
nāhaṃ jānāmi hemnoṃtaṃ sva-nivāse niśācara |
saṃsevante yuvāno me caraṇau kāma-pīḍitāḥ ||77||
mayā te vaṣcitāḥ sarve sarvasvena tu māyayā |
anyonya-spardhā bhāvena mṛtāḥ kecit tu kāminaḥ ||78||
itthaṃ tan nagare ramye sakale me gatis tadā |
prāpte tu vārddhake kāle śuśoca hṛdayaṃ mama |
na dattaṃ na hutaṃ japtaṃ na vrataṃ caritaṃ mayā ||79||
nārādhito mayā devaś catur-varga-phala-pradaḥ|
na mayā pūjitā devī durgā durgati-nāśinī |
sarva-pāpa-haro viṣṇur na smṛto bhoga-lubdhayā ||80||
na ca santarpitā viprā na kṛtaṃ prāṇināṃ hitam |
aṇumātram idaṃ puṇyaṃ na kṛtaṃ ca pramādataḥ ||81||
pātakaṃ tu kṛtaṃ bhadra te na me dahyate manaḥ |
bahudhaivaṃ vilapyāhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā ||82||
brahmaṇyaṃ veda-vidvāṃsaṃ tasya rājṣaḥ purohitam |
sa hi pṛṣṭo mayā rakṣaḥ kathaṃ me niṣkṛtir bhavet ||83||

svenaiva karmaṇā taptāṃ varākīṃ dīna-mānasām ||84||
pāpa-paṅka-nimagnāṃ tvaṃ mām uddhara kaca-grahaiḥ |
mayi kāruṇyajaṃ vāri varṣa-harṣa-dṛśā dvija ||85||

ity asau mad-vacaḥ śrutvā ca kārānugrahaṃ mayi ||86||
dvija uvāca—
niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ jāne sarvaṃ te'haṃ varānane |

 tatra gatvā kuru-snānaṃ tena pāpa-kṣayas tava |
sarvaṃ mano-gataṃ bhadre tvadīyaṃ śocitaṃ mayā ||88||
nāham anyat prapaśyāmi yat te pāpa-praṇāśanam |
prāyaścittaṃ paraṃ tīrthe snānaṃ ca ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtam ||89||
kiṃ tu tīrthe tyajed bhīru manasāpy aśubhaṃ kṛtam |
prayāga-snāna-śuddhātvaṃ svargaṃ yāsyasi niścitam ||90||
prayāga-snāna-mātreṇa nṛṇāṃ svargo na saṃśayaḥ |

adho-mukhas tato bhūtvā devarājo vinirgataḥ ||95||

meroḥ śirasi toyāḍhye śata-yojana-vistṛte ||96||
 tatra gatvā praviṣṭas tu hemāmbhoruha-korake |
 tatra stho garhayan nityam ātmānaṃ man-mathaṃ tathā ||97||
dhik tāṃ kāmātmatāṃ loke sadyaḥ pātaka-dāyinīm |
yayā hi narakaṃ yāti sarva-loka-vigarhitaḥ ||98||
āyuḥ-kīrtir yaśo-dharma-dhair ya-dhvaṃsakarī tathā |
dhiṅ manmathaṃ durācāram āpadāṃ niya##||99||
deha-sthaṃ durdamaṃ śatru santuṣṭaṃ sadāvaśam |
itthaṃ vādini pracchanne vāsave padma-sadmani ||100||
ākhaṇḍalaṃ vinā bhīru deva-loko na śobhate |
tato devāḥ sa-gandharvā loka-pālāḥ sa-kinnarāḥ ||101||
śacyā saha samāgamya papracchus te bṛhaspatim |
bhagavan balabhid devaṃ naiva jānīmahe vayam ||102||
kva tiṣṭhati gataḥ kutra kutra vā mṛgayāmahe |
na nākaḥ śobhate tena vinā deva-gaṇaiḥ saha ||103||
suputreṇa vinā yadvat kulaṃ śrīmad-guṇānvitam |
upāyaś cintyatāṃ sadyaḥ svar-loke yena śobhate ||104||
sa-nāthaḥ suśriyā yukto na vilambo'tra yujyate |
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā gurur vacanam abravīt ||105||
jāne'haṃ svāparādhena lajjayā yatra tiṣṭhati |
rabhasā labdha-kāryasya bhuṅkte sa maghavā phalam ||106||
nṛṇāṃ nīti-parityāgād vipākāḥ syur bhayaṅkarāḥ |
aho rājya-madair  mattaḥ kṛtyākṛtyam acintayan ||107||
kṛtavān nindyamānaṃ hi dṛṣṭādṛṣṭa-kṣayaṅkaram |
kurvanti bāliśā yatra daivopahata-buddhayaḥ ||108||
aparādhād yathā janma syād ihāmutra-niṣphalam |
adhunā tatra gacchāmo yatra śakraḥ sa tiṣṭhati ||109||
ity uktvā nirgatāḥ sarve bṛhaspati-purogamāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā sarasi vistīrṇe svarṇa-paṅkaja-kānanam ||110||

tato guroḥ prabodhena nirgataḥ padma-kuḍmalāt ||111||
dīnā na no virūpas tu vrīḍā-kuṣcita-locanaḥ |

śṛṇu devendra vakṣye'ham upāyaṃ pāpa-nāśanam |
prayāga-snāna-mātreṇa tat-kṣaṇād eva pātakāt ||114||

sasnau sitāsite tīrthe sadyo mukto hy aghais tataḥ |

sahasram etad yonīnāṃ sahasraṃ syā##śāṃ tava |

tryahāt pāpa-kṣayo jātaḥ saptaviṃśatibhir dinaiḥ ||126||
śeṣair  me yad abhūt puṇyaṃ tena devatvam āgatā |

rākṣasa uvāca—
iṣṭaṃ dadāti gṛhṇāti guhyaṃ vadati pṛcchati ||131||
prītyā hi sajjano bhadre tac ca sarvaṃ tvayi sthitam |
tvayā sambhāvito nūnaṃ manye'haṃ vāma-locane ||132||

ato vakṣyāmi te bhadre duṣkṛtaṃ yat svayaṃ kṛtam ||133||
nivedya sajjane duḥkhaṃ tataḥ sarva-sukhī bhavet |

jātaḥ purā dvijaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kule mahati nirmale |

atra tri-yojanaṃ subhrūr nirjantu hi mayā kṛtam ||144||

tvad-darśana-sudhā-siktaṃ gataṃ śaityaṃ mano mama |

ataḥ sat-saṅgatiṃ subhrūḥ praśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sva-duḥkhaṃ hṛd-gataṃ mayā ||147||
viralaḥ sajjanaḥ subhrūḥ svātmā yasya na khidyate |
jānāsy atrocitaṃ tvaṃ hi kiṣcin no vacmy ataḥ param ||148||
asya duḥkhodadheḥ pāraṃ kathaṃ yāmīti cintayan |
sajjanānāṃ samābhūtiḥ sarveṣām upajīvanam ||149||
kṣīrārṇavaḥ payo datte’haṃ sāyanabakāya kim |
dattātreya uvāca—
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā dayārdrīkṛta-mānasā ||150||
dharma-dāne matiṃ kṛtā jagau kāṣcana-mālinī |
kariṣye niṣkṛtiṃ rakṣa idānīṃ khalu mā śucaḥ ||151||
pratijṣāṃ tu dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā yatiṣye tava muktaye |
bahavo hi kṛtā māghā varṣe varṣe yathā-vidhi ||152||
śraddhā-pūrvaṃ mayā bhadra brahma-kṣetre sitāsite |
tāṃ vadāmi tu saṃkhyātiṃ tasya dharmasya rākṣasa ||153||
gūḍho dharmo hi kartavya ity ūcur vibudhā janāḥ |
ārtedānaṃ praśaṃsanti munayo veda-vādinaḥ ||154||
sāgare varṣato bhadra kiṃ meghasya phalaṃ bhavet |
anubhūtaṃ mayā rakṣaḥ svayaṃ tat-puṇyajaṃ phalam ||155||
tat tu dāsyāmi te mitra sadyaḥ pāpa-vināśanam |
niṣpīḍyātha tato vastraṃ jalaṃ kṛtvā karāmbuje ||156||
dadau sā māghajaṃ puṇyaṃ tasmai vṛddhāya rakṣase |
śṛṇu rājan vicitraṃ hi prabhāvaṃ māgha-dharmajam ||157||
tadaivaṃ prāpya tat puṇyaṃ vimuktā rākṣasī-tanuḥ |
sambhūto devatākāras tejo-bhāskara-vigrahaḥ ||158||
deva-yānaṃ samārūḍhaḥ saharṣotphulla-locanaḥ |
dyotamānas tadā vyomni bhāsayan prabhayā diśaḥ ||159||
divya-rūpa-dharo reje dvitīyaiva bhāskaraḥ |
tato'bhinandayā māsa-satāṃ kāṣcana-mālinīm ||160||
bhadre vettīśvaro devaḥ karmaṇāṃ yaḥ phala-pradaḥ |
tat tvayopakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yatra me nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ ||161||
idānīm api kāruṇyāt prasīdānugrahaṃ kuru |
śikṣāṃ vidhehi me devi sarva-nīti-mayīṃ śubhām ||162||
sarva-dharma-karīṃ nūnaṃ na kurve pātakaṃ yathā |
tāṃ śrutvā tvad-anujṣātaḥ paścād yāmi surālayam ||163||
dattātreya uvāca—
etan niśamya tenoktaṃ priyaṃ dharma-mayaṃ vacaḥ |
atiprītyābravīd dharmaṃ rājan kāṣcana-mālinī ||164||
dharmaṃ bhajasva satataṃ tyaja bhūta-hiṃsāṃ 
sevasva sādhu-puruṣān jahi kāma-śatrum |
anyasya doṣa-guṇa-kīrtanam āśu hitvā
satyaṃ vadārcaya hariṃ vraja deva-lokam ||165||
dehe'sthi-māṃsa-rudhire sva-matiṃ tyaja tvaṃ 
jāyā-sutādiṣu sadā mamatāṃ vimuṣca |
paśyāniśaṃ jagad idaṃ kṣaṇa-bhaṅguraṃ hi
vair āgya-bhāva-rasiko bhava yoga-niṣṭhaḥ ||166||
prītyā mayā nigaditaṃ tava dharma-mārgaṃ 
citto nidhehi sakalaṃ bhava-śīla-yuktaḥ |
santyajya rākṣasa-tanuṃ dhṛta-deva-deho
jyotir-mayo vraja yathā-sukham āśu nākam ||167||
śrutvā dharmaṃ tato hṛṣṭaḥ santuṣṭo rākṣaso'bravīt |
bhava pramuditā nityaṃ sarvadā śivam astu te ||168||
ācandrārkaṃ ramasva tvaṃ kailāse śiva-sannidhau |
umayā'khaṇḍitaṃ prema tavāstu vara-varṇini ||169||
dharma-niṣṭhā tapo-niṣṭhā mātas tvaṃ bhava sarvadā |
māstu lobhaḥ śarīre te āpannārti sadā hara ||170||
ity uktvā tu praṇamyātha satāṃ kāṣcana-mālinīm |
jagāma rākṣasaḥ svargaṃ gandharvair  bahubhiḥ stutaḥ ||171||
deva-kanyās tadāgatya vavarṣuḥ puṣpa-vṛṣṭibhiḥ |
tasyāḥ kāṣcana-mālinyā mūrdhni harṣa-samākulāḥ ||172||
tām āliṅgya tataḥ procuḥ kanyakās tu priyaṃ vacaḥ |
kṛtaṃ bhadre tvayā citraṃ rākṣasasya vimokṣaṇam ||173||
duṣṭasyāsya bhayāt kaścid viśaty asmin na kānane |
adhunā nirbhayā hy atra vicarāmo yathā-sukham ||174||
śrutvā tad vacanaṃ rājaṃs tāsāṃ kāṣcana-mālinī |
hṛṣṭā te naiva dānena kṛta-kṛtyā tadā satī ||175||
taṃ rākṣasaṃ kāṣcana-mālinī varā
gandharva-kanyā parimocya satvaram |
krīḍanty amūbhiḥ prayayau harālayaṃ 
prītyā sa-pūrṇā ca paropakārayā ||176||
saṃvādam enaṃ vara-kanyakeritaṃ 
bhaktyā paraṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyāc ca mānavaḥ |
na bādhyate jātu sadā sa rākṣasair 
dharme matis tasya bhṛśaṃ hi jāyate ||177||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām
uttara-khaṇḍe māgha-māsa-māhātmye 
dilīpa-vasiṣṭha-saṃvāde rākṣasa-mokṣo nāma 
sapta-viṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
||127||

(128)
aṣṭāviṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

yoga-sāra-stotram

vasiṣṭha uvāca—
kathitaṃ māgha-māhātmyaṃ dattātreyeṇa bhāṣitam |
adhunā'haṃ pravakṣyāmi māgha-snānasya yat phalam ||1||
sarva-kratu-variṣṭhaṃ tu sarvadā na phala-pradam |
sarva-vrata-tapas tulyaṃ māgha-snānaṃ paraṃ tapa ||2||
snānena māghasya viśuddha-mānasā 
pitṝn divi sthāpya kula-dvayasya vai |
svargaṃ prayānti svayam ujjvalān anāvarair 
vimānai ruciraiś ca kāmagaiḥ ||3||
ye mānavāḥ pāpa-kṛto'pi sarvadā 
sadā durācāra-ratā vimārga-gāḥ |
snātvā hi māghe harim arcayanti 
ye muṣcanti te’pīha mahāgha-saṣcayam ||4||
satyena hīnāḥ pitṛ-mātṛ-duḥkha-
dāhyanāśramasthāḥ kula-dharma-varjitāḥ |
ye dāmbhikās te'pi narāḥ satāṃ gatiṃ 
snānaiḥ prayānty atra hi māgha-sambhavaiḥ ||5||
puṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu ca māgha-māse 
snānaṃ narāṇām atidurlabhaṃ bhuvi |
tasmād yato brahma-vidāṃ padaṃ naraiḥ 
samprāpyate nātra vicāraṇā mama ||6||
māghe tapo-dāna-japa-prasevanaṃ 
sthānaṃ hareḥ pūjanam akṣayaṃ nṛpa |
tasmād yathā-śakti naraiḥ prayatnataḥ
snātvā pradeyaṃ vasanān na kāṣcanam ||7||
māghe 'nna-dātā'mṛtapaḥ surālaye
hemnaś ca dātā balabhit-samīpagaḥ |
dīpāgni-vāsāṃsi dadan naraḥ sadā
sūryasya loke vasati prabhā-mayaḥ ||8||
yajṣaiḥ sudānaiḥ sutapobhir ujjvalaiḥ 
subrahmacaryārcana-yoga-sevayā |
śuddhā bhavantīha tathā na pāpinaḥ
snānair  yathā puṇya-bhavais tu māghajaiḥ ||9||
duḥkhaugha-santaptim asahya-yātanāṃ 
yāṃ yāṃ na te yānty api pāpa-kāriṇaḥ |
ye māgha-māse vara-tīrtha-majjanaṃ 
kurvanti cārdhodita-sūrya-maṇḍale ||10||
snātvā ca māghe harim arcayanti 
ye svarga-cyutā bhūpatayo bhavanti |
bhavyāḥ surūpāḥ subhagāḥ priyaṃ-vadā 
dharmānvitā bhūri-dhanāḥ śatāyuṣaḥ ||11||
dīptānalekāṣṭha ca yo yathā huto
bhasmāvaśeṣo bhavatīha tat-kṣaṇāt |
snāne na māghasya tathā vilīyate 
kṣudro'pi pāpaugha-mahāgha-saṣcayaḥ ||12||
kāyena vācā manasāpi pātakaṃ 
jṣātaṃ yad ajṣātam alaṃ kṛtaṃ naraiḥ | 
snānaṃ ca māghe vara-tīrtha-sambhavaṃ 
sarvaṃ dahad viṣṇur ivāśu hṛd-gataḥ ||13||
sambhujyamānāgha-phalaṃ hi pārthiva-
pramādato’pīha nṛṇāṃ kadācana |
snānaṃ hi māghasya yataḥ prasajyate
tadaiva tat saṅkṣayam eti niścitam ||14||
gandharvaṃ kanyāḥ pṛthivīśa-śāpajaṃ 
sambhujyamānāgha-phalaṃ duratyayam |
snānād vimuktāḥ khalu māgha-māsajād
vākyāt purā lomaśa-jātam adbhutam ||15||
sūta uvāca—
śrutvaitatpārthivaḥ prītyānatvātatpādapaṅkajam |
śraddhayāparayānamrastaṃ papracchapurodhasam ||16||
bhagavanbrūhikanyābhiḥ śāpohyabhigataḥkutaḥ |
kasyāpatyānitāstāsāṃ nāma kiṃ kīdṛśaṃ vayaḥ ||17||
kathaṃ lomaśavākyenavipākācchāpasambhavāt |
vimuktāḥkutratāḥ sasnurmāsaṃtāḥ katisaṃkhyayā ||18||
vasiṣṭha uvāca—
śrūyatāṃ rājaśārdūladharmagarbhāṃ kathāṃ parām |
yathā'raṇirvahnigarbhādharmasūrvahnisūriva ||19||
gandharvaḥ sukhasaṃgītistasyakanyāpramodinī |
suśīlasyasuśīlācasusvarāsvaravedinaḥ ||20||
sutārācandrakāṃ tasyacandrikāsuprabhasyaca | 
imānivaranāmāni tāsāmapsarasāṃ nṛpa ||21||
kumāryaḥ paṣcasarvāstāvayasāsusamāḥpunaḥ |
candrādivaviniṣkrāṃ tāścandrikevasamujjvalāḥ ||22||
candrānanāḥ sukeśinyaścandrāmṛtarasādharāḥ | 
netreṣv ānandakāriṇyaḥ kaumudīkumudeṣviva ||23||
lāvaṇyapiṇḍasambhūtāścārurūpāmanoharāḥ |
udbhinnakucakuṃ bhinyaḥpadminyaivamādhave ||24||
unmīlyayauvanaṃ kāṃ taṃ vallīvanavapallavaiḥ | 
hemagaurāścahemābhāhemālaṃ kārabhūṣitāḥ ||25||
hemacaṃ pakamālinyohemacchavisuvāsasaḥ |
svaragrāmāvalīhāsuvividhāmūrcchanāsuca ||26||
tāladāna vinodeṣuveṇuvīṇāpravādane |
mṛdaṃ ganādasambhinnaṃ lāsyamārgalaveṣuca ||27||
citrādiṣuvinodeṣukalāsucaviśāradāḥ | 
evaṃ bhūtāstutāḥkanyāmumuhuḥkrīḍanevane ||28||
pitṛbhirlālitāḥ satyaśceruścadhanadālaye |
kautukādekadāpaṣcamilitvāmāsimādhave |
kanyāmandārapuṣpāṇivicinvaṃ tyovanādvanam ||29||
gaurīṃ samārādhayituṃ varāṃ ganāḥkadācidacchodasarovaraṃ yayuḥ |
hemāmbujānipravarāṇitāḥpunastasmādupādāyavarotpalaiḥ saha ||30||
vaiḍūryaśuddhasphaṭikācchavidrumesnātvātaḍāgeparidhāyacāṃ baram |
maunenacasthaṇḍilapiṇḍikāmayīsvarṇasyasiktābhirumāṃ vinirmamuḥ ||31||
samarcitāṃ candanacandrakuṅkumair abhyarcyagaurīṃ varapaṅkajādibhiḥ |
nānopacāraiś ca subhaktibhāvitāstālaprayogair  nanṛtuḥkumārikāḥ ||32||
gāndhāramāśrityavaraṃ svaraṃ tatogeyaṃ sutāradhvanibhiḥ sumūrcchitam |
eṇīdṛśastāḥ prajaguḥkalākṣaraṃ cāruprabandhaṃ gatibhistususvaram ||33||
tasminsunāderasavarṣaharṣadekanyāsvalaṃ nirbharanṛtyavṛttiṣu |
acchodatīrthapravaretadāgataḥ snātuṃ munervedanidheḥ sutāgnipaḥ ||34||
rūpeṇaniḥ sīmatarovarānanaḥ sarojapatrāyatalocanoyuvā |
viśālavakṣāḥ subhujo'tisundaraḥ śyāmacchaviḥkāmaivāparohisaḥ ||35||
sabrahmacārīsaśikhovirājatedaṇḍenayuktodhanuṣaivamanmathaḥ |
eṇājinaprāvaraṇaḥ susūtradhṛgghemābhamauṃ jīkaṭisūtramekhalaḥ ||36||
taṃ dṛṣṭvābrāhmaṇaṃ bālāstās tatra sarasastaṭe |
jaharṣuḥkautukāviṣṭāḥko'yaṃ nonayanātithiḥ ||37||
saṃtyaktanṛtyagītāstāstasyālokanatatparāḥ |
hariṇyolubdhakenevaviddhāḥkāmenasāyakaiḥ ||38||
paśyapaśyetijalpaṃ tyomugdhāḥpaṣcasusambhramam |
tasminvipravareyūnikāmadevabhramaṃ yayuḥ ||39||
punaḥpunastamabhyarcyanayanaiḥ paṅkajair iva |
paścādvicāramāyāsustāścakanyāḥparasparam ||40||
yadyayaṃ kāmadevohiratihīnaḥkathaṃ vrajet |
athāyamaśvinaudevautaunūnaṃ yugmacāriṇau ||41||
gandharvaḥkinnarovāthasiddhovākāmarūpadhṛk |
ṛṣipu'trothavākaścitkaścidvāmānuṣottamaḥ ||42||
astuvākaścidevāyaṃ dhātrāsṛṣṭohinaḥkṛte |
yathābhāgyavatāmarthenidhānaṃ pūrvakarmabhiḥ ||43||
tathāsmākaṃ kumārīṇāṃ gauryā nīto varottamaḥ |
karuṇā-jala-kallola-plavārdrīkṛta-cittayā ||44||
mayāvṛtastvayā cāyaṃ tvayā vṛtas tathāmayā |
evaṃ paṣcasukanyāsuvadaṃ tīṣunṛpottama ||45||
śrutvātadvacanan tatra kṛtvāmādhyāhnikīḥkriyāḥ |
ālocyahṛdayeso'pivighnametadupasthitam ||46||
brahmaviṣṇugiriśādayaḥ surāyecasiddhamunayaḥpurātanāḥ |
te'piyogabalinovimohitālīlayātadabalābhiradbhutam ||47||
yoṣitāṃ nayanatīkṣṇasāyakair bhrūlatāsudṛḍhacāpanirgataiḥ |
dhanvināma karaketunāhataḥkasyanopatatihāmanomṛgaḥ ||48||
tāvadevanayadhīrvirājatetāvadevajanatābhayaṃ bhajet |
tāvadevadṛḍhacittatābhṛśaṃ tāvadevagaṇanākulasyaca ||49||
tāvadebavatapasaḥ pragalbhatātāvadevayamadhāraṇaṃ nṛṇām |
yāvadevavanitekṣaṇabāṇair mohayanty urumadair  namānuṣāḥ ||50||
mohayaṃ tumadayaṃ turāgiṇāṃ yoṣitaḥ sulalitair manoharaiḥ |
mohayanti madayanti māmimaṃ dharmarakṣaṇaparaṃ hikair guṇaiḥ ||51||
māṃ saśukramalamūtranirmiteyoṣitāṃ vapuṣinirghṛṇe'śucau |
kāminaścaparikalpyacārutāṃ māramaṃ tusuvimūḍhacetasaḥ ||52||
dāruṇohiparikīrtitoṃ ganāsannidhirvimalabuddhibhirbudhaiḥ |
yāvadatranasamīpagāimāstāvadevahigṛhaṃ vrajāmy aham ||53||
samīpaṃ tasyayāvaddhināgacchanti varāṃ ganāḥ |
vaiṣṇavenaprabhāveṇatāvadaṃ tardadhedvijaḥ ||54||
tasyayogabalādbhūpagatasyādarśanantadā |
dṛṣṭvātadadbhutaṃ karmaṛṣiputrasyadhīmataḥ ||55||
vitrastanayanābālāḥkuraṃ gyaivakātarāḥ |
sambhrāṃ tanayanāḥ śūnyādadṛśustādiśodaśa ||56||
iṃ drajālaṃ sphuṭaṃ vettimāyāṃ jānātivāpunaḥ |
dṛṣṭo'pyadṛṣṭarūpo'bhūdityūcuścaparasparam ||57||
vyāptaṃ tuhṛdayaṃ tāsāṃ sadaivavirahāgninā |
jvaladdāvānalenevasusnigdhaṃ sāṃ drakānanam ||58||
tyaktvaiṃ drajālikīṃ vidyāṃ kāṃ tadarśayasatvaram |
svātmānaṃ no manoyuktaṃ prāgagrāsemakṣikopamam ||59||
hākaṣṭaṃ darśitaḥkasmāddhātrātvaṃ ghaṭitaḥpunaḥ |
jṣātaṃ mahānusaṃtāpahetornas tvaṃ vinirmitaḥ ||60||
kaccit te nirdayaṃ cetaḥ kaccid asmāsu no manaḥ |
kaccid dhūrto'si he kānta kaccin muṣṇāsi no manaḥ ||61||
kaccin na pratyayo’smāsu kaccid asmān parīkṣase |
kaccin narma-kalā-śīlaḥ kaccin māyā-viśāradaḥ ||62||
kaccic citte praveṣṭuṃ ca vetsi vijñāna-lāghavam |
kaccin niṣkramaṇopāyaṃ na jānāsi kutaḥ punaḥ ||63||
kaccid vināparādhaṃ tu tvam asmāsu prakupyase |
kaccid duḥkhaṃ vijānāsi pareṣāṃ vipralambhajam ||64||
tvad-darśanaṃ vinānūnaṃ hṛdayeśvara-sāmpratam |
na jīvāmo'tha jīvāmaḥ punas tvad-darśanāśayā ||65||
asmāṃś canīyatāṃ tatra yatra śīghraṃ gato bhavān |
tvad-darśana-haro dhātā vyadadhād aṅkura-cchidam ||66||
sarvathā darśanaṃ dehi kāruṇyaṃ bhaja sarvathā |
paryantaṃ na prapaśyanti sarvathā sajjanā janāḥ ||67||
itthaṃ vilapyatāḥ kanyāḥ pratīkṣya ca bahukṣaṇam |
pitṛrbhiyāgṛhaṃ gantuṃ śīghram ārebhire gatim ||68||
tat-prema-nigaḍair  baddhā bhṛśaṃ viraha-viklavāḥ |
kathaṣcid dhair yam ālambya tāḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛham āgatāḥ ||69||
āgatya patitāḥ sarvājala-yantra-samīpataḥ |
kim etan-mātṛbhiḥ pṛṣṭāḥ kutaḥ kālātyayo'bhavat ||70||
kanyā ūcuḥ --
krīḍaṃ tyaḥkinnarībhistusārdhaṃ saṃgītakaṃ mudā |
saṃsthitāstenanajṣātaṃ divasādisarovare ||71||
pathiśrāṃ tāvayaṃ mātaḥ saṃtāpastenanastanau |
mohenamahatāvaktuṃ nakenāpyutsahāmahe ||72||
ity uktvā luluṭhus tatra maṇibhūmaukumārikāḥ |
ākāraṃ gopayanty astāmugdhā jalpanti mātṛbhiḥ ||73||
kācin nartayati krīḍā-mayūraṃ na mudā tadā |
na pāṭhayati taṃ kīraṃ paṣjare'nyā kutūhalāt ||74||
lālayen nakulaṃ nānyānollāsayati sārikām |
aparātīvasaṃmugdhā naiva krīḍati sārasaiḥ ||75||
bhejire na vinodāṃs tā remire naiva mandire |
ūcire bāndhavair  nālaṃ vīṇā-vādyaṃ na cakrire ||76||
kalpa-druma-prasūtaṃ yad rasavat tu sudhopamam |
mandāra-kusumāmodi na papur madhuraṃ madhu ||77||
yoginyaiva tāḥ kanyā nāsāgra-nyasta-locanāḥ |
alakṣya dhyāna-saṃtānāḥ puruṣottama-mānasāḥ ||78||
candrakāṃ tamaṇicchannesravadvārikaṇadrave |
kṣaṇaṃ vātāyanesthitvājalayaṃ trekṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇāt ||79||
racayanti kṣaṇaṃ śayyāṃ dīrghikāmbhojinīdalaiḥ |
vījyamānāsakhībhistāḥ śītalaiḥ kadalīdalaiḥ ||80||
itthaṃ yugasamāṃ rātriṃ manvānāstāvarastriyaḥ |
kathaṃcid dhīratāṃ kṛtvā vihvalāḥ sa-jvarā iva ||81||

dayādharmaparonityaṃ viṣṇudharmeṣutatparaḥ ||3||
phalamūlajalāhārīśaṅkha-cakra-pradhārakaḥ |
tri-kālaṃ pūjayed viṣṇuṃ sā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī matā ||4||
uttamā sāttvikī proktā rājasī caiva madhyamā |
kaniṣṭhā tāmasī caiva trividhā bhaktir ucyate ||5||
śrīdhare tu prakartavyā mukti-kāma-phalepsubhiḥ |
ahaṃkāreṇa rūpeṇa dambha-mātsarya-māyayā ||6||
ye kurvanti janābhaktiṃ tāmasīsāudāhṛtā |
parasyotsādanārthaṃ vādambhamuddiśyavā'thavā ||7||
yābhaktiḥkriyatedevetāmasīsāprakīrtitā |
viṣayānpratisaṃdhāyayaśa##śvaryamevavā ||8||
arcādāvarcayedyomāṃ pṛthagbhāvaḥ sarājasaḥ |
karmakṣayārthekarttavyābrāhmaṇair jñānatatparaiḥ ||9||
viṣṇau hy ātmārpaṇīṃ buddhiṃ sā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī matā |
atovaisarvathādevisaṃsevyaḥ sarvadāhariḥ ||10||
tāmasenatubhāvenatāmasatvaṃ hilabhyate |
rājasorājasenaiva sātvikenatusātvikaḥ ||11||
vedādhyāyarataḥ śrīmānrāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ |
śaṅkha-cakra-dharovipraḥ sarvadāśucirucyate ||12||
karmakāṇḍepravṛttoyaḥ sarvadāviṣṇuniṃ dakaḥ |
niṃ dakastajjanā##camahācaṇḍālaucyate ||13||
vedādhyāyaratānityaṃ nityaṃ vaiyajṣayājakāḥ |
agnihotraratānityaṃ viṣṇudharmaparāṅmukhāḥ |
niṃ daṃ tiviṣṇudharmāṃś cavedabāhyāḥ sureśvari ||14||
kurvanti śāṃ tiṃ vibudhāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥkṣemaṃ prakurvanti pitāmahādyāḥ |
svastiprayacchanti munīṃ dramukhyāgovindabhaktiṃ vahatāṃ narāṇām ||15||
śubhāgrahābhūtapiśācayuktābrahmādayodevagaṇāḥ prasannāḥ |
lakṣmīsthirātiṣṭhatimandirecagovindabhaktiṃ vahatāṃ narāṇām ||16||
gaṅgāgayānaimiṣapuṣkarāṇikāśīprayāgaṃ kurujāṃ galāni |
tiṣṭhanti dehekṛtabhaktipūrvaṃ govindabhaktiṃ vahatāṃ narāṇām ||17||
evamārādhayedvidvānbhagavaṃ taṃ śriyāsaha |
kṛtakṛtyobhavennityaṃ savipronātra saṃśayaḥ ||18||
kṣatriyovāthavaiśyovāśūdrovāsurasattame |
bhaktiṃ kurvanviśeṣeṇamuktiṃ yātisavainaraḥ ||19||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe viṣṇu-bhakti-mahimā-varṇanaṃ nāma

(131)
ekatriṃśādhika-śatamo'dhyāyaḥ

pārvaty uvāca—
śālagrāma-śilā śuddhā mūrtayaḥ santi bhūtale |
tāsāṃ caiva tu mūrtīnāṃ pūjanaṃ katidhā smṛtam ||1||
brāhmaṇaiḥ katipūjyāstāḥkṣatriyair vāsureśvara |
vaiśyair vāpikathaṃ śūdraiḥ strībhirvāpisamādiśa ||2||
mahādeva uvāca—
śālagrāma-śilā puṇyā pavitrā dharma-kāriṇī |
yasyā darśana-mātreṇa brahmahā śudhyate naraḥ ||3||
tad-gṛhaṃ sarva-tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ śrutinoditam |
yatreyaṃ sarvadā mūrtiḥ śālagrāma-śilā śubhā ||4||
brāhmaṇaiḥ paṣca-pūjyā syuś catasraḥ kṣatriyais tathā |
vaiśyais tisras tathā pūjyā ekā pūjyā prayatnataḥ ||5||
tasyā darśana-mātreṇa śūdro muktim avāpnuyāt |
anena vidhinā devi ye narāḥ pūjayanti vai ||6||
bhogān sarvāṃs tatra bhuktvā yānti viṣṇoḥ sanātanam |
iyaṃ sā mahatī mūrtiḥ sarvadā pāpa-hāriṇī ||7||
kailāsādyaṃ phalaṃ devi jāyate pūjanād yataḥ |
 tatra gaṅgā ca yamunā godāvarī sarasvatī ||8||
tiṣṭhate ca śilā yatra sarvaṃ tatra na saṃśayaḥ |
kim atra bahunoktena bhūyo bhūyo varānane ||9||
pūjanaṃ manujaiḥ samyak kartavyaṃ muktim icchubhiḥ |
bhakti-bhāvena deveśi ye'rcayanti janārdanam ||10||
teṣāṃ darśana-mātreṇa brahmahā śudhyate janaḥ |
dāsa-bhāvena ye śūdrāḥ svarcanaṃ kurvate sadā ||11||
teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ na jānanti brahmādyāś ca sureśvari |
bhakti-bhāvena ye viprā harim abhyarcayanti vai ||12||
ekaviṃśati-kulaṃ tais tu tāritaṃ teṣu janmasu |
śaṅkha-cakrāṅkito yas tu vipraḥ pūjanam ācaret ||13||
pūjitaṃ tu jagat sarvaṃ tena viṣṇu-prapūjanāt |
pitaraḥ saṃvadanty asmat-kule jātāś ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ||14||
tat kulaṃ tāritaṃ tais tu yāvad-ābhūta-samplavam |
te tu cāsmān samuddhṛtya nayante viṣṇu-mandiram ||15||
sa eva divaso dhanyo dhanyā mātā'tha bāndhavāḥ |
pitā tasya ca vai dhanyo dhanyā vai suhṛdas tathā ||16||
sarve dhanyatamā jṣeyā viṣṇu-bhakti-parāyaṇāḥ |
teṣāṃ darśana-mātreṇa mahā-pāpāt pramucyate ||17||
upapātakāni sarvāṇi mahānti pātakāni ca |
tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśanāt ||18||
pāvakā iva dīpyante ye narā vaiṣṇavā bhuvi |
vimuktāḥ sarva-pāpebhyo meghebhya iva candramāḥ ||19||
ārdraṃ śuṣkaṃ laghu sthūlaṃ vāṅ-manaḥ-karmabhiḥ kṛtam |
tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāti vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśanāt ||20||
hiṃsādikaṃ ca yat pāpaṃ jṣānājñānaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat |
tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāti darśanād vaiṣṇavasya ca ||21||
niḥpāpās tridivaṃ yānti pāpiṣṭhā yānti śuddhitām |
darśanād eva sādhūnāṃ satyaṃ tubhyaṃ mayoditam ||22||
saṃsāra-kardamālepa-prakṣālana-viśāradaḥ |
pāvanaḥ pāvanānāṃ ca viṣṇu-bhakto na saṃśayaḥ ||23||
pratyahaṃ viṣṇu-bhaktā ye smaranti madhusūdanam |
te tu viṣṇumayā jṣeyā viṣṇus tatra na saṃśayaḥ ||24||
nava-nīla-ghana-śyāmaṃ nalināyata-locanam |
śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-padma-dharaṃ pītāmbarāvṛtam ||25||
kaustubhena virājantaṃ vana-mālā-dharaṃ harim |
ullasat-kuṇḍala-jyotiḥ-kapola-vadana-śriyā ||26||
virājitaṃ kirīṭena valayāṅgada-nūpuraiḥ |
prasanna-vadanāmbhojaṃ catur-bāhuṃ śriyānvitam ||27||
evaṃ dhyāyanti ye viprā viṣṇuṃ caiva tu pārvati |
te viprā viṣṇu-rūpāś ca vaiṣṇavās te na saṃśayaḥ ||28||
teṣāṃ darśana-mātreṇa bhaktyā vā bhojanena vā |
pūjanena ca deveśi vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate dhruvam ||29||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe 
śālagrāma-śilā-pūjana-māhātmyaṃ nāma
ekatriṃśādhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
