sātvikīviṣṇusambhūtirbrahmāvair ājasaḥ smṛtaḥ |
śivastutāmasaḥproktaebhiḥ sarvaṃ pravartitam ||80||
ekābrāhmīsthitirlokekarmabījānusārataḥ |
tayā saṃharate viṣṇuḥ sarva-lokānuśeṣataḥ ||81||
tiṣṭhaty asau tadā tatra bhagavān viṣṇur avyayaḥ |
evaṃ sarva-gato viṣṇur ādi-madhyānta eva ca ||82||
avidyayā na jānanti lokā vai karma-niścitāḥ |
varṇocitānikarmāṇiyaḥkāleṣuprakārayet ||83||
yatkarmaviṣṇudaivatyaṃ nahigarbhasyakāraṇam |
vedāṃ taśāstremunibhiḥ sarva daivavicāryate ||84||
brahmajñānamidaṃ dehetadahaṃ parikīrttaye |
śubhāśubhasyakāryaṃ cakāraṇaṃ manaevahi ||85||
manasāśudhyatesarvaṃ tadābrahmasanātanam |
manaevasadābandhurmanaevasadāripuḥ ||86||
manasātāritāḥkecinmanasāyātitāścake |
madhyesarvaparityāgaḥbāhyekarmatathācaran ||87||
evamevakṛtaṃ karmakurvannapinalipyate |
padmapatraṃ yathānīraleśair apinalipyate ||88||
agniragnauyathākṣiptobhaktyācakiṃ prayojanam |
yadābhaktirasojṣātonamuktīrocatetadā ||89||
yogair aṣṭavidhair viṣṇurnaprāpyaścehajanmani |
bhaktyā vā prāpyate viṣṇuḥ sarvadā sulabho bhavet ||90||
vedāṃ taiḥ prāpyate jñānaṃ jṣānena jṣeyam eva ca |
tat tu jṣeyaṃ yadā prāptaṃ tadā śūnyam idaṃ jagat ||91||
balena prāpyate viṣṇur yogair  aṣṭa-vidhaiś ca kim |
sarveṣām eva bhāvānāmbhāva-śuddhiḥ praśasyate ||92||
āliṅgyateyathākāṃ tāyathābhāvas tathāphalam |
upānadyuktapādohivetticarmamayīṃ mahīm ||93||
buddhir yathāvidhā yasya tadvat sa manyate jagat |
dugdhena sikto nimbo'pi kaṭu-bhāvaṃ na tu tyajet ||94||
prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni upadeśo nirarthakaḥ |
chittvā vai sahakāraṃ ca phalaṃ patraṃ kathaṃ labhet ||95||
indriyāṇāṃ sukhārthenavṛthājanmakathaṃ nayet |
sthālyāṃ vaiḍūryamayyāṃ hipacyatecauṣadhaṃ yathā ||96||
dahyatecāgadastadvadvṛthājanmakathaṃ bhavet |
nidhānaṃ cagṛhekṣiptvāśubhaḥ sevāṃ kathaṃ caret ||97||
tyaktvāvaikuṇṭhanāthaṃ tamanyamārgekathaṃ ramet |
bhaktihīnaiś ca turve daiḥ paṭhitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||98||
śvāpacobhaktiyuktastutridaśair apipūjyate |
svakarekaṃ kaṇaṃ baddhādarpaṇaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||99||
brahmarudrādibhirdevair dattaiśvaryāścasevakāḥ |
arpitaṃ naiva gṛhṇaṃ tiprabhoścaivatu kiṣcana ||100||
akiṃ canāyabhaktāyadātuṃ nālaṃ gatovaram |
niḥ śarīrasyakṛṣṇasya tatra dhyānaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ||101||
sākāraṃ bahavodṛṣṭvāgatābhaktyācatatpadam |
pūjābhaktiḥkathaṃ śūnyesākārekathyatebudhaiḥ ||102||
śūnyamārgekathaṃ yātiādhāreṇavinānaraḥ |
sākāroyaḥ svayaṃ svāmīnirākāraḥ savaiprabhuḥ ||103||
sākārohisukhenaiva nirākāronadṛśyate |
sevārasaścasākārenirākāreṇavair asaḥ ||104||
sākāreṇanirākārojṣāyatesvayamevahi |
harismṛtiprasādenaromāṃ citatanuryadā ||105||
nayan ānandasalilaṃ muktirdāsībhavettadā |
bālyecayatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkathaṃ navinaśyati ||106||
pūjādānavrataistīrthair japahomaistvadarpitaiḥ |
nijadharmaṃ parityajyatapoghoraṃ kathaṃ caret ||107||
svadharmenidhanaṃ śreyaḥparamadharmobhayāvahaḥ |
vidhiṃ saṃtyajyaśāstrīyaṃ tapoghoraṃ kathaṃ caret ||108||
āśrameṇavināmūḍhonaiva siddhimavāpnuyāt |
brahmaṇānirmitāvarṇāḥ svesvedharmeniyojitāḥ ||109||
svadharmeṇāgataṃ dravyaṃ śukladravyaṃ taducyate |
śukladravyeṇayaddānaṃ dīyateśraddhayānvitam ||110||
svalpenāpimahatpuṇyaṃ tasyasaṃkhyānavidyate |
nīcasaṃgenayaddravyamānītaṃ gṛhakarmasu ||111||
tenadravyeṇayaddānaṃ kṛtaṃ vaimanujādibhiḥ |
tat phalaṃ nabhavettevainaiva tat phalabhāginaḥ ||112||
yādṛśaṃ kurutekarmaindriyāṇāṃ sukhecchayā |
tādṛśīṃ yonimāpnotimūḍhohijñānadurbalaḥ ||113||
ihayatkurutekarmatatparatropabhujyate |
puṇyamācarataḥpuṃsoyadiduḥkhaṃ prajāyate ||114||
tadātāponakarttavyastatkarmapūrvadehajam |
pāpamācarataḥpuṃsojāyateduḥkham eva ca ||115||
nakarttavyas tadāharṣaḥ sukhe tatra sureśvari |
rajjubaddhāścapaśavaḥ prabhuṇāsvecchayāyathā ||116||
nīyaṃ tekarmabandhenamanujā apibhūtale |
śākhāmṛgovanacaronṛtyatecagṛhegṛhe ||117||
evaṃ cakarmaṇājīvānīyaṃ tesarvayoniṣu |
krīḍatākaṃ dukoyadvatpreryateprabhuṇecchayā ||118||
karmaṇāvātathājaṃ turnīyatesukhaduḥkhayoḥ |
prāṇīsvakarmabhirbaddhonaśaktobandhanigrahe ||119||
devovaikarmabhirbaddhāṛṣayaścatathāpare |
kailāserudradehasthābhujaṃ gāviṣabhojinaḥ ||120||
asamarthāḥ sudhābhoktuṃ karmayonirbalīyasī |
nīrogadehadātāyobudhaiḥ sūryohikathyate ||121||
tadrathesārathiḥpaṃ guḥkarmayonirbalīyasī |
iṃ dradyumnohirājarṣigarjatvaṃ karmaṇāgataḥ ||122||
samarthasvāminātasminkarmayonirvṛthākṛtā |
rudrabrahmādayodevāmānavāścāsurāścaye ||123||
tesarvekarmabaddhāścavicaranti mahītale |
karmādhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ viṣṇunānirmitaṃ purā ||124||
tatkarmakeśavādhīnaṃ rāmanāmnāvinaśyati |
sarvatrāpisthitaṃ toyaṃ muktidaṃ tusitāsite ||125||
evamācaratāṃ karmamuktidaṃ keśavārcanam |
indriyāṇāṃ sukhārthāyayaḥkarmamanasācaret ||126||
ahaṃ kṛtenamanyetakevalaṃ dehamevahi |
manasāsaṃsmaranjaṃ tuḥprāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||127||
sapūrvakarmabhoktācaagrekarmanavarddhate |
praśaṃsanti grahānkecitkecitpretapiśācakān ||128||
keciddevānpraśaṃsanti hyoṣadhīḥkecidūcire |
kecinmantraṃ casiddhiṃ cakecidvuddhiparākramam ||129||
udyamaṃ sāhasaṃdhair yaṃ kecinnītiṃ balaṃ tathā |
ahaṃ karmapraśaṃ sābhiḥ sarvekāmānuvartinaḥ ||130||
itimeniścitābuddhiḥkathyatepūrvasūribhiḥ |
yadāpuṇyamayojaṃ tuḥpāpaṃ kiṃ cinnaḥvidyate ||131||
jñānaṃ hidvividhaṃ caivatadāpuṇyaṃ subhaṃ vet |
pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ samaṃ yasya tadā karmasu vidyate ||132||
samaṃ yogaṃ yadādvaṃ dvaṃ tad ānandapadaṃ vrajet |
bāhyesarvaparityāgīmanasāsaṃspṛhībhavet ||133||
tadvṛthācaritaṃ tasyatenatatpāpabhoginaḥ |
bāhyekarotikarmāṇimanasāniḥ spṛhobhavet ||134||
tyāgo'saumadhyamojṣeyonatupūrṇaphalaṃ labhet |
bāhyamadhyeparityajyabuddhyāśūnyāvalaṃ banam ||135||
tyāgaḥ sauttamojṣeyoyogināma pidurllabhaḥ |
krodhātsarvaṃ tyajaṃ tyekekecidvādaprabhāvataḥ ||136||
kaṣṭātsarvaṃ tyajaṃ tyeketyāgāḥ sarvenumadhyamāḥ |
subuddhyāśraddhayāyuktonakrodhādivaśaṃ gataḥ ||137||
karmaṇāṃ hyavalipto'pisugatiṃ yātimānavaḥ |
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehedhīmatāṃ yogināma pi ||138||
yogādrbhaṣṭastujāyetakulevaidvijapūrvake |
svalpenaiva tukālenapūrṇaṃ yogaṃ caviṃ dati ||139||
cid ānandapadaṃ gacchedyogabhaktiprasādataḥ |
paṃ kenaiva yathāpaṅka-ṃ rudhiraṃ rudhireṇavai ||140||
hiṃ sayākarmaṇākarmakathaṃ kṣālayituṃ kṣamaḥ |
hiṃsākarmamayoyajṣaḥkathaṃ karmakṣayekṣamaḥ ||141||
svargakāmakṛtāyajṣāsvargetecālpasaukhyadāḥ |
anityānitusaukhyānibhavanti cabahūnyapi ||142||
nityaṃ saukhyaṃ nateṣvastivinābhaktyāhareḥ kvacit |
sārvabhaumasukhaṃ rājyaṃ svargecāpitathāsukham ||143||
anyatiṃ kacinnavāṣchāmigarbhavāsādvibhemyaham |
grāvāvaibhidyatelohair māṇikyaṃ naiva bhidyate ||144||
nānākāmamayībuddhyāviṣṇu-bhaktirnabhidyate |
bakojalacarānbhuṅkte maṇḍūkādīṃś ca varjayet ||145||
tathāyamaḥ sarvahaṃ tāvarjayetkṛṣṇasevakān |
yorakṣatisahartācasavaipālakaucyate ||146||
aparādhaśatair yuktaṃ svaṃ sthāneyatravāsitā |
yathākṛtāparādhasyakṛṣṇastasyakṛpākaraḥ ||147||
phalaṃ calabhatevādyarakṣakaḥkiṃ karoticet |
evamātmācadehesminparavaśyakṛpākaraḥ ||148||
prāptonapāraḥ śanakair mallair yuktānavāpitā |
vyādhasyamuktidātācakubjakātāritāsvayam ||149||
brahmādyair durlabhaḥ svapnesulabhogopamandire |
gopocchiṣṭaṃ yadābhuktaṃ tadātetāritāḥ svayam ||150||
yogibhir gīyate nityaṃ paramātmā janārdanaḥ |
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ śrīmān dṛṣṭvā tair  devi vismaye ||151||
etatsmaraṇakaṃ divyaṃ yepaṭhaṃ tidinedine |
sarva-pāpavinirmuktāyānti viṣṇoḥ sanātanam ||152||
anayābhāvabuddhyācapaṭhanaṃ viṣṇusannidhau |
ihalokesukhaṃ bhuktvāparaṃ padamavāpnuyāt ||153||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe viṣṇu-smaraṇaṃ nāma 
dvātriṃśādhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||132||

(133)
trayastriṃśādhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

pārvaty uvāca—
dvīpe'sminyānitīrthānitānimevadasuvrata |
dvīpānāṃ dvīparājo'yaṃ sarvadābhuvinirmitaḥ |
saṃkhyayātvaṃ vadasvāminkṛpāṃ kṛtvāmamopari ||1||
mahādeva uvāca—
sarvagaḥ sarva-bhūteṣudraṣṭavyaḥ sarvatobhuvi |
saptalokeṣuyatkiṃ ciddṛśyatesacarācaram ||2||
tatvaṃ tenavinādevinadṛṣṭaṃ naśrutaṃ mayā |
atoviṣṇurmahādevaḥkeśavaḥkleśanāśanaḥ |
tīrtharūpeṇavartetadvīpehyasminsureśvari ||3||
tānitīrthānivakṣyāmisāṃ prataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
prathamaṃ puṣkaraṃ kṣetraṃ tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ śubham |
vārāṇasīdvitīyaṃ tukṣetraṃ muktipradāyakam ||4||
tṛtīyaṃ naimiṣaṃ kṣetramṛṣīṇāṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam |
prayāgaṃ vaicaturthaṃ tutīrthānāmuttamaṃ smṛtam ||5||
kārmukaṃ paṣcamaṃ proktaṃ utpannaṃ gandhamādane |
ekādaśaṃ kānyakubjaṃ yatratiṣṭhativāmanaḥ ||6||
saptamaṃ viśvakāyaṃ tuavareparvateśubhe |
aṣṭamaṃ gautamākhyaṃ camaṃ darenirmitaṃ purā ||7||
madotkaṭaṃ tunavamaṃ daśamaṃ rathacaitrakam |
ekādaśaṃ kānyakubjaṃ yatratiṣṭhativāmanaḥ ||8||
dvādaśaṃ malayaṃ caivakubjāmrakamataḥparam |
viśveśvaraṃ girikarṇaṃ kedāraṃ gatidāyakam ||9||
bāhyaṃ himavataḥpṛṣṭhegokarṇegopakaṃ tathā |
sthāneśvaraṃ himādraucabilvakebilvapatrikam ||10||
śrīśailemādhavaṃ tīrthaṃ bhadraṃ bhadreśvaretathā |
vārāhevijayaṃ proktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vaiṣṇavegirau ||11||
raudraṃ turudrakoṭetupaitryaṃ kāliṃ jaregirau |
kaṃ pilekāpilaṃ tīrthaṃ mukuṭekarkoṭakaṃ tathā ||12||
śālagrāmodbhavaṃ tīrthaṃ gallikāyāṃ sureśvari |
narmadāyāṃ śivākhyaṃ tumāyāyāṃ viśvarūpakam ||13||
utpalākṣaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ jātaṃ vair aivategirau |
gaṅgāyāṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ caviṣṇupādodbhavaṃ tathā ||14||
vipāśāyāṃ vipāpācapāṭalepuṇḍravarddhanam |
nārāyaṇaṃ supārśvetutrikūṭeviṣṇu-mandiram ||15||
vipulevipulaṃ nāma kalyāṇaṃ malayācale |
kauravaṃ koṭitīrthe casugandhaṃ gandhamādane ||16||
kubjāmraketrisaṃdhyaṃ tugaṅgāṃ dvāreharipriyam |
śailaṃ viṃ dhyapradeśetubadaryāṃ sārasvataṃ smṛtam ||17||
kāliṃ dyāṃ kālarūpaṣcasahyevaisāyakaṃ smṛtam |
cāṃ draṃ candrapradeśeturamaṇaṃ tīrthanāyakam ||18||
yamunāyāṃ mṛgākhyaṃ tu karavīre kurūdbhavam |
vināyakeparvatevaiumākhyaṃ tīrtham eva ca ||19||
ārogyaṃ bhāskaredeśemahākālemaheśvaram |
tīrthaṃ abhayadaṃ nāmāmṛtākhyaṃ viṃ dhyakaṃ dhare ||20||
maṇḍapeviśvarūpaṣcasvāhākhyaṃ īśvarepure |
vaigaleyaṃ pracaṇḍāyāṃ cāṇḍikaṃ marakaṇṭake ||21||
someśvaraṃ tathātīrthe prabhāsepuṣkaraṃ tathā |
devamātraṃ sarasvatyāṃ pārāvatataṭesthitam ||22||
mahālayaṃ mahāpadmepayoṣṇyāṃ piṃ galeśvaram |
siṃ hikāyāṃ tathātīrthaṃ sauraveravisaṃjṣakam ||23||
kārttikaṃ kṛttikākṣetreśāṃ karaṃ śaGkaregirau |
utpalākhyaṃ tatodivyaṃ subhadrāsiṃ dhusaṃgame ||24||
gāṇapatyaṃ tataścaivaparvatoviṣṇusaṃjṣake |
jālaṃ dharetataḥ proktaṃ tīrthaṃ viṣṇumukhaṃ cayat ||25||
tārevaitārakaṃ proktaṃ parvateviṣṇusaṃjṣake |
devadāru-vane pauṇḍraṃ pauṣkaṃ kāśmīra-maṇḍale ||26||
bhaumaṃ himaṃ himādraucatuṣṭikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ punaḥ |
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ jātaṃ māyāpuretathā ||27||
śaṃ khoddhāraṃ tataścaivadevaṃ vaiśaṅkhadhārakam |
piṇḍevaipiṇḍanāmānaṃ siddhevaikhānasambhavet ||28||
acchodeviṣṇukāmaṃ tudharmakāmārthamokṣadam |
auṣadhyaṃ cottarekūlekuśadvīpekuśodakam ||29||
manmathaṃ hemakūṭetukumudesatyavādanam |
vadanty āvāśvakaṃ tīrthaṃ viṃ dhyevaimātṛkaṃ smṛtam ||30||
cittebrahmamayaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam |
eteṣāṃ sarvatīrthānāmuttamaṃ śṛṇusundari ||31||
viṣṇornāma mayaṃ tīrthaṃ nabhūtaṃ nabhaviṣyati |
brahmahāhemahārīvābālahāgoghna eva ca ||32||
mucyatenāma mātreṇaprasādātkeśavasyatu |
kalau dvāravatī ramyā dhanyo devo janārdanaḥ ||33||
yepaśyanti narādevaṃ muktisteṣāṃ suniścalā |
evaṃ dhanyatamaṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarveśvaraṃ prabhum ||34||
cintayāmimahādevividvatsaṃsthojanārdanam |
aṣṭottaraṃ tutīrthānāṃ śatametadudāhṛtam ||35||
yojapecchṛṇuyādvāpisarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
eṣutīrtheṣuyaḥ snātvāpaśyennārāyaṇaṃ harim ||36||
sarva-pāpavinirmuktoyātiviṣṇoḥ sanātanam |
jagannāthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ lokānāṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam ||37||
yegacchanti naraśreṣṭhāstepiyānti parāṃ gatim |
śatāṣṭakaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śrāvayetpitṛkarmaṇi ||38||
ihalokesukhaṃ bhuktvāyātiviṣṇoḥ sanātanam |
godāneśrāddhadānevā ahanyahanivāpunaḥ ||39||
devārcanavidhauvidvānparaṃ brahmādhigacchati ||40||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ uttara-khaṇḍe jambū-dvīpa-tīrtha-varṇanaṃ nāma 
trayastriṃśādhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||133||

(134)
catustriṃśādhika-śatatamo'dhayāyaḥ

mahādeva uvāca—
vetravatyāstumāhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmiśṛṇusundari |
yatrasnātvāvimucyante yāvadābhūtasamplavam ||1||
vṛtreṇacakṛtaḥkūpomahāgaṃ bhīrasaṃjṣakaḥ |
kūpātsāniḥ sṛtādevīmahāpāpaughanāśinī ||2||
yathāgaṅgātatheyaṃ casaricchreṣṭhāsurottame |
asyādarśanamātreṇapāpaughāḥ śamayanti ca ||3||
śṛṇudevipravakṣyāmiitihāsampurātanam |
yacchrutvāpāpinodoṣair vimuktāḥkarmabandhanāt ||4||
caṃ pakenagarecaivarājārājyaṃ karotisaḥ |
sadāduṣṭoduṣṭarūpojanānāṃ saprapīḍakaḥ ||5||
adharmodharmarūpaścaviṣṇuniṃ dāparāyaṇaḥ |
devadvijanihaṃ tāca āśramāṇāṃ vidūṣakaḥ ||6||
vedaniṃ dāparaḥ śrīmānmūrkhovānirghṛṇaḥ śaṭhaḥ |
asacchāstreṣunirataḥparadārābhimarśakaḥ ||7||
vidāruṇetināmācasaṃjātomūrkha eva ca |
kadāciddaivayogena āgatastāṃ nadīṃ prati ||8||
ākheṭakasamāyuktaḥ svayaṃ kuṣṭhīsureśvari |
mahāpāpādayaṃ jātobrāhmaṇānāṃ caniṃ danāt ||9||
vṛthāvādīdurātmācaśaṭhovainirghṛṇaḥpaśuḥ |
vedaniṃ dāratonityaṃ gośāstrāṇāṃ pradūṣakaḥ ||10||
evaṃ vidhovanebhrāmyaṃ stṛṣārtaḥ sasuhṛdvṛtaḥ |
aśvāduttīryarājā'saujalaṃ pītvāgṛhaṃ gataḥ ||11||
tenaivodakapānenagataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
buddhistunirmalājātātasyarājṣoviśeṣataḥ ||12||
viṣṇaubhaktiḥ samutpannātadātasyasureśvari |
tataḥ prabhṛtikālenasnānaṃ vaikṛtavānsadā ||13||
nirmalobahurūpāḍhyojātas tatra sureśvari |
ihalokesukhaṃ bhuktvākṛtvāyajñānanekaśaḥ ||14||
viprebhyodakṣiṇāṃ datvāsagatovaiṣṇavaṃ padam |
itijṣātvātubhodevivetravatyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||15||
snānaṃ kurvanti yeviprāstemuktānaganaṃ dini |
rājanyovāthavaiśyovāśūdrovāsurasattame ||16||
yatrasnānaṃ prakurvanti temuktāḥpāpabandhanāt |
kārttikevā'thamāghe vābāhyovāvedaniṃ dakaḥ ||17||
saritāṃ saṃgamesnātvāmucyatedevikilbiṣāt |
sābhramatyāḥ samaṃ yatratasyāḥ saṃgaḥ pradṛśyate ||18||
 tatra snātvāviśeṣeṇamucyatebrahmahāsadā |
kheṭakaṃ nagaraṃ divyaṃ svargarūpaṃ tuvā'naghe ||19||
brahmaṇā tatra vaideviyogāścabahavaḥkṛtāḥ |
 tatra snātvā ca bhuktvā ca punarjanmanavidyate ||20||
sādvitīyāsmṛtāgaṅgākalaudeviviśeṣataḥ |
yenarāḥ sukhamicchanti dhanamicchanti yenarāḥ ||21||
svargamicchanti yelokāstevaisnātvāpunaḥpunaḥ |
ihalokesukhaṃ bhuktvāyānti viṣṇoḥ sanātanam ||22||
sūryavaṃ śecayejātāḥ somavaṃ śetathaivaca |
āgatāvetravatyāṃ tusnātvānirvṛtimāgatāḥ ||23||
darśanāddharateduḥkhaṃ sparśanānmānasaṃhyagham |
snātvābhuktvātathādevimuktibhāgīna saṃśayaḥ ||24||
snānājjapāttathāhomādanantaṃ phalamaśnute |
gatvāvārāṇasītīrthaṃ bhaktyācāṃ drāyaṇaṃ caret ||25||
 tatra gatvām ahatpuṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ surasattame |
vetravatyāṃ viśeṣeṇapaṣcatvaṃ yadigacchati ||26||
savaicaturbhujobhūtvāyātiviṣṇoḥparaṃ padam |
pṛthivyāṃ yānitīrthāniyedevāḥpitaras tathā ||27||
tesarvecavasaṃtīhavetravatyāṃ sureśvari |
kimanyadbahunoktenabhūyobhūyovarānane ||28||
vetravatyāḥ samaṃ tīrthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ nasanātani |
ahaṃ viṣṇus tathābrahmādevāścaparamarṣayaḥ ||29||
tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ sarvevetravatyāṃ maheśvari |
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vātrikālaṃ caviśeṣataḥ ||30||
snānaṃ kurvanti ye tatra tevaimuktāna saṃśayaḥ ||31||

bhodevyanyatpravakṣyāmihiraṇyāsaṃgamaṃ mahat |
yadāsābhramatīgaṅgāsaptasrotāpurābhavat ||1||
tadāsābrahmatanayāsaptasrotetiviśrutā |
saptamaṃ taddhiraṇyākhyaṃ srotaityabhidhīyate ||2||
tasmiṃ stīrthe naraḥ snātvāpāpīgatimavāpnuyāt |
ṛkṣumaṃ jumayor madhyesatyavānnāma parvataḥ ||3||
tasyaprāksumahattīrthaṃ hiraṇyāsaṃgamaṃ śubham |
 tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca śubhāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt ||4||
vanasthalyāṃ tatogacchedṛṣṭvānārāyaṇaṃ harim |
tīrthamapsarasāṃ puṇyaṃ hiraṇyāsaṃgameśvaram ||5||
yatrorvaśīpurājātāsamastāpsarasāṃ śubhā |
naranārāyaṇau tatra tapastepaturuttamam ||6||
hiraṇyāsaṃgameramyemahāpāpahareśubhe |
yatravaiṛṣayaḥ sarvemajjanti vītakalmaṣāḥ ||7||
vasiṣṭhādyāścayeviprāvālakhilyādayaścaye |
yatramajjanti deveśihiraṇyāsahasaṃgame ||8||
yatrahiraṇmayaṃ rūpaṃ snānādvaibhavatidhruvam |
kapilāgosahasrasyadānenaiva tuyat phalam ||9||
tat phalaṃ samavāpnotihiraṇyāsaṃgamesadā |
daśāśvamedheyatpuṇyaṃ grahaṇecandrasūryayoḥ ||10||
tadanantaguṇaṃ proktaṃ hiraṇyāsaṃgamepunaḥ |
tulāpuruṣadānecayat phalaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||11||
tat phalaṃ samavāpnotihiraṇyāsaṃgamesadā |
hiraṇyākṣomahādaityastenataptaṃ mahattapaḥ ||12||
hiraṇyasadṛśaṃ tatra śarīramabhavatpurā |
janamejayetathārājṣiyatrasnānaṃ prakurvati ||13||
brahmahatyāgatādevihiraṇyāsaṃgametadā |
viśvāmitro'tharājarṣiḥ snānārthaṃ vaisamāgataḥ ||14||
snānaṃ kṛtvāviśeṣeṇagato'saumāmakīṃ purīm ||15||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāś cātha sureśvari |
snānaṃ ye'tra prakurvanti te gacchanti śivālayam ||16||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcapaṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe 
umā-maheśvara-saṃvāde hiraṇyā-sagamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāma catvāriṃśad-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||140||

dharma uvāca—

dvicatvāriṃśad-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
śrī-mahādeva uvāca—
kambu-tīrthe naraḥ snātvākṛtvāvāpitṛtarpaṇam |
arcayeddeva-deveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāma yam ||1||
dattvā dānāni vidhivad brahmaṇebhyo vidhānataḥ |
viṣṇu-lokam avāpnoti tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||2||
atra rājarṣiṇā pūrvaṃ viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā |
tapas taptaṃ viśeṣeṇa prajā-kāmena sundari ||3||
vāyu-bhakṣo nirāhāro yatrāsīd anilāśanaḥ |
viṣṇu-pūjā-paro nityaṃ viṣṇu-dhyāna-parāyaṇaḥ ||4||
tapasānena saṃjātaḥ prajā-kāmam avāptavān |
prajā-kāmo naro yaś ca kambu-tīrthaṃ hi gacchati ||5||
sa prajāṃ labhate nityaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane ||6||
iti kambu-tīrtha-māhātmyam ||
tato gacchet sura-śreṣṭhe tīrthaṃ nāma kapīśvaram |
saṃnidhauraktasiṃ hasyamahāpātakanāśanam ||7||
badhyamānepurāsetaurāmarāvaṇavigrahe |
gṛhītvāparvataśreṣṭhaṃ viśeṣātkapibhiḥkṛtam ||8||
nāmnākapīśvarādityaṃ cakrustīrthamanuttamam |
yatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvākṛtvāvāpitṛtarpaṇam ||9||
dṛṣṭvākapīśvarādityaṃ mucyatebrahmahatyayā |
 tatra snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ caitrāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||10||
hanumatpramukhais tatra snātaṃ yatradinatrayam |
kapitīrthaprabhāvo'yaṃ bhavatyaisamudīritaḥ ||11||

rūpavānbahubhogaścajāyatenātra saṃśayaḥ ||12||
balaṃ vāṣchatiyolokodharmaṃ vāputram eva ca |
sarvaṃ satulabhennityaṃ kapitīrthaprabhāvataḥ ||13||
iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuttara-khaṇḍe umāmaheśvara
saṃvādekapitīrthamāhātmyaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśad-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||142||

mahādeva uvāca—
tatogacchettathādevitīrthaṃ kāpotikaṃ punaḥ |

dattvā vai sva-śarīraṃ tu kapoto'tha mahātmane ||17||
sa gato vaiṣṇavaṃ tatra yāvac-candra-divākarau |
ato gatvā tu bho devi atithiṃ pūjayet sadā |
pūjite cātithau tatra sarvaṃ ca labhate dhruvam ||18||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām

atra tīrthātparaṃ tīrthaṃ caṇḍeśaitiviśrutam |

nāmnā tu vasudevo hi veśyāyām atilampaṭaḥ ||11||
tasmin janmani naiva ṃ ca cakāra sukṛtaṃ kiyat |
bhuktvā madhu-ghṛtaṃ caiva veśyā-saṅgama-lālasaḥ ||12||
mad-vratasya prabhāvena bhaktir jātā tavānagha |
prahlādovāca --
vistarādvadadeveśakasyaputrasyakiṃ vratam ||13||
veśyāyāṃ vartamānenakathaṃ ciddhikṛtaṃ mayā |
mamoparikṛpāṃ kṛtvāsarvaṃ kathayasāṃ pratam ||14||
nṛsiṃha uvāca—
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ tupurābrahmācakrehyetadanuttamam |
madbratasyaprabhāvenanirmitaṃ sacarācaram ||15||
īśvareṇavrataṃ cīrṇaṃ vadhārthaṃ tripurasyaca |
vratasyāsyaprabhāvenatripurastunipātitaḥ ||16||
anyaiś ca bahubhirdevair ṛṣibhiścapurātanaiḥ |
rājabhiścamahāprājṣair vihitaṃ vratamuttamam ||17||
vratasyāsyaprabhāvena sarvesiddhimavāpnuyuḥ |
mamatevaipriyājātādivibhogānanekaśaḥ ||18||
bhuktvāmayivilīnāstuprahlādatvaṃ viśasvamām |
kāryārthamavatārastemaccharīratpṛthagyataḥ ||19||
nateṣāṃ punarāvṛttirmahākalpaśatair api |
daridrolabhatelakṣmīṃ dhanadasyacayādṛśī ||20||
tataḥ kāmīlabhetkāmaṃ rājyārthīrājyamuttamam |
āyuṣkāmolabhedāyuryādṛśaṃ caśivasyahi ||21||
avaidhavyakaraṃ strīṇāṃ putradaṃ bhāgyadaṃ tathā |
dhanadhānyakaraṃ caivatathāśokavināśanam ||22||
striyovāpuruṣāvāpikurvanti vratamuttamam |
tebhyodadāmy ahaṃ saukhyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalaṃ tathā ||23||
bahunoktenakiṃ vatsavratasyāsyaphalasyahi |
madbratasyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nāhaṃ śaktonaśaGkaraḥ ||24||
prahlāda uvāca—
bhagavaṃ stvatprasādenaśrutaṃ vratamanuttamam |
vratasyāsyaphalaṃ śrotuṃ tvayimebhaktikāraṇam ||25||
adhunāśrotumicchāmivratasyāsyavidhiṃ param |
kasminmāsebhavedevakasmiṃ ścidvāsareprabho ||26||
etadvistaratodevavaktum arhasisāṃ pratam |
vidhināyenavaisvāminsamagraphalabhāgbhavet ||27||
nṛsiṃha uvāca—
prahlādavatsabhadraṃ teśṛṇuṣvaikamanāvratam |
vaiśākhesitapakṣetucaturdaśyāṃ samācaret ||28||
mamāvirbhāvasaṃyuktaṃ mamasantuṣṭikāraṇam |
śṛṇuputramamotpattiṃ bhaktānāṃ sukhahetave ||29||
paścimāyāṃ diśāyāṃ casaṃjātaṃ kāraṇāṃ tarāt |
maulistānamidaṃ kṣetraṃ pavitraṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||30||
tasminkṣetretuvikhyātobrāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ |
hārītaitināmnācajñānadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||31||
tasyastrītumahāpuṇyāsatīrūpāsadāprabho |
līlāvatītunāmnācabharturvaśaparāsadā ||32||
tābhyāṃ tapomahattaptaṃ kālaṃ bahutaraṃ suta |
ekaviṃ śayugāścaivayātās tatra na saṃśayaḥ |
tasminakṣetretu vai tābhyāṃ pratyakṣovābhavattadā ||33||
nṛsiṃha uvāca—
yaṃ yaṃ vāṣchayasebrahmaṃ staṃ dadāmina saṃśayaḥ |
tābhyāmuktaṃ tadātasmaidīyatecedvaromama ||34||
tvādṛśomamaputrastuhyadhunaiva bhavatviti |
mayoktaṃ tutadāvatsaputro'haṃ tena saṃśayaḥ ||35||
viśvakarmāhy ahaṃ sākṣātparamātmāparātparaḥ |
udare'haṃ navatsyāmiyato'haṃ vaisanātanaḥ ||36||
hārītenatadācoktaṃ bhavatvevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
tadāprabhṛtivaikṣetresthito'haṃ bhaktakāraṇāt ||37||
atrāgatyaprakurvītadarśanaṃ bhaktasattamaḥ |
tasyāhaṃ sakalāṃ bādhāṃ nāśayāminirantaram ||38||
etasmātkāraṇāccaivavrataṃ vaividhipūrvakam |
ye kurvanti naraśreṣṭhānateṣāṃ vidyatebhayam ||39||
bālarūpamayaṃ dhyātvātābhyāṃ sahaviśeṣataḥ |
pūjanaṃ kuruterātrausavainārāyaṇobhavet ||40||
caturbhujaṃ mahādaṃ ṣṭraṃ kālarūpaṃ durāsadam |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ yamakoṭidurāsadam |
siṃhavac ca mukhaṃ yasya naravac cāṅga-saṃyutam ||41||
śrī-nṛsiṃhaṃ divya-siṃhaṃ kāla-rūpaṃ bhajet sadā |
evaṃ jṣātvāviśeṣeṇayaḥ sthānaṃ māmakaṃ vrajet ||42||
vrataṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ śrīkadaṃ bapradaṃ mahat |
aṃ temuktipradaṃ caivabhaktānāṃ cana saṃśayaḥ ||43||
yenavaikriyamāṇena sahasradvādaśīphalam |
svātīnakṣatrasaṃyogeśanivāretumadbratam ||44||
siddhiyogasyasaṃyogevaṇijekaraṇetathā |
yogaiḥ sarvaiś ca saṃyogaṃ hatyākoṭivināśanam ||45||
etadanyatarair yogemaddinaṃ pāpa-nāśanam |
vijṣāyamaddinaṃ yastulaṃ ghayetsatupāpakṛt ||46||
akarttā narakaṃ yāti yāvac candra-divākarau |
prāptemamadinevatsadaṃ tadhāvanapūrvakam ||47||
mamāgrevratasaṃkalpaṃ madbhaktovijitendriyaḥ |
adyāhaṃ tevidhāsyāmivrataṃ nirvighnatāṃ naya ||48||
vratasthenanakarttavyaṃ duṣṭasambhāṣaṇādikam |
tatomadhyāhnasamayenadyādauvimalejale ||49||
gṛhevādevakhātevātaḍāgevāthaśobhane |
vaidikenatumantreṇasnānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||50||
mṛttikāgomayenaiva tathādhātrīphalenaca |
tilaiś ca vidhivatsnāyātsarva-pāpaughaśāṃ taye ||51||
paridhāyaśubhevastrenityakarmasamārabhet |
tatogṛhaṃ vilipyāthakuryādaṣṭadalaṃ śubham ||52||
kalaśaṃ tatra saṃsthāpyatāmraṃ trasamanvitam |
tasyoparinyasetpātraṃ taṇḍulaiḥ paripūritam ||53||
haimīṃ ca tatra manmūrtisthāpyalakṣmyāsamanvitām |
nirmāyaśaktyāsvarṇenasnāpyapaṃ cāmṛtaistataḥ ||54||
tato brāhmaṇamāhūya ācāryaṃ nātilolupam |
śāstrajṣamagrataḥkṛtvātatodevaṃ samarcayet ||55||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tatra puṣpastabakaśobhitam |
ṛtukālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjyo'haṃ cayathāvidhi ||56||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmaṃ trair  niyamaiś ca yaḥ |
tataḥ paurāṇikair mantraiḥ pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ ||57||
candanaṃ ca sa-karpūraṃ ghana-kuṅkuma-miśritam |
kālodbhavāni puṣpāṇi tathā tulasī-dalāni ca ||58||
śrī-nṛsiṃhāya yo dadyāt sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ |
kṛṣṇāguru-mayaṃ dhūpaṃ sarvadā hari-vallabham ||59||
haraye gurave dadyāt sarva-kāmārtha-siddhaye |
mahā-dīpaḥ prakartavyo hy ajñāna-dhvānta-nāśanaḥ 
mahā-nīrājanaṃ kuryād dhaṇṭā-nāda-puraḥ saram ||60||
naivedyaṃ śarkarāṃ cāpi bhakṣya-bhaujya-samanvitam |
dadāmi te ramā-kānta sarva-pāpa-kṣayaṃ kuru ||61||
naivedya-mantraḥ
nṛsiṃhācyutadeveśatavajanmadineśubhe |
upavāsaṃkariṣyāmisarvabhogavivarjitaḥ ||62||
tenaprītobhavasvāminpāpaṃ janmanirākuru |
rātraujāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gītavāditraniḥ svanaiḥ ||63||
purāṇapaṭhanaṃ nityaṃ śrīnṛsiṃ kathāśrayam |
tataḥ prabhātasamayesnānaṃ kṛtvāhyanantaram ||64||
pūrvoktenavidhānenapūjayenmāṃ pratarpayan |
vaiṣṇavaṃ kārayecchrāddhaṃ madagresvasthamānasaḥ ||65||
tatodānānideyānivakṣyamāṇāniyānyuta |
pātrebhyaḥ sadbijebhyohilokadvayajigīṣayā ||66||
sahasvarṇamayodevomamasaṃtoṣakārakaḥ |
gobhūtilahiraṇyādipradadātidvijātaye ||67||
śayyāsatūlikādeyāsaptadhānyasamanvitā |
anyāni cayathāśaktyādeyāninijaśaktitaḥ ||68||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ nakurvītayathoktaphalakāṃ kṣayā |
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścāttebhyo dadyāt sudakṣiṇām ||69||
nirdhanair apikarttavyaṃ deyaṃ śaktyanusārataḥ |
sarveṣām eva varṇānāma dhikāro'stimadbrate |
madbhaktaistuviśeṣeṇakarttavyaṃ matparāyaṇaiḥ ||70||
tataḥ prārthanāma ṃ traḥ 
madvaṃ śeyenarājātāyebhaviṣyāścamānavāḥ |
tānuddharasvadeveśaduḥkhadādbhavasāgarāt ||71||
pātakārṇavamagnasyavyādhibhiścāṃ bucāribhiḥ |
jīvaistuparibhūtasyamahāduḥkhagatasyame ||72||
karāvalaṃ banaṃ dehiśeṣaśāyījagatpate |
vratenānenadeveśabhuktimuktipradobhava ||73||
evaṃ prārthyatatodevaṃ visṛjyacayathāvidhi |
upahārādikaṃ sarveācāryāyanivedayet ||74||
dakṣiṇābhiścasaṃtoṣyābrāhmaṇāṃś cavisarjayet |
mamadhyānasamāyuktobhuṃ jītasahabandhubhiḥ ||75||
akiṃ canopiniyatamupoṣyaticaturdaśīm |
saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyatenātra saṃśayaḥ ||76||
yaidaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyāvrataṃ pāpa-praṇāśanam |
tasyaśravaṇamātreṇabrahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||77||
pavitraṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ kīrtayedyastumānavaḥ |
sarva-kāmanavāpnotivratasyāsyaphalaṃ sadā ||78||
yaidaṃ kuruteśaktyākālemadhyāhnasaṃjṣake |
līlāvatyāsahaṛṣiṃ śrīnṛsiṃhaprasādataḥ ||79||
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā muktiṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīm |
tasmin kṣetre tu yo gatvā śrī-nṛsiṃhaṃ prapūjayet ||80||
vāṣchitalabhatenityaśrīnṛsihaprasādataḥ |
śrīnṛsiṃhamahadrūpakālakoṭidurāsada ||81||
bhair avaśaharārtighnabālarūpanamostute |
śrīnṛsiṃhāyarūpāyabālāyabālarūpiṇe ||82||
vyāpakāyasunaṃ dāyasvātmaprakaṭarūpiṇe |
sarvajīvātmakāyaivaviśveśāyasvarātmane ||83||
mārtaṇḍamaṇḍalasthāyadayāsiṃ dhonamostute |
caturviṃ śasvarūpāyakālarudrāgnirūpiṇe ||84||
jagadekasvarūpāyanṛsiṃhāyanamostute |
bhāledadhārayodevonṛsiṃhovīrabhadrajit ||85||
dvādaśādityabiṃ bānisutaptānipramāṇataḥ |
 tatra siṃ dhumaṃ hāpuṇyānadīramyāviśeṣataḥ ||86||
tasyāḥ samīpenagaraṃ varttate'dyāpisundari |
maulistānetivikhyātaṃ sarvadādevanirmitam ||87||
vasatirvarttate tatra hārītasyamahātmanaḥ |
līlāvatītu tatra ivatiṣṭhatenātra saṃśayaḥ ||88||
pratiśabdobhavet tatra siṃ dhunadyāḥ samīpataḥ |
kalauyugetusamprāptemlecchāvaipāpacāriṇaḥ ||89||
nivasaṃtitu tatra ivabahavonātra saṃśayaḥ |
nṛsiṃhajanmaniyathāśabdo'bhūdadbhutaḥparaḥ ||90||
nṛsiṃhetinṛsiṃhetiyauccair  nadatenaraḥ |
tādṛśaḥ pratiśabdovaijāyatenaganaṃ dini ||91||
brahmahāhemahārīvāsurāpogurutalpagaḥ |
siṃ dhaugatvāviśeṣeṇasnānaṃ kurvanti yejanāḥ ||92||
mucyatenātrasaṃdehaḥ śrīnṛsiṃhaprasādataḥ |
daśārātripramāṇenamānavāyevasaṃtihi ||93||
tejṣeyāḥpuṇyakarmāṇonāsatyaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ |
nivasaṃtikalau tatra varṇāyedvijapūrvakāḥ ||94||
mlecchavatte'pivijṣeyāvedabāhyāḥ surottamaiḥ |
māṃ saṃkhādaṃ tite tatra madyapānaṃ papuḥ sadā ||95||
atohyadharmarūpāstepāpiṣṭhānātra saṃśayaḥ |
saṃdhyāhīnāyathāviprāvedabāhyāstathaivaca ||96||
nivasaṃtipuretasminpaścimāyāṃ sureśvari |
ekamevaparaṃ tīrthaṃ nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ suvistaram |
yaṃ śrutvāmucyatepāpānnaraḥ sadyona saṃśayaḥ ||97||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe nṛsiṃhotpattir nāma 
catuḥ-saptaty-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

gītā-māhātmyam
(175-192)

(175)
paṣcasaptatyadhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

pārvaty uvāca --
bhagavansarvatatvajṣaśrīviṣṇostvatprasādataḥ |
śrutānānāvidhādharmālokanistārahetavaḥ ||1||
adhunā śrotum icchāmi gītā-māhātmyam apy aham |
śrutenayenadeveśaharaubhaktirvivarddhate |
tadvadasvādhunādevayadya##tavavallabhā ||2||
īśvara uvāca
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ khageṃ drāsanamacyutam |
śayānaṃ śeṣaśayyāyāṃ mahāviṣṇumupāsmahe ||3||
kadācidāsaneramyesukhāsīnaṃ muradbiṣam |
ānaṃ dayitrīlokānāṃ lakṣmīḥpapracchasādarāt ||4||
śrīr uvāca
śayālurasidugdhābdhaubhagavankenahetunā |
udāsīnaivaiśvaryaṃ jagaṃ tisthāpayanniva ||5||
īśvara uvāca
itidevyāvacaḥśrutvāmurabhijjñānagarvitam |
uvāca ślakṣṇayāvācāvismayasmeralocanaḥ ||6||
śrī bhagavān uvāca
nāhaṃ sumukhinidrālurnijaṃ māheśvaraṃ vapuḥ |
dṛśā tattvānuvartinyā paśyāmy antar-nimagnayā ||7||
kuśāgrayādhiyādeviyadaṃ taryoginohṛdi |

dvaipāyanoyadāsādyagītāśāstraṃ nisṛṣṭavān ||11||

sāharṣotphullalolākṣīlakṣmīśrutvāvisismire ||13||

yathāsthitastato'nyatvaṃ yadimāṃ bodhayācyuta ||15||
śrī bhagavān uvāca
māyāmayamidaṃ devivapurmenatutātvikam |
sṛṣṭisthityopasaṃhārakriyājālopabṛṃ hitam ||16||
ato'nyadātmanorūpaṃ  dvaitādvaitavivarjitam |
bhāvābhāvavinirmuktamādyaṃ tarahitaṃ priye ||17||
śuddhasaṃvitprabhālābhaṃ parānaṃ daikasuṃ daram |
rūpamaiśvaramātmaikyagamyaṃ gītāsukīrtitam ||18||
ityākarṇyavacodevidevasyāmitatejasaḥ |
śaṃ kamānāhavākyeṣuparasparavirodhiṣu ||19||
svayaṃ cetparamānaṃ damavāzmanasagocaram  |
kathaṃ gītābodhayatiitimecchiṃ dhisaṃśayam ||20||
īśvara uvāca
śriyaḥśrutvāvacoyuktamitihāsapuraḥsaram |
ātmānugāminīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ gītāṃ bodhitavānprabhuḥ ||20||
ahamātmāpareśāniparāparavibhedataḥ |
dvidhātataḥparaḥsākṣīnirguṇoniṣkalaḥśivaḥ ||21||
aparaḥpaṣcavaktro'haṃ dvidhātasyāpisaṃsthitiḥ |
śabdārthabhedatovācyoyathātmāhaṃ maheśvaraḥ ||22||
gītānāṃ vākyarūpeṇayannirucchidyatedṛḍhaḥ |
madīyapāśabaṃ dho'yasaṃsāraviṣayātmakaḥ ||23||
yadābhyāsaparādhīnaupaṣcavaktramaheśvarau |

idaṃ paravibhedenabudhyatebhavabhīrubhiḥ |

māhātmyaṃ setihāsaṃcasarvaṃ tasyainyavedayat |
śrī bhagavān uvāca
śṛṇusuśroṇivakṣyāmigītāsusthitimātmanaḥ ||26||
vaktrāṇipaṣcajānīhipaṃ cādhyāyānanukramāt |
daśādhyāyābhujāścaikaudaraṃ dvaupadāṃ buje ||27||
evamaṣṭādaśādhyāyāvāzmayīmūrtiraiśvarī |
vijṣeyājñānamātreṇamahāpātakanāśinī ||28||
atodhyāyaṃ tadardhaṃ vāślokamarddhaṃ tadardhakam |
abhyasyatisumedhāyaḥsuśarmevasamucyate ||29||
śrīr uvāca
suśarmānāma kodevakiṃ jātīyaḥkimātmakaḥ |
kutastasyacavaimuktiḥkenājāyatahetunā ||30||
śrī bhagavān uvāca
suśarmānāma durmedhāḥsīmāpāpātmanāma bhūt |

nadhyānaṃ najapohomonacaivātithipūjanam |

kṛṣikarmaratonityaṃ parṇajīvīsurāpriyaḥ |
māṃ sopahārīsuciraṃ kālamevaṃ nināyasaḥ ||33||
ānetukāmaḥparṇāniparyaṭanṛṣivāṭikām |
tataḥsatatradaṣṭo'bhūtkālasarpeṇamūḍhadhīḥ ||34||
kāladharmaṃ samāsādyagatvācanirayānbahūn |
punarāgatyamartyeṣubalīvardatvamīyivān ||35||
paṃ gunākenavikrītaḥsasvajīvanahetave |
nayanpṛṣṭhenaśaradaḥsaptāṣṭaukaṣṭatonayat ||36||
kadācitpaṃ gunāso'piciramāvartitojavāt |
papātatarasābhūmaumūrcchāṃ capratipedivān ||37||
vikalāṃ govivṛttākṣaḥphenasaṃtatimudgiran |
najīvatinamṛtyuṃ vāpratipedesvakarmaṇā ||38||
kautukākṛṣṭaloke'smiṃ stasminjanasamāgame |
śreyasetasyasukṛtīkaścitpuṇyaṃ vitīrṇavān ||39||
karmāṇisvānyanusmṛtyadaduranyecakecana |
gaṇikākāpitatrasthālokayātrānuvartinī ||40||
ajṣātanijapuṇyāsākiṃ cidutsṛṣṭavatyabhūt |

kimanenamahāchāgaduḥkhajātenanityaśaḥ |

mahādeva uvāca --
astikolhāpuraṃ nāma nagaraṃ dakṣiṇāpathe |
sukhānāṃ sadanaṃ sādhvisādhūnāṃ  siddhisaṃbhavam ||1||

yayāśaktyākṛtāveśaḥ  saṃharatyakhilaṃ haraḥ |17||
tāṃ bhajeparamāṃ śaktiṃ sargasthitilayorjitām |
yogidhyeyāṃ ghrikamalekamalekamalālaye ||18||

nahato'syaguṇadraṣṭāsarvasādhāraṇaṃ tvidam |
yatphalaṃ tapasānaitinayogenasamādhinā ||70||
tatphalaṃ labhatedhīmānkalaukeśavakīrtanāt |
etādṛśaṃ kaliṃ dṛṣṭvāsārātsāraphalapradam ||71||
viṣṇurātaḥsthāpitavānkalijānāṃ hitāyaca |
kukarmācaraṇātsāraḥsarvatonirgato'dhunā ||72||
padārthāḥsaṃsthitābhūmaubījahīnāstuṣāyathā |
viprairbhāgavatīvārttāgehegehejanejane ||73||
kāritādhanalobhenakathāsārastatogataḥ |
atyugrabhūrikarmāṇonāstikādāṃ bhikājanāḥ ||74||
tiṣṭhaṃ tisarvatīrtheṣutīrthasārastatogataḥ |
kāmakrodhamahālobhatṛṣṇāvyākulacetasaḥ ||75||
samāraṃ bhaṃ tekarmāṇikarmasārastatogataḥ |
manasaścājayāllobhāddaṃ bhātpākhaṇḍasaṃśrayāt ||76||
śāstrānabhyasanāccaivadhyānayogaphalaṃ gatam |
paṇḍitāstekalatreṣuramaṃ temahiṣāiva ||77||
putrotpādanadakṣāścanadakṣāmuktisādhane |
nahivaiṣṇavatākutrasaṃpradāyapuraḥsarāḥ ||78||
devaniṃ dāparāḥ sarvesādhuniṃ dāparāyaṇāḥ |
ayaṃ tuyugadharmo'stidīyatekasyadūṣaṇam ||79||
atastvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ smṛtvāsaukhyamavāpsyasi ||80||
evaṃ mayoktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvāsāvismayaṃ gatā |
uvāca vacanaṃ bhūyo māṃ praśasya dvijottamāḥ ||81||
bhaktir uvāca --
devarṣe tvaṃ tu dhanyo'si mad-bhāgyena samāgataḥ |
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ loke sarva-siddhi-pradāyakam ||82||
sukhopāyo yathā me syāt tathādiśa mune'dhunā |
sarvajṣasya tava brahman na sādhyaṃ kim apīha vai ||83||
ajayad ajita-māyāṃ yasya kāyādhavas te 
vacana-racanam ekaṃ kevalaṃ cākalayya |
dhruva-padam upayāto yat-kṛpāto dhruvo vai 
tam aham araṇa-bhūtaṃ brahma-putraṃ natāsmi ||84||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṃcāśat-sahasra-saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe bhāgavata-māhātmye
trinavaty-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

(194)
catur-navaty-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ -

sūta uvāca --
evaṃ samprārthito viprās tayā bhaktyātidīnayā |
yataś cākathayaṃ tad vai tac chṛṇudhvaṃ dayālavaḥ ||1||
nārada uvāca --
mā khidas tvaṃ vṛthā bāle samādhāya mano hṛdi |
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇāmbhojaṃ smara-saukhyaṃ labhiṣyasi ||2||
draupadī ca paritrātā yena kaurava-kaśmalāt |
pālitā gopa-sundaryaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ kvāpi no gataḥ ||3||
tvaṃ tu bhaktiḥ priyā tasya satataṃ prāṇato'dhikā |
tvayāhūtas tu bhagavān yāti nīca-gṛheṣv api ||4||
satyādi-triyuge bodho virāgo mukti-sādhakau |
kalau tu kevalā bhaktir brahma-sāyujya-kāriṇī ||5||
iti niścitya vidrūpī svakāṅgāt tvāṃ sasarja ha |
paramānanda-cin-mūrtiḥ sva-priyāṃ prīta-mānasaḥ ||6||
baddhvāṣjaliṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaḥ kiṃ karomīti vai hariḥ |
tvāṃ tadājṣāpayat kṛṣṇo mad-bhaktān poṣayeti ca ||7||
aṅgīkṛtaṃ tvayā tadvat prasanno'bhūd dharis tadā |
muktidāsīṃ dadau tubhyaṃ jñāna-vairāgya ātmajau ||8||
bhaktānāṃ poṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ vaikuṇṭha-sthā karoṣi ca |
bhūmau ca bhakta-poṣāya chāyā-rūpaṃ samāśritā ||9||
vimukti-jñāna-vairāgyaiḥ saha caivāgatā trahi |
kṛtādi-dvāparāṃ te hi kāle muktim udāsthitā ||10||
kalau tu saṅkṣayaṃ prāptā pāṣaṇḍāmaya-pīḍitā |
tvad-ājṣayā gatā śīghraṃ vaikuṇṭhe punar eva sā |
smṛta-mātrā tvayādyāpi muktir āyāti satvaram ||11||
putrī-kṛtya tvayaimau ca sva-pārśve parirakṣitau |
upekṣātaḥ kalau mandau vṛddhau jātau sutau tava ||12||
tathāpi cintāṃ muṣca tvam upāyaṃ cintayāmy aham |
kalinā sadṛśaḥ ko'pi yugo nāsti varānane ||13||
tasmiṃs tvāṃ khyāpayiṣyāmi gehe gehe jane jane |
anya-dharmās tiraskṛtya puraskṛtya mahotsavān ||14||
yadi pravartaye na tvāṃ tadā dāso harer na hi |
tvad-anvitāś ca ye jīvā bhaviṣyanti kalāv iha ||15||
pāpino'pi gamiṣyanti nirbhayā hari-mandiram |
yeṣāṃ citte bhaved bhaktiḥ sarvadā prema-rūpiṇī ||16||
na te paśyanti kīnāśaṃ svapne'py amala-mūrtayaḥ |
na preto na piśāco vā rākṣaso vāsuro’pi ca ||17||
bhakti-yukta-manaskānāṃ sparśane darśane prabhuḥ |
na tapobhir na vedaiś ca na jṣānenāpi karmaṇā ||18||
harir hi sādhyate bhaktyā pramāṇaṃ tatra gopikāḥ |
nṛṇāṃ janma-sahasreṇa bhaktiḥ sukṛtināṃ bhavet ||19||
kalau bhaktiḥ kalau bhaktir bhaktyā kṛṣṇaḥ puraḥ sthitaḥ |
bhakti-droha-karāye ca te sīdanti jagat-traye ||20||
durvāsā duḥkham āpannaḥ purā bhakti-vinindakaḥ |
alaṃ vṛttair alaṃ tīrthair alaṃ yogair alaṃ makhaiḥ ||21||
alaṃ jñāna-kathālāpair bhaktir ekaiva muktidā |
evamuktaṃ mayāsātusvamāhātmyaṃ niśamyavai ||22||
sarvāṃ gaharṣasaṃ yuktāmāṃ punarvākyamabravīt |
ahonāradadhanyo'siprītistemayiniścalā ||23||
nakadācinvimuṃ cāmicittaṃ temayisaṅgatam |
kṛpālunātvayāsādhomadvādhādhvaṃ satitākṣaṇāt ||24||
putrayoścetanānāstimamemaupratibodhaya |
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvākāruṇyenānvitohyaham ||25||
tayoḥ prabodhanaṃ kartuṃ pravṛttaḥ pāṇināspṛśan |
mukhaṃ saṃ sṛjyakarṇāṃ teśabdamuccaiḥ samuccaran ||26||
jñānaprabuddhyatāṃ śīghraṃ vairāgyapratibudhyatām |
vedavedāntaghoṣaiścagītā pāṭhairmuhurmuhuḥ ||27||
bodhyamānautadātena kathaṣcid vodhamāgatau |
netrairanavalokaṃ taujṛṃ bhaṃ tausālasāvubhau ||28||
bakavatpalitauprāyaḥ śuṣkakāṣṭhasamāṃ gakau |
kṣutkṣāmautaunirīkṣyaivapunaḥ svāpamupāgatau ||29||
tadācintāparo'bhūvaṃ kiṃ vidheyaṃ mayetica |
ahonidrā kathaṃ yātivṛddhatvaṃ cānayoḥ param ||30||
cintayannitagovindaṃ smarannāsamdvijottamāḥ |
vyomavāṇītadaivābhūnmāṛṣekhidyatāmiti ||31||
udyamaḥ saphalastetubhaviṣyatinasaṃ śayaḥ |
etadarthantusatkarmasurarṣetvaṃ samācara ||32||
tatkarmate'bhidhāsyanti sādhavaḥ sādhubhūṣaṇāḥ |
satkarmaṇikṛte tasmin svapanaṃ bṛddhatānayoḥ ||33||
gamiṣyatikṣaṇādbhaktiḥ sarvataḥ prasariṣyati |
ityākāśavacaḥ spaṣṭaṃ niśamyāpimayādvijāḥ ||34||
najṣātaṃ yannabhovāṇyāgopyatvenanirūpitaṃ |
kiṃ tatkarmacayenaitaubhavatojñānasaṃ yutau ||35||
kvabhaviṣyanti te santaḥ kathaṃ vakṣyanti karmasat |
mayātrakiṃ prakarttavyaṃ yaduktaṃ vyomabhāṣayā ||36||
athatau tatra saṃsthāpyanirgato'haṃ bahirdvijāḥ |
vṛṃ dāraṇyādapṛcchaṃ ca yatra tatra dvijottamān ||37||
vṛttāntaṃ sarvaevātha śrutvāvismitamānasāḥ |
naivottaraṃ prayacchanti hyanabhijñānabhogiraḥ ||38||
asādhyaṃ kecanaprocurāvijṣeyamathāpare |
mūkībabhūvuranyetucintayānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||39||
vedavedāntaghoṣaiścagītāpāṭhairmuhurmuhuḥ |
bodhyamānaṃ trikaṃ tattunodatiṣṭhadahovidhiḥ ||40||
yoginānāradenāpisvayaṃ najṣāyatetuyat |
tat kathaṃ śakyate kartumitarairihamānuṣaiḥ |
tataścintāturaścāhaṃ badarīvanamāgataḥ ||41||
tapaścarāmicātraivatadarthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ |
tāvaddadarśapurataḥ sanakādyānmunīśvarān |
koṭisūryasamābhāsān uvācamunisattamān ||42||
idānīṃ bhūribhāgenabhavatāṃ darśanaṃ hyabhūt |
tadupāyaṃ mahābhāgāvadaṃ tuprītamānasāḥ ||43||
bhavanto yogināṃ śreṣṭhābuddhimanto bahuśrutāḥ |
kumārāevapaṣcābdāḥ pūrveṣāmapipūrvajāḥ ||44||
sadāvaikuṇṭhanilayāharikīrttanatatparāḥ |
līlāmṛtakathonmattāharismaraṇatatparāḥ ||45||
atohikāladuhitāyuṣmānnaivaprabādhate |
yeṣāṃ bhrūbhaṃ gamātreṇadvārapālauhareḥ purā ||46||
daityaubhutvātrijanmānipunastatsthānamāsthitau |
aśarīragiroktaṃ ya##katatsādhanamucyatām ||47##||
anuṣṭheyaṃ yathā yatra prabruvaṃ tukṛpālavaḥ |
bhaktijñānavirāgāṇāṃ sukhamutpadyate yathā |
khyātirvaḥ sarbalokeṣu tathā sādhūcyatāṃ budhāḥ ||48||
kumārā ūcuḥ --
mācintāṃ kurudevarṣesvacitteharṣamāvaha |
upāyaḥ sukhāsādhyo'travidyateviśvasaukhyadaḥ ||49||
ahonāradadhanyo'siviraktānāṃ śiromaṇiḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇapremapātrāṇāmagraṇīrvadatāṃ baraḥ ||50||
tvayicitraṃ nadevarṣebhaktisādhanatatpare |
ucitaṃ kṛṣṇadāsānāṃ bhakteḥ saṃ cāraṇaṃ bhuvi ||51||
ṛṣibhirbahudhālokeupāyāḥ siddhayekṛtāḥ |
śramasādhyāścatesarveprāyaḥ svargaphalapradāḥ ||52||
vaikuṇṭhasādhakaḥ paṃ thāguptolokeṣuvarttate |
tasyopadeśakaḥ sādhuḥ prāyobhāgyenalabhyate ||53||
yattesatkarmanirdiṣṭaṃ vyomavācāmunīśvara |
tajjṣeyamihasarvajṣairjñānayajṣaḥ purātanaiḥ ||54||
śrīmad-bhāgavatālāpojñānayajṣaḥ śukoditaḥ |
bhaktijñānavirāgāṇāṃ sukhadaḥ pratibhātinaḥ ||55||
kalidoṣāimesarveśrīmad-bhāgavatadhvaneḥ |
prabhītāḥ pralayāyaṃ tesaṃ haśabdādvṛkāiva ||56||
jñānavairāgyasaṃ yuktābhaktiḥ premarasāvahā |
pratigehaṃ pratijanaṃ sukhakrīḍāṃ kariṣyati ||57||
sūta uvāca --
kumāroktaṃ samākarṇyanāradaḥ prītamānasaḥ |
punaḥ provācabhagavāṃs tadutkarṣaṃ vibhāvayan ||58||
nārada uvāca --
vedavedāntaghoṣaiścagītāpāṭhaiḥ prabodhitam |
nodatiṣṭhattrikaṃ tattukalidoṣatiraskṛtam ||59||
 kathaṃ bhāgavatālāpāttadvibodhamihaiṣyati |
chiṃ daṃ tusaṃ śayaṃ hyenaṃ bhavanto 'moghadarśanāḥ ||60||
vilaṃ bonātrakarttavyaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalāḥ |
tatastesanakādyāstuviraktahyūrddhvaretasaḥ ||61||
siddhāḥ sanātanābiprānāradaṃ procurādarāt ||62||
kumārā ūcuḥ |
vedopaniṣadāṃ sārājjātā bhāgavatīkathā |
atyuttamātatobhātipṛthagbhūtāphalonnatiḥ ||63||
āmūlāgraṃ rasostyevarasālasya yathā phale |
pṛthagbhūtaṃ tupānena yathā viśvamanoharaḥ ||64||
 yathā dugdhesthitaṃ sarpirnacasvādūpakalpyate |
pṛthagbhūtaṃ tutaddivyaṃ devānāṃ prītibarddhanam ||65||
ikṣuṣvivādimadhyāntaṃ śarkarāvyāpyatiṣṭhati |
pṛthagbhūtātusāmiṣṭā tathā bhāgavatīkathā ||66||
śrīmad-bhāgavataṃ nāmapurāṇaṃ rasamevahi |
bhaktijñānavirāgāṇāṃ saukhyā##vaprakāśitam ||67||
kṛṣṇenabrahmaṇenābhikaṃ jasthāyahṛdaivahi |
taccatuḥ ślokamakhilaṃ brahmaivapratibhāsate ||68||
tubhyaṃ cabrahmaṇāproktaṃ taccaritranidarśanam |
tvayāpivyāsadevāyaproktaṃ tattāpahānaye ||69||
yadīyasmaraṇātsadyonirviṇṇobādarāyaṇaḥ |
cakāramahadākhyātumātmārāmamanoharam ||70||
atratevismayaḥ kenayenapṛccheḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
śrīmad-bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ kṣamaṃ kṛṣṇānukarṣaṇe ||71||
sūta uvāca --
etan niśamya vacanaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ tu 
yogīśvaraiḥ sanaka-mukhyatamair abhīṣṭam |
bhaktyā vidhṛtya caraṇaṃ ca praṇamya mūrdhnā 
hṛṣṭo jagāda jagad-ādhi-nivarttakāṃs tān ||72||
nārada uvāca --
sandarśanaṃ ca bhavatāṃ vinihanty aghaughaṃ 
śreyas tanoti bhava-duḥkha-davārditānām |
niḥśeṣa-śeṣa-mukha-gīta-kathaika-pānāt
prema-prakāśana-kṛteśa-raṇaṃ gato vaḥ ||73||
puṇyodayena bahu-janma-samarjitena
sat-saṅgamo yadi bhavet kṛtino janasya |
ajñāna-hetu-kṛta-moha-mahāndhakāro
naśyet tadā hy udayam eti mahān vivekaḥ ||74||

paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasrayāṃ saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe -
śrī-bhāgavata-māhātmye catur-navaty-adhika-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||194|

(195)
paṣcanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ -

sūta uvāca --
atha devaṛṣis tatra kumārān anumānya ca |
uvāca praṇato vākyaṃ jñāna-yajṣa-kṛtādaraḥ ||1||
nārada uvāca --
jñāna-yajṣaṃ kariṣyāmi śuka-śāstra-kathojjvalam |
bhakti-jñāna-virāgāṇāṃ sthāpanārthe prayatnataḥ ||2||
yatra kāryo mayā yajṣaḥ sthānaṃ tat kathyatāṃ dvijāḥ |
catvāro yajṣavāhāś ca yūyam eva vṛtā mayā ||3||
kiyadbhir divasaiḥ śrāvyā śrīmad-bhāgavatī kathā |
ko vidhis tatra kartavyo jñāna-yajṣa-viśāradāḥ ||4||
kumārā ūcuḥ ---
śṛṇunāradavakṣyāmastubhyaṃ yatra kathānṛṇām |
śṛṇvatāṃ pāparāśighnobhavetpuṇyavibardvinī ||5||
gaṅgādvārasamīpetukāmadākhyaṃ puraṃ mahat ||6||
svarṇadyāścottare puṇyetaṭamānandanāmakam |
nānāṛṣigaṇairjuṣṭaṃ devasiddhaniṣevitam ||7||
nānātarulatākīrṇaṃ svacchakomalavālukam |
ramyamekāntadeśasthaṃ svarṇapaṃ kajaśobhitam ||8||
yatsamīpasthajīvānāṃ kṣetrasyaivaprabhāvataḥ |
mithaḥ saṃ snigdhacittānāṃ vairaṃ cetasinasthitam ||9||
jñānayajṣastvayā tatra karttavyohiprayatnataḥ |
apūrvarasadātrīcakathā tatra bhaviṣyati ||10||
vṛṃ dāvanapratolisthaṃ jarājīrṇakalevaram |
sutadvayaṃ puraskṛtyabhaktistatrāgamiṣyati ||11||
 yatra bhāgavatī vārtābhaktis tatra sahātmajā |
kṛṣṇakīrtisudhāṃ pītvātaruṇīvābhaviṣyati ||12||
sūta uvāca --
evamuktvākumārāstenāradenasamaṃ tataḥ |
gaṅgādvāresamājagmurjñānayajṣāyasatvarāḥ ||13||
yadāprāptāstaṭaṃ tetugaṅgāyābhārgavarṣabha |
tadākolāhalaścāsīdbhūrlokādikasaptasu ||14||
śrīmad-bhāgavatāsvādalaṃ paṭāsāptalaukikāḥ |
dhāvaṃ dhāvaṃ samājagmuḥ prācīnāvaiṣṇavāścaye ||15||
bhṛgurvasiṣṭhaścyavanaścagautamomedhātithirdebaladevarātau |
rāmas tathā gādhijaśākalaucamṛkaṇḍaputrātrijapippalādāḥ ||16||
yogeśvarauvyāsaparāśaraucaśukādayobhāgavatapradhānāḥ |
śiṣyairupetābahuśāstravijṣāḥ kṛṣṇāmṛtāsvāda kṛtaupradhānāḥ ||17||
vedāṃ tānicavedāścamaṃ trāstaṃ trāṇisaṃ hitāḥ |
daśasaptapurāṇāniṣaṭśāstrāṇi tathā yayuḥ ||18||
gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tatra puṣkarādisarāṃ sica |
kṣetrāṇicadiśaḥ sarvādaṇḍakādivanānica ||19||
himādayonagās tatra devagaṃ dharvakinnarāḥ |
dvīpāḥ samudrādikpālāḥ pātālasthās tathā yayuḥ ||20||
dīkṣāyāṃ nāradenāthadattamāsanamuttamam |
kumārāvaṃ ditāsarveniṣeduḥ kṛṣṇatatparāḥ ||21||
vaiṣṇavāḥ suviraktāścanyāsinobrahmacāriṇaḥ |
mukhyāhyagresthitā steṣāṃ puratonāradaḥ sthitaḥ ||22||
vāmabhāgemunigaṇādakṣiṇecadivaukasaḥ |
vedopaniṣado'n yatra tīrthānicabhṛgūdvaha ||23||
jayaśabdonamaḥ śabdaḥ śaṃ khaśabdas tathaiva ca |
babhūvākāśasaṃ sparśīghoṣayanvidiśodaśa ||24||
vimānānisamāruhyaprahṛṣṭānākavāsinaḥ |
kalpavṛkṣaprasūnaiścatāṃ sabhāṃ samavākiran ||25||
sūta uvāca --
evaṃ teṣuniviṣṭeṣubhṛgvādiṣu yathā rhataḥ |
śrī-bhāgavata-māhātmyam ūcire nāradāya te ||26||
kumārā ūcuḥ ---
śṛṇunāradavakṣyāmomahimānaṃ mahādbhutam |
śrīmad-bhāgavatākh yasya śāstrasyavidhipūrvakam ||27||
sadānaraiḥ sukṛtibhiḥ sevyābhāgavatīkathā |
yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇakṛtārthatvaṃ prayāṃ tite ||28||
graṃ tho'ṣṭādaśasāhasrodvādaśaskaṃ dhasaṃ yutaḥ |
parīkṣicchukasaṃ vādaḥ śrīmad-bhāgavatābhidhaḥ ||29||
tāvatsaṃ sāracakresminbhramatyajñānamohitaḥ |
yāvatkarṇagataṃ nosyācchukaśāstraṃ janasyaca ||30|
kiṃ śrutairbahubhiḥ śāstraiḥ purāṇaiḥ saṃ hitāgamaiḥ |
yadibhāgavataṃ puṃ bhirnaśrutaṃ bhaktibhāvanaiḥ ||31||
kathābhāgavatasyāpinityaṃ bhavatiyadgṛhe |
tadgṛhaṃ tīrtharūpaṃ hinṛṇāṃ pāpavināśanam ||32||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇirājasūyaśatānica |
bhāgavatyāḥ kathāyāścakalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||33||
tāvatpāpānitiṣṭhanti dehe'sminmunipuṃ gava |
yāvannaśrūyatesamyakśrīmad-bhāgavataṃ naraiḥ ||34||
nagaṅgānagayākāśīpratiṣṭhānaṃ napuṣkaraḥ |
kathāyābhāgavatyāścasamāpuṇyaphalenaca ||35||
ślokārdhaṃ śloka-pādaṃ vā nityaṃ bhāgavatodbhavam |
paṭhasva sva-mukhenāpi yadīcchasi bhava-kṣayam ||36||
vedādir veda-mātā ca pauruṣaṃ sūktam eva ca ||
trayī-bhāgavataṃ caiva dvādaśāṣṭākṣarau manū ||37||
dvādaśātmāprayāgaścakālaḥ saṃ vatsarātmakaḥ |
brāhmaṇaścāgnihotraṃ casurabhirdvādaśītithiḥ ||38||
tulasī ca vasanta-rtuḥ puruṣottama eva ca |
eteṣāṃ vastuto nāsti pṛthag bhāvo munīśvara ||39||
yaś ca bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ vyākuryād anvahaṃ dvija |
janma-koṭi-kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya naśyati nārada ||40||
śrutaṃ ca paṭhitaṃ dhyātaṃ śrīmad-bhāgavataṃ nṛbhiḥ |
dadāti muktiṃ bhaktiṃ vā tulasy-agnyoś ca sevanam ||41||
anta-kāle tu samprāpte bhayaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ |
śrīmad-bhāgavataṃ bhaktyā śṛṇuyād yaḥ sa mukti-bhāk ||42||
prauṣṭha-padyāṃ carākāyāṃ hema-siṃha-samanvitam |
alaṃ kṛtya-dvijāgryāya śrīmad-bhāgavataṃ dadet ||43||
bhakti-yukto vimānaś ca mitāśī ca jitendriyaḥ |
śrutvāditaḥ sa kṛṣṇasya sāyujyaṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||44||
ājanma-mātram api ye na śaṭhena cittaṃ 
samyaṅ niyamya bhuvi kṛṣṇa-kathā na pītā |
cāṇḍālavac ca paśuvad bata tena nītaṃ 
mithyā sva-janma-jananī bhṛśam arditā ca ||45||
yair na śrutaṃ bhāgavataṃ purāṇam
ārādhito no puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ |
mukhe hutaṃ naiva dharāmarāṇāṃ 
teṣāṃ vṛthā janma-gataṃ narāṇām ||46||
cittaṃ na yasya tu narasya hareḥ kathāyāṃ 
samprīyate durita-duṣṭam asat-prasaṅgāt |
dhik taṃ naraṃ paśu-samaṃ bhuvi bhāra-bhūtam
evaṃ vadanti munayaḥ kila pūrva-siddhāḥ ||47||
durlabhaiva kathā loke śrīmad-bhāgavatodbhavā |
koṭi-janma-samutthena puṇyenaiva tu labhyate ||48||
tena yoga-nidhe sādho śrotavyā sātvatī kathā |
pratyahaṃ niyamo nāsti dinānāṃ vastuto dvija ||49||
satyena brahmacaryeṇa yato'sya śravaṇaṃ matam |
tataḥ kalau viśeṣo hi vidhiḥ sapta-dinātmakaḥ ||50||
manasaś cājayād rogāt puṃsāṃ caivāyuṣaḥ kṣayāt |
kaler doṣa-bahutvāc ca saptāha-śravaṇaṃ matam | 51||
manaso nigrahaś caiva niyamācaraṇaṃ tathā |
kartuṃ sapta-dinaṃ śakyaṃ tato niyama-kalpanā ||52||
śraddhayā śravaṇe nityam ādyaṃ tāvad hi yat phalam |
tat phalaṃ śukadevena saptāha-śravaṇe kṛtam ||53||
yat phalaṃ nāsti tapasā na yogena samādhinā |
anāyāsena tat sarvaṃ saptāha-śravaṇāl labhet ||54||
yajṣād vratāc ca tapaso dhyānāj jṣānāc ca tīrthataḥ |
śrī-bhāgavata-saptāha-niyamo hy uttamo mataḥ ||55||
yadā kṛṣṇo bhuvaṃ tyaktvā sva-padaṃ gantum udyataḥ |
tadājṣāyoddhavo dhīmān govindaṃ vākyam abravīt ||56||
uddhava uvāca --
bhagavan bhavatā sarvaṃ deva-kāryaṃ prasādhitam |
adhunāgantum icchus tvaṃ svaṃ padaṃ tamasaḥ param ||57||
ataś cintā mamotpannā tvad-viyoga-bhiyā vibho |
tāmapākurudeveśatvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||58||
āgato'yaṃ kalirghoro'trasarve'pijanāḥ khalāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti tatonāthakiṃ vidheyaṃ tadādiśa ||59||
iyaṃ bhāravatībhūmiḥ śaraṇaṃ kiṃ prayāsyati |
tvadanyodṛśyatenātratrātāsyāyadunandana ||60||
ato'smāsudayāṃ kṛtvātiṣṭhātraivadayānidhe |
sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇāyaivatvamāvirabhavaḥ prabho ||61||
nirguṇo'pinirākāraḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥ |
tvadviyogenatebhaktāḥ kathaṃ sthāsyanti bhūtale ||62||
nirguṇopāsanekaṣṭamato'smaddhitamācara |
sūta uvāca --
ityuddhavavacaḥ śrutvācintayitvākṣaṇaṃ hariḥ ||63||
dadaubhāgavataṃ tasmaikṛpayāparayāyutaḥ |
nijantejaḥ samādhāyaśrīmad-bhāgavatedvija ||64||
datvoddhavāyabhagavānsvakīyaṃ padamāviśat |
teneyaṃ vāṅmahīmūrtirvarttateśrīhareriha ||65||
sevanātsatataṃ cāsyāḥ pāpaṃ naśyennṛṇāṃ kṣaṇāt |
saptāhaśravaṇaṃ tenakathitaṃ sarvato'dhikam ||66||
śrotāvaktāpṛcchakaścayāṃ titanmayatāṃ dvija |
duḥkhadāridryadaurbhāgyapāpaprakṣālanāyaca ||67||
kāmakrodhajayārthaṃ cakalaubhāgavataṃ kṣamam |
anyathā vaiṣṇavī māyā devānām api durjayā |
kathaṃ nivartate puṃsāṃ śrīmad-bhāgavataṃ vinā ||68||
sūta uvāca --
ity evam uktvā māhātmyaṃ śrīmad-bhāgavatasya te |
kathāṃ bhāgavatīṃ divyāṃ pravaktumupacakramuḥ ||69||
vedopaniṣadāṃ sāre śrīmad-bhāgavate dvijaiḥ |
ārabhyamāṇe tatra iva bhaktir āvirabhūt kṣaṇāt ||70||
premānvitācārutanurmudānvitausutaugṛhītvātaruṇausvadorbhyām 
śrīkṛṣṇagoiṃ vaṃ daharemurārenāthetināmānimuhurvadaṃ tī ||71||
tāmāgatāṃ bhāgavatārthabhūṣāṃ sucāruveṣāṃ dadṛśuḥ sadayāḥ |
vyatarkayaṃ ścāpi kathaṃ kutāsaukāstītisarve'pisuvismitākṣāḥ ||72||
tataḥ kumārājagaduḥkṛtārthākathārthatoniṣpatitādhuneyam |
evaṃ giraḥ sāsasutāniśamyajagādanamrābjabhuvaḥ kumārāt ||73||
bhaktir uvāca --
bhavadbhir adyaiva kṛtāsmi puṣṭā
kalau praṇaṣṭāpi kathā-rasena |
tiṣṭhāmi kutrāham abhīṣṭam ābhyāṃ 
sahāspadaṃ mahyam upādaśadhvam ||74||
sūta uvāca --
tad-vākyam ākarṇya vidheḥ kumārā
vicārya samyak praṇidhāya citte |
ucuś ca bhaktiṃ bhava-roga-hartrīṃ 
premaika-dātrīṃ hari-bhakti-bhājām ||75||
kumārā ūcuḥ |
bhakteṣu govinda-parāyaṇeṣu 
sādhuṣv atho dīna-dayā-pareṣu |
mano niyamyotpatha-sampravṛttaṃ 
kṛtvaikatānaṃ hari-pāda-padme ||76||
tato hi doṣāḥ kalijā ime tvāṃ 
draṣṭuṃ na śaktāḥ prabhavo’pi loke |
kalau tvam eka iva jagaddhitāya
bhaviṣyase nārada-sampraṇītā ||77||
sakala-bhuvana-madhye nirdhanāś cātidhanyā
nivasati hṛdi yeṣāṃ śrī-harir bhaktir ekā |
harir api nija-lokaṃ satvaraṃ saṃvihāya
praviśati hṛdi yeṣāṃ prema-sūtrāpinaddhaḥ ||78||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe -
śrī-bhāgavata-māhātmye paṣcanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||195||

(196)
ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 

sūta uvāca --
athavaiṣṇavacitteṣudṛṣṭvābhaktimalaukikīm |
nijalokaṃ parityajyabhuvamabhyagamaddhariḥ ||1||
vanamālīghanaśyāmaḥ pītavāsāḥ kirīṭadhṛk |
kāṃ cīkalāpaparyastolasanmakarakuṇḍalaḥ ||2||
tribhaṃ galalitaścārukaustubhenavirājitaḥ |
koṭimanmathalāvaṇyoharicaṃ danacarcitaḥ ||3||
paramānandacinmūrtirmadhuromuralīdharaḥ |
āviveśasvabhaktānāṃ hṛdayānyamalānica ||4||
vaikuṇṭhavāsinoyecavaiṣṇavāḥ śāntamānasāḥ |
gūḍharūpāḥ samāyātāḥ śravaṇāyahareḥ kathāḥ ||5||
tadājayajayetyuccaiḥ śabdo'bhūtkaṃ buśabdayuk |
yenāmaṅgalamatyugraṃ kalijaṃ pralayaṃ gatam ||6||
 tatra sthānāṃ janānāṃ cadṛṣṭvāgehātmavismṛtim |
nārado'dhyātmatatvajṣaḥ kumārānpraty uvācaha ||7||
nārada uvāca --
alaukiko'yaṃ mahimāmunīśvarāḥ saptāhajanyodyavilokitomayā ||8||
mūḍhāḥ śaṭhāyepaśupakṣiṇo'pitepiprayāṃ tyevagatiṃ parākhyāt |
atonṛlokenatuśāstramanyaccit tasya śudhyaibihitaṃ pavitram ||9||
aghaughavidhvaṃ sikṛtārthatāvahaṃ kalauyugedoṣanidhaukumārāḥ | kekenaśudhyanti vadaṃ tumahyaṃ saptāhajajṣenakathāmayena ||10||
kṛpālubhirlokahitobhavadbhiḥ prakāśitaṃ ko'pinavīnamārgaḥ |
kumārā ūcuḥ 
yemānavāḥ pāpakṛtaḥ suduṣṭāḥ sadādurācāraratāḥ samatsarāḥ ||11||
krodhāgnidagdhāḥ kuṭilāścakāminaḥ saptāhayajṣenahariṃ vrajanti te ||12||
satyenahīnāḥ pitṛmātṛdūṣakāstṛṣṇākulāścāśramavarṇabāhyāḥ |
yedāmbhikājīvavihiṃ sakāścasaptāhayajṣenahariṃ vrajanti te ||13||
paṣcograpāpāścchalakāriṇaścakrūrāḥ piśācāivanirdayāśca |
brahmasvapuṣṭāvyabhicāriṇaścasaptāhayajṣenahariṃ vrajanti te ||14||
kāyenavācāmanasāpipātakaṃ nityaṃ prakurvanti śaṭhāhaṭhenaye |
nīcāḥ kṛtaghnāmalinādurāśayāḥ saptāhayajṣenahariṃ vrajanti te ||15||
sūta uvāca --
athaivaṃ tuṣṭacitte'thanāradedevapūjite |
prasannāstekumārāścapunarūcuścanāradam ||16||
kumārā ūcuḥ |
atratekīrtayiṣyāmaitihāsampurātanam |
 yasya śravaṇamātreṇapāpahāniḥprajāyate ||17||
tuṃ gabhadrātaṭepūrvaṃ pattanekohalābhidhe |
varṇāśramācārayutedhanadhānyasamākule ||18||
ātmadevaitikhyātastatrāsīddvijasattamaḥ |
vedavidyāvidhiprājṣonityakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ||19||
tatpriyādhuṃ dhulīnāmanityaṃ svīyahiteratā |
svavākyasthāpanācāpisuṃ darīsukulodbhavā ||20||
pūrvakarmavipākenaprāyaśobahujalpinī |
śūrācagṛhakṛtyeṣukrūrācakalahapriyā ||21||
evaṃ nivasatos tatra daṃ patyornirapatyayoḥ |
vyatikrāntaṃ vayaścāpipaṣcāśadvarṣasaṃ mitam ||22||
athatauduḥkhitaujātaunirapatyaugṛhesthitau |
saṃ tānotpattayetābhyāṃ dattaṃ cāpidhanādikam ||23||
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃ sidattānyapi bahūnica |
naputronāpiduhitājāyatepūrvakarmaṇā ||24||
sacaikadātunirviṇṇaātmadevodvijottamaḥ |
gṛhaṃ tyaktvāgato'raṇyamānapatyenaduḥkhitaḥ ||25||
 yatra tatra bhramanbhrāṃ toduḥkhākulitamānasaḥ |
kṣutkṣāmastṛṭparītaścadaivātprāptojalāśayam ||26||
jalaṃ pītvātatastasmiṃ staḍāgesadvijottamaḥ |
vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśrityaniṣaṇṇas tatra nārada ||27||
atha tatra tadaivāgātkaścitsiddhobhramanmahīm |
jalaṃ pītvātaḍāgetuso'pi tatra ivacāgataḥ ||28||
taṃ dṛṣṭvānyāsinaṃ śāntamātmadevaudāradhīḥ |
satkṛtyotthāyatatpādaujagrāhasvaguroriva ||29||
upaviṣṭautatastaudvaukṛtapraśnauparasparam |
susnigdhamānasaubhūtvāguruśiṣyāvivāśrame ||30||
athataṃ sayatirdṛṣṭvāśvasaṃ taṃ duḥkhitāntaram |
papracchakaruṇāsiṃ dhurātmadevaṃ puraḥ sthitam ||31||
siddha uvāca --
kātecintādvijaśreṣṭhaduḥkhāyahṛdivartate |
tāṃ samācakṣvadharmajṣaparitāpapradāyinīm ||32||
tacchrutvāvacanaṃ tasya siddhasyasumahātmanaḥ |
ātmadevauvācāthasvasyaduḥkhasyakāraṇam ||33||
ātmadeva uvāca --
kiṃ bravīmimuneduḥkhaṃ saṃ citaṃ pūrvakarmaṇā |
madīyāḥ pūrvajāstoyaṃ kavoṣṇamupabhuṃ jate ||34||
maddattaṃ naivagṛhṇanti pitarodevatābalim |
tenaduḥkhenanirviṇṇaḥ prāṇāṃs tyaktumihāgataḥ ||35||
dhigjīvitaṃ prajāhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ caivadhanaṃ kulam |
pālyateyāmayādhenuḥ sā'pivaṃ dhyātvametiha ||36||
yomayāropitovṛkṣaḥ sopivaṃ dhyatvamāgataḥ |
nirbhāgyasyānapat yasya kimatojīvitename ||37||
kumārā ūcuḥ 
ity uktvā sarurodoccaistatpuroduḥkhapīḍitaḥ |
yadātadāyateścittekaruṇābhūdgarīyasī ||38||
lalāṭākṣaramālāṃ cadṛṣṭvājṣātvāsayogavān |
ātmadevaṃ dvijaṃ prājṣaḥ punarūcesavistaram ||39||
siddha uvāca
śṛṇu vipra mayā te'dya prārabdham avalokitam |
sapta-janmāvadhi-prāptiḥ putrasya na ca dṛśyate ||40||
muṣcāgrahaṃ prajā-hetor baliṣṭā karmaṇo gatiḥ |
vivekaṃ tu samāsādya sukhī bhava mahāmate ||41|
evam uktaṃ samākarṇya siddhasya dvija-sattamaḥ |
prajāśā-baddha-cittas tu siddhaṃ prāhātiduḥkhitaḥ ||42||
vipra uvāca --
vivekena bhavet kiṃ me putraṃ dehi balād api |
no cet tyajāmy ahaṃ prāṇāṃs tvad-agre śoka-mūrcchitaḥ ||43||
iti viprāgrahaṃ dṛṣṭvā prābravīt sa tapo-dhanaḥ |
santateḥ sagaro duḥkham avāpāṅgaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||44||
citraketur gataḥ kaṣṭaṃ vidhi-lekha-vimārjjanāt |
atas tvam api dharmajṣa yadi putraṃ labher api ||45||
sutenanasukhībhūyāḥ daivaṃ hibalavattaram |
ity uktvā dvijavaryāyasasiddhaḥ sādhusaṃ mataḥ ||46||
dadāvekaṃ phalaṃ tasmaiprāgraheṇasutārthine |
idaṃ phalaṃ mayātubhyaṃ dattaṃ putrāptayedvija ||47||
bhāryāyaidehiputrastebhaviṣyatinasaṃ śayaḥ |
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayādānamekabhaktaṃ tubhojanam ||48||
varṣāvadhistriyākāryaṃ tenaśuddhobhavetsutaḥ |
evamuktvāyayauyogīvipraḥ svagṛhamāgataḥ ||49||
dattvāpatnyaiphalaṃ tattusiddhoktamavadaccaha |
athasādhuṃ dhulīkrūrāsvavākyasthāpanotsukā ||50||
svasakhyaiprāhatatsarvaṃ patyoktaṃ siddhabhāṣitam |
yadyahaṃ bhakṣayecedaṃ phalaṃ siddhenacārpitam ||51||
garbhomamabhavettarhi kathaṃ cāhaṃ sahāmy aham |
svalpaṃ bhakṣyamaśaktiścagamanegṛhakarmaṇi ||52||
tiryakcedāgatogarbhotadāmemaraṇaṃ bhavet |
prasūtau dāruṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ sukumārī kathaṃ sahe |
mandayāṃ mayi sarvasvaṃ na nāndā saṃharet sadā ||53||
cintā me samanuprāptā kiṃ karomi śuci-smite |
sā tad-vacanam ākarṇya sneha-bhaṅga-bhayād dvija ||54||
evam eveti tāṃ prāha prītyā prahasitānanā |
evaṃ kutarka-yogena tat-phalaṃ naiva bhakṣitam ||55||
patyāpṛṣṭe phalaṃ bhuktaṃ bhuktaṃ ceti tayeritam |
ekadā bhaginī tasyāḥ svecchayā tad-gṛhaṃ gatā ||56||
tad-agre kathitaṃ sarvaṃ cinteyaṃ mahatī hi me |
kiṃ karomi sa-garbho'haṃ tvaṃ prabrūhi yathā tatham ||57||
sābravīn mama garbho’sti tubhyaṃ dāsye prasūtitaḥ |
tāvat-kālaṃ sa-garbheva guptā tiṣṭha gṛhe sukham ||58||
taṃ bālaṃ poṣayiṣyāmi tvad-gṛhe caiva nityadā |
phalaṃ dhenoḥ prayacchādyaparīkṣārthaṃ śubhānane ||59||
ity uktvā sāyayaugehamātmanohṛṣṭamānasā |
dhuṃ dhulyāpiyathoddiṣṭaṃ tadbhaginyā tathā kṛtam ||60||
athaprasūyasābālaṃ dhuṃ dhulyaicārpayaddrutam |
tayācakathitaṃ bhartreprasūtaḥ sukhamarbhakaḥ ||61||
lokasyasukhamutpannamātmadevaprajodayāt |
dattvādānaṃ dvijāgrebhyojātakarmacakāraca ||62||
gītavāditranirghoṣogṛhetasyātimaṅgalam |
babhūvaharṣamāpannaātmadevomahāmatiḥ ||63||
athasāprāhabharttāraṃ dugdhaṃ mestanayornahi |
pālayiṣye kathaṃ bālaṃ sadyaḥ sūtaṃ prabho'dhunā ||64||
matsvasuścaprasūtāyāmṛtobālaḥ purābhavat |
tāmānīyagṛherakṣasārbhakaṃ poṣayiṣyati ||65||
itiśrutvāvacastasyādhuṃ dhulyādvijasattamaḥ |
 tathaiva kṛtavānbhrāntarātmadevomudānvitaḥ ||66||
dhuṃ dhukārītināmāsyakṛtaṃ mātrā yathā rthataḥ |
stanyenapoṣamāpnotinityaṃ mātṛṣvasuḥ sutaḥ ||67||
trimāsenirgatecāthasādhenuḥ suṣuve'rbhakam |
sarvāṃ gasuṃ daraṃ divyaṃ nirmalaṃ kanakaprabham ||68||
dṛṣṭvāprasannastaṃ bipraḥ saṃ skārānsvayamādadhe |
taṃ didṛkṣavaāyātājanāḥ sarve'tivismitāḥ ||69||
ātmadevasyaviprasyamahābhāgyodayenaca |
dhenvābālaḥ prasūtaścadevarūpo'tikautukam ||70||
najṣātaṃ tadrahasyaṃ tukenāpividhiyogataḥ |
gokarṇaḥ taṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvāgokarṇetyevacābhyadhāt ||71||
kiyatkālenasamprāptautāruṇyaṃ tābubhāvapi |
gogakarṇaṃ paṇḍitojṣānīdhuṃ dhukārīmahākhalaḥ ||72||
snānaśaucakriyāhīnobhakṣyābhakṣīkrudhāplutaḥ |
cauraḥ sarvajanadveṣīduṣṭacāṇḍālasaṅgataḥ ||73||
krīḍatohyarbhakāndhṛtvābalātkūpenipātayet |
evaṃ veśyāprasaṅgenānayadrdavyaṃ kṣayaṃ pituḥ ||74||

gokarṇa uvāca --
asārastātasaṃ sāraduḥkhamohapradonṛṇām ||78||

mohenabaddhodīnātmālokaḥ kliśyatinān yathā ||79||

tatastadvākyamākarṇyagokarṇaṃ sadvijo'bravīt |

pitur itthaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā gokarṇo jñāna-paṇḍitaḥ |
uvāca dīnaṃ nirviṇṇaṃ pitaraṃ hṛṣṭa-mānasaḥ ||84||
gokarṇa uvāca --
māṃsāsthi-rakta-nikare sva-śarīrake'smin

jṣānī virāga-rasiko bhava-bhakti-niṣṭhaḥ ||85||
dharmaṃ bhajasva satataṃ tyaja loka-dharmān
saṃsevya sādhu-puruṣān jahi kāma-tṛṣṇām |
anyasya doṣa-guṇa-cintanam āśu muktvā

evaṃ sutokta-viditānubhavo nirīhas

nityaṃ hari-priya-janānugato mahātmā
duṣprāpam āpa ca padaṃ sa harer vanasthaḥ ||87||

śaunakādiṛṣibhyastutenaproktā yathā rthataḥ |
varīvarttipurāṇānāmuparīyaṃ nagātmane ||116||
asyāṃ saṃ lagnacittānāṃ nṛṇāman yatra noratiḥ |
jāyatemānasekṛṣṇonandasūnuścakāstica ||117||
yattupṛṣṭaṃ tvayābhadrelokanistārahetave |
śrībhāgavatamāhātmyaṃ mahyaṃ saṃ kīrttayetiha ||118||
tatsarvaṃ camayātubhyaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ gaṇapāṃ bike |
nānetihāsasahitaṃ bhaktimuktipradāyakam ||119||
yaḥ śṛṇotinarobhaktyāmāhātmyaṃ paṭhate'pica |
anumodanenavāsopilabhateparamāṃ gatim ||120||
dvijo'dhītyāpnuyādvedānkṣatriyastulabhejjayam |
dhanaṃ vaiśyas tathā śūdraḥ śrutvaivalabhategatim ||121||

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ—
kālindyāś caiva māhātmyaṃ vada sūta savistaram |
yasmai prakāśitaṃ yena tad ākhyāna-samanvitam ||1||
sūta uvāca—
ekadā pāṇḍu-tanayaḥ śuśrūṣuḥ saubhareḥ śubham |
jñānaṃ tat sthānam abhyetya natvā tam iti pṛṣṭavān ||2||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca—
brahman mārtaṇḍa-tanayā-tīra-tīrtheṣu yac chubham |
tīrthaṃ tad vada vaikuṇṭha-janma-bhūmi-parāt-param ||3||
saubharir uvāca—
ekadā tu muni-śreṣṭhau divi nārada-parvatau |
gacchantau khāṇḍavaṃ paśyan paśyataḥ sumanoharam ||4||
tatrāvatīrṇo nabhasa upaviṣṭau taṭe śubhe |
kālindyāḥ kṣaṇa-viśrāntau snātuṃ viviśatur jale ||5||
śibira uśīnaro rājā mṛgayāntau caran vane |
dṛṣṭvā tān nirgamāpekṣī niṣasāda sarit-taṭe ||6||
tau munī vidhivat snātvā paridhāyāmbarāṇi ca |
vanditau śirasā rājṣā tenopāviśatāṃ taṭe ||7||
tatrālokya suvarṇasya śibir yūpān sahasraśaḥ |
nāradaṃ garva-rahitaḥ parvataṃ ca jagāda saḥ ||8||
śibir uvāca—
kathyatāṃ muni-śārdūlau kasyemā yāga-yaṣṭayaḥ |
kenātra vihito yajṣaḥ sureṇātha nareṇa vā ||9||
muktvā kāśyādi-tīrthāni yajṣair ījye'tra kaḥ pumān |
ko viśeṣo'tra tīrthebhyas tebhyo vijñāna-sannidhiḥ ||10||
nārada uvāca—
purā hiraṇyakaśipur jitvā śakrādi-devatāḥ |
trailokya-rājyam āsādya so’kharvaṃ garvam ādade ||11||
prahlādas tasya tanayo nārāyaṇa-parāyaṇaḥ |
tasmai so’druhyatābhīkṣṇaṃ pāpātmā naṣṭa-maṅgalaḥ ||12||
tadrohād viṣṇunā sadyo nṛsiṃha-tanu-dhāriṇā |
hatvā daitya-patiṃ svarga-rājyaṃ svaḥ-pataye'rpitam ||13||
sva-padaṃ prāpya deveśo bṛhaspatim athāvadat |
mūrdhnābhivandya tat-pādau nārāyaṇa-guṇān smaran ||14||
indra uvāca—
guro nṛsiṃha-rūpeṇa hariṇā loka-dhāriṇā |
dattaṃ me devatā-rājyaṃ yaṣṭum icchāmi taṃ makhaiḥ ||15||
sthānaṃ pavitraṃ kathaya brāhmaṇāṃś caiva me guro |
na vidheyo vilambo'tra tvayā no hita-kāriṇā ||16||
bṛhaspatir uvāca—
asti te khāṇḍava-vanaṃ ramyaṃ parama-pāvanam |
ketaky-aśoka-bakula-madhu-matta-madhu-vratam ||17||
tatrāsti yamunā puṇyā dhanyā trailokya-pāvanī |
dadāti smaraṇe svargaṃ maraṇe brahmaṇaḥ padam ||18||
tat-tīre yaja deveśa keśavaṃ bahubhir makhaiḥ |
yadīcchasi svakīyānāṃ kalyāṇaṃ tvaṃ nirantaram ||19||
nārada uvāca—
guror vacanam ākarṇya tūrṇam āruhya vāhanam |
śiva-pradam imaṃ śakraḥ svakīya-vanam āgamat ||20||
guruṇā saha devaiś ca yajṣopakaraṇais tathā |
atrāgatya vilokyaitad vanaṃ lebhe mudaṃ parām ||21||
guruṇānoditaḥ śakro saptarṣīn brahmaṇaḥ sutān |
vasiṣṭhādīn dvijān avṛtvā yajati sma jagat-patim ||22||
tasya prasanno bhagavān brahmeśābhyāṃ sahāgataḥ |
kratau śatakrator yatra mahān abhavad utsavaḥ ||23||
devatrayīṃ satāṃ vīkṣya śakro vakra-matis tadā |
utthāyāsanatas tūrṇaṃ vavande munibhiḥ saha ||24||
vāhanebhyo'varuhyāśu tad-anteṣūpaviśyate |
āsaneṣu suhaimeṣu babhur vedīṣv ivāgnayaḥ ||25||
sita-raktāṅgayoḥ śambhu-brahmaṇor harir ābabhau |
nīla-cchaviḥ pīta-vāsās taḍitvān iva śṛṅgayoḥ ||26||
śakraḥ prakṣālya tat-pādān mūrdhnā taj-jalam ādadhe |
abravīc ca mudā yukto vacanaṃ madhurākṣaram ||27||
indra uvāca—
vihito'yaṃ mayā deva-yajṣo'dya saphalo'bhavat ||28||
yady ayaṃ darśanaṃ prāptā durlakṣyā api yogibhiḥ |
ekenaiva tvayā viṣṇo kṛtā mūrtis trayī-mayī ||29||
guṇais tathāpi nānātvaṃ sphaṭikasyeva te mṛṣā |
yathā dāruṣu gūḍho'gnir gharṣaṇena vinā vibho ||30||
nāvirbhavati bhūtānāṃ hṛt-subhaktyā tathā bhavān |
ekasya tvayi bhaktiḥ syāt sarva-bhūtopakāriṇī ||31||
babhūvuḥ sukhinodevāḥ prahlādakṛtayātayā|
vayaṃ viṣayiṇodevatvanmāyāvṛtacetasaḥ ||32||
najānīmaḥ svarūpaṃ te yathā vatpādasevakāḥ |
bhobrahmanbho mahādevayuvāmapijagadgurū ||33||
e tasya ivagurutvenayatonātaḥ pṛthakyuvām |
yatiṃ kaṃ ciducyatevācāmanasācavicintyate |
asyaivamāyātatsarvegaddvayīdūravartinaḥ ||34||
prapaṣcajātaṃ yadidaṃ vilokyatenasatyamityevavicintayennasaḥ |
bhajanti viṣṇoścaraṇantar- anti teyadaṃ bumūrdhnāharadhāryatetvayā ||35||
vidhesyabhūyādanujanmapādayoratirmadīyākamalābhayorbhṛśam yadīkṣaṇakṣobhitayātayājagatsamastametanmahadādijāyate ||36||
bhavādṛśonāstikṛpāparoparovipakṣapakṣevitanoṣiyatsukham |
svalokaśokāpanayekṛpālutāyaducyatetenṛharetadajṣatā ||37||
nārada uvāca—
ity abhiṣṭūya deveśaṃ keśavaṃ praṇato'grataḥ |
tasthautadvākyaśuśruṣādattacittomahīyate ||38||
evamākarṇyamunayastutiṃ tasya ramāpateḥ |
kṛtāmindreṇasadasisādhusādhviticābruvan ||39||
śatamanyovarṣaśataṃ ye kurvanti mahattapaḥ |
nateṣāmīdṛśībhaktiryādṛśītavamādhave ||40||
nayogaḥ sulabhoṣṭāṃ gaḥ khyātiryenādhigamyate |
samatvenacatattyāgastadbhaktiḥ śaraṇaṃ nṛṇām ||41||
svadharmārjitavittairyad yathā vidhividhīyate |
karmatasyārpaṇaṃ viṣṇaubhaktireṣāśivapradāḥ ||42||
nanindeddevatāmanyāṃ viṣṇubuddhyāṃ cayonamet |
natyajedvedavākyānisabhakto'sya hareḥ priyaḥ ||43||
yeśṛṇvanti harerguṇānaharahaḥ kurvanti yekīrtanaṃ yecāsyasmararṇaṃ yadoścabhajanaṃ ye'muṃ jayaṃ te tathā ||44||
yedāsyenanamanti cainamamunākurvanti yemitratāṃ yecasvaṃ canivedayanti nahitevāṃ cchanti muktyādikam ||45||
indrabhaktyātvamapyenamārādhayajagadgurum |
nakāmayekimapyāsmatkṛtakṛtyobhaviṣyati ||46||
nārada uvāca—
munibhiritiśikṣitesamastasevyāṃ tribhuvanapārapadapradāṃ niśamya |
hariraniśaguruḥ kṛtāṃ svabhaktiṃ madhuram uvācavacohariṃ samāje ||47||

vicintyamānaṃ hṛdiyogivṛndaiḥ kaṃ daṃ parānandabhuvovimukteḥ ||38||
prāptāḥ kāmaṃ śrīpate tvat-svarūpaṃ śrīvatsādyair lakṣitaṃ cāru-cihnaiḥ |
vāṃ cchāmas te dāsa-bhāvaṃ tathāpi prāptaṃ sarvair ādṛtaṃ nāradādyaiḥ ||39||
yat saukhyaṃ te dāsa-bhāvaṃ gatānāṃ tan no lakṣmyā vakṣaso’ntar-vasantyāḥ |
taj jānāti śrīpate śrī-maheśo nānyo lokeyena tac cānubhūtam ||40||
madhye'smākaṃ śrīpate sevakānāṃ nīrāgāṇām apy asaumānanīyaḥ |
asmāt taṃ tenāradādyāmunīśās tvad-bhaktāptair lokanāthaṃ bhajante ||41||
kāmaṃ brahmānandamāsotarātmātvaddāsyenotṛptimāyātiśambhuḥ |
vāraṃ vāraṃ tvadguṇānāgrahītuṃ nṛtyatyuccaistvatparobhāvayuktaḥ ||42||
hetorasmāddehinaḥ svasyadāsyaṃ yatprāptānāṃ normayaḥ sambhavanti |
tvaccihnāṃ gaudvārapālautadīyaumohāddhāmaprāpyatautatsvakīyam ||43||
lokādasmādantar- eṇatvadicchātvallokānāṃ nodyatecāśupātaḥ |
kojānīyāttāvakīmatramāyāṃ duvijṣeyāṃ brahmaśarvādidevaiḥ ||44||
nārada uvāca—
evaṃ taiḥ stūyamānaḥ saprabhurnijapadonmukhaḥ |
 uvācatāndākṣiṇātyānmeghagambhīrayāgirā ||45||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
bho bho dvijābhavanto 'syāḥ kośalāyāḥ prasādataḥ |
sārūpyamapimeprāptādāsabhāvaṃ cayāsyatha ||46||
adyaprabhṛtimeviprāstīrthametadanuttamam |
dakṣiṇakośaletyuccairnāmnākhyātaṃ bhaviṣyati ||47||

sākathyatemunivaraiḥ sarvairuttarakośalā ||48||
vipannojñānavānyasyāvaikuṇṭhamadhirohati |
vināpitadvasedyo'syāṃ so'pisvargaṃ cagacchati ||49||
imāntatodaśaguṇāmāhurdakṣiṇakośalām |
ekādaśaguṇāmekesamyagāhurmunīśvarāḥ ||50||
iyānevaviśeṣo’sti tasyāasyāmatirmama |
tasyāṃ mṛtaṃ nayaṃ tyetevaikuṇṭhaṃ māmakāgaṇāḥ ||51||
asyāṃ mṛtaṃ svayamahamananyavadamānasam |
āropyagaruḍaṃ dattvāsārūpyaṃ prāpayāmitat ||52||
nārada uvāca—
ity uktvā tāndvijānviṣṇurnītvāvaikuṇṭhamabhyagāt |
mahimānaṃ stuvann asya svayaṃ tīrthasya bhūpate ||53||
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagatīpate |
yeneyaṃ kathyate vijṣair iha dakṣiṇa-kośalā ||54||
kali-mala-kula-hantā śṛṇvatāṃ mānavānāṃ 
kamala-nayana-pāda-prāptayevāṃ cchitaś ca |
nṛpa-vara-mahimā te varṇitaḥ kośalāyā
madhu-vana-bhava-vṛttaṃ śṛṇvatas te vadāmi ||55||

kālindī-māhātmye kośalā-mahimā-varṇanaṃ nāma 
dvādaśādhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

śaṅkara uvāca—
ūrdhva-puṇḍrasya māhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi śubha-darśane |
dhāraṇād eva mucyeta bhava-bandhād dvijottamaḥ ||1||
ūrdhva-puṇḍrasya madhye tu viśāle sumanohare |
lakṣmyā sārdhaṃ samāsīno deva-devo janārdanaḥ ||2|| 
tasmād yasya śarīre tu ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ dhṛto bhavet |
tasya dehaṃ bhagavato vimalaṃ mandiraṃ śubham ||3||
sa snātaḥ sarva-tīrtheṣu sarva-yajṣeṣu dīkṣitaḥ |
dhārayed vordhva-puṇḍraṃ yo mṛdā śubhreṇa vaiṣṇavaḥ ||4||
ūrdhva-puṇḍra-dharo vipraḥ sarva-lokeṣu pūjitaḥ |
vimāna-varam āruhya yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||5||
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tu trisandhyaṃ tu dvijottamaḥ |
sarva-pāpa-viśuddhy-artham iṣṭāpūrta-phalāptaye ||6||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ dharaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate |
namaskṛtvāthavā bhaktyā sarva-dāna-phalaṃ labhet ||7||
ūrdhva-puṇḍra-dharaṃ vipraṃ yaḥ śrāddhe bhojayiṣyati |
ākalpa-koṭi-pitaras tasya tṛptā na saṃśayaḥ ||8||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ dharo yas tu kuryāc chrāddhaṃ śubhānane |
kalpa-koṭi-sahasrāṇi gayā-śrāddha-phalaṃ labhet ||9||
yajṣa-dāna-tapaś-caryā-japa-homādikaṃ ca yat |
ūrdhva-puṇḍra-dharaḥ kuryāt tasya puṇyam anantakam ||10||
ūrdhva-puṇḍra-vihīnas tu kiṃcit karma karoti yaḥ |
iṣṭāpūrtādikaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ syān na saṃśayaḥ ||11||
yac charīraṃ manuṣyāṇām ūrdhva-puṇḍra-vivarjitam |
draṣṭavyaṃ naiva tat kaṃcit śmaśāna-sadṛśaṃ bhavet ||12||
ūrdhva-puṇḍra-vihīnas tu sandhyā-karmādikaṃ ca yat |
tat sarvaṃ rākṣasair nītaṃ narakaṃ cāvagacchati ||13||
ūrdhva-puṇḍra-dharo vipro mṛdā śubhreṇa vaidikaḥ |
na tiryag dhārayed vidvān āpady api kadācana ||14||
viprāṇām ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ syāt tilakaṃ tu mahī-bhṛtaḥ |
paṭṭākāraṃ tu vaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ vai tri-puṇḍrakam ||15||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ mṛdā kāryaṃ kastūryās tilakaṃ tathā |
paṭṭākāraṃ tu gandhena bhasmanaiva tripuṇḍrakam ||16||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tu sarveṣāṃ na niṣiddhaṃ kadācana |
dhāreyet kṣatriyād yo'pi viṣṇu-bhakto bhaved yadi ||17||
viprāṇāṃ naiva kāryaṃ syāt tiryak-paṭṭādi-dhāraṇam |
nārāyaṇāt pareśānād anyeṣām arcanaṃ na tu ||18||
brāhmaṇaḥ kulajo vidvān bhasma-dhārī bhaved yadi |
varjayet tādṛśaṃ devi madyocchiṣṭaṃ ghaṭaṃ yathā ||19||
tri-puṇḍraṃ śūdra-kalpānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca vidhis tathā |
tri-puṇḍra-dhāraṇād vipraḥ patitaḥ syān na saṃśayaḥ ||20||
ekāntino mahā-bhāgāḥ sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ |
sāntarālaṃ prakurvīran puṇḍraṃ hari-padākṛtim ||21||
hareḥ pādākṛtiṃ kuryād ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ vidhānataḥ |
madhya-cchidreṇa saṃyuktaṃ tad dhi vai mandiraṃ hareḥ ||22||
ūrdhva-puṇḍram ṛjuṃ saumyaṃ supārśvaṃ sumanoharam |
daṇḍākāraṃ suśobhāḍhyaṃ madhye cchidraṃ prakalpayet ||23||
tasmāc chidrānvitaṃ puṇḍraṃ daṇḍākāraṃ suśobhanam |
viprāṇāṃ satataṃ kāryaṃ strīṇāṃ ca śubha-darśane |24||
ūrdhva-puṇḍrasya madhye tu viśāle sumanohare |
sāntarāle samāsīno harir asti śriyā saha ||25||
nirantarālaṃ yaḥ kuryād ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ dvijādhamaḥ |
sa hi tatra sthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ śriyaṃ caiva vyapohati ||26||
acchidram ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tu ye kurvanti dvijādhamāḥ |
teṣāṃ lalāṭe satataṃ śunaḥ pādo na saṃśayaḥ ||27||
tasmāc chidrānvitaṃ puṇḍraṃ sa-haridraṃ śubhānvitam |
dhārayed brāhmaṇo nityaṃ hari-sālokya-siddhaye ||28||
ādāya parayā bhaktyā veṅkaṭādrau hṛde mṛdam |
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrāṇi hari-sāyujya-siddhaye ||29||
śrī-kṛṣṇa-tulasī-mūle mṛdam ādāya bhaktimān |
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrāṇi haris tatra prasīdati ||30||
dvāravatyāṃ śubhe ramye vāsudeva-hrade tathā |
tatrodbhavāṃ mṛdaṃ ramyām ādāya dvija-sattamaḥ ||31||
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrāṇi sarva-kāma-phalāptaye |
ādāya parayā bhaktyā gaṅgā-tīrodbhavāṃ mṛdam ||32||
tathā dhṛtordhva-puṇḍrāṇi sarva-yajṣa-phalaṃ labhet |
candanaṃ ca haridrāṃ ca tathā bhasmāgnihotrajam ||33||
sarva-vaśya-karaṃ proktam ūrdhva-puṇḍrasya dhāraṇāt |
yatra puṇyaṃ hari-kṣetraṃ tatra vai mṛdam āharet ||34||
parvatāgre nadī-tīre bilva-mūle jalāśaye |
sindhu-tīre ca valmīke hari-kṣetre viśeṣataḥ ||35||
viṣṇoḥ snānodakaṃ yatra pravāhayati nityaśaḥ |
puṇḍrāṇāṃ dhāraṇārthāya gṛhṇīyāt tatra mṛttikām ||36||
śrī-raṅge veṅkaṭādrau ca śrī-kūrme dvārake śubhe |
prayāge nārasiṃhādrau vārāhe tu lasī-vane ||37||
gṛhītvā mṛttikāṃ bhaktyā viṣṇu-pāda-jalaiḥ saha |
dhṛtvā puṇḍrāṇi cāṅgeṣu viṣṇu-sāyujyam āpnuyāt ||38||
yasmin kasmin mahā-bhāgā vaiṣṇavā dhārayanti vai |
tasmin vai mṛttikā grāhyā ūrdhva-puṇḍrasya dhāraṇe ||39||
śyāmaṃ śānti-karaṃ proktaṃ raktaṃ vaśya-karaṃ tathā |
śrī-karaṃ pītam ity āhuḥ śvetaṃ mokṣa-karaṃ śubham ||40||
vartulaṃ tiryag achidraṃ hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ tataṃ tanum |
vakraṃ virūpaṃ baddhāgraṃ chinna-mūlaṃ pada-cyutam ||41||
aśubhaṃ rūkṣam āsaktaṃ tathā nāṅguli-kalpitam |
vigandham avasahyaṃ ca puṇḍram āhur anarthakam ||42||
ārabhya nāsikā-mūlaṃ lalāṭāntaṃ likhen mṛdā |
samārabhya bhruvor madhyam antarālaṃ prakalpayet ||43||
antarālaṃ dvy-aṅgulaṃ syāt pārśvāv aṅguli-mātrakau |
mṛdā śubhreṇa vilikheta puṇḍram ṛjutaraṃ śubham ||44||
lalāṭe keśavaṃ dhyāyen nārāyaṇam athodare |
vakṣaḥ-sthale mādhavaṃ ca govindaṃ kaṇṭha-kūpake ||45||
viṣṇuṃ ca dakṣiṇe kukṣau bāhau ca madhusūdanam |
trivikramaṃ kandhare tu vāmanaṃ vāma-pārśvake ||46||
śrīdharaṃ bāhuke vāme hṛṣīkeśaṃ tu kandhare |
pṛṣṭhe vai padmanābhaṃ ca kaṭyāṃ dāmodaraṃ nyaset ||47||
tat-prakṣālana-toyena vāsudevaṃ tu mūrdhani |
lalāṭe bhuja-yugme tu pṛṣṭhayoḥ kaṇṭha-kūpake ||48||
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tu catur-aṅgula-mātrataḥ |
kukṣau tat-pārśvayoḥ proktam āyataṃ tu daśāṅgulam ||49||
bāhvor vakṣaḥ-sthale puṇḍraṃ maṣṭāṅgulam udāhṛtam |
evaṃ dvādaśa-puṇḍrāṇi brāhmaṇaḥ satataṃ dharet ||50||
tat-tat-puṇḍrāṇi tan-mūrtīr dhyātvā mantreṇa dhārayet |
antarāleṣu sarveṣu haridrāṃ dhārayec chriyām ||51||
catvāri bhū-bhṛtām āhuḥ puṇḍrāṇi dve viśāṃ smṛte |
eka-puṇḍraṃ tu nārīṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca vidhīyate ||52||
lalāṭe hṛdi bāhvoś ca catuḥ-puṇḍrāṇi dhārayet |
lalāṭe hṛdaye dve tu phāle tv ekaṃ vidhīyate ||53||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ lalāṭe tu sarveṣāṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam |
lalāṭādi-krameṇaiva dhāraṇaṃ tu vidhīyate ||54||
mūrtīs tu vāsudevādyāś catuḥ-puṇḍreṣu dhārayet |
dvayor govinda-kṛṣṇau tu ekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dharet ||55||
evaṃ puṇḍra-vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarveṣāṃ girije mayā |
aśvattha-patra-saṅkāśo veṇu-patrākṛtis tathā ||56||
padma-kuḍmala-saṅkāśo mohanaṃ tritayaṃ smṛtam |
mahā-bhāgavataḥ śuddhaḥ puṇḍraṃ hari-padākṛtim ||57||
daṇḍākāraṃ tu vā devi dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrakam ||58||
sudarśanenāṅkita-bāhu-mūlās
tathordhva-puṇḍrāṅkita-sarva-gātrāḥ |
mālāravindākṣa-dharā viśuddhā 
rakṣanti lokān duritaugha-saṅgāt ||59||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe umā-maheśvara-saṃvāde ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ māhātmyaṃ nāma paṣcaviṃśaty-adhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 
||225||

(226)
ṣaḍviṃśaty-adhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 

śaṅkara uvāca—
nyāse vāpy arcane vāpi mantram ekāntinaḥ śrayet |
avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭena mantreṇa na parā gatiḥ ||1||
avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭaṃ cet pūrva-mantra-varaṃ dvayam |
punaś ca vidhinā samyak vaiṣṇavād grāhayed guroḥ ||2||
sahasra-śākhādhyāyī vā sarva-yajṣeṣu dīkṣitaḥ |
kule mahati jāto'pi na guruḥ syād avaiṣṇavaḥ ||3||
yas tu mantra-dvayaṃ samyag adhyāpayati vaiṣṇavaḥ |
sa ācāryas tu vijṣeyo bhava-bandha-vidārakaḥ ||4||
ācāryaṃ saṃśrayitvātha vatsaraṃ sevayed dvijaḥ |
tasya vṛtti-parijṣātvā mantram adhyāpayed guruḥ ||5||
kṛtvā tāpādi-saṃskārān paścān mantram udīrayet |
tāpaṃ puṇḍraṃ tathā nāma kṛtvā vai vidhinā guruḥ ||6||
paścād adhyāpayen mantraṃ śiṣyaṃ nirmala-cetasam |
cakreṇa vidhinā taptaṃ tāpa ity abhidhīyate ||7||
puṇḍram ūrdhvaṃ tathā proktaṃ nāma vaiṣṇavam ucyate |
tato mantraṃ vidhānena śiṣyam adhyāpayed guruḥ ||8||
nyāsam aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantram anyaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ manum |
nyāsam evātra paramaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhānane ||9||
tasmāt tu nyāsam evaiṣām atiriktam ihocyate |
nyāsa-vidyā-paro yas tu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate ||10||
nyāsāt parataraṃ nāsti mantraṃ satyaṃ bravīmi te ||
nyāsaṃ dvayaṃ prapattiḥ syāt paryāyeṇa nibodha me ||11||
dvayopadeśa-pūrvaṃ tu sarva-karma samācaret |
dvayādhikārī na bhavet sarva-karmasu nārhati ||12||
tasmād vayam adhītyeva paścān mantram anuttamam |
śrīmad-aṣṭākṣaraṃ samyag abhyased dvija-sattamaḥ ||13||
mantram aṣṭākṣaraṃ proktaṃ praṇavasyaiva saṅgrahāt |
naisarga-praṇavādyaṃ tu mantrem ity ucyate budhaiḥ ||14||
nānyatra sarva-mantreṣu praṇava-sva-svabhāvataḥ |
pūrvaṃ tu sarva-mantrāṇāṃ yojayet praṇavaṃ śubham ||15||
oṅkāraḥ praṇavaṃ brahma sarva-mantreṣu nāyakaḥ |
ādau sarvatra yuṣjīta mantrāṇāṃ tu śubhānane ||16||
svabhāvāt praṇavan tasmin mūla-mantre pratiṣṭhitam |
om ity ekākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ dvyakṣaraṃ nama ity atha ||17||
tato nārāyaṇāyeti paṣcārṇāni yathā kramam |
evam aṣṭākṣaro mantro jṣeyaḥ sarvārtha-sādhakaḥ ||18||
sarva-duḥkha-haraḥ śrīmān sarva-mantrātmakaḥ śubhaḥ |
ṛṣir nārāyaṇas tasya devatā śrīśa eva ca ||19||
chandas tu devī gāyatrī praṇavo bījam ucyate |
nityānapāyinī devī śaktiḥ śrīr ucyate manoḥ ||20||
prathamaṃ padam oṅkāro dvitīyaṃ nama ucyate |
tṛtīyaṃ nārāyaṇāyeti pada-trayam udāhṛtam ||21||
akāraś cāpy u-kāraś ca ma-kāraś ca tataḥ param |
veda-trayātmakaṃ proktaṃ praṇavaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam ||22||
a-kāreṇocyate viṣṇuḥ śrīr ukāreṇa cocyate |
ma-kāras tv anayor dāsaḥ paṣcaviṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||23||
vāsudevasvarūpaṃ tadakāreṇocyataibudhaiḥ |
ukāreṇaśriyodevyārūpaṃ munibhir ucyate ||24||
ma-kāreṇocyate jīvaḥ paṣcaviṃ śoditaḥ pumān |
bhūtāni ca ka-vargeṇa ca-vargeṇendriyāṇi ca ||25||
ṭa-vargeṇa ta-vargeṇa jñānaṃ dhādayas tathā |
manaḥ pa-kāreṇaivoktaṃ pha-kāreṇa tv ahaṅkṛtiḥ ||26||
ba-kāreṇa bha-kāreṇa mahān prakṛtir ucyate |
ātmā tu sa ma-kāraḥ syāt paṣcaviṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||27||
dehendriya-manaḥ prāṇādibhyo’nyo’nanya-sādhanaḥ |
bhagavac-cheṣa-bhūto'sau ma-kārākhyaḥ sa-cetanaḥ ||28||
avadhāraṇa-vācy evam u-kāraḥ kaiścid ucyate |
śrīś ca tat-pakṣa-pātitvād a-kāreṇaiva cocyate ||29||
bhāskarasya prabhā yadvat tasya nityānapāyinī | 
ā-kāreṇocyate viṣṇuḥ kalyāṇa-guṇa-sāgaraḥ ||30||
śrīśaḥ sarvātmanāṃ śeṣo jagad-bījaṃ paraḥ pumān |
jagat-kartā jagad-bhartā īśvaro loka-bāndhavaḥ ||31||
jagatām īśvarī nityā viṣṇor anapagāminī |
mātā sarvasya jagataḥ patnī-viṣṇor manoramā ||32||
jagad-ādhāra-bhūtā śrīr u-kāreṇātra cocyate |
ma-kāreṇa tayor dāsaḥ kṣetrajṣaḥ procyate budhaiḥ ||33||
jṣānāśramo jñāna-guṇaś cetanaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ |
na jaḍo nirvikāraś ca eka-rūpa-svarūpa-bhāk ||34||
aṇur nityo vyāpti-śīlaś cid-ānandātmakas tathā |
aham artho'vyayaḥ kṣetrī bhinna-rūpaṃ sanātanaḥ ||35||
adāhyo’cchedyo hy aklaidyas tv aśoṣyo’kṣara eva ca |
evam ādi-guṇopetaḥ śeṣa-bhūtaḥ parasya vai ||36||
ma-kāreṇocyate jīvaḥ kṣetrajṣaḥ paravān sadā |
dāsa-bhūto harer eva nānyasya tu kadācana ||37||
evaṃ dāsatvam evāsya madhyame vāvadhāryate |
ity evaṃ praṇavasyārtho jṣātavyokto mayānaghe ||38||
vivṛtiḥ praṇavasyārtha-mantra-śeṣeṇa vai śubhe |
parasya dāsa-bhūtasya svātantryaṃ neha vidyate ||39||
tasmān mahad ahaṃ kārau manasā vinivartayet |
svopāya-buddhyā yat kṛtyaṃ tad api pratiṣidhyate ||40|
ahaṅkṛtir ma-kāraḥ syān na-kāras tan-niṣedhakaḥ |
tasmāt tu namasaiva syād ahaṅkāra-vimocanam ||41||
namasā sarva-siddhiḥ syād anyathā nāśam āpnuyāt |
namasā sahitaṃ kiṃcit tad ahaṅkāra ucyate ||42||
ahaṅkāreṇa yuktasya sukhaṃ kiṃcin na vidyate |
ahaṅkāra-vimūḍhātmā andhe tamasi majjati ||43||
tasmāt tu namasā cātra svātantryaṃ pratiṣidhyate |
bhagavat-para-tantro'sau tadā yattaś ca jīvati ||44||
tasmāt sādhana-kartṛtvaṃ cetanasya na vidyate |
īśvarasyaiva saṅkalpād vartate sva-carācaram ||45||
tasmāt sva-sāmarthya-vidhiṃ tyajet sarvam aśeṣataḥ |
īśvarasya tu sāmarthyān nālabhyaṃ tasya vidyate ||46||
tasmin nyasta-bhavaḥ śete tat-karmaiva samācaret |
paramātmāhariḥ svāmīsvamahaṃ tasya sarvadā ||47||
icchāyāviniyoktavyas tasya ivātmeśvarasyahi |
ityevaṃ manasātyaktamahaṃ tāmamatorjitam ||48||
deheṣvahaṃ matirmūlaṃ saṃ sṛtaukarmabandhane |
tasmānmahadahaṃ kāraumanasāvarjayed budhaḥ ||49||
athanārāyaṇapadaṃ vakṣyāmigirajeśubhe |
nārāityātmanāṃ saṅghāsteṣāṃ gatirasaupumān ||50||
taevacāyanaṃ tasya tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
sarvaṃ hicidacidvastuśrūyatedṛśyatejagat ||51||
yo’sau vyāpyasthito nityaṃ savainārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nārāścetisarvapuṃ sāṃ samūhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||52||
gatirālaṃ banaṃ teṣāntasmānnārayaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
narājjātānitatvāninārāṇītividurbudhāḥ ||53||
tānyevacāyanaṃ tasya tenanārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kalpāṃ tepijagatkṛtsnaṃ grasitvāyenadhāryate ||54||
punaḥ saṃ sṛjyateyenasavainārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
carācaraṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ nāraity abhi dhīyate ||55||
 tasya vāsaṅgatiryenatenanārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
nāronarāṇāṃ saṅghātastasyāsāvayanaṃ gatiḥ ||56||
tenāsaumunibhirnityaṃ nārāyaṇaitīritaḥ |
prabhavantiyatolokāmahābdhaupṛthuphenavat ||57||
punaryasmātpralīyantetasmānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
yovainityapadenityonityamuktaikabhogavān ||58||
īśaḥ sarvasyajagataḥ savainārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahmatatvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ param ||59||
yaccakiṃ cijjagat yasmin dṛśyateśrūyate'pivā |
antar- baṃ hiścatatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ ||60||
apahatapāpmāpuruṣaḥ sarva-bhūtāntarasthitaḥ |
divyaekaḥ sadānityoharirnārāyaṇo'cyutaḥ ||61||
yastudraṣṭācadraṣṭavyaṃ śrotāśrotavyam eva ca |
sapraṣṭācasparśitavyaścadhyātādhyātavyam eva ca ||62||
vaktācavācyaṃ jṣātācajṣātavyaṃ cidacijjagat |
taccasarvaṃ hariḥ śrīśonārāyaṇaudāhṛtaḥ ||63||
sahasraśīrṣāpuruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
salokānsarvatovyāpyaatyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam ||64||
yadbhūtaṃ yaccabhavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ nārāyaṇohariḥ |
utāmṛtatvasyeśānoyadannenavirāṭpumān ||65||
sa eva puruṣoviṣṇurvāsudevo'cyutohariḥ |
hiraṇmayo'thabhagavānso'mṛtaḥ śāśvataḥ śivaḥ ||66||
patirviśvasyajagataḥ sarvalokeśvaraṃ prabhuḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhāḥ savitāananto 'saumaheśvaraḥ ||67||
bhagavānitiśabdo'yaṃ tathā puruṣaity api |
vartatenirupādhiścavāsudevo'khilātmani ||68||
īśvarobhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramātmājagatsuhṛt | 
śāstācarācarasyaikoyatīnāṃ paramāgatiḥ ||69||
yovedādausvaraḥ proktovedāṃ tecapratiṣṭhitaḥ |
 tasya prakṛtilīnasyayaḥ paraḥ samaheśvaraḥ ||70||
yosāvakārovaiviṣṇuryo’sau nārāyaṇohariḥ |
sa eva puruṣonityaḥ paramātmāmaheśvaraḥ ||71||
yasmādudbhūtamaiśvaryaṃ yasmin kasiṃ maścavartate |
 tasmin nīśvaraśabdo'piprocyate munibhis tathā |
nirupādhīśvaratvaṃ hivāsuṃ devepratiṣṭhitam ||72||
ātmeśvaraiti proktovedavādaiḥ sanātanaiḥ |
tasmānmaheśvaratvaṃ tu vāsudevepratiṣṭhitam ||73||
asautripādvibhūtestulīlayāapiceśvaraḥ |

 tasya dāsyaṃ caturthyānumantreproktaṃ tu pārvati ||91||

natubhuktiṃ cabhaktiṃ canacamuktiṃ varānane ||93||

mahādeva uvāca—
devatānāṃ hitārthāyavṛttiṃ pākhaṇḍināṃ śubhe |

evaṃ devahitārthāyavṛttirmedevigarhitā |
