pārvaty uvāca—
tāmasāni ca śāstrāṇi samācakṣva mamānagha |
samproktāni ca tair viprair bhagavad-bhakti-varjitaiḥ |
teṣāṃ nāmānikramaśaḥ samācakṣvasureśvara ||1||
rudra uvāca—
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tāmasāni yathā kramam ||2||
teṣāṃ smaraṇa-mātreṇa mohaḥ syāj jṣāninām api |
prathamaṃ hi mayaivoktaṃ śaivaṃ pāśupatādikam ||3||
mac-chaktyā veśitair vipraiḥ proktāni ca tataḥ śṛṇu |
kaṇādena tu samproktaṃ śāstraṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ mahat ||4||
gautamena tathā nyāyaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ tu kapilena vai |
dhiṣaṇena tathā proktaṃ cārvāka-mati-garhitam ||5||
daityānāṃ nāśanārthāya viṣṇunā buddha-rūpiṇā |
bauddha-śāstram asat-proktaṃ nagna-nīla-paṭādikam ||6||
māyāvādam asac-chāstraṃ pracchannaṃ bauddham ucyate |
mayaiva kathitaṃ devi kalau brāhmaṇa-rūpiṇā ||7||
apārthaṃ śruti-vākyānāṃ darśayan loka-garhitam |
svakarma-rūpaṃ tyājya tvam atraiva pratipādyate ||8||
sarva-karma-paribhraṣṭair vaidharmatvaṃ tad ucyate |
pareśa-jīva-pāraikyaṃ mayā tu pratipādyate ||9||
brahmaṇo’sya svayaṃ rūpaṃ nirguṇaṃ vakṣyate mayā |
sarvasya jagato'py atra mohanārthaṃ kalau yuge ||10||
vedārthavan mahā-śāstraṃ māyayā yad avaidikam |
mayaiva kalpitaṃ devi jagatāṃ nāśa-kāraṇāt ||11||
mad-ājṣayā jaimininā pūrvaṃ vedam apārthakam |
nirīśvareṇa vādena kṛtaṃ śāstraṃ mahattaram ||12||
śāstrāṇi caiva girije tāmasāni nibodha me |
purāṇāni ca vakṣyāmi tāmasāni yathā kramāt ||13||
brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā |
tathaiva nāradīyaṃ tu mārkaṇḍeyaṃ tu saptamam ||14||
āgneyam aṣṭamaṃ proktaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ navamaṃ tathā |
daśamaṃ brahma-vaivartaṃ liṅgam ekādaśaṃ smṛtam ||15||
dvādaśaṃ ca varāhaṃ ca vāmanaṃ ca trayodaśam |
kaurmaṃ caturdaśaṃ proktaṃ mātsyaṃ paṣcadaśaṃ smṛtam ||16||
ṣoḍaśaṃ gāruḍaṃ proktaṃ skandaṃ saptadaśaṃ smṛtam |
aṣṭādaśaṃ tu brahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇāni yathā kramam ||17||
mātsyaṃ kaurmaṃ tathā laiṅgaṃ śaivaṃ skāndantathaiva ca |
āgneyaṃ ca ṣaḍ etāni tāmasāni nibodha me ||18||
vaiṣṇavaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca tathā bhāgavataṃ śubham |
gāruḍaṃ ca tathā pādmaṃ vārāhaṃ śubha-darśane ||19||
sāttvikāni purāṇāni vijṣeyāni śubhāni vai |
brahmāṇḍa-brahma-vaivartaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ tathaiva ca ||20||
bhaviṣyaṃ vāmanaṃ brāhmaṃ rājasāni nibodha me |
sāttvikā mokṣa-dāḥ proktā rājasāḥ sarvadāśubhāḥ ||21||
tathaiva tāmasā devi niraya-prāpti-hetavaḥ |
tathaiva smṛtayaḥ proktā ṛṣibhis triguṇānvitāḥ ||22||
sāttvikā rājasāś caiva tāmasā śubha-darśane |
vāsiṣṭhaṃ caiva hārītaṃ vyāsaṃ pārāśaraṃ tathā ||23||
bhāradvājaṃ kāśyapaṃ ca sāttvikā muktidāḥ śubhāḥ |
yājṣavalkyaṃ tathātreyaṃ taittiraṃ dākṣame vaca ||24||
kātyāyanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca rājasāṃ svargadāḥ śubhāḥ |
gautamaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ ca sāṃvartaṃ ca yamaṃ smṛtam ||25||
sākhyaṃ cauśanasaṃ ceti tāmasā niraya-pradāḥ |
kim atra bahunoktena purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣv api ||26||
tāmasānarakāyaivavarjayettānvicakṣaṇaḥ |
etattesarvamākhyātaṃ prasaṅgācchubhadarśanam |
śeṣāṃ caprabhavāvasthāṃ harervakṣyāmiteśṛṇu ||27||
iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe tāmasaśāstra-
kathanaṃ nāmaṣaṭ-triṃśad-adhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||236|| ||cha||

śrīrudra uvāca—

patitāṃ dhara##dṛṣṭvādaṃ ṣṭrayoddhṛtyapūrvavat ||18||

aṣṭatriṃśad-adhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 

rudra uvāca—
bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ jṣātvā hiraṇyakaśipus tataḥ |
tapas tepe mahā-daityo meroḥ pārśve ca māṃ prati ||1||
divya-varṣa-sahasrāṇi vāyu-bhakṣo mahā-balaḥ |
japan paṣcākṣaraṃ mantraṃ pūjayāmāsa māṃ śubhe ||2||
tataḥ prahṛṣṭa-manasā tam avocaṃ mahāsuram |
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva daiteya yat te manasi vartate |
tataḥ provāca daiteyo māṃ prasannaṃ śubhānane ||3||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
devāsura-manuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvoraga-rakṣasām |
paśu-pakṣi-mṛgāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ vai mahātmanām ||4||
yakṣa-vidyādharāṇāṃ ca kinnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
sarveṣām eva rogāṇām āyudhānāṃ tathaiva ca |
sarveṣām ṛṣi-mukhyānām avadhyatvaṃ prayaccha me ||5||
rudra uvāca—
evam astv iti tad rakṣas tv abruvaṃ priya-darśane |
matto mahad varaṃ prāpya sa daiteyo mahā-balaḥ ||6||
jitvā mahendraṃ devāṃś ca sa trailokyeśvaro'bhavat |
sarvāṃś ca yajṣa-bhāgāṃś ca svayam evāgrahīd balāt ||7||
trātāraṃ nādhigacchanti devatās tena nirjitāḥ |
tasya iva kiṅkarāḥ sarve gandharvā deva-dānavāḥ ||8||
yakṣāś ca nāgāḥ siddhāś ca sādhyāś ca vaśa-vartinaḥ |
uttānapādasya sutāṃ kalyāṇīṃ nāma kanyakām ||9||
upayeme vidhānena daitya-rājo mahā-balaḥ |
tasyāṃ jāto mahā-tejāḥ prahlādo daitya-rāṭ śubhe ||10||
anurakto hṛṣīkeśe garbha-vāse'pi yo harau |
sarvāvasthāsu kṛtyeṣu mano-vāk-kāya-karmabhiḥ ||11||
nānyaṃ jānāti deveśāt prasannātmā sanātanāt |
sakāle'pi vinītaḥ san guru-gehe’vasat sudhīḥ ||12||
adhītya sarva-vedāṃś ca śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca |
kasyacit tv atha kālasya guruṇā saha daityajaḥ ||13||
pituḥ samīpam āgatya vavande vinayānvitaḥ |
taṃ pariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ tanayaṃ śubha-lakṣaṇam |
aṅke nidhāya daityendraḥ provācedaṃ suvismitam ||14||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
prahlāda cira-kālaṃ tvaṃ guru-gehe niveśitaḥ |
yad uktā guruṇā vidyā tan mamācakṣva suvrata ||15||
rudra uvāca—
iti pṛṣṭaḥ sva-pitrā vai prahlādo janma-vaiṣṇavaḥ |
prāha daityeśvaraṃ prītyā vacanaṃ kaluṣāpaham ||16||
prahlāda uvāca—
yo vai sarvopaniṣadām arthaḥ puruṣa īśvaraḥ |
taṃ vai sarva-gataṃ viṣṇuṃ namaskṛtvā bravīmi te ||17||
rudra uvāca—
iti viṣṇu-stutiṃ śrutvā daitya-rāḍ vismayānvitaḥ |
uvāca taṃ guruṃ roṣāt kiṃ tvayoktaṃ mamātmaje ||18||
mamātmajasya durbuddhe hari-saṃstavam īdṛśam |
kim artham uktavān jāḍyam akāryaṃ brāhmaṇocitam ||19||
aśrāvyaṃ mada-mitrasya stavam etaṃ mamāgrataḥ |
bālenāpi kṛtaṃ tv etat tvat-prasādād dvijādhama ||20||
ity uktvā parito vīkṣya daitya-rāṭ krodha-mūrcchitaḥ |
uvāca daityam ekaṃ tu bandhayainaṃ dvijādhamam ||21||
iti rāja-vacaḥ śrutvā sa babandha bhṛgoḥ sutam |
badhyamānaṃ guruṃ dṛṣṭvā prahlādo brāhmaṇa-priyaḥ |
uvāca pitaraṃ tāta idaṃ me noktavān guruḥ ||22||
kṛpayā deva-devasya śikṣito’smi hareḥ prabho |
nānyo gurur me bhavati sa eva prerako hariḥ ||23||
śrotā mantā tathā vaktā draṣṭā sarvaga īśvaraḥ |
harir evākṣayaḥ kartā niyantā sarva-dehinām |
tasmād anāgaso vipro moktavyo'yaṃ guruḥ prabho ||24||
rudra uvāca—
iti putra-vacaḥ śrutvā hiraṇyakaśipus tataḥ |
taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ mocayitvā sva-sutaṃ prāha vismayāt ||25||
kiṃ vatsa tvaṃ bhramasy evaṃ mithyā-vākyair dvijan manaḥ |
ko viṣṇuḥ kiṃ tu tad-rūpaṃ kutrāsau saṃsthito hariḥ ||26||
aham eveśvaro loke trailokyādhipatir yataḥ |
mām evārcaya govindaṃ tyaja śatruṃ durāsadam ||27||
athavā śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ rudraṃ loka-guruṃ prabhum |
arcayasvāsurādhyakṣaṃ sarvaiśvarya-pradaṃ śivam ||28||
tri-puṇḍra-dhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhasmanā daitya-pūjitam |
pūjayitvā mahā-devaṃ pāśupatyokta-mārgataḥ ||29||
rudra uvāca—
iti daitya-pater vākyaṃ śrutvā daitya-purohitāḥ ||30||
purohitā ūcuḥ—
evam eva mahābhāga kuruṣva vacanaṃ pituḥ |
tyaja śatruṃ kaiṭabhāriṃ pūjayasva trilocanam ||31||
rudrāt parataro devo nāsti sarva-prado nṝṇām |
pitā tavāpi tasyaiva prasādād īśvaro'bhavat ||32||
rudra uvāca—
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā prahlādo janma-vaiṣṇavaḥ ||33||
prahlāda uvāca—
aho bhagavataḥ śreṣṭhā yan māyā-mohitaṃ jagat |
aho vedānta-viduṣaḥ sarva-lokeṣu pūjitāḥ ||34||
brāhmaṇā api cāpalyād vadanty evaṃ madānvitāḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ param ||35||
nārāyaṇaḥ paro dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārayaṇaḥ param |
gatir viśvasya jagataḥ śāśvataṃ śivam acyutaḥ ||36||
dhātā vidhātā jagato vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
viśvam evedaṃ puruṣas tad viśvam upajīvati ||37||
hiraṇmaya-vapur nityaḥ puṇḍarīka-nibhekṣaṇaḥ |
śrī-bhū-līlā-patiḥ saumyo nirmalaḥ śubha-vigrahaḥ ||38||
tenaiva sṛṣṭau brahmeśau sarge devottamau vibhū |
tasyaivājṣāṃ puraskṛtya vartete brahma-śaṅkarau ||39||
bhīṣāsmād vāti pavano bhīṣodeti divākaraḥ |
bhīṣāsmād agniś candro'tha mṛtyur dhāvati paṣcamaḥ ||40||
āsīd eko harir divyo devo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ |
brahmānendro na ceśāno na ca candra-divākarau ||41||
na vādyā vāpṛthivyau ca nakṣatrāṇi divaukasaḥ |
tasya viṣṇoḥ paraṃ dhāma sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ ||42||
evaṃ sarvopaniṣadām arthaṃ hitvā dvijottamāḥ |
rāgāl lobhād bhayād vāpi kiṃ bravītha mamāgrataḥ ||43||
taṃ sarva-rakṣakaṃ devaṃ tyaktvā sarveśvaraṃ harim |
kathaṃ pāṣaṇḍam āśritya pūjayāmi ca śaṅkaram ||44||
lakṣmī-patiṃ deva-devam anantaṃ puruṣottamam |
indīvara-dala-śyāmaṃ padma-patrāyatekṣaṇam ||45|
śrīvatsa-lakṣitoraskaṃ sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣitam |
sadā kumāraṃ sarveśaṃ nityānanda-sukha-pradam ||46||
kṛṣṇaṃ dadhyur mahātmāno yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ |
yam arcayanti brahmeśa-śakrādyā devatā-gaṇāḥ ||47||
yasya patnyāḥ kaṭākṣārdha-dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭā divaukasaḥ |
brahmendra-rudra-varuṇa-yama-soma-dhanādhipāḥ ||48||
yan-nāma-smaraṇād eva pāpinām api satvaram |
muktir bhavati jantūnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabhā ||49||
sa evaṃ rakṣakaḥ śrīśo devānām api sarvadā |
tam eva pūjayiṣyāmi lakṣmyā saṃyutam acyutam ||50||
prāpsyāmi susukhenaiva tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam |
rudra uvāca—
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā hiraṇyakaśipus tataḥ ||51||
krodhena mahatā viṣṭo jajvālāgnir ivāparaḥ |
parito vīkṣya daiteyān ity āha krodha-mūrcchitaḥ ||52||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
bhīṣaṇaiḥ śastra-saṅghātaiḥ prahlādaṃ pāpa-kāriṇam |
mamājṣayā ghātayadhvaṃ śatru-pūjana-tat-param ||53||
rakṣitā harir eveti rakṣate tena vātsalāt |
adyaiva saphalaṃ tasya paśyeyaṃ hari-rakṣaṇam ||54||
rudra uvāca—
tadodyatāstrā daiteyā hantuṃ daityeśvarātmajam |
parivārya mahātmānaṃ tasthur daityeśvarājṣayā ||55||
prahlādo'pi tathā viṣṇuṃ dhyātvā hṛdaya-paṅkaje |
japann aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ tasthau girir ivāparaḥ ||56||
taṃ jaghnuḥ parito vīrāḥ śūlatomara-śaktibhiḥ |
prahlādasya vapus tatra hari-saṃsmaraṇāc chubhe ||57||
viṣṇoḥ prabhāvād durdharṣād vajra-bhūtam abhūd bhṛśam |
tataḥ samprāpya tad-gātraṃ mahāstrāṇi sura-dviṣām ||58||
nīlotpala-dalānīva petuś chinnāḥ kṣitau śubhe |
alpam apy asya tad-gātraṃ bhettuṃ daityā na ca kṣamāḥ ||59||
vismitā vāṅ-mukhās tasthur daitya-rājāntike bhaṭāḥ |
tādṛg vidhaṃ mahātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ mahā-balam ||60||
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā daitya-rāṭ krodha-mūrcchitaḥ |
ādideśa tataḥ sarvān dandaśūkān mahā-viṣān ||61||
vāsuki-prabhṛtīn bhīmān khādayadhvam iti krudhā |
ādiṣṭās tena rājṣātha tenāgāḥsu mahā-balāḥ ||62||
jvalitāsyā mahā-bhīmās taṃ cakhādur mahā-balam |
garuḍa-dhvaja-bhaktaṃ taṃ vidaśya garalāyudhāḥ ||63||
nirviṣāś chinna-daśanā babhūvur anilāśanāḥ |
vainateya-sahasreṇa chinna-gātrāḥ suvihvalāḥ ||64||
pradudruvur diśaḥ sarvā vamanto rudhiraṃ bhṛśam |
tādṛg-vidhān mahā-sarpān dṛṣṭvā daitya-patis tadā ||65||
ādideśa tataḥ kruddho dig-gajān sumadānvitān |
nirdiṣṭās tena rājṣātha dig-gajāś ca madoddhatāḥ ||66||
parivāryātha taṃ jaghnur dantaiḥ pṛthutarair bhṛśam |
atha dig-gaja-dantāś ca chinna-mūlāḥ patan bhuvi ||67||
dantair vinākṛtā nāgā bhayārtā vai pradudruvuḥ |
tān dṛṣṭvātha mahānāgān daityendraḥ kupito balī ||68||
prajvālya ca mahā-vahniṃ cikṣepa sutam ātmanaḥ |
jala-śāyi-priyaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahlādaṃ havya-vāhanaḥ ||69||
na dadāha ca taṃ dhīraṃ suśītaḥ samabhūc chikhī |
adahyamānaṃ taṃ bālaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā suvismitaḥ ||70||
prādāt tasmai viṣaṃ ghoraṃ sarva-bhūta-hitaṃ tadā |
tasya viṣṇoḥ prabhāvāc ca viṣamasyāmṛtaṃ bhavet ||71||
arpaṇāt tasya devasya viṣaṃ cāmṛtam aśnute |
evam ādyair vadhopāyair ghora-rūpaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ ||72||
mohayitvātmajaṃ rājā tasyāvadhyatvam īkṣya ca |
tataḥ sāmnā sutaṃ prāha daitya-rāḍ vismayākulaḥ ||73||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
tvayā viṣṇoḥ paratvaṃ ca samyag uktaṃ mamāgrataḥ |
vyāpitvāt sarva-bhūtānāṃ viṣṇur ity abhidhīyate ||74||
yo’sau sarva-gato devaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ |
tasya sarva-gatatvaṃ vai pratyakṣaṃ darśayasva me ||75||
aiśvarya-śakti-tejāṃsi jñāna-vīrya-balāni ca |
parasya tasya paramaṃ rūpaṃ guṇa-vibhūtayaḥ ||76||
samyag dṛṣṭvā prayatnena viṣṇuṃ manye divaukasām |
mama prati balo loke nāsti deveṣu kaścana ||77||
īśāna-vara-dānena sarva-bhūteṣv avadhyatām |
prāptavān sarva-bhūtānāṃ durjayatvaṃ ca mānada |
īśvaratvaṃ labhed viṣṇur māṃ jitvā bala-vīryataḥ ||78||
rudra uvāca—
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahlādaḥ prāha vismitaḥ |
hareḥ prabhāvaṃ dainyasya kathayāmāsa suvrataḥ ||79||
prahlāda uvāca—
yo’sau nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān paramātmā sanātanaḥ |
vasanāt sarva-bhūteṣu vāsudevaḥ sa ucyate ||80||
sarvasyāpi jagad-dhātā viṣṇur ity abhidhīyate |
na kiṃcid asmād anyaṃ tu jagat sthāvara-jaṅgamam ||81||
sarvatra cid-acid-vastu-rūpaṃ tasya iva nānyathā |
tripād-vyāptiḥ paraṃ vyomni pāda-vyāpti-kalādbhutā ||82||
yo’sau cakra-gadā-pāṇiḥ pīta-vāsā janārdanaḥ |
yogibhir dṛśyate bhaktyā nābhaktyā dṛśyate kvacit ||83||
draṣṭuṃ na śakyo roṣāc ca matsarād vā janārdanaḥ |
deva-tiryaṅ-manuṣyeṣu sthāvareṣv api jantuṣu ||
vyāpya tiṣṭhati sarveṣu kṣudreṣv api mahatsu ca ||84||
rudra uvāca—
iti prahlāda-vacanaṃ śrutvā daitya-varas tadā |
uvāca roṣa-tāmrākṣo bhartsayaṃś ca sutaṃ muhuḥ ||85||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
asau sarva-gato viṣṇur api cet paramaḥ pumān |
pratyayaṃ darśayasvādya bahubhiḥ kiṃ ca lāpitaiḥ ||86||
mahādeva uvāca—
ity uktvā sahasā daityaḥ prāsāda-stambham ātmanaḥ |
tāḍayāmāsa hastena prahlādam idam abravīt ||87||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
asmin darśayataṃ viṣṇuṃ yadi sarva-gato bhavet |
anyathā tvāṃ vadhiṣyāmi mithyā-vākya-pralāpinam ||88||
rudra uvāca—
ity uktvā sahasā khaḍgam ākṛṣya ditijeśvaraḥ |
prahlādorasi cikṣepa hantuṃ khaḍgena taṃ ruṣā ||89||
tasmin kṣaṇe mahā-śabdaḥ stambhe saṃśrūyate bhṛśam |
saṃvartā-śani-saṃrāvaiḥ kham iva sphuṭitāntaram ||90||
tena śabdena mahatā daitya-śrotra-vighātinā |
sarve nipātitā bhūmau chinna-mūlā iva drumāḥ ||91||
bibhyantaḥ samplutaṃ daityā menire vai jagat-trayam |
tataḥ stambhe mahā-tejā niṣkrānto vai mahā-hariḥ ||92||
cakāra sa mahā-ghoraṃ jagat-kṣaya-nibhaṃ svanam |
tena nādena mahatā tārakāḥ patitā bhuvi ||93||
nṛsiṃha-vapur āsthāya tatra ivāvirabhūd dhariḥ |
aneka-koṭi-sūryāgni-tejasā sa samāvṛtaḥ ||94||
mukhe paṣcānana-prakhyaḥ śarīre mānuṣākṛtiḥ |
daṃṣṭrā-karāla-vadanaḥ sphuraj-jihvāmbaroddhataḥ ||95||
jvālāvalita-keśāntas taptālātekṣaṇo vibhuḥ |
sahasra-bāhubhir dīrghaiḥ sarvāyudha-samanvitaiḥ ||96||
vṛto merur ivābhāti bahu-śākhānagānvitaḥ |
divya-mālyāṃ vara-dharo divyābharaṇa-bhūṣitaḥ ||97||
tasthau nṛkesarī-rūpaḥ saṃhartuṃ sarva-dānavān |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghora-saṃkāśaṃ narasiṃhaṃ mahā-balam ||98||
dagdhākṣi-pakṣmo daityendro vihvalāṅgaḥ papāta ha |
prahlādo'tha tadā dṛṣṭvā nārasiṃhopamaṃ harim ||99||
jaya-śabdena deveśaṃ namaścakre janārdanam |
dadarśa tasya gātreṣu nṛisiṃhasya mahātmanaḥ ||100||
lokān samudrān sa-dvīpān sura-gandharva-mānuṣān |
ajāṇḍānāṃ sahasraṃ tu saṭāgre tasya dṛśyate ||101||
dṛśyante tasya netreṣu soma-sūryādayas tathā |
karṇayor aśvinau devau diśaś ca vidiśas tathā ||102||
lalāṭe brahma-rudrau ca nabho vāyuś ca nāsike |
indrāgnī tasya vaktrāṃ te jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ||103||
daṃṣṭrāsu siṃha-śārdūlāḥ śarabhāś ca mahoragāḥ |
kaṇṭhe ca dṛśyate meruḥ skandheṣv api mahādrayaḥ ||104||
deva-tiryaṅ manuṣyāś ca bāhuṣv api mahātmanaḥ |
nābhau cāsyāntarikṣaṃ ca pādayoḥ pṛthivī tathā ||105||
romasvoṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ pāda-pānakha-paṅktiṣu |
niḥśvāseṣu ca vedāś ca sāṅgopāṅga-samanvitāḥ ||106||
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśve-devā marud-gaṇāḥ |
sarvāṅgeṣu pradṛśyanta te gandharvāpsarasaś ca ye ||107||
itthaṃ vibhūtayas tasya dṛśyaṃ te paramātmanaḥ |
śrīvatsa-kaustubhoraskaṃ vanamālā-vibhūṣitam ||108||
śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-khaḍga-śārṅgādyair hetibhir yutam |
sarvopaniṣadām arthaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityeśvarātmajaḥ ||109||
harṣāśru-jala-siktāṅgaḥ praṇanāma muhur muhuḥ |
daityendras tu hariṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhān mṛtyu-vaśe sthitaḥ ||110||
yoddhuṃ khaḍgaṃ samudyamya nṛsiṃhaṃ tam abhidravat |
atha daitya-gaṇāḥ sarve labdha-saṃjṣā mahā-balāḥ ||111||
svāny āyudhāni cādāya hariṃ jaghnus tvarānvitāḥ |
palālakāṇḍāni yathā vahnau kṣiptāny anekaśaḥ ||112||
tathaiva bhasmatāṃ yānti mahāstrāṇi hares tanau |
tāny anīkāni daityānāṃ dṛṣṭvā nara-haris tadā ||113||
saṭair dadāha ca jvālā-mālā viracita sphuṭaiḥ |
nṛkesari-saṭodbhūta-vahninā dānavā bhṛśam ||114||
nirbhasmitā gaṇāḥ sarve niḥśeṣaṃ tad abhūd balam |
prahlādaṃ sānugaṃ hitvā bhasmite vīkṣya tad-bale ||115||
krodhād daitya-patiḥ khaḍgam ākṛṣyābhiprapadyata |
khaḍga-hastaṃ tu daityendraṃ jagrāhaikena bāhunā ||116||
pātayāmāsa deveśo yathā śākhāṃ mahānilaḥ |
gṛhītvā patitaṃ bhūmau mahā-kāyaṃ nṛ-kesarī ||117||
svotsaṅge sthāpayāmāsa dadarśāsau mukhaṃ hareḥ |
viṣṇu-nindā-kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tathā vaiṣṇava-doṣajam ||118||
nṛsiṃha-sparśanād eva nirbhasmitam abhūt tadā |
atha daityeśvarasyātha mahad gātraṃ nṛ-kesarī ||119||
nakher vidārayāmāsa tīkṣṇair vajra-nibhair ghanaiḥ |
sanirmmalātmā daityendraḥ paśyan sākṣān mukhaṃ hareḥ ||120||
nakha-nirbhinna-hṛdayaḥ kṛtārtho vijahāv asūn |
tad-gātraṃ śatadhā bhittvā nakhais tīkṣṇair mahā-hariḥ ||121||
ākṛṣyāntrāṇi dīrghāṇi kaṇṭhe saṃsaktavān priyān |
atha deva-gaṇāḥ sarve munayaś ca tapo-dhanāḥ ||122||
brahma-rudrau puraskṛtya śanaiḥ stotuṃ samāyayuḥ |
te prasādayituṃ bhītā jvalantaṃ viśvato-mukham ||123||
mātaraṃ jagatāṃ dhātrīṃ cintayāmāsur īśvarīm |
hiraṇya-varṇāṃ hariṇīṃ sarvopadrava-nāśinīm ||124||
viṣṇor nityānavadyāṅgīṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇīṃ śubhām |
devī-sūkta-japair bhaktyā namaścakruḥ sanātanīm ||125||
taiś cintyamānā sā devī tatraivāvirabhūt tadā |
catur-bhujā viśālākṣī sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣitā ||126||
dukūla-vastra-sahitāṃ divya-mālānulepanām |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā deva-devasya priyāṃ sarve divaukasaḥ ||127||
ūcuḥ prāṣjalayo devīṃ prasannaṃ kurute priyam |
trailokyasyābhayaṃ svāmī yathā dadyāt tathā kuru ||128||
rudra uvāca—
ity uktāsahasādevīpriyaṃ prāpyajanārdanam |
praṇipatyanamaskṛtyaprasīdeti uvācatam ||129||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvāmahiṣīṃ svasyapriyāṃ sarveśvarohariḥ |
rakṣaḥ śarīrajaṃ krodhaṃ tatyājaprītavatkṣaṇāt ||130||
aṃ kamādāyatāṃ devīṃ samāśliṣyadayānidhiḥ |
kṛpāsudhārdradṛṣṭyāvainiraikṣata surānhariḥ ||131||
tatojayajayetyuccaiḥ stuvatāṃ namatāntadā |
taddayādṛṣṭidṛṣṭānāṃ sānandaḥ sambhramo'bhavat ||132||
tatodeva-gaṇāḥ sarveharṣanirbharamānasāḥ |
 ūcuḥ prāṣjalayodevaṃ namaskṛtyajagat-patim ||133||
deva-gaṇā ūcuḥ—
draṣṭumatyadbhutaṃ tejonaśaktāstejagat-pate |
atyadbhutamidaṃ rūpaṃ bahuvāhupadāṃ kitam ||134||
jagat-trayasamākrāntaṃ tejastīkṣṇataraṃ tava |
draṣṭuṃ sthātuṃ naśaktāḥ smaḥ sarvaevadivaukasaḥ ||135||
mahādeva uvāca—
ityarthitastuvibudhaistejastadatibhīṣaṇam |
upasaṃ hṛtyadeveśobabhūvasukhadarśanaḥ ||136||
śaratkoṭīṃ dusaṃ kāśaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ |
sudhāmayasaṭāpuṃ javidyutkoṭinibhaḥ śubhaḥ ||137||
nānāratnamayairdivyaiḥ keyūraiḥ kaṭakānvitaiḥ |
bāhubhiḥ kalpavṛkṣasyaśākhaughairivasatphalaiḥ ||138||
caturbhiḥ komalairdivyairanvitaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
japākusumasaṃ kāśaiḥ śobhitaḥ karapaṅkajaiḥ ||139||
śaṅkhacakragṛhītābhyāmudbāhubhyāṃ virājitaḥ |
varadābhayahastābhyāmitarābhyāṃ nṛkesarī ||140||
śrīvatsakaustubhoraskovanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ |
udyaddinakārābhyāṃ cakuṇḍalābhyāṃ virājitaḥ ||141||
hārakeyūrakaṭakairbhūṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃ kṛtaḥ |
savyāṃ gasthaśriyāyuktorājatenarakesarī ||142||
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvādevatāḥ samaharṣayaḥ |
ānandāśrujalaiḥ siktāharṣanirbharacetasaḥ ||143||
ānandasindhumagnāstenamaścakrurnirantaram |
arcayāmāsurātmeśaṃ divyapuṣpasamarpaṇaiḥ ||144||
ratnakuṃ bhaiḥ sudhāpūrṇairabhiṣicyasanātanam |
vastrairābharaṇairgandhaiḥ puṣpaidhūpairmmanoramaiḥ ||145||
divyairniveditairdīpairarccayitvānṛkesarim |
tuṣṭuvuḥ stavanairdivyairnamaścakrurmmuhurmmahuḥ ||146||
tataḥ prasannolakṣmīśasteṣāmiṣṭānvarāndadau |
tatodeva-gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarveśobhaktavatsalaḥ ||147||
prahlādaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ cakrerājānamavyayam |
āśvāsyabhaktaṃ prahlādamabhiṣicyasurottamaiḥ ||148||
dadautasmaivarāniṣṭānbhaktiṃ cāvyabhicāriṇīm |
tatodeva-gaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ stūyamānonṛkesarī ||149||
vikīrṇapuṣpavapubhis tatra ivāntaradhīyata |
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarvesvaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ prapedire ||150||
punaścayajṣabhāgānsvānbubhujuḥ prītamānasāḥ |
tatodevāḥ sagandharvānirātaṃ kābhavaṃ s tadā ||151||
 tasmin hatemahādaityesarvaevapraharṣitāḥ |
prahlādastutadācakrerājyaṃ dharmeṇavaiṣṇavaḥ ||152||
hareḥ prasādāllabdhanturājyaṃ vaiṣṇavasattamaḥ |
bahubhir yajṣa-dānādyair arcayitvā nṛ-kesarim ||153||
kāle hari-padaṃ prāpa yogi-gamyaṃ sanātanam |
etat prahlāda-caritaṃ ye tu śṛṇvanti nityaśaḥ ||154||
te sarve pāpa-nirmuktā yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim |
etat te kathitaṃ devi nṛsiṃhaṃ vaibhavaṃ hareḥ |
śeṣāṃ ca vaibhavāvasthāṃ śṛṇu devi yathā kramam ||155||

śrī-pārvaty uvāca—
raghunāthasya caritaṃ sādhūktaṃ hi tvayā vibho |
śrutvā dhanyāsmi deveśa tvat-prasādān maheśvara ||1||
vasudeva-sutasyāsya kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ mahat |
śrotum icchāmi deveśa caritaṃ kalmaṣāpaham ||2||
rudra uvāca—
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇasyāsya mahātmanaḥ |

dattvātasmaivaraṃ muktiṃ niṣkrāṃ toyadunandanaḥ ||1||
hataṃ cayavanaṃ śrutvājarāsandhaḥ sudurmatiḥ |
yayudherāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ svabalenasamāvṛtaḥ ||2||
kṛṣṇenanihataṃ sainyaṃ sarvaṃ tasya durātmanaḥ |
sapapātamahīpṛṣṭhemūrcchitomagadhādhipaḥ ||3||
cireṇalabdhvāsaṃ jṣāṃ tu vihvalāṅgobhayāturaḥ |
naśaśākaraṇeyoddhuṃ rāmeṇamagadheśvaraḥ ||4||
vimukhaḥ prādravattūrṇaṃ hataśeṣabalānugaḥ |
ajeyāvititaumatvārāmakṛṣṇaumahā-balau ||5||
tayorvirodhaṃ tyaktvāthanagarīṃ svāṃ viveśaha |
athatauvasudevasyatanayausahasenayā ||6||
mathurāṃ tyajyanagarīṃ praviṣṭaudvārikāṃ purīm |
indreṇapreṣitovāyuḥ sabhāṃ tatra divaukasām ||7||
kṛṣṇāyapradadauprītyānirmitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
vajravaiḍūryaracitāṃ bahvāsanavicitritām ||8||
nānāratnamayairdivyaiḥ svarṇacchatrairvirājitām |
tāṃ prāpyaramyāṃ tu sabhāmugrasenādayonṛpāḥ ||9||
modaṃ tenaigamaiḥ sārdhaṃ divideva-gaṇāiva |
ikṣvākuvaṃ śasambhūtoraivatonāmapārthivaḥ ||10||
kanyāṃ duhitaraṃ svasyasarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām |
rāmāyapradadauprītyārevatīnāmanāmataḥ ||11||
upayemevidhānenasarāmastāṃ carevatīm |
ramayāmāsacatayāśacyāivasureśvaraḥ ||12||
vidarbharājodharmātmābhīṣmakonāmadhārmikaḥ |
vabhūvus tasya putrāsturukmaprabhṛtayaḥ śubhāḥ ||13||
teṣām avarajā kanyā rukmiṇī vara-varṇinī |
kamalāṃśena sambhūtā sarva-lakṣaṇa-saṃyutā ||14||
rāghavatve’bhavat sītā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇa-janmani |
anyeṣv evāvatāreṣu viṣṇor eṣā sahāyinī ||15||
hiraṇyaka-hiraṇyākṣau sambhūtau dvāpare punaḥ |
śiśupālo dantavaktra iti nāma samanvitau ||16||
caidyānvaye samudbhūtau mahā-bala-parākramau |
rukmiṇīṃ śiśupālāya dātum aicchat tad-ātmajaḥ ||17||
taṃ necchatī patiṃ sā tu śiśupālaṃ śubhānanā |
bālyāt prabhṛti vai viṣṇum anuraktā dṛḍha-vratā ||18||
uddiśya kṛṣṇaṃ bhartāraṃ surāṇām arcanaṃ sadā |
cakāra rukmiṇī kanyā dānāni vividhāni ca ||19||
vratacaryā-parā bhūtvā dhyāyantī puruṣottamam |
ātmeśaṃ svasya bhartāram uvāsa pitṛ-mandire ||20||
kartuṃ tāṃ śiśupālāya vivāhaṃ pārthivottamaḥ |
cakāra yatnaṃ putreṇa rukmiṇā savidhī matā ||21||
purohita-sutaṃ vipraṃ preṣayāmāsa rukmiṇī |
uddiśya kṛṣṇaṃ bhartāraṃ sa tūrṇaṃ dvārakāṃ yayau ||22||
sametya kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca tābhyāṃ vidhivad arcitaḥ |
ekāṃ te sarvam ācaṣṭa rukmiṇī bhāṣitaṃ tayoḥ ||23||
tac chrutvā rāma-kṛṣṇau tu tena vipreṇa dhīmatā |
sarva-śastrāstra-sampūrṇaṃ ratham ākāśagaṃ prabhuḥ ||24||
āruhya sūta-mukhyena dārukeṇa mahātmanā | 
vidarbha-nagarīṃ tūrṇaṃ jagmatuḥ puruṣottamau ||25||
rājānaḥ sarva-rāṣṭrebhyo vivāhaṃ draṣṭum āgatāḥ |
jarāsandha-mukhāḥ sarve śiśupālasya dhīmataḥ ||26|| 
tasminn udvāha samaye rukmiṇī rukma-bhūṣaṇā |
durgāṃ niḥsṛtārcayituṃ sakhībhir nagarād bahiḥ ||27||
etasminn eva kāle tu samprāpto devakī-sutaḥ |
ratha-sthāṃ tāṃ ca jagrāha balāvān madhusūdanaḥ ||28||
saha sāratham āropya yayau tūrṇaṃ svam ālayam |
tataḥ krodha-samāviṣṭā jarāsandha-mukhā nṛpāḥ ||29||
rukmiṇā rāja-putreṇa yuddhāya samupasthitāḥ |
anuyātā hariṃ kruddhāś caturaṅga-balānvitāḥ ||30||
balabhadro mahābāhur avaruhya rathottamāt |
lāṅgalaṃ muśalaṃ gṛhya nijaghāna kṣaṇād arīn ||31||
rathān aśvān mahā-nāgāṃs tathā pāda-carān api |
lāṅgalamuśalāmyāṃ vai nijaghāna balād raṇe ||32||
tasya lāṅgala-pātena cūrṇitā ratha-paṅktayaḥ |
nāgāś ca patitā bhumau vajreṇeva mahīdharāḥ ||33||
nirbhinna-mastakāḥ sarve vamanto rudhiraṃ bahu |
kṣaṇenaiva hataṃ sainyaṃ balarāmeṇa vai tadā ||34||
sāśvaṃ sa-nāgaṃ sa-rathaṃ sa-padātiṃ mahā-raṇe |
samantāt samare tatra susruvuḥ śoṇitāpagāḥ ||35||
prabhagnāḥ pārthivāḥ sarve dudruvur bhaya-pīḍitāḥ |
kṛṣṇena kadanaṃ cakre rukmī krodha-vaśād balī ||36||
dhanur udyamya bāṇaughais tāḍayāmāsa śārṅgiṇam |
tataḥ prahasya govindaḥ śārṅgam ādāya līlayā ||37||
jaghānaikena bāṇena rathāśvāṃs tasya sārathim |
rathaṃ dhvajaṃ patākāṃ ca ciccheda dharaṇī-dharaḥ ||38||
virathaḥ khaḍgamādāyadharaṇyāṃ saupasthitaḥ |
kṛṣṇastukhaḍgaṃ cicchedabāṇenaikenavīryavān ||39||
tataḥ samuṣṭimudyamyakṛṣṇaṃ vakṣasyatāḍayat |
taṃ jagrāharaṇevīraṃ nibadhyanibiḍaṃ hariḥ ||40||
tīkṣṇaṃ kṣurapramādāyaprahasanmadhusūdanaḥ |
śirasomuṇḍanaṃ kṛtvāmumocacajanārdanaḥ ||41||
satuśokasamāviṣṭoniḥśvasannurago yathā | 
āviveśapuraṃ svīyaṃ satu tatra ivacāvasat ||42||
iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām uttara-khaṇḍe umā-maheśvara-saṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇacaritevidarbhasenāvidhvaṃ sanaṃ nāmasaptacatvāriṃ śadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||247||
(248)
aṣṭacatvāriṃ śadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 
rudra uvāca—
atha kṛṣṇas tu rāmeṇa rukmiṇyā dārukeṇa ca |
divyaṃ syandanam āruhya yayau tūrṇaṃ svam ālayam ||1||
tataḥ praviśya nagarīṃ dvārakāṃ devakī-sutaḥ |
śubhe hi śubha-lagne vai vedokta-vidhinā hariḥ ||2||
upayeme nṛpa-sutāṃ rukmiṇīṃ rukma-bhūṣitām |
tasminn udvāha samaye deva-dundubhayo divi ||3||
vineduḥ puṣpa-varṣāṇi vavṛṣuḥ sura-sattamāḥ |
vasudevograsenau ca tathākrūro yadūttamaḥ ||4||
balabhadro mahātejā ye cānye yadu-puṅgavāḥ |
cakruḥ kṛṣṇasya rukmiṇyā vivāhaṃ susukhaṃ yathā ||5||
nanda-gopo’tha gopālair gopa-vṛndaiḥ samāgataḥ |
svalaGkṛtābhir yoṣābhir yaśodā ca samāgatā ||6||
vasudeva-striyaḥ sarvā devakī-pramukhās tathā |
revatī rohiṇī-devī yāś cānyāḥ pura-yoṣitaḥ ||7||
sarvāṇyudvāhakarmāṇicakrurharṣasamanvitāḥ |
surāṇāmarcanaṃ prītyākartavyaṃ tatra devakī ||8||
vṛddhābhirnṛpayoṣidbhiścakāravidhinātadā |
sarvamaudvāhikaṃ karmautsavaṃ hidvijottamaiḥ ||9||
brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsavastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
ugrasenādayas tatra rājānaścasupūjitāḥ ||10||
nandagopādayogopāyaśodādyāścayoṣitaḥ |
bahubhiḥ svarṇaratnādyairvāsobhiḥ savibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||11||
pūjitāḥ samprahṛṣṭāstetadvivāhamahotsave |
taudaṃ patīsamāśliṣyapraṇataujātavedasam ||12||
veda-vidbhirvipramukhyairāśīrbhirabhinaṃ ditau |
tasyāṃ vivāhavedyāṃ tu śuśubhāte vadhūvarau ||13||
brāhmaṇebhyo'thavṛddhebhyorājanyaḥ sahabhāryyayā |
vavaṃ dedevakīputrojyeṣṭhasyabhrātur eva ca ||14||
evamaudvāhikaṃsarvaṃ nirvartyamadhusūdanaḥ |
vyasarjayannṛpānsarvānyeca tatra samāgatāḥ ||15||
prasthitāhariṇā tatra pūjitānṛpapuṅgavāḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ sumahātmānoniryayuḥ svakamālayam ||16||
rukmiṇyāsahadharmātmādevakīnandano'vyayaḥ |
uvāsa susukhenaiva divya-harmya-tale śubhe ||17||
tayā vai ramayāmāsa nārāyaṇa iva śriyā |
saṃstūyamānomunibhirdivideva-gaṇairapi ||18||
ahanyahanihṛṣṭātmāsukhenaivajanārdanaḥ |
athovāsasuśobhāyāṃ dvāravatyāṃ sanātanaḥ ||19||

iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣca-paṣcāśat-sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyām 
uttara-khaṇḍe umā-maheśvara-saṃvāde 
śrī-kṛṣṇa-carite rukmiṇī-vivāha-kathanaṃ nāma
aṣṭācatvāriṃśad-adhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ

śrī-rudra uvāca—
atha magadhādhipaḥ kaṃsa-vadhānantaraṃ dviṣann eva yādavān sadā pīḍayāmāsa te duḥkhitāḥ kṛṣṇam ūcuḥ ||1|| sa cabhīmārjunāvāhūya saṃmantrayāmāsa kṛṣṇaḥ anena rudraḥ pūjitas tat-prasādāc chastrair avadhyaḥ paraṃ kenāpi prakāreṇa hantavya iti ||2||
atha vicārya bhīmam āha enaṃ pratimalla-yuddhaṃ kuru tat tena pratijṣātam ||3||
atha sakala-carācara-jagad-vandyo vāsudevo bhīmārjuna-sahito jarāsandhasya purīṃ gatvā vipra-veṣeṇa tasyāntaḥ puram avāpa |4||
so'pi mahā-vīryānakṣatriyān yuddhe nirjitya balād gṛhītvā sva-veśmani nirudhya māsi māsi kṛṣṇa-caturdaśyām ekaikaṃ hatvā tad-raktenaiva baliṃ bhairavāyākarot ||5||
evaṃ vidhaṃ sakala-jana-pārthiva-vadhaṃ kurvato jarāsandhasya samudyamāno bhīmārjuna-sahitas tasya gṛhe vipra-veṣeṇaiva praviveśa ||6||
sa tu tān dṛṣṭvā daṇḍavat praṇato bhūtvā yathocitāsaneṣu niveśya madhuparka-vidhānena sampūjya-dhanyo’smi kṛta-kṛtyo’smi kimarthaṃ bhavanto me samīpa āgatās tad-vaktavyam ahaṃ tat sarvaṃ bhavadbhyo dāsyāmīty uvāca ||7||
teṣāṃ vāsudevaḥ prahasan pārthivaṃ tam uvāca kṛṣṇa-bhīmārjunāyuddhārtham āgatāḥ sma asmākam anyatamaṃ dvandva-yuddhārthaṃ vṛṇīṣv etya vadat ||8||
so'pi tathety avadat tato dvandva-yuddhārthaṃ mārutiṃ varayāmāsa ||9|||
tato bhīma-jarāsandhayor abhito bhayaṅkaraṃ malla-yuddhaṃ nirantaraṃ paṣcaviṃśati-vāsaram abhūt ||10||
tataḥ kṛṣṇenaiva saṣcodito vāyu-putras tasya śarīraṃ dvidhā-kṛtya bhūmau nipātayāmāsa |
evaṃ jarāsandhaṃ pāṇḍu-putreṇa hatvātān jarāsandha-nirodhitān vāsudevo'pi pārthivān mocayāmāsa ||11||
nihatya vāyu-putreṇa jarāṃ sandhaṃ yadūdvahaḥ |
tad-gṛhe sanniruddhāṃs tu mocayāmāsa pārthivān ||12||
te ca tatra namaskṛtya stutvā ca madhusūdanam |
svān svān jana-padān sarve jagmuḥ kṛṣṇena rakṣitāḥ ||13||
atha tābhyām indraprasthaṃ gatvā vāsudevas tatra mahā-kratuṃ rājasūyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraṃ kārayāmāsa ||14||
tatra samāpte kratau agra-pūjāṃ bhīṣmānumatena kṛṣṇāya dattavān ||15||
tatra śiśupālaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bahūny ākṣepa-vākyāny uktavān ||16||
kṛṣṇo'pi sudarśanena tasya śiraś ciccheda ||17||
asau janma-trayāvasāne hareḥ sārūpyam agamat ||18||
atha śiśupālaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā dantavaktraḥ kṛṣṇena yoddhuṃ mathurām ājagāma ||19|| 
kṛṣṇas tu tac chrutvā ratham āruhya tena yoddhuṃ mathurām āyayau ||20|| dantavaktra-vāsudevayor ahorātraṃ mathurā-pura-dvāri yamunā-tīre saṅgrāmaḥ samavartata kṛṣṇas tu gadayā taṃ jaghāna ||21|| 
sa tu cūrṇita-sarvāṅgo vajra-nirbhinna-mahīdhara iva gatāsur avani-tale papāta ||22|| 
so'pi hareḥ sāyujyaṃ yogi-gamyaṃ nityānandasukhaṃ śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam avāpa ||23|| 
itthaṃ jaya-vijayau sanakādi-śāpa-vyājena kevalaṃ bhagavato līlārthaṃ saṃsṛtāv avatīrya janma-traye 'pi tenaiva nihatau janma-trayāvasāne muktim avāptau ||24|| 
kṛṣṇo'pi taṃ hatvā yamunām uttīrya nanda-vrajaṃ gatvā prāktanau pitarāv abhivādya āśvāsya tābhyāṃ sāśru-kaṇṭham āliṅgitaḥ sakala-gopa-vṛddhān praṇamyāśvāsya ratnābharaṇādibhis tatrasthān santarpayāmāsa ||25|| 
kālindyāḥ puline ramye puṇya-vṛkṣa-samāvṛte |
gopa-nārībhir aniśaṃ krīḍayāmāsa keśavaḥ ||26||
ramya-keli-sukhenaiva gopa-veṣa-dharo hariḥ |

kṛṣṇas tu nanda-gopa-vrajaukasāṃ sarveṣāṃ paramaṃ nirāmayaṃ svapadaṃ dattvā divi deva-gaṇaiḥ saṃstūyamāno dvāravatīṃ śrīmatīṃ viveśa ||29||
tatra vasudevograsena-saṅkarṣaṇa-pradyumnāniruddhākrūrādibhiḥ pratyahaṃ sampūjita-ṣoḍaśa-sahasra-bhāryābhir aṣṭābhir divya-mahiṣībhiś ca viśva-rūpa-dharo divya-ratnamaya-nānā-gṛhāntareṣu suta-kusumāṣcita-ślakṣṇatara-
paryaṅkeṣu ramayāmāsa ||30||
atha rāma-kṛṣṇa-satīrthyo vipro bāla-sakhā sadātyanta- dāridrya-pīḍito muṣṭi-mātrān yācanāpta-pṛthukāṣ jīrṇa-vāsasi nibadhya vāsudevaṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīmatīṃ dvārakā-nagarīm ājagāma ||31||
sa tu rukmiṇy-antaḥ-pura-dvāri kṣaṇaṃ tūṣṇīṃ tasthau ||32||
kṛṣṇo'pi samāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jṣātvā pradyumnena namaskṛtvā vāma-karaṃ gṛhītvā gṛhāntare svāsane niveśya bhayād vepamānaṃ taṃ rukmiṇī-hasta-gata-suvarṇa-kalaśa-jalena pādau prakṣālya madhu-parkeṇa pūjayāmāsa ||33||
sudhāmṛtopamair anna-pānādyais tarpayitvā tasya jīrṇa-vastrāntare yācanāpta-pṛthukān svayam eva hastena gṛhītvā prahasan jagrāsa ||34||
kṛṣṇena pṛthuke bhakṣite tasminn eva kṣaṇe tasya bahu-dhana-dhānya-vastrābharaṇa-sambhūtaṃ mahad aiśvaryam abhūt ||35||
sa tu kṛṣṇena visṛṣṭo mama kiṃcid vastraṃ vā dhanaṃ vā kṛṣṇena na dattam iti manyamānaḥ sva-puraṃ viveśa ||36||

teṣāṃ dhārtarāṣṭra-pāṇḍu-putrāṇāṃ nānā-deśādhipa-nṛpaiḥ kurukṣetra-mahā-puṇye devānām api bhayaṃ karo mahāsaGgrāmo'bhavat ||40||

śrī-pārvaty uvāca—
bhagavan sarvam ākhyātaṃ vai bhavāvasthitaṃ hareḥ |
te tasmin rāma-kṛṣṇābhyāṃ caritram ativismitam ||1||
aho rāmasya caritaṃ kṛṣṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
śṛṇvatyā mama deveśa kalpāntara-śatair api ||2||
tṛptiṃ naiveti bhūteśa ceto hari-kathāmṛtam |
adhunā śrotum icchāmi viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam |
tat-pūjana-vidhiṃ deva śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ tathā ||3||
śrī-rudra uvāca—
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi hareś ca sumahātmanaḥ |
sthāpanaṃ ca svayaṃ vyaktaṃ dvividhaṃ tat prakīrtitam ||4||
śilā-mṛd-dāru-lohādyaiḥ kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ hareḥ |
śrauta-smārtāgama-prokta-kriyā-saṃsthāpanaṃ hi yat ||5||
tat sthāpanam iti proktaṃ svayaṃ vyaktaṃ hi me śṛṇu |
yasmin saṃnihito viṣṇuḥ svayam eva nṛṇāṃ bhuvi ||6||
pāṣāṇa-dārvor ātmeśaḥ svayaṃ vyaktaṃ hi tat smṛtam |
svayaṃ vyaktaṃ sthāpitaṃ vā pūjayen madhusūdanam ||7||
devatānāṃ maharṣīṇām arcanārthe sanātanaḥ |
svayam eva jagannāthaḥ sānnidhyaṃ yāti keśavaḥ ||8||
yasya yad vigrahe bhogyaṃ tad evāvirabhūd bhuvi |
tad eva pūjayen nityaṃ tasminn eva ramet sadā ||9||
śrī-raṅga-śāyī deveśo vidhinārcyaḥ surottamaḥ |
sa evekṣvākunāthānāṃ tapasāvirabhūd bhuvi ||10||
mamāpi kāśyāṃ sampūjyo mādhavaḥ kaluṣāpahaḥ |

tatra tatra samāgamya rame'haṃ saṃvyavasthitaḥ |
nāṣṭāṅga-yoge yajṣeśas tv arcāyāṃ vindate nṝṇām ||12||

sarvāvasthāsu saulabhyam arcāyāṃ labhyate janaiḥ ||13||
ajṣānām api sānnidhyaṃ sarvadā pṛthivī-tale |
jambūdvīpe mahā-puṇye varṣe vai bhārate śubhe ||14||

tat tasmād bhārate varṣe munibhis tridaśair api ||15||
sevitaḥ satataṃ devi tapo-yajṣa-kriyādibhiḥ |
bhārate'sminmahāvarṣenityaṃ saṃ nihitohariḥ ||16||
indradyumne tathā kaurme siṃhādrau kara-vīrake |

kṛta-śauce haret pāpaṃ pauṇḍarīke ca daṇḍake |18||
māthure veṅkaṭādrau ca śvetādrau garuḍācale |

catuḥ-paṣcāśad-adhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ 

vasiṣṭha uvāca—
evam uktā tu sā devi pati nāśūla-pāṇinā |
praṇipatya mahātmānam uvāca prāṣjalis tadā ||1||
pārvaty uvāca—
sādhūktaṃ hi tvayā nātha vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmam uttamam |
guhyād guhyatamaṃ viṣṇoḥ svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ ||2||
dhanyāsmi kṛta-kṛtyāsmi sarva-deva-namaskṛta |
tava prasādād deveśam arcayāmi sanātanam ||3||
vasiṣṭha uvāca—
tatas tad-vacanaṃ śrutvā sa bhavas tripurāntakaḥ |
samāśliṣyāvadad devīṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanāḥ ||4||
rudra uvāca—
sādhu sādhu mahādevi sādhu sādhu varānane |
arcayasva hṛṣīkeśaṃ lakṣmī-bhartāram acyutam ||5||
kṛta-kṛtyo'smy ahaṃ bhadre vaiṣṇavyā bhāryayā tvayā |
guruṇā tava cārvaṅgi vāma-devena dhīmatā ||6||
anujṣātārcayasveśaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam |
gurūpadeśa-mārgeṇa pūjayitvaiva keśavam |
prāpnoti vāṣchitaṃ sarvaṃ nānyathā bhūdharātmaje ||7||
vasiṣṭha uvāca—
evam uktā tadā devi vāma-devāntikaṃ nṛpa |
jagāma sahasā hṛṣṭā viṣṇu-pūjana-lālasā ||8||
sametya taṃ guruṃ devi pūjayitvā praṇamya ca |

kalyāṇaguṇapūrṇāya namas te paramātmane |

arcayenmantraratnenavidhināpuruṣottamam |
 tasya prasādasevāṃ cakuryyānnityamatandritaḥ ||107||

puruṣottama-māhātmyam

|| atha śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe saptamaṃ kriyā-khaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate ||

(1)
atha prathamo'dhyāyaḥ

śrī-gaṇeśāya namaḥ |

atha kriyā-yoga-sāra-khaṇḍam ārabhyate |

lakṣmīnātha-padāravinda-yugalaṃ brahmeśvarādyāmara-
śreṇī-namra-śiro-lirolimā amalaṃ vandāmahe santatam |
bhaktyā yogi-manas-taḍāga-suṣamā-sandohapuṣyattamaṃ 
gaṅgāmbho-makaranda-bindu-nikaraṃ saṃsāra-duḥkhāpaham ||1||

yo mūrtīr bahudhā vidhāya bhagavān rakṣann aśeṣaṃ jagad
yat-pādārcana-tat-parā na hi punar majjanti viśvārṇave |
sarva-prāṇi-hṛd-ambujeṣu vasatir yasya prabhoḥ santataṃ 
ramya-kroḍa-vapur-dharāya haraye devāya tasmai namaḥ ||2||

vedebhya uddhṛtya samasta-dharmā-
nyo’yaṃ purāṇeṣu jagāda devaḥ |
vyāsa-svarūpeṇa jagad-dhitāya 
vande tam etaṃ kamalā-sametam ||3||
ekadāmunayaḥ sarvesarva-loka-hitaiṣiṇaḥ |
suramyenaimiṣāraṇyegoṣṭhīṃ cakrurmanoramām ||4||
tatrāntaremahātejāvyāsaśiṣyomahāyaśāḥ |
sūtaḥ śiṣya-gaṇair  yuktaḥ samāyāto hariṃ smaran ||5||
tam āyāntaṃ samālokyasūtaṃ śāstrārthapāragam |
nemuḥ sarvesamutthāyaśaunakādyāstapodhanāḥ ||6||
so'pitānsahasābhaktyāmunīnparamavaiṣṇavān |
nanāmadaṇḍavadbhūmausarvadharmavidāṃ varaḥ ||7||
varāsanemahābuddhistair ddattemunisattamaiḥ |
uvāsahamunirmadhyesarvaiḥ śiṣyagaṇair vṛtaḥ ||8||
tatropaviṣṭaṃ taṃ sūtaṃ śaunakomunisattamaḥ |
baddhāṣjalirimāṃ vācam uvāca—vinayānvitaḥ ||9||
śaunaka uvāca— --
maharṣe sūta sarvajṣa kali-kāle-samāgate |
kenopāyena bhagavan bhūri bhaktir bhaven nṛṇām ||10||
kalausarvebhaviṣyanti pāpakarmaratājanāḥ |
vedavidyāvihīnāścateṣāṃ śreyaḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||11||
kalāvannagatāḥ prāṇālokāḥ svalpāyuṣas tathā |
nir dhanāścabhaviṣyanti nānāduḥkhaprapīḍitāḥ ||12||
prayāsasādhyaṃ sukṛtaṃ śāstreṣukriyatedvija |
tasmāt ke'pikariṣyanti kalaunasukṛtaṃ janāḥ ||13||
sukṛteṣuvinaṣṭeṣupravṛttepāpakarmaṇi |
savaṃ śāḥ pralayaṃ sarvegamiṣyanti durāśayāḥ ||14||
svalpaśramair alpavittair alpakālaiścasattama |
 yathā bhavenmahāpuṇyaṃ tadvaikathayasūtaja ||15||
yasyopadeśataḥ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vākurvatejanāḥ |
satadbhāgībhavenmartyaitiśāstreṣuniścitam ||16||
puṇyopadeśaḥ sadayaḥ kaitavaiścavivarjitaḥ |
pāpam ārgavirodhīcacatvāraḥ keśavopamāḥ ||17||
jñānaṃ samprāpya saṃsāre yaḥ parebhyonayacchati |
jñānarūpīharistasmai prasannaivanekṣate ||18||
jñānaratnaiścaratnaiścaparasanto ṣakṛnnaraḥ |
sajṣeyaḥ sumatirnūnaṃ nararūpadharohariḥ ||19||
tvamevamuniśārdūlavedavedāṅgapāragaḥ |
tvadṛte na hi vaktā'nyoyatastvaṃ vyāsaśāsitaḥ ||20||
sūta uvāca—
dhanyo'sitvaṃ muniśreṣṭhatvamevavaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ |
yataḥ samastalokānāṃ hitaṃ vāṣchasisarvadā ||21||
śṛṇu śaunakavakṣyāmiyattvayāśrotum icchitam |
sarva-loka-hitārthāyavaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||22||
pṛṣṭojaiminināsarvaṃ yad uvāca—śṛṇu ṣvatat |
maharṣirjaiminirnāmayogābhyāsarataḥ sadā ||23||
praṇamyaśirasāvyāsampapracchamunisattamaḥ |
jaiminir uvāca—
bhagavansarvadharmajṣavyāsasatyavatīsuta ||24||
kalaukasmād bhavenmokṣastanmamācakṣvamūlataḥ |
suta uvāca—
jaiminervacanaṃ śrutvāvyāsaḥ saṃ tuṣṭamānasaḥ ||25||
prārebhemuniśārdūlakathāṃ maṃ galasaṃ yutām |
vyāsa uvāca—
jaiminemuniśārdūladhanyo'sitvaṃ mahāmate ||26||
nārāyaṇakathāṃ śrotuṃ yatovāṃ chasisarvadā |
satkathāśravaṇebuddhir yasya yasya pravartate ||27||
 tasya tasya bhavejjñānaṃ jñānaṃ mokṣapradaṃ viduḥ|
navaiṣṇavakathāyasmair ocatepāpinebhuvi ||28||
vṛthaivasṛṣṭvāvidhinābhūmirbhāravatīkṛtā |
kathāyaijagatīvaktuṃ ślāghyatevaiṣṇavair janaiḥ ||29||
tāṃ mithyāmivayovaktisajṣeyaḥ pāpināṃ varaḥ |
 yasmin dinemuniśreṣṭhaśrūyatenahareḥ kathā ||30||
taddinaṃ durdinaṃ manyeghanacchannaṃ nadurdinam |
 yatra yatra mahībhāgevaiṣṇavīvartatekathā ||31||
sāṃ nidhyaṃ tatra bhagavānnajahātikadācana |
yovaiṣṇavakathārambhevighnakṛnmānavobhavet ||32||
tamevaśaptvābhagavāndaivataiḥ sahagacchati |
prabhāvaṃ vāsudevasya śrutvāhṛṣyanti yejanāḥ ||33||
jṣeyāsta evadevāṃ śāḥ pūjyādṛśyāścasattamāḥ |
nārāyaṇaprabhāvaṃ yeśrutvācopahasanti vai ||34||
tevijṣeyādānavāṃ śānarānarakabhāginaḥ |
 tatra tīrthānisarvāṇigaṅgādīnidvijottama ||35||
devarṣayaścadevāścamunayaścatapodhanāḥ |
śṛṇvatāṃ lokasaṅghānāṃ pāpavyādhivināśanī ||36||
nārāyaṇakathā yatra vartateprativāsaram |
munekriyā-yogasāraṃ bahvarthaṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||37||
nārāyaṇakathopetaṃ setihāsaṃ niśāmaya ||38||
iti śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre jaimini-vyāsa-saṃvāde prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1|| 

(2)
dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ

vyāsa uvāca—
sṛṣṭerādaumahāviṣṇuḥ sisṛkṣuḥ sakalaṃ jagat |
sraṣṭāpātācasaṃ hartāiṃ tramūrtirabhavatsvayam ||1||
sṛṣṭyarthamasyajagataḥ sasarjabrahmasaṃjṣakam |
dakṣiṇāṃ gataātmānamātmanāśreṣṭhapūruṣaḥ ||2||
tatastupālanārthāyajagatojagatīpatiḥ |
viṣṇuṃ sasarjavāmāṃ śānnijāṃ śaṃ keśavaṃ mune ||3||

munesasarjamadhyāṃ gātkṛtapadmālayaḥ prabhuḥ ||4||
rajaḥ satvaṃ tamaścetipuruṣaṃ triguṇātmakam |

ekoviṣṇustridhābhūtvāsṛjatyatticapātica |
tasmād bhedonakartavyastriṣulokeṣusattamaiḥ ||6||
ādyāprakṛtire tasya mahāviṣṇoḥ parātmanaḥ |
nidānaṃ bhūtaviśvasyavidyāvidyetigīyate ||7||
bhāvābhāvasvarūpāsājagaddhetuḥ sanātanī |
brāhmīlakṣmīrambiketitrimūrtiḥ sahasā'bhavat ||8||
sṛṣṭisthitivināśeṣuyāṃ niyojyatatomune |
ādyāṃ caivādyapuruṣas tatra ivāntaradhīyata ||9||
yasyājṣayātatobrahmāmahābhūtānsasarjaha |
pṛthivyākāśavāyvaṃ buvahnīnpaṣcasamādhinā ||10||
bhūrbhuvaḥ svas tathā caiva mahaś caiva janas tathā |
tapaścasatyamityādīnsṛṣṭavānkamalāsanaḥ ||11||
atalaṃ sṛṣṭavānbrahmātato'dhovitalaṃ dvija |
tato'dhaḥ sutalaṃ caiva tato'dhaścatalātalam ||12||
mahātalamadhastasmāt tato'dhaścarasātalam |
tasmād adhaścapātālaṃ lokānevaṃ yathā kramam ||13||
devatānāṃ nivāsārthaṃ ratnasānuṃ mahāgirim |
sṛṣṭavānpṛthivīmadhyejāmbūnadasamujjvalam ||14||
mandaraṃ caramaṃ caiva trikūṭamudayācalam |
anyāṃ ścaparvatāṃ ś caiva sṛṣṭavānvividhānapi ||15||
lokālokastataś caiva tanmadhyesaptasāgarāḥ |

navamo'dhyāyaḥ

jaiminir uvāca—
bhūya evagurobrūhigaṅgāmāhātmyamuttamam |

nṛpatekuśalaṃ brūhisarvapuṇyātmanāṃ vara |

prakāśayādbhutaṃ tātakiṃ tedāsyāmicādhunā ||65||
rājovāca --
sarvam evadayāsindhotvayādattaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
pāpināpimayāprāptaṃ tavasthānaṃ sudurlabham ||66||
tasyānenatuvākyenaprasannaḥ kamalāpatiḥ |
snehānniveśayāmāsabhūpālaṃ tanniśāmaya ||67||
tataḥ suvarṇālaṃ kārair viśvakarmavinirmitaiḥ |
cakāramaṇḍalaṃ tasya svayamevadayāmayā ||68||
athanānāvidhair bhakṣyair divyair apisudurlabhaiḥ |
toṣitaḥ samahīpāloviṣṇunātisahiṣṇunā ||69||
evaṃ pratidinaṃ tasthausarājāviṣṇumandiram |
manvantarasahasrāṇinavavarṣaśatānica ||70||
prajānāṃ pālanaṃ cakresarājādharma-tat-paraḥ |
pūjayāmāsasatataṃ bhaktyāparamayāhariḥ ||71||
cārucaṃ pakapuṣpaiścanaivedyair vividhaiścasaḥ |
āyuḥ śeṣesabhūpālomaraṇaṃ jāhnavījale ||72||
samāsādyayayaumokṣaṃ prasādāccakrapāṇinaḥ |
vyāsa uvāca—
vipracaṃ pakapuṣpasyaprabhāvo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ ||73||
capaṃ kair harimabhyarcyamuktāḥ syuḥ pāpinojanāḥ |
sphuṭacaṃ pakapuṣpeṇapūjitobhagavānhariḥ ||74||
acireṇaivaviprarṣedadātiparamaṃ padam |
yeyajanti parātmānamicchayāvāpyanicchayā ||75||
te'piyānti paraṃ dhāmavimuktāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ ||76||
harauprasanneduritīnako'piyataḥ sarājākṛtapātako'pi |
jagāmamokṣaṃ kṛpayāmurārerviśvārṇavaṃ nimnamimaṃ vitīrya ||77||

bhaktyāyajedyaḥ paramādareṇamartyovrajettattuvihāyapāpam ||78||

aṃ gaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya yas tu nārāyaṇāgrataḥ |
so'pitatphalamāpnotikimanyair bahubhāṣitaiḥ ||119||

 yas tu vāradvayaṃ viprakuryādviṣṇupradakṣiṇām |

viṣṇupradakṣiṇaṃ  yas tu kuryādvāradvayaṃ janaḥ |

yo'śnātibhaktibhāvenasagacchetparamaṃ padam |

dehaṃ tyajatipāpānibrahmahatyāmukhāny api |
bhuṃ jatoharinaivedyaṃ dāsīvavaśagābhavet ||158||

acireṇaivataṃ viṣṇurnayatisvāntanuṃ prati |

vidhihīnāmapiśreṣṭhāṃ pūjāṃ śrī-kamalāpateḥ |

vidhijṣovidhināviṣṇumabhyarcyayatphalaṃ labhet |
yathoktavidhināvipranaivedyair buhubhiḥ prabho ||163||
pūjito'pi na tuṣṭaḥ syād yadi bhaktir na tiṣṭhati |
yasya vai yāvatī bhaktir devadeve janārdane ||164||
tāvadevaphalāvāptis tasya nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ |
abhaktyāyāhareḥ pūjākriyatebhuvimānavaiḥ ||165||

saṃsthānaṃ labhate viṣṇor yato bhakta-vaśo hariḥ ||169||
asāram etad bhuvanaṃ samastaṃ 
sāraṃ hareḥ pūjanameva vipra |
tasmān manuṣyo nija-maṅgalaiṣī 
bhaktyā yajet kṛṣṇam ananta-mūrtim ||170||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre 
hari-pūjā-vidhir nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||

vyāsa uvāca—
phālgunebrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaśrī-kṛṣṇaṃ suravanditam |
pūjayedbhaktibhāvenapratyahaṃ vaiṣṇavojanaḥ ||1||

phalaṃ tasya pravakṣyāmiyataḥ samyaṅniśāmaya ||2||
sarvayajṣaphalaṃ prāpyasarvadānaphalaṃ tathā |
aṃ teyātihareḥ sthānaṃ sarva-pāpavivarjitaḥ ||3||
yugakoṭisahasrāṇibhukttvābhogaṃ harer gṛhe |
 tatra ivamokṣamāpnotisamprāpya jñānamuttamam ||4||

vyāsa uvāca—

evaṃ prabodhitāstenayamenayamakiṃ karāḥ |

(16)
ṣoḍaśodhyāyaḥ 

vyāsa uvāca—
bhūya eva dvija-śreṣṭha mahā-viṣṇoḥ parātmanaḥ |
bravīmi śṛṇu māhātmyaṃ sarva-duḥkha-vināśanam ||1||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣattriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāś cānye’ntyajās tathā |
hari-bhaktiṃ prapannā ye te kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ ||2||
harer abhakto vipro'pi vijṣeyaḥ śvapacādhikaḥ |
hari-bhaktaḥ śvapāko'pi vijṣeyo brāhmaṇādhikaḥ ||3||
sa kathaṃ brāhmaṇo yas tu hari-bhakti-vivarjitaḥ |
sa kathaṃ śvapaco yas tu bhagavad-bhakti-mānasaḥ ||4||
avyājena yadā viṣṇuḥ śvapākenāpi pūjyate |
tadā paśyet tam apy evaṃ catur-veda-dvijādhikam ||5||
purāsīc cakriko nāma śabaro loka-karṣa-kṛt |
sujāti-vṛtti-hīnaś ca yuge  dvāpara-saṃjṣake ||6||
vipra-vādī jita-krodhaḥ para-hiṃsā-vivarjitaḥ |
dayālur dambha-hīnaś ca pitṛ-mātṛ-parāyaṇaḥ ||7||
na kṛto vaiṣṇavālāpo mokṣa-śāstraṃ na ca śrutam |
tathāpi jātā tac-citte hari-bhaktir acaṣcalā ||8||
hare keśava govinda vāsudeva janārdana |
ity ādīni smaran nityaṃ sa ca nāmāni cakriṇaḥ ||9||
vanyaṃ phalaṃ ca yat kiṣcit prāpnoti dvija-sattama |
ādau dadāti tad-vaktre nije śabara-vaṃśajaḥ ||10||
tan-mādhuryaṃ tato jṣātvā vaktrān niṣkāsya tat punaḥ |
dadāti haraye bhaktyā suprītaḥ prati vāsaram ||11||
ucchiṣṭaṃ vāpy anucchiṣṭaṃ dvayam eva na vetti saḥ |
nija-jāti-svabhāvo hi satataṃ mūirghna vartate ||12||
kadācit sa dvija-śreṣṭha kānanābhyantare bhraman |
phalam ekaṃ prāpya pakvaṃ priyālasyeti śākhinaḥ ||13||
athāsau harṣitas tasya phalam aprāpya cakrikaḥ |
sa-saṃraṃbheṇa jṣātvā vainija-vaktrāntare dadau ||14||
sa dadau tat-phalaṃ yāvan nija-vaktrāntare dvija |
praviveśa galaṃ tāvat tat-phalaṃ śṛṇu jaimine ||15||
tāvat savyena hastena gala-randhraṃ babandha saḥ |
yatnād vidhṛtya savyena pāṇinā sakalaṃ dvija ||16||
cakrikaś cintayāmāsa hari-bhakti-parāyaṇaḥ |
phalam etad yadā tasmai na dadāmi murāraye ||17||
na jātaḥ ko'pi saṃsāre tadāham iva pātakī |
hariṃ saṃcintya bahudhā sa cakāra matiṃ tataḥ ||18||
 tathāpi tat-phalaṃ tasya na niṣkrāntaṃ galād dvija |
harer ekānta-bhakto'sau chittvā paraśunā galam ||19||
ānīya tat-phalaṃ pakvaṃ dadau devāya viṣṇave |
tat-sannidhiṃ samāyātas tam eva hṛdi cintayan ||20||
rudhiro kṣita-sarvāṅgaḥ patitaḥ kṣiti-maṇḍale |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavān viṣṇur gatāsuṃ vyathito'bhavat ||21||
ye tasya sadṛśo bhakto mamako'pi na vidyate |
yato nija-galaṃ chittvā mama santoṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ||22||
yathā bhaktimatā'nena sāttvikaṃ karma vai kṛtam |
yad dattvānṛṇyam āpnoti tathā vastu kim asti me ||23||
dhanyo'yam atidhanyo’yaṃ dhanyo’yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |

 yathā miṣṭānnapānena na hi tṛpyanti gardabhā ||216||

bhadra-tanur uvāca—

dānta uvāca— --
kiṃ te'bhilaṣitaṃ viprasiddhiṃ pratigataṃ vada |
acireṇaivatapasāṃ kathamudyāpanaṃ kṛtam ||222||
bhadra-tanur uvāca—

 tathā mebhagavānviṣṇuḥ suprītodvija-sattama ||225||

anugrahostideveśayadāmayijagatpate |

yadānūnaṃ tvayotsṛṣṭāmatsamdarśanadakṣiṇā |

 tasmin vipresamāyātedāntedātṛvarehariḥ |

dayālokamalākāntaśaraṇāgatapālaka |

yena stotreṇa te prītiṃ janayiṣyāmi cetasi ||249||
rakṣa rakṣa prabho rakṣa māṃ prasīda jagat-pate |
tvad-dāsa-dāsa-dāsānāṃ dāsatvenāpi māṃ vṛṇu |

tataḥ prahasyadeveśobhaktigrāhīdayāmayaḥ |
karāravindaṃ tanmūrdhnidatvāprāhetijaimine ||250||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
madbhakto'sidvija-śreṣṭha prāptaṃ maddarśanaṃ tvayā |
matprasādenabhadraṃ tesarvam evabhaviṣyati ||251||
vyāsa uvāca—
tamāliṅgyatatodāntaṃ premṇābhadratanuṃ catam |
 tatra ivāntardadheviprasahasāparameśvara ||252||
 tasmin akṣetravarepuṇyedurllabhepuruṣottame |

 yatra viṣṇuṃ samabhyarcyamartyāḥ syuḥ suravanditāḥ ||257||
śakrādyāstridaśāḥ sarvesupuṇyakṣayabhīravaḥ |
anyonyamapijalpanto 'niśaṃ cadvija-sattama ||258||

kadā tatra kariṣyāmaḥ pūjāṃ śrī-kamalāpateḥ ||259||
atidhanyāimelokā asmatto'pimahattarāḥ |
durllabhebhāratevarṣepūjayanti ha##prabhum ||260||
ahobhāratavarṣasyakaḥ śaktoguṇabhāṣaṇe |
yatrārādhyahariṃ pūrvaṃ vayaṃ devatvamāgatāḥ ||261||
itthaṃ devagaṇāḥ sarvevāsavādyādvijottama |
nityaṃ bhāratabhūbhāgaṃ praśaṃ santi śubhapradam ||262||
 tatra janmasamāsādyayenanārādhitohariḥ |
tattulyaḥ ko'pi saṃsāre ko'pidṛṣṭaḥ śrutonaca ||263||
satyaṃ satyaṃ punarapigadyatesatyamevatat |
viśvātmānaṃ sakṛdapimānavāye'rcayanti ca ||264||
apyaśrāntaṃ dvijasudṛḍhayākarmabhūmaucabhaktyā |
muktāḥ pāpaiḥ sukararacitair yānti kaivalyamāśu ||265||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre 
puruṣottama-kṣetre bhadra-tanu-vara-pradānaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ

(18)
aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ

jaiminir uvāca—
tīrtha-śreṣṭham iti proktaṃ yat tvayā puruṣottamam |
tan-māhātmyaṃ guro brūhi yadi te mayy anugrahaḥ |||1||
vyāsa uvāca—
puruṣottamasya māhātmyaṃ samāsena śṛṇu dvija |
samyag vaktuṃ jagaty asmin kaḥ śakto viṣṇunā vinā ||2||
lavaṇāmbho-nidhes tīraṃ puruṣottama-saṃjṣitam |
puraṃ tad brāhmaṇa-śreṣṭha svargād api ca durlabham ||3||
svayam asti pure tasmin yataḥ śrī-puruṣottamaḥ |
puruṣottamam ity uktaṃ tasmāt  tan-nāma-kovidaiḥ ||4||
kṣetraṃ tad durlabhaṃ vipra samantād daśa-yojanam |
tatrastha-dehino devair  dṛśyante ca catur-bhujāḥ ||5||
praviśan vai tu tat-kṣetraṃ sarve syur viṣṇu-mūrtayaḥ |
tasmād  vicāraṇā tatra na kartavyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||6||
cāṇḍālenāpi saṃspṛṣṭaṃ grāhyaṃ tatrānnam agrajaiḥ |
sākṣād viṣṇur yatas tatra cāṇḍālo dvija-sattama ||7||
tatrānna-pācikā lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ bhoktā janārdanaḥ |
tasmāt  tatraudanaṃ vipra daivatair  api durlabham ||8||
hari-bhuktāvaśiṣṭaṃ yat pavitraṃ bhuvi durlabham |
annaṃ ye bhuṣjate lokās teṣāṃ muktir na durlabhā ||9||
brahmādyās tri-daśāḥ sarve tad-annam atidurlabham |
bhuṣjate nityam āgatya mānuṣāṇāṃ ca kā kathā ||10||
na yasya ramate cittaṃ tasminn anne sudurlabhe |
tam eva viṣṇu-dveṣṭāraṃ prāhuḥ sarva-maharṣayaḥ ||11||
pavitraṃ bhuvi sarvatra yathā gaṅgā-jalaṃ dvija |
tathā pavitraṃ sarvatra tad-annaṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||12||
tad-annaṃ komalaṃ divyaṃ yady api dvija-sattama |
kṛkacasyodara-prāyaṃ tathāpy agha-vidāraṇe ||13||
pūrvārjitāni pāpāni kṣayaṃ yāsyanti yasya vai |
bhaktiḥ pravartate yasya tasminn anne sudurlabhe ||14||
bahu-janmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ yasya yāsyati saṃkṣayam |
tasminn anne dvija-śreṣṭha tasya bhaktir na jāyate ||15||
indradyumnasya sarasi mārkaṇḍeya-hrade tathā |
rohiṇyāṃ ca samudre ca śveta-gaṅgā-jaleṣu ca  ||16||
snānaṃ ye kurvate martyā bhakti-bhāva-samanvitāḥ |
teṣāṃ na vidyate janma punar asmin mahītale ||17||
lavaṇāmbhonidhes toyaiḥ pitaras tarpitā dvija |
sarva-duḥkha-vinirmuktā vrajanti hari-mandiram ||18||
tīrtha-rājaḥ samudro'sau kīrtitas tattva-darśibhiḥ |
tasmāt  tatra kṛtaṃ karma sarvam evākṣayaṃ bhavet ||19||
pitrarcanaṃ tathā dānaṃ bhagavac-caraṇārcanam |
japa-yajṣaṃ tathānyac ca tasmin kṣetre manorame ||20||
yat karma kurute martyo viṣṇu-prīṇana-hetave |
sarvam evākṣayaṃ tac ca bhaven nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ ||21||
balabhadraṃ subhadrāṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca kamalekṣaṇam |
ye mānavāḥ prapaśyanti teṣāṃ kiṃcin na durlabham ||22||
adṛṣṭvā śrī-jagannāthaṃ subhadrāṃ ca balaṃ tathā |
mokṣaṃ na labhate martyaḥ kurvan puṇya-śatāny api ||23||
tatra vetra-prahāreṇa śarīraṃ yasya lohitam |
taṃ vandante dvija-śreṣṭha devāḥ śakrādayo'khilāḥ ||24||
sthitvāntarikṣe śakrādyāḥ sarva-deva-gaṇā dvija |
vimāna-cāriṇo'nyonyaṃ pravadantīti harṣitāḥ ||25||##
kadā mānuṣyam asmabhyaṃ dāsyate kamalā-patiḥ |
manuṣyaiva gacchāmas tadā draṣṭuṃ hariṃ prabhum ||26||
kadā vetra-prahāreṇa kṣetre śrī-puruṣottame |
bhaviṣyanty asmadīyāni lohitāni vapūṃṣi ca ||27||
vāsavādyāḥ surāḥ sarve tasmin akṣetre vara-prade |
sadā vetra-prahārāṃś ca vāṣchanti dvija-sattama ||28||
tatrākṣaya-baṭaṃ ye tu bhaktyā paśyanti mānavāḥ |
koṭi-janmārjitaiḥ pāpair  muktā yānti parāṃ gatim ||29||
subhadrāṃ balabhadraṃ ca jagannātham anāmayam |
śvetaṃ mādhava-deveśaṃ mārkaṇḍeya-hradaṃ tathā ||30||
jyāmeśvaraṃ hanūmantaṃ tatrākṣayyaṃ baṭaṃ dvija |
paśyanti bhaktyā ye martyās teṣāṃ muktir hi śāśvatī ||31||
dolāyamānaṃ govindaṃ phālgune māsi tatra ye |
paśyanti mānavā bhaktyā teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ niśāmaya ||32||
vimuktāḥ sakalaiḥ pāpair  ante yānti harer gṛham |
jñānaṃ samprāpya tatra iva mokṣaṃ yānti sudurlabham ||33||
caitrake māsi vāruṇyāṃ yo jagannātham īkṣate |
sa mṛtaḥ praviśed dehaṃ jagannāthasya jaimine ||34||
vaiśākhe caiva śuklāyām ekādaśyāṃ jagat-patim |
tṛtīyāyāṃ ca yaḥ paśyen mukta eva sa mānavaḥ ||35||
praviśed yas tu manujo mahā-snānaṃ jagat-pateḥ |
tasya siddhyanti viprarṣe sarva eva manorathāḥ ||36||
brahmādyās tridaśāḥ sarve sthitvākāśe jagat-pateḥ |
mahā-snānaṃ prapaśyanti bhakti-bhāva-samanvitāḥ ||37||
mahā-jyeṣṭhyāṃ ca viprarṣejagannātham anāmayam |
ālokya labhate martyo viṣṇos tat paramaṃ padam ||38||
guṇḍicā-maṇḍapaṃ yāntam āṣāḍhe kamalā-patim |
balabhadraṃ ca yaḥ paśyet sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||39||
yaḥ paśyati jagannāthaṃ rathasthaṃ kamalekṣaṇam |
tasya nāsti punar janma saṃsāre sarva-duḥkha-de ||40||
rathārūḍhāṃ subhadrāṃ ca bhaktyā paśyanti mānavāḥ |
chinatti bhagavāṃs tasya duḥkhadambhava-bandhanam ||41||
aputrā mṛta-putrā ca yā subhadrāṃ prapaśyati |
bahvapatyā jīva-vatsā sā nārī bhavati dvija ||42||
durbhagā kāka-vandhyā vā subhadrāṃ yā prapaśyati |
sā svāmi-subhagā nārī bahv-apatyā bhavet khalu ||43||
guṇḍicā-maṇḍapa-sthaṃ ca-kṛṣṇaṃ paśyati yaḥ pumān |
balabhadraṃ subhadrāṃ ca sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||44||
rogī duḥkhī ca yaḥ paśyed guṇḍikā-maṇḍape harim |
rogāc chokāc ca sahasā jaimine sa pramucyate ||45||
yastvaputrojagannāthaṃ guṃ ḍikāmaṇḍapesthitam |
paśyetsacadvija-śreṣṭha putraṃ prāpnoti vaiṣṇavam ||46||
vidyārthīlabhatevidyāṃ dhanārthīlabhatedhanam |
dārārthīlabhatedārānmokṣārthīmokṣamāpnuyāt ||47||
bhraṣṭarājyonṛpo yas tu hariṃ paśyatibhaktitaḥ |
guṇḍikā-maṇḍape vipra nija-rājyaṃ labheta saḥ ||48||
śatrubhir varjito yas tu guṇḍikā-maṇḍape harim |
bhaktyā paśyati viprarṣe tasya naśyanti śatravaḥ ||49||
guṇḍikā-maṇḍape paśyed yo rāja-pīḍito bhṛśam |
sa sadya eva rājānaṃ svakīyaṃ vaśam ānayet ||50||
sarvāsām eva yātrāṇāṃ guṇḍikā pravarā matā |
tasmāt  sa mānavaiḥ kāryā tyaktvā kārya-śatāny api ||51||
śayane ca tathotthāne tasmin akṣetre manorame |
hariṃ paśyati yo martyaḥ sa devair  api pūjyate ||52||
puruṣotta-mamāhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ śaknoti kaḥ kṣitau |
yasya praveśa-mātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet ||53||
bahunātra kim uktena saṃkṣepād ucyate mayā |
sarveṣām eva tīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam ||54||
saṃsāra-sindhum atinimnam iman titīrṣuḥ 
kleśa-pradaṃ viṣama-pāpa-gaṇāśrayaṃ yaḥ |
kṣetre samasta-sukha-de puruṣottamākhye
paśyed amuṃ sura-varaṃ puruṣottamaṃ ca ||55||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre 
puruṣottama-māhatmyaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||

ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

vyāsa uvāca—
nārāyaṇa-prapannā ye narā bhakti-samanvitāḥ |
kadācid aśubhaṃ teṣāṃ vidyate na dvijottama ||1||

yac chrutvā mānavāḥ sarve labhante paramaṃ padam ||2||

pākhaṇḍā na hi tṛpyanti narake kleśa-bhāginaḥ ||3||
pākhaṇḍānāṃ samīpe tu viṣṇu-māhātmyam uttamam |
na vaktavyaṃ dvija-śreṣṭha vaktavyaṃ vaiṣṇavāgrataḥ ||4||
pūrvaṃ tretā-yuge vipraurvīśur nāma jaimine |
āsīt pāpa-rato nityaṃ dharma-nindā-parāyaṇaḥ ||5||
brahma-sva-hārī viprendra para-strī-gamanodyataḥ |
gomāṃsāśī surāpī ca veśyā-vibhrama-lolupaḥ ||6||
śaraṇāgata-hantā ca para-nindā-karaḥ sadā |
viśvāsa-ghātī mitraghno jṣāti-pīḍā-karas tathā ||7||
asatya-bhāṣī krūraś ca pākhaṇḍa-jana-saṅga-bhāk |
vṛtti-cchedī dvijātīnāṃ nyāsāpahārakas tathā ||8||
tādṛśaṃ taṃ samālokya duṣṭaṃ pāpa-parāyaṇam |
ājagmur jṣātayaḥ sarve kruddhās tasya nijaṃ gṛham ||9||
jṣātaya ūcuḥ 
pratiṣṭhopārjitā pūrvair asmākaṃ vimale kule |
sā pratiṣṭhā tvayā mūḍha vināśaṃ pratinīyate ||10||

mad-vaṃśa-kīrti-hananaṃ jāto'si jṣāti-duḥkhadaḥ ||11||

yasmii##sadhauśaśījātas tatra kṣveḍodbhavo'pi ca ||12||

jāteputrottamevaṃ śaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ syādadhamo'pi ca |
putredhametuśreṣṭho'pivaṃ śogacchatihīnatām ||14||
vyāsa uvāca—
ityuktvājṣātayastecataṃ sarvepāpināṃ varam |
apakīrtibhayātkruddhāstatyajuḥ sahasādvija ||15||
jṣātibhiḥ saparityaktojanaiḥ sarvaiścadhikkṛtaḥ |
prapededasyutāṃ duḥkhīvibhraṣṭākhilavaibhavaḥ ||16||
taṃ dasyukarmakurvaṃ taṃ nir ddayaṃ parahiṃ sakam |
dhṛtvājanapadāḥ sarvebhūpālāyanyavedayan ||17||
tenabhūmibhujā tasya pitṛ-snehāddvijottama |
nahato'saudurācāronijadeśādvahiṣkṛtaḥ ||18||
tato'sauvanamāśritya dasyubhiḥ sahanir ddayaḥ |
pāṃ thasvaharaṇārthāyatasthaubahubhiruddhataiḥ ||19||
kadācittaṭinītīraṃ dasyubhiḥ sahajaimine |
vanaparyaṭaneśrāṃ tojagāmasnānahetave ||20||
tasyāntaṭinyāṃ bhagavatparicaryāparāyaṇān |
asaudadarśaduṣṭātmābrāhmaṇākṛtinobahūn ||21||
athatebrāhmaṇāḥ sarvesamārādhyajanārdanam |
anyonyaṃ kathayāmāsurvihitā atikautukāt ||22||
adyacaṃ pakapuṣpāṇimayātyaktānitānivai |
kaścidvadatitāmbūla-ṃ mayādattaṃ murāraye ||23||
na khāditavyaṃ tāmbūla-ṃ kadācid api janmani |
mayādyaharayedattaṃ kadalīphalamuttamam ||24||
janmajanmānicamayābhakṣyaṃ cakadalīphalam |
ko'pivaktimayādattaṃ harayedāḍimīphalam ||25||
ko'pivaktimayādattaṃ rasālaphalamuttamam |
anyo'nyametadvadatāṃ teṣāṃ śrutvāvacāṃ sica ||26||
urvīśuścintayāmāsakiṃ pradāsyāmi viṣṇave |
saṃsāre yānivastūnibhakṣyāṇisanti tānyaham ||27||
na hi śaknomisaṃ tyaktuṃ kiṃ dāsyāmimurāraye |
nityaṃ vanāntarastho'haṃ caurorājabhayā kulaḥ ||28||
śakaṭārohaṇenāstihyadhikāraḥ kadāpime |
vyāsa uvāca—
ityuktvādasyunātenabhūyobhūyodvijottama ||29||
śakaṭaṃ harayedattaṃ caturvargapradāyine |
athatebrāhmaṇāḥ sarvejagmurvipra yathā gatāḥ ||30||
so'pidasyurdasyubhiścajagāmanijamāśrayam |
ekadāguḍakaṃ ḍolaṃ tenaivakhaluvartmanā ||31||
gṛhītvāpathikaḥ kaścitkākīmaṃ ḍalamāgataḥ |
tato'sausahasādasyurnirbhayaḥ parahiṃ sakaḥ ||32||
jahāraguḍakaṃ ḍolamadhvanīnasya tasya ca |
athatedasyavaścakrurguḍakaṃ ḍolabhaṃ janam ||33||
urvīśuścāpatadbhāgeśakaṭaṃ guḍanirmitam |
urvīśuḥ śakaṭaṃ gauḍaṃ samāsādyadvijottama ||34||
manasācintayāmāsavacaḥ smaraṇapūrvakam |
anomayāpurādattaṃ svayamevamurāraye ||35||
tasmād anonamegrāhyaṃ kadācidihajanmani |
vicintyetihṛdādātuṃ tadanoguḍanirmitam ||36||
dattaṃ viprāyakasmaicinmādhavaprītihetave |
tāṃ bhaktiṃ tasya vijṣāyamahāpātakinodvija ||37||
jahārasakalaṃ pāpaṃ sadyaḥ prītojanārdanaḥ |
tasmin nevadineviprapraviśyacamahāvanam ||38||
hataḥ paurajanaiḥ sarvair athakruddhaiḥ saurviśuḥ |
bhagavānathataṃ netuṃ vimānaṃ svarṇanirmitam ||39||
dūtāṃ ścapreṣayāmāsanānābharaṇa bhūṣitān |
athatebhagavaddūtāstamurvīśuṃ gatainasam ||40||
samāropyavimānetaṃ sadyojagmuḥ puraṃ hareḥ |
tatau'sauharisānnidhyaṃ prāpyapuṇyātmanāṃ varaḥ ||41||
punarmanvantar- aśataṃ sthitvākeśavasannidhim |
paramaṃ jñānamāsādyasaviveśatanuṃ hareḥ ||42||
vyāsa uvāca—
yenakenāpyupāyenahari-bhaktikaronaraḥ |
saṃsārajaladheḥ pāraṃ rājahaṃ saivavrajan ||43||
kṣaṇamevaharerbhaktirvartate yasya cetasi |
tatpadaṃ paramaṃ yātisapāpātmāpigacchati ||44||
ekamapyuttamaṃ vastudatvā'sautanmurāraye |
svayamevahibhoktavyaṃ paścātpāpopaśāntaye ||45||
yadvastuharayedattaṃ taccadadyāddvijātaye |
kiṃcic cheṣaṃ nabhoktavyaṃ tasyāvaśyaṃ svayaṃ budhaiḥ ||46||
vastūnibrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhamiṣṭāniyānikānica |
adatvāviṣṇavetāninabhoktavyānivaiṣṇavaiḥ ||47||
viṣṇunaivedya-māhātmyaṃ sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam |
setihāsampunarvacmiśṛṇu viprasamāhitaḥ ||48||
āsītsarvajanirnāmabrāhmaṇaḥ śuddhavaṃ śajaḥ |
śāṃ todāntodayāyuktogurubrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ ||49||
hareḥ pūjāparaś caiva harismaraṇa-tat-paraḥ ||
prapannakleśavidhvaṃsīsatyavādījitendriyaḥ ||50||
prātaḥ snāyīnijācāragrāhīhiṃsā-vivarjitaḥ |
ekādaśībrataratojṣātipūjāparāyaṇaḥ ||51||
kadācitsadvija-śreṣṭha ḥ svapne'paśyaccakeśavam |
śyāmaṃ virajapadmākṣaṃ smerāsyaṃ pītavāsasam ||52||
svarṇakuṇḍalamaṣjīrakirīṭojjvalavigraham |
kaustubhodbhāsitoraskaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ||53||
caturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ prabhum |
samastair lakṣaṇair  yuktaṃ svarṇayajṣopavītinam ||54||
samprāpya darśanaṃ svapnesaviprojagatīpateḥ |
kṛtāṣjalistamastauṣīdromāṃ citatanurmudā ||55||
tubhyaṃ namo’stu jagataḥ sakalasyabhartresallokaśokabhayarogavināśanāya |
nārāyaṇāyakamalāhṛdayapriyāyadharmārthakāmaparamāmṛtadāyatubhyam ||56||
pāpāni caiva sakalānimayā kṛtānimattenamohavaśagenasadāmurāre |
tasmād vibhemijagadaṃ bunidhergabhīrānmāmuddharasvanijabhaktitarīṃ pradāya ||57||
jānāmiyadyapihareduritaṃ manuṣyovyāmohamāśucalabhebhuvikaiṭabhāre |
pāpaṃ tathāpi camudāsatataṃ karomitasmānnako'pyahamivāstijanovimūḍhaḥ ||58||
puṇyadrumaḥ sukhaphalaṃ sahasaivadhattekiṃ vedminetinṛharekṛtapātako'ham |
puṣpadrumārpaṇavidhaunamamāstivittaṃ nāthaprasīdabhagavankimahaṃ karomi ||59||
tvatpādapadmayugalaṃ paramāmṛ tasya sthānaṃ vihāyamamacittamadhuvrato'yam |
nārīmukhaṃ vrajatidevamṛtipradaṃ yacchleṣmaprakīrṇamaniśaṃ kamalabhrameṇa ||60||
pāṇiḥ pradānarahito'nṛtabhāṣivaktraṃ karṇaucapāpaśravaṇāyasadaivadakṣau |
doṣānimānmamahareharasevakasyayasmānnunāthaśaraṇāgatadoṣahaṃ tā ||61||
saṃsāraghorajaladhaunṛharekadācittvadbhaktinaurihamayāsudṛḍhācalabdhā |
tatrāpidaivavaśago'hamahodurātmāvarteta evasatataṃ mamaduḥkhakālaḥ ||62||
saṃsārapāragamanāyalasatpatho'stikiṃ sarvaduḥkharahitaḥ sadayaḥ prasannaḥ |
aṃ dhīkṛ tasya mamamohamahattamisrair dṛṣṭistvayīhanakadāpi cayātiviṣṇo ||63||
pāpātmano'pimamacittamidaṃ murārenaṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭajanakaṣṭavinaṣṭikāri |
yastvāṃ samastasuravanditapādapadmasvapne'pikeśimathanādyavibhosamīkṣe ||64||
vyāsa uvāca—
iti tena stuto devo bhagavān kamalā-patiḥ |
uvāca— vākyaṃ vākyajṣaḥ saṃsārārṇava-tārakaḥ ||65||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
bhaktibhistavaviprendratuṣṭo'haṃ nityameva ca |
tasmāt tavācireṇaivasarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ||66||
pāpino'pitavoddhāromayāpūrvaṃ kṛtodvija |
adhunāmamabhakto'sinavipattirbhaviṣyati ||67||
brāhmaṇa uvāca— --
ko'haṃ tasthaupurāviṣṇokiṃ vāpāpaṃ mayākṛtam |
pāpino'pimamoddhāraḥ kathaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayākṛtaḥ ||68||
 saṃsāre 'smin kathaṃ jātojanito'haṃ kathaṃ tvayā |
etat sarvaṃ vibhobrūhiyatastvaṃ sadayaḥ sadā ||69||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
aprakāśyamidaṃ guhyaṃ yadyapidvija-sattama |
tathāpi tavavātsalyānnigadāminiśāmaya ||70||
purātvaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhapakṣivaṃ śasamudbhavaḥ |
bhūto'sibhūmibhāgeṣunijakarmavipākataḥ ||71||
kṣudhayātṛṣayāvāpisatataṃ vyākulobhavān |
babhrāmabhakṣayankīṭānnirjharoṣṇodakaṃ tathā ||72||
nānāduḥkhaṃ sadābhuṃ janpakṣiyonausamudbhavaḥ |
caturvarṣasahasrāṇisthito'sitvaṃ purākṣitau ||73||
ekadākulabhadrākhyobrāhmaṇaḥ sarvatatvavit |
pūjayāmāsamāṃ bhaktyānaivedyādyair nadītaṭe ||74||
samabhyarcyasaviprendromamanaivedyataṃ dulam |
yayau tatra ivanikṣipyabhūya evanijaṃ gṛham ||75||
tatovṛkṣātsamāgatyakṣudhināpakṣiṇātvayā |
mamanaivedyasambandhibhakṣitaṃ sarvataṃ dulam ||76||
bhuktvaivasadyomukto'sipātakair atidāruṇaiḥ |
kadācitprāptakālastvaṃ kāladharmagatodvija ||77||
tvāmānetuṃ mayādūtāḥ preṣitāḥ sarvathānijāḥ |
tatorathesamāropyabhavantaṃ naṣṭakalmaṣam ||78||
sadyodūtagaṇāḥ sarvesamāyātāḥ paraṃ padam |
yugakoṭisahasrāṇisthito'simamasannidhau ||79||
bhuṃ jansukhānisarvāṇidurllabhānisurair api |
tatoyāto'siviprendraviśuddhebrāhmaṇānvaye ||80||
tatrāpimayibhaktistejātātisudṛḍhāpunaḥ |
kriyā-yogenamāṃ nityaṃ samārādhyadvijottama ||81||
āyuṣoṃ tematprasādānmāmakaṃ padamāpsyasi |
yadātuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ viprasapāpātmāpimuktibhāk ||82||
kadācid yasya ruṣṭosmipuṇyātmāpi capāpabhāk |
tasmād brāhmaṇabhadraṃ tebhakto'simamasuvrata ||83||
dāsyāmiteparaṃ sthānaṃ yadalabhyaṃ surair api |
brāhmaṇa uvāca— --
tvatprasādācchrutaṃ nāthapūrvavṛttāntamātmanaḥ ||84||
idānīṃ śrotum icchāmiyatkiṣcidbrūhitatprabho |
kasyatuṣṭo'sidevendrakasyaruṣṭo'sivāprabho ||85||
mahatyākṛpayāsarvametanmevaktumarhasi |
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
karmaṇāyenaviprendratuṣṭirmehṛdijāyate ||86||
krodhaścatatsamastaṃ cakathayāmi samāsataḥ |
yodayāvāndvija-śreṣṭha sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā ||87||
ahaṃ kāravihīnaśca tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
karmakuryānmadarthaṃ yodharmabhaktisamanvitaḥ ||88||
brūtemadarthaṃ yaḥ śāntaṃ tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
miṣṭaṃ vastusamāsādyadatvāmeyaścamānavaḥ ||89||
mānāpamānesadṛśas tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
sarvabhūtaśarīrasthaṃ yomāṃ jānātimānavaḥ ||90||
parahiṃsā-vihīnoyas tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
karmāṇikurute  yas tu suvicāryapunaḥ punaḥ ||91||
gobrāhmaṇahitaiṣīyas tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
svayaṃ niruktaṃ vacanaṃ yatnādyaḥ paripālayet ||92||
prapannaṃ yātiyatnādyas tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
dadātyanupakāribhyodānānidvija-sattama ||93||
mayicittaṃ sadā yasya tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
karmaṇāyenatuṣṭo'sminiruktaṃ tatsamāsataḥ ||94||
ruṣṭo'smikarmaṇāyenavipravacmiśṛṇu ṣvatam |
parahiṃsā-rato yas tu nir ddayaḥ sarvajaṃ tuṣu ||95||
ahaṃ yuḥ sarvadākruddhaḥ samāṃ nayatiśatrutām |
asatyabhāṣīkrūraścaparaniṃ dāparastuyaḥ ||96||
kavivartanavidhvaṃsīsamāṃ nayatiśatrutām |
adṛṣṭadoṣaupitaraustrībhrātṛbhaginī tathā ||97||
mohāttyajatiyomūḍhaḥ samāṃ nayatiśatrutām |
pitṛ-bhirbhartsanaṃ  yas tu kurute mūḍhadhīrnaraḥ ||98||
gurvavajṣākaroviprasamāṃ nayatiśatrutām |
ārāmacchedinoye cajalāśayavilāyinaḥ ||99||
grāmanāśakarāye catemāṃ nayanti śatrutām |
parastriyaṃ samālokyaviṣādaṃ yāntiyejanāḥ ||100||
śṛṇvanti pāpacarcāṃ cateṣāṃ ruṣṭosmy ahaṃ sadā |
dviṣanti nāthaṃ yemūḍhā anāthasvaṃ haranti ye ||101||
viśvāsaghātinoye cateṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
ye cagovīryahaṃ tārovṛṣalīpatayaścaye ||102|||
aśvatthaghātinoye cateṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ madhyeyebhedakāriṇaḥ ||103||
paradārātiraktāyeteṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
ekādaśyāṃ bhuṃ jateyelobhātpāpadhiyonarāḥ ||104||
vedaniṃ dākarāye cateṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
pāpabuddhiratāye camitradroharatās tathā ||105||
dhātrītaruṃ cayeghnanti teṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
divasemaithunaṃ ye cakurvatekāmamohitāḥ ||106||
rajasvalāstriyāṃ caiva teṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
yecādṛṣṭārtavāṃ nārīṃ mohādgacchanti sattama ||107||
vratasthāṃ casadājālmāstemāṃ nayanti śatrutām |
amāvāsyātithauye cakurvateniśibhojanam ||108||
bhojanadvayamevārketeṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
āmiṣaṃ maithunaṃ tailamamāvāsyādinedvijāḥ ||109||
nayetyajanti viprendrateṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
bahunātrakimuktenasaṃ kṣepāttevadāmyaham ||110||
nindanti vaiṣṇavānye cateṣāṃ ruṣṭo’smy ahaṃ sadā |
vyāsa uvāca—
ityuktvābhagavānviṣṇuradṛśyaḥ sahasā'bhavat ||111||
sacavipraḥ samuttasthautyaktanidrastumaṃ cataḥ |
keśavoktenavākyenasaviprohari-bhaktikṛt ||112||
saṃ tyajyasakalaṃ kāryaṃ kriyā-yogarato'bhavat |
nārāyaṇasyanaivedyaṃ bhuṃ jato'piphalaṃ tvidam ||113||
haripūjākṛtāṃ puṃ sāṃ najānekiṃ bhavediti |
samāsenabravīmitvāṃ śṛṇu sattamajaimine ||114||
sakṛtkṛtvāhareḥ pūjāṃ prāpyateparamaṃ padam|
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ lokepūjātatrāpi cakriṇaḥ ||115||
bhaktistatrāpiviprendradurllabhāparikīrtitā ||116||
saṃsārābdhiṃ sarva-duḥkha-prapūrṇaṃ 
tartuṃ vāṣchā yasya citte’sti puṃsaḥ |
bhaktyā nityaṃ vāsudevasya pūjāṃ 
kuryād āryaḥ karmaṇāṃ so'khilānām ||117||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre 
ekonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||19|| 

(20)
viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

vyāsa uvāca—
viṣṇu-pūjā-phalaṃ vipra saṅkṣepāt kathitaṃ mayā |
idānīṃ vacmi dānāni niśāmaya samāhitaḥ ||1||
dānaṃ tapodvayormadhyedānamekaṃ paraṃ smṛtam |
tapasāpāpam ity uktaṃ napāpodānakarmaṇi ||2||
tapaḥ kṛtayuge śreṣṭhaṃ tretāyāṃ dhyānam eva ca |
saparyādvāpareśreṣṭhādānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kalau yuge  ||3||
tasmāt kaliyuge dānaṃ prītayekamalāpateḥ |
kartavyaṃ satataṃ prājṣair ricchadbhiḥ paramaṃ padam ||4||
kalayākalayācandrakalāṃ saṃ vardhate tathā |
dānasyasāgatiḥ proktātapasaścamanīṣibhiḥ ||5||
palādapidvija-śreṣṭha kartavyovittasaṅgrahaḥ |
saṃ citaṃ tudhanaṃ prājṣodānakarmaṇisaṃ kṣipet ||6||
dhanesthitopiyomartyonāśnātinadadātiyaḥ |
daridraḥ sacavijṣeyodānabhogavivarjitaḥ ||7||
vittaṃ kenasahāyātiyātitenatukodvija |
āyātitatpurādattamihapaṣcatvamāgate ||8||
datvādatvāsadādānaṃ mānavāyedaridrati |
natedaridrāvijṣeyāḥ paralokemaheśvarāḥ ||9||
dhanaṃ rakṣanti kārpaṇyādyetejṣeyāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ |
ante tyaktvā ca tat sarvaṃ nirāśā yānti jaimine ||10||
para-loke dvija-śreṣṭhaḥ sādhu-sadvala-varjitaḥ |
nir dhane bandhu-hīne ca nādattam upatiṣṭhate ||11||
stokaṃ stokaṃ ca viprendra bhakti-śraddhā-samanvitaḥ |
nityaṃ deyāni dānāni vaiṣṇavair  nija-bhaktitaḥ ||12||
sarveṣām eva dānānām anna-dānaṃ dvijottama |
jala-dānaṃ ca tattva-jṣair  atiśreṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitam ||13||
vinānnena na tiṣṭhanti prāṇā deheṣu dehinām |
annadaḥ prāṇa-do jṣeyaḥ prāṇadaḥ sakala-pradaḥ ||14||
tasmāt  samasta-dānānām annado labhate phalam |
anna-dāna-samandānaṃ jala-dānaṃ ca jaimine ||15||
vinā toyena nānnaṃ syād atas toyaṃ pradīyate |
kṣudhā-tṛṣāpi viprendra dve tulye tu prakīrtite ||16||
tasmād  datvā ca toyaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ proktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ |
jīvanaṃ jīvanaṃ nṝṇāṃ jīvanaṃ na ca jīvanam ||17||
ato jīvana-rakṣārthaṃ jīvanaṃ prājṣa utsṛjet |
annaṃ toyaṃ ca viprendra dattaṃ yena mahītale ||18||
tena sarvāṇi dānāni kṛtāni nātra saṃśayaḥ |
anna-dānasya māhātmyaṃ jaladānasya vai śṛṇu ||19||
babhūva hāstinapure kuberaiva vittavān |
tasmin nevapureveśyābabhūvasurasundarī ||20||
khyātāratividagdhetisarvalakṣaṇasaṃ yutā |
tatra kṣemaṃ karīnāmabrāhmaṇīśreṣṭhavaṃ śajā ||21||
samastaguṇasampannāvidhavāsīddvijātmajā |
sābrāhmaṇīdvija-śreṣṭha jārānuraktamānasā ||22||
niṣiddhaṃ karmakurvantī  tyaktvā yātyavivekatām |
tayāsaṃ nihitāvipraveśyāpibāhmaṇīcasā ||23||
cakārasakhyaṃ snehenaveśyāvṛttimupetyasā |
sāveśyābrāhmaṇīcāpidve'pyekatradinedine ||24||
pāpānicakratuḥ prītyā asaṃ khyātānijaimine |
tatoratividagdhāsāvṛddhabhāvamupāgatā ||25||
brāhmaṇīcāpiviprendraduḥśīlātyanta-pāpinī |
kadācidvāramukhyāsājarantī tāṃ nijāṃ sakhīm ||26||
prāhetivismitāvipravacanaṃ vinayānvitā |
ratividagdhovāca -
sakhitvayāsahānekaṃ dāruṇaṃ pātakaṃ kṛtam ||27||
adyāpipātakedṛṣṭirmahatīvartatemama |
saundaryaṃ cabalaṃ caiva sarvaṃ mejarayāhṛtam ||28||
itthamasvāsthyakṛnnityamāśāṃ tyaktuṃ naśakyate |
sthāvaraṃ sumahatprāptaṃ kṛtapātakayāmayā ||29||
samāgatamivaitarhisamīkṣyamaraṇaṃ gatam |
upārjitenapāpenayānivittānivaimayā ||30||
rakṣiṣyaṃ tyanapatyāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ mayitānike |

gaṅgāyāḥ śubha-māhātmyaṃ viṣṇu-pūjāphalaṃ tathā |
annadānasya-māhātmyaṃ jaladānasyacottamam ||1||
viprapādodakasyāpi-māhātmyaṃ pāpa-nāśanam |
tvatprasādācchrutaṃ sarvaṃ setihāsaṅguromayā ||2||
idānīṃ muniśārdūlaśrotum icchāmisādaram |
ekādaśyāḥ phalaṃ sarvaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ||3||
kasmād ekādaśīśreṣṭhātasyāḥ kovāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
kadācikriyatekiṃ vāphalaṃ tasyāvadasvame ||4||
kāvāpūjyatamā tatra devatāsadguṇārṇava |
akurvataḥ syātkodoṣastanmevaktumihārhasi ||5||
vyāsa uvāca—
ekādaśyāḥ phalaṃ sarvaṃ vaktuṃ nārāyaṇādṛte |
śaknotinānyoviprarṣetasmād vacmisamāsataḥ ||6||
sṛṣṭvādaupuruṣaśreṣṭhaḥ saṃsāraṃ sacarācaram |
sarveṣāṃ damanārthāyasṛṣṭavānpāpapūruṣam ||7||
dvijātihatyāmūrdhānaṃ madirāpānalocanam |
svarṇasteyaṃ ca vadanaṃ gurutalpagatiḥ śrutiḥ ||8||
strīhatyānāsikaṃ caiva gohatyādoṣabāhukam |
nyāsāpahāraṇagrīvaṃ bhrūṇahatyāgalaṃ tathā ||9||
parastrīgatavukkāgraṃ suhṛllokavadhodaram |
śaraṇāpannahatyādinābhigartāvadhiṃ kaṭim ||10||
guruniṃ dāsakthibhāgaṃ kanyāvikrayaśephasam |
viśvāsavākyakathanaṃ pāyuṃ prītivadhāṃ ghrikam ||11||
upapātakaromāṇaṃ mahākāyaṃ bhayaṃ karam |
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ piṃ ganetraṃ svāśrayātyanta-duḥkhadam ||12||
taṃ dṛṣṭvāpāpapuruṣamatyugraṃ puruṣottamam |
sadayaścintayāmāsaprajākleśaharaḥ prabhuḥ ||13||
sṛṣṭo'yaṃ durjanaḥ krūraḥ svāśrayakleśadāyakaḥ |
prajānāṃ damanārthāyasṛjāmye tasya kāraṇam ||14||
athāsaubhagavānviṣṇurbabhūvasvayamaṃ takaḥ |
sasarjarauravādīṃ ścanirayānpāpiduḥkhadān ||15||
pāpaṃ yaḥ sevatemūḍho nayātiparamaṃ padam |
yamājṣayāvrajet tatra narakaṃ rauravādikam ||16||
ekadābhagavānviṣṇuḥ prajānāṃ duḥkhanāśanaḥ |
vainateyaṃ samāruhyajagāmayamamandiram ||17||
taṃ dṛṣṭvājagatāmīśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam |
dhūpādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsabhāskaristuṣṭamānasaḥ ||18||
yamenābhyarcitoviṣṇuḥ sarva-lokaikanāyakaḥ |
uvāsadvijaśārdūlapīṭhekanakanirmite ||19||
tatropaviṣṭobhagavānyamenasahadaityahā |
śuśrāvakraṃ danaṃ dhyānaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśiprabho ||20||
athāsaukamalākāṃ tovismayāviṣṭamānasaḥ |
uvācetiyamaṃ teṣāṃ kuto'yaṃ kraṃ danadhvaniḥ ||21||
yama uvāca—
devapātakinomartyāniraye'tyanta-duḥkhade |
svahastārjitadoṣeṇasīdanti camamālaye ||22||

mayisthite'pinarakesīdaṃ tyekāntaduḥkhade ||26||

tasmād ekādaśīṃ viṣṇomūrtiṃ viddhiparātmanaḥ |
samastaduṣkṛtiśreṣṭhaṃ vratānāṃ vratamuttamam ||29||
ekādaśīṃ tithiṃ kṛtvāpāvayantī ṃ jagat-trayam |
śaṃ kitaḥ pāpapuruṣo viṣṇuṃ stotumupāyayau ||30||
tatobaddhāṣjalirbhaktyāsapāpapuruṣodvija |
tuṣṭāvakamalākāntaṃ bhagavaṃ taṃ janārdanam ||31||
 tasya stavaṃ samākarṇyaprasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
uvācāhaṃ prasanno'smikiṃ te'bhimatamucyatām ||32||

sṛṣṭobhagavatāviṣṇonijānugrahaduḥkhadaḥ |

tanmekathayadeveśatvayāsṛṣṭo'smyahetukaḥ ||42||
vyāsa uvāca—
ityuktvā pāpapuruṣaḥ kleśanāśanamacyutam |
bhūmaunipatyacakraṃ dasravadvāṣpavilocanaḥ ||43||
tataḥ prahasyabhagavānmadhukaiṭabhamardanaḥ |
ekādaśībhayāttrastam uvāca—pāpapūruṣam ||44||
śrī-bhagavān uvāca—
uttiṣṭhapāpapuruṣatyajaśokaṃ mudaṃ kuru |

nārāyaṇayaśogītaṃ pratikaṃ ṭhaṃ viniḥsṛtam |
śrutvāmūḍhānatṛpyanti śvānovīṇākvaṇaṃ yathā ||130||
santo harṣaṃ samāyānti śrutvāgītaṃ jagatpateḥ |
samastapāpavidhvaṃsivīṇākvāṇaṃ yathā mṛgāḥ ||131||
gāyaṃ taṃ harigītāninṛtyanti nṛtyamuttamam |
tṛpyanti vratinodṛṣṭvātṛpyanti kamalāpateḥ ||132||
vratinoyenatṛpyanti viṣṇor āyatanedvija |
pratijanmanivaiteṣāṃ paśutāśāśvatībhavet ||133||
nayegītānigāyanti vratinoharivāsare |
vihīnāvacanaistecabhramanti pratijanmani ||134||
mṛdaṃ gādīnivādyānikartatyānihareḥ puraḥ |
yatovādyair bhavettuṣṭobhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ ||135||
kurvanti  jāgaraṃ viṣṇor vedādhyayanamuttamam |
purāṇapaṭhanaṃ vāpikartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavair janaiḥ ||136||
rāmāyaṇaṃ bhāgavataṃ bhārataṃ vyāsabhāṣitam |
anyānicapurāṇānipāṭhyāniharivāsare ||137||
ye paṭhanti puroviṣṇor yeśṛṇvantiharerdine |
pratyakṣarelabhaṃ tetekapilādānajaṃ phalam ||138||
niśijāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsānaṃ dovaiṣṇavojanaḥ |
jitanidrobhavetsamyagdhyāyatekeśavaṃ hṛdā ||139||
pradakṣiṇākāratayābhūyobhūyoharerddine |
nipatyadaṇḍavadbhūmaupraṇameccajanārddanam ||140||
tataḥ prabhātevimalekṛtapaṣcamahādhvaraḥ |
hariṃ saṃ snāpyadugdhenapūjayedbhaktimānvratī ||141||
vra tasya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyānnijaśaktyādvijanmane |
tatastudvādaśīmadhyevratīpāraṇamācaret ||142||
pāraṇaṃ kurute  yas tu vilaṃ ghyadvādaśītithim |
janmakoṭyarjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya caiva vinaśyati ||143||
dvādaśītithimadhyetukartavyaṃ pāraṇaṃ budhaiḥ |
nakadācittrayodaśyāṃ vra tasya phalamicchubhiḥ ||144||
upavāsadinevipraniśāyāmapivaiṣṇavaḥ |
upavāsaphalaprepsuryatnātsvāpaṃ vivarjayet ||145||
vinājāgaraṇaṃ nūnamupavāsonirarthakaḥ |
atojāgaraṇaṃ kāryyamubhayorapipakṣayoḥ ||146||
ekādaśī-vrataṃ yenavidhinānenakurvate |
satyaṃ satyaṃ dvija-śreṣṭha sarvetemokṣagāminaḥ ||147||
janma-mṛtyu-haraṇaika-nidānaṃ sendra-deva-nikarair  api kāryam |
vāsudeva-divasa-vrata-sāraṃ jaimine tvam aniśaṃ kuru yatnāt ||148||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre 
ekādaśī-māhātmye dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||22||

 yas tu dhātrīphalaṃ bhuṃ ktemānavo'khilatatvavit |
taddehābhyantar- asthāyisarvaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati ||60||
dhātrīphalamayīṃ mālāṃ yovaheddvija-sattama |
bravīmiśṛṇu -māhātmyaṃ sarva-pāpaharaṃ param ||61||
śmaśāne'piyadāmṛtyus tasya syāddaivayogataḥ |
gaṅgāmaraṇajaṃ puṇyaṃ samprāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ||62||
taṃ dṛṣṭvāpāpinaḥ sarvepāpajālaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ |
sadya evapramucyaṃ tejanmakoṭi-śatair api ||63||
nityaṃ gṛhṇātivipredrayodhātrīphalakarddamam |
dine dinelabhetpuṇyaṃ samprāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ||64||
dhātrītaruṃ cayo hanti sarvadevagaṇāśrayam |
sadadātihareraṃ geghātaṃ nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ ||65||
sarvadevamayīdhātrīviśeṣātkeśavapriyā |
samyagvaktuṃ guṇaṃ tasyābrahmaṇāpinaśakyate ||66||
dhātryāstulasyāvidadhātibhaktiṃ yomānavojṣātasamastatatvaḥ |
bhuktvācabhogānsakalāṃ statoṃ 'tesamuktimāpnotihareḥ prasādāt ||67||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre 
tulasī-māhātmyaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||24|| 

(25)
paṣcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

jaiminir uvāca—
bhūya evamahābhāgatulasyāḥ pāpa-nāśanam |

kṛtāniyānipāpāniāvābhyāṃ mohataḥ purā ||17||
tānisarvāṇinaṣṭānitvatpādayugadarśanāt |
bhavānnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣātpūjanīyo'marair api ||18||
samyaktepūjanaṃ kartuṃ kimāvāṃ mānuṣaukṣamau |
atitheryākṛtāpūjāte'smābhirnijaśaktitaḥ ||19||
anayābhavasuprītaḥ kṣamasvadoṣamāvayoḥ |
ityuktvātaumahātmānautasyāganto ḥ padadvaye |
nipetaturdvija-śreṣṭha va yasya ugṛhamedhinau ||20||
vyāsa uvāca—
tatobhaktyāsusaṃ tuṣṭolomaśoviduṣāṃ varaḥ |
yuvāṃ vinayināṃ śreṣṭhaudvijāgryaudharma-tat-parau ||21||
āpyāyito'smisutarāṃ yuvayorvinayoktibhiḥ |
sākṣādbrahmāśivo viṣṇuratithiḥ procyatebudhaiḥ ||22||
 tasmin netāvatībhaktiryuvayorastumaṅgalam |
ārādhito'smy ahaṃ samyagatithirbhūribhojanaiḥ ||23||
vyāsa uvāca—
tatautthāyatauviprautatpādakamaladvaye |
bhūyo'pitaṃ namaskṛtyaprāhaturlomaśaṃ munim ||24||
brāhmaṇāvūcatuḥ |
brahmannatithipūjāyā-māhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasi |

ko'tithiḥ procyateloke tasya pūjācakīdṛśī |

vānaprasthobrahmacārībhikṣuścaiṣāṃ prapūjanāt |

taiścātithīnāṃ kartavyāpūjābhaktisamanvitaiḥ ||28||

āśramācārato'bhraṣṭāstatastegṛhiṇomatāḥ ||29||
vaṃ hatyatithipūjāyāṃ dakṣatāṃ gṛhiṇoyadi |
tadāprayojanaṃ teṣāṃ kimanyaiḥ puṇyakarmabhiḥ ||30||
 yasya naśrūyatenāmanacagotraṃ nacasthitiḥ |
akasmād gṛhamāgacchetso'tithiḥ procyatebudhaiḥ ||31||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāvāpivaiśyāvāvṛṣalās tathā |

cāṇḍālapramukhāye'nyehīnavarṇasamudbhavāḥ |

yadikarmavipākenagṛhībhavati vittavān |

tṛṇābhāvenavaibrūyādbhūbhautiṣṭhetibhakti## ||38||

 tatra durgrahasaṃ cārāddvādaśābdaṃ cavāsavaḥ |

 tasmin mahatidurbhikṣelokāstaddeśavāsinaḥ |

jñānabhadromahāyogīyuge dvāpara saṃjṣake |

kṣudhākulānsutāndṛṣṭvādārāṃ ścadvijasaṃmatau |

e tasmin nantareviprameghair nnīlapadair iva |
āvṛtegaganevṛṣṭirmahāsārair babhūvaha ||55||

 tasmin rājyetudurbhikṣaṃ vinaṣṭamabhavattataḥ |

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāre paṣcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||25|| 

(26)
ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ 

jaiminir uvāca—
kalau yuge mahābhāgasamāyātesudāruṇe |
bhaviṣyanti janāḥ sarvekīdṛśāstadvadasvame ||1||
vyāsa uvāca—
ādyaṃ satyayugaṃ prāhus tatra viprādayojanāḥ |
nārāyaṇārcanaparāḥ śokavyādhivivarjitāḥ ||2||
satyoktibhāṣiṇaḥ sarvesadayādīrghajīvinaḥ |
dhanadhānyādisampannāiṃ haṃ sādambhavivarjitāḥ ||3||
paropakaraṇāś caiva sarvaśāstravidas tathā |
evaṃ vidhāḥ satyayuge sarvelokā dvijottama ||4||
rājadharmagrāhiṇaścabhūpālājanapālanāḥ |
ahosatyayugasyāstikovyākhyātuṃ guṇaṃ yaśaḥ ||5||
adharmoccāraṇaṃ yatra janāḥ ke'pinakurvate |
tretāyuge samāyātedharmaḥ pādonakaṃ gataḥ ||6||
alpaśokānvitālokāḥ kecit kecidaghāśrayāḥ |
viṣṇudhyānaratālokāyajṣadānaparāyaṇāḥ ||7||
varṇāśramācāraratāḥ sukhinaḥ svasthacetasaḥ |
kṣetrabhūmikṛtaḥ śūdrāḥ sarvebrāhmaṇasevinaḥ ||8||
brāhmaṇāścamahātmānovedavedāṅgapāragāḥ |
pratigrahanivṛttāścasatyasandhājitendriyāḥ ||9||
tapovrataratānityaṃ dātāroviṣṇusevinaḥ |
tretāyugasyāvasānedvāpareyugaāgate ||10||
dvipādahīnodharmaḥ syātsukhaduḥkhānvitānarāḥ |
kecit kecitpāparatāḥ kecit kecic cadharmiṇaḥ ||11||
kecit kecidguṇair  hīnāḥ kecit kecinmahāguṇāḥ |
atyantaduḥkhinaḥ kecit kecic casukhinas tathā ||12||
pratigrahebrāhmaṇaścakadācitkurute spṛhām |
bhūbhujair dhanalobhenakadācitpīḍyateprajā ||13||
viṣṇu-pūjāparāviprāḥ śūdrāścadvijasevinaḥ |
yadāyuge yuge dharmaḥ pādonatāṃ gatodvija ||14||
tadāvyāsoviṣṇurūpīvedabhāgaṃ cakāraha |
kalau yuge caviprendrasarva-pāpaikarmandire ||15||
ekapādobhaveddharmaḥ sarvepāparatājanāḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣattriyāvaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ pāpaparāyaṇāḥ ||16||
atyanta-kāminaḥ krūrābhaviṣyanti kalau yuge  |
vedaniṃ dākarāś caiva dyūtacauryakarās tathā ||17||
vidhavāsaṅgamagnāścabhaviṣyanti kalau yuge  |
vṛttyarthabrāhmaṇāḥ kecinmahākapaṭadharmiṇaḥ ||18||
sarvestraiṇābhaviṣyanti mādakadravyasevinaḥ |
sadā strīyoniniratāḥ paradravyaṃ haranti ca ||19||
parānnalolupānityaṃ tapovrataparāṅmukhāḥ |
pākhaṇḍasaṅgabaddhāścabhaviṣyanti kalau yuge  ||20||
raktāmbarābhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇāḥ śūdradharmiṇaḥ |
kalauyāsyanti nirvṛttāuttamā atinīcatām ||21||
nīcāścadhanasampannāyāsyaṃ tyuccapadaṃ prati |
pradāsyaṃ tyupakāribhyodānānisakalājanāḥ ||22||
yatnādapi caneṣyanti vṛṣalāvipravartanam |
mitrasnehādvadiṣyanti kūṭasākṣyaṃ kalaujanāḥ ||23||
adharmabuddhilapanādharmabuddhivilāpinaḥ |
parokṣanindakāḥ krūrāḥ saṃ mukhepriyavādinaḥ ||24||
sādhvīvādaṃ vadiṣyanti bhartāraṃ puṃ ścalīstriyaḥ |
parastrīhiṃ sakāś caiva gotravikrayiṇodvijāḥ ||25||
kanyāvikrayiṇaś caiva bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge  |
strījitāḥ puruṣāḥ sarvestriyo'pyatyanta-caṣcalāḥ ||26||
kalau yuge bhaviṣyanti kalaumartyādurāśayāḥ |
alpasasyāvasumatīmeghāḥ svalpodakās tathā ||27||
akālavarṣiṇaścāpibhaviṣyanti kalau yuge  |
kalauviḍbhojinogāvaḥ svalpakṣīrāścajaimine ||28||
ghṛtahīnaṃ catatkṣīraṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ |
ātmastutiparālokāḥ paraniṃ dāparāyaṇāḥ ||29||
bhaviṣyanti cakharvāṅgābālābahvannabhojanāḥ |
pitṛ-yajṣaṃ kariṣyanti dambhārthaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ kalau ||30||
sarvevacaḥ snehinaḥ syuryāvatkāryaṃ nasiddhyati |
narāndharmaparāndṛṣṭvāsarvecopahasanti vai ||31||
vardhaṃ tyadharmatolokāstasmāt pāparatājanāḥ |
daśadvādaśavarṣecasamūlo'pyetisaṃ kṣayam ||32||
jalasyevabhaviṣyanti yathā varṣāsuvṛddhayaḥ |
tato lokābhaviṣyanti kalaugalitayauvanāḥ ||33||
paṣcamevāpiṣaṣṭhevāvarṣestrīgarbhadhāriṇī |
bahvapatyāścapuruṣābhaviṣyanty atiduḥkhinaḥ ||34||
netukāmāścasarve'pidātukāmānake'pi ca |
kalaumlecchābhaviṣyanti rājānaḥ pāpa-tat-parāḥ ||35||
ekavarṇābhaviṣyanti viṣayārthaṃ kalaujanāḥ |
kaleḥ prathamasamdhyāyāṃ hariṃ nindanti mānavāḥ ||36||
kalermadhyenapaśyanti harernāmānikevale |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣattriyāvaiśyāvṛṣalāścakalau yuge  ||37||
ekavarṇābhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra evaca |
yadāyadādvija-śreṣṭha hāniḥ sukṛtināṃ bhavet ||38||
vṛddhiścapāpināṃ nṝṇāṃ jṣeyāvṛddhistadākalau |
yadyapyayaṃ kalirghoromayāproktodvijottama ||39##||
 tathāpy astimahānasyaguṇoguṇavatāṃ vara |
satyedvādaśabhirvarṣair bhavetpuṇ yasya sādhanam ||40||
tadardhenacatretāyāṃ māsenadvāparebhavet |
ahorātreṇaivaviprabhavettaccakalau yuge  ||41||
tasmāt kaliyuge nṝṇāṃ martyenaivottamāgatiḥ |
dvādaśābdair  yuge 'n yasmin harimabhyarcyayatphalam ||42||
tatphalaṃ labhatemartyoharimuccāryavaikalau |
harernāmaikamap yatra kalauvadatiyonaraḥ ||43||
kalirnabādhatetaṃ casatyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
jaiminir uvāca—
manaḥ śuddhivihīnatvātsamastaṃ karmaniṣphalam ||44||
itipūrvaṃ tvayāproktaṃ manovismayadaṃ mama |
kalausarvebhaviṣyanti manaḥ śuddhivivarjitāḥ ||45||
teṣāṃ yathā bhavetkarmasakalaṃ brūhitadguro |
vyāsa uvāca—
yatiṃ kaṃ citkurute karmamartyodharmaṃ kalau yuge  ||46||
tadarpayenmahāviṣṇaubhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥ |
viṣṇausamarpitaṃ karmasarvam evākṣayaṃ bhavet ||47||
vyāsa uvāca—
ititekathitaṃ sarvaṃ vṛttaṃ brāhmaṇasattama |
yacchrutvābhaktibhāvenanaromokṣamavāpnuyāt ||48||
sūta uvāca—
evaṃ prabodhitastenajaiminiḥ paramātmanā |
kriyā-yogaratobhūtvājagāmaparamaṃ padam ||49||
imaṃ kriyā-yogasāraṃ vyāsenoktaṃ mahātmanā |
ye paṭhanti janābhaktyāśṛṇvanti camumukṣavaḥ ||50||
tesarvepātakair ghorair bahu-janmārjitair api |
vimuktāḥ paramāṃ muktiṃ labhaṃ tenātrasaṃśayaḥ ||51||
yadyadiṣṭaṃ paṭhaṃ tyetacchṛṇvanticamumukṣavaḥ |
labhaṃ tetattadevāśuprasādātkamalāpateḥ ||52||
ślokārdhaṃ ślokamekaṃ vāślokapādamathāpivā |
naraḥ paṭhitvā śrutvācalabhatevāṃ chitaṃ phalam ||53||
likhitvālekhayitvāvāyaḥ śāstramidamarcayet |
saviṣṇu-pūjanasyaivaphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||54||
idamatiśayaguhyaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ vyāsavaktrāddru(dru)ciratarapurāṇaṃ prītidaṃ vaiṣṇavānām |
ciramamaravarādyair vanditāṃ ghrermurāreḥ sakalabhuvanabhartuścakriṇaḥ prītaye'stu ||55||

iti śrī-padma-purāṇe kriyā-yoga-sāra-khaṇḍe vyāsa-jaimini-saṃvāde 
yuga-dharma-nirūpaṇa-pūrvakaṃ purāṇa-māhātmya-varṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||26||
